yakita:LSLZXST_4_1.chapter: 剧情_3_4_洛瑟菈线_生态冒泡_4_1
yakita:LSLZXST_4_1.text: This is bad. This is REAL bad. Director Aalto walked out without even eating the cup noodles!
yakita:LSLZXST_4_1.zh: 坏了坏了，秋水领导没吃杯面就走了！

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_13.chapter: 剧情_2_7主线内主线后生态_7_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_13.text: You mean the missing frequency, right? We've already cross-checked it against Chimera and Cartethyia's frequency samples left here at the Black Shores…
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_13.zh: 是指「鸣式宝石」残缺的那部分频率吧？我们已经与奇美拉，还有卡提希娅在黑海岸留下的频率样本进行了比对……
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_13.speaker: Aalto

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_17.chapter: 剧情_2_7主线内主线后生态_7_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_17.text: Abby? It's a curious case. Even in the deepest databanks of the Black Shores, we found no relevant data...
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_17.zh: 嗯？关于阿布吗？即使在黑海岸最深层的数据库中，我们也没有发现任何与它相关的资料……
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_17.speaker: Aalto

yakita:jiabeilina_shengtai_7_2.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_嘉贝莉娜_2_7_2_1
yakita:jiabeilina_shengtai_7_2.text: The name listed is… A-Aalto? Th-that can't be right.
yakita:jiabeilina_shengtai_7_2.zh: 完成人是……秋、秋水？这、这不对吧？

yakita:BVBHD_30_12.text: (If Encore gets into this, I bet Aalto's wallet won't stand a chance.)
yakita:BVBHD_30_12.zh: （要是让安可知道这个游戏，秋水的钱包恐怕又要大出血了吧。）
yakita:BVBHD_30_12.speaker: Rover

yakita:FavorStory_140301_Content.text:
[…]

One day, Aalto became known for the intel he had on some ancient treasure.

[…]

Days later, an electronic display in the New Federation police department office broadcasted the latest news: the long-sought theft ring had finally been caught.

[…]

Aalto opened the suitcase, took out a single piece of Shell Credit, and flipped it into the air.

[…]
yakita:FavorStory_140301_Content.zh:
这是一次赔本买卖。
至少表面上是这样。

想要买到秋水手中古代秘宝情报的人很多，下至毛头小孩，上至六旬老人纷纷前来报价。
“小朋友，压岁钱不是这么用的，回家去吧。”
“您这养老的钱，我不能收。”
客人们都以为是自己给出的价格不如秋水心意，其实秋水只是在等人。
直到有天，他等到了那位客人。一位包裹严实的客人以令人乍舌的低价拿到了这个情报。
客人们纷纷感叹，秋水糊涂，怎么还做亏本买卖。
数日后，新联邦警局的电子屏上正在播报城内热点新闻，追捕多年的盗窃组织正式缉拿归案。
一团雾气溜进局长的办公室内，遮蔽了电子屏的画面。
“别看了，该结算我们的交易了。”
局长将一沓文件扔到桌上，还有一个装满酬金的手提箱。
“这招请君入瓮一网打尽真是妙。但秋水先生，我很好奇，你怎么断定他们一定会找上门呢？大张旗鼓兜售假的秘宝情报，不担心他们怀疑吗？”
“局长先生太小看追逐利益的赌徒了，为了利益，连命都可以舍弃，何况只是冒点风险呢？”
局长将手提箱和文件往秋水面前一推。
“秋水先生，这是说好的报酬，和你要的名单。合作愉快。”
“合作愉快。”
秋水从箱子中取出一枚酬金，轻轻抛起，待酬金落下，秋水已化作一团雾气渐渐消散。

yakita:Flow_226750000_11.text: Nice pick! You won't regret choosing Aalto's service.
yakita:Flow_226750000_11.zh: 眼光不错，和我交易不会吃亏。
yakita:Flow_226750000_11.speaker: Aalto

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_12_15.text: You recount to Aalto the events that led to your arrival here.
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_12_15.zh: 和秋水详细讲述了刚才的事……

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_12_18.text: Ahem... Anyway, let's not get carried away. We should head to the Greenhouse. The abnormal frequency you collected needs to be uploaded to the Tethys System as soon as possible in order to avoid another Lament in the Port City of Guixu.
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_12_18.zh: 不过现在，我们一起去花房吧。你拿到的东西需要尽快回收到泰缇斯系统，从而解决归墟港市的问题。
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_12_18.speaker: Aalto

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_12_25.text: You hand the antique Youhu gave you over to Aalto.
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_12_25.zh: 将釉瑚转交给自己的古物给了秋水查看……

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_12_26.text: Huh, didn't expect to see it outside Mt. Firmament…
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_12_26.zh: 这东西居然从乘霄山流出来了……
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_12_26.speaker: Aalto

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_12_29.text: Looks like it was also used to record abnormal frequencies in the Port City of Guixu…
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_12_29.zh: 没想到它恰巧还在归墟港市承担了转录异常频率的功能……
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_12_29.speaker: Aalto

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_12_38.text: You tell Aalto about the person you met on the beach…
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_12_38.zh: 和秋水讲述了刚才在海滩上遇到的人……

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_12_39.text: A person in light blue… Could it be the Shorekeeper?
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_12_39.zh: 淡蓝色的身影……守岸人吗？
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_12_39.speaker: Aalto

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_17_55.text: KU-Money is right. Just in case, the Tethys System is very likely to send out a warning to Jinzhou about an imminent Lament in the Port City of Guixu.
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_17_55.zh: 库默尼提醒了我，保险起见，泰缇斯系统可能会向今州发布归墟港市的悲鸣预警。
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_17_55.speaker: Aalto

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_17_66.text: What's going on, Aalto? I never see you this serious.
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_17_66.zh: 不过，怎么你今天突然这么严肃了？有点不太像你……
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_17_66.speaker: KU-Money

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_17_68.text: What's worse, along with the data, we received some terrible news. The Bloom Bearers we sent to the Port City of Guixu… We lost them all.
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_17_68.zh: 漂泊者从归墟港市带来的不只是这份数据，还有其他消息……我们派去归墟港市的人，牺牲了。
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_17_68.speaker: Aalto

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_2191_2.text: But it seems Aalto took the liberty of naming it the "Money Tree."
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_2191_2.zh: 不过似乎被秋水“擅自”命名为“发财树”。

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_21_14.text: Hmm... Aalto didn't plant a flower but a tree. A money tree, I remember…
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_21_14.zh: 唔……他种的好像是一棵树来着……发财树……

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_27_19.text: But more importantly, she died in the Lament that destroyed the Port City of Guixu a few hundred years ago.
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_27_19.zh: 而且最重要的是，她在几百年前那场毁灭了归墟港市的悲鸣中，已经牺牲了。
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_27_19.speaker: Aalto

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_2_23.text: I still have this Blake Bloom that Aalto gave me.
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_2_23.zh: 我还有之前秋水给我的黑花。

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_3_8.text: Oh!? So… y-you're the one Aalto invited earlier?
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_3_8.zh: 嗯！？你……你是那个秋水邀请过的人吗？

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_31_11.text: Encore just did as Aalto said! Encore is usually a good girl.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_31_11.zh: 明明是秋水让安可这么做的，安可平时才不这样呢。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_31_11.speaker: Encore

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_31_51.text: We'll be waiting for you near this Beacon in Whining Aix's Mire! And don't forget to come alone, okay?
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_31_51.zh: 我们会在怨鸟泽信标的附近等你！记得自己一个人来哦！
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_31_51.speaker: Aalto

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_31_52.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_第四章_28_1
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_31_52.text: You track them down and discover they are Consultants for the Black Shores. Aalto strikes a deal to reveal what he knows about you in exchange for your help in recovering a Resonance Beacon from the Court of Savantae Ruins, in Whining Aix's Mire.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_31_52.zh: 你追上了安可和秋水，原来两人正是黑海岸的客卿。秋水与你达成了一笔交易：他会将所知有关你的情报统统告诉你，但你必须要首先去怨鸟泽的稷廷遗址帮助他们回收一个信标。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_31_6.text: Encore and Uncle Aalto won't do anything bad to you...
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_31_6.zh: 铛铛！安可和秋水叔叔不会把你怎么样的……
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_31_6.speaker: Encore

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_32_18.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_第四章_41_1
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_32_18.text: After Aalto and Encore depart, Chixia and the others arrive. You brief them on your deal. Yangyang warns that Whining Aix's Mire hasn't been visited in ages due to treacherous weather and urges caution.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_32_18.zh: 待秋水和安可离开后炽霞等人赶到，你向他们简单告知了情况后便准备前往怨鸟泽。秧秧告诉你因为怨鸟泽的异常天气那里已经很久没人踏足，希望你时刻留意，一路小心。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_33_24.text: Aalto, even Encore can tell what you're up to...
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_33_24.zh: 秋水，你心里的小算盘打得安可都能听到了……
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_33_24.speaker: Encore

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_33_7.text: Aalto, why are you telling bedtime stories now? Is it time to sleep already?
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_33_7.zh: 现在不是睡觉的时间啊？秋水怎么开始讲起睡前故事了？
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_33_7.speaker: Encore

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_35_4.text: That's because Aalto set off the security alarm! And now the gate's closed, hmph!
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_35_4.zh: 秋水，这明明是你之前不小心触发了安保装置，才让大门重新关上了吧……
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_35_4.speaker: Encore

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_51_2.text: ...Uh, no, no no no... Aalto said when it rains like this, we hide!
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_51_2.zh: 不对不对，秋水教过，遇到这种大雨必须要赶快躲起来才行！
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_51_2.speaker: Encore

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_19_61.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_第五章1_2_1
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_19_61.text: You find Taoqi overseeing border defenses. Aalto is also present. The protective barrier against the Retroact Rain is under urgent repair, but the onslaught of Tacet Discords continues. Aalto and Encore must return to the Black Shores to warn of the impending revival of the Threnodian, while those remaining prepare for battle.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_19_61.zh: 你来到城防负责人桃祈处，秋水也在这里。用以抵挡“溯洄雨”影响的防护罩虽然已经在紧急修复，但面对接连袭来的残象潮依然危险。秋水与安可必须立刻赶回黑海岸将今州鸣式即将复苏的警报知会各地。而留下的每个人都将投入到这场与今州共存亡的战斗中。

yakita:LGNCZST_1411_5.text: Mr. Aalto was right. Bloom Bearers attract other Bloom Bearers!
yakita:LGNCZST_1411_5.zh: 秋水师父说得没错。执花与执花之间，果然是会相互吸引的！

yakita:Main_Honami_2_8_2_47_13.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_8_下半_穗波市_3_26
yakita:Main_Honami_2_8_2_47_13.text: The radio suddenly picks up a signal from outside the Sonoro. On a talk show hosted by the Pioneer Association, special guest Aalto recounts an incident he dealt with in Lilyland, where someone attempted to resell the Troupe of Fools' tour tickets at outrageous prices...
yakita:Main_Honami_2_8_2_47_13.zh: 收音机似乎收到了索诺拉之外的信号。先约电台的访谈节目上，特邀嘉宾秋水谈起了他在莉莉兰德解决的一起事件。当时，有人企图高价倒卖愚人剧团巡演的门票……

yakita:Main_Honami_2_8_2_47_4.text: Glad to have you. Mr. Aalto, why don't you start us off with the Lilyland incident?
yakita:Main_Honami_2_8_2_47_4.zh: 秋水先生，请讲讲您在莉莉兰德解决的那起事件吧。

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_11_12.text: Hello, hello! And please, just Aalto is fine. No need for that "honored sir" stuff...
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_11_12.zh: 您好您好，叫我秋水就行！我算不上什么“大人”哈……
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_11_12.speaker: Aalto

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_11_17.text: Cup Noodles? Uh, thanks. And hey, just call me Aalto...
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_11_17.zh: 杯面？谢谢谢谢，不用加“长官”，叫秋水就行……
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_11_17.speaker: Aalto

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_13_14.text: As you can see, Mr. Aalto, this is our signature "Sleep Learning Program."
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_13_14.zh: 秋水审查官，这是本校特色的“睡梦学习法”。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_13_14.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_13_2.text: Shall we sit in for a bit, Mr. Aalto? Before we tour the student projects?
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_13_2.zh: 秋水审查官，不如我们在参观学生项目前稍微旁听一下？
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_13_2.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_16_10.text: Anyway, the New Federation and the majority of the board want to pull the plug immediately and draft a new teaching plan from scratch.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_16_10.zh: 以新联邦为首的大部分董事要求立刻暂停适格者当前的教学计划，讨论新的草案。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_16_10.speaker: Aalto

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_19_4.text: So, whaddya say, Auditor Aalto? How about you order ten as a starter pack!
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_19_4.zh: 怎么样，秋水审查官，我们先定个十辆！
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_19_4.speaker: Lynae

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_20_26.text: Chief Aalto! It was you, wasn't it?! You're the sponsor!
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_20_26.zh: 秋水长官，一定是您赞助的我们吧！
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_20_26.speaker: Sigrika

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_21_9.text: So, Mr. Aalto, shall we move on to the evening's special viewing?
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_21_9.zh: 秋水审查官，我们这就出发进行今晚的特别参观吧？
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_21_9.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_24_2.text: Sorry, Professor, Mr. Aalto... and Club Leader Lenie. I lost control. I'm... I'm really sorry...
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_24_2.zh: 对不起老师、秋水审查官，对不起莱妮社长，我失误了，我……对不起……

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_26_16.text: Change of plans. The New Federation caught wind she was rallying support and moved the review up.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_26_16.zh: 新联邦发现洛瑟菈校长在联系支持者，于是将审查会提前了。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_26_16.speaker: Aalto

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_26_3.text: Fishing for intel. That Mr. Aalto must've put you up to it, right?
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_26_3.zh: 套我的话呀，秋水审查官肯定拜托你了吧？
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_26_3.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_40.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_序幕_11_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_40.text: I'll have Aalto arrange your transportation to Rinascita then.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_40.zh: 那么……我会联系秋水，为你准备前往黎那汐塔的船只。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_0_3_40.speaker: Shorekeeper

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_0_4_10.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_序幕_2_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_0_4_10.text: This is cutting-edge gear from the New Fed World Expo. Nearly lost my shirt haggling for it. Planning to stock up for the Black Shores.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_0_4_10.zh: 这可是新联邦万国博览会上展出的新品，我当时花了好大一番口舌才把价格砍下来，之后我还想给黑海岸批量引进呢。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_0_4_10.speaker: Aalto

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_5.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕下_狂欢节_64_15
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_5.text: Mr. Aalto was right. Bloom Bearers attract other Bloom Bearers!
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_5.zh: 秋水师父说的没错。执花与执花之间，果然是会相互吸引的！

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_91_2.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_16_2
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_91_2.text: So, all available Bloom Bearers have arrived in Rinascita. We're standing guard at Averardo Vault, and Buling is already en route to reinforce Septimont.
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_91_2.zh: 黑海岸所有可出动的执花，均已抵达黎那汐塔。埃弗拉德金库这里有我们协同防守，七丘那边，我们也派出了卜灵他们前去支援。
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_91_2.speaker: Aalto

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_1.text: Indeed... Aalto will head to Xuanfang soon to assist the Goldrunner. In the meantime, we will step up our monitoring of the Somnoire.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_1.zh: 嗯……秋水会尽快前往玄方城帮助那位淘金客的，这段时间，我们也会加紧对心之集域情况的监测。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_1.speaker: Shorekeeper

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_37.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束1_5_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_37.text: You contact Shorekeeper, who informs you that Aalto will soon travel to Xuanfang to assist Jedediah. She has also uncovered information about the New Federation in the Tethys System's database. One detail stands out: Promeus, the New Federation's Sentinel, took no action during the Resonator War. This is at odds with what you know of Sentinels, whose core directive is to "guide civilization" forward. Surely, Promeus should have acted when the situation called for it. With more questions than answers, you turn to your only lead: the battlefield hidden within the Somnoire.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_37.zh: 你与守岸人取得了通讯联系。守岸人告诉你，秋水会尽快前往玄方城帮助那位淘金客。此外，守岸人通过筛查泰缇斯系统的数据，获得了一些关于新联邦的信息。这些信息中值得注意的是，新联邦的岁主普罗米厄在那场共鸣者战争中未采取任何行动。普罗米厄的举止与你熟知的岁主不同，在文明向前的进程中，“引导文明”是岁主的基本逻辑，祂通常会在合适的时机行动才对。谜团越来越多，对你来说，现在唯一的线索就是心之集域里那片战场。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_9_30.text: Mr. Aalto also contacted me and said it will take a few more days for him to reach Xuanfang Hold.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_9_30.zh: 秋水先生联系过我了，他到达玄方城似乎还需要几日的行程。

yakita:NPC_HBGC_59_3.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_32
yakita:NPC_HBGC_59_3.text: Yeah. Mr. Aalto got sent to the New Federation for urgent marine insurance issues, so the application changed at the last minute.
yakita:NPC_HBGC_59_3.zh: 是这样，秋水先生改道新联邦，说是有船险相关的要事处理，所以黑海岸临时变更了申请确认函。

yakita:NPC_HBGC_59_7.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_32
yakita:NPC_HBGC_59_7.text: Sender: Mr. Aalto. Courier: Mr. Wei from Lollo Logistics.
yakita:NPC_HBGC_59_7.zh: 寄件人是秋水先生，承运人是呜呜物流的韦先生。

yakita:Side_HSMY_1_12.text: …Hah, I like your spirit. No wonder Aalto says you're a funny person.
yakita:Side_HSMY_1_12.zh: ……呵，还挺活泼。怪不得秋水也说你是个很有趣的人。
yakita:Side_HSMY_1_12.speaker: Valentina

yakita:Side_HSMY_1_13.text: After the Battle of Norfall Barrens, Tethys issued a new warning based on the data from the battlefield Resonance Beacons and those you provided Aalto and Encore.
yakita:Side_HSMY_1_13.zh: 北落野大战后，泰缇斯系统根据战场信标传来的数据，综合大战前你帮助秋水和安可收集的数据，发布了一项新预警。
yakita:Side_HSMY_1_13.speaker: Valentina

yakita:TZZNQ_4_6.text: Encore, where is Aalto? Is he meddling with things again?!
yakita:TZZNQ_4_6.zh: 安可，秋水呢？是不是他又到处乱按了！

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_18.chapter: 剧情_2_7主线内主线后生态_7_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_18.text: (But in that battle against the Journeying Paradise… Leviathan spoke Abby's name.)
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_18.zh: （在巡游天国战斗时，我曾听到利维亚坦喊出了阿布的名字……）
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_18.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_19.chapter: 剧情_2_7主线内主线后生态_7_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_19.text: (Yet no one else seemed to react. Was it only Abby and I who heard it?)
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_19.zh: （但当时其他人并没有对此有任何反应，难道只有我和阿布听到了这句话吗？）
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_19.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_20.chapter: 剧情_2_7主线内主线后生态_7_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_20.text: (Abby's true identity… Perhaps I'll only uncover it on the road ahead.)
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_20.zh: （阿布的身世……或许，只有在往后的旅途中，我才能找到答案了……）
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_113_20.speaker: Rover

yakita:NPC_LCZ_21_8.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院列车站生态_36_1
yakita:NPC_LCZ_21_8.text: He really lives up to his name... Maybe they can also call him "Abby" for short.

yakita:YangYang_Shengtai_20_3.text: I remember Abby has been looking forward to going back for the food, right? After everything it's been through, it's earned a good meal.
yakita:YangYang_Shengtai_20_3.zh: 我记得阿布一直惦记回今州吃好吃的吧？这一路阿布也很辛苦，找个机会犒劳一下它吧。
yakita:YangYang_Shengtai_20_3.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:InfoDisplay_35000002_Text.text:
[…]

Dear Rover,

How are you finding your time at Startorch Academy?

[…]

In it, I am alone in the Gorges of Spirits, running and running...

[…]

Does that sound like I am complaining?

[…]

Some time ago, my older sister said she wanted to come visit me in Jinzhou.

[…]

I assume by the time you receive this letter, Chixia and I will be on an assignment together.

[…]

Sincerely,
Yangyang

[…]

I've also included some seasonal snacks for Abby.

Do share them with your friends at Lahai-Roi.

[…]
yakita:InfoDisplay_35000002_Text.zh:
漂泊者：
       不知你在星炬学院过得还好么？今天所照拂我的阳光，要隔多久才能到你那儿去呢？
       最近……我偶尔会做一个梦。梦见自己独自一人身处云陵谷，不断地跑着跑着……每当我像是要找到什么的时候，却总会被什么推回到现实中去。
       这段话……像是在发牢骚吗？抱歉，偶尔，也让我写一点吧。
       对了，前段时间，姐姐说要来今州看我。我们之间已经几年没见了，不知道姐姐现在成了什么样，不过我想，按姐姐的性格，应该还是我记忆中的模样吧。如果能介绍你们认识就好了，你们肯定能成为很好的朋友。
       等你收到这封信的时候，我应该就要协助炽霞出任务了。最近今州有些不安宁，但不必担心，就像你已经用了那么多的故事去磨砺自己的剑一样，我想，自我们初见以来，我应该也有所成长。
       所以，等到下次，就由我给你讲述我这次的“冒险”吧，漂泊者。
       秧秧。 

       也给阿布带了些应时的点心，和拉海洛的朋友们一起吃吧，希望能合大家的口味。

yakita:Character_ChangLi_5_1.text: Hey. Why are the people here so divided about Changli?
yakita:Character_ChangLi_5_1.zh: 怎么感觉这里的人对长离的评价那么两极分化啊？
yakita:Character_ChangLi_5_1.speaker: Abby

yakita:HD_CZRGJWJQ_5_17.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局外对话事件_5_1
yakita:HD_CZRGJWJQ_5_17.text: "It went down exactly the way I thought it would. Knew Fenrico was up to no-good right from the start!"
yakita:HD_CZRGJWJQ_5_17.zh: “这电影我猜得果然没错，芬莱克这家伙……哼，我一眼就看出他不是好人！”
yakita:HD_CZRGJWJQ_5_17.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_16.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_序幕_7_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_16.text: Hmm... Wha... Huh? We docked already? Where is Brant and the crew?
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_16.zh: 唔……呼哈……嗯……？已经上岸了吗？布兰特他们呢？
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_16.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_43.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_序幕_7_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_43.text:
You finally arrive at the docks of Ragunna. The troupe bids you farewell, promising to make their grand entrance during the opening of the Carnevale.
As you and Abby search for a way into the city, you witness deacons from the Order sending "the Fools" on a pilgrimage. A mysterious playwright named Cristoforo notices your confusion and begins to explain the origins of this practice.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_0_15_43.zh:
你们终于抵达了拉古那城的接驳码头，游行剧团将你在此放下，与你告别。待到狂欢节开幕，他们将伴随着最浩大的欢呼声入城。
你与阿布在码头寻找着入城之路，偶然目睹了修会的执行者们遣送“愚人”前去朝圣的场景。
一位神秘的剧作家“克里斯托弗”看到了你内心的困惑，向你解释了“朝圣”的来历……

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_26.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_11_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_26.text: It's Phoebe! What's she doing here with all those Echoes?
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_26.zh: 好像是菲比！她怎么会出现在这呢？还和那些声骸在一起？
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_26.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_8_1_18.chapter: 剧情_2_5_七丘主线_下半间章_1_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_8_1_18.text: Abby, what do you think Imperator wants me to find? If Cartethyia's right, the last clues should be somewhere on the Sanguis Plateaus.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_8_1_18.zh: 阿布，你说英白拉多留给我的……会是什么呢？按照卡提希娅的说法，剩余的信息应该就遗留在七丘的桑古伊斯狩原。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_8_1_18.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_8_1_21.chapter: 剧情_2_5_七丘主线_下半间章_1_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_8_1_21.text: I remember Lupa said there's this weird Blightcloud hanging over the Sanguis Plateaus.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_8_1_21.zh: 我记得之前露帕说，桑古伊斯狩原的天上有一片怎么飘都飘不走的「黑潮云」。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_8_1_21.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_395_1.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_呓语镇_2_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_395_1.text: To speed up the search for the False Sovereign, you and Augusta split up. When you contact Buling for help, she explains that the Sovereign has absorbed Murmurstown's chaotic frequencies to mask its own, making it impossible for the Tethys System to locate it. To fix this, you and Abby set out to find a sample of pure Dark Tide frequency.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_395_1.zh: 为了尽快找到伪作的神王，你与奥古斯塔选择分开行动。搜寻途中，你尝试联络卜灵，对方回应称，神王目前已吞噬融合了一部分呓语镇内繁杂紊乱的频率，这一情况导致现有的黑潮样本难以协助泰缇斯系统实现对神王的精准定位。若能设法找到纯净的黑潮频率并将其提供给黑海岸，确认神王的确切坐标将不再是难题。于是，你和阿布打算一同探索小镇，着手寻找相关线索。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_475_13.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_13_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_475_13.text: If anyone can sniff out the truth, it's Abby. But just to be sure, I'll send the data to Buling once we're out of here.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_475_13.zh: 阿布的鼻子不会有错，但以防万一，等离开「索诺拉」之后，我会把记录下来的数据传回给卜灵。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_475_13.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_16_35.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_12_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_16_35.text:
The strange woman you saw in Cristoforo's "illusion" suddenly appears and shoots Cartethyia right before your eyes. She then summons an unfamiliar Tacet Discord that blocks Cantarella's attack before vanishing. You want to go after her immediately, but instead choose to stay and try to revive Cartethyia, clinging to a faint hope... But Cantarella tells you that her frequency has completely vanished.
 
Rage flares within you. You realize that the scene matches what you saw in the "illusion."
 
Just then, Cartethyia's Tacet Mark flickers, sparking a glimmer of hope. Cantarella senses that although Cartethyia's frequency is gone, she is still resonating with something.
 
After steadying yourself, you uncover more anomalies within the Tower. To protect Cartethyia's body, Cantarella takes her to the Fisalia estate, and you and Abby set out to track down the killer.
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_16_35.zh:
颠倒塔中，你曾在“幻境”中见过的神秘女子突然闯入，在你的面前“射杀”了卡提希娅，并召唤出一只古怪的残象，抵挡下坎特蕾拉的攻击后消失不见。虽欲追杀凶手，但你看着怀中的卡提希娅，还是决定先行治疗，为她争夺一线生机……然而，治疗过后，坎特蕾拉只能表示：卡提希娅的频率已经完全消失。
你愤怒地看向凶手离去的方向……却突然意识到，这番情景，与你在“幻境”中所看到的画面几乎完全重合。
而在此时，卡提希娅的声痕突然亮起，本以为这代表着一丝希望，坎特蕾拉却在感应后道出了更加诡异的事实：卡提希娅的频率虽然消失，但她仍在和什么保持着共鸣。
冷静过后，你也在颠倒塔中发现了更多的疑点……为了查明真相，卡提希娅由坎特蕾拉带回家族的宅邸保护，你则与阿布一同飞出颠倒塔，前去追踪凶手的下落。

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_1_2.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_1_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_1_2.text: Mmm—mmm—! Can you smell that? Sweet o' Margherita's Restaurant. C'mon, c'mon, let's go stuff our faces already!
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_1_2.zh: 嗯——嗯——大老远就能闻到玛格烈特餐厅的香气，真想现在就去饱餐一顿。
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_1_2.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_1_20.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_1_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_1_20.text: Look! Over there! Isn't that Brant and Roccia? Wow, the Troupe of Fools is putting on a show!
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_1_20.zh: 你看，那不是布兰特和洛可可他们吗？喔——愚人剧团正在演出呢！
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_1_20.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_1_34.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_1_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_1_34.text:
On your earlier journey through Septimont, you recovered the Sentinel's Relic from the Earthrend Wedge. To unlock it, you returned to the Black Shores seeking Tethys's aid. Its analysis revealed it to be the Civilization Capsule, likely containing the Sentinel's legacy data. But for reasons unknown, it requires the combined forces of both the Sentinel and the Threnodian to open. With no clear solution, you return once again to Ragunna, hoping to find answers from Cartethyia in the Inverted Tower.

Back in Ragunna, however, the atmosphere is thick with a strange tension. The only splash of color comes from a Troupe of Fools performance. As you and Abby pause to watch, Cristoforo's whisper slips into your ear...
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_1_34.zh:
在先前七丘的旅途中，你从彻地之楔处取得了岁主遗留的旧物，为将其打开，你曾回归黑海岸寻求泰缇斯的帮助。而经泰缇斯分析，你得知这个名为「文明之匣」的物件，里面很可能封存了岁主留下的重要底层数据，只是不知为何……它却需要“岁主与鸣式的两股力量”合同才能开启。因此，你再一次回到了拉古那，准备前往颠倒塔寻找卡提希娅，向她询问办法。
再度踏足拉古那城，你与阿布却察觉城中氛围有些异常的压抑，唯有一抹亮色映入眼帘——「愚人剧团」正在演出。你与阿布驻足观看，而克里斯托弗的低语，却不合时宜地在你耳畔传来……

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_64_46.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_狄斯台地主线_上半_巡游天国_1_38
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_64_46.text:
You awaken from the illusion. Your companions are by your side once more, and Galbrena returns atop the back of the Dragon of Dirge.

To reach you, she ignited her own life force, Overclocking her power to tear open the Dark Tide's illusion. Chimera bore part of the cost for her. Meanwhile, when Septimont and your companions were engulfed by the Dark Tide, the Echoes responded to humanity's hope and resolve. They came together in their strongest form to aid. Though the Anchor Stone was destroyed, your companions still followed a different beacon. You, the "Anchor of Hope."

Through the Dark Tide, all of your memories connected. They have learned of Galbrena and Cartethyia's plan too. But Abby can no longer bear the burden of the Gem. Galbrena offers to use her power of devouring to seal the Gem within herself. It is for this very reason that the Fractsidus made her their target.

Cristoforo believed his script to be flawless, but underestimated what small hopes, when united, can become. Now, before the gate of the Paradise, you and your companions stand together. It is time to break it open and cast down the false Divinity that waits beyond.
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_64_46.zh:
自幻境中苏醒后，你看见伙伴们都已赶至你的身旁，嘉贝莉娜也在一只“叹息古龙”的帮助下归来。
先前，为了解救落入黑潮的你，嘉贝莉娜点燃了自己的生命，以超频的状态，强行撕裂了黑潮幻境的隔阂。奇美拉，则为她承担了一部分“超频的代价”。
而另一边，伙伴们在落入黑潮之后，黎那汐塔的声骸们对人类的“希望与决心”做出了回应，将力量聚合为更强的形态保护了他们。虽然此前黑潮中的定向锚被毁，但他们依然循着一个“精神的锚点”，抵达了这里——这个锚点，正是你。
他们也通过黑潮与你共享了记忆，得知了嘉贝莉娜与卡提希娅的计划。但……阿布的状况，已不允许它再吸收鸣式宝石，嘉贝莉娜却在此刻提出，自己能够用“吞噬”的力量，将「宝石」暂时保存在自己的体内。这也是残星会将笔锋对准她的理由。
克里斯托弗认为他的剧本已经足够完美，却忽视了微小希望汇聚出的可能。现在，你与伙伴们正集合与天国的门扉之前——是时候，“砸开”这道天国之门，将那虚伪的神明彻底击溃了。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_10_1.text: By the time we finish looking into this, Yangyang will probably have already left Xuanfang, huh...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_10_1.zh: 等我们调查完，秧秧她已经离开玄方城了吧……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_10_1.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_14.text: Well... let's save the rest of your and Abby's story for dinner. We've still got plenty of time ahead of us.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_14.zh: 那……阿布和你的故事，我们晚餐的时候再聊吧，反正接下来我们还有很长很长的时间。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_14.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_24.text: Trust and understanding... Right. Abby, come say hello.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_24.zh: 信任和了解……嗯，阿布，出来吧。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_25.text: This is my first step in trusting you. Meet my partner, Abby. It usually stays inside my Tacet Mark.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_25.zh: 这也是我信任你，所迈出的第一步。它叫作阿布，是我的伙伴，平时藏在我的声痕里。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_26.text: That's right! Bet you know what Echoes are, right, Lily? Well, I'm one-of-a-kind among 'em!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_26.zh: 没错，莉莉你应该知道声骸吧，本布可是声骸中独一无二的存在哦。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_26.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_27.text: So you've been inside {PlayerName} this whole time... Abby. That's a cute name.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_27.zh: 你一直都在{PlayerName}的体内吗……阿布，真是一个可爱的名字。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_27.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_28.text: C-Cute?! {PlayerName}, you hearing this? Who goes around calling this majestic force of nature that...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_28.zh: 可……可爱，{PlayerName}，很少有人用这个词语形容威猛霸气的本布……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_28.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_32.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束3_13_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_32.text: Lily thanks you for giving Mr. Grimm a chance to reconcile with himself. In return, she shares her diary, which contains valuable information about the train and its soldiers. She tells you that this is the first step in learning to trust you. To reciprocate, you bring out Abby, whom you've kept hidden until now. Drawn to Lily's gentle nature, Abby takes an immediate liking to her.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_32.zh: 莉莉十分感谢你，因为你的那番言语，才让格姆先生有了与自己和解的机会。她将自己的日记分享给你，因为上面记录着许多和列车、战士有关的信息。莉莉表示这是自己信任你迈出的第一步。你为了回报莉莉的信任，于是把一直藏起来的阿布叫了出来。由于莉莉为人温柔，阿布似乎十分亲近她。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_11_10.text: Relax. {PlayerName} ain't alone. I still count, don't I?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_11_10.zh: 放心吧，{PlayerName}可不是一个人，本布不是还在吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_11_10.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_11_6.text: Again with this Somnoire thing? I always feel like there's something weird staring at me in there.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_11_6.zh: 不过……又是心之集域吗？我总感觉里面有股奇怪的视线。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_11_6.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_11_7.text: Don't get all twisted up about it, though! It might just be my imagination.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_11_7.zh: 不过你别担心！这也可能只是我的错觉。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_11_7.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_12_2.text: We made it. Huh? Hold up, {PlayerName}, does this "door" look different to you?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_12_2.zh: 终于到了，诶？{PlayerName}……这“门”是不是和之前的不太一样？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_12_2.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_12_3.text: Yeah... Abby, do you still feel like something's watching us?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_12_3.zh: 嗯……阿布，你说的那股视线还在吗？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_12_4.text: A little. But I can't tell where it's coming from. Maybe I should hide in your Tacet Mark for now.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_12_4.zh: 能感觉到一点点，但我找不到它的方位。既然这样，我还是先藏回声痕吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_12_4.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_12_5.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束1_6_2
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_12_5.text: You arrive at the entrance to the Somnoire, only to find that the gateway has changed. With caution, you and Abby step inside.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_12_5.zh: 你来到心之集域入口处，发现进入心之集域的门发生了变化。阿布和你都抱着谨慎的态度进入了心之集域。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_1.text: Hey, {PlayerName}. Bad dream again? You were yelling your head off just now. I tried shaking you, but you just wouldn't wake up.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_1.zh: 喂，{PlayerName}。又做噩梦了吗？刚刚你一直在房间里大喊大叫，怎么摇你都没有反应。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_1.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_11.text: Could be. But it's just us and Lily on this train. You still think she's behind it?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_11.zh: 的确，但这辆列车上，除了我们，就只有莉莉了，你还是怀疑她吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_11.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_14.text: Honestly, I don't know... Everything we've seen these past few days shows she's a kind, innocent girl. Abby, remember feeling like something was watching us?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_14.zh: 不，我也不知道……这段时间与莉莉相处下来，我们了解的她，只是一个善良单纯的女孩。阿布，你还记得你说过的视线吗？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_16.text: Hmm... don't think so. Lily's too soft for a stare that suffocating.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_16.zh: 嗯……应该不是，莉莉的视线很柔和，没有那么强的压迫感。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_16.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_18.text: Nope. It's almost time for you two to lay the souls to rest, but she's been staying in the conservatory.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_18.zh: 没有，按理来说现在应该是你和莉莉安息亡魂的时间了，可莉莉似乎一直待在花房里。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_18.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_19.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束4_2_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_19.text:
You wake up to find yourself still in your room. After one nightmare after another, you realize that someone has been deliberately interfering with your thoughts. When you ask Abby about the time, it reminds you that you and Lily should be helping souls find peace. Yet the train is unusually quiet today. You soon understand why: only one soul remains aboard.
You and Abby decide to make Lily's final day as happy as possible.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_19.zh: 醒来后，你仍然在自己的房间里。接二连三的噩梦让你意识到，有人在特意影响你的思考。你询问起现在的时间，阿布说现在应该是你和莉莉安息亡魂的时间，但今天列车十分安静。你明白这是因为只剩下最后一个亡魂了……你们决定让莉莉开开心心地过完最后一天。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_3.text: It's almost time for you two to lay the souls to rest.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_3.zh: 按理来说应该是你和莉莉安息亡魂的时间了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_3.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_6.text: You mean Lily's... Maybe we could ask her about the nightmares?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_6.zh: 你是说莉莉她……那要不我们直接问问她关于噩梦的事情。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_6.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_134_2.text: I noticed it when I woke up too. But nobody came into our room.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_134_2.zh: 起床时，我也发现了。不过奇怪的是，根本没有人进过我们房间。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_134_2.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_137_2.text: Yeah. No piano, no warm greetings, no Lily chatting with the soldiers.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_137_2.zh: 是啊，钢琴声、热情的招呼声，还有莉莉和战士们在一起聊天的声音。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_137_2.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_138_1.text: {PlayerName}, are we really gonna say goodbye to Lily? I just feel...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_138_1.zh: {PlayerName}，我们真的要和莉莉说再见了吗？总觉得心里有点……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_138_1.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_138_2.text: I know, Abby. I feel it, too. But... they're already dead.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_138_2.zh: 我明白你的心情，我也一样，但……他们已经是逝者了。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_26.text: Abby's not very good at goodbyes. There's a lot it still wants to tell you, but...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_26.zh: 阿布它不太擅长告别，它其实有很多话想和你说，但……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_6.text: Mm. It's time for me to join them and find my way home, too. Thank you so much for everything... Oh, where's Abby?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_6.zh: 嗯，我也该和他们一样，踏上回家的路了，谢谢你一直以来的帮忙。对了，阿布呢？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_6.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_7.text: I suppose you can hear me right now, Abby? Thank you. Getting to know you both made me so happy. But there's one last favor I'd like to ask of you...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_7.zh: 阿布应该听得见吧。谢谢你，阿布，认识你们我也很开心。有件事情我想拜托你们……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_7.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_178_2.text: (Her whole dreamland was a lie. She absorbed so many frequencies of the dead that her scent fooled even Abby's nose.)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_178_2.zh: （属于她的幻梦只是一场骗局，因为她吸收了太多逝者的频率，所以她身上的味道连阿布都骗过了。）

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_186_2.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_12_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_186_2.text: Ugh, the carriages got pulled apart! We've gotta catch up with her, quick!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_186_2.zh: 可恶，车厢间的距离被拉远了，我们得快点追上她。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_186_2.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_189_2.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_15_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_189_2.text: {PlayerName}, look out. More Tacet Discords incoming!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_189_2.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_21_11.text: Abby, did you see that white cat? Someone seemed to be impersonating it, using it to guide us here.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_21_11.zh: 阿布，你有没有看见白猫，刚才似乎有人假扮它为我们引路。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_21_12.text: No. As soon as we arrived, our connection got cut off. Next thing I knew, I was already here.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_21_12.zh: 没有，自从进来后，我们之间的联系就被切断了，回过神来本布就已经在这里了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_21_12.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_21_14.text: I don't know what happened, but we gotta be careful going forward. I smell something rotten...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_21_14.zh: 虽然不知道发生了什么，但前面的路我们最好小心一点，我闻到了一些不好的味道……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_21_14.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_21_15.text: Better I stay in the backseat for now. But if something happens, I'll be there to help you.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_21_15.zh: 我还是先藏起来吧，有意外发生，本布会出来帮你的。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_21_15.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_238_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_16_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_238_1.text: We're falling even further behind! {PlayerName}, Lily's in bad shape, and it's getting worse by the minute!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_238_1.zh: 距离还在拉远，{PlayerName}，莉莉，她的状态似乎越来越糟了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_238_1.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_240_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_18_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_240_1.text: The conservatory door... {PlayerName}, we're almost there!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_240_1.zh: 那是花房车厢的门……{PlayerName}，我们快到了！
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_240_1.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_320_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_15_2
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_320_1.text: To the left! No, no, the right... Why do the paths keep splitting?!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_320_1.zh: 左边，不对不对，是右边……岔路怎么越来越多了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_320_1.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_32_1.text: ...The voices finally stopped. {PlayerName}, are you alright?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_32_1.zh: ……那些声音终于消失了，{PlayerName}，你还好吧？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_32_1.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_32_3.text: All good here. But where are we? Wait, do you smell that? There's a strange type of fragrance on this train.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_32_3.zh: 我没事，不过这里究竟是什么地方？等等，你闻到了吗，车上好像有股特别的香气。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_32_3.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_40_3.text: I'm getting closer to that fragrance Abby was talking about.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_40_3.zh: 离阿布说的香气越来越近了……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_51_4.text: Abby, keep an eye on any shifts in frequency while we're in here... Abby?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_51_4.zh: 阿布，在幻梦里，你记得注意一下周围频率的变化……阿布？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_1.text: Whoa... So this bottle's where that fragrance is coming from. My head feels all clear now. It's super relaxing...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_1.zh: 呜啊……原来这个味道是这瓶香薰发出来的，总感觉脑袋里空空的，真是令骸安心的味道……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_1.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_12.text: I don't mind. Roleplaying's too complicated for me anyway. I'll just stay in your Tacet Mark and save us both the headache.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_12.zh: 这样也好，扮演角色对本布来说太复杂了，我还是不给你添麻烦，继续待在声痕里吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_12.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_13.text: Abby, what do you make of everything Lily told us?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_13.zh: 阿布，你怎么看待莉莉告诉我们的信息？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_15.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束2_41_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_15.text: Back in your room, Abby notices that the fragrance from the diffuser seems to have a relaxing effect. You ask what Abby thinks of Lily's words. Abby agrees that this place is the Somnoire but sees no reason to believe Lily is lying. Having sensed the frequencies of both Lily and the soldiers, Abby finds them extraordinarily faint, just like those of the dead. Abby suggests contacting the Ivory Gatekeeper and Ebony Gatekeeper through WavesLine.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_15.zh: 回到房间后，阿布注意到房间内的香薰似乎能让人放松下来。你问阿布怎么看待莉莉说的话。阿布明白这里是心之集域，但它认为莉莉也没有说谎。因为阿布闻过战士们和莉莉身上的频率了，十分微弱，和逝者一模一样。阿布建议你可以通过飞讯问问白色守门人和黑色守门人。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_2.text: What a nice room Lily got us! She's too sweet.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_2.zh: 莉莉她人不错嘛，替我们准备这么好的房间。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_2.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_4.text: Well, we are in the Somnoire, but I don't think she was lying. The frequencies on her and the soldiers were really faint.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_4.zh: 这里是心之集域没错，但我觉得她也没有欺骗我们，我闻了闻战士们和莉莉身上的频率，十分微弱。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_4.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_5.text: Just like what you'd expect from the dead. Besides, she didn't seem out to get us, and she laid all her cards on the table.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_5.zh: 的确和逝者一模一样。而且，那位少女对我们也没有展现出任何敌意，坦诚地告诉了我们一切。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_5.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_6.text: If it's still bugging you, we can always message the Ivory and Ebony Gatekeepers on WavesLine.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_6.zh: 实在不放心的话，要不试试用飞讯联系一下小黑，小白。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_6.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_9.text: Nah, I felt way better the second we got on the train. But it seems I can't follow you into the dreams Lily weaves.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_9.zh: 上车后，感觉好多了。不过我好像不能和你一起进入莉莉编织的幻梦里。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_9.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_86_1.text: Message failed to send, huh? Is the Somnoire's anomaly giving us trouble now?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_86_1.zh: 发送消息失败，是受心之集域异变的影响吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_86_1.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_86_5.text: Yeah, your call... Just let me know when you're sure she's trustworthy. I'll come say hi.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_86_5.zh: 好啊，你决定就好……等你打消对莉莉的疑虑后，再把本布介绍给她吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_86_5.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_86_7.text: Abby, I think we should stay on board and help her lay these souls to rest.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_86_7.zh: 阿布，这段时间我们就先待在列车上，帮她一起安息亡魂吧。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_86_8.text: Yawn... I'm beat. Time to hit the hay. You should get some rest too, {PlayerName}.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_86_8.zh: 呼啊……好困，我先睡了，{PlayerName}你也早点休息。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_86_8.speaker: Abby

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_99_2.text: Abby, did anyone come into our room last night?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_99_2.zh: 阿布，昨晚有人来过我们房间吗？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_99_5.text: Didn't notice a thing. Maybe your brain's cooking up nightmares 'cause you're all suspicious about this train and Lily?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_99_5.zh: 我没有注意到，你说的噩梦会不会是你对列车，还有莉莉抱着警惕的缘故？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_99_5.speaker: Abby

yakita:POI_QSMG_35_7.text: You really scared the crap out of me, 漂泊者! You froze up like Carlow when you touched that thing. Luckily, Margherita came by and snapped you out of it.
yakita:POI_QSMG_35_7.zh: 漂泊者，你刚刚吓死我了，你接触那东西后，就突然变得和卡洛一样，幸亏玛格烈特小姐出现唤醒了你。
yakita:POI_QSMG_35_7.speaker: Abby

yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120071_10.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120071_10.text: "So, do you think those Fractsidus goons are involved in this, Yinlin?"
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120071_10.zh: “难道吟霖是觉得这里也有残星会那样的坏蛋？”
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_120071_10.speaker: Abby

yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_17.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_17.text: "Look, 漂泊者! Isn't that Sanhua? Finally, a familiar face!"
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_17.zh: “漂泊者快看，那个不是散华么！终于在这场电影里找到熟人啦！”
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_210021_17.speaker: Abby

yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_12.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_12.text: "Holy! Jianxin? Geez, you look awful... What happened to you?"
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_12.zh: “天哪，这不是鉴心么，你看起来脸色好差……怎么一段时间不见混成这样啦。”
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_12.speaker: Abby

yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220051_14.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220051_14.text: "Um, I'm pretty sure that's Youhu... What should we do, 漂泊者? Should we go help her out?"
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220051_14.zh: “额，好像，是釉瑚诶……怎么办，漂泊者，我们要出手吗？”
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220051_14.speaker: Abby

yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_19.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_19.text: "No matter where she is, it's the same old Youhu..."
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_19.zh: “果然，不论在哪釉瑚都是这个样子……”
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220052_19.speaker: Abby

yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_12_31.text: You and Suisui hover around Abby, fanning it and bringing it glass after glass of water. After much effort, it finally "cools down."
yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_12_31.zh: 你们手忙脚乱给阿布端水扇风，好不容易才让阿布冷静下来。

yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_5_12.text: —to show you my thanks! Seriously, Suisui, you're the best.
yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_5_12.zh: 表演一个非常感谢！谢谢穗穗，你真是好人。
yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_5_12.speaker: Abby

yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_25_1.text: I get the full picture now. Abby, Buling, listen.
yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_25_1.zh: 我明白了。阿布，卜灵，听我说。
yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_25_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:ST_HSJB2_12_3.text: Because there's no Panhua's Restaurant or Trattoria Margherita...
yakita:ST_HSJB2_12_3.zh: 这里既没有攀花饭馆，也没有“玛格烈特”餐馆……
yakita:ST_HSJB2_12_3.speaker: Abby

yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_4001_2.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2.8千夏活动主线_29_1
yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_4001_2.text: You consider trying to split the mirage from the rift, but before you can act, a hand bursts from the rift and pulls you in. With Buling and Abby's cries fading behind you, you're dragged into the unknown Sonoro Sphere's turbulent depths.
yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_4001_2.zh: 就在你试图对裂隙进行「分离」时，从中突然伸出一只手，将你径直拉入其中。在卜灵和阿布的大喊中，你跌入陌生的风暴漩涡。

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_40_4.text: You're right, Abby. In this reality, Hsin wasn't hurt in the meeting with the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs, and Xuanqing took over the Civilization Capsule instead to assume command over Xuanfang Hold. She even started building Cloud Shuttles.
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_40_4.zh: 阿布说得没错。心月狐没有在与谛天鉴的会议中受伤，接管文明之匣的人变成了璇情，此后都由她来管理玄方城，甚至建造了云梭。
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_40_4.speaker: Rover

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_6_1.text: I smell Xuanqing's frequency all over this thing! Has to be one of those Feeling Capsule pieces she was talking about.
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_6_1.zh: 这个东西的频率有璇情的味道！这应该就是她说的，那个「情匣」的碎片之一吧。
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_6_1.speaker: Abby

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_7_1.text: Mmm, that's definitely Xuanqing's scent! One of the Feeling Capsule's pieces, for sure.
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_7_1.zh: 唔，是璇情的味道！这一定就是她说的「情匣」的碎片之一。
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_7_1.speaker: Abby

yakita:ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_3.text: In Jinzhou, you joined hands with Jiyan and the other Resonators to quell the Tacet Discord outbreak in Norfall Barrens. You also met "little Abby." You ultimately triumphed over and absorbed the Dreamless.
yakita:ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_3.zh: 你在今州协力忌炎和今州的大家，平息了北落野的残象潮，收获了一个“小阿布”。也最终成功击败并“吸收”了「无妄者」。

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_55_2.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_3_5
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_55_2.text: What kind of place is the New Federation, anyway? Are they all gonna be like that?
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_55_2.zh: 新联邦到底是个什么样的地方啊！那里的人该不会都这样吧？
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_55_2.speaker: Abby

yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_13_1.text: That looks like something from Xiangli Yao's childhood. Could his memories be affecting this Sonoro's frequencies?
yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_13_1.zh: 看来是他小时候的记忆，这个索诺拉的频率也受到了影响吗？
yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_13_1.speaker: Abby

yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_45_9.text: It's Xiangli Yao! He's right behind this door!
yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_45_9.zh: 是相里要的声音，就在这扇门背后！
yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_45_9.speaker: Abby

yakita:AMS31_1_3.text: You look toward "Aemeath." She is quietly resting on the sofa, eyes closed.
yakita:AMS31_1_3.zh: 你看向「爱弥斯」，她正倚靠在小屋的沙发上，安静地闭着双眼。

yakita:AMS31_2_3.text: You look toward "Aemeath." She hunches over the workbench, head tilted as she pores over the display.
yakita:AMS31_2_3.zh: 你看向「爱弥斯」，她正专注着站在工作台前，歪着脑袋凝视着眼前的一切。

yakita:AMS31_2_4.text: This was where you used to work and the usual haunt for young Aemeath. When you were busy, she would sit beside you and draw in silence, like a small, loyal guardian keeping watch.
yakita:AMS31_2_4.zh: 这是过去的你工作时使用的地方，也是年幼的爱弥斯常来的地方。有时候你在忙，她就坐在一旁的椅子上自个儿画画，像个忠实的小守卫。

yakita:AMS31_3_3.text: You look toward "Aemeath." She sits motionless by the shore of the Ginnungamere, her gaze fixed on the water, where glistening lights dance on the ripples
yakita:AMS31_3_3.zh: 你看向「爱弥斯」，她正一动不动地坐在渐湖的湖畔，目光投向眼前闪动着瑰丽色彩的湖面。

yakita:SHENGTAI_Ameath_1_18.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_爱弥斯增补_3_3_1_1
yakita:SHENGTAI_Ameath_1_18.text: Aemeath tilts her head in thought, then smiles at you.
yakita:SHENGTAI_Ameath_1_18.zh: 爱弥斯歪着脑袋思索片刻，微笑着看向你。

yakita:SHENGTAI_Ameath_1_2.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_爱弥斯增补_3_3_1_1
yakita:SHENGTAI_Ameath_1_2.text: You see Aemeath crouching near some Snowfluff Seals. Her smile is soft as she reaches out to ruffle the fur on one of their heads.
yakita:SHENGTAI_Ameath_1_2.zh: 你看到爱弥斯半蹲在几只雪绒海豹的附近，笑眯眯地伸出手揉搓其中一只的脑袋。

yakita:SHENGTAI_Ameath_1_3.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_爱弥斯增补_3_3_1_1
yakita:SHENGTAI_Ameath_1_3.text: The Snowfluff Seals look dazed, their eyes squinted as they remain still, as if knowing resistance is futile by Aemeath's aura alone.
yakita:SHENGTAI_Ameath_1_3.zh: 海豹们一副昏昏欲睡的表情，半眯着眼睛，但没有爬开，似乎都已屈服于爱弥斯强大的气场下。

yakita:SHENGTAI_Ameath_3_12.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_爱弥斯增补_3_3_3_1
yakita:SHENGTAI_Ameath_3_12.text: With Aemeath's gentle humming nearby, you drift into a light, peaceful sleep.
yakita:SHENGTAI_Ameath_3_12.zh: 身边传来爱弥斯轻柔的歌声，你逐渐在困倦中陷入了浅梦。

yakita:SHENGTAI_Ameath_4_18.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_爱弥斯增补_3_3_4_1
yakita:SHENGTAI_Ameath_4_18.text: You share your joys and sorrows with Aemeath, and her expressions shift with your words—delight and anger, excitement and concern.
yakita:SHENGTAI_Ameath_4_18.zh: 你和爱弥斯诉说着那些或喜或悲的经历，看她的表情因你的言语而被牵引，露出欣慰与不忿，兴奋与担忧。

yakita:MAIN_YHX_12_46.text: If it's leaving the campus, it's probably going to the frostlands. Right, we'll need to take the Starward Riseway.
yakita:MAIN_YHX_12_46.zh: 如果要往校外走，大概会去罗伊冰原……噢，那我们得去一趟联运椎骨。
yakita:MAIN_YHX_12_46.speaker: Aemeath

yakita:MAIN_YHX_134_1.text: I'm Aemeath. The Academy's star. A Synchronist. A savior.
yakita:MAIN_YHX_134_1.zh: 我是爱弥斯。我是……学院明星，适格者，救世主。
yakita:MAIN_YHX_134_1.speaker: Aemeath

yakita:MAIN_YHX_13_1.text: When I was a kid, I once hid in the Starward Riseway and made it to the frostlands all by myself.
yakita:MAIN_YHX_13_1.zh: 小时候我曾偷偷藏进联运椎骨，自己一个人去过冰原呢。
yakita:MAIN_YHX_13_1.speaker: Aemeath

yakita:MAIN_YHX_145_1.text: Our next stop is the Starward Riseway. Are you ready?
yakita:MAIN_YHX_145_1.zh: 接下来就要去联运椎骨那边了，准备好出发了吗？
yakita:MAIN_YHX_145_1.speaker: Aemeath

yakita:MAIN_YHX_51_14.text: Aemeath, you think Cassettes might be a breakthrough?
yakita:MAIN_YHX_51_14.zh: 爱弥斯，你是觉得磁带是个突破口？

yakita:MAIN_YHX_64_21.text: So I ran away from Bjartr Woods by myself. I hid in the Starward Riseway and made my way to the frostlands.
yakita:MAIN_YHX_64_21.zh: 于是我独自从浮光林跑了出来，躲藏在联运椎骨中，一路来到了冰原。
yakita:MAIN_YHX_64_21.speaker: Aemeath

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_168_19.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_24_1
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_168_19.text: No, Hiyuki. I don't seek Aemeath to confess my regrets.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_168_19.zh: 不，绯雪。我不是为了对爱弥斯诉说我的后悔，才去寻找她的。
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_168_19.speaker: Rover

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21011_17.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_25_1
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21011_17.text: Aemeath, there's something I want to ask you.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21011_17.zh: 爱弥斯，有件事我想问你。
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21011_17.speaker: Rover

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_68_48.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_8_2
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_68_48.text: I remember you came across Aemeath's traces before.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_68_48.zh: 我记得，你发现过爱弥斯的踪迹……

yakita:EVENT_LGNDPW_1_10.text: Oh, sorry about that. Haven't introduced myself yet. My name's Alannah, I'm with the Product Development Team at the Pioneer Association.
yakita:EVENT_LGNDPW_1_10.zh: 啊啊——不好意思，我还没自我介绍，我叫阿兰娜，隶属于先行公约的产品制作团队！
yakita:EVENT_LGNDPW_1_10.speaker: Alannah

yakita:EVENT_LGNDPW_1_6.text: (Upon hearing your voice, Alannah turns her back and lowers her voice.)
yakita:EVENT_LGNDPW_1_6.zh: （听到你的声音后，阿兰娜转过身，并放低了音量）

yakita:EVENT_LGNDPW_20_11.text:
By the young man's invitation, the three of you begin sunbathing with Slowy.
After getting plenty of sunshine, you see Alannah in deep thought. She then says goodbye and returns to Jinzhou on her own.
yakita:EVENT_LGNDPW_20_11.zh:
在男生的建议下，你们三人跟慢慢一起晒了会儿太阳。
晒完太阳后，阿兰娜似乎若有所思。她跟你告别后，独自走回了城里。

yakita:EVENT_LGNDPW_21_14.text: After some hard work, Alannah manages to send a shipment of Jinzhou-styled Echo plushies to Ragunna.
yakita:EVENT_LGNDPW_21_14.zh: 经过一番准备，阿兰娜将数个今州特色声骸抱枕发往了拉古那。

yakita:EVENT_LGNDPW_2_4.text: You see, Rinascita is comprised mostly of islands out at sea, with Ragunna City on one of the isles.
yakita:EVENT_LGNDPW_2_4.zh: 是的！那拉古那城所在的黎那汐塔，是一个被海洋环绕的岛屿地区。
yakita:EVENT_LGNDPW_2_4.speaker: Alannah

yakita:EVENT_LGNDPW_5_6.text: Yuanwu has his own boxing gym and is secretly the proprietor of the Liuxian Teahouse. A good guess.
yakita:EVENT_LGNDPW_5_6.zh: 渊武不仅开着拳馆，还是六羡茶行的幕后所有者，的确很有实力。
yakita:EVENT_LGNDPW_5_6.speaker: Alannah

yakita:EVENT_LGNDPW_7_7.text: Later, by adding a few edits here and there, Alannah finishes compiling a printout called Mahe's Spicy Secret.
yakita:EVENT_LGNDPW_7_7.zh: 没过多久，阿兰娜添油加醋地整理好了一本名叫《马家秘辛》的资料……

yakita:34NPCTHST_7_9.text: But here's the thing. Like President Lucilla said during the review, Rabelle College's future challenge isn't Aleph-1 anymore. It's the Etheric Sea... something nobody's ever broken through.
yakita:34NPCTHST_7_9.zh: 但……正如洛瑟菈校长在审查会上所说，拉贝尔学部未来要面对的不再是阿列夫一，而是……从未被突破的那片天空海。
yakita:34NPCTHST_7_9.speaker: Reilynn

datamine:InfoDisplay_72010103_Text.title: The Genesis of the Twin Nova Project: A Developmental Retrospective (Excerpt)
datamine:InfoDisplay_72010103_Text.text:
[…]

The melee model, Twin Nova: Collapsar Blade, engages with fast and aggressive actions, while its ranged counterpart, Twin Nova: Nebulous Cannon, prefers to stay back and provide support.

Their very names embody the Spacetrek Collective's mission: to descend into the unknown as they continue to reach for the stars.

[…]

The Threnodian of Void, Aleph-1, erases individuals from memory, and the twins couldn't imagine a world where they might forget each other.

[…]

The Collective opted for humanoid frames to symbolize humanity's presence on the frontier.

Rumor has it the design also helps them seem less intimidating when serving as security at Startorch Academy, and perhaps caters to a few researchers' personal tastes.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_72010103_Text.zh:
"……综上所述，开发高性能战斗机器人已是燃眉之急。
 而接受这项任务的是一对双胞胎姐妹研究员，姐姐热情冒进，妹妹沉稳少言，两人的性格也体现在她们开发的双极系列战斗机器人上。
 近战特化机型名为双极·渊陨重锋，战斗风格激进，远程特化机型名为双极·星升辉铳，战斗时倾向在后方支援，两者的名字象征深空联合要向下进入深渊但却是在探索星空。
 起初决定开发成对的战斗机器人是出于一种浪漫的愿景，阿列夫一让人类的存在被消解，被遗忘，而这对双胞胎姐妹无法想象遗忘彼此带来的痛苦，因此希望自己开发的双子机器人能有对方相伴，不被遗忘，尽管阿列夫一不一定会消解无机物的存在，但还是秉承如此想法开发了双极系列。
 也因此，深空联合特意让双极采用类人素体设计，象征以人类之形探索未知，但据传，此设计亦为降低其在星炬学院担任安保时对学生的压迫感，甚至也反映了部分研究员的个人趣味。
 开发者为双极设计了自主战术博弈模型，但由于深空联合缺乏战斗经验，战术模型内的数据由开发者亲自操控双极进行模拟战来填充，且由于开发者的偏爱，致使双极动作优雅华丽，稍欠实用性。
 但在当下，随着实战数据的积累，模型持续进步中，近战特化型会在战斗时则冲锋陷阵，攻入敌阵，远程特化型则会与人类小队协同，支援近战特化型并保护队伍。"

yakita:AreaReportContent_Text65.zh:
【00:02:11】
在罗伊族的古老传说中，██源自比拉海洛更幽深的所在。
传说称，那是灾厄的根源，就在现今坠剑湖的下方。

【00:03:49】
 黑海岸监测确认，██的频率分布异常，出现“双源”结构：
 A 点——拉海洛，周期性出现的████区；
 B 点——坠剑湖底，信号极弱，似受干扰。

【00:05:02】
科考队沿信号潜入湖底，发现███结构，形态类似████，
该██倒悬的███相连，主体深植地底，

提交人：洛瑟菈
呈报对象：深空联合战略风险评估委员会
一、调查背景与目的
自本年度第三周以来，拉海洛全境观测到以下异常现象：
1，虚质磁暴活跃周期骤缩至72标准时，频次提升约40%；
2，区域虚质浓度较去年同期环比增长31.7%，且增长曲线尚未出现平缓趋势；
3，低频段鸣式频率干扰现象频发，部分监测站记录到来源不明的谐振波动。
依据《拉海洛虚质防护安全条例》,并鉴于上述异常指标与鸣式外溢事件的前兆特征高度吻合，故委托特聘顾问对黯原地区封存地进行紧急复查。
执行人员：绯雪（鸣式对策组专员）
调查地点：黯原封存地·止庭
二、执行人员调查记录
以下内容根据绯雪口述及行动终端记录整理：
止庭的刀还在，但是刃口接触的地面有虚质熔蚀的痕迹。
是。隧门另一边的东西正在加剧积蓄力量，但我无法判断它具体什么时候行动。
……我为这把刀重新注入了频率，至少短期内，阿列夫一的力量无法逾越这里。
记录完毕。
三、调查结论
综合绯雪的实地勘验及后续频谱数据分析，现就黯原封存地状况形成以下结论：
封印主体结构仍保持完整，未出现实质破裂或外溢迹象；
但裂隙下方的虚质活性反应呈持续上升趋势，与近期磁暴频次、浓度增长形成正相关佐证；
基于上述，判断鸣式“阿列夫一”封印失效的时间窗口正在缩短。
四、建议与提请事项
鉴于当前形势，本人提请深空联合虚质科学部审议以下事项：
立即解封“夜幕”计划预备阶段，提升拉海洛全境虚质灾害预警等级至二级响应；
加速实战用机兵及虚质对策机兵的机体调试进程，优先完成对隧者基础框架的修复与动态负载测试；

yakita:FavorStory_110805_Content.zh:
绯雪并未与残星会多做纠缠，没有人会想与那群把人当作耗材的家伙们合作的。
她主动前往苇原各地，留下了刻有自己频率的白鸟，交代各地的巫女，自己与这些白鸟心思相连，如若真有无法处理的意外发生时，则碾碎白鸟，自己会及时返回。

与鸣式抗争的道路，总该有尽头……必须有终点。

绯雪听闻了深空联合相关的事，深空联合此时正苦于探索工作缺少安全保障，绯雪便主动提出了“交易”——她来主导保障探索工作的安全，而深空联合，则需要以当今索拉里斯最高的科研水准，为她准备一把刀，一把锋利到足以斩落鸣式的刀。
她以特别对策组的身份申请加入了深空联合，这个小组曾有过不少人，但随着阿列夫一的活跃，伤亡比逐渐增高。绯雪递交了申请，往后，将由她一人独自负责鸣式对策工作，保护探测人员的安全。

初到时，深空联合还只有一处地基，她眼看着拉海洛一步步被完善建立起来，逐渐意识到人类本身的力量——深空联合的建立堪称索拉里斯史上的基建奇迹，而这份奇迹，并非由神赐福，并非借由任何单独一人的伟力，而是由整个索拉里斯怀揣着理想与抱负的人们一砖一瓦地搭建起来。

“洛瑟菈。”
“嗯？”
洛瑟菈自然地从桌下翻出一瓶佳酿来，这是来自苇原的特产，某位想要求保佑期末考过关的苇原学生特意放在绯雪曾出现过的地方，下面还压着一张工整的字条，写着些求巫女大人保佑的话。
绯雪叹了口气，转身拿出两个杯子，推到左顾右盼的洛瑟菈面前。

“深空联合……是为了探索索拉里斯外的星空而建立的，对吧？”
“啊，对。”
“你们现在的进度如何了？”
“唉……”
洛瑟菈拿起杯子一饮而尽，叹了口气。
“还差得远了，各处的研究都有瓶颈，上头还总下些难捱的需求。”
绯雪摩挲着手腕处的铃铛，垂下眼来。
“那你们有没有想过，这条路何时才是尽头？”

洛瑟菈掂了掂空杯，碰了碰绯雪的杯子。
“没有尽头，绯雪，就像你想做到的事一样，没有尽头。”
“但，我们总要向前走。”
“不是为了走到尽头，而是为了与身旁的人共同再迈出一步。”

绯雪沉默了一阵，轻轻点头，也拿起杯子任由辛辣入喉，再向下，揉入略显单薄的身体。
手腕处的铃铛作响，孤身前行的灼樱巫女，也必将迈出她的一步吧。

███的样本分析已经确认，██的材质与██一致。
浮光林██的能流指向表明，██正借由根系正在持续被“供给”。

（短暂停顿，轻微的呼吸声）

换言之，██无时不刻不在██着██后的██。这是一种修复与损耗之间的动态平衡。
一旦这种“供给”出现问题，这种动态平衡将失衡，██后的██将冲出██，并涌入拉海洛。
《P.C.-LH-R/0987拉海洛阶段性研究简报》表明，「拟岁主」的状况不容乐观。
做，或有一线生机，不做，我们必败无疑，██的开启是必然的结果。
不论何时开启、由谁来开启，我们必须做好应对措施。

（台下传来不安的絮语）

岁主借由“共鸣”解限绝非孤例。
既然我们已经成功证明了「拟岁主」与岁主的高度一致性，
那么人为地创造「外源性共鸣」，必将是突破「拟岁主」能力上限的最优解。
要么以我们的双手控制「拟岁主」打开██，主动迎击██后的██，
或者是我们眼睁睁地看着██突破██，却毫无还手之力。
显然我们没有选择。

（与会者们的议论声）

我知道，这听起来太像一场豪赌。
我眼前的，是索拉里斯最出色的头脑，各个学科最出众的领军人物。
我想……科学的精神，从来都不在确定之中，而在那一步迈向未知的勇气。

因此，我们确立了计划：
以研究隧者为核心，延伸至航天、生物共鸣与能源体系的联合项目。
这不仅仅是一次学术尝试，更是一场文明自救的努力。

我在此正式宣布：「极地联合」更名为——「深空联合」。
与此同时，新的学研机构“星炬学院”也将于拉海洛建成。它将成为███科研的前哨——
在那里，罗伊人与来自世界各地的学者将一同研究隧者的生物机械特性，培育能与「拟岁主」产生「外源性共鸣」的「███」，
学院的建立将帮助我们，借由「拟岁主」研究、掌握后悲鸣时代的法则，突破天空海的封锁，到达更遥远的深空与未来。
相信有朝一日，关于「拟岁主」的研究成果能够坦然公诸于世，惠及整个索拉里斯的人类。

课题组中的学生曾问过我，我们的终点是什么？
我想，答案很简单——不是重返深空，而是重返…

datamine:InfoDisplay_120101045_Text.zh:
文艺作品的生命由两部分组成，一部分来自于它的创作者，另一部分来自于它的读者。
创作者给予作品新生，而读者阅读后得以将作品的生命延续。延续的方法有许多种，也许是分享给他人，也许是发表自己对作品的解读和感受。
也有人对“作品生命”这个词感到疑惑，因为它过于抽象，难以触碰。
但我们或许能借助人类生命的某些概念来理解“作品生命”，当谈及人类生命时，我们一定绕不开一个名词——名字。名字是区分个体生命间的重要元素，也是一种生命存在的象征。要想触碰作品的生命，最直观的方式同样是感受它的名字——创作者和读者为它赋予的各种名字。
我曾听闻过东方的一个怪异传闻，肌肤似雪的女人冒着暴雪站在路边，她手中托着一个哭泣的婴儿，央求过路的人替她抱住孩子。而过路者一旦应允，便再也放不开手，直至被冻死。
怎么样？光听这样的一个故事，是不是会产生许多遐想，因为遐想太多，所以这个作品的生命显得四分五裂。
如果赋予它一个名字呢？比如说……雪女。一个名字就讲述完了整个故事，并决定了故事的面容。
名字虽然固定了故事在人们脑海里的形象，但因为文字本身的特殊性，每个人在阅读后依旧会对作品的生命有不同的理解。
所以……作品的生命比起人类的生命，更加不可控。
如果有一天，人们对作品出现错误的理解，那么文字可能会变成一把可怕的武器。
到那时，我们该怎么办？是愤怒吗？不，绝不应该如此！愤怒是最廉价的宣泄手段，我们作为创作者能做的只能是相信，相信自己的文字能活出生命真正的姿态。
                                                                                                                        ——黄金之歌文艺专访

星炬学院学生手册·入学指南（节选）

「星炬学院」学生宣言
于「星炬」之下，我们彼此立约：承续星炬的薪火，与志同道合的伙伴并肩，共拓知识的疆界。每一次对真理的探求，都将化作点亮天幕的星火，直至长夜褪去——我们终将携手，筑就属于我们的黎明。

一、学院学制
学院实行“2年预科＋4年专精”的培养体系。
· 预科阶段（前2年）
除拉贝尔学部的「适格者」外，全体学生须接受跨学科通识教育，内容涵盖基础学科、人文社科及拉海洛必备生存技能。学部分配将于预科结束时，综合学生意向与学业表现统一确定。
特殊说明：拉贝尔学部的「适格者」自入学即确定学部归属，享有专属培养方案，不参与预科通识课程。
· 专精阶段（后4年）
以培养科研专才为目标，鼓励学生融入课题组，践行“学研并进”。学院将为有意留校发展的优秀学子提供全方位支持。

二、学部架构
星炬学院以「隧者」及拉海洛独特生态为核心研究对象，依研究领域划分为四个学部：

· 拉贝尔学部
（共感训练学科群／文明协同学科群）
专注隧者外源性共鸣者的选拔与培养。
学部以拉贝尔曲线发明者史考特·拉贝尔之名命名，采用严谨量化手段为适格者提供顶尖科研教育，素有“适格者学部”之称。作为学院核心，其研究成果已衍生出多项关键技术，为各学科提供了新的科研基础。学部配备由隧者零件与神经元构建的模拟驾驶舱，可模拟驾驭隧者的同频负荷。为保障安全而研发的适格者监测技术，已通过下属共鸣医疗科转化为“频率医疗”体系，服务于全院师生。

· 隧者工学部
（机体共融学科群／战术开发学科群）
聚焦机械共融与战术装备研发。
学部基于隧者部件的自我增殖特性，开展新型智械与模块化武器研究，并致力于研究实战环境下的模拟验证。该学部同时承担通过外部零件搜寻与人工培育，加速隧者修复进程的重要使命。

· 虚质科学部
（空间异变学科群）
探索空间异变与虚质特性。
学部从隧者研究中开发出一系列的通信与空间锚定技术，以实现跨维定位隧者，以及监测适格者的生命体征。同时，学部以解析「海蚀现象」生成逻辑为核心课题，通过对拉海洛地区虚质磁暴的观测，并辅以对其他地区海蚀现象的数据分析，力求能建立起有效的灾难…

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_10_15_25.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_下半_1_23
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_10_15_25.text: Although I hate to admit it, Avidius was right... Since you still remember Iuno and thus hold onto that last connection between her and the world, you've essentially "anchored" her.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_10_15_25.zh: 虽然我很不想承认，但阿维狄亚是对的……因为你还记得尤诺，保持了她和世界最后的联系，一定程度上「锚定」了她。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_10_15_25.speaker: Lillibet

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_150_3.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_赤林台地_3_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_150_3.text: Avidius, take a response team and get that Anchor Obelisk functioning.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_150_3.zh: 阿维狄亚，带上应急行动人员修复锚定界石。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_150_3.speaker: Augusta

yakita:ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_32.text: Determined to bring Iuno back, you traveled to Tetragon Temple in search of clues. Through Avidius's story, you came to understand that existence itself was the sum of memories, feelings, and connections. You decided to Anchor Iuno back into existence through those bonds.
yakita:ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_32.zh: 你决定前往四方殿寻找尤诺的线索，却因阿维狄亚的遭遇领悟到存在其实是记忆、情感和联系的总和，你决定用相同的方法将尤诺从混沌之中「锚定」，将她带回这个世界。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_74_2.speakerZh: 神秘男性研究员的影像
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_74_2.text: The "Artificial Retroactive Rain" project has advanced to its second phase... We have various evidence that this ancient civilization was the Whining Aix's Mire at some point.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_74_2.zh: “人工溯洄雨”已经成功进入到第二阶段了…… 我们手头已知的种种证据都表明，这一文明的确曾来到过怨鸟泽。

yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_12_19.chapter: 剧情_2_2_支线_历程记忆手册_2_2
yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_12_19.text: I recall the dusk when I took Rosalie to Avinoleum. The golden light of the setting sun bathed the main tower's dome.
yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_12_19.zh: 我想起……带罗萨莉去看「阿维纽林」的那个傍晚，黄昏的淡金色铺满了主塔的穹顶。
yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_12_19.speaker: Andrea

yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_12_4.chapter: 剧情_2_2_支线_历程记忆手册_2_2
yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_12_4.text: This is indeed Avinoleum. These towers, these columns... They still shine with the brilliance of days gone by.
yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_12_4.zh: 是的……啊，这确实是「阿维纽林」。这些塔楼和廊柱……它们仍像从前那样辉煌……
yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_12_4.speaker: Andrea

yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_2_12.chapter: 剧情_2_2_支线_历程记忆手册_2_1
yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_2_12.text: But when I reached the part about Avinoleum, I realized I could barely remember what it looked like.
yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_2_12.zh: 但当我提笔写起「阿维纽林」，我却发觉它在记忆里的样子变得有些模糊了。
yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_2_12.speaker: Andrea

yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_2_25.chapter: 剧情_2_2_支线_历程记忆手册_2_1
yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_2_25.text: This was drawn back when Avinoleum was still on the ground. It marks the renowned places of that time.
yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_2_25.zh: 这份路线图是在「阿维纽林」仍在地面时绘制的，标注的都是当时知名的地点。
yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_2_25.speaker: Andrea

yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_2_4.chapter: 剧情_2_2_支线_历程记忆手册_2_1
yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_2_4.text: Once, Avinoleum was a marvel admired across all of Rinascita. But now, it's nothing more than an expanse of shadows, hanging in the sky.
yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_2_4.zh: 曾经让整个黎那汐塔震撼的「阿维纽林」，现在只是天空中一片难以辨识的阴翳。
yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_2_4.speaker: Andrea

yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_3_1.chapter: 剧情_2_2_支线_历程记忆手册_1_2
yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_3_1.text: When you were in Avinoleum, did you encounter... No, please forget it. Good luck on your journey.
yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_3_1.zh: 你是否在「阿维纽林」遇到过……不，没什么。祝你一路顺风。
yakita:Guid_ZJAWNL_3_1.speaker: Andrea

yakita:lmzx_11_20.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_3_3
yakita:lmzx_11_20.text: Ah, I remember now! You must be Ms. Lenore from the something-something Archive of the Sanctuary Affairs Bureau, right? You sent me sympathy letters after I applied for the Order's aid.
yakita:lmzx_11_20.zh: 啊——我想起来了！圣堂事务局那个什么什么书院的伊诺尔小姐对吧，当时我向修会申请援助，你给我回了好几封慰问信来着。
yakita:lmzx_11_20.speaker: Andreas

yakita:lmzx_11_29.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_3_3
yakita:lmzx_11_29.text: Now, listen to me carefully, Ms. Lenore—I want you to grab every unhappy thought you've got... and direct it squarely at Captain Brant!
yakita:lmzx_11_29.zh: 伊诺尔小姐，你听我说——现在，把你感受到的所有不开心，统统怪到布兰特团长身上吧！
yakita:lmzx_11_29.speaker: Andreas

yakita:lmzx_11_35.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_3_3
yakita:lmzx_11_35.text: Ms. Lenore, I don't blame a pure soul for being naive. And I won't fault a kind heart for not being kinder.
yakita:lmzx_11_35.zh: 伊诺尔小姐，我不会责怪单纯的人太过单纯，也不会埋怨善良的人还不够善良。
yakita:lmzx_11_35.speaker: Andreas

yakita:FavorWord_151213_Content.text:
Lady Anna and I were close friends when we studied at the Clotho Doctors Alliance. We were sent to different war zones after, but we never stopped writing letters. Right up until I was sent to the Fifth Sector...
Luckily, we both made it out alive. When I saw her again, she'd become the New Federation's "Queen of the Deep," with powerful folks kneeling at her feet. But even now that she's taken her place among the powers that be, I'll never think ill of her. We always stood side by side, ever since our days in the Alliance. She's saving people in her own way, I'm sure of it. So... until we can stand beside each other again, I won't let myself break!
yakita:FavorWord_151213_Content.zh:
安娜小姐是我在「克洛瑞德医师联盟」学习时认识的好友。后来，我们前往了不同的战区工作，但始终保持着书信联系，直到我前往第五战区……
幸运的是，我们都活了下来。再次见面，她已是新联邦的“水下女王”，无数权贵跪倒在她脚下。但即便她成了支配者的一员，我也绝对不会去恶意揣测她。从在医师联盟学习开始，我们就一直并肩作战，我坚信，她是在用自己的方式去拯救他人。所以……在与她会合前，我也不会倒下！
yakita:FavorWord_151213_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_211_16.text: I've arranged an auction. Quite a few exceptional items will be on offer. Since you're all longstanding patrons, you know precisely what such items represent...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_211_16.zh: 我准备了一场拍卖会，里面有不少好东西，大家都是老买家了，你们都清楚那些东西意味着什么……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_211_16.speaker: Anna

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_211_18.text: So, I'd like to hear your thoughts. And more to the point, what you're prepared to lay on the table...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_211_18.zh: 所以，我想听听大家的意愿，以及你们能拿出什么筹码……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_211_18.speaker: Anna

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_211_19.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束5_17_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_211_19.text: Meanwhile, a meeting unfolds somewhere in the New Federation. Several powerful figures voice their concern that the Resonator War could happen again. Their discussion is interrupted by a woman named Anna, who appears to be hosting the gathering. She mocks the assembled dignitaries before steering them back to the matter at hand. It seems she has arranged an auction for the New Federates...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_211_19.zh: 此时此刻，新联邦的某一角正召开着会议。新联邦的几位权贵似乎担心着那场战争会再次重演，这时候，名叫安娜的女子打断了他们的谈话。从谈话中可以得知，她是这里的主人。她讽刺着在座的所有权贵，将会议拉回到了正题，安娜似乎准备了一场面向联邦人的拍卖会……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_211_8.text: Heh... Lady Anna is quite right, as always. Gentlemen, we are merely guests here. Why don't we hear what our host has to say?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_211_8.zh: 诶嘿嘿，安娜小姐说的是，各位，我们是来客，我们还是先听听这里的主人，安娜小姐怎么说吧。

yakita:Flow_311000006_602.chapter: 剧情_天城生态_NPC_其他过道_3_1
yakita:Flow_311000006_602.text: We need to be extra vigilant to ensure everyone's safety, just like Chixia said!
yakita:Flow_311000006_602.zh: 到时候可更得盯紧点，要保证居民朋友的安全，炽霞姐就是这么说的！
yakita:Flow_311000006_602.speaker: Aomei

yakita:Side_NPCZYJWBTH_3_3.text: I need to be more vigilant to keep the people safe. That's what Chixia said!
yakita:Side_NPCZYJWBTH_3_3.zh: 我可得盯紧点，要保证居民朋友的安全，炽霞姐就是这么说的！
yakita:Side_NPCZYJWBTH_3_3.speaker: Aomei

yakita:MXXSST_37_1.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_38_1
yakita:MXXSST_37_1.text: 漂泊者... No, Lady Hsin's Arbiter. I've finally met you!
yakita:MXXSST_37_1.zh: 漂泊者……不，心大人的御者，终于见到你了！

yakita:JSZYH_1_10.text: Please rest assured, Mengzhou's Ministry affairs will be handled. It is our duty. And should anything require the Arbiter's assistance, we will inform you at once.
yakita:JSZYH_1_10.zh: 请放心……梦州谛天鉴诸事，我们都会妥善处理，这是我们的职责所在……如果有需要御者介入之事，我们自会及时告知。

yakita:JSZYH_1_11.text: Ah, we were only doing our duty, Arbiter. Think nothing of it.
yakita:JSZYH_1_11.zh: 这……是我们职责所在，御者不必挂怀。

yakita:JSZYH_1_7.text: One thing, though... now that the crisis here is over, it's time I returned to Mengzhou to give the Ministry my report. So I've come to say goodbye, Arbiter.
yakita:JSZYH_1_7.zh: 只不过……既然此处的危机解除，我也得返回梦州谛天鉴述职，这回是来向御者辞行的。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_234_4.text: The Arbiter and Suoming will not give it the chance.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_234_4.zh: 御者和锁暝不会给祂机会。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_28.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_7_心相迷宫&后日谈_3_9
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_28.text:
You ask Suoming what became of the people of Mengzhou during the century after Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox was struck down, while "Hsin" was away remolding the Civilization Capsule. Not long after the assassination, a Waveworn Phenomenon called the "Evil Miasma" spread across Mengzhou. Suoming's homeland, Huating, was ravaged as well, and countless lives were lost. The Sentinel, bound by Its own injuries, could offer no help. Suoming took up the title of Intendant and led the Ministry's members against the disaster, each of them carrying a "Providence Lock" the Sentinel had made imbued with Its power. Over the years, the situation in Mengzhou began to stabilize.
 
Suoming tells you that Mingting is working with the Ministries of every city to seek greater possibilities for the Huanglong Sentinels, and that when the time is ripe, you will be needed to act as Arbiter.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_28.zh: 你向锁暝询问心月狐遇刺后，心重塑 “文明之匣” 的百年间梦州百姓的状况：岁主遇刺后名为 “恶瘴” 的海蚀现象在梦州蔓延，锁暝的故乡华亭亦受“恶瘴”威胁，生灵涂炭。彼时岁主受困于伤势无法伸出援手，锁暝接过州监之位，带领谛天鉴成员佩戴岁主所制的 “锦妙锁” 对抗危难，令梦州局势趋于稳定。锁暝告诉你，明庭正联合各州谛天鉴探寻瑝珑岁主的更多可能性，待到时机成熟时需御者介入。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_255_14.text: Perhaps, because you repelled Ovathrax in Jinzhou, Mengzhou has remained peaceful.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_255_14.zh: 而且，兴许是因为御者在今州击退了无相燹主，梦州属地这段时间也很太平。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_255_14.speaker: Hsin

yakita:LHYSTTH2_6_10.text: Me? If Chisa could be my reading partner... then yeah, I'll join, too!
yakita:LHYSTTH2_6_10.zh: 我……能和千咲同学一起读书的话，当然要参加了！
yakita:LHYSTTH2_6_10.speaker: Arisa

yakita:LHYSTTH2_6_8.text: Chisa likes detective stories too, right? The fan club could invite her to join.
yakita:LHYSTTH2_6_8.zh: 千咲同学不是也喜欢本格推理嘛，邀请她加入同好会怎么样。
yakita:LHYSTTH2_6_8.speaker: Arisa

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_66_1.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_折枝_12_1
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_66_1.text: Master Zhezhi, have you made any plans for your next painting?
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_66_1.zh: 折枝大师，不知道您对下一卷画画什么可有想法？
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_66_1.speaker: Art Manager

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_66_12.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_折枝_12_1
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_66_12.text: Of course. Take your time, Master Zhezhi. Let me know when you've decided.
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_66_12.zh: 好好，折枝大师，您慢慢画不着急，我等着你的消息！
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_66_12.speaker: Art Manager

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_73_12.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_折枝_14_1
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_73_12.text: Zhezhi, you're a true master! Would a master present a client with a half-finished piece?
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_73_12.zh: 不是……折枝大师，您要清楚自己的身份。您可是大师啊，当然要用最成熟的作品示人！
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_73_12.speaker: Art Manager

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_73_16.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_折枝_14_1
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_73_16.text: With all due respect, Master Zhezhi, not everyone will buy whatever you paint.
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_73_16.zh: 不是我刻意贬低您，但现状就是，您不是那种画什么都有人买的画家。
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_73_16.speaker: Art Manager

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_73_4.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_折枝_14_1
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_73_4.text: Okay, Master Zhezhi! About the painting I mentioned last time...
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_73_4.zh: 您手头的画，不知道情况如何了？
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_73_4.speaker: Art Manager

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_76_3.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_折枝_5_1
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_76_3.text: Don't be so stubborn, Zhezhi! A painting that doesn't sell well is meaningless!
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_76_3.zh: 折枝大师，你真是执迷不悟！卖不出好价的画，没有任何意义！
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_76_3.speaker: Art Manager

datamine:InfoDisplay_102801016_Text.title: Monitoring Report on Abnormal Spectrum Performance of C-001
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801016_Text.text:
[…]

Title: Spectrum Anomaly Monitoring Report for Subject C-001

[…]

The data exhibited significant increases with varying patterns.

It was postulated that this event occurred due to the presence of Subject C-002, also known as the "Mianloong Chamber." Subsequent thirty-two one-factor experiments confirmed a significant correlation between Subject C-002 and the duration of frequency loss in Subject C-001.

[…]

Firmament would likely surpass its limitations and impact a broader range of regions… Such as, the entirety of Jinzhou.

[…]

Efforts are being made to advance the development of the artificial Resonance Object.

Although we have not yet achieved success, we have decided to name it the "Chronosorter" in honor of our recent progress.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801016_Text.zh:
名称：关于个体C-001的频谱异常表现监测报告
编号：#H-C-6947
【内容概要】
本报告所使用数据来自████6月至████12月间，针对个体C-001（一般用名，「角」）的频谱检测实验。
在████6月14日首次实验中，研究人员发现个体C-001的频谱出现长达15秒缺频，后于当日及次日共计进行5次检测，得到的缺频数据没有显著性差异（误差值小于0.02）。
在次月第3日、第6日、第11日、第23日、第30日获取的频谱检测数据中，个体C-001的缺频持续时长呈缓慢增长趋势，但单次数据增幅差异大，增长速率不恒定，考虑或受个体C-002（一般用名，眠龙庭）影响——在后续的32次单因素实验中，证实个体C-002与个体C-001的频谱缺频时长增长速率相关，对个体C-001的频谱缺频时长增长有抑制作用。
基于████6月至████12月间有关个体C-001的频谱监测数据，分析得出初步结论如下：
1. 个体C-001存在缺陷/损伤。
2. 个体C-002可暂缓个体C-001缺陷/损伤发展，但无法补足个体C-001的频谱缺损。

附录-1（来源于研究备忘录#C349）
在那位“奇人”的帮助下，我们与个体C-001有了对谈的机会。这是一次有意义的谈话，也是一次平等的谈话，虽然我们得到的信息并不像我预想的那么多。
但这次对话至少证明了一点：我们此前的研究是有成效的，C-001的确存在某种“缺陷”。用祂的话来说“时序之法失其一”，在全盛情况下C-001可以减缓或停滞时间、回溯时间、回正时间，可现在，祂“病”了，被干涉过的时序无法回正复原，乘霄山成了时间汪洋中的“孤岛”，尽管这一切的开端是出于拯救。

附加-2（来源于研究备忘录#C382）
根据时间流速模型的测算，我们得到了两个推论：
第一，C-001的“缺陷”并非是先天性的，这一“缺陷”应当始于C-001初至乘霄山前后（已确认“缺陷”无法修复，详见报告#H-C-7426）。
第二，“结界”内外的时流差异正在逐渐扩大，经由数据对比，乘霄山时间流速的减缓速率与C-001的缺频持续时长增长速率相关。

yakita:ItemInfo_42601490_BgDescription.text: A far‑from‑home species that, when mature, bears bell‑shaped crimson fruits. In Ashinohara, these fruits are often consecrated to the divine. Should a soft chime ring out during prayer, know that the divine has heard your plea.

yakita:ItemInfo_80001077_BgDescription.text:
Red bean pudding that can be easily made at home, a simple homemade dessert. After Hiyuki tweaked the recipe, it now comes in a more convenient package.
Hiyuki doesn't have much of a sweet tooth, but once she became the miko, she quietly visited a dessert shop to learn how to make red bean puddings. 
The children of Ashinohara came to call it the "good luck pudding." However the story grew, the sweetness itself stayed simple. Almost plain.
Just as she hoped.
yakita:ItemInfo_80001077_BgDescription.zh:
在家中也可以轻松制作的红豆布丁，最朴素的家常甜点之一。经由绯雪的改良，变为更方便携带的袋装形制。
绯雪对甜食并无过分的偏好，但在她接任巫女职位后，悄悄去一家甜品店请教了红豆布丁的做法。
即便在苇原的孩子间被传成“能够带来福气”的布丁，但不论外界如何流传，它都只有一份朴素到有些寡淡的甜。
就像她所期盼的那样。

yakita:Term851078_Desc.text:
Ashinohara has long relied on the "miko system" to resist the Threnodian, with each miko organization assigned to a specific territory. The Miko of Flaming Sakura is unique, her responsibility spanning all of Ashinohara.
The Seal of Flaming Sakura is one of her line's secret arts, said to have been created by the very first Miko of Flaming Sakura . It is the only secret art passed down in written form. The seal draws power from the miko herself: the more power she channels into it, the longer it lasts.
The seal's form changes with its caster.
It is said that Hiyuki sealed away part of "her own future" within it—including, some say, a future that cannot be named.
yakita:Term851078_Desc.zh:
苇原是依靠“巫女制度”与鸣式长久对抗的，各巫女所属的组织各有其负责的区块。而灼樱巫女，便是其中最特殊的一支——在职责划分上，整个苇原都在灼樱的守护范围内。
灼樱封印，便是灼樱流传下的秘法之一，据传是由首任灼樱巫女所创，也是灼樱唯一以典籍形式流传下来的秘法。它可以将灼樱巫女身上的部分力量剥离，形成封印，投入的力量越多，封印的效果也就越长久。
封印的形制受施术者影响，呈现出不同的样式。
据说，绯雪在其中封存了部分“自身的未来”——其中，甚至有一份不可言说的未来。

The subject's Rabelle's Waveform diagram exhibits an elliptical oscillation pattern with a stable Time Domain representation. No abnormal fluctuations were observed. Examination results are determined to be within normal parameters. 
 
Current Overclocking threshold is exceptionally high, and subject stability remains robust. There is no risk of Overclocking, and the subject has no prior history of Overclocking. However, a course of psychological intervention is recommended.
 
"This miko... How should I put this..."
"Ashinohara textbooks never show her face, but they're clear about one thing. She is the strongest living warrior in all of Ashinohara."
"And yet, with all that combat, her readings stay perfectly stable. Something about that just doesn't sit right..."
"I get your concern, but the data is clear. There's not a single irregularity."
"...Then what about those shadows? Like parallel-universe versions of herself from some movie?"
"Hardly. It must be the Suzu's power. Just as the Ashinohara records describe, it allows her to 'draw upon the future' to a certain extent."

当前超频临界值极高，稳定性高，绝无超频风险，无过往超频史。

yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1108_TalentDoc.zh:
「调自深空联合：保密档案」
「访谈报告记录：绯雪」
出于多方考量，我们并未对苇原的代表，即灼樱巫女，进行真正深入的完整测试。
大部分情报都由她本人自述，从记录者本人的经验，及多方查证后来看，她无意隐藏关于自身的任何情报。
“毕竟关于这位「永世灼樱巫女」的情报，随便一本苇原小学教材上都翻得到……”

据她本人所说，其特殊能力的共鸣源，是她佩戴在右手手腕处，被称为“颂物”的「铃」。
绯雪本人对「铃」的描述为：能够通过它看到未来自身的可能性，并加以利用，但无法做到与“未来可能性的影子”沟通。
她通常战斗中所使用的冰结能力，也是从「铃」中取得的一部分。
“据苇原官方报告核实，颂物是岁主留下的五种物品，分别交由苇原内部势力保管。”
“其中，关于「铃」的描述为‘预取未来’。”

因此，判断其卓绝战斗能力的根本来源，仍然是她自身。
但供她预取的未来总有尽头，出于对她自身寿命的考虑，仍不建议过于激进地使用能力。
“据查证，历代灼樱巫女的死因都只有一条，在战斗中过于激进地使用「铃」而凭空在战场上消失。”
