yakita:FavorStory_110801_Content.zh:
从醉倒的玉露口中第一次听到自己的身世时，绯雪抿了抿嘴，为自己也倒上半杯。
“绯雪……我的好绯雪呀！”
“你做不了这个……你不能做什么狗屁灼樱巫女……你的人生不该是这样！”
绯雪眯起眼，如果让大家看到平日里威风凛凛的灼樱巫女大人，私下里竟是这副模样……
秒针向前，分针渐进，时针终于肯向前挪动。
按照苇原的算法，从这一刻起，就算迈入成年了。
她叹了口气，将面前的半杯一饮而尽。
“你做得，我就做不得了？”
辛辣入喉，再向下，揉入略显单薄的身体。
嗯，所谓长作大人后才能喝的东西，滋味也不过如此。
绯雪站起身，拖出一床被子来，盖在哼哼唧唧的玉露身上，抵在角落里窝了一阵，又回头紧了紧被角才关门离去。

第二日，玉露对着颂物继承管理人的发怒的骂声隔两条街都听得到。
「铃」的能力本质是预取未来，简单地讲，使用者的寿命会随着力量的取用逐渐减少，再说得过分些，兴许今天刚刚接过「铃」的使用者，会在下一场对鸣式的战斗中身亡。
因此，继承者的选定通常被提前的极早，即便玉露一直不肯选定绯雪为正式继任者，但跟随玉露前后生活十几年……除了绯雪外，还能是谁？
玉露的性子没人压得住，管理人只能讪笑着应和，哎呀……就算不是绯雪，您也总得指一位出来不是？
玉露沉默了数秒，叹了口气，清了清嗓子，总之，先把他们骂回去吧。

终归是绯雪推门开口，结束了这场闹剧。
“十几年来我跟着你走遍了苇原，各处该注意的，我都清楚。”
“苇原巫女百般武艺我都学会了，织造术法、仪典舞道，更是你亲自找的老师。”
“玉露姐……灼樱巫女大人，唯有我，不会玷污灼樱的名讳。”
玉露皱紧了眉头，扬了扬手。
“你都学会了，那你难道不知道，这「铃」会要了你的命？”
“我本就是被你捡回来的孤儿，家人都在那场鸣式灾袭中被埋在雪里了，无牵无挂。”
房间里静得令人喘不过气，只余下玉露摩挲手腕铃铛的沙哑声。
她张了张口，终是没能发出声来。

yakita:FavorStory_110802_Content.text:
[…]

The days following Hiyuki's succession were inevitably frantic.

[…]

Ashinohara had long suffered under the Threnodian's shadow, forcing the land to weave its very survival around the mikos.

As the bearer of the Suzu, Hiyuki's status was as uniquely sacred as it was heavy, and her jurisdiction covered the entirety of Ashinohara.

[…]

The Miko of Flaming Sakura was no exception.

[…]

The only thing missing was Gyokuro's specific Flaming Sakura swordsmanship.

[…]
yakita:FavorStory_110802_Content.zh:
接过灼樱巫女继承者的责任后，绯雪的日子不可避免地繁忙起来。往日只需跟在玉露身后看着，如今许多事务必须亲自上手才行。
苇原受鸣式侵袭已久，以巫女为核心构建起了自身的防御体系，其中，灼樱作为颂物「铃」的持有者，地位更为特殊，责任也更为沉重，划分上，整个苇原都是灼樱巫女的守备范围。因此，灼樱巫女必须频繁往返于苇原各地，四处作战，分担各地巫女的压力。
另一方面，巫女也是苇原人的精神寄托，要在各类活动中频繁露面，给予苇原坚持与鸣式抗争的信心，灼樱巫女，自然不可缺席。
绯雪处理得很好，兴许是年幼时便跟随灼樱巫女左右，战斗也好，仪典也罢，她早已习惯了这些。
只是，玉露仍不肯传给她灼樱的刀法，甚至平日里也刻意地与绯雪拉开了些距离。
也好，你不肯教，那我便偷偷学吧，总有一天能学会的，总有一天。

没有那一天了。
「铃」的能力本质是预取未来，兴许今天刚刚接过「铃」的使用者，会在下一场对鸣式的战斗中身亡。

绯雪已不记得管理人在将「铃」交给自己时口中念叨的是什么，也不记得是如何将它学着熟悉的样子绑在手腕上，她不记得那一天的天气，不记得是谁递给她那个代表玉露的小盒子……等她反应过来时，已捧着盒子里那张愿签，呆坐在空荡的灼樱本部里了。
血液仿佛在心脏处凝固，指尖有些麻痹了。
绯雪一点一点地移动，抵在熟悉的角落里窝了一阵。
那枚愿签被揉皱了，又展开。

“……嗯。”
“……你的愿望，我收下了。”
“……不会再有下一个灼樱巫女。”

yakita:FavorStory_110803_Content.text:
[…]

"Lady Hiyuki, you have served as the Miko of Flaming Sakura for a century now.

[…]

Long enough that "Hiyuki" was now a fixed entry in Ashinohara's history books.

[…]

The Office of Legacy Talismans now treated its visits to the shrine as a mere formality.

[…]

Yet Hiyuki often heard a voice.

It wasn't the grating, persistent lure of the Fractsidus.

[…]

But your enemy, the Threnodian, has a far longer lifespan.

[…]

Hiyuki rose and called out to the child who had volunteered to help clean the shrine, reminding her to stay vigilant and watch for intruders while she was away.

[…]

Hiyuki waved goodbye to the little girl.

[…]
yakita:FavorStory_110803_Content.zh:
“绯雪大人，您担任灼樱巫女已有百年，如果再次立约……”
“无妨。”
“那，便依照之前的约定，再许多少年呢？”
“随你填吧。”
“没想到您会和上任巫女一样……咳，好吧，如您所愿，「永世灼樱巫女」大人。”
管理人恭敬地关上门，与他一起来的工作人员似乎已换了三次。
绯雪摇摇头，眯起眼打量着桌上的信封，顿了顿，转而伸向已冷掉的茶杯。
和上任巫女一样……吗？

接过灼樱巫女之名，到底已过了多久？
久到苇原的课本上已有了绯雪的名字。
长吗？
还不够长。
如同那年那日承接下的愿签，绯雪用自身的能力证明着，不会再有下一个灼樱巫女。渐渐地，催促选定继任者的声音越来越少，颂物管理处也只把拜访灼樱当作例行公事，恐怕连管理人自己都觉得无需选定继承者，绯雪已是巫女一职的代名词了。

但绯雪时常会听到一种声音，那声音并不如残星会的劝诱那样恼人，它只是平和、安静地在她耳边陈述着。
绯雪，你已经坚持了足够久的时间——但眼前的敌人，鸣式，祂有着更为漫长的时间，直到你死去，直到每一位巫女的每一位继承者都死去。
与鸣式抗争的这条道路，真的有尽头吗？

冷掉的茶水最苦，那股熟透的苦涩味道绕在舌尖，让每一次呼吸都带着令人不快的沉闷。
绯雪的指尖轻叩在信封上，那信封便迅速地结上一层冰霜，再微微一点，其上的残星会标记便随未打开的蜡封化作冰屑碎裂。

绯雪起身，叮嘱门外自愿来打扫的孩子，在她离开时要多加注意，小心外人摸进来。
她又露出笑容来，揉了揉那孩子的脑袋，将一枚平安符放在小小的手心。
“巫女大人，您这次是要去哪儿帮忙呀？”
“穗波，我很快回来，这几天，记得把这符带在身边。”

绯雪与身后的小姑娘挥手作别，腕上的铃铛仍旧光彩照人。

yakita:FavorStory_110804_Content.text:
[…]

The people of Ashinohara had long grown accustomed to the distortions wrought by the Threnodian.

Survival was a matter of routine: seek shelter, wait for the local miko to deploy, and if the situation spiraled, wait for the recovery teams and the Miko of Flaming Sakura to arrive.

To Hiyuki, this felt like just another fight among thousands.

[…]

Even after a desperate appeal to the Spacetrek Collective for their most advanced tracking technology, not a single trace could be found.

[…]

Hiyuki returned to the Flaming Sakura.

She took the protective charm from the child at the gate, forcing a ghost of a smile.

[…]
yakita:FavorStory_110804_Content.zh:
苇原的人们早已惯常于鸣式引发的怪异，无非是躲避到安全处，负责本区域的巫女自会出动，事态再大些，也不过是等待救援队与灼樱巫女到场。
至于绯雪，原本也认为这只是千百次鸣式侵袭中的一次，她利落地解决怪物，依照往常的习惯检查结界的情况。
躲藏在安全屋中的民众走出，父母拉起孩子的手指向绯雪，看，那边那位就是灼樱巫女大人哦？

绯雪轻轻点头回应，迈步避开倒下的、标识着禁止通行的路牌，又转身回到结界中。
只需像往常一样，凝神、挥刀、收刀……嗯？
刀刃划过的手感，似乎有微妙的区别？

绯雪将整个结界都检查了一遍，好像没什么不对，但那股异样的手感仍粘滞在指腹，她放开刀柄，活动着手腕，指尖轻抿……
一滴泛彩的黑色泥泞悄然从指尖生出，涌向指缝间漏下，悄然自脚下漫开。
绯雪抽刀出鞘，霜寒瞬间凝结——先控制住它，让民众撤离，再想办法——绯雪转过身，却发不出声音。
如同从未存在过一般，好像连同此处的空气也消失，呼吸也被迫静止了一瞬。

穗波，消失了。
除开脚下那块碎裂的禁止通行与悄然爬上裙摆的泥泞，不再有任何存在的痕迹。

向前伸出手，手指又自顾自地退缩回来。
急促地想要呼吸，却又捕捉不到氧气。
手中的刀刃想要挥出，却找不到可以斩断的敌人。
唯有残留的频率痕迹证明着，鸣式曾以从未被观测过的烈度活动过一瞬。

依据苇原的观测记录表明，那一瞬，穗波似乎被拉入了另一个空间。
后续，即便向深空联合提出援助申请，期望借由最新的技术，也没能查出一丝踪迹。

当其他人将绯雪带离原地时，绯雪下意识地摩挲着手腕处的铃铛，仍未来得及从那一瞬的惊诧中走出。
这场无声的灾难，是绯雪的责任吗？
当然是，作为灼樱巫女，她没能救下穗波。
当然不是，在鸣式面前，单薄一人，即便能预取百万种未来于此刻，又算得上什么？

绯雪返回灼樱，从门外的孩子手中接过还愿的平安符，挤出一抹笑容来。
慢步向前，疲惫地推开房门，桌上悄然放着那封理应被碎裂的信件。

绯雪啊绯雪，这条路，真的有尽头吗？

yakita:FavorWord_110807_Content.text: Ashinohara still occupies my thoughts... but I would not call it a burden. The past is settled. What remains is to handle what was left behind. Even if it is nowhere to be found on any map, the land still carries a legacy meant to endure.
yakita:FavorWord_110807_Content.zh: 苇原……不过，这也算不得什么烦恼，既然事情已经发生，无非是如何处理的问题。即便它已在地图上消失，总该留有些痕迹。
yakita:FavorWord_110807_Content.speaker: Hiyuki

yakita:FavorWord_110808_Content.text: Gyokuro tea. It is Ashinohara's specialty. When I was young, I would steal sips from the adults' cups. All I tasted then was bitterness. But by the time I learned to appreciate the sweet aftertaste, I realized I had begun to miss that bitterness instead.
yakita:FavorWord_110808_Content.zh: 茶，以苇原特产的玉露茶最优。年幼时悄悄喝过大人杯中的茶，那时只觉得苦涩，等到能品出其中清香时，倒找寻起最初那口苦涩了。
yakita:FavorWord_110808_Content.speaker: Hiyuki

yakita:FavorWord_110811_Content.text: The bell I wear on my wrist is what we call a "Legacy Talisman" in Ashinohara. For us Mikos of Flaming Sakura, it is a sacred relic passed down through generations—a vessel of Ashinohara's wishes. Through it, I gain the power to burn my futures, a power said to originate from Ashinohara's Sentinel. I know you share a close bond with the Sentinels. If you wish to see it, I can show it to you. Oh... the cord tied to the bell? Gyokuro braided it for me when I was a child. That alone is mine. The only thing that is.
yakita:FavorWord_110811_Content.zh: 我手腕处的铃铛，在苇原被称为“颂物”，对灼樱巫女而言，它是代代相传的秘宝，承载着苇原众生的愿望。这铃铛也是我“预求身”力量的来源，据说其本源来自苇原的岁主，你与岁主关系紧密，如果你感兴趣，也可以摘下来给你看看……这铃上的系绳，是年幼时玉露姐为我编的发绳，它才是独属于我的宝物。
yakita:FavorWord_110811_Content.speaker: Hiyuki

yakita:FavorWord_110812_Content.text: If you wish to know more about my past, you will find snippets of it in the records of Ashinohara. They tell a far more vivid tale than I ever could. After all, my only memory of the past is me striking that blade, again and again and again.
yakita:FavorWord_110812_Content.zh: 我的过去……感兴趣的话，苇原相关的资料里应该有不少能查阅的。真由我自己说出口倒显得无趣，毕竟，对我来说，只是在不停地挥刀而已。
yakita:FavorWord_110812_Content.speaker: Hiyuki

yakita:FavorWord_110814_Content.text: Chisa is also from Ashinohara. I have made a point to avoid meeting her. After all, in our homeland, Mikos only appeared in the darkest of times. We were never omens of good fortune—perhaps a parallel can be drawn to those detective comics popular nowadays. Besides, it may be unsettling to see a name from history standing before you in the flesh. Also, please do not speak to her of what transpired in Ashinohara. That burden is not hers to bear.
yakita:FavorWord_110814_Content.zh: 千咲同学也是从苇原来，我刻意避开了与她过分接触，毕竟，巫女总是在情况恶劣时出现，总觉得像什么不祥之物——就像时下流行的侦探漫画读物里那样。而且，教材上的人突然出现在面前，总会感到困惑吧？对了，暂时不要向她提起苇原的事，不论如何，那不是她该担忧的。
yakita:FavorWord_110814_Content.speaker: Hiyuki

yakita:FavorWord_110818_Content.text: Though Lucilla insists our partnership is only contractual, I am well aware that without her discreet arrangements, I would have no place in the Spacetrek Collective, much less have obtained that blade. She carries herself lightly, yet the weight on her shoulders is plain to see. She often visits me, half in jest, declaring that she intends to "call it quits"—it is her way of venting. Before returning to Ashinohara, I should at least see her through the troubles presently at hand.
yakita:FavorWord_110818_Content.zh: 即便她多次和我强调过，我们只是“雇佣”关系，但我心里清楚，没有洛瑟菈上下打点照顾，我没办法留在深空联合，更没办法取得那把刀。她平日看起来轻松，身上背负的压力却不少，常来我这里叫嚷着“不干了”之类的话来排解压力……在返回苇原之前，至少得陪她处理完眼下的麻烦。
yakita:FavorWord_110818_Content.speaker: Hiyuki

yakita:FavorWord_121114_Content.text:
That miko from Ashinohara is so powerful. Like she's cheating, you know? Yeah, I'd heard the stories before. But facing that power myself was a whole different story.
She wasn't exactly what I pictured, though. Beyond all that strength and the gentleness you can tell right from her face, there's something else, almost... clinging to her. Something that won't wash away. Loneliness... or maybe regret?
If growing stronger really comes with a price, I wonder… what has she given up to get this power?
yakita:FavorWord_121114_Content.zh:
那位苇原的巫女强的犯规了吧？虽然听过她的传闻，但亲自体会她的力量，又是另一回事了。
不过她本人给我的感觉却和印象中有些出入呢。除了强大，温柔，这种几乎写在脸上的特点外，总觉得还有某种无法洗去的东西纠缠着她……那是种该命名为孤独或者遗憾的情绪吗？
如果说成长需要代价的话，她又是失去了多少东西，才变得这么强大的呢？
yakita:FavorWord_121114_Content.speaker: Denia

yakita:HD_JYZDFY_1_19.text: It's about a miko from my hometown. I don't know if you've heard, but Ashinohara's defense against the Threnodian was built around mikos.
yakita:HD_JYZDFY_1_19.zh: 是关于我故乡的一位巫女，不知道你有没有听说过，苇原抵抗鸣式的防线是以巫女为核心构建的。
yakita:HD_JYZDFY_1_19.speaker: Platya

yakita:HD_JYZDFY_8_3.text: But I did find one journal. The daily habits recorded in it match someone from Ashinohara. It's highly likely our Lady Miko wrote it herself.
yakita:HD_JYZDFY_8_3.zh: 不过我注意到了一封日志，里面记载的生活习惯与穗波人十分相像，而且极有可能就是巫女大人写下的。
yakita:HD_JYZDFY_8_3.speaker: Platya

yakita:MAIN_RGLC_15_5.text: Zashiki-warashi won't require much of your attention. This Overseer primarily operates in Ashinohara, a region that's been largely destroyed by the Lament.
yakita:MAIN_RGLC_15_5.zh: 「座敷童子」，这个会监不用太关注，其活动的地域主要在苇原，而苇原已经被悲鸣毁灭大半了。
yakita:MAIN_RGLC_15_5.speaker: Luuk Herssen

yakita:MAIN_RGLC_15_6.text: Ashinohara... I've heard of it somewhere before.
yakita:MAIN_RGLC_15_6.speaker: Rover

yakita:MAIN_RGLC_15_7.text: The girl we had in the infirmary for a while, Chisa, I remember? The city that trapped her, Honami, is part of Ashinohara.
yakita:MAIN_RGLC_15_7.zh: 之前在医务室养过一段时间伤的孩子，我记得是叫千咲？她曾在的穗波市就属于苇原。
yakita:MAIN_RGLC_15_7.speaker: Luuk Herssen

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_82_11.text: All eyes are watching Ashinohara now. In Lucilla's words, it is a "complicated and troublesome adult world." And the appearance of the Miko of Flaming Sakura would only complicate things further.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_82_11.zh: 现在各方都在注意着苇原的情况，用洛瑟菈的说法是“比较复杂、麻烦的大人世界”，灼樱巫女的出现只会让事情变得更复杂。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_82_15.text: The Fractsidus. The Threnodian... Perhaps even something rooted within Ashinohara itself. I will have to see with my own eyes to know.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_82_15.zh: 残星会、鸣式……也有可能是苇原内部的问题……得亲眼看看才知道了。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_82_3.text: Nothing of value. Lucilla made inquiries on my behalf. There have been discoveries of peculiar frequency traces where Ashinohara's center once lay. Investigations are ongoing.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_82_3.zh: 没什么有价值的消息，洛瑟菈帮我打听过，苇原曾经的中心上倒是有一些奇怪的频率残留，各方也都在查。

yakita:NPC_HBGC_35_6.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_19
yakita:NPC_HBGC_35_6.text: "Now in active production!!! The Academy's 100 Great Mysteries!" You can just tell this is from some Ashinohara students...
yakita:NPC_HBGC_35_6.zh: 《学院百大不可思议》锐意连载中？这种标题一看就是苇原的学生起的啊！

yakita:NPC_XYJS_2_7.text: Well, Ashinohara was devastated by it. I hope to work with Ms. Platya one day at the Black Shores to develop an early warning system for such disasters.
yakita:NPC_XYJS_2_7.zh: 因为苇原受到这样的灾难蹂躏，我想有一天，能去黑海岸和桔梗小姐一起工作，对那些灾难做出预警。

yakita:QDHDNPCST_74_5.text: People from everywhere: Huanglong, Rinascita, Ashinohara, the New Federation...
yakita:QDHDNPCST_74_5.zh: 大家来自许多地方，瑝珑、黎那汐塔、苇原、新联邦……

yakita:Side_DESLGYMZ_37_1.chapter: 剧情_活动_找BUG二期_新年别墅_37_1
yakita:Side_DESLGYMZ_37_1.text: There's this widespread urban legend in Ashinohara... Says that in the dead of night, swordsmen wielding vegetables duel it out in the streets.
yakita:Side_DESLGYMZ_37_1.zh: 以前有一个在苇原流传很广的都市传说……据说在午夜，会有使用蔬菜作为武器的剑客在街头决斗。
yakita:Side_DESLGYMZ_37_1.speaker: Bertolt

yakita:Side_DESLGYMZ_37_25.chapter: 剧情_活动_找BUG二期_新年别墅_37_1
yakita:Side_DESLGYMZ_37_25.text: But according to Ashinohara's urban legend, those white radishes can cleave a phone booth clean in half with a single swing.
yakita:Side_DESLGYMZ_37_25.zh: 可在苇原的传说里，那些白萝卜可是能一刀把电话亭切成两半的！
yakita:Side_DESLGYMZ_37_25.speaker: Bertolt

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_10_23.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半序章_6_1
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_10_23.text: I know the Fractsidus has caused Ashinohara its fair share of grief. But personally? I hold no ill will toward you.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_10_23.zh: 我知道，残星会给苇原添了不少麻烦，但我本人对你并无敌意。

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_14_1.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半序章_9_1
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_14_1.text: (If Ashinohara could truly be this peaceful, if their dreams could really come true… then I wouldn't have to raise my blade ever again…)
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_14_1.zh: （如果苇原真能有这样平和的日子，实现他们的愿望，也无需再用刀了吧……）
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_14_1.speaker: Hiyuki

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_163_21.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_16_12
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_163_21.text: Hiyuki. Lucilla told me you fought a Threnodian in Ashinohara for a long time.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_163_21.zh: 绯雪，洛瑟菈说你在苇原和鸣式打过很久交道。
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_163_21.speaker: Rover

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_163_23.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_16_12
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_163_23.text: Did you fight in Ashinohara because you were certain you would win?
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_163_23.zh: 你是因为有必胜的把握，才前往苇原战场的吗？
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_163_23.speaker: Rover

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_163_29.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_16_12
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_163_29.text: Before breaking the Seal of Flaming Sakura, Hiyuki mentions the high likelihood that confronting the Threnodian could end in failure. You don't deny it. You don't promise success, only that you'll give everything you have, just as she did back in Ashinohara. Hiyuki sighs, then turns toward the seal.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_163_29.zh: 解开裂隙的灼樱封印前，绯雪向你提及了对抗鸣式失败的可能性，而你也坦言自己并无百分百的成功把握，但求尽力而为——如同当年苇原的绯雪，易地而处，她也会做同样的选择。绯雪叹息一声，转身走向封印处。

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_168_26.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_24_1
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_168_26.text: ...As I learned when I failed to save Ashinohara.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_168_26.speaker: Hiyuki

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_188_12.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_20_1
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_188_12.text: Besides, she's failed one too many times. Drawn one too many futures from herself. And she still insists on walking the path of saving Ashinohara alone, with no intention of stopping.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_188_12.zh: 而且，她失败了太多次，也预取了自己的太多未来。可她又决心继续踏上独自拯救苇原的道路，并不打算就此停下。

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_188_16.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_20_1
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_188_16.text: In an empty classroom, the Grand Architect contacts the Overseers from various regions. She spares no thought for the Ashinohara miko she once sought to recruit. Hiyuki has already burned through every possible future as a Threnodian Resonator. One day, she too will be reduced to ash by her own wish, just like her sister Gyokuro before her.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_188_16.zh: 残星会会长在无人的教室中，和各地的会监进行了联络。对于那位曾想招揽的苇原巫女，会长不再关心：绯雪预取尽了自己作为鸣式共鸣者的未来，终有一日，也将被她自己的誓愿烧成灰烬——就像她姐姐玉露那样。

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_18_11.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半序章_10_1
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_18_11.text: The Threnodian's active cycle is almost here. Death will be a frequent visitor to Ashinohara once more.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_18_11.zh: 鸣式的活跃期快到了，死亡将再次频繁地造访苇原。

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_193_30.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_21_2
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_193_30.text: So that Gyokuro may simply be Gyokuro. So that Hiyuki may simply be Hiyuki. So that Ashinohara will no longer need a Miko of Flaming Sakura.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_193_30.zh: 让玉露只需要成为玉露，让绯雪只需要成为绯雪，让苇原不再需要灼樱巫女。
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_193_30.speaker: Hiyuki

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_193_33.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_21_2
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_193_33.text: I met someone, Sister. Unlike me, who failed Ashinohara, {Male=he;Female=she} always finds a way to save.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_193_33.zh: 玉露姐姐，近来，我遇到了一个人。与我在苇原的路不同，{TA}总是能成功“拯救”。
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_193_33.speaker: Hiyuki

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_193_37.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_21_2
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_193_37.text: I thought, if only I possessed {Male=his;Female=her} strength. Then my days would not be filled with regret. Ashinohara would be saved.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_193_37.zh: 我想，若我也能如{TA}一般强大，就不会只得到遗憾和悔恨。苇原，亦能得救。
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_193_37.speaker: Hiyuki

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_193_49.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_21_2
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_193_49.text:
Hiyuki tells Gyokuro how much she still misses her—the longing, the resentment, and finally her wish: to become the Miko of Flaming Sakura who defeats the Threnodian, so that Ashinohara will never need another miko after her.
But Hiyuki admits that meeting Rover changed something in her. She no longer despairs over countless failures. Though she knows a future awaits where she burns to ash, knowing she once had a companion on this path makes the pain easier to bear. 
Before Gyokuro fades away, she tells Hiyuki that she has always been proud of her.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_193_49.zh:
绯雪诉说了自己对姐姐的思念与怨恨，也诉说了自己的誓愿：成为最后一任灼樱巫女击退鸣式，让苇原不再有下一任巫女。
她也说了自己遇到漂泊者后，想法有了些许改变，不再为无数次失败而感到绝望——尽管未来她终将烧却成灰，作为失败的救世主，想到自己也有同行者，她的痛苦也减轻了些许。
玉露在消散前，也诉说了对绯雪的祝福——她一直以绯雪为傲。

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_194_7.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_21_3
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_194_7.text: A message arrives for Hiyuki from the Grand Architect: "Ashinohara has vanished in a single day. Congratulations on your wish coming true, Miko of Flaming Sakura."
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_194_7.zh: 残星会会长向绯雪拨来了通讯：苇原在一夜之间消失无踪了，恭喜你愿望成真，灼樱巫女。

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_1_7.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半序章_1_1
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_1_7.text: The very same, but don't let the quick agreement fool you. He's already thinking ten steps ahead. If Ashinohara wasn't in such dire straits, he wouldn't have agreed to forge that blade for you so easily.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_1_7.zh: 是，别看他当时答应得挺痛快，脑子里估计绕过一百个弯了，要不是苇原现在是那副样子，他不会轻易同意给你做那把刀。
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_1_7.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21013_10.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_25_2
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21013_10.text: Hiyuki recounts her encounters with the Fractsidus, and the situation in Ashinohara…
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21013_10.zh: 绯雪向你讲述了她与残星会的交集，以及苇原的情况……

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21013_14.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_25_2
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21013_14.text: Do not worry over me. As for Ashinohara... Lucilla will assist with the investigation. Once matters here are settled, I will return.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21013_14.zh: 不必担心我，苇原的情况……洛瑟菈会协助我调查，等到这边的情况安稳，我就会动身回去。
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21013_14.speaker: Hiyuki

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21013_24.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_25_2
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21013_24.text: Lucilla has more reports for me, something about Ashinohara. I should go.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21013_24.zh: 洛瑟菈那边好像还有些苇原相关的报告要我帮忙，我先去她那边看看。
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21013_24.speaker: Hiyuki

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21013_25.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_25_2
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21013_25.text: Okay. If I can help with Ashinohara, just let me know.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21013_25.zh: 嗯，如果苇原的事有需要，随时联系我。
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21013_25.speaker: Rover

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21013_26.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_25_2
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21013_26.text: Rest easy. As the "savior" {Male=himself;Female=herself}  taught me, this long road to save Ashinohara was never meant to be walked alone.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21013_26.zh: 安心，就像“救世主”所教给我的，想要救回苇原这条长路，总不该想着由我一人走完。
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21013_26.speaker: Hiyuki

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21013_29.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_25_2
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21013_29.text:
Hiyuki speaks to you about matters concerning Ashinohara, the Fractsidus, and her future path that she never had the chance to share before. She feels changed by everything that has happened.
Before you part, her white bird flies into your chest and disappears. Hiyuki gazes out the window, looking forward to that distant future of stepping into spring for the first time.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21013_29.zh:
绯雪与你谈及了之前未来得及告知你的，有关苇原和残星会的事，也谈及了自己未来的去向，她似乎的确和之前有所不同了。
在你离开前，她的白鸟飞到了你的心口消失不见。而她看向窗外，第一次期望起那个遥不可及的，步入春日的未来。

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_3_2.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半序章_2_2
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_3_2.text: (Once business in Lahai-Roi is settled, I'll take it back to Ashinohara.)
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_3_2.zh: （待拉海洛事毕，也该……携刀返回苇原。）
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_3_2.speaker: Hiyuki

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_48_10.chapter: 剧情_3_3_残星会长副本主线_1_1
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_48_10.text: Hehe, you can afford to be more effusive. Unlike you, who failed Ashinohara time and again, {Male=he;Female=she} is the perfect "savior."
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_48_10.zh: 呵呵，话可以说得再满一些，与在苇原屡次失败的你不同，{TA}是个完美的“救世主”。

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_48_21.chapter: 剧情_3_3_残星会长副本主线_1_1
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_48_21.text: Honami would not be a ruin. And Ashinohara would finally have its true "savior."
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_48_21.zh: 穗波的现状不会如此，苇原也将迎来真正的“救世主”。

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_48_29.chapter: 剧情_3_3_残星会长副本主线_1_1
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_48_29.text: You've crawled through countless defeats, barely protecting Ashinohara from the Threnodian's assault. But what of the future? You are no savior like 漂泊者.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_48_29.zh: 你已历经无数次失败，你的确在与鸣式的战斗中勉力前行，护佑了苇原。可未来呢？你毕竟不是漂泊者那样完满的救世主。

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_48_7.chapter: 剧情_3_3_残星会长副本主线_1_1
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_48_7.text: From Ashinohara's legends and the Spacetrek Collective's investigative reports, you know who 漂泊者 is by now.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_48_7.zh: 你从苇原的传说故事和深空联合的调查报告中，应当已经认识了漂泊者是谁。

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_4_9.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半序章_3_1
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_4_9.text: But you defeated it. Again. And one day, you'll drive it away from Ashinohara for good!
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_4_9.zh: 但您又一次击退了鸣式，早晚有一天，您会将鸣式彻底从苇原驱逐出去！

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_5_3.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半序章_3_2
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_5_3.text: (When will we be freed from this nightmare, Ashinohara…?)
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_5_3.speaker: Hiyuki

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_68_54.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_8_2
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_68_54.text:
You reach the Dimmr Plains and find Hiyuki, the Ashinohara miko you met before. She offers you her origami familiar, a way to reach her if you are in need, then departs to track the Fractsidus.
Lucilla will stay behind with the other researchers to monitor the Voidmatter Barriers, while you make your preparations to head toward the Keystone's location alone.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_68_54.zh:
抵达地下黯原后，你见到了那位曾有一面之缘的苇原巫女绯雪。她将自己的纸役白鸟送到了你身上，告诉你若是需要，可以向她祈愿，而后便离开去追踪残星会了。
洛瑟菈将和其他研究员一起留在此处监测虚质防护装置，而你则做好了准备，孤身犯险，前往隧锚所在。

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_50_18.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_2_1
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_50_18.text: Chase started as a low-level employee at Ashridge Energy in the New Fed. Then he dropped off the grid for a few years before resurfacing in a government position.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_50_18.zh: 此人最初只是新联邦「灰岭能源」的一名小职员，后来几年没有相关的社会记录，再出现就是去了联邦政府任职。
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_50_18.speaker: Luuk Herssen

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_50_19.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_2_1
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_50_19.text: After that, he left the government and started diving into multiple large-scale investment projects. Some say he's still been Ashridge Energy's man the whole time, but no one's been able to prove it.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_50_19.zh: 又过了一段时间，查特从联邦政府离开，开始参与到许多大型投资项目中……有个说法是他从始至终都是灰岭能源的人，但没人能确认。
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_50_19.speaker: Luuk Herssen

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_320_1.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_29_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_320_1.text: With all Anchor Stones in place, the hunting party tracks Tyrannos to Asphodel Barrens, a historical battlefield scarred by brutal conflicts between Gladiators and Dark Tide creations. Augusta, embracing her rivalry with fellow would-be Hero of Heroes Avidius, proposes they hunt the Corrosaurus together. The stakes are set for their eventual duel.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_320_1.zh: 完成全部定向锚的架设后，一行人等追踪「暴君」来到往世花平野——这片荒野曾见证过无数角斗士与黑潮造物的生死交锋。面对同为“准王”候选的阿维狄亚，奥古斯塔选择直面挑战，主动邀其联手完成对蚀脊龙「暴君」的最终狩猎，以此作为两人正面对决的开端。

yakita:FavorStory_150503_Content.text:
[…]

When the robots mentioned the name "Delone," the Shorekeeper immediately recalled all that was tied to it.

This wasn't just due to her natural ability to store and record information, but because Delone was special—she was one of the few who sought out the Black Shores herself.

[…]

At that time, the Astral Modulator, who once held the highest authority in the Black Shores, had not yet been absent for long, and the Shorekeeper was still able to visit the surface.

[…]

"I took down eight Tacet Discords in one go during the Lament.

[…]

Just as Delone had said, the Shorekeeper transformed the frequencies of the departed into a "star," leaving them within the constellations of data.

[…]
yakita:FavorStory_150503_Content.zh:
别为我叹息，我不在那里，也没有离去。

听小机器人们提到德罗涅这个名字的时候，守岸人几乎没花什么时间就回忆起了和这个名字有关的全部信息。这不仅因为能量体适应存储、记录的特质，也因为德罗涅很特别——她是为数不多自己找到黑海岸来请求加入的成员。
明快爽朗的少女热血沸腾，一边抱怨着自己多不容易找来这里，一边带着点小得意地挑眉，“我就知道！为了阻止悲鸣带来更多的异象，一定会有人聚集起来做些什么的！”
那时候，曾掌握最高权限的调律者还没漂泊太久，她也还会在黑海岸地上活动。看着少女兴致满满一把抓住自己的手，恳切地表达着想要加入的决心，守岸人一时间竟不知道怎么反应，只觉得少女的手热热的、烫烫的，和少女眼里的温度一样。
守岸人为德罗涅申请了成员考核的资格，这其实不符合泰缇斯推演判定的招募流程，但没来由地，守岸人回忆起调律者曾对自己说过的那句话，“人类不是这样被限制的存在……我们不是数据，也不是存在记录中的某种概念”。守岸人想，如果是{TA}的话应该也会这样做吧，为了不让少女的那份温度冷却。后来，德罗涅通过了考核，正式成为了黑海岸的一员。

所以守岸人没有想过，再和德罗涅相见会是在这样的情况之下。
时隔十多年，曾经热血的少女已经长成了沉着冷静的女人，她冲着到来的守岸人颤巍巍伸出手，被洞穿的腹部汩汩往外流血。守岸人看得出来，德罗涅的生命在流失，属于她的结局只有一个。
“别看我现在这样，悲鸣爆发的时候，可是一口气解决了八个残象呢。但特瓦拉……他们运气不太好，收集到的残像数据只能由我带回来啦。”
送别的氛围渐渐浓厚，在场的其他成员们神情肃穆，并不知晓守岸人身份的他们只当她是与德罗涅特别亲近的朋友，自发将最后的时间留给两人。

“原来时间已经过去这么久了，我，我都……但你还和之前一样。”
“我做得很好吧？没让你失望吧？”
德罗涅的声音因虚弱显得有些抖，但眼睛依旧像第一次见面时那样亮。如果是调律者{TA}会怎么做？不知道，没有答案，甚至没有可以参考的范例，守岸人只知道对上那双眼睛，自己的胸口就闷闷的，仿佛有一种她无法形容的感受要从那里长出来。那感受迫使她像多年前那样，再一次做出破例的举动。
“辛苦…

datamine:InfoDisplay_102802008_Text.title: Voyage Logbook
datamine:InfoDisplay_102802008_Text.text:
[…]

Starting today, I'm working for the Montelli family.

[…]

The gate to Rinascita has finally opened for me.

Even though I'm in a cabin right now, thousands of miles away from home, as long as I'm working under the Montelli name and wearing this uniform, maybe one day I'll have my own place in the Montelli Quarter in Ragunna.

[…]

The day before yesterday was so cloudy, and I bet the Nimbus Wraiths were feeling pretty gloomy.

[…]

Instead, they use emotions, which is kind of interesting, don't you think?

[…]

"Unhappy" weather means thunder or strong winds.

[…]

The entire sea of clouds turns red.

[…]

According to the route map, we'll be passing through a place called the Atrium of Reflections.

[…]

By Imperator above, we will arrive safely.

(The words are illegible due to being soaked in water.)
...Mom...

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_102802008_Text.zh:
破旧的工作日志1
工作日志_编号_#00
妈妈，你有见过云海妖精吗？这还是我第一次看见云海妖精，她们好美。
我不知道该如何向他人分享这份喜悦，只好写在这里。
我的人生，终于在今天迎来转机。
从今天起，我就为莫塔里家族工作，我就是莫塔里的一员，人们将以莫塔里为名来称呼我。
黎那汐塔的大门，今天终于向我敞开。
虽然此刻我正在故土千里之外的车厢里，但只要能继续在莫塔里的名字下，穿着这身制服工作，或许有朝一日，我能在拉古那城内的莫塔里区有一块独属于我的安身处。
妈妈，我明白了，莫塔里的名字为什么会传遍黎那汐塔的每个角落。
其他贵族贩卖地位与商品，而莫塔里人向我们出售希望。
我最近就会忙起来，工作适应的也很顺利，就是列车上只安排了我一个安全员，连个搭话的人都没有。
我会努力工作的，等再回到镇子里时，我就把你接到拉古那来，让您享享清福。

破旧的工作日志2
工作日志_编号_#17
妈妈，我想你。
这里的雾很大，每次雾起时，我总想起小时候和你在一起的日子。
年幼时，我们住在乡下的屋子里，我总记得它是一间草屋，夏天时能听见屋顶的干草被阳光晒得噼啪作响，冬天时墙里总透出湿气。
一推门就是一条狭小的走廊，不过两步宽，一直通到厨房去，里面挂着一个坏了又莫名被修好的灯泡，裸露在外的线路被黑色的胶带缠了几圈。
两侧则是两个小房间，我睡在稍小的北间，印着修会圣词的薄纱帘在夜里有些瘆人，睡不着时，我就逃到狭小的走廊去，睁眼与闭眼没什么区别。背靠着潮湿的墙壁，黑得看不见嘴里吐出的哈气。
风试图从缝隙里穿过，门框在收紧，老旧的线路在撕裂，湿气与砖瓦在互相撞击，我的头发摩挲着墙壁，墙壁后的一团被褥在缓慢地伸展……这些声音在我的脑子里揉做一团，沿着耳道向外流淌向皮肤，再回到我的身体里敲打着我的骨头，发出令我着迷的颤音。
我迷恋着这份回响在脑内的潮湿，今天它再一次包围了我。
我刚刚穿过航线上的雾障，我好像做了一场梦，它让我不安。
不用为我担心，按安全手册里的说法，这雾障会引来幻觉，但基本无害，现在我已经平安地穿过了雾障，接下来我要去重新清点一遍货舱内货物，以免有人在幻觉中碰过我们的货。
我很想你，妈妈，记得我…

yakita:InfoDisplay_102802002_Text.text:
[…]

(A tourism guide penned by the Pioneer Association.

But the column about Egla Town hasn't been updated in quite a while.)

[…]

For those brave enough to venture to the place that inspired the adventurous plays during the Carnevale, exploring the legendary realm of the mighty "giant," listening to the songs echoing from the sea of clouds by the water, or following in the footsteps of knights in pursuit of honor and justice will no longer be mere fantasies.

[…]

[Dreamy Destinations] Nimbus Sanctum!

In this edition of [Dreamy Destinations], we journey to the mesmerizing Nimbus Sanctum hidden deep within Whisperwind Haven.

[…]

Yet, few are aware that the Atrium of Reflections—often depicted in romantic tales—is not merely a creation of fiction, but the ruins of the highest spire of ancient Ragunna.

To save its people, Napoli the Second invoked a miracle, turning the Dark Tide into the very sea of clouds that graces the land today.

[…]

[Column Memories] Voice of Travelers!

[…]

After hearing my explanation, the self-proclaimed alien Ford seemed completely fascinated by the Cyclops.

His emotions became so agitated that he plopped down on the ground, muttering some unintelligible words while pointing at the windmills in the distance.

[…]

Praise be to Imperator!

[…]

Putting on a solemn expression like the Acolytes of the Order, I envisioned a halo of nobility above my head, envisioned the almighty Imperator spreading wings before me, envisioned myself crowning a laurel at the Carnevale, envisioned standing in the grand church, wielding a sword as I was knighted, relishing the reverent gazes of the noble lords of Ragunna!

I replied, stressing each word with great emphasis:
"OF COURSE—"
"However, there are too many outsiders who seek the path of knighthood.

Are you confident enough to accept the trial?"
The alien named Ford, whose Tacet Mark was blinking along excitedly, quickly grabbed my calf and shook it furiously, as if clinging to a log in the midst of a drowning.

[…]

[Top Chef's Super Secrets]
Imagine yourself asking anyone on the streets of Ragunna, "Which restaurant is the best in Ragunna?"
Six out of ten will answer, "Trattoria Margherita!" Three will point to the family restaurant downtown, and the last one will say, "It's the place where the soft-tailed chef works!"
That's right!

[…]

To maintain the special flavors of her dishes, Miss Margherita even takes time off to gather ingredients in Egla Town or Riccioli Islands!

[…]

The town's trade and logistics are tied to Ragunna City.

[…]

[Comments from Special Guests]
Former Tax Envoy of the Order: The traditional cuisine is a remembrance of Rinascita's past.

[…]
yakita:InfoDisplay_102802002_Text.zh:
（一份先行公约撰写的旅游指南，关于埃格拉镇的栏目似乎很久没更新了。）

【下一个热门探险地】：埃格拉镇！
对那些有勇气追寻狂欢节冒险剧的舞台原型之人而言，前往传说中宏伟的“巨人”的地盘一游，在水畔间聆听云海中咏叹的歌声，或是追寻骑士们的踪迹瞻仰荣誉与正义都将不再是一种神话。在埃格拉镇，游览者将会邂逅唯美的水畔风光，在夕阳的平原上看牦群迁徙和风车轮转；或者于恣肆生长的鲜花丛旁享受一份惬意的下午茶，品尝传承百年的风味美食。

【梦幻旅途榜单】：氤柔水境！
本期在【梦幻旅途】单元入选的是拂风水畔深处的氤柔水境。引人入胜的贡多拉巡游中，云海一直以如梦似幻的奇景成为必经景点之一。
不过来访的游客往往有所不知的是，作为各种浪漫故事的舞台原型，云海上空漂浮的咏夜歌庭却并非无根之萍，而是旧日拉古那城最高那座塔楼的遗址——曾经那不盖勒二世于黑潮中唤来圣迹，挽救了拉古那的人民，自那以后，黑潮便化作了一片洁白的云海，演化成了如今的面貌。
昔日埃格拉镇的旧址，则正淹没于这片云海之下。

【旅途就是目的地】：立刻出发！
值得一提的是，虽然目前还无法查明原因，但数十年来云海的水位不断上涨，使得埃格拉镇的住民们迁徙到了如今北部的高地定居。
彼时这里还是荒芜一片、坚岩裸露的未开发地区，也因此被称为“拂风岩地”。
后来，聪慧的埃格拉镇的人们建造了风车，那些风车塔长年累月地旋转着，源源不断地将低处的水源抽调上来，滋养了作物和鲜花，拂风岩地才变成了如今【拂风水畔】的美丽地貌。

【幸福专栏回忆】：旅客之声!
贵社关于埃格拉镇的栏目自从上一次狂欢节就再没更新过了，每次都刊登一模一样的文章，莫非是付不起撰稿人的稿费么？
该不会是如今根本不会有游客对埃格拉镇感兴趣吧？不会吧？难道我说中了？

（一篇短篇小说，发布日期在十年前。
“畅销榜的无耻流氓！曾被修会三度禁止！”
“只有十分之一的人能读懂！你是其中之一么？”
“异想天开！罗素星人的讽喻时隔多年依然一针见血！”
编辑推荐语上如是写道……看得出十年前它一度是话题作品。）

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_16.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_17_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_16.text: According to the Codex, Lorelei is a powerful Remnant creature residing in the Atrium of Reflections at the center of the Nimbus Sanctum.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_16.zh: 根据圣典记载，罗蕾莱是一个强大的回音生物。她居住在氤柔水境中央的云中庭院里。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_16.speaker: Phoebe

yakita:Augusta_shengtai2_10_29.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_奥古斯塔_2_7_3_1
yakita:Augusta_shengtai2_10_29.text: And so, you and Augusta walk side by side, from the Titanbone Expanse arena to the stone walls of Capitoline Hill.
yakita:Augusta_shengtai2_10_29.zh: 就这样，你与奥古斯塔并肩而行，从巨石原的竞技场走到卡庇托山城的石墙下。

yakita:Augusta_shengtai2_15_10.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_奥古斯塔_2_7_4_1
yakita:Augusta_shengtai2_15_10.text: The night sky of Titanbone Expanse bears witness to your fierce battle with Augusta. Without a single pause, you fight until dawn, the sparks from your clashing blades igniting the horizon.
yakita:Augusta_shengtai2_15_10.zh: 就这样，巨石原的夜色见证了你与奥古斯塔的酣战。你们未曾停歇，直到晨光破晓，炽烈的剑芒点燃天际。

yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_22_1.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府内生态_2_13
yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_22_1.text: Augusta! You are our eternal Hero of the Heroes!
yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_22_1.zh: 奥古斯塔，您才是我们永远的王！

yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_5_8.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府内生态_1_5
yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_5_8.text: It's true that Ephor Augusta has had her share of accomplishments... but many still doubt her ability to lead all of Septimont.
yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_5_8.zh: 诚然奥古斯塔总督在某些方面表现出色，但想要治理七丘，仅凭目前的表现尚不足以说服众人。
yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_5_8.speaker: Lumiel

yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_6_1.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府内生态_1_6
yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_6_1.text: Augusta, Hero of the Heroes. I didn't expect her to truly prove herself.
yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_6_1.zh: 英雄王奥古斯塔啊……没想到她真的证明了自己。
yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_6_1.speaker: Lumiel

yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_6_9.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府内生态_1_6
yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_6_9.text: I believe under Ephor Augusta's rule, more will come to see her as she truly is.
yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_6_9.zh: 相信随着总督的治理，越来越多的人会认同她。
yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_6_9.speaker: Lumiel

yakita:NPC_204JIUDIAN_23_2.text: I hope our Ephor Augusta can turn everything around.
yakita:NPC_204JIUDIAN_23_2.zh: 希望奥古斯塔总督能改变这一切。

yakita:NPC_24SIMPLE_61_1.text: It's been ages since I've watched an Agon, but the fights today are no match for that one Augusta was in...
yakita:NPC_24SIMPLE_61_1.zh: 唉……好久没看角斗士比赛了，感觉都不如当年奥古斯塔那场……

yakita:NPC_MAINSY_1_16_2.text: A power struggle. Nothing new. But going up against Augusta is a steep hill to climb.
yakita:NPC_MAINSY_1_16_2.zh: 争权夺势嘛，不过对上奥古斯塔，我看阿维狄亚未必能有胜算。
yakita:NPC_MAINSY_1_16_2.speaker: Brandis

yakita:NPC_MAINSY_1_16_3.text: Without a strong Forte, Augusta's strength was always going to have limits.
yakita:NPC_MAINSY_1_16_3.zh: 没有足够的共鸣天赋，奥古斯塔的力量终归是有极限的。
yakita:NPC_MAINSY_1_16_3.speaker: Cileli

yakita:NPC_MAINSY_1_16_5.text: I wouldn't put it like that. Knowing how Augusta operates, Avidius wouldn't have even risen to prominence if she hadn't allowed it.
yakita:NPC_MAINSY_1_16_5.zh: 话不能这么说，按照奥古斯塔的行事风格，若不是她默许，阿维狄亚甚至没有被推到台前的机会。
yakita:NPC_MAINSY_1_16_5.speaker: Brandis

yakita:NPC_MAINSY_1_415_1.text: Avidius is better suited to lead than Augusta.
yakita:NPC_MAINSY_1_415_1.zh: 比起奥古斯塔，阿维狄亚才是更合适的人选。

yakita:NPC_MAINSY_1_415_3.text: Let's see if Augusta can hold her ground when the storm hits.
yakita:NPC_MAINSY_1_415_3.zh: 就看这次狩猎，奥古斯塔是否能驾驭住风暴……

yakita:NPC_MAINSY_1_430_1.text: Don't worry about me, Leonora. Augusta commands this hunt, and Avidius rides with us. Victory is assured.
yakita:NPC_MAINSY_1_430_1.zh: 不用担心我，蕾欧诺拉。这次出猎有奥古斯塔总督坐镇，再加上有阿维狄亚同行，我们必能得胜归来。

yakita:NPC_MAINSY_1_460_2.text: Barely… This hunt was beyond anything I imagined. Just staying alive took all I had. If it weren't for Ephor Augusta and the others...
yakita:NPC_MAINSY_1_460_2.zh: 侥幸而已……狩猎的规模超出我的想象太多，光是保住性命就已经拼尽全力，倘若没有奥古斯塔总督他们……

yakita:NPC_MAINSY_1_5_1.text: Strange that Augusta would allow Avidius to join the hunt…
yakita:NPC_MAINSY_1_5_1.zh: 奥古斯塔竟然会让阿维狄亚介入狩猎……

yakita:NPC_MAINSY_1_6_1.text: Strange that Augusta would allow Avidius to join the hunt… without taking any precautions.
yakita:NPC_MAINSY_1_6_1.zh: 奥古斯塔竟然会让阿维狄亚介入狩猎，还如此……毫不设防。

yakita:PQGCST_36_3.chapter: 剧情_七丘_喷泉广场生态_1_20
yakita:PQGCST_36_3.text: At the wave of Augusta's hands, bring about winds of resolution.
yakita:PQGCST_36_3.zh: 奥古斯塔之手掠过山城，此地新风拂面。

yakita:PQGCST_62_2.chapter: 剧情_七丘_喷泉广场生态_2_24
yakita:PQGCST_62_2.text: Easy! It's Augusta, our Ephor. My turn. Bearing the strength of a thousand men! Fierce and battle-hardened! Full of brilliance! And… Bold with unwavering integrity! And also...
yakita:PQGCST_62_2.zh: 显然是奥古斯塔总督啊！那轮到我，力敌万夫！骁勇善战！锋芒毕露！还有……磊落飒爽，还有还有——

yakita:SZSTBC_73_2.text: Ephor Augusta hasn't given a straight answer. Who knows where he's gone?
yakita:SZSTBC_73_2.zh: 奥古斯塔总督还没有给出确切的信息。谁知道他去了哪儿？

yakita:SZSTBC_74_1.text: That's not the way to put it, Lord Este. Ephor Augusta's radiance is beyond question. On what grounds could she ever deal with Avidius?
yakita:SZSTBC_74_1.zh: 话不能这么说，埃斯特阁下，以奥古斯塔总督的光辉，她有什么理由去处理阿维狄亚？
yakita:SZSTBC_74_1.speaker: Baglionia

yakita:SZSTBC_74_2.text: The Ephor's virtues are beyond reproach. Still, it troubles me that we've heard nothing of Avidius so far.
yakita:SZSTBC_74_2.zh: 奥古斯塔阁下的为人当然无可指摘，但如今阿维狄亚迟迟没有消息，这令人十分担忧啊。
yakita:SZSTBC_74_2.speaker: Sforza

yakita:SZSTBC_80_1.text: After the catastrophe, Augusta has truly come into her own.
yakita:SZSTBC_80_1.zh: 此次大灾之后，奥古斯塔更是如日中天。

yakita:SZSTBC_87_2.text: Ephor Augusta is strong, yes, but not that strong. That's exactly my point.
yakita:SZSTBC_87_2.zh: 奥古斯塔总督强归强，但也没有到最强的程度，我就想说这个。

yakita:ZDFST_12_4.text: But I believe all Septimontians should follow Ephor Augusta's example. Solving the problem should always take priority over following procedure!
yakita:ZDFST_12_4.zh: 但我认为所有七丘人都应该向奥古斯塔总督学习，最优先的应该是解决问题，而不是遵守流程！

yakita:ZDFST_13_3.text: That's right. With the High Tide on the horizon, Augusta's decisiveness and bravery are exactly what we need to weather the coming storm.
yakita:ZDFST_13_3.zh: 是啊，而且七丘即将迎来「涨潮期」，奥古斯塔总督行事果决，骁勇善战，一定会带领我们跨越危机。

yakita:ZDFST_24_1.text: You know, from all the intel I've gathered on Septimont, I got close to nothing on Ephor Augusta's past.
yakita:ZDFST_24_1.zh: 你看，我来七丘后收集的资料里，关于奥古斯塔总督的过去几乎一片空白。

yakita:ZDFST_6_1.text: Greetings, I am Nicco. Envoy from Ragunna. My meeting with Ephor Augusta was arranged in advance. May I wait here?
yakita:ZDFST_6_1.zh: 您好，我是拉古那的使节，名为尼科，与奥古斯塔总督会面的日程先前已经安排妥当，请问我是否在此等候即可？

yakita:jiabeilina_shengtai_2_3.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_嘉贝莉娜_2_7_七丘彩蛋_2_1
yakita:jiabeilina_shengtai_2_3.text: I promised Augusta that once everything was settled, I'd come to Septimont City.
yakita:jiabeilina_shengtai_2_3.zh: 之前我和奥古斯塔说好了，事情结束后，就来七丘城看看。
yakita:jiabeilina_shengtai_2_3.speaker: Galbrena

datamine:InfoDisplay_125000118_Text.title: The Gladiator Special Issue
datamine:InfoDisplay_125000118_Text.text:
A Special Issue of The Gladiator Released Ahead of the Great Agon.

This new issue offers a look back at the storied history of past champions. From gripping duels to behind-the-scenes anecdotes, the magazine dives deep, especially in its extensive profile of current Ephor, Augusta.

But one year stands out for its omission.

That year's match ended on a strange note: the expected winner, a young girl from Ragunna, disappeared just before the award ceremony. Without receiving the victor’s medal, her win was never officially recognized.

"It’s unfortunate," the writer noted, "but without a proper conclusion, the result could never be confirmed. To this day, Mya’s standing remains a topic of debate."
datamine:InfoDisplay_125000118_Text.zh:
一份在本届冠军赛开始前发行的《角斗士》期刊。
期刊内容回顾了往期各届冠军的经历和趣闻，其中关于当今总督奥古斯塔的部分最长最详尽。
顺着时间向前，有一届比赛的冠军相关内容却是缺失的。
尽管期刊的撰写者认为，当期获得胜利的那位拉古那少女理当是冠军。但她在领奖前突然失踪，并未获得勋章。
“虽然笔者也觉得非常遗憾……但没有完成的比赛，其结果就无法得到承认。因此，蜜芽的成绩一直有着争议。”

datamine:InfoDisplay_26010001_Text.title: Letter from Ephor's Palace
datamine:InfoDisplay_26010001_Text.text:
To Gladiator Lord Aeolus,

I have received your withdrawal request. It is hereby denied. The glory of Septimont shall forever shine upon you—a true Gladiator.

Also, Mr. Aeolus, you were the seventh formidable opponent I faced on my path forward. Your swordsmanship and keen battle instincts left a deep impression on me. I will carry your blade, your ideals, and everything you stood for, and lead Septimont forward.

Please, bear witness.

With respect,
Ephor Augusta of Septimont
datamine:InfoDisplay_26010001_Text.zh:
伊厄鲁角斗士
       你的离队申请我已收到，现驳回你的申请。七丘的荣光会永远照耀着你，一位真正的角斗士。
       另，伊厄鲁阁下，我前行道路所遭遇的第七位强敌，您的剑技和敏锐的战斗直觉令我印象深刻。我会背负着您的剑，您的愿景，背负着您的一切带领七丘走下去，敬请见证吧。
       七丘总督奥古斯塔敬上。

yakita:FavorStory_130603_Content.chapter: 奥古斯塔档案_角色故事
yakita:FavorStory_130603_Content.text:
[…]

There's not a soul in Septimont who doesn't know him."

[…]

In the shadow of a street corner, Augusta took the last bite of her dry bread, her eyes fixed on the tall figure speaking in the square.

[…]

A once-in-a-generation Gladiator prodigy.

He had slain seven Corrosauruses in the Sanguis Plateaus and returned alive, bathed in dragon's blood.

[…]

Many believed he would rise as the prophesied Hero of Heroes of their era.

[…]

You've earned Arsinosa's blessing.

[…]

The warrior of the Sanguis Plateaus, lightning in hand, ripping through stormclouds and despair to bring hope to those behind him.

Her Tacet Mark flared on the back of her hand.

She could never summon lightning like his.

Her Forte was a whisper compared to his roar.

[…]

A handwritten invitation from the Ephor's Palace.
yakita:FavorStory_130603_Content.zh:
“他是谁？”
“别开玩笑了，那可是马格诺总督！哪有七丘人不认识他的？”
“总督……”
街角的阴影下，奥古斯塔咬下最后一口干面包，遥遥望向那个正在广场上发表宣讲的高大身影。那人约莫三十岁出头的年纪，他的面容硬朗，如同雕像般线条分明，却带着温和开朗的笑意。宣讲至高潮时，他敞开双臂，民众欢呼的热浪一阵高过一阵。
公开角斗赛未尝一败的绝对王者，不世出的天才角斗士。曾在桑古伊斯狩原斩杀七只蚀脊龙，浴“龙血”而生还，而被冠以「灭龙」的称谓——彼时，七丘还流行着这样的传说。
那是一个不会拒绝民众愿望的倾听者，一个没有私欲的执行者，他是七丘众望所归的总督，同时也是当今世代最符合「英雄王」预言的人选。
曾被奥古斯塔只当成一个遥不可及的愿望而憧憬着的「英雄王」，这是她第一次发现，现实中居然有如此接近那张王座的存在。
奥古斯塔的心中燃起一阵烈火。那些看起来不可思议的事迹，那些振奋人心的传说，在她所诞生的时代里，仍有人能亲身完成——这意味着她的梦想不是一个虚假的白日梦，而是切实能够达成的目标。
可随即，她的思绪渐渐冷却下来，她注视着那个男人的面庞，凝视着那副没有破绽与瑕疵的笑容——
“为什么连这样的人……也没能救下法比亚纳……”

很快，奥古斯塔带着这些困惑与思考，站到了那个男人的面前。
“恭喜你，获得亚狮诺索认可的年轻人。你将加冕为新的「冠军」。”
授勋台上，奥古斯塔站在马格诺面前，在等待马格诺为她佩戴勋章的期间，她透过那张努力保持笑容的面孔，看到了一双疲惫而浑浊的眼睛。
那与她想象中的英雄相去甚远，那名被誉为「灭龙」的勇士，瞳孔中的心火已经归于沉寂。
奥古斯塔安静地接受了马格诺的授勋，直到最后，她才以唯有马格诺能听见的声音低语——
“那些关于你的传说，到底是真的吗？”
回应她的仍是沉默的笑容。

一段时间过后，地下角斗赛上出现了一个没有名字的角斗士。他戴着遮掩面庞的兜鍪，身披漆黑的甲胄，他如同求死般只挑战最强大的对手，他战斗的方式无所不用其极，毫无节制与尊严可言，仿佛他身处的不是追求荣誉的角斗场，而是只言生死的狩猎之地。
「无名」的胜场迅速累积，很快引起了奥古斯塔的注意。哪怕已经加冕为「冠…

yakita:FavorWord_130606_Content.chapter: 奥古斯塔档案_角色语音
yakita:FavorWord_130606_Content.text: From the heights of the Ephor's Palace, one can overlook the entire City of Septimont. Whenever I finish my duties, I enjoy climbing up to the rooftop to feel the wind. At times, Griffrexes returning from the Sanguis Plateaus soar above the palace. I listen to their cries, eyes tracing their wings as they sweep across every inch of Septimont's land, a land that we, and our forebearers, reclaimed from the jaws of calamity. We Septimontians rarely dwell on the pain of struggle, for we understand that the road to victory is never smooth. And I will carry this glorious legacy forward. It is the promise I make to our people, and to this land that burns with pride.
yakita:FavorWord_130606_Content.zh: 站在总督宫的高处，可以俯瞰整座七丘城，偶尔处理完政务，我喜欢攀上屋顶走一走、吹吹风。有时从桑古伊斯狩原归巢的狩王鹫会飞过总督宫的上空，我聆听着它们的啼鸣、眼光追随着它们的羽翼，飞掠七丘的每一寸土地——这片坚实的土地，是我们，还有我们的祖辈从灾厄手中夺回的。七丘人从不轻言斗争的伤痛，因为我们深知，胜利的道路从不是平坦的通途。我会将这份辉煌的荣耀延续下去，这是我对七丘人、对这片炽热的土地做出的承诺。
yakita:FavorWord_130606_Content.speaker: Augusta

yakita:FavorWord_130616_Content.chapter: 奥古斯塔档案_角色语音
yakita:FavorWord_130616_Content.text: Buling... Heh, just from the name alone, I can tell she's from Huanglong. From the moment we met, this remarkable young lady made an impression. I'm grateful she kept her promise and gave Septimont a fighting chance. For me, and for everyone in this land, her kindness is a debt we will never forget.
yakita:FavorWord_130616_Content.zh: 卜灵，呵，光听名字便知道她出身瑝珑。从第一次见面起，我就记住了这位有趣的小姑娘。感谢她信守承诺，为七丘争取了一线生机。不论是我，还是这片土地上的人们，这份深重的情谊，我们必将铭记在心。
yakita:FavorWord_130616_Content.speaker: Augusta

yakita:GondolaRideSharingPlot_39_1.chapter: 剧情_贡多拉共乘_奥古斯塔_1_4
yakita:GondolaRideSharingPlot_39_1.text: The Sanguis Plateaus, border to the abyss... countless unsung heroes have fallen in these hunting grounds. May the fragrance of Asphodels bring peace to their souls, and may the wings of Gryphons guide them home to the Vale of Glory.
yakita:GondolaRideSharingPlot_39_1.zh: 毗邻狭渊的桑古伊斯狩原……太多无名的英雄倒在了这片荒凉的猎场，愿往世花的幽香抚慰他们的英魂，愿鹰鹫的羽翼引领他们归返荣耀之间。
yakita:GondolaRideSharingPlot_39_1.speaker: Augusta

yakita:LHLZTC_1_9.text: Afterward, at the invitation of Septimont's Ephor Augusta, you traveled with her to the Sanguis Plateaus, where you watched her prove, through her deeds, what it means to be a true sovereign.
yakita:LHLZTC_1_9.zh: 之后，你接受七丘总督奥古斯塔的邀请一起来到狩原，见证了她用行动诠释何为王者。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_155_1.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_赤林台地_4_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_155_1.text: Avidius's team should be almost done, Augusta. I'll head over to join them.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_155_1.zh: 奥古斯塔，阿维狄亚那边处理得差不多了。我去接应他。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_155_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_25_1.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_6_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_25_1.text:
You're invited to the Ephor's Palace to meet Septimont's Ephor, Augusta. After an exchange of swords, she shares a brief history of Septimont's hunting traditions and formally invites you to join the hunt for the Dark Tide and its creations in the Sanguis Plateaus.

You accept and share information about the Sentinel's Relic and the Journeying Paradise. Upon hearing this, Augusta suggests that the Earthrend Wedge in the hunting grounds may be where the Relic is hidden. Before parting, she tells you that a storm rising in the skies southeast of Septimont will mark the beginning of the hunt.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_25_1.zh: 你应邀来到总督宫，如约见到了在此等候的七丘总督奥古斯塔。二人以剑交心后，奥古斯塔向你简述了七丘的狩猎历史，并正式邀你一同前往桑古伊斯狩原，追猎黑潮及其造物。你欣然应允，随后与奥古斯塔交换了有关岁主旧物及巡游天国的情报。闻言，奥古斯塔表示，位于狩原深处的彻地之楔或许正是岁主旧物的所在。临别前，奥古斯塔同你约定，当七丘城的东南方高天卷起风暴，即是你们启程之时。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_25_21.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_6_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_25_21.text: It's no exaggeration to say that the blood of Gladiators still burns in every inch of the crimson Sanguis Plateaus.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_25_21.zh: 毫不夸张地说，角斗士们沸腾的热血几乎灼烧着桑古伊斯狩原每一寸猩红的土地——
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_25_21.speaker: Augusta

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_25_23.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_6_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_25_23.text: You've surely noticed the lingering Blightcloud that hovers over the Sanguis Plateaus. Since the first Dark Tide outbreak in Rinascita, that place has become a breeding ground for its horrors.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_25_23.zh: 你或许知道，桑古伊斯狩原的高空，盘桓着一片永恒不散的黑潮云。自黎那汐塔第一次黑潮爆发始，狩原就不幸沦为滋生黑潮造物的温床。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_25_23.speaker: Augusta

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_25_39.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_6_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_25_39.text: Go to the Earthrend Wedge. It's where the Sentinel Imperator first descended upon the Sanguis Plateaus and is the "epicenter" of every hunt to this day.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_25_39.zh: ……去彻地之楔看看吧，那是岁主英白拉多在桑古伊斯狩原的降临地，也是历来狩猎的“核心”所在。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_25_39.speaker: Augusta

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_300_3.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_赤林台地_26_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_300_3.text: Makes for a fun challenge, don't you agree, Avidius?
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_300_3.zh: 但这才是有趣的挑战，不是吗？阿维狄亚。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_300_3.speaker: Augusta

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_320_16.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_29_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_320_16.text: This is a matter between Augusta and Avidius. We shall not intervene for the time being.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_320_16.zh: 奥古斯塔和角斗士之间的事，暂时还不需要我们插手。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_320_16.speaker: Iuno

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_320_8.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_29_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_320_8.text: Avidius, descendant of the Hero of Heroes, Atilius. Decorated for the four crossings of Manes Deep.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_320_8.zh: 英雄王阿提留斯的后裔，因四度穿越玛涅斯之底而授勋的阿维狄亚。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_320_8.speaker: Augusta

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_35_1.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_8_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_35_1.text: Seeing a storm form in the distance, you head for Tempest Cliffs, the agreed-upon meeting point. Along the way, you encounter the Gladiator Avidius, who's also bound for the hunt. He suggests traveling together.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_35_1.zh: 到了约定之日，你按计划动身去往事先与奥古斯塔商定好的会合地点，风潮崖。途中，你偶遇同样要去参加狩猎的贵族角斗士阿维狄亚，在简短交谈后，他向你发出了同行的邀请。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_32.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_36_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_32.text: Before this hunt, Augusta and I investigated such Dark Tide irregularities at the Sanguis Plateaus.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_32.zh: 在这次狩猎开始前，我和奥古斯塔提前调查了桑古伊斯狩原，确认了这次涨潮的不寻常。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_360_32.speaker: Iuno

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_1.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_38_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_1.text: You contact Consultant Buling of the Black Shores. She reports that the Tethys System has detected the False Sovereign rapidly consuming nearby frequencies and growing stronger. Left unchecked, it could threaten the Earthrend Wedge and trigger a catastrophic collapse. To stop the Dark Tide's spread and intercept the Sovereign, you, Augusta, and the Gladiators set out for Murmurstown, the most frequency-rich area in the hunting grounds.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_1.zh: 鉴于当前紧迫的局势，众人在临时营地的主营帐中与黑海岸客卿卜灵取得了联系。对方透露，泰缇斯系统已观测到伪作的神王正以一种令人不安的趋势吞噬频率、汲取力量，若任其继续壮大，势必将对彻地之楔构成严重威胁，甚至引发无可挽回的灾厄。为了遏止黑潮蔓延，你、奥古斯塔与众角斗士决议前往桑古伊斯狩原内频率最为集中的区域——呓语镇，追踪神王动向，并设法加以阻截。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_11.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_38_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_11.text: That's right. Her name is Buling. An interesting young lady. Left quite an impression on me.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_11.zh: 没错，名字叫卜灵。有趣的小姑娘，我印象很深。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_11.speaker: Augusta

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_57.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_38_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_57.text: You recall what Iuno once shared with you—the plan she and Augusta devised to hunt down the Sovereign. Though that plan has since failed, you relay the details to Buling, backed by Augusta's permit.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_57.zh: 你回想起尤诺曾向你透露，她与奥古斯塔原先暗中筹划过一项狩猎神王的计划。尽管那一计策终告失败，你仍依奥古斯塔的意思将其转告给了卜灵。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_375_1.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_40_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_375_1.text: Avidius, ready the Anchor Stones. We must set up a defense line around Murmurstown.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_375_1.zh: 阿维狄亚，准备好定向锚，我们需要在呓语镇筑起防线。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_375_1.speaker: Augusta

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_385_1.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_1_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_385_1.text: Once consumed by the Dark Tide, the ruins of Murmurstown still bear its scars. In the face of such destruction, the hunting party knows this hunt cannot fail. Avidius offers to lead a team to place Anchor Stones around the town's perimeter, sealing off any escape routes. Meanwhile, you and Augusta will enter the ruins and track the Sovereign's presence.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_385_1.zh: 一行人等按计划抵达呓语镇。在目睹了这座曾遭黑潮侵蚀、如今化为废墟的小镇后，你们深知这场狩猎不容有失。经简短商议，阿维狄亚决定和众角斗士留守外围，架设定向锚，以封锁神王可能的退路。而深入镇内，追踪隐匿形态的神王踪迹的任务，则由你与奥古斯塔承担。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_40_1.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_9_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_40_1.text: Under Avidius's escort, you arrive at Tempest Cliffs. Once the hunting party is assembled, Augusta gives the order to begin the campaign.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_40_1.zh: 在阿维狄亚的引领下，你顺利抵达风潮崖。见众人集结完毕，奥古斯塔当即下令，狩猎队伍随之启程。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_440_4.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_2_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_440_4.text: It was once called Fabianum—the town of Gladiators, visited by Fabius, the Hero of Heroes. But the Dark Tide claimed it in the end, leaving behind a scar Septimont will never forget.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_440_4.zh: 确切地说，是被黑潮的阴影纠缠的角斗士小镇，英雄王法比乌昔日的造访地……七丘永恒的伤口——法比亚纳。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_440_4.speaker: Augusta

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_16.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_43_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_16.text: But Fabianum never found its Hero of Heroes... Ever since then, the name was lost, replaced by Murmurstown, a scar that Septimont refuses to face...
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_16.zh: 可惜我的故乡没有盼来英雄王……在那之后不久，法比亚纳就成了七丘人羞于启齿的呓语镇……
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_16.speaker: Augusta

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_28.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_43_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_28.text: (Tell Augusta about the Unyielding Gladiator's Spirit.)
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_452_28.zh: （告知不屈角斗士“英灵”的情报。）

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_475_16.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_13_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_475_16.text: More Phantoms appear inside Oak Hollow. Young Augusta rushes to Angel's side, believing the Whispers may have granted her the power to fend off the Dark Tide. But something is wrong. Just before her Phantom vanishes into a swirling vortex of pure Dark Tide frequency, Angel cries out, urging Augusta to flee. Stunned, you and Augusta collect the frequency and prepare to send it to Buling for analysis at the Black Shores.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_475_16.zh: 橡树洞内，“虚影”重现：年少的奥古斯塔匆忙赶来，想要确认安吉尔的安危，然而树洞内却早已不见黑潮的踪影。奥古斯塔本以为安吉尔获得了传说中英雄王的力量击退了黑潮，可对方的状况却有些异常。在安吉尔用残存的理智呼喊奥古斯塔离开的瞬间，“虚影”消失了，而先前安吉尔所在的位置，缓缓浮现出一团来自纯净黑潮频率的回响。惊愕之余，你和奥古斯塔准备先将纯净黑潮频率的数据回传给卜灵，等待后续泰缇斯系统的分析结果。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_500_1.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_18_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_500_1.text:
The Sovereign's power grows exponentially after absorbing the pure Dark Tide frequencies sealed within Oak Hollow and the surrounding frequencies of deceased souls in Murmurstown. It now seeks to uproot the Earthrend Wedge and unleash the full force of the Dark Tide being suppressed beneath the Sanguis Plateaus. Rinascita teeters on the brink of catastrophe.

However, Buling identifies a weakness in the Sovereign. Iuno proposes a plan to use the Anchor Stones to disrupt its internal frequency and reclaim control of the Wedge. To buy time for the plan to work, Iuno offers to put her own existence on the line by using her Forte to keep the Sovereign exposed. 

As the final battle approaches, she tells you that your "unknowable fate" might be the key to overcoming the crisis. She implores that you stand with Augusta until the very end.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_500_1.zh:
在被尘封于橡树洞中的纯净黑潮频率的加持下，伪作的神王完成了瞬间的成长，它一举融合了呓语镇内大量亡故生灵的频率，并试图调集全部力量，控制、拔除彻地之楔，释放所有被压制于桑古伊斯狩原之下的黑潮。黎那汐塔危在旦夕。
面对绝境，卜灵结合卜算与泰缇斯系统提供的数据，分析出神王的弱点隐藏于其身形之内，黎那汐塔尚有一线生机。听闻这一线索，尤诺表示或可借助定向锚的力场，从神王的体内瓦解其形态，趁神王频率不稳之际夺回彻地之楔的控制权。为了确保计划能够顺利推进，尤诺不顾自身安危，决心再次消耗共鸣力维持神王显化，为你与奥古斯塔争取将定向锚送入神王内部的机会。
决战将至，临别之际，尤诺提及也许你那“不可知的命运”正是扭转危机的关键。她请求你，无论如何都要坚定地信任奥古斯塔，与她并肩战斗到最后一刻。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_502_2.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_20_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_502_2.text: The Anchor Stone Avidius and the others set there could come in handy.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_502_2.zh: 之前阿维狄亚他们架设的定向锚，应该能用得上。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_502_2.speaker: Augusta

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_505_6.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_21_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_505_6.text: Buling mentioned even something small could have a great influence. The smaller, the more unnoticed.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_505_6.zh: 卜灵提起过，即便是微不足道的力道，也足够能达成我们的目标。既然如此……动手的时候，藏得越深越好。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_505_6.speaker: Augusta

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_27.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_14_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_27.text: Avidius was correct. It is a Tacet Discord born from the Dark Tide.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_27.zh: 阿维狄亚说得没错，那是诞生自黑潮的残象。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_27.speaker: Augusta

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_31.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_14_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_31.text: Only the Earthrend Wedge that bears Sentinel Imperator's power can sever the link between the Dark Tide and the Threnodian, burying the calamity deep beneath the Sanguis Plateaus.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_31.zh: 只有拥有岁主英白拉多力量的彻地之楔，可以切断黑潮与鸣式之间的那根脐带，将灾厄死死钉在桑古伊斯狩原的深渊之下。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_65_31.speaker: Augusta

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_10.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_1_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_10.text: It doesn't make sense. The Earthrend Wedge is still holding back the Dark Tide at its depths... At any rate, Augusta's already led a team to the Sanguis Plateaus to investigate.
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_10.zh: 彻地之楔明明还在压制着底层的黑潮，现在这些状况……完全说不通……总之，奥古斯塔已经带队去桑古伊斯狩原了。
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_10.speaker: Iuno

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_9022_5.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_17_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_9022_5.text: Lady Cantarella, how many of your family's potions remain?
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_9022_5.zh: ……坎特蕾拉女士，家族的秘药，还有多少？
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_9022_5.speaker: Augusta

yakita:SLZYDST_28_1.text: Ephor Augusta is certainly capable. But cries for Avidius to be the next Hero of Heroes grow louder by the day.
yakita:SLZYDST_28_1.zh: 奥古斯塔总督实力雄厚，但七丘城中，拥护“准英雄王”阿维狄亚的呼声也已日渐高涨。
yakita:SLZYDST_28_1.speaker: Baglionia

yakita:SLZYDST_30_1.text: That's not the way to put it, Lord Este. My loyalty to the Ephor has never wavered. Her deeds shine as gloriously as the eternal blazing sun. A mere figure like Avidius can never be compared to her.
yakita:SLZYDST_30_1.zh: 话不能这么说，埃斯特阁下，我可一直对奥古斯塔总督忠心耿耿。她的辉煌功业如同正午的烈阳，区区阿维狄亚，怎堪与她相提并论？
yakita:SLZYDST_30_1.speaker: Baglionia

yakita:SLZYDST_30_2.text: The Ephor's deeds are indeed admirable. But I must insist that Avidius, too, is a true Gladiator and a hero deserving of the same glory!
yakita:SLZYDST_30_2.zh: 奥古斯塔总督的伟绩值得敬佩，但我还是要说，阿维狄亚无愧于角斗士的荣耀，他是一名真正的英雄！
yakita:SLZYDST_30_2.speaker: Sforza

yakita:ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_28.text: Following the clues Fenrico left behind, you traveled to Septimont. There, the Ephor, Augusta, extended an invitation to you.
yakita:ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_28.zh: 依照芬莱克留下的线索，你再次前往七丘探查情况，恰巧此时你也受到七丘总督奥古斯塔的邀请。

yakita:ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_29.text: In the Sanguis Plateaus, you met Avidius, a rising Hero of Heroes recognized by the Senate. During the final pursuit of the Dark Tide creation known as the Corrosaurus, Augusta prepared to execute her original plan—
yakita:ZXZTC_Rinascita_1_29.zh: 你们在桑古伊斯狩原结识了元老院认定的准英雄王阿维狄亚，在追猎黑潮造物「蚀脊龙」的最后关头，奥古斯塔准备施行她原本的计划——

yakita:LGNCZST_28_1.text: If this keeps up, Averardo Vault will turn into an Averardo General Store.
yakita:LGNCZST_28_1.zh: 哎，再这么下去，埃弗拉德金库就要成埃弗拉德杂货铺了。
yakita:LGNCZST_28_1.speaker: Quinto

yakita:LGNCZST_41_1.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_新贵族生态_1_3
yakita:LGNCZST_41_1.text: Have you heard? Averardo Vault has suddenly tightened its security.
yakita:LGNCZST_41_1.zh: 听说了吗？最近埃弗拉德金库突然戒严了。

yakita:LGNCZST_41_5.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_新贵族生态_1_3
yakita:LGNCZST_41_5.text: Precious Echo? What Echo is precious enough to be in Averardo Vault?
yakita:LGNCZST_41_5.zh: 什么声骸这么珍重？还要收藏进埃弗拉德？

yakita:LGNCZST_65_2.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_新贵族生态_2_5
yakita:LGNCZST_65_2.text: I bet it's part of Averardo Vault's collection.
yakita:LGNCZST_65_2.zh: 我猜是埃弗拉德金库的馆藏。

yakita:LGNCZST_71_11.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_11
yakita:LGNCZST_71_11.text: —you'll fire me on the spot, freeze all my accounts, and have me sent to Averardo Vault's underground worksite.
yakita:LGNCZST_71_11.zh: ——您就会立刻开除我，冻结我所有的账户，把我送去埃弗拉德金库的地下工作。

yakita:NPC_JKWW_5_5.text: Averardo Vault at night truly has a charm of its own, doesn't it?
yakita:NPC_JKWW_5_5.zh: 说起来，夜晚的埃弗拉德金库，景色可真是别有风味啊。

datamine:InfoDisplay_104000901_Text.title: A Letter Written on Torn Paper
datamine:InfoDisplay_104000901_Text.text:
My dear boy,
 
Leaving you is the last thing I want, but these troubled times force my hand. All I can offer now are a few words on this torn paper.

Stand tall and live your life with pride. Your parents gave their lives for the dignity of art, and you carry the same blood in your veins.

I've sacrificed my freedom in pursuit of the endless mysteries these Echoes hold, but I believe in you—you have a strong heart. Hold on to hope and keep moving forward.

One day, the treasure we have valued deep within the Averardo Vault will bring forth new hope.

With Love,
Ash
datamine:InfoDisplay_104000901_Text.zh:
孩子，爷爷也不想离开你，但时境危艰，只能用这一张碎纸片送几句话给你。
你要挺胸抬头地好好活着，你的父母为了艺术的尊严而死，你身上流着他们的骨血。
我以个人的自由为代价，只求追寻声骸背后的无限秘密。
爷爷相信你是个坚强的孩子，心怀希望地活下去吧！
那在埃弗拉德金库深处，被我们珍视着的宝物，终会带来新的希望。
艾许

datamine:InfoDisplay_175750010_Text.title: Translated by a Kind Stranger
datamine:InfoDisplay_175750010_Text.text:
I am sincerely seeking a kind-hearted person to take me to the Echo Depository of the Averardo Vault!

If I had the choice, I would prefer to live a short but meaningful life over a long but ordinary one.

——Bakethoven the Echo

(Transcribed by a helpful passerby. Please help, it really wants to grow as an Echo.)
datamine:InfoDisplay_175750010_Text.zh:
诚征一位好心人，把我送去埃弗拉德金库的声骸藏馆！
如果可以选择，我想体验短暂而有价值的人生，胜却平凡但漫长的一生。
——声骸「焙多分」
（由本路过的好心人代写，帮帮它吧它太想进步了。）

datamine:InfoDisplay_21020101_Text.title: Averardo Vault Important Notice (1)
datamine:InfoDisplay_21020101_Text.text:
The following is restricted to employees with Level 1 clearance or higher:
 
The Precious Metals and Artworks Depository is the first depository of the Averardo Vault, responsible for the safekeeping of precious metals and rare artworks.
 
Each section has security rooms, with the top-level security control room in the artwork section holding the highest clearance.
 
Monthly reports on the quantity and volume of items in the precious metals section must be recorded to ensure proper tracking of any losses.
 
Maintain environmental conditions (e.g., temperature, humidity) within acceptable ranges. 
 
Do not examine certain items to avoid potential mental impacts.
 
To avoid misunderstandings among individuals with particular beliefs, do not remove coverings from specific items in the artwork section under any circumstances!
To avoid misunderstandings among individuals with particular beliefs, do not remove coverings from specific items in the artwork section under any circumstances!
To avoid misunderstandings among individuals with particular beliefs, do not remove coverings from specific items in the artwork section under any circumstances!
datamine:InfoDisplay_21020101_Text.zh: 以下内容仅限持有一级与一级以上权限的员工阅读： 贵金属与艺术品藏区，是埃弗拉德金库的第一层藏区，主要负责保管贵重金属及稀有的各类艺术品。 两类藏区分别设有安全控制室，顶层艺术品藏区内控制室拥有本区间内最高权限。 请注意以月度为单位记录并向上汇报贵金属藏区内物品的数量、体积等数据，确保损耗已知。 请注意温度、湿度等数值处于合理区间内。 请注意不要主动翻阅、查看艺术品藏区内的部分藏品，避免对自身心智造成影响。 请注意不要主动揭开艺术品藏区内部分外置的遮盖系统，以免引起部分特殊信仰人士的误会！ 请注意不要主动揭开艺术品藏区内部分外置的遮盖系统，以免引起部分特殊信仰人士的误会！！ 请注意不要主动揭开艺术品藏区内部分外置的遮盖系统，以免引起部分特殊信仰人士的误会！！！

datamine:InfoDisplay_21020102_Text.title: Averardo Vault Important Notice (2)
datamine:InfoDisplay_21020102_Text.text:
The following is restricted to employees with Level 2 clearance or higher:
 
The Echo Depository, the second depository of the Averardo Vault, is a strictly controlled area. Unauthorized entry is considered a violation.
 
Its primary function is to contain, protect, and cultivate Echoes. It is the most dangerous section of the vault.
 
Strict adherence to protocols is mandatory—unauthorized actions will trigger the forced shutdown of the Echo containment systems.
 
Do not touch any containment devices, as certain Echoes require specialized containment measures.
 
Non-experts should avoid this area, as certain Echoes exhibit aggression.
 
The majority of Echoes are rare or possess unique traits and must not be damaged under any circumstances!
The majority of Echoes are rare or possess unique traits and must not be damaged under any circumstances!
The majority of Echoes are rare or possess unique traits and must not be damaged under any circumstances!
datamine:InfoDisplay_21020102_Text.zh: 以下内容仅限持有二级与二级以上权限的员工阅读： 声骸藏区位于埃弗拉德金库的第二层级，属于严格管控区，任何在权限规定外的进入行为，都将被视为入侵行为； 声骸藏区以收容、保护、培养声骸为主要功能，是整个金库中最危险的区域。 请注意遵守权限规则，任何入侵行为将触发针对声骸列车的强制停止行为。 请注意部分声骸需要特殊的收容措施，请勿触碰声骸保存装置。 请注意部分声骸具有一定攻击性，非专业人士请远离该藏区。 请注意声骸藏区内的声骸大部分属于珍稀种类，或具有某些珍稀特质，绝不可损坏！ 请注意声骸藏区内的声骸大部分属于珍稀种类，或具有某些珍稀特质，绝不可损坏！！ 请注意声骸藏区内的声骸大部分属于珍稀种类，或具有某些珍稀特质，绝不可损坏！！！

datamine:InfoDisplay_21020104_Text.title: Vault Promotional Flyer
datamine:InfoDisplay_21020104_Text.text:
[…]

Subject: Welcome aboard the Echo Train of Averardo Vault!

[…]

You may call the Echo Train via your Terminal, and it will typically arrive within three minutes.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_21020104_Text.zh:
主题：欢迎您搭乘埃弗拉德金库的声骸列车！
为了方便您在埃弗拉德金库中办理业务，金库特推出了声骸列车服务。这些特殊的声骸能够将您迅速送往金库的各个区域。
出于安全考虑，请您遵循以下规定：
1.声骸列车性情温和，但请不要尝试投喂或对它们进行攻击，以免它们在受到惊吓时偏离航道，甚至坠落。
2.您可以在列车运行期间通过窗口欣赏风景，但请不要将任何肢体伸出窗外。如果您看到这里时发觉自己已经违反了本条规定，则请迅速阅读规定条目6。
3.埃弗拉德金库中只存在展馆和其他贮存建筑，以及装饰性的小雕像。不存在高度在▇▇▇▇▇左右，且外形类似▇▇▇的雕像或建筑。如果您在乘坐列车途中看到了类似的建筑，请告诉自己这只是由于金库的封闭环境所带来的错觉，立刻移开视线。如果您发现您仍能看到该建筑，请迅速阅读规定条目6。
4.您可以使用终端呼叫声骸列车，正常而言它们会在呼叫后三分钟内抵达。若它们在三分钟后仍未抵达，迅速离开车站并向前台的金库员工报告。不要乘坐在三分钟后抵达的任何列车。
5.金库中使用的声骸列车外形应该类似鱼类，不存在任何肢体、脚或触肢，如果发现声骸列车的外表出现异常，不要乘坐，请尝试再次呼叫列车，并等待至外表异常的列车离开站台为止。
6.如果您违反了以上规定的任何一条，请迅速离开站台并向最近的金库员工说明情况。若您正位于列车上，请将该宣传单迅速扔出窗外。列车会立刻前往最近的站台，并会有金库员工来接您离开金库。不要和他们对话或对视。

yakita:InfoDisplay_21020105_Text.text:
Subject: Averardo Vault Tour Guide (Underground Depository Zone)
 
Welcome to Averardo Vault! We hope you have a wonderful and unforgettable time here.
 
The main areas of the Underground Depository are as follows:
 
1. Precious Metals and Artworks Depository
This section primarily stores valuable metals and rare artworks. Some of the items are displayed to the public on a rotating basis. Below is a partial list of recommended exhibits for this month:

Stern's Ceramic Jar
The beloved ceramic jar of the famous comedian Arthur Stern! After receiving the Laurel, he retired from the stage to focus on the art of pottery. This jar is one of twelve masterpieces he personally painted.
Recommendation Rating: Five Stars!

"Deepening Stars"
The painting of an anonymous artist, depicting the starlight reflected from beneath the abyss. Critics have debated the theme of this piece for years, making it a highly controversial and discussed piece.
Recommendation Rating: Three Stars!
 
2. Echo Depository (Currently Closed)
This section primarily houses Echoes.
Important: The Echo Depository is no longer open to visitors.
 
3. [Data Deleted]
yakita:InfoDisplay_21020105_Text.zh:
主题：埃弗拉德金库游览指南（地下藏区部分）
欢迎来到埃弗拉德金库，希望您能在这里度过一段美好而难忘的时光。
地下藏区的主要区域如下：
1.贵金属与艺术品藏区
该藏区主要存放贵重金属及稀有的艺术品。部分藏品会不定期进行对外展示。以下是本月推荐展品名单（部分）：
斯特恩的陶罐
著名喜剧演员亚瑟·斯特恩最钟爱的陶罐！他在荣膺桂冠后退出了舞台，专心研究陶罐艺术。该陶罐为他亲手绘制的十二个杰作之一。
推荐等级：五星！
画作《深瞑星》
无名作家的作品，主题为深渊之下所映射的星光。评论家曾对此画作的主题争论了长达数年，极具话题性的作品。
推荐等级：三星！
2.声骸藏区（已关闭）
该藏区主要存放声骸藏品。
重要：声骸藏区不再对游客开放。
3.【数据删除】

yakita:AreaReportContent_Text29.text:
[…]

I once joked to a friend that if, one day, you find yourself wanted across all of Solaris-3 for illegal actions like short selling or trading in debts, then, based on my experience, apart from digging your own grave, your best bet would be to hide in Averardo Vault in Rinascita.

As long as you can prove your worth, the Montelli family will keep you safe—even if it means turning a blind eye.

[…]

—Excerpt from How to Get Unlimited Shell Credits
yakita:AreaReportContent_Text29.zh:
我曾经和朋友开过一个玩笑，我说如果你有一天做空或者债务买卖的事情败露了，被全索拉里斯人通缉……那么相信我的判断，除了直接给自己修个坟，你最好的选择就是藏在黎那汐塔的埃弗拉德金库里，只要你能证明自己的价值，莫塔里人就算捏着鼻子也要把你保住——他们甚至会出钱帮你取保候审，组一个专业的国际法务团队，前提只有一个：只要你和他们建立足够的业务联系。
相信我，我经常和莫塔里人打交道。他们比大多数商人更尊重所谓的“契约精神”。
在几十年前我还年轻的时候，我最讨厌这些海岛来的愣头青，他们不懂规矩，干劲满满，口无遮拦，和从前认识的那些只会歌舞的黎那汐塔人截然不同；可后来我发现，他们这些人做生意有一个特点是其他人模仿不来的……那就是他们的服务向来明码标价。他们简直就是世界上最好懂的商人，因为莫塔里人的世界只遵循一个规则：合同！而驱动这个规则的载体永远只有一个：利益。

——节选自《如何实现贝币自由》

yakita:AreaReportContent_Text43.text:
The Employee Manual for all staff members of the Averardo Vault. Below is the content from the first page:

Welcome to the Averardo Vault. Your arrival brings fresh energy to the Vault, and we sincerely look forward to your exceptional performance.

In keeping with the principle of "the sanctity and inviolability of private property," the Averardo Vault houses a vast collection of priceless Echoes and artworks. It is the safest and most secure place in Rinascita. Your every word and action reflect the Vault's image, and we trust this manual will help you gain a comprehensive understanding of the Averardo Vault.

Vault Overview:

The Vault is located east of Ragunna City, where it stores a vast array of Echoes and artworks. The Vault is divided into two zones: the Upper Management Zone, positioned above a chasm with a commanding view of the sea of clouds, and the Underground Depository Zone, situated beneath the clouds and connected to the upper zone by an elevator tower.

The Vault's security system is comprised of Echoes.
yakita:AreaReportContent_Text43.zh:
埃弗拉德金库在职员工均持有的手册，以下是手册第一页所记载的内容。

欢迎您入职埃弗拉德金库。您的到来为金库注入了新的血液，衷心期待您接下来的优异表现。
秉持着私有“私有财产神圣不可侵犯”的条例，埃弗拉德金库内存储有大量珍贵声骸与艺术品，是黎那汐塔最为安全、稳固的场所。您的一言一行时刻代表着金库的形象，相信这本手册将会帮助您全面地了解埃弗拉德金库。

金库简介：
金库坐落于拉古那城的东侧，其中贮藏着难以计数的大量声骸和艺术品。金库分为上下两层，上层的管理区位于天堑之上，能够睥睨云海；下层的藏馆区则在云海之下，由电梯发射塔将两处相连。
金库的保全设施由声骸构成。

yakita:Event_WWDG_14_5.text: Well, about Bakethoven, while it is a pity that the Averardo Vault declined its application...

yakita:GNNPC_AFLDJK_5_4.zh: 埃弗拉德金库收藏一切有价值，或者说，对拉古那的过去与未来而言有价值的物件。

yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_203_32.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_2_4
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_203_32.text: Qiuyuan fights alone, driving back Tidespawn in the streets and rescuing an Acolyte in the middle of evacuating civilians. Carlotta and the others soon arrive to help, guiding the civilians to seek sanctuary at the Cathedral of Mercury and Averardo Vault. Because Qiuyuan is not from Rinascita, the Dark Tide does not harm him. Instead, it allows him to sense you in pursuit of Galbrena, far away in Avinoleum...
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_203_32.zh: 仇远以一人之力击退了商店街前的黑潮造物，救下疏散民众的修会教士。此时珂莱塔等人也支援过来，将民众向水星天教堂以及更远的埃弗拉德金库撤离。由于仇远不是黎那汐塔人，那黑潮似乎对他没什么危害，反而能让他透过黑潮，感知到你正在阿维纽林追逐嘉贝莉娜……

yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_601_2.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_5_2

yakita:JKXCCZST_4_10.text: Alright. Thank you for choosing Averardo Vault's Echo storage services.
yakita:JKXCCZST_4_10.zh: 好的。感谢您选择埃弗拉德金库的声骸存储服务。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_16.text: There happens to be an auction at Averardo Vault today. The top members of the family will be there.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_16.zh: 今天正好是「埃弗拉德金库」会举办拍卖会的日子。家族的上层人物都会到场。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_49_16.speaker: Zani

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_53_1.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕下_41_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_53_1.text: Averardo Vault is just up ahead. It seems this is where we part ways, Noah.

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_53_1.speaker: Zani

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_54_1.text: Welcome to Averardo Vault. Do you have an appointment?

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_54_4.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕下_42_1

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_54_4.zh: 这份邀请函是……啊，失礼了，欢迎您。请问二位有什么需要办理的业务吗？

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_5.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕下_43_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_5.text: Despite our feud, no one in Ragunna can refuse the services of Averardo Vault.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_5.zh: 虽然我们和他们不太对付，但在拉古那，埃弗拉德金库所提供的服务是不可替代的。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_55_5.speaker: Zani

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_56_5.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕下_44_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_56_5.text: Here we are. Welcome to Averardo Vault—the Montellis' heart and glory.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_56_5.zh: 我们就要到了。欢迎来到埃弗拉德金库，莫塔里家族的心脏与骄傲。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_56_5.speaker: Carlotta

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_24_7.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_20_1

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_25_11.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_21_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_25_11.text: Evacuation here is still on track. No anomalies detected in Averardo Vault… yet.
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_25_11.zh: 居民转移工作正在有序进行，目前埃弗拉德金库这边，还没有任何异常发生。
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_25_11.speaker: Zani

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_25_17.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_21_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_25_17.text: You and Avidius rush there, only to find most civilians already evacuated, with no signs of Dark Tide creations. Just as doubt begins to set in, the sound of familiar gunfire echoes through the Vault...
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_25_17.zh: 你与阿维狄亚赶至埃弗拉德金库，只是得知拉古那的平民大部分已完成转移，并未发现任何与黑潮造物有关的痕迹。正当你疑惑之时，熟悉的枪声却在金库上方传来……

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_47.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_22_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_47.text:
Following the gunshots, you witness what appears to be the Discord Slayer firing on civilians, only to realize these "civilians" are actually Dark Tide creations, Tidespawn, in disguise. Avidius accuses her of corrupting them with the very Dark Tide power she wields... 

Suddenly, Fenrico, meant to be stationed at the Fabricatorium of the Deep, appears. He calls the woman "Galbrena" and unleashes a devastating assault. Galbrena takes the blow to shield the civilians behind her. When "Fenrico" demands that you give him the Civilization Capsule, you begin to doubt his true intentions.
 
Tensions erupt. Though pierced by Fenrico's sword, Galbrena "rises from death." Dismissing his words, she hurls her lantern-like Terminal into the air, where it detonates, scattering the Light of Genesis. The burst reveals more disguised Tidespawn as battle erupts…
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_47.zh:
你们循着枪声前往埃弗拉德金库的上层平台，目睹了“猎魔人”射杀人类的景象……但随后，她却向你们展示了另一个真相：这些“人类”，都是黑潮的造物。阿维狄亚却怀疑，黑潮能够腐化其他造物，而她同样拥有黑潮的力量……
此时，本该身处隐海试验场的芬莱克主座却于此现身，道出女子“嘉贝莉娜”的名号，并对她展开了大范围攻击。而嘉贝莉娜为保护身后的平民，被芬莱克的攻击径直贯穿。“芬莱克”的行为很快令你做出判断，对方也直接表明了来意——他要求你将手中的“文明之匣”交给他。
剑拔弩张之时，被贯穿的“嘉贝莉娜”却“死而复生”。面对“芬莱克”的诡辩，她将腰间的提灯终端抛向空中引爆，起源的光辉如雨泼洒，一众伪装成人类的黑潮造物也终于现出原形。一场战斗也随之爆发……

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_32.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_25_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_32.text:
Escaping the Civilization Capsule with Galbrena, you learn that the Averardo Vault crisis has passed, but Avidius has vanished.

Using her abilities, Galbrena tracks his location, and together you ride her wind trail toward Thessaleo Fells.
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_34_32.zh:
你与嘉贝莉娜自文明之匣中脱出，埃弗拉德金库的危机也已过去，只是……阿维狄亚已不知所踪。
嘉贝莉娜利用能力定位到了阿维狄亚的去向，同时借助她开辟的风轨，你们“走空路”迅速赶往狄萨莱海脊。

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_421_2.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_42_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_421_2.text: Seems like the Order has already transported most of the wounded to Averardo Vault.
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_421_2.zh: 看起来，那些受伤的伤员，也已经被修会转运至埃弗拉德金库了。
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_421_2.speaker: Galbrena
