yakita:AreaReportContent_Text19.text:
[…]

The first page of the New Branch Employee Handbook, distributed by KU-Tata.

It provides an overview of the Black Shores ground level.

As the think tank for Lament prediction and world salvation, the Black Shores is also referred to as the "singularity for observing the Lament." Over the course of civilization, it has focused on studying the Lament and Waveworn Phenomena.

Black Shores members travel globally to collect Reverberation samples from Lament zones, using the Tethys System to reverse-engineer them.

[…]

By feeding a large volume of Reverberation specimens into the system, they aim to improve the accuracy of the Lament and Waveworn Phenomenon forecasts, reducing losses for their allies.

The Black Shores Archipelago is built on a massive piece of Tacetite, rich in high-dimensional Remnant Energy, which powers the endless computational cost of the Tethys System.

[…]

For those outside the organization, entry to the Black Shores is by invitation only, under the guidance of the Shorekeeper.
yakita:AreaReportContent_Text19.zh:
库塔塔发给新枝的员工手册第一页，这是一份关于黑海岸上层的基础信息汇总。

作为救世与悲鸣预警的智库，黑海岸在过去也被称作“悲鸣观测的奇点”，与文明同行，在漫长的时间里负责悲鸣与海蚀现象观测。黑海岸的成员会去往世界各地的悲鸣区域收集遗留的残响样本，借助“泰缇斯系统”逆向解析悲鸣区遗留的残响，加以复现悲鸣发生的前兆与历程，并以此接近悲鸣的原点。借由残响样本的大量输入，以进一步提高悲鸣与海蚀现象预警的精度，从而帮助同盟降低悲鸣带来的损失。

黑海岸岛链本身就是一块巨大的、蕴含着高维回音能量的黑石，这也成为了支持黑海岸“泰缇斯系统”巨大能耗的核心。而黑石频率的形成的巨大能量场，成为了黑海岸隐匿于海中的天然屏障。对组织外人员而言，需要得到黑海岸的邀请，才能因循守岸人的指引到达。

yakita:AreaReportContent_Text20.text:
Each area within the Black Shores Archipelago serves a specific function, including personnel management, issuing warnings, hosting international envoys, and providing living and preparation areas for Black Shores Consultants and Bloom Bearers.

Its true core, however, lies deep underground in Tethys' Deep—a highly classified zone off-limits to anyone outside the organization.

For years, the Black Shores has been collecting Reverberation data, recruiting skilled personnel, and liaising with other nations to advance efforts in analyzing the Lament.

As a global salvation organization, the Black Shores aims to minimize the impact of the Lament on civilization, help allies avoid threats, assist with reconstruction, and offer neutral advisory services during disasters. Notably, only the ground level is accessible to international envoys, where visitors are welcomed, daily affairs are managed, and information is exchanged.
yakita:AreaReportContent_Text20.zh:
黑海岸的地上的群岛以岛屿为单位划分职能，分别用于人事管理、发布预警信息、接待外国使节，或作为黑海岸客卿与执花的生活区、整备区。
而黑海岸真正的核心工作区位于地下的“泰缇斯之底”，也是任何非黑海岸成员无法进入的机密场所。

长久以来，黑海岸持续收集残响数据、招贤纳士，与各国接洽以推进解析悲鸣的协同计划。
作为救世组织，黑海岸需要降低文明遭受侵害，协助同盟势力进行避险，并提供重建支援，或以中立身份作为灾害应对的顾问，不过值得一提的是，黑海岸仅地表区域对各国使节开放，地表地区负责访客接待、日常事务与信息收发。

yakita:AreaReportContent_Text25.text:
A page of the New Branch Employee Handbook, distributed by KU-Tata. It provides an overview of the Black Shores underground level.

The underground of the Black Shores is where its data space intersects with reality, also known as Tethys' Deep.

In other words, the underground space of the Black Shores is the Tethys System itself. Space Anchors, stabilizing devices positioned throughout the surface and underground levels, act as firewalls to maintain the balance between the data zone and reality, ensuring they do not interfere with each other.

If the Space Anchors malfunction, the data zone within the Tethys System can "invade" reality, triggering anomalies that, according to the records, include but are not limited to:

Regional overlap between the digital space and the physical world, an increased likelihood of Consultants and Bloom Bearers developing spatial perception disorders, and simulated objects from the Sand Table escaping into reality.
yakita:AreaReportContent_Text25.zh:
库塔塔发给新枝的员工手册的中间一页，这是一份关于黑海岸下层信息的简要说明。

黑海岸的地下是数据空间与现实的交界地，也被称作泰缇斯之底。

换言之，黑海岸地下空间即是泰缇斯系统本机。贯穿地上与地下的四柱空间稳定锚如同防火墙般，稳定着数据区域与现实区域的平衡，使二者的运转互不干扰。
而稳定锚一旦出现故障，【泰缇斯系统】内的数据区域将对现实区域产生“入侵”，根据卷宗的记录，包括但不限于：
数据空间对现实世界产生区域性覆盖；执花与客卿出现空间认知障碍的概率提升；沙盘系统中的模拟造物逃逸至现实等异常现象。

瑝珑梦州方士，黑海岸客卿，风水大师，论坛冲浪高手。
豁达开朗，云游四方，卜卦算命，万事皆灵。

yakita:FavorStory_130705_Content.text:
[…]

Without her master's sheltering, Buling's first days away from home were uneasy and frustrating.

Had she not rescued that Huaxu Academy researcher from Mengzhou, who repaid her with a prototype headset that muffled intrusive sensations, she might have suffered from those ceaseless whispers far longer.

[…]

Her journey stretched on, a winding road of self-cultivation.

She crossed most of Huanglong, stood on the Black Shores, and ventured into the New Federation.

She marveled at Mengzhou's endless waters, braved Chongzhou's jagged peaks, walked through rule-based nations, and wandered lawless lands where only the strong survived.

Much later, in Rinascita, she received an assignment through the Tethys system: assist a Bloom Bearer from the Black Shores who, like her, had traveled far.

From the start, she sensed {Male=his;Female=her} identity was more complicated than the records suggested, as {Male=his;Female=her} fate lines were tangled beyond divination.

Their paths crossed again and again: in Septimont City with both bright and dark sides, in hunting grounds haunted by the Dark Tide, and in the ruins of destroyed Honami City.

[…]

That Rover was different—no carefree traveler, but someone forever running from one storm to the next.

[…]
yakita:FavorStory_130705_Content.zh:
与山上道馆的清净天地相比，山外的世界宽广、冗杂、喧嚣。失去了师长的荫庇，卜灵在下山初期度过了一段烦闷的时光。若不是偶然救起那位梦州华胥研究院的研究员，获赠一副新式耳机型感知屏蔽仪，她恐怕还要因纷扰不休的絮语困扰许久。
年轻的方士行走在热闹的街市，感受着、学习着当下最新潮的城市生活。师父教导的变通之道，成了她的行事准则之一。时移世易，如今的道门应该引入当下的新潮文化，各式法宝也应当紧跟时代。她时不时会给九峰道长寄去一些她购买或是改良的新玩意，比如微波式炼丹炉、带闹钟功能的驱魂铃、晚上会闪霓虹光的拂尘。其中她最满意的是一把内嵌了声控装置的飞行桃木剑，会根据使用者的指令在空中改变方向，这可比什么御剑术省力多了。
不堪其扰的老道寄来了一封亲笔信，里面只有刚劲的笔锋写的几个大字——“瞎胡闹”。待到卜灵某天回到道馆，她却发现师父身后就背着这把徒弟送的桃木剑。
这是一段漫长的旅途，也是一次漫长的修行。渐渐地，卜灵游遍了大半个瑝珑，去过黑海岸，到过新联邦。她曾欣赏烟波浩渺的梦州水景，也曾感受山峦险塞的重州风光。她曾到过秩序井然的文明之邦，也曾来过弱肉强食的无法之地。
后来，卜灵云游至黎那汐塔，期间接到了泰缇斯系统的传令，协助一位与她一样游历至此的黑海岸执花。卜灵早已察觉，{TA}的身份绝没有资料里写的那样简单，毕竟自己可算不清{TA}的气运。接下来的时光，他们曾多次发生交集。光影伴生的七丘城，黑潮将临的狩原，劫后荒废的穗波市……这么一说，倒都是些不太平的地方。
卜灵四海云游，自认逍遥。{TA}却难称得上是一名游客，总是从一个危机奔赴下一个危机。不知为何，卜灵也想看看那个人露出像自己一样享受旅途的表情。在列车长咖啡厅的聚会，便是这样的轻松时刻。
接下来，他们的脚步又会在什么地方交汇呢？卜灵本想卜卦一算，随即打消了念头。
该重逢的时候自然会重逢。届时，自己想必会像过去的每一次一样，助{TA}一手。

yakita:FavorStory_150505_Content.zh:
你就像黑夜，拥有寂静与群星。
 
漫长的等待以和漂泊之人的重逢告终，{TA}如期回到这座海岸。尽管失去了记忆，但{TA}的选择还是和从前一样，他们一起矫正了泰缇斯的错误，将安息归还给噬亡星中的人们。
但比起纯粹的喜悦，此时内心或许还掺杂着称作迷惘的情绪，他们赋予的也好，泰缇斯下达的也好，调律者告诉自己的也好，已经知道的路就到此为止了，那么尽头之后呢……守岸人看着喧闹着庆祝的成员们，悄声离去，不知不觉间，她又来到那片自己熟悉的海岸线。
像先前每一次一样，守岸人不带任何目的地在这条海岸线上散步，那是等待漂泊的调律者回到黑海岸时养成的习惯。睡眠对她没有太多意义，她更宁愿睁着眼睛看海岸上存在的事物，回忆时间叠加在它们身上的痕迹，毕竟……当漂泊之人回到这片海岸，至少会需要一位记得所有的守望者。

这次散步，似乎和以往没什么不同。地底的昼夜仍不流转，一抬头，可以望到的还是那片星空。但前路从脚下不断延伸，翻涌的浪潮中，守岸人朝那并不能真正望见的尽头伸出手——她很确信有什么已经改变，就像是，尽管她现在还不完全明晰该做些什么，要做些什么，尽管她现在的状态似乎和等待被启用的原始状态一样，空白无措，但她已经能毫不困惑地分清两者之间的差异。
可以选择的自由，终于真正来到了她自己手中，这世界是他们的，也同样是她的。
“填满它吧，用你想要的一切。“
“填满它吧。”
“填满它吧。”
“填满它吧。”
所有曾被她指引的星星仿佛都在发出无声低吟，它们静默地注视着她，也照耀着她，鼓舞她朝触手可得的新开始迈进。

脚步声渐渐靠近，那个陪守岸人从最开始一路走到现在的同伴，总是第一时间注意到她微小的情绪。{TA}走近她，又一次来到她的身边。
而这一次，她决定做两人中率先打破沉默的那个。
“我的名字……你曾说我们会有很多时间来讨论这件事。”
“所以你已经想好了吗？”
“守岸人，这就是我的名字。不是保守秘密、守护岸基的意思，而是说，守望着漂泊之人的人。”
“它代表着从过去到现在，所有构成我的部分，而未来……我希望……在属于我们的故事里，我可以是你漂泊之后停驻的海岸。”
“以及……”少女说着露出微笑，少有地卖了个关子“…

yakita:FavorStory_160302_Content.zh:
她从梦中醒来。
眼前的舱体内壁浸透在黑暗中，因调节频率的减噪效果，医疗舱内唯有厚重的寂静安然停驻。椿眨了眨眼，干涩的眼球转动着向右，终端屏幕上显示的指数已经趋于正常——手脚上的枷锁松开了，但她还是没什么力气，只好继续躺在这方狭窄的矫正装置中。
椿尝试着回忆之前发生了什么。她尽量保持平稳地状态去想，但失去的那部分如同一个无底的黑色洞口，望进去，什么也看不见。
她的记忆又中断了。
椿加入黑海岸的时间不久，刚满一年，执花的考核过了，最近才有了权限查看更多泰缇斯系统里的内容。
在登岛前，她独自一人在索拉里斯游荡了很久。
最初苏醒的溶洞没有其他人存在的痕迹，只有盘根错节的植物爬满了洞壁。椿赤着脚淌水前行，走到洞外，看到了荒废的村庄。
脚下踢到一寸残碑，上面刻着模糊的“落香村”三字。
从这座废村向外走，又花费了若久时间。
她饥饿时便杀死山林中的野兽食其血肉，渴了就饮山泉水，在密林中穿行。数月后，椿终于来到有人迹的地方。
后来她才迟缓地觉察出，那座村子或许已经被遗忘数百年了。
来到外界后，椿的记忆仍旧一片空白，并未因为环境的改变而发生变化，而她本人也仍旧只是一头齿爪锋利的动物。人的世界，很多规矩椿都不懂，但她能够使用自己的共鸣能力，这就足够了。力量于椿而言是天生就知道如何应用的武器，她随心所欲地使用它，在悲鸣侵蚀过的土地上自由自在地走着、笑着。
因一无所知，对她而言，索拉里斯的一切在最初都十分有趣。但逐渐掌握了一定程度的知识后，椿又很快感到了无聊。
来到黑海岸纯属意外，但椿总觉得周遭的一切都有种奇妙的熟悉感。
又过了一年，她在系统里找到了自己的名字，得知了过去自己曾在这里生活、工作，得知了自己曾被称为「花女」。
说来也怪，她遗忘了一切，却仍旧记得自己的名字。
好奇驱赶着椿在黑海岸开始了查找，为了找到过去自己的来处，找到「花女」的踪迹……然后呢？然后发生了什么？
想到这里，剧痛再次钉穿了她的头颅，胸口的花骤然膨大疯长，颜色趋近深紫，藤蔓上的尖刺几欲将医疗舱撑裂刺穿。些许片段在脑海中跳跃着，「花女」并不允许她想起这些过去……椿在漆黑的医疗舱中发出沉闷的惨叫，拘束器再度钳制住她的四肢，尖利…

yakita:FavorStory_160305_Content.zh:
她从梦中醒来。
大厦顶端的风凛冽地吹着，她伸了个懒腰，半眯着眼睛向下望去。交错的马路栉比鳞次，川流不息的车辆以尾灯串起一节节多彩的链条，她撑着脸，哼起歌来。
这是她从漂泊者那里学来的歌。
当然，不是亲自求问的，是她悄悄听来的。
他们现在或许算不上敌人，但这份联系无论如何算不上友好，顶多是单方面的认识。
漂泊者的出现引起了各方关注，包括她所属的组织。
当然，这和她没什么关系，也不是她能考虑的事。
她不过是被臻选过的种子，是只为追踪漂泊者而盛放的花。大部分时间里，她都因为被注射的那些药剂而神思昏沉，沉浸在半梦半醒间，唯有对那个人本能的追逐铭刻于心。
那些液体将她的理智拖入泥沼，夺走了她的清醒和自我。
她的思考是不连贯的、疯狂的，如一台随时会起爆的器械，在每一个指针走到终点的时刻前被强行重置。
但她并不在乎。
除了漂泊者，她几乎不关心任何事。有时候，她觉得那个人就像是被置于空白的画框中。那是一张仅有轮廓的陌生人的画像。画像的剪影由她搜集的那些信息组成——尽管他们离得这么近，但从未见过一次面，因此她并不知道对方的相貌是什么样的。
据说是为了规避泰缇斯系统的追踪，这也意味着他们彼此间不能有接触。
真想和{TA}见一面呀！
她以一种几乎要坠下大厦的姿势将自己悬吊在空中，在心中悠然想到，又忍不住为这幻想嗤笑出声。
藤蔓缠绕着她的手臂向上攀援，细小的花苞在末端徐徐盛放。
忽然地，一个念头出现在她心头。
我要送一朵花给漂泊者。
这个念头甫一出现，立刻占据了她全部的心神。她要找到漂泊者，再寻找一个恰当的机会做这件事。然后，她会把这朵由自己躯体生出的椿花送给那个人，它不会损坏、也不会枯萎……这个念头也很快没入她纷乱的思绪中，不见踪影。
此时她尚且不知道，千百年后，她眼前的世界将会湮灭在大悲鸣中。而她会不断在记忆的迷宫徘徊、迷失，直到在一个秋日的清晨沉睡在落香村的湖边，与前来救援此地的漂泊者相遇，加入黑海岸。再过数百年，那个人将会离开她，而她也将离开黑海岸，直到数十年后于今州重逢。一切未来尚未发生，正如可能性仍沉睡于种子中，等待着命运的绽放。
她从大厦上一跃而下，依靠藤蔓在建筑群中轻快地跳跃着…

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_15_43.zh: 见到了库默尼所说的黑海岸人事主管莫妮卡，得知泰缇斯系统目前仍然处于不稳定运行状态，并向她讲述了归墟港市的事。

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_28_63.text: The Shorekeeper explains that during your absence, she and the Tethys System had taken over the running of the Black Shores. yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_28_63.zh: 守岸人告诉你，在过去的一段时间里，她和泰缇斯系统替代你承担着黑海岸管理者的职能，也说明的确是她在归墟港市救下了你、秧秧和釉瑚。而为了解决“霍德”和萦绕在黑海岸与归墟港市两地的阴霾，她请求你深入地底，前往黑海岸地下的星空……

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_2_42.text: The battle in Norfall Barrens is over, and the Black Shores should be withdrawing... but they've asked the Midnight Rangers to monitor the area around the Port City of Guixu.
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_2_42.zh: 北落野的战斗告一段落后，今州的黑海岸成员就陆续撤回了。不过前几天，他们向夜归申报，要在归墟港市开展环境监测。

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_2_47.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_3_黑海岸主线_3_1
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_2_47.text: Yangyang has sent word that a Bloom Bearer from the Black Shores is currently in the Port City of Guixu and may have important information about your identity. Upon your arrival in the city, you happen to run into Chenpi's apprentice, Youhu…
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_2_47.zh: 你收到秧秧的消息，据她说归墟港市现今正能找到来自于黑海岸的执花，以此进一步找到关于你的身世谜团。恰巧，在你抵达归墟港市后，遇到了陈皮的“徒弟”——釉瑚……

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_3302_4.text: You've met KU-Money, then. He is the robot administering the Black Shores Archipelago.
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_3302_4.zh: 你已经见过库默尼了啊。他是黑海岸地上群岛的机器人管理者。

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_3_43.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_3_黑海岸主线_3_8
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_3_43.text: In the Port City of Guixu, you meet Niya, a Bloom Bearer who quickly recognizes you. She warns of an abnormal frequency detected in Guixu that must be urgently brought back to the Black Shores. If left unresolved, it might trigger another Lament…
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_3_43.zh: 在归墟港市遇到了一位自称妮娅的执花，她立刻认出了你并表示目前的归墟港市存在着一段异常频率需要带回黑海岸，如果放任下去，也许会造成新一轮悲鸣……

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_5609_18.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_3_黑海岸地下_归墟港市副本_2_4
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_5609_18.text: Ahead lies the onset of the Port City of Guixu's destruction. According to the Shorekeeper, despite deploying every available Black Shores member to prevent the disaster, many innocent lives were lost to the Necrostar, including Hoda, the field medic.
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_5609_18.zh: 再往前，你们要面临的就是归墟港市毁灭的开端。据守岸人所说，那时候黑海岸和你派出了所有能动用的执花和客卿，然而还是有许多无辜的人消逝在了黑洞之中，身为战地医生的霍德也不例外。

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_5609_5.chapter: 剧情_1_3_黑海岸地下_归墟港市副本_2_4
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_5609_5.text: You dispatched all available personnel to assist Huanglong in evacuation.
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_5609_5.zh: 尽管你已经把当时黑海岸所有能动用的客卿和执花都派了出去，最大限度协助瑝珑疏散归墟港市。
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_5609_5.speaker: Shorekeeper

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_6195_3.text: Watch over the Black Shores, watch over the Shorekeeper...
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_6195_3.zh: 保佑黑海岸，保佑守岸人……

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_8001_12.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_3_黑海岸主线_3_13
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_8001_12.text: Youhu reveals that the clue Hoda mentioned is an artifact from Mt. Firmament, discovered by her and Master Chenpi. Now, it seems connected with the Black Shores. The frequency tied to Hoda is hidden within this artifact, and it seems linked to the deaths of the Bloom Bearers. Reporting this matter to Niya and the Black Shores is now a matter of urgency.
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_8001_12.zh: 釉瑚告诉你，“霍德”指向于她的线索其实就是她和师傅陈皮发现的乘霄山遗物，现在看来也许正和黑海岸有关。那段代表“霍德”的频率最终寄宿在了釉瑚交给你的乘霄山遗物上，而现如今已经涉及到了执花们的阵亡，必须尽快将情况告知妮娅和黑海岸。

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_8_47.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_3_黑海岸主线_3_2
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_8_47.text: Upon arriving at the coordinates provided by Niya, you find the bodies of several Black Shores members who have died under mysterious circumstances. There, you encounter a mysterious Bloom Bearer named Hoda, who claims to know about your past but cannot divulge the details. Before disappearing, Hoda directs you to Youhu for further clues...
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_8_47.zh: 当你们抵达异常频率的精确坐标后，却发现了许多死于不明原因的黑海岸成员的遗体，以及一个自称为“霍德”的神秘执花，她似乎知道与你过去有关的事，却又无法和盘托出。而在“霍德”消失前，将线索指向了顺路前来的釉瑚……

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_81_44.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第五幕_庭际刀刃鸣_5_2
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_81_44.text: Jinhsi reveals a prophecy from Jué foretelling your quest to find Commander Jiyan in the Norfall Barrens at a time when raindrops fall upstream. Until that day comes, she advises you to seek out an organization known as the Black Shores.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_81_44.zh: 今汐告诉你岁主角曾经有一个关于你的预言，要你在瀑雨逆流之时去北落野找忌炎。但现在明显时机未到，于是她建议你可以先去寻找一个名叫黑海岸的组织。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_6_27.text: Hmm... We're still in the dark about Fractsidus' plans, and the Norfall Barrens is too risky. The Black Shores seems to be our only option now.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_6_27.zh: 嗯……残星会的底牌不明，北落野又太过凶险。那黑海岸，就是我们目前唯一的线索了。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_6_27.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_6_38.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_第四章_3_1
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_6_38.text: After hearing the story, you express your desire to find members of the Black Shores before heading to the Norfall Barrens. Yangyang suggests starting with the Blake Bloom, the organization's symbol.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_6_38.zh: 听完说书人的故事后大家感触良多，接着你告诉两人自己需要寻找黑海岸的成员，并且要等待时机前往北落野。秧秧表示从黑海岸那朵标志性黑花下手也许能更快得到线索。

yakita:LoadingTipsText_151201_TipsText.text:
On the virtual shores, deep within the Tethys System, lies the ultimate destination of the Black Shores in a distant future.
The tides of fate bring the lost traveler to this place, where their journey finds their end.
Yet, the guardian of this final destination, like yourself, is but a remnant of that very future.
yakita:LoadingTipsText_151201_TipsText.zh:
泰缇斯系统最深处虚拟海岸，记录并代表着遥远未来的黑海岸的终点。
浪潮将失乡的旅者推至终点，自此以后，不再有漂泊。
然而，守护着终点的人，和你一样，都是来自于终点的孑遗。

yakita:LoadingTipsText_UGC03_TipsText.text:
Modulation is the process of adjusting frequencies. In Solaris-3, frequencies serve as a crucial tool for uncovering the truth about reality. By altering these frequencies, one can delve into the very core of existence.
At the Black Shores, modulating Stellar Matrices is crucial for tracing and analyzing the Lament. Over the course of the Black Shores' history, only one individual has ever been honored with the title of "The Modulator."
yakita:LoadingTipsText_UGC03_TipsText.zh:
调律即调节频率，在索拉里斯，频率是事物的第一判断标准，对频率的调节，也即对事物本质的探究。
黑海岸通过对星图的调律，实现对悲鸣本质的溯源和解析。在黑海岸历史上，只有过一个人被称之为「调律者」。

yakita:Main_Honami_2_8_2_2_18.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_8_下半_穗波市_1_2
yakita:Main_Honami_2_8_2_2_18.text: Some time later, you return to the Black Shores to visit Chisa. Valentina tells you that the connection between Honami's Sonoro and the real world is stabilizing. Chisa has completed her treatment and shows no serious lingering Overclocking symptoms. However, she recently went back to Honami alone for reasons unknown. Her guide, KU-Shosho, might know more.
yakita:Main_Honami_2_8_2_2_18.zh: 一段时间后，你回到黑海岸探望千咲，在瓦莲京娜处得知穗波市的索诺拉和现实的连接已经变得稳定。千咲在近期结束了封闭治疗，身上没留下显著的超频后遗症。但让人意外的是，千咲在不久前独自前往了穗波市，具体原因不明。或许，这些天负责指引千咲的泰缇斯终端了解一些情况……

yakita:Main_Honami_2_8_2_39_37.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_8_下半_穗波市_3_4
yakita:Main_Honami_2_8_2_39_37.text: Not long after, Shorekeeper arrives. It turns out Chisa already met her while recovering in the Black Shores. Later, Buling arrives and lightens the mood. Although Chisa has heard of her from you, this is their first meeting. Namipon then leads Buling inside.
yakita:Main_Honami_2_8_2_39_37.zh: 一段时间后，你们在咖啡厅门口迎接了守岸人。原来千咲在黑海岸休养时，就已经和守岸人认识了。稍晚到场的卜灵活跃了现场的气氛，尽管千咲听你提起过卜灵，但这次是她们第一次见面。波仔带着卜灵先一步进了咖啡厅。

yakita:Main_Honami_2_8_2_51_16.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_8_下半_穗波市_3_30
yakita:Main_Honami_2_8_2_51_16.text: From Shorekeeper, you learn that no other guests are expected. Of everyone invited, only Shorekeeper, Encore, and Buling were able to come. Encore turned down the invite, choosing instead to finish the homework assigned by the Tethys System. Her newfound dedication to studying might be because Chisa tutored her in math during her time spent in the Haven of Sprouts...
yakita:Main_Honami_2_8_2_51_16.zh: 你在守岸人处得知接下来大概没有其他客人了。原来你给的邀请名单上，今天还留在黑海岸的只有守岸人、安可和卜灵。安可不知为何拒绝了派对的邀请，决心要完成泰缇斯系统布置的作业。究其原因，或许是因为千咲在新枝地休养时曾给安可辅导过数学习题……

yakita:Main_Honami_2_8_2_51_4.text: From the guest list you provided, only Encore, Buling, and myself were free to come. The others are either away or currently on assignment.
yakita:Main_Honami_2_8_2_51_4.zh: 你给的邀请名单上，今天留在黑海岸的只有安可、卜灵还有我。其他人或是外出，或是执行任务去了。
yakita:Main_Honami_2_8_2_51_4.speaker: Shorekeeper

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_49.text: Dr. Luuk is waiting for the auditor at the Starward Riseway as we speak. They'll be here any minute.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_49.zh: 陆医生已经去联运椎骨接那位黑海岸审查官了，估计很快就到。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_49.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_7422_10.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_35_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_7422_10.text:
After the meal, you and Galbrena head toward the harbor. You spot Calcharo, who aided Ragunna in the battle, waving from afar. 

Galbrena mentions she once worked briefly with him back in the New Federation, and that, surprisingly, he's not all that hard to get along with. If you ever find yourself in the New Federation, you will probably have the chance to become better acquainted.
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_7422_10.zh:
饱餐过后，你与嘉贝莉娜正欲前往码头，看见先前作为“黑海岸外援”出战的“卡卡罗”，远远向你们致以了一个问候。
嘉贝莉娜曾在新联邦与他有过短暂合作，据她所言，或许，对方并不是一个太难接触的人。日后若是去到新联邦，你一定会对他有更多了解的。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_1_16.text: I know of your ties to the Black Shores, so I thought you might be able to help him.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_1_16.zh: 我知道你与黑海岸有所联系，所以我觉得你或许能帮上他。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_1_9.text: A merchant caravan outside Xuanfang Hold rescued a man not from these parts. He insists on speaking with a Black Shores representative. Says they're the only ones who can help him.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_1_9.zh: 玄方城的商队在城外救助了一位异邦人，他指定要见黑海岸的人，说只有他们能帮到自己。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_22.text: I see. I'll contact the Black Shores and have them help Jedediah get back to the New Federation.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_22.zh: 嗯……我会联系黑海岸帮助杰凯德先生回到新联邦的。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_25.text: Well then, {PlayerName}... until the Black Shores takes over, I'll keep an eye on him for you.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_25.zh: 那……在黑海岸的人来之前，{PlayerName}，我就先帮你照看他吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_25.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_46.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束1_3_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_46.text: You arrive at the agreed meeting place with Yangyang, only to find a man screaming in agony before collapsing into a deep sleep. Yangyang explains that he is Jedediah, a Goldrunner from the New Federation. Goldrunners often venture into the Somnoire through "Dream Pathways" in search of treasure. During his latest expedition, Jedediah wandered into a strange battlefield where soldiers cried out the name of Promeus. Suspecting it was a battlefield from the Resonator War in the Federated Cities, he pressed on until the soldiers' screams drove him to the brink of madness. In a delirious state, he pushed open a door and awoke in the Mengzhou Borderlands. Now, he seeks the Black Shores' help to return to the New Federation. Sensing something amiss within the Somnoire, you decide to investigate.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_46.zh: 你前往与秧秧约定见面的地方，发现一名男子正痛苦地嘶吼着，随后倒在地上陷入了沉睡。秧秧向你说明了整件事的来龙去脉，这名男子名叫杰凯德，是来自新联邦的淘金客。在他们的文化中，淘金客们时常会借由“梦路”进入心之集域寻宝。而这次寻宝中，杰凯德误入了一片奇怪的战场，他猜测这是联邦城共鸣者战争的战场，因为里面的人都呼喊着普罗米厄的名字。杰凯德的精神被战士们的嘶吼不断侵蚀，在精神错乱的状态下推开了一扇门，醒来后发现自己被传送到了梦州地界。因此他想要寻求黑海岸执花的帮助，希望执花能带他返回新联邦。你察觉到心之集域发生了某种异变，决定前去调查。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_5.text: You... you're from the Black Shores, right? Help me! Take me away from here. Home... take me home...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_5.zh: 你……你是黑海岸的人吗？帮帮我，带我离开这里，回家……回家……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_5.speaker: Jedediah

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_7_1.text: After parting with Yangyang, you find a quiet spot and open a channel to the Black Shores.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_7_1.zh: 与秧秧分别后，你找到了一处安静的地方，接通了与黑海岸的通讯。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_17.text: But there's no record of Promeus doing anything in the war? Did the monitoring registers not detect any change in Its activity?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_17.zh: 而普罗米厄却在战争期间没有任何行动的迹象，黑海岸侦测普罗米厄状态的寄存器有反应吗？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_18.text: None that I can see... But the New Federation is hostile to the Black Shores. They have deported many of our Bloom Bearers in the past.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_18.zh: 目前没有警报反应……不过新联邦对黑海岸抱有敌意，过去曾驱逐了我们在该地区的大量执花。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_18.speaker: Shorekeeper

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_36.text: And as a neutral organization, we are bound by treaty to keep our observation to a minimum.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_36.zh: 现在黑海岸只能依照作为完全中立组织的条约，对新联邦进行最低限度的观测。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_36.speaker: Shorekeeper

yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_1_1.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2.8千夏活动主线_7_2
yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_1_1.text: The Tethys System recently expanded its frequency feature library and detected a previously unknown, special frequency. In response, the Black Shores dispatched Bloom Bearers to investigate. Valentina informs you that Shorekeeper is now analyzing the abnormal frequency and suggests you meet her for more information.
yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_1_1.zh: 近日，由于泰缇斯系统扩充了频率特征库，竟意外捕捉到了前所未见的特殊频率，黑海岸调遣各执花前往调查。你从瓦莲京娜处得知，守岸人正在谬误收容所中分析这段异常频率，你可以前去与她确认。

yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_1_4.text: The Black Shores recovered the Threnodian's Gem not long ago... I mean, Leviathan's essence. The Tethys System ran a deep analysis and expanded its frequency feature library. This enhancement allows us to detect previously unidentifiable special frequencies.
yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_1_4.zh: 黑海岸此前收容的鸣式宝石……对，就是利维亚坦的核心。近日泰缇斯系统对其进行了深度解析，扩充了频率的特征库，由此探测到了更多此前没能识别的特殊频率。
yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_1_4.speaker: Valentina

yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_3003_18.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2.8千夏活动主线_12_1
yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_3003_18.text: After Buling pinpoints the location, a strange mirage of a city suddenly materializes over the waters near the Black Shores Archipelago.
yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_3003_18.zh: 在卜灵成功定位了坐标的具体位置之后，黑海岸群岛的近海，却凭空出现了一座海市蜃楼。

yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_4_1.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2.8千夏活动主线_7_3
yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_4_1.text: A mysterious spatial rift appears, leading to an unknown Sonoro Sphere. Researchers from the Black Shores quickly assemble a makeshift observation platform nearby. You want to enter the rift, but Buling can't shake a sense of dread.
yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_4_1.zh: 黑海岸各成员已搭建起观测平台，一个通往未知索诺拉的神秘裂隙出现在你们面前。你想前去一看究竟，卜灵却隐有不安的预感。

yakita:Side_HSMY_1_20.text: Valentina and the Black Shores team picked up the latest TD samples from Huaxu Academy just as the warning came through.
yakita:Side_HSMY_1_20.zh: 预警发布后，瓦莲京娜带着黑海岸的人去了今州的华胥研究院，拿到了最新的残象样本。
yakita:Side_HSMY_1_20.speaker: Yhan

yakita:St_QSGZMNY_1_4.chapter: 剧情_3_6_群声共振模拟域引导_1_1
yakita:St_QSGZMNY_1_4.text: It's been a while, Valentina. How are things at the Black Shores?
yakita:St_QSGZMNY_1_4.zh: 好久不见，瓦莲京娜。黑海岸最近如何？

yakita:St_QSGZMNY_1_7.chapter: 剧情_3_6_群声共振模拟域引导_1_1
yakita:St_QSGZMNY_1_7.text: I'm Valentina, a Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores.
yakita:St_QSGZMNY_1_7.zh: 我是黑海岸的执花，瓦莲京娜。

yakita:ZXZTC_1_19.chapter: 剧情_2.0剧情直通车活动剧情梗概_1_1
yakita:ZXZTC_1_19.text: You confronted a crisis in the Port City of Guixu alongside Yangyang. Shortly after, the Shorekeeper guided you to the Black Shores, a place shrouded in mystery. The Tethys System of the Black Shores had suffered a catastrophic failure, unleashing data-based pollution that corroded everything it touched.
yakita:ZXZTC_1_19.zh: 与秧秧一同经历了归墟港市的危情，守岸人将你引导至黑海岸。黑海岸的泰缇斯系统面临着一场灾难，它释放出由数据构成的污染，侵蚀着一切。

yakita:ZXZTC_1_27.chapter: 剧情_2.0剧情直通车活动剧情梗概_1_1
yakita:ZXZTC_1_27.text: Rinascita is a nation to the southeast of the Black Shores, making the Black Shores archipelago the perfect starting point for your journey...
yakita:ZXZTC_1_27.zh: 而黎那汐塔，就在黑海岸的另一边，如果要动身前往黎那汐塔，黑海岸就是最好的起点……

datamine:InfoDisplay_101400000_Text.title: Huanglong News
datamine:InfoDisplay_101400000_Text.text: (Text puzzle) Pursue the direction of Blake Bloom, and the matter to be explored will be answered.
datamine:InfoDisplay_101400000_Text.zh: 存在异常，如有疑问请联系官方客服

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_15_6.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_第四章_51_1
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_15_6.text: Verina uses her Resonance Abilities to conjure a black flower that perfectly matches the one in the photo.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_15_6.zh: 维里奈用她的共鸣能力为你们变出来一朵外形与照片完全一致的黑花。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_68_1.text: Rover, did you see that? Miss Verina just conjured up this exquisite Blake Bloom out of thin air!
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_68_1.zh: 漂泊者，你看到了吗！这么精巧的一朵黑花，维里奈小姐凭空就把它变出来了！
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_68_1.speaker: Chixia

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_69_1.text: Oh, I see! And guess what? Miss Verina just made another Blake Bloom for us. Now it comes in handy!
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_69_1.zh: 喔……原来是这样。我刚才又请维里奈小姐帮我们做了一朵黑花，正好派上用场！
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_69_1.speaker: Chixia

yakita:SZSTBC_17_8.text: Fenrico's vanished. The Blessed Maiden has returned. And we're staring down an entirely new chapter.
yakita:SZSTBC_17_8.zh: 如今芬莱克不见踪影，圣女重现人间，这是全新的局势。
yakita:SZSTBC_17_8.speaker: Cameron

datamine:InfoDisplay_125000116_Text.title: Her Wishes
datamine:InfoDisplay_125000116_Text.text:
Cartethyia smiles quietly. Watching her puts a smile on you, too.

After twenty years in her solitary confinement, she’s finally stepped out of that tower—back into the warmth of the crowd, into the embrace of sunlight and zephyrs. This is the moment she's been longing for through her turbulent years as the Blessed Maiden: to experience the mundanity of life, as Cartethyia, the Wandering Knight. And those three wishes she once made? They came true because you were there with her.
datamine:InfoDisplay_125000116_Text.zh:
卡提希娅静静地微笑着，你也不禁因此露出了微笑。
历经了二十年的孤独与苦痛后，她终于从那座塔中走出，回到了温和安宁的人群中，被光与风所拥抱。这样平凡的时刻，正是在历经圣女动荡不安的人生中，属于流浪骑士卡提希娅真正追寻的幸福。她三个愿望的实现，是因为有你——因为你来到了她身边。

datamine:InfoDisplay_133002012_Text.title: Dark Tide
datamine:InfoDisplay_133002012_Text.text:
The Dark Tide is a Waveworn Phenomenon native to Rinascita. It manifests as a dark, swirling mass of clouds that gathers and eventually breaks, pouring down in torrents like a waterfall. Wherever the Dark Tide strikes, it spawns Tacet Discords, and the area around its point of origin becomes a new Tacet Field.

There have been two significant Dark Tides in Ragunna's history. The first, according to the Order of the Deep, was stopped by Napoli II, the first Primus of the Order. The second was quelled by the martyrdom of the Blessed Maiden Fleurdelys.
datamine:InfoDisplay_133002012_Text.zh:
「黑潮」是黎那汐塔地区特有的海蚀现象，黑潮会在天空中形成聚拢的黑色云海，在聚集至顶峰时便会如瀑布般倾泻而下。这些黑色云雾会向周边区域迅速扩散，黑潮所至之处，将会生成残象，而黑潮爆发的原点将生成新的无音区。
在拉古那，较大规模的黑潮曾经发生过两次。在隐海修会的记载中，第一次黑潮被修会的初代主座那不盖勒二世所阻止，第二次黑潮则由于圣女芙露德莉斯的自愿牺牲而最终消弭。

datamine:InfoDisplay_22010102_Text.title: Record of the Knighting Ceremony
datamine:InfoDisplay_22010102_Text.text:
Long ago, it was right at this solemn and sacred site of trial that the Blessed Maiden was bestowed Haultir, the Sword of Virtue. Now, in the same hallowed place, the Blessed Maiden raised the Sword of Virtue high, her gaze fixed upon the squire kneeling before her. The squire held his posture with perfect stillness, silent as a statue.
 
"Before our Master Imperator, do you vow to fight only for justice and righteousness, and to lend your hand to the weak?"
 
The squire could not speak. He answered with a slow, deliberate nod.
 
"Do you vow to remain steadfast in faith and oath, never to abandon the duties entrusted to you?"
 
Again, the squire nodded.
 
"Even should you find yourself in the most dire of trials? Even should you... face death itself?"
 
The squire uttered an indistinct sound. From the tone, it seemed to be an affirmation.
 
The flat of the Sword of Virtue lightly touched Cadanto's shoulders—once, twice, thrice.
 
"From this day forth, you are a true knight, Cadanto."
 
For many of the Acolytes witnessing the ceremony, this was the first time they had seen an Echo rise to knighthood.
datamine:InfoDisplay_22010102_Text.zh:
昔日，正是在这个神圣庄严的试炼之所，圣女大人被授予了人权剑「奥特尔」。如今在同一地点，圣女大人举着人权剑，注视着阶下的侍从。后者以端正的姿态跪立着，如同一座静默的雕塑。

“吾主英白拉多在上，你是否愿意宣誓，今后只为正义与公正而战，对弱者施以援手？”

侍从无法言语，只是缓缓地点了点头。

“你是否忠于信仰和承诺，绝不背弃自己应有的职责？”

侍从点点头。

“即使身陷最艰难的境地，即使……直面死亡？”

侍从发出了模糊不清的声音，听语气，像是肯定的答复。

于是，人权剑的剑背轻轻地触碰着卡迪安特的肩膀，一下，两下，三下。

“那么，从今天起，你就是一名货真价实的骑士了，卡迪安特。”

对旁观仪式的多数教士来说，这是他们第一次见到声骸被册封为骑士。

datamine:InfoDisplay_311000011_Text.title: The Martyrdom of Blessed Fleurdelys (Unfinished) Act III, Scene 1
datamine:InfoDisplay_311000011_Text.text:
[…]

(Drums beat solemnly as Fleurdelys, Brand, and other Acolytes enter, each carrying relics.)

Fleurdelys: Lo, the Dark Tide hath momentarily receded, granting Rinascita a fleeting respite.

[…]

We serve not only thee but also the Sentinel.

[…]

Though the tide hath withdrawn for now, its return is as certain as fate itself.

[…]

Brand: Praise be to Sentinel Imperator!

My lady, if this oracle is true, and thou hast shared thy strength with the Sentinel… could it be that the prophesied Enlightened One hath already walked among us?

[…]

To us, thou art the Blessed Maiden.

[…]

Now that I know the path to Their throne, it falls upon me to stop the curse at its very root, for Rinascita cannot bear further sacrifice.

[…]

If thou art to travel east, Priest Fenrico is stationed there with a detachment of the guard.

[…]

It is said that she held back the Dark Tide through her martyrdom, using the very last of her strength.

These fragments of history inspire endless curiosity: Who, truly, was the Enlightened One?

Was the Blessed Maiden indeed the Enlightened One the prophecy suggested?

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_311000011_Text.zh:
旗鼓前导，芙露德莉斯、布朗德及众教士各持圣器上。

芙露德莉斯 如今黑潮暂时散去，黎那汐塔终于有了喘息之机。感谢众教士长日以来的坚守。

布朗德 圣女言重。我们不仅是您的兵士，亦是岁主的兵士。黎那汐塔已危在旦夕，我等岂能苟且偷生。更何况，您亲自披坚执锐，带领我等抵御黑潮，身负重伤不曾后退。您既拥有着一位教士的高洁与忠贞，也具有一位战士的无畏与英勇，我等也是受您身姿感召，百死莫辞。

布朗德 只是，先前那北方刚透露出些许曙光，无情的黑潮便又汹涌而至，如同一只蛮劣的野兽，残忍地噬咬着我们的土地。兵士们奋勇抵挡，转瞬便被后至的潮水淹没。此刻潮水虽已退去，却不知它何时卷土重来，如命运般无常反复。长此以往，只怕我等气力后续难以维系……

芙露德莉斯 ……或许，此事仍有一丝转机。

芙露德莉斯 前些时日，我因黑潮侵蚀而负伤昏迷。惨怛的噩梦纠缠了我三天三夜，直教我如坠深渊，万劫不复。有一丝微光——如同祂为我们降下神谕时一般，祂用无上慈悲的话语抚慰了我的灵魂，在黑暗中唤醒了我。祂告知于我，神躯上的伤口若不复原，黑潮将永无止息。而祂的伤口，必须由具有其力量之人与祂链接，方能愈合。因此，祂要我向东行进，抵达那迷雾中的高天之座，如此，可解黑潮之危。

布朗德 万福英白拉多！诚如您之所说，若您已与岁主力量相通，建立链接……难道预言中的神启者，早已降临至我们身边！

芙露德莉斯 岁主在上，我不敢妄言此事。在我领受神谕即位之日，岁主并未告诉我有关神启者的事实。

布朗德 圣女啊，您已行无数光明之事，救民于水火，将世人之愿上达天听，我们亦是怀着感激的真诚尊称您为圣女。在我们眼中，您已与那神启者并无二至。

芙露德莉斯 无论如何，此事关乎岁主，既我已知晓那高天之座的所在，必须尽好圣女的职责，及早前去。黎那汐塔不会因这场黑潮灭亡，却也不能因此继续平添更多牺牲。

布朗德 诚然！卫队！即刻准备启程，护送圣女！

芙露德莉斯 请勿。黑潮仍在北方蔓延，卫队的力量，理应更多地投入到守护民众的安危之中。

布朗德 可是……

芙露德莉斯 这是岁主交由我的使命，我们都有各自的路要行。此去凶险，或许……我的终点正在那…

yakita:ItemInfo_70140029_BgDescription.text:
A play written by the mysterious playwright Cristoforo, telling the story of Fleurdelys, the Blessed Maiden of the Order of the Deep.
The script, however, is unfinished, leaving the story hanging just before the Maiden's martyrdom.
yakita:ItemInfo_70140029_BgDescription.zh:
由神秘剧作家克里斯托弗所撰写的剧本。剧中讲述了隐海修会的旧日圣女“芙露德莉斯”的相关事迹。
目前还处于未完成的阶段，故事只进行到圣女殉道前的一幕便戛然而止。
可阅读。

yakita:AreaReportContent_Text39.text:
10 Fun Facts You May Have Missed in the Pioneer Association's Historical Documentary: Land of the Sentinel!

1. All scenes depicting miracles and myths were filmed on the Fagaceae Peninsula, the only location abundant with the distinctive Viscum Viride. Interestingly, plant lineage studies suggest that Viscum Viride is most likely not native to Rinascita.
 
2. For scenes featuring Napoli the Second, the Order of the Deep denied the crew access to film within their Cathedral. Instead, the crew used ruins in the Fagaceae Peninsula to complete these shots. The reason for the denial was that the actor portraying Napoli the Second had previously played a merchant who falls in love with an Acolyte in another documentary.

3. The backstory of the Fisalia family's rise to prominence is loosely based on a legendary wealthy merchant from the New Federation, as the Fisalia family declined to share their own history for the documentary.

4. In the documentary, the Blessed Maiden is shown helping villagers pick fruit as a child. However, there are no fruit trees near Egla Town. This scene was actually filmed on the Fagaceae Peninsula.
yakita:AreaReportContent_Text39.zh:
关于先行公约出品的黎那汐塔历史纪录片「岁主之国」，你所不知道十个彩蛋！

1，片中所有关于神迹和传说的取景地都在槲生半岛，因为只有这里大片生长着标志性的的青枝。事实上，从植物系谱上来分类，这种植物很大概率不是黎那汐塔的本地产物。

2，关于那不盖勒二世的部分，隐海修会拒绝在圣堂建筑内部提供取景，最后剧组跑到槲生半岛的遗迹完成了这场戏。原因是因为扮演那不盖勒二世的演员曾在其他记录片中扮演过一个爱上神职人员的商人。

3，片中的翡萨烈发家史其实以新联邦的传奇富商故事为原型，而关于真正的历史翡萨烈人则拒绝提供资料。

4，片中的圣女小时候会帮助村民采摘水果，但事实上埃格拉镇附近没有果树，这段是在槲生半岛拍的。

yakita:AreaReportContent_Text40.text:
5. The Divine Envoys featured in the documentary were actually portrayed by the Echoes from Reserved Terminals, as the Order refused to allow the actual Divine Envoys to participate in any form of entertainment filming.

6. The battle scenes involving Napoli the Second and the Blessed Maiden were largely performed by sponsors, many of whom were contractors from Lollo Logistics. Locals from Rinascita only made up a small part of the cast, but they spent an entire day teaching the couriers how to charge into their enemies like knights.

7. In the bar fight scene, the director personally contributed to the fighting choreography due to having consumed too much of the special brew made in the Fagaceae Peninsula.

8. The iconic scene of the first Pilgrim's Sail setting off was filmed in a single take because the crew was only able to lease the ship for half a day.

9. The current head of the Montelli family made a cameo appearance, playing the role of the first family head of the Montellis.

10. The documentary has yet to be shown in local cinemas in Ragunna.
yakita:AreaReportContent_Text40.zh:
5，片中出镜的神使全部都是私人终端中的声骸假扮的，修会拒绝了让神使参与这种拍摄娱乐制品的行为。

6，片中随那不盖勒二世或圣女出征的场面其实都是由赞助商扮演的，其中，有许多是来自呜呜物流的临时工。黎那汐塔的本地员工只占一小部分，但他们用一天教会了配送员们如何像个骑士一样冲锋。

7，酒馆室内打架那段戏，导演自己也抡拳上去了，原因是因为在片场喝了太多槲生半岛的特酿酒。

8，扮演初代朝圣船出海的那场戏只拍了一遍，因为那艘船剧组只能租半天。

9，莫塔里家族的初代家族长由他们这一代家族长友情客串。

10，这部纪录片至今未在拉古那城本地上映。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_45_8.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_32_1

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_37.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_7_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_37.text:
You run into Cristoforo, the mysterious playwright, again. He's on a journey for inspiration to finish his script about the Blessed Maiden, "Fleurdelys." 
As for Gilberto, he tells you that a Fisalia member has been frequenting Whisperwind Haven, and Echoes have been mysteriously vanishing. 
Suspecting a connection, you follow the Echoes to investigate further.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_8_37.zh:
你再一次与神秘的剧作家克里斯托弗相遇。他正在此处采风，撰写一出有关拉古那的旧日圣女「芙露德莉斯」的剧本。
提及吉尔贝，克里斯托弗表示，最近确有一位翡萨烈家族的成员常来附近闲逛，而拂风水畔最近常有声骸失踪，二者之间或有关联。

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_904_35.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_5_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_904_35.text:
You speak with the stranger from Huanglong named Qiuyuan. Dispatched by the Mingting Capital, he is hunting a fugitive while gathering intel on the "Threnodian's Resonator." He had originally sought Ragunna's Blessed Maiden, but instead found Primus Fenrico, who entrusted Qiuyuan with the Lantern of Napoli the Second before giving his life to drive back the Dark Tide beneath Ragunna's sea.

Qiuyuan speaks of your identity as a "Harbinger of the Dark Tide" and warns that all Harbingers share the same fate—death. But you have long since come to terms with that.

Looking at your companions busy in their preparations, you ask Qiuyuan for one favor: to help Rinascita weather this calamity. He replies that the Dark Tide rejects all but Rinascitans, and you are a rare exception. But he promises to defend the surface in your absence.

Before parting, he tells you the Magistrate of Jinzhou sends her regards. Those whom you once aided are still waiting for your return.
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_904_35.zh:
为了确认拉古那海底黑潮的情况，你前去与来自瑝珑的陌生侠士「仇远」交谈。得知其受明庭命令，目前正在追捕一名逃犯，而且，他似乎在调查与“鸣式共鸣者”有关的信息。他本想寻找拉古那的圣女，兜兜转转，却找到了那位修会的主座。也是受其所托，他才将“那不盖勒二世的提灯”带到了你们手中。而芬莱克……则以自己的生命为代价，彻底驱散了拉古那海底的黑潮。
言谈之中，仇远提及了你“黑潮的代行者”身份，并提醒你……所有的黑潮的代行者，最后都可能面临同一种结局——死亡。
但你……对此早有觉悟。
你看向伙伴们忙碌的身影，向仇远提出了一个请求：希望他能够帮助黎那汐塔度过这次难关。仇远则表示，黑潮会拒斥黎那汐塔人之外的人进入，你的情况特殊，他并无手段进入其中。但他答应，会在你们深入黑潮之后，协助人们守护好地上的防线。
暂别之际，仇远向你提到：今州令尹，托他向你问个好——你曾经帮助过的那些人，也在等你回去。

yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_3_9.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府内生态_1_3
yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_3_9.text: If the Sanguis Plateaus were to fall, the Blightcloud would sweep in, unstoppable. It would devour all of Septimont in an instant, and the City of Glory would be lost to history.
yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_3_9.zh: 倘若桑古伊斯狩原失守，黑潮云的翻涌便无人可以阻止。它很有可能在顷刻间倾覆七丘，毁灭我们的荣耀之都。

datamine:InfoDisplay_161000002_Text.title: Tarnished Sword Tomb
datamine:InfoDisplay_161000002_Text.text:
(The inscription shows signs of being deliberately defaced.)
 
"Damn it… I told you we never should've let the young face the Blightcloud. And now, just us. A bunch of useless ████ left standing. How the hell are we supposed to stop the Kerasaurs?"

"Doesn't matter. If they weren't shorthanded, we'd still be rotting in our ██."

"We've lived our lives. No regrets if we fall here. But those children… they are Septimont's future. They deserve the chance to grow up."

"Save the speeches. What do we actually do? Try to get them out? With ██ closing in, there's nowhere safer than here."

"Then we deal with this the way ████ do. Been a long time since we held weapons. You haven't forgotten how to fight, huh?"

"Heh. Don't go underestimating me! Once I'm done skewering the Kerasaurs, I'll give you a taste of my lance!"

"Your lance? You can't even talk without wheezing, you old bastard!"

"Tch… shut up. So long as I can breathe, I can fight. And while I can fight, those things haven't won yet."

"Damn right. If we're going down… Maybe next time they talk about us, they'll call us something other than ████..."
datamine:InfoDisplay_161000002_Text.zh:
（剑冢上的文字留有刻意被抹除的痕迹）

“该死的，我早就说过不应该派那么多年轻人去迎战黑潮云的！这下好了，现在城里只剩下我们这些没什么用的████，怎么去阻挡发狂的角鳄啊！”
“那又怎么样？如果不是因为人手不足，我们几个现在还被关在██呢！”
“我们都活了那么久了，就算死在这里也没什么遗憾……但这些孩子们不一样，他们是七丘的未来，还有许多大好时光。”
“别说这些有的没的！现在怎么办？把孩子们转移走吗？可██迫近，没有比七丘城更安全的地方了……”
“那就只能用我们████的方式来解决问题了。那么久没碰过武器了，你们不会连怎么打架都忘了吧？”
“瞧不起谁呢！等解决完角鳄我就让你尝尝我长枪的锋利……咳、咳咳！”
“还锋利呢……你都老得气都喘不顺了！”
“这你别管，只要还能呼吸就还有战胜角鳄的希望。”
“你说得对。希望下次这些孩子们提及我们的时候，会以另一个全新的身份称呼……”

yakita:Term750001_Desc.text:
An operation conducted by Septimont's Gladiators to eliminate the Dark Tide and its creations within the Sanguis Plateaus.
The Plateaus' unique terrain allows Remnant Energy to accumulate, sustaining the lingering Blightcloud hanging over the area, a remnant of the first Dark Tide outbreak in Rinascita. Consequently, the region has become a breeding ground for Dark Tide creatures, where the Dark Tide's corruption continues to spread unchecked.
As the confrontation with the Dark Tide stretched on, the Septimontians discovered a strategy to effectively curb the Dark Tide's advance: luring its creations toward the Earthrend Wedge and hunting them near its base. Since then, the "hunt" gradually evolved into an institutionalized tradition deeply woven into Septimont's culture.
yakita:Term750001_Desc.zh:
指七丘角斗士于桑古伊斯狩原地区，针对黑潮及其造物所展开的定向清剿行为。
由于桑古伊斯狩原地形特殊，回音能量常在此聚集，自黎那汐塔第一次黑潮爆发始，黑潮云即滞留在狩原上空终年不散。受此影响，狩原内黑潮造物活动频繁，黑潮侵蚀范围亦持续扩张。
而在与黑潮的持续对抗中，七丘人逐渐意识到将黑潮造物引导至靠近彻地之楔深根的区域再加以猎杀，可有效抑制黑潮蔓延。自此，“狩猎”逐步演变为一种制度化传统，并成为七丘文化的重要组成部分。

yakita:Term750003_Desc.text: A colossal wedge-shaped structure located in the lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus. It descended from the high heavens alongside Rinascita's Sentinel Imperator, who had full control over it. When the first Dark Tide outbreak struck Rinascita, the Earthrend Wedge was activated. Its energy field effectively suppressed the Blightcloud above the hunting grounds, preventing it from spreading into Septimont's urban areas. Subsequently, the Dark Tide stemming from the clouds has been mostly contained within the lower levels of the Plateaus.
yakita:Term750003_Desc.zh: 坐落于桑古伊斯狩原下层区域的巨大楔形构筑物，与黎那汐塔岁主英白拉多一同自高天降临，受其所辖。黎那汐塔第一次黑潮爆发后，彻地之楔被激活，其力场有效限制了狩原上空的黑潮云，使之难以向七丘城区蔓延。受其牵制，衍自黑潮云的黑潮也多被封锁、抑制于狩原底层。

yakita:Term851028_Desc.text: The Sanguis Plateaus was once the Septimont frontline against the Dark Tide. Due to the region's unique landscape, Remnant energy gathers here in unusual density, along with a Blightcloud perpetually looming overhead, formed since the first Dark Tide. During High Tide seasons, Gladiators from across Septimont arrive here to hunt Dark Tide creations in the name of glory.
yakita:Term851028_Desc.zh: 桑古伊斯狩原是七丘对抗黑潮的前沿阵地。由于地形特殊，狩原常年回音能量聚涌，自黎那汐塔第一次黑潮爆发以来，在异常地貌的加持下，狩原上空始终盘踞着一片无法散去的黑潮云。每逢黑潮涨潮期，无数七丘角斗士便聚集在此，狩猎黑潮造物，追逐荣誉。

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_27.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_1_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_27.text: Bad. It's the highest point in the Sanguis Plateaus, well beyond the Blightcloud's reach. The Dark Tide has never touched it before.
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_27.zh: 它是桑古伊斯狩原的至高点，位置上也相对远离黑潮云的覆盖范围，在此之前，那里还从未出现过黑潮侵扰的先例。
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_1_27.speaker: Iuno

yakita:LGNCZST_80_3.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_居民区生态_1_3
yakita:LGNCZST_80_3.text: Eccentric Roccia the First Mate, free-spirited Captain Brant...
yakita:LGNCZST_80_3.zh: 沉稳可靠的洛可可大副，奔放自由的布兰特船长……

yakita:LKKST_1_4.text: Should it be "Battier and the Golden Harpoon," "Tina the Soprano Navigator," "Brant the Maverick Captain," or "Pero the Peculiar Box"?
yakita:LKKST_1_4.zh: 《金鱼叉巴蒂尔》《驭水玫瑰蒂娜》《不羁船长布兰特》，还是《怪奇百宝箱佩洛》？
yakita:LKKST_1_4.speaker: Roccia

yakita:NPC_24_JISHI_17_2.text: I saw Brant's performance before in Lilyland. The captain is so handsome!
yakita:NPC_24_JISHI_17_2.zh: 之前在莉莉兰德看到了布兰特的演出，船长真的好帅啊！

yakita:NPC_LHLSTHY_11_3.text: Then when you do go back, could you help me get Brant's autograph?
yakita:NPC_LHLSTHY_11_3.zh: 那你回去的时候，能帮我拿到布兰特的亲笔签名吗？

yakita:NPC_LNXTMDST_16_12.text: Captain Brant said everything was fine and went to speak to the creature alone. We were all a bundle of nerves, I'll tell you that much.
yakita:NPC_LNXTMDST_16_12.zh: 但布兰特船长说没关系，他独自去和这个大家伙对话，可把我们紧张坏了。

yakita:NPC_LNXTMDST_21_19.text: If it weren't for Brant saving me, I'd be breathing through my mouth for the rest of my life!
yakita:NPC_LNXTMDST_21_19.zh: 要不是被布兰特救下，我这辈子都只能靠嘴呼吸了！
yakita:NPC_LNXTMDST_21_19.speaker: Kasper

yakita:NPC_LNXTMDST_32_2.text: If Brant manages to snag the Laurel this year, you can bet Troupe Strength will sell like hotcakes. Heh, heh, heh...
yakita:NPC_LNXTMDST_32_2.zh: 如果这次布兰特能在狂欢节上拿到“桂冠”，剧团烈度一定会卖得更好，嘿嘿嘿……

yakita:SZSTBC_16_3.text: Brant's been asking for a celebration, so he commissioned a new batch from me.
yakita:SZSTBC_16_3.zh: 布兰特说要搞个庆祝会，在我这里定制了新的烟花。
yakita:SZSTBC_16_3.speaker: Kasper

yakita:lmzxst_18_1.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建生态支线_2_5
yakita:lmzxst_18_1.text: The Troupe of Fools' best shows are with Captain Brant on stage.
yakita:lmzxst_18_1.zh: 愚人剧团的表演，还是布兰特船长的最精彩啊！

datamine:InfoDisplay_70130016_Text.title: Picture of the First Cubie Derby
datamine:InfoDisplay_70130016_Text.text: "Oh! Contender Cartethyia has not only caught up with the pack but surged into the lead! If she keeps this pace to the finish line, she'll—wait, what's that?! Contender Brant is soaring! Contender Brant, what are you doing?!"
datamine:InfoDisplay_70130016_Text.zh: “我们可以看到，卡提希娅选手不仅迅速追上了大部队，甚至还一马当先！她能将这份优势保持到终点，其它选手又……布兰特选手？布兰特选手飞起来了！布兰特选手你在干什么？！”

yakita:BVBHD_103_22.text: You tell Brant that you're the current Apex Duelist in Septimont.
yakita:BVBHD_103_22.zh: 你告诉布兰特，你就是七丘目前的“巅峰决斗家”。

yakita:Character_Brant_10_1.text: Leave the paperwork to Brant. It's part of his responsibilities.
yakita:Character_Brant_10_1.zh: 这些文书工作就交给明天的布兰特吧，别担心，那是他该做的事。
yakita:Character_Brant_10_1.speaker: Roccia

yakita:Character_Brant_16_12.text: Margherita, two glasses of Nectarwine please, and top off Bella's drink. On my tab.
yakita:Character_Brant_16_12.zh: 玛格烈特，两杯「蜜露果酒」，再给这位朋友满上一杯，记在我账上就好。
yakita:Character_Brant_16_12.speaker: Brant

yakita:Character_Brant_16_26.text: ALL EYES ON ME! I, Brant of the Troupe of Fools, have a grand announcement to make!
yakita:Character_Brant_16_26.zh: 全体目光看向我，我——愚人剧团的布兰特，要在这里宣布一件大事！
yakita:Character_Brant_16_26.speaker: Brant

yakita:Character_Brant_16_8.text: It might surprise you to learn that Brant lost a bet.

yakita:Character_Brant_17_1.text: (Ah... Brant is playing the crowd. Heh, a clever move.)
yakita:Character_Brant_17_1.zh: （他应该是想看看周围人对硬币的反应……还真是「即兴」。）
yakita:Character_Brant_17_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Character_Brant_1_4.text: Is that Brant...? What are those two doing? Better find out.
yakita:Character_Brant_1_4.zh: 那不是布兰特吗……？他们在那做什么……过去看看吧。
yakita:Character_Brant_1_4.speaker: Rover

yakita:Character_Brant_29_1.text: Brant, look over there! There's another Lottie Lost.
yakita:Character_Brant_29_1.zh: 布兰特，那边也有个和你一样的寂寞小姐。
yakita:Character_Brant_29_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Character_Brant_3_17.text: As Brant and Battier heatedly discuss the stakes, you notice the fishing rod twitching, the line pulling tight—
yakita:Character_Brant_3_17.zh: 布兰特和巴蒂尔就赌局讨论得热火朝天，而你注意到他们身后的鱼竿正在抖动——

yakita:Character_Brant_46_5.text: As if to chase away any worries, Brant hums softly.
yakita:Character_Brant_46_5.zh: 像是要安抚这段旅程，布兰特轻柔地哼起歌来。

yakita:Character_Brant_51_10.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_1_角色_布兰特线_1_35
yakita:Character_Brant_51_10.text: After finding out that Brant is the Flaming Returned, the pirates immediately surrender.
yakita:Character_Brant_51_10.zh: 这些海盗认出布兰特是「火焰舞台的归亡者」，他们不想打了。

yakita:Character_Brant_8_12.text: Splendid! Brant took us to Septimont once, so we know that route well.
yakita:Character_Brant_8_12.zh: 稳妥的方案，之前布兰特带我们去过七丘演出，这条航线我们熟。
yakita:Character_Brant_8_12.speaker: Tina

yakita:Character_Brant_8_2.text: Normally, Captain Brant calls the shots, but since the helm is yours, I'm all ears!
yakita:Character_Brant_8_2.zh: 平时都是布兰特做决定，但今天你才是船长，按照准则，我得来问你。
yakita:Character_Brant_8_2.speaker: Tina

yakita:Character_Brant_9_6.text: Brant might not look like your typical captain, but he gets the job done.
yakita:Character_Brant_9_6.zh: 虽然他看起来想一出是一出，但还是会把自己的工作做好。
yakita:Character_Brant_9_6.speaker: Roccia

yakita:Character_Rococo_1_5.text: Umm... Brant and Bardolino are away, and they put me in charge of the welcoming proceedings.
yakita:Character_Rococo_1_5.zh: 嗯……布兰特和巴多里奥出了门，把剧团的迎新工作全权交给了洛可可。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_0_11_10.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_序幕_5_2
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_0_11_10.text: All good, Roccia? Some new friends have joined us.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_0_11_10.zh: 洛可可，还好吗？有新朋友来啦。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_0_11_10.speaker: Brant

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_8.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_1_2
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_8.text: Uh... Hello, I'm Roccia. We've met before on Brant's ship. I was... in this box.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_8.zh: 唔……你好。我叫洛可可……我们之前应该在花船上见过一面。我是那个……箱子。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_8.speaker: Roccia

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_27_7.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_3_4
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_27_7.text: Brant, you handle the Tacet Discords. I've got the dragon.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_27_7.zh: 布兰特，身手灵活，去处理其他残象。这里交给洛可可。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_27_7.speaker: Roccia

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_32_10.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_4_3
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_32_10.text: The troupe's base is, surprisingly, hidden in a cavern beneath Penitent's End. The thick mist provides a natural cover, but it remains a perilous environment. Brant and Roccia tell you how to find Bardolino, the former Laureate, and then set off to handle the lingering impact of the mist. They'll meet you again once their tasks are done.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_32_10.zh:
游行剧团的据点竟然建立在悲叹墓岛下方的海窟之内。虽然海雾为他们的藏身提供了天然屏障，但其本身带来的威胁不容小觑。
布兰特与洛可可把老桂冠“巴多里奥”的位置指示给你后，表示需要先去处理下之前海雾造成的影响，待会儿与你汇合。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_32_5.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_4_3
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_32_5.text: They say the most dangerous places are the safest. Penitent's End has always been forsaken, and now, cloaked in the sea of mist, even the Order's envoys wouldn't dare set foot here. It's the perfect refuge for us.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_32_5.zh: 最危险的地方就是最安全的地方。墓岛本就人迹罕至，再加上海雾这道天然屏障，就连修会的使节都不敢前来。可以说是完美的藏身处了。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_32_5.speaker: Brant

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_10.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_4_4
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_10.text: Brant is a natural. As for me, I'm more comfortable managing these kinds of tasks.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_10.zh: 布兰特的性格，总是能感染他人。相比之下，我的性子还是更适合做这些整备工作。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_33_10.speaker: Roccia

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_1.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_4_5
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_1.text: Welcome back, Brant! I... I heard a lot of voices coming from the mist. It's scary...
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_34_1.zh: 布兰特哥哥，你回来了……刚才的海雾里面，有好多人的声音，好恐怖……

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_19.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_4_11
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_19.text: Exactly. I'll handle the stage lighting, Brant will narrate, and the rest will take on the role of the audience.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_19.zh: 嗯。那么，洛可可会担任舞台的灯光师，布兰特担任旁白，其他成员则扮演互动的观众。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_40_19.speaker: Roccia

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_72_3.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕下_狂欢节_57_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_72_3.text: I have sent the address to your Terminal. Brant and Roccia are also here. We are awaiting your arrival.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_72_3.zh: 地址已经发送到你的终端上了。布兰特与洛可可也在，我们在这等你。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_72_3.speaker: Carlotta

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_20_3.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_6_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_20_3.text: We did right by the trust they placed in us. We got all the folks from the Riccioli Islands to safety.
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_20_3.zh: 没有辜负大家的信任，我们已经将黎乔利群岛的居民，全部安全送达庇护所。
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_20_3.speaker: Brant

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_741_10.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_50_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_741_10.text: But you're a bit too young for this, Roccia. The crew and I will handle the taste test!
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_741_10.zh: 不过大副可不能喝，就由我们，来为大副代尝吧！
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_741_10.speaker: Brant

yakita:TZZNQ_41_46.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_团团团团转2_7_1
yakita:TZZNQ_41_46.text: You finally meet the legendary and super mighty Elite No. 1, who turns out to be none other than your old acquaintance, Calcharo. In the end, you strike a deal: he hands over the newly captured Brant, and you hire him to help settle his debt with Abbowser.
yakita:TZZNQ_41_46.zh: 你们终于见到了传说中无比强大的干部一号，果然他也是你的熟人，卡卡罗。你和卡卡罗达成了一笔交易，他将新鲜逮捕的布兰特交给你们，而你需要雇佣卡卡罗，让他师出有名好找布大王算账。

yakita:lmzx_11_42.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_3_3
yakita:lmzx_11_42.text: Before leaving, Andreas hands Lenore a list of the Troupe's upcoming performances. He invites her to swing by anytime for a show... and maybe yell at Brant a little while she's at it.
yakita:lmzx_11_42.zh: 安德烈临走前给了伊诺尔一张愚人剧团的演出计划表，欢迎她随时来看自己演出，顺便也可以找布兰特发发牢骚。

yakita:InfoDisplay_264800003_Text.text:
Buling: Tab... settled
Buling: Tab... settled...

Note: That girl keeps hanging around. She must have found something about Grandpa. Ugh... I dressed up as a ghost to keep people away, but instead a real Taoist came knocking. Now I have to move Grandpa away... At least the ritual's almost ready. Just a few more days.
yakita:InfoDisplay_264800003_Text.zh:
卜灵 赊账……已还
卜灵 赊账……已还
……
备注：这小姑娘一直在附近，看来是发现爷爷的事了。唉……本想装鬼让大家别来，没想到让真道士找上门了。这下只能把爷爷转移走……还好仪式就快能进行了，就等这几天……

yakita:ItemInfo_80001019_BgDescription.text: Stir fry the shredded fish with seasoning, place it on top of the simmered thick broth, and then pour hot oil over the dish, creating a sizzling sound that brings out sweet and savory flavors. This rich soup is by far Buling's favorite hometown dish.
yakita:ItemInfo_80001019_BgDescription.zh: 煸炒的底料与鱼丝，放在调味焖煮至汤汁浓稠的高汤面上，热油浇下去"滋啦"一声后的香气与咸鲜微甜的美味，是卜灵心中永远排名第一的家乡美食。

yakita:Term130702_Desc.text: When Buling obtains Minor Yin and Minor Yang, she enters the Yin-Yang Balance state, replacing her Resonance Liberation - Flashing Thunder Spell with Resonance Liberation - Flashing Thunder Spell: Harmony.
yakita:Term130702_Desc.zh: 拥有【少阴】和【少阳】时，卜灵进入【阴阳相生】状态，共鸣解放·飞雷诀替换为共鸣解放·飞雷诀·归一。

yakita:AVG_Farewellday_30_5.text: Happy graduation, Boss! Hope everything goes nice and smooth for you from here on out. May you go wherever you wanna go and live however you wanna live!
yakita:AVG_Farewellday_30_5.zh: 毕业快乐，{PlayerName}老板！祝你以后的路能够走得顺顺利利，去到自己想去的地方，过上自己想要的生活。
yakita:AVG_Farewellday_30_5.speaker: Buling

yakita:AVG_Farewellday_40_33.text: There are even a bunch of people commenting in the threads saying they wanna get into our school just so they can be in the same campus as you.
yakita:AVG_Farewellday_40_33.zh: 甚至还有不少人直接跟帖评论，说希望也能考进这所学院，成为你的学弟学妹。
yakita:AVG_Farewellday_40_33.speaker: Buling

yakita:AVG_Farewellday_40_35.text: So how about it, Boss? Wanna strike while the iron's hot and crank up the publicity? Help the school bring in more new students?
yakita:AVG_Farewellday_40_35.zh: 怎么样，{PlayerName}老板？要不要趁热打铁，再加大宣传力度，帮咱们学院多招点新生？
yakita:AVG_Farewellday_40_35.speaker: Buling

yakita:AVG_Farewellday_40_71.text: Hope everything goes nice and smooth for you from here on out. May you go wherever you wanna go and live however you wanna live!
yakita:AVG_Farewellday_40_71.zh: 祝你以后的路能够走得顺顺利利，去到你想去的地方，过上你喜欢的生活。
yakita:AVG_Farewellday_40_71.speaker: Buling

yakita:EVENT_AVGanniversary_100_16.chapter: 剧情_3.8索拉学院_周年庆节日_1_6
yakita:EVENT_AVGanniversary_100_16.text: Plus, since today's a special event, we've loaded up the prize pool with tons of exclusive stuff. You definitely don't wanna miss out!
yakita:EVENT_AVGanniversary_100_16.zh: 而且今天可是特别活动哦！好多奖品都是专门准备的，走过路过不要错过！
yakita:EVENT_AVGanniversary_100_16.speaker: Buling

yakita:EVENT_AVGclubCenter_20_113.chapter: 剧情_3.8索拉学院_社团阵营分线剧情_1_20
yakita:EVENT_AVGclubCenter_20_113.text: There are no such things as ghosts and spirits in the world. People fear the unknown, then make up whatever they've heard secondhand.
yakita:EVENT_AVGclubCenter_20_113.zh: 但是世界上哪有什么神神鬼鬼的，不过都是大家对未知的畏惧，以及道听途说之后的添油加醋而已。
yakita:EVENT_AVGclubCenter_20_113.speaker: Buling

yakita:EVENT_AVGclubCenter_20_114.chapter: 剧情_3.8索拉学院_社团阵营分线剧情_1_20
yakita:EVENT_AVGclubCenter_20_114.text: As the saying goes, "You can't fear what you can name."
yakita:EVENT_AVGclubCenter_20_114.zh: 有句话说得好哇，“人不会畏惧有名之物”。
yakita:EVENT_AVGclubCenter_20_114.speaker: Buling

yakita:EVENT_AVGclubCenter_20_115.chapter: 剧情_3.8索拉学院_社团阵营分线剧情_1_20
yakita:EVENT_AVGclubCenter_20_115.text: Once you can name what scares you, you're able to recognize it and explain it. Nothing to be afraid of then.
yakita:EVENT_AVGclubCenter_20_115.zh: 一旦能给恐惧命名，那就说明是大家可以清晰地识别和合理解释的东西，自然就没什么可怕的了。
yakita:EVENT_AVGclubCenter_20_115.speaker: Buling

yakita:FavorGoods_130701_Content.text:
Many have wondered whether the Master Exorcist's tinted sunglasses hold any special powers—blocking disturbances, perhaps? Or identifying demons and deities?

When Buling finally bought this stylish pair in a bustling store, she just wanted another shiny accessory to brighten her look. Still, somewhere deep down, she might have desired such speculations. After all, it's the fanciful meanings people project onto an object that make it worth more than its price.
yakita:FavorGoods_130701_Content.zh:
人们经常猜测“驱鬼大师”这副特殊颜色的墨镜有什么神奇的功能，是能隔绝外界干扰？还是能分辨神鬼？
当她在琳琅满目的商店里挑挑选选，最终买下这件潮流靓丽的装饰品时，除了是因为她喜欢身上亮闪闪的感觉，所期望的或许也包括人们的那些想象。毕竟，有时人们的想象早已超越了物品本身的价值。

yakita:FavorGoods_130702_Content.text:
On her first few trips down the mountain, Buling used to stuff her talismans into her pockets, only to pull them out all wrinkled when it came time to fight. Sometimes they even scattered across the ground, leaving her scrambling in a panic to gather them up during a fight.

To save herself from further embarrassment, she repurposed a charming little casket she found, refitting it to hold an entire stack of talismans and adding a few convenient extras: navigation, feng shui reading, and fortune-telling. As for what the casket originally carried, well… probably bubble gum.
yakita:FavorGoods_130702_Content.zh:
刚下山游历时，卜灵总是把符箓皱皱巴巴叠起来放在衣兜里，紧急情况想拿出来使用，却总是手忙脚乱撒得一地都是，经常在敌人面前狼狈捡拾。
为了不让自己继续丢面子，她在一个称手的容器上进行了一些改造，让它既能分辨四方，判断风水与吉凶，还可以存储大量符箓，方便抽出取用。至于这个容器一开始是什么，似乎是……泡泡糖盒子。

yakita:FavorGoods_130703_Content.text: As Buling grew older and her Forte matured, the noises in her ears grew sharper, impossible to ignore. Beyond the temple's walls, she couldn't keep chanting to hold them back the way she could in quiet practice. The relentless clamor gnawed at her mind. Then one day, dazed and aching after dragging someone out of a swarm of Tacet Discords, that person gently placed a Huaxu Academy's invention on her head. In that instant, her world fell completely silent.
yakita:FavorGoods_130703_Content.zh: 耳朵听到的杂音随着她的年龄增长与共鸣能力的成熟越来越清晰。出门在外，她无法和在道馆中静心修行时一样，时时刻刻念咒保持耳边清净。那些杂乱的声音不断扰乱她的精神，在痛苦而恍惚的状态下从残象群中救下一人后，那人将自己在研究院的成果戴在了她的头上。那一刻，整个世界都安静了下来。

yakita:FavorWord_130710_Content.text: People call me "Spiritchaser Taoist" because they're afraid of the Tacet Discords and spooky unknowns. But the day Buling makes that name un-be-lingable… that means I did good.
yakita:FavorWord_130710_Content.zh: “驱鬼方士”这个名号源自人们对残象和不可测的危险的恐惧，什么时候卜灵让这个名号不灵了，那才好。
yakita:FavorWord_130710_Content.speaker: Buling

yakita:FavorWord_130714_Content.text: Master Youhu helps lots of my clients check their treasures, telling them what's real, what's fake, clearing their doubts and worries. But she's never that serious with me. Last time she brought out a new eggshell porcelain cup. Told me it's an ancient treasure with thin glaze, clean color, things like that, and she said five hundred Shell Credits is a steal. I said the cup was cursed with evil Yin Qi, and better pay seven hundred for a talisman seal, or it's not safe. Guess what happened in the end?
yakita:FavorWord_130714_Content.zh: 釉瑚大师帮我的不少客户鉴定过宝贝，消除他们心中的恐惧与疑虑，可她对我从来不像对别人那样认真。她上次拿出个崭新的蛋壳陶杯对我说胎薄均匀，颜色纯正，是上古时代的珍宝，五百贝币得之已是大赚。我说这陶杯邪阴相伴，有些不祥，或需七百贝币请符镇压才可保持有者日日平安。你猜，最后结果如何？
yakita:FavorWord_130714_Content.speaker: Buling

yakita:FavorWord_130723_Content.text: Mengzhou Taoist Buling here. Exorcism, talisman divination, fortune-telling... you name it, I "bling" it!
yakita:FavorWord_130723_Content.zh: 梦州方士卜灵不仅卜卦灵，驱鬼祈福，测字解签，法宝符箓……样样都灵！
yakita:FavorWord_130723_Content.speaker: Buling

yakita:MAIN_RYAM_47_14.text: How much do you know about it? This is our second time meeting, Buling. That can't be a coincidence.
yakita:MAIN_RYAM_47_14.zh: 关于这种异常，你知道多少？卜灵，你第二次找上我，这次不再是“偶遇”了吧。
yakita:MAIN_RYAM_47_14.speaker: Rover

yakita:MAIN_RYAM_47_32.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_4_七丘主线_上2_4_1
yakita:MAIN_RYAM_47_32.text:
As you consider the connection between Lupa and the strange happenings in Septimont, Buling appears once more. 

She tells you that she also senses the oddities around but cannot find a way to break the deadlock. She hands you a copper mirror. As you examine it, the scene shifts to reveal a conversation that occurred two decades ago during the Great Agon. Two Septimontians discuss a shadowy underground bet involving Gladiator Mya.
yakita:MAIN_RYAM_47_32.zh:
在你思考着露帕与七丘的异常之间的关系时，卜灵再次悄然出现。
她告诉你，她也隐约感到了周围的异常，但并不能找到破局之法。于是她将一面奇妙的铜镜给了你，而在你用铜镜映照之处，出现了二十年前举办冠军赛时的情境——有两个七丘人，正在谈论和角斗士蜜芽有关的暗庄赌局。

yakita:MAIN_RYAM_89_14.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_4_七丘主线_上1_4_5
yakita:MAIN_RYAM_89_14.text:
You encounter a young Taoist girl named Buling, who claims to be from Mengzhou.

She seems to have sought you out deliberately, but after a few cryptic exchanges, she vanishes without a trace.
yakita:MAIN_RYAM_89_14.zh:
一位自称是梦州方士的少女卜灵忽然出现在你身侧。
她似乎是特意来接触你的，却又在说了些古怪难明的话后悄然消失了。

yakita:MAIN_RYAM_89_6.text: Me? I'm a traveling Taoist from Mengzhou. Just call me Buling.
yakita:MAIN_RYAM_89_6.zh: 我嘛？只是一个来旅游的梦州方士，老板叫我卜灵就好。
yakita:MAIN_RYAM_89_6.speaker: Buling

yakita:MAIN_RYAM_89_9.text: Heard about you from an old friend. You know Jianxin? Pretty sure you met her in Jinzhou. She trained with the same master before me.
yakita:MAIN_RYAM_89_9.zh: 听一位故人讲过啦~鉴心，就是你在今州遇到过的那个姑娘，也是我的师姐！
yakita:MAIN_RYAM_89_9.speaker: Buling

yakita:MAIN_YGDX_1_14.text: (Before meeting Buling, when I touched the Echo in that village, I felt... a layered, indistinct frequency.)
yakita:MAIN_YGDX_1_14.zh: （遇到卜灵前，我在那个村落中触碰声骸时，曾感到一种“层层叠叠、模糊不清的异样频率”。）
yakita:MAIN_YGDX_1_14.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Honami_2_8_2_42_10.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_8_下半_穗波市_3_5
yakita:Main_Honami_2_8_2_42_10.text: Buling tells you that Honami feels quiet, likely because many of the "people" who once lived there have already faded away.
yakita:Main_Honami_2_8_2_42_10.zh: 卜灵表示现在的穗波市很安静，大概是因为许多生活在这里的“人”都已经消散了。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_37.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_1_38_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_37.text: Looks like it's east of the Sanguis Plateaus. Yeah, that place has lots of dark energy. Bet many tough people died there.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_37.zh: ……好像是桑古伊斯狩原的东边，唔……那地界阴气不散，怕是之前出过大事，折过不少厉害人物呢。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_370_37.speaker: Buling

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_395_3.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_呓语镇_2_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_395_3.text: Hey Buling, can you help me track down the Sovereign?
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_395_3.zh: 卜灵，你那边能定位到神王的具体位置吗？
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_395_3.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_480_1.chapter: 剧情_2_6_狄斯台地主线_上半_2_14_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_480_1.text: After leaving the Sonoro, you return to Murmurstown and send the pure Dark Tide frequency to Buling.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_9_480_1.zh: 你们离开「索诺拉」返回到了呓语镇，并将收集到的纯净黑潮频率回传给了卜灵。

yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_24_1.text: Recently, he bought Waterlamp, White Jade Beauty, Soulwrought Jade... and according to Buling, these are all materials for "Soul Summoning."
yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_24_1.zh: 他在最近购买了水灯花、白玉美人、妙心琢玉……结合卜灵的说法，这些都是“灵魂召唤”相关的材料。
yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_24_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_35_10.text: I suppose I should address you as "young friend Buling" now.
yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_35_10.zh: 我该叫你一声“卜灵小友”了。

yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_35_13.text: You give Buling a brief account of everything that's happened lately.
yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_35_13.zh: 你们将这段时间发生的事，简要地告诉了卜灵。

yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_35_22.text: Buling, since you're here, why not stay and cultivate with me a while longer?
yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_35_22.zh: 卜灵儿，既然你来了，不妨再在我这修行一段时间吧。
yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_35_22.speaker: Qingxiao

yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_35_25.text: Huh? But I've already promised Encore we'd head off to the New Federation!
yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_35_25.zh: 哎！先说好，我可是和安可约好了，马上要启程去新联邦玩了啊。
yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_35_25.speaker: Buling

yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_42_1.text: The reason he spread ghost rumors and told Buling to stay away is—
yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_42_1.zh: 他散播鬼怪有关的传闻，并要求卜灵不要呆在附近的原因是——
yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_42_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_43_1.text: But Buling's poking around put him on guard, so he's likely moved the TD somewhere else.
yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_43_1.zh: 然而卜灵的调查让他警惕，所以他应该已经将残象转移了。
yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_43_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_50_1.text: Lyu Yi's memo. From the notes, he's been secretly performing a ritual. However... "He's definitely been scammed," Buling remarked.
yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_50_1.zh: 店长吕一的备忘明细。从明细上看，店长吕一一直在秘密举行仪式。不过……“他肯定是被骗了啦。”卜灵这样评价。

yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_51_1.text: Lyu Yi's records of Buling's tabs. Judging by the records, Buling really does love this shop's skewers... "That's not the point!"
yakita:SIDE_XUANFANG_SSJX_51_1.zh: 店长吕一记载的卜灵的赊账记录。从记录上看，卜灵确实很爱吃这家店的烤串……“重点不是这里吧！”

yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_201_1.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2.8千夏活动主线_28_3
yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_201_1.text: After leaving the Error Cell, you encounter Buling, who has also sensed the abnormal frequency. Using her Forte, she helps pinpoint the exact location of the shifting coordinates.
yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_201_1.zh: 你来到谬误收容所外，发现卜灵也来了此处。卜灵称自己也感受到了异常频率，并提出可以使用自己的共鸣能力，帮忙定位坐标。

yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_201_18.text: Ms. Buling, we understand your concern. But the Tethys System hasn't completed its analysis yet, and your talisman divination isn't always—Ahem, what I mean is, without proper clearance, we can't initiate a high-level response...
yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_201_18.zh: 卜灵小姐我们明白你的担忧，但目前泰缇斯系统还没给出确切的分析结果，更何况卜灵小姐的占卜也并非每次都能……咳，我是说，现在我们还不能擅自调动高等级响应……
yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_201_18.speaker: Ria

yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_201_20.text: It's not that we don't trust you, Ms. Buling. It's just... last time, when you dreamed of a black cat dancing ritualistically, it turned out your Casket just had water in it.
yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_201_20.zh: 我们不是不信你，问题是……你上次说梦见黑猫跳大神，结果是玄机匣进水。
yakita:Shixifeidu_main_2_8_201_20.speaker: Ria

yakita:LGNCZST_140_10.text: The people of Ragunna City live alongside the water, resting upon it as they sleep, yet often needing to confront the threat of the tides.
yakita:LGNCZST_140_10.zh: 拉古那城的人们与水同居，枕水而眠，又时常需要面对海潮的威胁。
yakita:LGNCZST_140_10.speaker: Calaris

yakita:lmzx_1_22.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_1_1
yakita:lmzx_1_22.text: Acolyte Phoebe, I've put together a list of missing Acolytes from the Fabricatorium of the Deep. Acolyte Luther is counting on your help to coordinate the response.
yakita:lmzx_1_22.zh: 菲比大人，隐海试验场的失踪教士名单已经整理好了，卢德大人希望由您负责善后工作。
yakita:lmzx_1_22.speaker: Calaris

yakita:ItemInfo_80001005_BgDescription.text: Calcharo has a fondness for Huanglong's Food Ration Bar. He believes it efficiently satisfies basic energy needs in the wild and has a unique taste. To cater to some of the younger merc's preferences, Calcharo has enhanced the bar by adding dried fruits, sugar beans, and various seasonings, creating a variety of flavors.
yakita:ItemInfo_80001005_BgDescription.zh:
卡卡罗一直对瑝珑的戍边粮情有独钟，认为其已经能够满足野外的基本果腹需求，口感也别具特色。
但为了照顾到一些佣兵团内小朋友的口味，卡卡罗在此基础上又进行了改良，在其中添加了果干，糖豆等调剂，设计了多种口味。

yakita:Term800008_Desc.text: A mercenary group in the New Federation led by Calcharo.
yakita:Term800008_Desc.zh: 猎犬即「幽灵猎犬」，是卡卡罗在新联邦所率领的一支佣兵团。

yakita:FavorGoods_130101_Content.text: Calcharo's nameplate from his childhood. It has lost its original color due to rust, all that remains visible are the rusty carvings of a dog. The markings appear to have been crudely drawn by a child.
yakita:FavorGoods_130101_Content.zh:
卡卡罗从儿时保留至今的铭牌，锈蚀的痕迹早已令其失去了原有的色彩，只能隐约看出其上刻有的恶犬形象。
笔迹稚嫩，似是孩童所刻。

yakita:FavorGoods_130102_Content.text:
For Calcharo, it's a life-saving treasure. 
It's rough, but it's good for the stomach. 
In the case of extreme hunger, no matter what flavor you eat, it will feel like a heavenly delicacy. 
Pungent, braised, spicy... According to him, the canned rations produced in Huanglong are a bit tastier than the ones from other regions.
yakita:FavorGoods_130102_Content.zh:
对于卡卡罗而言，这可是能够救命的宝贝。
虽然粗糙，但胜在果腹。
在极度饥饿的情况下，无论吃到何种风味，都会感觉是天赐的美味。
辛香、红烧、麻辣……卡卡罗还是觉得，瑝珑生产的罐头，要比其他地区生产的都要好吃一些。

yakita:FavorGoods_130103_Content.text:
A short sword that Calcharo has carried since childhood. 
It was there when he first rose to fame as the vicious Underdog. 
Unfortunately, it was broken in an unknown encounter. 
Calcharo doesn't like to talk about the battle, but sometimes you can catch him touching the broken blade as a way to remember those who died and a time that has passed.
yakita:FavorGoods_130103_Content.zh:
与卡卡罗一同出生入死，携带至今的短刀。
曾与卡卡罗一齐被冠以了“恶犬”的威名。 
遗憾的是，拥有如此盛名的獠牙， 
最终却折断于一场不为人知的交锋里。 
那场战斗的细节，卡卡罗想必不愿轻易提及，只是偶尔能看见他轻柔抚拭着断裂的獠牙，好像在祭奠某位消逝的故人，又好像在祭奠某段消逝的过去。

yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1301_TalentCertific.chapter: 卡卡罗档案_共鸣能力鉴定报告
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1301_TalentCertific.text:
Resonator Calcharo's waveform graph shows zigzag fluctuations. The pattern of Time Domain is irregular. Both the upper and lower peak values are high and manifest proximity to the Criticality level. The waveform displays segments of partial fuzziness and an abnormal waveform can be seen.

Resonant Criticality: Relatively high, combined with extremely low stability. Risk of Overclocking is substantial.

Resonator Calcharo has a documented history of Overclocking. Maximum recorded Overclocking rating: Severe. 

During Overclocking, signs of Tacet Discord erosion spreads on Resonator Calcharo's body, and the golden Tacet Core on his chest flickers. It also significantly intensifies his Frequency fluctuations and conjures multiple phantom-like entities.

No major incidents of civilian injuries or property damage from Calcharo's Overclocking episodes have been found.

Resonator Calcharo possesses an extremely high risk of Overclocking with an unidentified trigger. It is advised to raise his risk assessment level and closely monitor his condition.
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1301_TalentCertific.zh:
波形检验图呈锯齿形波动，时域表示无序，上下峰值较高，且峰值可接近临界点，波形呈现部分模糊状态，可见异常波形。
诊断结果：超频临界值较高，稳定性极低，超频风险极大。
存在过往超频史，最高等级：重。
超频时对象躯体残象化部分会大幅扩大，虚影荆棘环绕至全身，胸口金色核心发出频闪，频率波动反应极高，同时可观测到多重幻影。
暂未搜索到与对象相关联的大范围灾害事件。
无法判断超频原因，对象存在极高超频风险，建议提高风险评估等级，并对其持续保持关注。

yakita:FavorStory_130101_Content.zh:
“恶犬”卡卡罗，曾是“无法地带”流放者的一员，为了生存，早已练就了极为阴险的战斗技巧，如今为维护佣兵团口碑，投毒、收买、绑架人质、预埋炸弹……更是各种手段无所不用其极。坊间一直流传着关于卡卡罗的凶狠传闻，诸如能在炎热的沙漠中埋伏七天七夜滴水不喝，在身上绑满定时炸弹前去谈判，为骗取信任雇佣杀手刺杀自己……
种种传说虽含有夸大成分，却并非无根之谈，熟悉卡卡罗的人都不会怀疑——这些确实都是他能够做出来的事情。
然而，这类传说却随着时间的推移又产生了愈演愈烈的趋势……
“12岁时他能够单手截停运输车，15岁时他的异能令整个新联邦为之颤抖，18岁时一人对抗新联邦全部警力，最后全身而退……”
“他的胸口寄宿着鬼魂，额头上是神明降下的诅咒。他的双脚踏出闪电，他的双眼燃着火焰，誓要将怒火燃向高天……”
“历尽死亡，几度重生……无论多少次，他都会如幽灵般归来，夺回他的一切……”
关于卡卡罗今天又被造了什么谣的话题，已经成为了团员们每天茶余饭后必备的闲谈甜点。
至于卡卡罗本人，则显得尤为淡然……要么是早已见怪不怪，要么，就是在盘算着如何利用这些谣言。
在无法之地，让朋友成为敌人，或是令敌人成为朋友，就像风改变它的流向那样简单……更何况是其他事物呢？
一切事物都可以转化，有利或不利，从不绝对。二者的区别，只在于如何使用。
谣言带来偏见，偏见带来误解，误解带来错判。
而错判对手的实力，永远是博弈的大忌。

yakita:FavorStory_130102_Content.zh:
白手起家的卡卡罗，之所以能在短短几年之内打出名声，一方面源于卡卡罗总是敢于接取那些出生入死，一般人完成不了的高价委托，另一方面，则源于他那与任何人都可以达成合作的模糊道德观。
拿钱办事，天经地义。契约既定，使命必达。
武装押运，涉险夺人，无音区清理……又或是其他隐秘的业务，只要拿到酬金，卡卡罗便一定会将事情办妥。
若是雇主失信，那就需要做好被卡卡罗追杀到天涯海角的准备。
如此“公正信誉”，自然是为卡卡罗换来了各方势力的忌惮与默许。
没有什么不道德的委托，没有什么不可告人的买卖，一切只是“价值交换”，这便是卡卡罗所认为的交易的本质。
只是很多时候，价值，并不总以金钱来衡量。
在面对那些付不起高额酬劳的底层民众时，卡卡罗往往只会以个人的名义，象征性地收取一枚贝币。
在受惠者感恩戴义之时，殊不知这份礼物，早已成为了卡卡罗与他们所签订的契约……人情，可是最难以还清的债务。
绝不接受没有利益的委托，永远是卡卡罗的第一原则。
凭借这一理念，卡卡罗将不少市井小民都收归为了眼线，积累起强大的情报与人脉关系网，渗透进了各个境域。
唯利是图，心狠手辣，睚眦必报。这即是外界对于卡卡罗的评价。
但外界也不得不承认，卡卡罗以其手段所建立的秩序，的确避免了许多不必要的厮杀——毕竟谁也不知道，那个巷子里卖小吃的阿姨是否是卡卡罗的线人。
任何欺软怕硬的家伙，在想对这些平民百姓出手时，也都要因为这一点而先退让三分。

yakita:FavorStory_130103_Content.zh:
在过去的新联邦，歧视与偏见，曾是流放者们寻求合法工作的最大阻碍。
位于新联邦外围的流放者聚集地，也曾因此被称作“无法地带”。
帮派，则是无法地带的流放者们独特的生存方式。
在那个帮派横行的年代，曾有一支“恶狗帮”名噪一时。
恶狗帮最初的成员，是一批不过12岁左右的少年。
为首的少年不甘于其他帮派的压迫，暗中跟随所有被欺辱过的孩子，向他们发出邀请。
少年展现出惊人的手段与魄力，令恶狗帮在几年内迅速崛起。
帮派内没有等级，没有压迫，有的，只是少年们对生存与自由的渴望。
可成员们最终却接连死于其他帮派的窥视觊觎，死于合作者的阴谋暗算，死于金主的归顺变节。
时代并没有善待他们。在无法地带，相互背叛就是宿命，不向上攀登，便只能任人宰割。
醒悟的少年，向命运发起了一场赌博。
……
许久之后，新联邦对无法地带最后的帮派“恶狗帮”展开大规模清剿行动，引发了惨烈的战争。
于时，一支秘密组建，名为“幽灵猎犬”的佣兵团，在一夜之间便将“恶狗帮”吞并，终结了这场混乱。
浩劫过后，人们才注意到，该佣兵团首领的名字，竟与恶狗帮曾经的首领如出一辙。
荆棘环绕，幻影加身。
他以一种宛如幽灵般可怖的形象，再次回到了这里。
这一次，他会站在顶点，完成那些因自己的天真、恻隐、游移而未能完成的事情。
只是……多年以后，他仍会想起，在垃圾场中，他与同伴成立“恶狗帮”的那个午后——那却是他生命中为数不多的温存。

yakita:FavorStory_130104_Content.zh:
“出发前一定要清点弹药，检查武器损耗，确认防护装备穿戴整齐，小队行动必须确保彼此终端连接正常……“
尽管像雇佣兵这种刀尖舔血，九死一生的工作免不了伤亡，团员们也早有觉悟，但卡卡罗还是会在成员出战时，事无巨细不厌其烦地进行叮嘱，在成员交接任务时默默在背后注视一切，对自家人总是有操不完的心……像是一位天生的操劳命苦当家。
为此，卡卡罗曾为佣兵团定下十余条守则：
“成员享有自由组队的权利，但必须提前告知风险，不得以任何方式强迫其他成员……”
“委托内容对外必须保密……”
“成员必须遵守各城邦基本法律规定……”
“严禁任何形式的出卖与背叛行为，违者，死罪。”
……
缜密的条文之下，尽是卡卡罗的一片苦心。
卡卡罗始终明白，行走于黑暗边缘，必会被黑暗浸染。卖命生意，终不是长久之计。
为此，卡卡罗选择了低调行事，开始为佣兵团招揽各类合法生意，寻求更多的机会与可能。
长久的收敛为佣兵团招来了外部的觊觎，其中不乏一些妄图取而代之的新兴势力，他们曾无视“规矩”，将一名佣兵团新人打至重伤作为挑衅。
就在对方认为卡卡罗选择了忍气吞声之时，在一个夜晚，这支势力，于爆燃的火光中，彻底从这颗星球的历史上消失了。
这一事件在后来被包装成了一起“意外火灾“，相关机构均保持了沉默——尽管他们全部心知肚明。
狂吠的野狗往往不会咬人，而一旦触碰到了那头沉睡恶犬的底线，待他醒来，展露獠牙时再想逃跑……早已为时过晚。

yakita:FavorStory_160304_Content.zh:
她从梦中醒来。
昏迷与清醒的间隔越来越短，花女逐渐不再能够分辨自己在何时做梦、何时醒着。
她甚至不记得这是从何时开始的症状了。
海潮般的记忆尖啸着倒灌入意识中，破坏了她的认知和感官，痛苦一刻不歇地撕扯着躯体和意识。花女张开嘴，疼得想吐，但喉管已因重度超频带来的魔化扭曲成了一节粗粝的植物根茎。哀鸣声被堵截在胸膛内部，沉入腹中。
勉强支撑着躯体走了数步，她再度摔在泥泞的河岸边，浑身颤抖，就连指尖都开始不规律地抽搐起来。
这是……第几次了？
她茫然地睁着眼睛，看向上方漆黑的夜色。
一切思考都趋向混乱，但关于漂泊者的事却记得很清楚。
她已经想起了一切。
关于自己是谁，关于漂泊者是谁，关于她诞生的目的，关于索拉里斯，关于大悲鸣……
但在她因重度超频步入疯狂前，这些记忆都因躯体的机能被封锁在最深处，从来未曾浮出水面。每次，她都会在苏醒后丢失一切记忆，只余下空茫。待时间流转，躯体状况难以遏制地因重度超频恶化时，她才会回想起自己的使命和根源，接着再度丢失所有记忆。
这是第几次了？花女不知道。
文明毁灭，又再度繁盛，生命消逝，又再度出现新的火光。
她见证着索拉里斯的潮起潮落，却永远是个精神上的异乡人。
漂泊者……花女默念着这个名字。
他们却从未正式见过面、说过话，如今一切都已失去，她甚至无法判断彼此到底算不算是敌人。
但她知道，在下一次，她一定还会本能地追上{TA}。
这不是什么亲切可爱的思念和执着，而是躯体的枷锁，是花女无法抗拒的东西。
尽管她并不厌恶这枷锁。
林间传来窸窸窣窣的声响，她疲倦地眨了眨眼，红椿盛放，藤蔓瞬息间刺穿了不远处黑暗中的残象。
是了，这就是她的本能，是她的本质，是她的自我……即便在她即将丢失全部记忆和思想时，她仍旧可以依靠自己的本能。
事实上，除了本能，她实在也没什么可抓住的东西了。
下一次……如果能真正认识漂泊者，和{TA}说说话就好了。花女模糊地思考着。不过，这次她暴露了行踪，或许泰缇斯系统会将那个人引到此处也说不定。
花女闭上眼，在剧痛的顶峰陷入了安眠的黑暗。
带着凉意的湖水浸泡着她的半边脸孔，椿花逐渐枯萎，藤蔓收缩，回归她的躯体。
秋日的夜风吹拂着林叶，轻…
