yakita:FavorStory_130402_Content.text:
[…]

When Jinhsi became the Jinzhou Magistrate, she was young and inexperienced.

The people of Jinzhou placed their trust in her decisions, but she knew it was not her alone, but also her role as the Sentinel's Resonator, that earned their faith.

[…]

Standing amidst the crowd, Jinhsi held a Loong Scale, closed her eyes, and nodded, "I will convey your wish to the Sentinel."

[…]

Wishing became a popular custom, with people submitting their desires to her at City Hall.

[…]

"Dear Magistrate, I'm worried about Tacet Discords infiltrating our city."—Taoqi, director of the Defense Division, was then tasked with fortifying the city defense walls.

"Dear Magistrate, I pray for my father's safe return and an end to the war."—Jinhsi prioritized research on Tacetite weaponry and material engineering, pushing for new weapons against Discords and faster upgrades for defense.

"Dear Magistrate, the Exiles have been spotted in the city.

I'm scared."—Jinhsi expanded Patrol Stations, added Patrollers in the city, and assigned more Midnight Rangers to guard outside.

[…]

And eventually, they came to understand that she possessed an incredible power - without a Loong Scale, she could summon a dazzling light that could pierce through ice and turn the tide of time.

[…]
yakita:FavorStory_130402_Content.zh:
今汐刚被选为令尹时年纪尚幼、资历尚浅，人们信任的多半是岁主的选择，是岁主共鸣者的身份，而不是今汐本身。
作为一名合格的令尹，即使开局不利，也得用尽全力将今州引领至更好的未来。况且，信任是要靠自己的能力去争取的，今汐很清楚这点。
比起眼中的怀疑，今汐更在意城民们脸上的疲态——那是一种被生活的苦痛反复碾压，丧失了希望的疲态。
今汐知道，比起物资匮乏、内忧外患的环境，更难的是让被生活摧残得早已丧失气力的人们恢复期盼明天的勇气和信心。
在这种情况下，人们需要一个可以信任的精神寄托，而这个寄托是不是目前的自己，并不重要。

于是，在一次灾后重建中，少女令尹上演了一场“岁主与愿”的“神迹”。这处村庄地势偏远，残象潮虽已退却，连年的频率紊乱却导致了持续异常，乌云压城，雪凝不化。
少女令尹请村民说出自己的愿望。刚开始无人回应，直到一声喷嚏打破寂静，紧接着，一个小小的声音怯生生地哼唧道：“好冷……要是天气没有这么冷就好了。”
今汐站在人群中央，手捧龙鳞，闭目颔首：“我会向岁主传达你的愿望。”
霎时，她的头上生出龙角，一道形似岁主的光芒划破黑压压的乌云，击穿地上的积雪——霎时间，冰消雪融，寒去春来。
众人惊叹：“岁主……岁主显灵了！”龙形天光倒映在人们的眼中，重新点燃了希望的光芒。

一传十、十传百，许愿的习俗逐渐风靡今州。
大大小小的愿望在边庭附近聚集，传进少女令尹的耳中。
她从这些细碎的愿望中找出关键的信息，制定对应的策略。
“担心残象溜进城里。”——任命桃祈为天工防事科事务长，带头升级边防城墙。
“希望战争早点结束，爸爸早点回家。”——将黑石武器科和工学材料科并列为重点研究科，一边应对进化的残象开发新型武器，一边升级防护材料，边攻边守，齐头并进。
“城里混进了流寇，害怕。”——增设巡宁所，增加巡尉数量，夜归攘外，巡尉安内。
不出三年，边防城墙焕然一新，新型武器横空出世，残象潮败退至百里之外，城中政通人和，物埠民丰。

人们逐渐发现，所谓“岁主与愿”，只是少女令尹开的一个善意的玩笑。
毕竟，无论今州境内发生什么事情，令尹都会第一时间赶到现场，亲自了解状况，解决民众们的难题。
毕竟，边庭…

datamine:InfoDisplay_72010105_Text.title: Route Constructor Operation Manual
datamine:InfoDisplay_72010105_Text.text:
[…]

After refining native Lahai-Roi stone, the Spacetrek Collective produces a high-density construction medium.

[…]

After the arrival of the Exostrider, mechanical patterns and structures started to grow on it under the influence.

[…]

Step 5: Ensure the construction area is fully cleared of any personnel, animals, or Exoswarm units.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_72010105_Text.zh:
"造路悬仪需要严格按照以下步骤开启，请操作人员注意。
 第一步，放入所需数量的超缩基岩。
 备注：超缩基岩是经过加工的自然产物，深空联合将拉海洛原生的山石处理后，制造出的建筑材料，密度极高，但通过造路悬仪解析、分离后，能结合其它资源，制造出各类建筑需要的基板。
 第二步，放入所需数量的械晶石。
 备注：械晶石是拉海洛原生的矿石，在隧者到来后，受其影响出现了机械纹理并附着了机械结构，深空联合采集并发现使用这类矿石制作的电子设备在算力上会有提升，就好像械晶石本身便具有运算能力。
 第三步，放入所需数量的悬仪芯源。
 备注：悬仪芯源是人工制品，由于造路悬仪消耗的能源巨大、经常布设于荒野、且多数时候只需启动一次，不需要也难以建设稳定的能源输送线路。深空联合为此研发了悬仪芯源，通过引日透镜将炉光转化为能源后充入其中，成为便携且可重复使用的‘电池’。
 第四步，检查建造蓝图。
 备注：通常设置造路悬仪时就已输入蓝图，只需检查即可。
 第五步，确认建造区域已清理完毕，没有人员、动物、隧群等。
 第六步，启动造路悬仪。"

datamine:InfoDisplay_72010108_Text.title: Who Are the "Outcasts" (Excerpt)
datamine:InfoDisplay_72010108_Text.text:
[…]

Alienated by their tribes, openly rejecting tradition, or lured by an insatiable curiosity for a world they had never seen, a group of Roya set out on a path separate from their people.

They began trading in Exostrider cell remnants and Exoswarm materials to fulfill their own desires.

[…]

But they did not see this as a punishment, but a liberation, a chance to embrace their true natures.

They spread across Lahai-Roi, becoming a force of unrestrained chaos.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_72010108_Text.zh:
"或是被部族排挤、或是唾弃传统、或是对从未接触过的新世界充满强烈好奇，一群罗伊人踏上了背离传统的道路，他们出卖「隧者」残骸与「隧群」，用以换取满足自身欲望的一切。
 这样的行为无法被其他人接受，也被深空联合视为危险分子，随即这群人遭受了驱逐，并被称为“流民”。
 但他们不以为意，反而认为这是解放自身天性的机会，在拉海洛大地上成了一股肆无忌惮的混乱势力，他们对罗伊人的传统不仅是摒弃甚至要加以嘲讽，把罗伊人坚守的一切都以相反的形式体现在身上。
 丢弃源于自然的饰物，将「隧群」撕扯破坏，带上它们的头颅作为面具，践踏「牧杖」把它改装成武器。
 那被称为”流民“的他们究竟有何诉求？是为了什么而作乱呢？有传言说他们认为自己代表了罗伊人全新的、且正确的一派，希望作为正统的罗伊人成为新世界的一员。
 但传言毕竟是传言，他们还未展现统一的思想，也不为任何诉求发声，只是沉浸于接触新事物和掠夺「隧群」的刺激中。"

yakita:Term700011_Desc.text:
A colossal vertical transport system built along the Exostrider's greatsword, connecting Lahai-Roi and the Roya Frostlands.
Its structure resembles a spine piercing both heaven and earth. Powered by orbital-acceleration technology, it connects the deep cavern to the surface and serves as Lahai-Roi's most important transportation hubs.
yakita:Term700011_Desc.zh:
依托巨剑结构建造、连接拉海洛与罗伊冰原的大型升降运输系统。
其外观呈贯穿地空的脊柱形态，基于轨道推进加速技术实现高速运输，其联通地底与地表冰原，是拉海洛地区的核心交通枢纽。

yakita:Term750037_Desc.text: A phenomenon unique to the surface of the Roya Frostlands. Scholars theorize that this anomaly emerged when the Threnodian's power there attempted to devour the Exostrider, triggering abnormal Voidmatter transformations. Affected objects enter a state of unstable "existence," becoming impossible to observe directly.
yakita:Term750037_Desc.zh: 一种在罗伊冰原上层出现的特殊现象。推测其形成原因为该区域的鸣式力量尝试吞噬隧者时，虚质发生了特殊变化，被其影响的事物将处于“存在”不稳定的无法观测的状态。

yakita:AreaReportContent_Text62.text:
[…]

The Exoswarm are mimetic mechs, fragmented from the Exostrider's own mecha form.

[…]

For centuries unbroken, the Roya have guided the Exoswarm up from the depths to the frostlands, toward the site of the Exostrider's slumber.

Before the Starward Riseway was constructed, the Roya had no choice but to climb treacherous cliffs of impossible heights, where overhanging slopes greater than ninety degrees were not uncommon.

[…]

Royan mythology is woven with cycles of the old giving way to the new, and it is through this lens that they interpret both themselves and the world around them.

[…]
yakita:AreaReportContent_Text62.zh:
……

隧群是隧者躯体碎片分化而成的拟态机械，是修复和重构隧者的必备因素。
为了帮助隧者，罗伊族千百年如一日地引导着隧群攀上冰原，向着隧者的沉眠地进发。

在联运椎骨建成前，罗伊族必须在高不可攀的陡峭崖壁上跋涉。
冰原外沿的悬崖锐利险峻，有时还会形成大于九十度的不可能倒角——这条险途被罗伊人称为“天梯”。

在终于攀上冰原后，格洛犸图与格洛犸提便会映入罗伊人的眼帘。
这种强大的隧群会护送罗伊人，并与其他隧群一起回归隧者的躯体。

在罗伊族的神话中充满了新旧交替的概念，而他们也以此来诠释自己以及周身的万物：
亘古以前，格洛犸图的祖先，巨大的象族动物在这片原野上肆意奔腾，将族群的生命延续。
而如今，隧群踏破冰雪，将被给予的生命交还给自己的创造者。

……

yakita:AreaReportContent_Text76.text:
[…]

Seeing my stunned expression, the captain explained, "The Polar Collective's construction work is highly classified, so I can't take you to Lahai-Roi.

[…]

Even so, their kindness came through unmistakably.

They told me they were shepherds who herd the Exoswarm.

[…]

Together, they would journey toward the Exostrider.

In the end, all Exoswarm returned to the colossal Exostrider, which was said to slumber at the edge of the frostlands, the origin from which the Exoswarm were born.

[…]
yakita:AreaReportContent_Text76.zh:
……
在返航的前一天下午，队长找到了我，说想带我去一个地方。
这天是我第一次，也是最后一次穿上防护服，我和其他科考人员一起乘上了破冰者号科考艇。
经过了数十分钟的颠簸后，我忍着呕吐感，颤颤巍巍地走下了载具。
那是我毕生难忘的一天——在一座白色、蓝色与紫色交织的建筑里，坐着几位身着异域服饰的人，在他们的身旁，一头机械的白色巨熊正在打瞌睡。
我一脸震惊地望向队长，她告诉我说：“「极地联合」在进行保密性建设，我没法让你到拉海洛去，但我可以带你认识一下这里的原住民‘罗伊族’。他们主要生活在地下，但在冰原上也有少量营地。”
我记得那天的每一个细节，我们待了一整个下午，却感觉十分短暂。
我听不懂他们说话，必须经过熟知他们语言的队长转述才能与他们交流，即便如此，我也能感受到他们十分友善。
他们介绍自己是负责引导隧群的牧者，每隔一段时间都会引导地下的隧群来到冰原，与格洛犸图还有格洛马提等冰原上的大型隧群会合，并一起向着隧者跋涉。
最终，这些隧群会回归隧者——祂是沉眠在冰原尽头的巨大机械，据说一切隧群都来自于祂。
在屋中，他们与我分享了一种团状的烤蔬菜，以及一种香味独特的腌制鱼肉料理。
在离开前我们合了影，我当场影印出来赠送给了他们，而他们则赠与了我一个奇异的海螺——那上面有多得数不清的空格，以一种螺旋状的纹路规则排列。根据队长的说法，这是他们用于计算的工具。
……
当冰崖逐渐消失在地平线上时，我关上了舷窗。
海浪敲打着船底，传来有节奏的“铛——铛”声，我静静听着，感到睡意渐浓。
在梦中，我又见到了那几位罗伊族，他们伴着窗外冰原的风雪，为我奏响了告别的歌谣——
“踏上前路，踏上前路
如此宁静，在安详的夜里
我正踏上前路

并不遥远，就在脚下
迎着敞开的门
向黄昏，向远方
将尘事完结，将忧虑尽卸
无需再恐惧彷徨

父母正翘首以盼
旧友亦齐聚一堂
那些熟悉的面庞
那些熟悉的面庞”

yakita:AreaReportContent_Text82.text:
[…]

As the Pioneer Association set foot in Lahai-Roi, the land long sealed from the outside world encountered the so-called civilized world for the first time.

[…]

A small group, however, found their curiosity toward the world beyond ice outweighed the disciplines of their people.

They attempted to barter fragments of the Exostrider and the Exoswarm, treating these relics as an "entrance ticket" into the civilized world.

[…]

As exploration of the Roya Frostlands advanced, excavation of the Upphaf Forest Ruins yielded significant breakthroughs, leading to the construction of the Upphaf Life Chamber.

[…]

Gathering near the Upphaf Forest Ruins, they sought traces of an ancient homeland, hoping to reclaim a sense of origin and to find a place of belonging for a people long without roots.
yakita:AreaReportContent_Text82.zh:
……
随着先行公约的踏足，与世隔绝的拉海洛得以初次与文明世界相遇。而此时罗伊族人内部出现了两种截然不同的态度。
大部分罗伊族人对外界的事物不为所动，他们坚持着自身的使命与文化传统，坚持着族中一直以来的生活方式。
但也有少部分人，他们对于外部世界的好奇心压过了对于族中的规训——他们试图出卖隧者与隧群的残骸，以此作为进入文明世界的“入场券”。这些人被认定为忘却与唾弃了使命的罗伊族，他们被族人驱逐，被称作为“流民”。
在进入拉海洛的调查团野蛮生长的时期，这些“流民”曾自诩为族人中的“开化者”，认为自己才是与文明世界接轨的人。
但是，随着「极地联合」建立，以及罗伊族人自身也坐上谈判桌成为了影响拉海洛局势的一环，这些“流民”最终成为了不被任何一方所承认的游荡势力。
……
随着罗伊冰原的探索工作推进，元林遗址的挖掘行动获得了突出进展，元林再生舱得以建立——它为人们描摹出了远古时期广袤的元林的图景。
这一发现为背弃族群的流民们提供了新的方向——他们来到元林遗址附近，期望找到远古时期的家园，为没有根基的流民群体找到新的归宿。

yakita:BYCZ_46_3.speakerZh: 正在为新生讲解的老师
yakita:BYCZ_46_3.text: Ground was broken for the Polar Research Station, and next, the foundation was laid for the great freight elevator built into the Exostrider's greatsword itself— the Starward Riseway.
yakita:BYCZ_46_3.zh: 冰原上的极地科考站破土而出，而依托隧者巨剑建造的巨型垂直运载电梯「联运椎骨」也随之奠基。
yakita:BYCZ_46_3.speaker: Freshmen Instructor

yakita:BYSTMP_8_1.text: So the Starward Riseway was built alongside the Exostrider's greatsword—wait, no one told me the hilt alone was this huge!
yakita:BYSTMP_8_1.zh: 联运椎骨依托隧者之剑建造——光剑柄就这么大！

yakita:LoadingTipsText_201101_TipsText.text: Named after the colossal Exostrider greatsword that holds up the underground dome, its dark waters feel like a gateway to another world. As one of the few regions shielded from Void Storms, it became the foundation for the Spacetrek Collective's Starward Riseway, a lift that scales the greatsword's spine to link this subterranean oasis with the Roya Frostlands.
yakita:LoadingTipsText_201101_TipsText.zh: 因湖中托起地底穹顶的隧者兵装巨剑而得名，湖水幽暗，仿佛通往异世的门扉。作为少数能规避虚质磁暴的安全区，深空联合凭依剑脊建起，建造了贯通地底绿洲与罗伊冰原的运输动脉「联运椎骨」。

yakita:LoadingTipsText_201205_TipsText.text:
Formally known as the Spacetrek Collective: Frostlands Polar Research Outpost, this facility is a joint project between the Spacetrek Collective and the Roya people. Built around the Exostrider's greatsword embedded in the ice, it serves as a vital logistics hub.
Here, researchers work to salvage pre-Lament data from fallen satellites and space stations, run non-invasive diagnostics on the Exostrider to monitor its restoration, and survey the ecosystem to revive the long-frozen flora and fauna of the ancient world.
yakita:LoadingTipsText_201205_TipsText.zh: 全称「深空联合：极地科考站」，是深空联合与罗伊人协作，围绕冰原地表的隧者巨剑建造的科考工程，同时也是重要的物资集散枢纽。其主要科考项目包括搜索卫星及空间站残骸，回收悲鸣前观测数据；监测隧者修复状态，对机体进行非破坏性探测与试验，收集原始数据并采样；进行生物多样性勘测，复苏被封冻的动植物等。

yakita:MapMark_3340004_MarkDesc.text: The Voidbane Eldertree in Solisia Landing is severely contaminated by Voidmatter. Fortunately, Exostrider components scattered across the area can be used to help restore it.
yakita:MapMark_3340004_MarkDesc.zh: 位于落日堤屿样方内的虚蚀古代乔木。区域内虚质侵蚀严重，好在遗留有大量隧者元件，可用于生态修复工程。

datamine:InfoDisplay_102189702_Text.title: Discarded Log II
datamine:InfoDisplay_102189702_Text.text:
[…]

I haven't encountered the Void Storm yet, but I've learned much from the Royan archives.

[…]

Why is it that whenever I relax, I am reminded of the Roya tribe members from when I first arrived?

I watched them live alongside the Exoswarm, toiling with simple tools.

[…]

No one dwelled on the day's troubles.

They simply planned for tomorrow, then sang a song with a strange, simple, repetitive melody, as if speaking to Lahai-Roi.

[…]

We, in our "advanced" civilization, seek to master nature through technology, to eliminate all uncertainty and pain.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_102189702_Text.zh:
时间对我来说已经不重要了，毕竟它对我来说只意味着生命的倒计时了。
这段时间虽然没有遭遇虚质磁暴，但从罗伊人那里也了解了不少他们典籍中关于虚质磁暴的信息。据他们的记载，也有部分人从虚质磁暴中幸存下来，究竟是什么原因才会导致这种现象出现？在那之中，存在是否会被消解的界限又在哪里？
呼……高烧看样子还没有退，今天就先放下沉重的思考吧……
为什么……放松下来就会想起我刚来这里的时候，以及在这里遇见的罗伊族人……
我目睹了他们与隧群为伴，努力生活；我看着他们利用简单的工具，甚至是肉眼观察星空与异象，踏踏实实地一步步计算并总结规律。
夜晚，他们围坐在篝火旁。没有人为今天遭遇的麻烦烦恼，他们只是在规划明天应该做的事情，然后唱着一种调子很奇怪的歌，旋律简单，不断重复，像是在对拉海洛诉说，又像是在给自己打气。
我看着火焰映在他们布满皱纹或稚气的脸上，一种巨大的迷惑击中了我。
我们——我所在的“先进”文明——追求的是用科技征服自然，消除一切不确定性与痛苦。当技术停滞，我们便陷入绝望，甚至不惜背叛道德去寻求突破。我们认为，人类的尊严在于“征服”。
而他们，如此“渺小”，一场风暴也许就能轻易夺走他们辛苦积累的一切。但他们不绝望。他们的尊严，从不在于“征服”，而是沉默地、一次又一次地，用双脚重新丈量被毁坏的大地，弯下腰，从头开始。
我曾经鄙视这种“低效”的挣扎，认为这是文明未开化的标志。但现在，我心中涌起的，竟是一种陌生的……尊敬。
这种矛盾撕扯着我。我毕生追求的“纯粹科学”，如果最终导向的是我之前的背叛与虚无，那么它“纯粹”在何处？而这些部落民，他们最初甚至没有“科学”这个概念，但他们的生存本身，却印证了某种更根本的“纯粹”——无论被打倒多少次，都要挣扎着活下去的意志。
我这个高高在上的教授，在此刻显得如此可笑且渺小。我因理想的“不纯粹”而绝望自杀，而他们，却在用沾满泥土的双手去生存斗争，诠释着生命本身最强大的纯粹。
帐篷外的雨声越来越大了，像极了他们的歌……等烧退了，就离开这里吧，我得离虚质磁暴再近点，再了解它多一点，虽然老伙计已经坏掉帮不上忙了，但我还有一样东西可以记录下这一切。我记得前面…

datamine:InfoDisplay_30010011_Text.zh:
星炬学院交通安全管理条例

第一条 为维护拉海洛交通秩序，预防和减少事故，保障师生生命与科研资产安全，星炬学院内所有公共交通参与者均应遵守本条例。
第二条 学院应配合建立并健全道路交通安全工作协调机制，组织各学部、社团对校区建设及科研项目进行交通影响评价，制定安全管理规划与实施方案。
第三条 院内人员在申领载具前需出示相关驾驶凭证，并熟读记忆本条例，于三周内通过本条例的线上考核。
第四条 驾驶载具不得有下列行为：
（一） 拨打接听手持终端，进行论文赶工或观看线上课程等妨碍安全驾驶的行为；
（二） 下陡坡时熄火或空档滑行；
（三） 未经批准擅自进入虚质磁暴影响范围；
（四） 将载具停泊于教学楼前；
（五） 在开放式车斗内冲泡或食用杯面；
（六） 利用引擎余热进行食物加热；
（七） 在驾驶过程中投喂或挑衅野外隧群。
第五条 在道路上驾驶载具应遵守下列规定：
（一） 在学院内驾驶载具需遵循限速原则，时速不得超过10公里/小时。违者将暂扣载具，并需于每日课后参加为期七天的交通安全教育宣讲；
（二） 不得驾驶载具使用索道、滑轨等固定机关路径；
（三） 不得在连续工作/学习超过16小时后驾驶载具；日间连续驾驶不得超过4小时，夜间连续驾驶不得超过2小时；
（四） 驾驶科研摩托类型载具需佩戴头盔；
（五） 不得使用未经驯服或处于研究阶段的隧群进行任何形式的拖曳、牵引或并驾齐驱；
（六） 不得为追求“更优空气动力学”而擅自拆除载具车门、顶盖等安全结构；
（七） 不得在驾驶时进行冥想、共感训练等可能丧失物理感知的行为；
（八） 不得在明知载具处于能源核心过载状态时，仅张贴“危险勿近”纸条了事，须立即上报并疏散周边人员。

……

违反本条例规定，将视情节轻重，处以警告、暂扣载具、取消驾驶资格、取消实验配额与经费，或安排参与“路段清扫义工”等处罚，情节严重者将依照相关规定给予处分。

S.I.G.M.A.提醒：请注意，所有违章行为均会被记录为负面案例并与学院内公示，切勿顶风作案，文明出行，从你我做起。

datamine:InfoDisplay_72010104_Text.zh:
"拉海洛广袤的大地和无处不在的秘密让深空联合必须开始中长期野外科考的计划，但是想要在危险重重的野外进行长时间科研，就必须要有可靠的据点。
 权衡过后，深空联合决定开发的兼顾运输、储存与应急防卫功能的运输装置，探隧重机。
 探隧重机设计原型为轮腿机器人，身体两侧的巨型轮胎抓地力极强，在外墙光滑的建筑物上能直接顺着墙壁快速移动，即便在建筑林立的星炬学院内，也能将货物运往各处。
 而搭载于机身顶部的大型仓储箱也为野外考察提供便利，能在室外快捷地存取资源或其他辅助机械设备。
 同时为了对抗受海蚀影响的「隧群」或是“流民”的威胁，探隧重机也装备了一门巨型电磁炮和能够提供保护的护盾投射器。但由于探隧重机本身重量大，装载货物多，且为了节省能源，只装备了小型推进器，在必要的时刻提供加速，并不具备长时间飞行的功能。
 除了应对野外考察任务，探隧重机当下也是拉海洛重型物流的主力之一，只不过专注于物流时会拆掉武器，在机身加装能放置更多货物的储存箱。"

yakita:InfoDisplay_102181706_Text.zh:
一 饮食
为了您的安全着想，严禁在列车运行时进食或者饮用饮品。
受到灾害或隧群活动的影响，列车在运行时随时有可能进行紧急制动，违反规定饮食可能会导致食物呛入肺部，或被食品包装划伤。
在联运椎骨的垂直运输段饮食危险程度更高，列车在加速时可能会产生较强的加速度，此时饮食会造成更为严重的健康问题。

二 携带宠物/仿生机械/隧群
为了列车的安全和秩序管理，宠物和仿生机械均需要办理托运。
请将活体宠物置于坚固的宠物笼中，仿生机械关闭后放入保管箱中进行托运。严禁携带它们进入客运车厢。
隧群应在有牧者照管或陪同的情况下搭乘专用车厢，隧群应提前进行适应性训练，以免因列车突然加速而产生恐慌，影响乘车安全。
如需借用宠物笼或保管箱，请前往装卸区进行办理。

三 尝试在列车垂直加速/下降时跳跃
没错，这是个荒谬的规则。但再荒谬的规则背后都有更荒谬的现实原因。
曾经有一个流言称，在列车垂直加速/下降时人是无法跳起来的。这是个简单的力学原理……但之前曾有学生不相信这个。他们自制了外骨骼装具，偷偷带上列车，试图挑战客观规律。幸好被工作人员及时制止，否则预计不仅仅是他们会受伤，列车也会受到严重破坏。
请在列车运行期间坐在座位上，并系好安全带。不要进行任何危险行为。

[…]

It wasn't until midnight that the oceangoing vessel finally crossed the Void Storm Monitoring Zone and drew close to the Roya Frostlands.

[…]

Thanks to the Pioneer Association's advance notice to the researchers perhaps, I was able to move through most of the station without obstruction, aside from a handful of restricted areas.

From what I could tell, Phase One of the Polar Collective's construction, namely the Frostlands Transit Port, had already been fully completed.

yakita:AreaReportContent_Text75.zh:
……
直到午夜时，远航船才穿过磁暴检测区，到达了罗伊冰原附近。
从舷窗向外望，隔着海雾，我看到了山脉般高耸的冰崖，它们如无际的白色城墙般向两侧绵延。
我睁大双眼，看着那冰崖逐渐向我压近，感到呼吸越来越急促，昔日只存在于秘密报道中的罗伊冰原，诸国联合共建的「极地联合」——我终于要亲眼目睹这一切了。
船只系泊的广播响起，伴随着缆绞机拉紧缆绳的低沉声响，我们抵达了罗伊不冻港。
经过十数项严格的审查后，我和前来接应我的科考队会合，一起离开港口，坐上了前往冰原腹地的运载电梯。
这座电梯的规模十分巨大，单次运送的物资便能支持一座小型营地半年的科考工作。
但是当其启动后过了不过两分钟，我的感受便完全变了——这座巨大的电梯在冰崖上爬升时，就像蚂蚁在攀登一座山峰。
……
在科考队的带领下，我顺利到达了极地科考站。
在登记后，队长把我叫到了物资仓，带我领取了在冰原上活下去所需的一切东西。
随后，我被分配了一个房间，在访问期内，这个小屋将成为我每天入眠和醒来的地方。
我把随身的行李留在了房间里，然后便开始观察科考站内的各个设施。也许是先约那边提前通知过研究员们，除少部分禁止通行的区域外，我可以毫无阻碍地前往大部分地方。
根据我的观察，「极地联合」的一期工程，即我所在的冰原运输港此时已完全建成。据研究人员的说法，当地的罗伊族以及其引导的隧群也在建设工作中提供了极大的帮助。
但当我询问二期工程的规划时，营地内的人员并未给我答复。
大部分人忙于自己手头的研究和建设任务——虽然他们并未直接这么说，但当我问东问西时，他们的眼神告诉我：我没空管来自先约的“游客”。
……
经过我的计算，前三天一共有九十二辆重载型运输车抵达科考站，而它们所携带的物资中，只有极少数被运往了冰原其他区域，其余全部经轻轨输往了地下。
我推测，「极地联合」二期工程的重心并非位于罗伊冰原，而是在地下，在经由「联运椎骨」才能抵达的拉海洛地区。
……
第六天，我如往常一般从极地科考站中醒来，到用餐区吃过早饭后，再次找到了科考队的队长，第三次向他递交了拉海洛的访问申请。
不出意料，她再次拒绝了我的请求。
虽然感到十分遗憾，但我能够理解。
…

yakita:MapMark_3340001_MarkDesc.text: The Voidbane Eldertree in the Silent Crag is surrounded by rampaging Exoswarm. Surveying here won't be easy.
yakita:MapMark_3340001_MarkDesc.zh: 位于寂静断崖样方内的虚蚀古代乔木。附近活跃着为数不少的失控隧群，勘探难度因此上升。

yakita:ItemInfo_71260001_BgDescription.text: Incomplete sheet music, part of the core melody regulating the Fabricatorium of the Deep.
yakita:ItemInfo_71260001_BgDescription.zh: 一段不完整的乐谱,是控制隐海试验场正常运转的核心乐曲的一部分。

yakita:LHLZTC_1_8.text: In search of the Threnodian's Gem, you came to the Fabricatorium of the Deep. Along the way, you learned of the promise you once made to Phrolova, and the knot it had become in her heart. In the end Fenrico met his end, the Gem fell back into the Fractsidus's hands, and Phrolova sank into the deep, vanishing without a trace.
yakita:LHLZTC_1_8.zh: 为了寻找鸣式宝石，你来到了隐海修会的海底试验场，过程中，你得知了弗洛洛与你曾经的约定和如今的心结。最终芬莱克身死，鸣式宝石也被残星会回收，而弗洛洛沉入深海，不见踪影。

yakita:LoadingTipsText_200702_TipsText.text:
The core area in the Fabricatorium of the Deep for developing Common Echoes. Endless arrays of Echo Brooders line the space, cradling Echoes awaiting rebirth.
As the foundation of the Common Echo system, this site commands heavy investment of security and research resources by the Order.
yakita:LoadingTipsText_200702_TipsText.zh:
隐海试验场中培育、生产公共声骸的核心区域。大量培育舱聚集在此，孵育着还未新生的声骸。
作为公共声骸系统的基石，修会在这里投入了大量的守备力量与研究人员。

yakita:LoadingTipsText_200705_TipsText.text:
The central tower of the Fabricatorium of the Deep, where the Lost Beyond is created.
As the control hub of the entire Fabricatorium, the tower regulates the activities in all other areas within the facility. Deep in the tower keeps the lantern of the first Primus, the first gift bestowed upon the Order by Sentinel Imperator.
yakita:LoadingTipsText_200705_TipsText.zh:
隐海试验场的中心高塔，也是失亡彼岸建立、诞生的地方。
作为整个试验场的控制中枢，调律着试验场的各个区域。而在塔的更深处，则存放着初代主座的提灯，那也是岁主英白拉多给予隐海修会的第一份礼物。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_14_1.text: (Fabricatorium of the Deep... It belongs to the Order.)
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_14_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_167_27.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_主塔_1_13
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_167_27.text: In his last moments of consciousness, Fenrico reminds you that the Threnodian's residual energy isn't the real problem. Rinascita's woes lie in the "Journeying Paradise." He hopes you can prevent this impending calamity and save Rinascita. With this new information, you cease your search for the Threnodian's residual energy and instead plan to return to Septimont for further investigation. As you take one last look at the Fabricatorium of the Deep, wondering what to do with it, a Lycoris suddenly catches your eye.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_167_27.zh: 芬莱克用虚弱的意识最后提醒你，鸣式残力不是最重要的，黎那汐塔真正的灾难源泉在「巡游天国」之中，他希望你能阻止这场灾难降临，拯救黎那汐塔。你得到了新的线索后，不再强追鸣式残力，而是打算下一步回七丘继续探查。你最后看向这座海底的试验场，正在思索该如何处理这里时，突然看到了残留在此的彼岸花。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_170_6.text: (Tell her about the Fabricatorium of the Deep.)

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_74_20.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_能源场上层_1_9
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_74_20.text: You discover a piece of sheet music. Phrolova explains that this music is the core of the Fabricatorium of the Deep. The area can only be restored by returning it to the Orchestration Altar and fixing the melodies. When you speculate she composed it, she admits it was part of her collaboration with Fenrico. You both then agree to bring the sheet music back to the Altar.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_74_20.zh: 你们发现了遗落的曲谱，弗洛洛告诉你，乐曲是控制隐海试验场正常运转的核心，只有将它放回调律台将旋律调整回去，区域内才能恢复正常。你猜测这曲子是她创作的，她承认这是她与芬莱克合作的一部分后，你们打算将乐谱拿到调律台前将乐曲复原。

yakita:MapMark_3033_MarkDesc.text: A Supply Station set up for Acolytes living in the Fabricatorium of the Deep. Butler, the store's Steward, is running low on Sacred Salt, and he's willing to trade.
yakita:MapMark_3033_MarkDesc.zh: 为照顾生活于隐海试验场中的教士们而设立的物资站，由「服事人」巴德勒管理，他因缺少潮汐圣盐，愿意与你以物易物。

yakita:lmzx_1_12.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_1_1
yakita:lmzx_1_12.text: A name suddenly flashes through your mind: Lenore. Did she go to the Fabricatorium? Could her name be on the list?
yakita:lmzx_1_12.zh: 一个名字出现在你的脑海里，伊诺尔，她最后前往隐海试验场了吗？她会不会也在这份名单中？

yakita:lmzx_22_3.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_4_3
yakita:lmzx_22_3.text: Hello everyone, my name is Lenore, from the Minor Forbidden Archive of the Order of the Deep. Oh, sorry, now I belong to the Fabricatorium of the Deep… Wait, that's not right either...
yakita:lmzx_22_3.zh: 大家好，我叫伊诺尔，是隐海修会小禁书院……啊不是，我现在是隐海试验……也不对……
yakita:lmzx_22_3.speaker: Lenore

yakita:phone_JL_11_1.text: I've already submitted a full report on everything that happened at the Fabricatorium of the Deep.
yakita:phone_JL_11_1.zh: 隐海试验场的事，我已经悉数上报了。

yakita:ItemInfo_72010022_BgDescription.text: Torn pages found in the Fagaceae Peninsula. Collect them all and deliver them to Fuling.
yakita:ItemInfo_72010022_BgDescription.zh: 于槲生半岛拾到的散佚书页。集齐后，可以交给伏翎。

yakita:Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_13.chapter: 剧情_2_0_引导任务_巡礼之梦_2_1
yakita:Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_13.text: However, in the Fagaceae Peninsula and the Penitent's End, the Dreamscape Nodes appear to be veiled by an unknown force.
yakita:Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_13.zh: 不过在槲生半岛和悲叹墓岛，梦境网络的节点似乎都被某种莫名的力量遮蔽了。

yakita:Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_15.chapter: 剧情_2_0_引导任务_巡礼之梦_2_1
yakita:Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_15.text: It's truly a headache, meow. Penitent's End is completely shrouded in a thick, eerie fog, and some of the nodes in Thessaleo Fells are shielded by a strange energy.
yakita:Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_15.zh: 真是头疼喵，墓岛目前全域都被某种幽邃的雾气所笼罩，而槲生半岛的部分节点则被一些特殊力量覆盖了。

yakita:MapMark_133005_MarkDesc.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Fagaceae Peninsula area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"Let me fall in the storm. May the glory of the Sentinel endure forever."
yakita:MapMark_133005_MarkDesc.zh: 槲生半岛地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “请让我于风暴中死去，惟愿我主荣光长存。”

yakita:MapMark_133006_MarkDesc.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Fagaceae Peninsula area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"Please, don't look at me like that."
yakita:MapMark_133006_MarkDesc.zh: 槲生半岛地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “请不要用那样的眼神看着我。”

yakita:MapMark_133007_MarkDesc.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Fagaceae Peninsula area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"What?! The fire ring is meant for the audience?!"
yakita:MapMark_133007_MarkDesc.zh: 槲生半岛地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “什么？你们这里的火圈居然要观众亲自来钻！”

yakita:MapMark_133008_MarkDesc.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Fagaceae Peninsula area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"Decades from now, I believe Rinascita will thrive as a nation of freedom and unity. Don't you think so?"
yakita:MapMark_133008_MarkDesc.zh: 槲生半岛地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “几十年后的黎那汐塔，应该会是个自由而团结的美丽国度吧？”

yakita:POI_LGNJR_8_1.text: Here we are! You can now see the outline of Oakheart Highcourt, nestled deep within the Fagaceae Peninsula.
yakita:POI_LGNJR_8_1.zh: 我们到了，漂泊者，现在我们已经能够看到槲生半岛深处的青栎庭院的轮廓了。
yakita:POI_LGNJR_8_1.speaker: Phoebe

yakita:STNPC_JZST_26_4.text: There's too much cargo, so Fangzhou uses his Resonance ability for inspections... Don't worry, they're 100% accurate.
yakita:STNPC_JZST_26_4.zh: 货物太多，方周用了共鸣能力在核查……放心吧，保证准确。

yakita:Daily_JYQSZM_15_7.text: People would see that knights who uphold justice and righteousness are still active, in Whisperwind Haven and even in other places in Rinascita, not lost to time.
yakita:Daily_JYQSZM_15_7.zh: 人们会知道，践行正义与公正的骑士并未消失，他们仍然活跃在拂风水畔，乃至黎那汐塔的其他地方……
yakita:Daily_JYQSZM_15_7.speaker: Faro

yakita:Daily_JYQSZM_3_8.text: But think of the knight who ventured deep into Whisperwind Haven and faced the Giant alone. He must have encountered something far worse.
yakita:Daily_JYQSZM_3_8.zh: 但传闻中在水畔深处直面巨人的那位骑士，面临的肯定是更艰难的境况吧……
yakita:Daily_JYQSZM_3_8.speaker: Faro

yakita:ST_LL_1_20.text: Unlike Rinascita, the Federated Cities hold no faith in any Order. My mother gave me this dress on the day I became a perfumer.
yakita:ST_LL_1_20.zh: 其实联邦城并不像黎那汐塔，存在修会信仰，这条裙子是母亲在我正式成为调香师那天，送给我的礼物。
yakita:ST_LL_1_20.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_50_6.text: Maybe this so-called girl from the Federated Cities doesn't even exist.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_50_6.zh: 其实根本没有什么联邦城少女。

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_57_1.text:
[…]

The orator's voice echoed through the hall, a dry spark setting a silent room ablaze.

He kept saying that war was the Federated Cities' greatest instrument of change.

[…]

I mistook those complicated emotions for excitement and wrote my name on the enlistment form.

[…]

During the first artillery barrage, I cowered in a shell crater like a dog caught in the rain.

[…]

Two things fell from his pocket: a little sketchbook and a photograph of a woman and a child.

[…]

I wanted to return to that hall, find that young man named Grimm, and tear up his enlistment form.

[…]
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_57_1.zh:
致正在看这封信的人：
谢谢你找到了这封信，请原谅我的不礼貌，我不知道该如何称呼你。因为你或许是我认识的人，又或许我们未曾谋面。我不知我为什么要写下这封信，是因为知道自己快死了吗？还是，我想要忏悔呢……我不知道……
我记得那是秋天，联邦城演说家的声音在大厅里回响，像一把干燥的火，把本该鸦雀无声的大厅点着了。他重复着说战斗是联邦城推动变革最有力的武器，说我们这一代人太干净、太柔软，需要鲜血来熔铸。
那时的我，因为音乐家的身份，一直相信美是柔和的、有秩序的东西。可演说家的话语打碎了我对美的认知。一时间，我理不清内心的情绪，我把这种复杂的情绪误当做了兴奋，在报名表上填上了自己的名字。我把这个消息告诉给了家人，告诉给了朋友们，母亲狠狠地打了我一巴掌，流着眼泪说：“你的双手是用来弹奏钢琴的，不是用来端枪伤害他人的！”那时的我已经完全被兴奋冲昏了头脑，觉得母亲的话语正是演说家所说的软弱。
后来，我参军了，作为医疗兵。我们唱着歌上了一辆列车，姑娘们朝我们扔花。列车开动的时候，我真觉得自己是一首宏大的叙事乐曲，正要去创造一首伟大的旋律。
可惜……前线不是我想象中的样子。
第一次炮击时，我躲在弹坑里，像一只被打湿的狗。前线没有演说家所说的力量的美，只有恐惧，只有寒冷，只有靴子陷在泥里拔不出来的烦躁。
第一次开枪，我已经不记得具体的时间和地点了，但我记得我的第一个敌人，在我抢救战士时，他朝我扑了过来，我本能地拔出了腰间的配枪。后来，世界在枪响后就仿佛安静下来了。
我翻开他的手，从口袋里掉出两样东西：一本小小的速写本，一张女人和孩子的照片。
我打开速写本。里面画着田野，乡村的小屋，看不到尽头的河流，还有一张画得很认真的自画像。他和我一样，他的双手也是艺术家的双手。
那一刻，我突然觉得身体里有什么东西被抽走了，我想要回到那座大厅，走上讲台把演说家的嘴堵上。我想要回到那座大厅，叫住那个叫格姆的年轻人，撕掉他的报名表。我想要回到从前的联邦城，普通人和共鸣者坐在同一片树下，你画着画，我弹着钢琴，而不是在废墟里互相瞄准对方的心脏……
可一切都不会回到从前了，就算战争结束了，也不可能回到从前了，没有人会原…

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_60_1.text:
Since March 21, the government forces of the Federated Cities and the Resonator army have been locked in battle across this city for three months. The once-celebrated "City of Progress" has been torn apart by relentless artillery fire. 

Our reporters traveled along the highway toward the front. Everywhere they looked, ammunition crates, stretchers, and wrecked vehicles lined the roadside. Photography was strictly forbidden. All they could leave behind was this written account:

We saw... shell craters riddling the streets. Soldiers huddled in muddy trenches. Men and women pushed to the brink of mental collapse by exhaustion and fear. Medics moved through the smoke, braving incoming fire to carry the wounded away from the front. Farther ahead, we found ourselves at a loss for words. Behind us, artillery rumbled like distant thunder. It was broad daylight, yet the flames had stained the sky a different color, as though we stood at the very threshold of hell.

The road ahead was closed. We took no photographs and conducted no interviews. We simply turned back. And... fortunately, we made it back alive.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_60_1.zh:
自3月21日开始，联邦城政府军与共鸣者军队已在这座城市交战三个月之久。这座曾经的“进步之城”已被持续不断的炮火撕成碎片。记者沿着公路进入前线，所见之处，道路两旁堆满弹药箱、担架与报废的车辆。他们被禁止拍摄照片，只能留下这段文字描述：
我们看见……街道上的弹坑连成一片，士兵蜷缩在泥泞的掩体中，许多人因疲劳和恐惧都出现了精神崩溃的症状。医疗兵在硝烟里穿梭，冒着炮火从前线抬下伤员。再往前走，我们就不知道该如何描述见到的画面了。身后是闷雷般的炮声。明明是白天，可天空仿佛被火焰照成了另一种色彩，如同地狱的门槛。
前面禁止通行了，我们没有拍到照片，也没有完成采访，我们就这样回来了，但……幸运的是，我们回来了。

第一次开枪，我已经不记得具体的时间和地点了，但我记得我的第一个敌人，在我抢救战士时，他朝我扑了过来，我本能地拔出了腰间的配枪。后来，世界在枪响后就仿佛安静下来了。
我翻开他的手，从口袋里掉出两样东西：一本小小的速写本，一张女人和孩子的照片。
我打开速写本。里面画着田野，乡村的小屋，看不到尽头的河流，还有一张画得很认真的自画像。他和我一样，他的双手也是艺术家的双手。
那一刻，我突然觉得身体里有什么东西被抽走了，我想要回到那座大厅，走上讲台把演说家的嘴堵上。我想要回到那座大厅，叫住那个叫格姆的年轻人，撕掉他的报名表。我想要回到从前的联邦城，普通人和共鸣者坐在同一片树下，你画着画，我弹着钢琴，而不是在废墟里互相瞄准对方的心脏……
可一切都不会回到从前了，就算战争结束了，也不可能回到从前了，没有人会原…

yakita:InfoDisplay_38010006_Text.text:
Since March 21, the government forces of the Federated Cities and the Resonator army have been locked in battle across this city for three months. The once-celebrated "City of Progress" has been torn apart by relentless artillery fire. 

Our reporters traveled along the highway toward the front. Everywhere they looked, ammunition crates, stretchers, and wrecked vehicles lined the roadside. Photography was strictly forbidden. All they could leave behind was this written account:

We saw... shell craters riddling the streets. Soldiers huddled in muddy trenches. Men and women pushed to the brink of mental collapse by exhaustion and fear. Medics moved through the smoke, braving incoming fire to carry the wounded away from the front. Farther ahead, we found ourselves at a loss for words. Behind us, artillery rumbled like distant thunder. It was broad daylight, yet the flames had stained the sky a different color, as though we stood at the very threshold of hell.

The road ahead was closed. We took no photographs and conducted no interviews. We simply turned back. And... fortunately, we made it back alive.
yakita:InfoDisplay_38010006_Text.zh:
自3月21日开始，联邦城政府军与共鸣者军队已在这座城市交战三个月之久。这座曾经的“进步之城”已被持续不断的炮火撕成碎片。记者沿着公路进入前线，所见之处，道路两旁堆满弹药箱、担架与报废的车辆。他们被禁止拍摄照片，只能留下这段文字描述：
我们看见……街道上的弹坑连成一片，士兵蜷缩在泥泞的掩体中，许多人因疲劳和恐惧都出现了精神崩溃的症状。医疗兵在硝烟里穿梭，冒着炮火从前线抬下伤员。再往前走，我们就不知道该如何描述见到的画面了。身后是闷雷般的炮声。明明是白天，可天空仿佛被火焰照成了另一种色彩，如同地狱的门槛。
前面禁止通行了，我们没有拍到照片，也没有拿到采访，我们就这样回来了，但……幸运的是，我们回来了。

yakita:Term700033_Desc.text: A specialized ward established during the Federated Cities Resonator War. It treated soldiers suffering from acute stress reactions, combat fatigue, anxiety, depression, and sleep disorders, alongside those who had suffered complete mental breakdowns from shell shock or the loss of loved ones.
yakita:Term700033_Desc.zh: 联邦城共鸣者战争期间，医院开设的特殊治疗科室，收治因战争出现急性应激反应、战斗疲劳、焦虑、抑郁、睡眠障碍等症状，以及因爆炸、丧失亲人，朋友而精神崩溃的患者。

yakita:Term700037_Desc.text: The former name of the New Federation. Today, New Federates commonly refer to it as the Old Federation.
yakita:Term700037_Desc.zh: 联邦城市的旧称，如今的新联邦人通常把联邦城称为旧联邦。

yakita:FavorGoods_151203_Content.text:
Dog tags worn by the Resonator soldiers of the Federated Cities. There was an unwritten pact among them: the last one standing gathers the fallen's tags and carries them forward.
So the weight fell to Lily, and she carried it without a word. She strung each tag onto the cord with care, as if that could keep their souls from scattering too far from home.
"I'll take you home. I promise."
The girl has kept that promise through every one of the long years since.
yakita:FavorGoods_151203_Content.zh:
联邦城共鸣者战士佩戴的身份铭牌。战士们间有个不成文的约定，最后活下来的那个人要带走并保管好所有人的铭牌。
于是，莉莉默默背负起这份沉重的托付。她将每一枚铭牌细细串好，仿佛这样做，他们的灵魂便不会散落他乡。
“我……一定会带你们回家的。”
少女在漫长的时光中恪守着曾经的誓言。

yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1512_Info.chapter: 莉莉档案_共鸣能力鉴定报告
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1512_Info.text:
A young perfumer swept up in the Federated Cities' Resonator War, whose rare Resonance Ability made her a psychotherapist to the soldiers around her.
She could not stop the war. What a gentle girl could do was save whoever stood in front of her, with everything she had.
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1512_Info.zh:
被卷进联邦城共鸣者战争的调香师少女，因特殊的共鸣能力，在战争中成为了一名心理疗愈师。
温柔的少女无法阻止战争，唯一能做的便是拼尽全力拯救眼前的每一个人。

yakita:FavorStory_151204_Content.text:
[…]

Something deep in her mind made the choice for her, because her feet had already set out for the one place her memory still held onto: home, the Federated Cities.

"Fifth Sector.

Miss Lily Grace?" The official at the border turned her papers over and turned them back.

They were a Resonator soldier's identification.

[…]

Only your country isn't here any more.

This is the New Federation now.

[…]

Time in the Somnoire does not keep pace with time in the world.

[…]
yakita:FavorStory_151204_Content.zh:
“现在，你自由了。”
莉莉的耳边仍然回响着那只小猫的声音。
自由？可她究竟还能去哪里？也许是潜意识的作用，莉莉的脚迈向了她记忆中唯一留恋的地方，她的故乡，联邦城。
“第五战区，莉莉·格蕾丝小姐？”入境时，工作人员翻来覆去地查看莉莉的证件，那是一张共鸣者战士的身份证明。工作人员挠挠头，似乎在心底默默斟酌着措辞，等了好久才开口说：“欢迎你回来，莉莉小姐，但你说的国家已经不在了，现在这里叫做新联邦，欢迎你第一次来到新联邦。”
“它已经不在了，那是……什么意思？”
莉莉曾以为这是工作人员的恶作剧，但看着陌生的街道，陌生的大楼，以及周围人对自己奇怪的目光，她明白了……
心之集域与现实世界时间流速不同，她记忆里的联邦城被时间揉碎了。
她想要逃避周围人的目光，想要回家，哪怕家现在只有一丝存在的可能……
抱着这样的信念，她一路上笨拙地询问路人，凭借着破碎的描述，终于找到了家的方向。但走到路口时，莉莉看见自己的家已经变成了一座灯火通明的大厦。大厦楼下有一家餐厅，衣着华丽的男女坐在橱窗边，灯把他们的笑脸照得很亮很亮，她站在窗外，像站在另一个世界。
“你好，小姐，需要用餐吗？”
“我们的小公主回来了，赶紧洗洗手，准备吃饭了。”
餐厅侍者的声音仿佛和记忆中的母亲重合在一起，她记得母亲曾在那扇门后喊她吃饭，声音又尖又长，但在此刻，旧日的声音“砰”地一声碎在了地上。
夜色完全落了下来，莉莉拖着箱子漫无目的地走在街上，她站在灯火的缝隙里，影子被拉得十分扭曲。她终于意识到了，时代和联邦城已经远远地抛下了自己，抛下了战士们，向前走了，没有人记得他们来过。
她慢慢蹲下来，把脸埋进手里，哭了起来。过了很久，她才站起来，拖着箱子继续向前走。她不知道要去哪里，只知道不能停。因为一停下来，她就真的没有地方可去了。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_111_2.text: "We will make them pay! We'll give every drop of blood we have for the future of the Federated Cities!"
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_111_2.zh: “我们必须要让他们付出代价，我们必须为联邦的未来流尽最后一滴血！”

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_118_14.text: The Resonator War has begun in the Federated Cities...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_118_14.zh: 联邦城的共鸣者战争开始了……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_6.text: We will make them pay! We'll give every drop of blood we have for the future of the Federated Cities!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_6.zh: 我们必须要让他们付出代价，我们必须为联邦的未来流尽最后一滴血！
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_6.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_16.text: But I never once left the Federated Cities. My world was so small... just the town where I was born, and the battlefield where I died.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_16.zh: 但我从未离开过联邦城的土地，我的世界很小很小，小到只有出生的城镇和死前的战场。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_16.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_18.text: So why couldn't the Resonators and ordinary people of the Federated Cities...?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_18.zh: 那……联邦城的共鸣者和普通人呢……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_18.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_19.text: The Fifth Sector... Why does that name sound familiar? Ah, yes, I remember. Did you know, Doctor? It holds the highest casualty rate in all the Federated Cities.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_19.zh: 第五战区，好耳熟的名字。我想起来了，医生，你知道的吧，第五战区是不是就是联邦城伤亡率最高的阵地。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_19.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_23.text: As of today, Doctor Lily, you are now an official Resonator soldier of the Federated Cities. I imagine the news of you joining them on the frontlines will bring great joy to those children you fought so hard to protect.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_23.zh: 莉莉医生，从今天起，你就是联邦城正式的共鸣者战士了，我想你奔赴前线的消息传出去后，那群孩子也会开心吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_23.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_28.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束4_16_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_28.text: The scene shifts back to the war. Lily stands trial before the military in an interrogation room. She had once been ordered by her superiors to discharge a group of soldiers from medical care. Recognizing that they were on the verge of Overclocking and unfit to return to combat, she defied the order and sent them to the rear to recover, upholding her duty as a doctor. The military regarded her actions as blatant insubordination. Lily was found guilty and reassigned to the forces in the Federated Cities' Fifth Sector.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_28.zh: 时间线被拉回到了战争期间，莉莉在审讯室内接受军部的审判。原来莉莉曾收到上级指令，为一群战士开具出院证明，但她判断出这批战士已经濒临超频，无法继续战斗。出于医生的职责，莉莉违抗了指令，将这批战士送往后方疗养。军部对她的行为愤怒不已，最后莉莉被宣判有罪，编入了联邦第五战区的队伍。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_166_7.text: Free to go where? The Federated Cities. That's the only name I still remember
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_166_7.zh: 我还能去哪里？联邦城，我只记得这个名字
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_166_7.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_167_1.text: I never expected time to move so differently in the Somnoire. The Federated Cities... They're gone now.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_167_1.zh: 没想到心之集域的时间流速和外界差了这么多，联邦城……已经不在了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_167_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_170_1.text: Ah, Miss Lily, good timing! I never did finish telling you about my adventures out in the Federated Cities...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_170_1.zh: 哟，莉莉小姐，你来得正好，上次我在联邦城闯荡的故事还没讲完呢……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_21.text: You believe both the Federated Cities and the New Federation have abandoned you, don't you?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_21.zh: 你觉得联邦城和新联邦都抛弃了你，对吧？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_21.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_52.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束4_51_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_52.text:
As strange changes begin to overtake Lily's body, Meta suddenly intrudes upon one of her dreams. It reveals that, after returning from the New Federation, Lily secretly created another dream without its knowledge, gathering all the souls from the Fifth Sector who had yet to find peace.

Meta explains that Lily's transformation stems from more than the corruption she has absorbed. With time flowing differently inside the Somnoire, Lily has come to believe she no longer belongs anywhere, and that both the Federated Cities and the New Federation have abandoned her. The fear born of this conviction, combined with the corruption within her, has turned her into what she is now.

Terrified that she will become a monster and hurt others, Lily once again begs Meta to destroy her. Meta evades the request, however, and Lily resolves to find someone else who can end her life.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_52.zh: 莉莉察觉到自己的身体发生了异样的变化。这时候，梅塔闯入了她编织的幻梦。原来莉莉从新联邦回来后，瞒着梅塔二次创梦，并把第五战区所有未得到安息的亡魂带入了梦中。梅塔向莉莉道出了她异变的原因——因心之集域和外界时间流速不同，她觉得自己没有了容身之处，联邦城和新联邦都把自己抛弃掉了。这种念想诞生的恐惧加上莉莉吸收的污秽，便让她变成了现在这般模样。莉莉不想变成怪物伤害任何人，再次请求梅塔毁灭她。可梅塔仍然跳过了这个话题，于是莉莉决定寻找一个能毁灭自己的人。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_21.text: Meta told me I was free. I went to the Federated Cities holding onto a little sliver of hope. But they were already gone.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_21.zh: 梅塔对我说你自由了。我抱着一丝期待去了我心中的联邦城，但它已经不在了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_21.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_18.text: I want to go and see it all again. The New Federation, the Federated Cities, whichever.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_18.zh: 我想去重新看看，不管它是新联邦还是联邦城。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_18.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_12.text: Oh, speaking of which, a student mentioned today that a perfumer girl from the Federated Cities was spotted on campus.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_12.zh: 说起来，今天还有学生说有个联邦城的调香师少女出现在学院里。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_12.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_13.text: Either my students aren't getting enough sleep, or that perfumer isn't... The Federated Cities haven't been a thing for decades.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_13.zh: 我怀疑要么是学生们没睡好，要么是那个调香师少女没睡好……联邦城都是几十年前的了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_13.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_219_1.text:
WHAT'S NEW IN STARTORCH
Today's Headline: The Mysterious Girl from the Federated Cities

According to multiple student eyewitnesses, a girl in rather unusual attire was spotted on campus today.

She claims to be a perfumer from the Federated Cities, but oddly enough, she seems way too familiar with certain Academy fixtures. Like our beloved TARD-E Units, for example! 

Her response? "I saw it in a dream."

And that, somehow, shut down every skeptic on the forums. No one can find a single shred of evidence or logic to refute it. 
In fact, quite a few students have already joined her fan club. They say she carries an almost divine presence, as if pouring out your worries to her instantly cleanses and elevates your soul.

So... what's the truth?

This is Lynae, bringing you the latest as the story unfolds.

Photo attached below.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_219_1.zh:
学院快讯报道
今日头条新闻《神秘的联邦少女》
据多位同学的目击证词，一位打扮奇异的少女今日出现在校园内。
她自称是联邦城的调香师，但她似乎对学院的某些东西又很熟悉，比如我们敬爱的准时宝机器大人！
她说在梦中曾见过它……
这一回答击碎了论坛里所有学生的质疑。现在，学生们找不出任何证据、理论能够推翻这个答案。
反倒是不少学生已经加入了她的粉丝群，他们宣称少女身上似乎带着一股神性。
只要向她倾诉自己的烦恼，身心立马得到洗礼与升华！
所以……真相到底如何？
本台记者琳奈为你持续报道。
下面附一张拍摄的照片。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_41_18.text: No, what I meant to say earlier is that I'm not a soldier from the Federated Cities. This is my first time on this train.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_41_18.zh: 不，刚刚见面时，我想说的是……我并不是联邦城的战士，我是第一次登上这辆列车。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_41_51.text: The army... so this train's military? And when you say army, you mean the Federated Cities, right?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_41_51.zh: 军队……所以这辆车是军方的？你说的军队，是联邦城那边的吗？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_77_3.text: A small town, just south of the Federated Cities.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_77_3.zh: 我的故乡，它是在联邦城南边的一个普通小镇。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_80_4.text: Didn't think they'd have whiskey this good on a train. Hey, hey, you ever been to the Federated Cities?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_80_4.zh: 没想到这列车上还有这种好酒，好战友，你去过联邦城吗？

yakita:FWNPC_AGLXZMP_7_2.chapter: 剧情_拂风水畔_人文生态_冒泡_7_1
yakita:FWNPC_AGLXZMP_7_2.text: Devout believers will be protected by Imperator, as Lord Fenrico is the embodiment of the Sentinel's will!
yakita:FWNPC_AGLXZMP_7_2.zh: 虔诚的信仰者会被英白拉多大人庇佑，芬莱克大人就是岁主意志的延伸！

yakita:FWNPC_AGLXZMP_7_3.chapter: 剧情_拂风水畔_人文生态_冒泡_7_1
yakita:FWNPC_AGLXZMP_7_3.text: Whatever your obsessions or desires may be, as long as you confess to the Sentinel, Lord Fenrico will bring a response!
yakita:FWNPC_AGLXZMP_7_3.zh: 无论大家有怎样的偏执或心愿，只要肯向岁主告解，芬莱克大人都将带来回应！

yakita:FWNPC_AGLXZMP_9_2.chapter: 剧情_拂风水畔_人文生态_冒泡_9_1
yakita:FWNPC_AGLXZMP_9_2.text: In the third year, I joined The Order. It was through Lord Fenrico's guidance that I was able to understand the Sentinel's benevolence.
yakita:FWNPC_AGLXZMP_9_2.zh: 第三年起，我加入了修会。正是有了芬莱克大人的点化，我才能够感悟岁主的仁慈。

yakita:LGNCZST_127_18.text: Primus Fenrico established the Order Penitentiary as a response to the societal instabilities at the time.
yakita:LGNCZST_127_18.zh: 芬莱克主座增设忏悔院，也是出于当时维稳的需要。

yakita:LGNCZST_23_4.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_市中心生态_1_7
yakita:LGNCZST_23_4.text: Ever since the current Primus, Fenrico, took over the Order, many plays have been banned. All performances must be approved, or else you risk being arrested.
yakita:LGNCZST_23_4.zh: 自从那位蓝衣「芬莱克」入主修会，不少剧目都被列为了禁忌。所有演出都要经过修会的批准，否则就可能引来抓捕。

yakita:SZSTBC_18_2.text: Lord Fenrico's missing, and the Order's attitude is… unsettling. I fear we'd be killed the moment we set foot back there.
yakita:SZSTBC_18_2.zh: 芬莱克大人行踪不明，修会又态度暧昧，我害怕回去就会被杀掉……

datamine:InfoDisplay_133002002_Text.title: Ragunna City
datamine:InfoDisplay_133002002_Text.text:
Ragunna City, the administrative center of the Ragunna city-state in Rinascita, is a thriving port city by the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways. The Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, who believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel carrying Their divine will.

In addition to their faith, the people of Ragunna are also known for their love of the arts. The city is adorned with magnificent sculptures and paintings at every turn, and impromptu performances often bring the streets to life. Under the leadership of Fenrico, the current Primus of the Order of the Deep, a series of laws have been enacted to restrict certain themes in artistic expression. These laws have sparked divided opinion among the city's inhabitants.

At present, Ragunna's daily affairs are overseen by the Order of the Deep, while prominent families such as Montelli and Fisalia also hold significant influence over the direction of the city.
datamine:InfoDisplay_133002002_Text.zh:
黎那汐塔的城邦之一拉古那的都城，无比繁荣的港口城市。拉古那城坐落在海上，城区之间由水道相互联通。拉古那的人民普遍信奉岁主，他们将公共声骸视为岁主的赐福，甚至传达岁主意志的使者。
除了广为人知的虔信外，拉古那人还以对艺术的狂热追求而著称。精美绝伦的雕塑和画作在城内随处可见，街头也经常可以看到即兴戏剧上演。在现任「隐海修会」主座芬莱克在任期间，他曾颁布了一系列法令，对艺术创作的题材进行了限制。民众们对这些法令的看法褒贬不一。
拉古那城内的各项事务目前均由「隐海修会」进行实际管理，以莫塔里家族和翡萨烈家族为代表的各个家族也拥有相当重要的话语权。

datamine:InfoDisplay_21010007_Text.title: An Acolyte's Diary from the Avenolium Theological Seminary
datamine:InfoDisplay_21010007_Text.text:
Fenrico's devotion, wisdom, and determination are sufficient for him to become a second significant Priest in Avenolium.

Unfortunately, compared to the other one, he seems to lack spiritual insight and flexibility…

Impossible, impossible! So long as I study hard and practice what we preach, I WILL stand before the Divinity someday.

Is it not right to take the sacred Codex in its most literal form and apply these truths to every aspect of society?

These teachings are the only authoritative truth. I must still be lacking the full comprehension. But once my understanding is clear enough to uphold these truths, They will surely understand. They will surely see me.
datamine:InfoDisplay_21010007_Text.zh:
-芬莱克的虔诚、智慧与决心足以让他成为阿维纽林的第二位高位圣职者。
-可惜和另一位比起来，他似乎缺乏灵性，不善变通……

不可能，不可能！只要我刻苦修习，坚持践行教义，最终一定可以觐见神明。
用最传统的方式解释经文，并将这些理解运用于社会的各个方面难道不对吗？为什么……祂不理解。
不，那些教义是唯一的权威性真理，我一定理解还不透彻，等到我完全理解并坚定捍卫这样的权威性真理，祂一定会明白的，祂一定会看到我的。

yakita:Character_Rococo_3_14.text: Fenrico may be a phony hiding behind a mask, but I'm sure he wouldn't go back on his word as Primus.
yakita:Character_Rococo_3_14.zh: 唔……芬莱克虽然戴着虚伪的假面，但为了维护“主座的尊严”，应当不会食言。
yakita:Character_Rococo_3_14.speaker: Roccia

yakita:Character_Rococo_3_16.text: This Pilgrim's Sail probably left Ragunna before Fenrico gave his word.
yakita:Character_Rococo_3_16.zh: 而这艘「朝圣船」，在你夺得「桂冠」之前，就已经驶出拉古那。
yakita:Character_Rococo_3_16.speaker: Roccia

yakita:Character_Rococo_66_13.text: Mm-hmm, but now you've won the Laurel and forced Fenrico to finally back down.
yakita:Character_Rococo_66_13.zh: 嗯，不过好在你夺得了「桂冠」，芬莱克做出了让步。
yakita:Character_Rococo_66_13.speaker: Roccia

yakita:CommonVoice_Fuluoluo_24_1.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_通用文本_24_1
yakita:CommonVoice_Fuluoluo_24_1.text: I bet Fenrico never imagined these pipelines would end up making our lives easier.
yakita:CommonVoice_Fuluoluo_24_1.zh: 芬莱克大概也没想到，这些四通八达的管道会为我们提供便利。
yakita:CommonVoice_Fuluoluo_24_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:CommonVoice_Fuluoluo_30_1.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_通用文本_30_1
yakita:CommonVoice_Fuluoluo_30_1.text: Fenrico wanted to keep this place under wraps. There may be more to it than meets the eye.
yakita:CommonVoice_Fuluoluo_30_1.zh: 芬莱克不想让人知道这里的存在，那这或许还藏着些我们不知道的东西。
yakita:CommonVoice_Fuluoluo_30_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:HD_XK_41_12.text: I've heard whispers of your presence at Whisperwind Haven around that time. Whenever you were asked, you claimed to be seeking inspiration.
yakita:HD_XK_41_12.zh: 有人说那段时间你也出现在拂风水畔附近，每当有人问起，你的说辞都是在寻求灵感。
yakita:HD_XK_41_12.speaker: Fenrico

yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_2_5.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_2_1
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_2_5.text: You wish to confess to our Primus? Alas, Lord Fenrico is currently away on a journey to spread the Sentinel's teachings.
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_2_5.zh: 您是想要跟他亲自告解吗？真不巧，最近芬莱克大人外出宣讲福音了。

yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_4002_2.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_4_3
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_4002_2.text: Looks like Fenrico is still controlling this place.
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_4002_2.zh: 看来，芬莱克仍然控制着这里。
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_4002_2.speaker: Qiuyuan

yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_406_41.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_7_2
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_406_41.text: History shall remember me... as Fenrico the First.
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_406_41.zh: 后人也将称我为……芬莱克……一世。
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_406_41.speaker: Fenrico

yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_406_44.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_7_2
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_406_44.text: So ends the path of Fenrico the First, of the Order of the Deep.
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_406_44.zh: 这就是，隐海修会芬莱克一世的末路。
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_406_44.speaker: Qiuyuan

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_21.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_12_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_21.text: Yes, only one person has received such an honor—the current Primus, Fenrico.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_21.zh: 如今唯一一位成功觐见了岁主的信徒——也就是现在修会的「主座」，蓝衣「芬莱克」大人。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_10_21.speaker: Phoebe

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_25_5.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_19_2
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_25_5.text: We should have heeded Primus Fenrico's words…
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_25_5.zh: 我们本应该听从芬莱克大人的指示……

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_77_3.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_35_32
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_77_3.text: This must be Fenrico, the Primus of the Order of the Deep, just as Priest Alessio described.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_77_3.zh: 这位应当就是阿莱克斯司铎口中，隐海修会如今的主座，芬莱克。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_10.text: Well, Imperator called you "the Lost," and Primus Fenrico claims you are the Resonator for Leviathan, the Threnodian.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_10.zh: 「英白拉多」称你为迷途者，但现任主座芬莱克又告诉我，你是鸣式——「利维亚坦」的共鸣者。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_4_3_10.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_108_4.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐底试验场_能源场下层_1_33
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_108_4.text: Fenrico tied the music piece to the security system.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_108_4.zh: 芬莱克把能源安全系统和曲谱绑在了一起。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_108_4.speaker: Phrolova

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_111_3.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐底试验场_能源场下层_1_36
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_111_3.text: From what the Order's pursuers said, Fenrico will have his men guarding it.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_111_3.zh: 按照之前修会追兵所说，芬莱克应该带人正守在那里。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_111_3.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_117_10.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_朝拜圣所_1_14
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_117_10.text: Imperator's statue is gone… Is this Fenrico's ambition?
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_117_10.zh: 没有了英白拉多的雕像……这是芬莱克的野心吗？
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_117_10.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_129_1.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_朝拜圣所_7_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_129_1.text: ("Unity is the sole deliverance from the Divine Ordeal." That's why Fenrico fought to keep Ragunna from falling into discord.)
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_129_1.zh: （「联结」是度过「天难」的唯一道路……这是芬莱克强行阻止拉古那人之间产生分裂的真正原因？）
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_129_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_129_8.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_朝拜圣所_7_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_129_8.text: (That recording I found earlier also mentioned Fenrico giving conflicting orders to the Acolytes at times.)
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_129_8.zh: （之前发现的那份录音有提到，芬莱克在对教士下达命令时也出现过命令完全不同的情况。）
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_129_8.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_167_1.text: (Fenrico spoke of a... Paradise. What does it mean?)
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_167_1.zh: （芬莱克刚才提到的……天国……是什么？）
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_167_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_170_12.text: If what Fenrico said is true, the Order should make the right choice here.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_170_12.zh: 如果芬莱克说的都是真的，在这件事上修会应该能做出正确的选择。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_170_12.speaker: Zani

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_170_31.text: Sure. I'm heading to Septimont to follow the clues Fenrico left behind.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_170_31.zh: 好，那我先按照芬莱克留下的线索去七丘看看。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_170_31.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_22_7.text: Spare me the commentary. Fenrico wants the Gem, and I intend to stop him. That's all that matters. Now, lead the way.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_22_7.zh: 不用故意强调我和他们的对立，既然芬莱克也想要宝石，我就不可能不阻止他。继续带路。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_22_7.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_33_1.text: We must return to the tower before Fenrico finds it.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_33_1.zh: 要在芬莱克得手前回高塔中去。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_33_1.speaker: Phrolova

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_36_3.text: The area before us is vital to the Order. Fenrico wouldn't leave it lightly guarded.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_36_3.zh: 前面的核心区域被修会视为珍宝，芬莱克为它留下多少道防守都不为过。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_36_3.speaker: Phrolova

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_74_7.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_能源场上层_1_9
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_74_7.text: So all this chaos was caused by Fenrico disrupting the composition?
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_74_7.zh: 你的意思是我们见到的失控，都是芬莱克把这首曲子打乱造成的。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_74_7.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_81_3.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐底试验场_能源场下层_1_6
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_81_3.text: Fenrico likely hid the two music sheets separately to stall us.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_81_3.zh: 芬莱克有可能将两段曲谱分开存放来拖住我们。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_81_3.speaker: Phrolova

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_81_7.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐底试验场_能源场下层_1_6
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_81_7.text: Heh… Now I'm even more certain. Fenrico wanted us separated.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_81_7.zh: 呵……你的反应让我更加确定，芬莱克一定会将我们分开，并将两段曲谱分开藏放。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_81_7.speaker: Phrolova

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_89_7.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐底试验场_能源场下层_1_14
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_89_7.text: And if Fenrico's recording is real, who exactly was she trying to save when she created the Lost Beyond?
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_89_7.zh: 如果芬莱克的录音没有作假，那么弗洛洛创造失亡彼岸又是为了承载谁的意识？
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_89_7.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_13.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_22_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_13.text: Galbrena, demon wrought from ruin! You are not welcome here.
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_13.zh: 嘉贝莉娜，来自地狱的火魔……这里，不欢迎你。
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_13.speaker: Fenrico

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_21.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_22_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_21.text: (And Fenrico... he knew innocents were here, but didn't hold back at all...)
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_21.zh: （而且芬莱克，他明明知道这里聚集着大量民众，却对此视若无睹，攻击没有任何收敛的迹象……）
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_21.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_28.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_22_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_28.text: Unless... You're not Fenrico at all. You... Who are you? What do you want?
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_28.zh: 除非……你不是芬莱克。你……到底是什么人？你的目的又是什么？
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_26_28.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_72_13.chapter: 剧情_2_7_狄斯台地主线_上半_巡游天国_1_70
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_72_13.text: Rinascita will surely know... a lasting dawn.
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_72_13.zh: 黎那汐塔，一定会迎来一个……崭新的黎明。
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_72_13.speaker: Fenrico

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_743_10.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_52_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_743_10.text: Council of Ten was disbanded years ago. After that, all decisions went straight to Primus Fenrico.
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_743_10.zh: 「十人委员会」也已经被取消好多年了……之前修会所有的决议，都会集中到芬莱克主座手中决断。
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_743_10.speaker: Phoebe

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_903_1.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_18_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_903_1.text: (That visitor from Huanglong... He must know something about Fenrico.)
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_903_1.zh: （那位瑝珑的来客，似乎知道一些与芬莱克有关的信息。）
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_903_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410011_16.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410011_16.text: "The circus's final tour was a grand spectacle, but Fenrico still hasn't settled the performance fees."
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410011_16.zh: “马戏团的最后一次巡演声势浩大，但芬莱克至今都没付演出费。”
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410011_16.speaker: Rover

yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_17.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_17.text: "...I've come to see High Adjudicator Fenrico."
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410042_17.speaker: Rover

yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_15.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_15.text:
You notice the guards surrounding the stage, but you disregard them, walking straight toward Fenrico.
You meet his eyes calmly.
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_15.zh:
你发现警卫们团团围住了舞台，密切观察着你。但你如没看到他们一般，径直走向了芬莱克。
你看着芬莱克的眼睛，语气平静地说道：

yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_16.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_16.text: "There's no need for that, Fenrico. It's better we speak where the entire city can hear."
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_16.zh: “不必了，芬莱克。我们的事，还是当着全城人的面说明比较好。”
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410052_16.speaker: Rover

yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_19.speakerZh: 欧泊般闪耀的少女【新任家主】
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_19.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_19.text: "Had I been the head of the family back then, I would never have supported Fenrico. I would have chosen to support you."
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_19.zh: “如果当年我是家主的话，一定不会选择支持芬莱克，而是会选择支持你。”

yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_6.speakerZh: 欧泊般闪耀的少女【新任家主】
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_6.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_6.text: "I'll spare you the pleasantries, Chief. I sought you out regarding the High Adjudicator Fenrico."
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420031_6.zh: “我也不绕圈子了，行长。我这次找你，是为了芬莱克执行官的事。”

yakita:Side_AHKC_14_7.chapter: 剧情_2_5_支线_历程记忆手册_8_2
yakita:Side_AHKC_14_7.text: This is where Fenrico collaborated with the Fractsidus.
yakita:Side_AHKC_14_7.zh: 这里是芬莱克与残星会合作的地方。

yakita:Side_AHKC_8_10.chapter: 剧情_2_5_支线_历程记忆手册_10_1
yakita:Side_AHKC_8_10.text: Might be because Fenrico is keeping the cost of failure in check.
yakita:Side_AHKC_8_10.zh: 那或许是因为，芬莱克在控制失败的代价。
yakita:Side_AHKC_8_10.speaker: Rover

yakita:Side_AHKC_9_7.chapter: 剧情_2_5_支线_历程记忆手册_11_1
yakita:Side_AHKC_9_7.text: Fenrico must have known about this earlier than we ever expected.
yakita:Side_AHKC_9_7.zh: 这件事芬莱克知道的时间应该比我们料想的还要早得多。
yakita:Side_AHKC_9_7.speaker: Rover

yakita:InfoDisplay_38000003_Text.text:
April 17th. Rain and gray skies. The military began its private inquiry into my conduct today.
The military began its private inquiry into my conduct today. I thought I could protect them... but in the end, I failed to protect anyone.
The military found me guilty and shipped me off to the Fifth Sector... Fear, anger, sorrow... I feel none of them. I'm too weary to think. All I can do now is stay ready to save the soldiers on the front line.
yakita:InfoDisplay_38000003_Text.zh:
那是4月17日，天气阴雨，军部开始对我进行私人审讯。
我以为我能保护他们，但事实上我谁都保护不了。
我被军部宣判有罪，发配到了第五战区……恐惧、愤怒、悲伤，这些情绪我都没有感觉到，因为我没有了余力去思考，我能做的只是做好去前线救护战士的准备。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_11.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束3_26_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_11.text: Officer Herriman delivers a speech before an assembled audience, then asks Lily to stay behind. For reasons still unclear, she has been reassigned to the Fifth Sector. Before she boards the transport, Herriman takes the opportunity to mock her.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_11.zh: 军官赫利曼在台上发表着演讲，演讲结束后，他留下莉莉，原来莉莉因为某种原因被调配到了第五战区。上车前，赫利曼借此机会嘲笑了一番莉莉。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_9.text: Ah, Doctor Lily. I owe you my gratitude. When word spread that you'd set off for the Fifth Sector, folks changed their tune overnight and joined the war effort.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_9.zh: 噢，是莉莉医生。也多亏了你，不少人听说你去了第五战区，对战争的态度立刻从反对转为了支持。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_9.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_17.text: They're already en route to the Fifth Sector. Since you were so desperate to keep them safe... Why not go join them?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_17.zh: 现在他们已经在去第五战区的列车上了，你这么想保护他们，要不要和他们一起？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_17.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_22.text: The sentence is as follows: given the demands of the war, effective immediately, you are to be reassigned to the Fifth Sector.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_22.zh: 现判决如下：出于对战争局势的考虑，今日起，将莉莉编入联邦第五战区的队伍。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_22.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_146_1.text: As you saw, the military found me guilty and shipped me off to the Fifth Sector.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_146_1.zh: 和你看见的一样，我被军部宣判有罪，发配到了第五战区……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_146_2.text: November 10th. Clear skies. The Fifth Sector. The night before the assault...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_146_2.zh: 那是11月10日，天气晴，联邦第五战区，冲锋日的前夜……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_148_5.text: The Fifth Sector—nothing but an execution ground. This is where they dump the troublemakers and everyone they've given up on.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_148_5.zh: 联邦第五战区就是一块处刑地，军队将违纪的人，他们抛弃掉的人调配到这里。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_2.text: Good evening. It's been a few months since you arrived at the Fifth Sector. You've settled in well.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_2.zh: 嗯，格姆先生到第五战区已经几个月了，看上去你也逐渐适应这里了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_2.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_167_4.text: But as long as everyone from the Fifth Sector is still on the train, that's enough. Please, all of you, hold on just a little longer. Give me a little more time.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_167_4.zh: 但，只要第五战区的大家都在列车上就好，大家再等等我，再给我一些时间。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_167_4.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_253_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_86_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_253_1.text: The train to the frontlines dropped him at the Fifth Sector
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_253_1.zh: 他被列车送到了前线，联邦第五战区
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_253_1.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_55_18.text: He asked me about his ma once, and said he was s'posed to get off at the Fifth Sector.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_55_18.zh: 他曾问我关于他妈妈的问题，还说自己要在联邦第五战区下车。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_56_16.text: Slight too big for 'em to ignore. I heard they shipped her off to the Fifth Sector after that.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_56_16.zh: 她这种行为无疑是对军部的侮辱，后来，我听说军部把她送到了第五战区。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_56_21.text: The Fifth Sector... if that's where she ended up...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_56_21.zh: 第五战区，如果是那个战区的话……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_27.text: "When that happens, you can come to the Fifth Sector. Someone will be there to take you to me."
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_27.zh: “那时就代表游戏结束了，你可以到第五战区，会有人带你来见我的。”

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_41.text: I figure she was hoping he'd come to the Fifth Sector for her personal effects, once it was all over. But Liam..
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_41.zh: 她其实是希望利亚姆在战争结束后，前往第五战区领回她的遗物，可利亚姆现在……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_42.text: Can you take him? I can't look after him much longer. Next stop is the Fifth Sector, and that's where I get off.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_42.zh: 这孩子能拜托给你吗？我照顾不了他太久，因为下一站就是第五战区，我要下车了。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_65_7.text: I told him he missed his stop at the Fifth Sector. But as long as he stays on this train, he'll have another chance to get there.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_65_7.zh: 我已经告诉那孩子，他错过第五战区的站点了。但只要他留在车上，就有机会再次抵达第五战区。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_67_2.text: But sir, someone said this is the Fifth Sector. Is that true? Miss Lily told me it was the Sixth...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_67_2.zh: 战士叔叔，有人说这里是第五战区，这是真的吗？可莉莉姐姐告诉我这里是第六战区……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_67_2.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_69_1.text: Kid, you must be joking. No one from the Fifth Sector ever gets back on the train...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_69_1.zh: 孩子，你肯定是在开玩笑吧。怎么可能会有第五战区的人回到列车上来……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_69_4.text: {Male=Mister;Female=Madam} Attendant, is the Fifth Sector really that dangerous?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_69_4.zh: 乘务员{Male=哥哥;Female=姐姐}，所以第五战区是一个很危险的地方吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_69_4.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_1.text: {Male=Mister;Female=Madam} Attendant, you're here. We're almost at the Fifth Sector again, aren't we?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_1.zh: 乘务员{Male=哥哥;Female=姐姐}，你来了，马上又要到联邦第五战区了吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_1.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_3.text: Yeah. I know why you've all been lying to me. That soldier was right. The Fifth Sector is scarier than any witch or big bad wolf from the fairytales.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_3.zh: 嗯，我也知道你们为什么要骗我。战士叔叔说得没错，第五战区比童话故事里的女巫、大灰狼还要可怕。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_3.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_5.text: All this time, I didn't want to believe this was the Fifth Sector. I didn't want to believe that Miss Lily and Mama... were here.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_5.zh: 一直以来，我不愿承认这里就是第五战区，我也不愿相信莉莉姐姐和妈妈他们就在这里。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_5.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_53.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束2_32_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_53.text: The train completes another circuit through the war zones and returns to the Fifth Sector. Liam senses that something is wrong. Deep down, he has known all along where he is, but he cannot bear to believe that his mother and Lily, the woman who always protected him, could be in such a terrible place. He fears that his mother may already be gone. Seeing his despair, you offer him words of comfort. Encouraged, Liam resolves to open the door and end the game, no matter what awaits him. As the countdown begins, you catch a familiar floral scent and realize Lily is behind the door. A brilliant light floods your vision. When you open your eyes again, you see Liam's mother sitting in the room with her back to you, playing the harmonica. Liam rushes into her arms in tears and transforms into a lily. But it is all an illusion. The person actually sitting in the room is Lily herself.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_53.zh: 列车循环在各个战区之间，再次来到了第五战区。利亚姆似乎也察觉到了异常，他其实早就明白这里就是第五战区，但不愿承认自己的母亲，保护自己的莉莉姐姐会在这种残酷的地方。他害怕自己一直在找的人已经不在了……看着失落的利亚姆，你开始安慰起他来。在你的鼓励下，利亚姆决意推开门，不管门后面是什么，他都想结束掉这场游戏。在倒计时中，你闻到了一股熟悉的香气，明白莉莉就在门后。门后的光芒盖住了你们的视野，再次睁开眼，利亚姆母亲的背影坐在房间内吹着口琴，利亚姆哭着扑了过去，在母亲的怀抱下化作了一束百合。但这一切不过是幻象，事实上坐在房间内的，是真正的莉莉。

yakita:LGNCZST_117_6.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_20
yakita:LGNCZST_117_6.text: At his strong insistence, the Servitude Hall reported the matter to the higher-ups of the Order and proposed organizing a field investigation of the Penitent's End.
yakita:LGNCZST_117_6.zh: 在他的强烈要求下，驱役所将此事上报给了修会高层，并提出组织一次对悲叹墓岛的实地勘察。
yakita:LGNCZST_117_6.speaker: Figaro

yakita:LGNCZST_117_8.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_20
yakita:LGNCZST_117_8.text: Who knows, Tulio went alone to Penitent's End one night... and never returned...
yakita:LGNCZST_117_8.zh: 谁知道，图里奥竟然在一个夜晚，一个人，独自前去了悲叹墓岛……再也没有回来……
yakita:LGNCZST_117_8.speaker: Figaro

datamine:InfoDisplay_102802004_Text.text:
[…]

A Transgressor's Transcript (Part I)
In the ancient era, long before Ragunna was founded, the distant seas of Rinascita were the Realm of A Thousand Islands.

At that time, the Fisalia family was already well-versed in the ways of the ocean.

[…]

Later, with the assault of the Lament, the civilization of the archipelago teetered on the brink of destruction and our family became one of the founders of the Ark, embarking on a quest to find a new settlement.

[…]

Later, some fishermen claimed that they had been assisted by ▇▇▇▇ during their fishing trips.

This entity, long known as the Giant One, had existed for ages.

[…]

Yet, why have generations of family heads chosen to conceal this history?

[…]

And what, exactly, was the true object of our devotion?

This mysterious faith was quietly reshaping the history of Ragunna, and it even threatened our family's control over the Order of the Deep.

[…]

No one has ever resisted the dissipation of the form, for "every drop of water will eventually return to the sea."

[…]

Many members of the Fisalia family were tormented by strange nightmares...

[…]

The sound of wet scratches echoes on the floor.

[…]

Some ventured to Septimont and never spoke of the faith again, while others settled near the seaport, growing detached from the other forces.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_102802004_Text.zh:
僭越者的誊抄本·其一
在拉古那尚未建立的古老时代，黎那汐塔远海曾有「千岛之国」矗立。

彼时，我等翡萨烈已对海洋了如指掌。我族从培植的深海生物中提炼毒素与药物，掌握了庞大的远洋与深海资源，享有无上的财富与声望。其后悲鸣来袭，群岛文明危在旦夕，我族亦是寻觅新家园的「方舟」的建造者之一。

跨越重洋的航途凶险异常，方舟群或是在浓雾中迷航，或是在风暴中倾覆。我族方舟幸得「天外之音」指引，得以率领船队，循着远方「灯塔」的微光，最终抵达那片人迹未至的富饶群岛——其中一处岛屿，即是今日拉古那的发祥地。

新生的拉古那时局未定，一切尚有变数。时任族长为巩固家族的统治地位，宣称▇▇▇▇的显现即为深海信仰的具现化，是海洋神祗对我族虔信的回应。此举卓有成效，随着信众不断增多，我族执掌的权柄也日益稳固。

后来，近海有渔民声称在外出捕鱼之时，得到了▇▇▇▇的帮助。此物早已有之，民间称其为巨灵——海面之下的巨灵之影，指引拉古那的渔民与船队抵御风暴，屡屡为渔民唤来了远甚于前的渔获。

我族翡萨烈即是拉古那最初的主人，修会的信仰之基亦是由我族奠定。为何历代族长要刻意隐瞒这段历史？
为什么我一直想不起来祂的名字？该死的，伤口在隐隐作痛……这里的空气一定有什么问题……我得先换个地方
那些追兵肯定不会想到我就藏在塔里。要尽快将那些秘辛记下来……趁我还记得……

僭越者的誊抄本·其二
出海的渔民将那道鱼影视作▇▇▇▇，往往唤其圣名便能得其襄助。微小的奇迹不断累积，渐渐形成了一股强大的信仰暗流。民间越发相信，巨灵即为▇▇▇▇。

当家族的人士有所察觉，开始着手调查，他们才惊觉那些“奇迹”的事象与过往的记载大有出入。民众所信奉巨灵的真身究竟是什么？我们所虔诚信仰的对象究竟为何物？这种怪诞的信仰正悄然篡改着拉古那的真实历史，甚至威胁着我族对隐海修会的掌控。

唯有「方舟」先民与我族高层知晓▇▇▇▇应是▇▇的姿态。在修会的布道下，一无所知的大众对▇▇▇▇的信仰日益蓬勃。与此同时，▇▇▇▇真身为鱼形神祗的讹传开始四处蔓延。诡异的是，听闻这种说法的人真的在睡梦中遇见了▇▇姿态的▇▇▇▇。

这段文字真是我曾在族长的密…

datamine:InfoDisplay_133002008_Text.title: Fisalia
datamine:InfoDisplay_133002008_Text.text:
One of the most powerful, and certainly the oldest and most traditional, families in Ragunna, renowned for their expertise in medicine and poison. Their devotion to Sentinel Imperator is clear to all who know them.

A faction within the Fisalia family believes that the Montelli family's embrace of openness and the privatization of Echoes is a direct affront to Imperator's teachings, threatening to lead Ragunna into an abyss of heresy. They have directly opposed the Montellis through various means, shaking the family's longstanding image of dignified respectability. Yet, the head of the Fisalia family residing in Porto-Veno Castle seems disturbingly indifferent to the repercussions of these bold and provocative actions.
datamine:InfoDisplay_133002008_Text.zh:
拉古那的主要家族之一。最为古老，也最为保守的家族。翡萨烈家族以对药物和毒药的了解而著称，在大多数人眼中，他们对岁主无比虔诚。
一部分翡萨烈家族成员认为，莫塔里家族所倡导的开放和声骸私有化违背了英白拉多的教诲，将会使拉古那坠入无信的深渊。他们自作主张地通过各种手段和莫塔里家族针锋相对，这无疑破坏了翡萨烈家族一贯维持的保守形象，然而，居住在波蒂维诺堡的翡萨烈家主却似乎对他们的激进行动毫不关心。

datamine:InfoDisplay_21010005_Text.title: The History of Rinascita (Excerpt 2)
datamine:InfoDisplay_21010005_Text.text:
After the Fisalia family established the Sentinel faith and positioned themselves at the core of the religious structure, an increasing number of people in Ragunna began to dream of a fish imbued with divine presence. This phenomenon was especially common among the fishing communities who often went out to sea. When fishermen prayed to this fish in their dreams, their prayers were answered—sometimes with a more bountiful catch, other times by safely avoiding an approaching storm...

These accumulating small miracles over time gave rise to a new faith. While practitioners maintained their devotion to the Sentinel, they increasingly directed prayers to the dreamt fish, drawn by its tangible blessings.

Fearing crackdowns from the Fisalia family, followers of this new faith dared only to spread their belief within a limited circle among the lower classes. Yet as more discovered their shared worship of the same divine fish, a new clandestine group arose.
datamine:InfoDisplay_21010005_Text.zh:
在翡萨烈家确立信仰岁主并以自己家族为主导的体系后，越来越多的拉古那人在梦中梦见了一条充满神性的鱼，这种现象在经常外出捕鱼的渔民群体中尤为常见。当渔民尝试在梦中对这条鱼祈祷时，那些祈祷得到了回应：有时是能够多收获几条鱼，有时是能够避开一场风暴……
细微的奇迹在累积中创造了一种崭新的信仰——人们一边并未抛弃对岁主的信仰，但是另一边对于奇迹的渴望又让他们对鱼的祈祷逐渐频繁起来。
出于对翡萨烈家的畏惧，这种信仰只在底层民众中小范围内传播，当越来越多的人发现他们都在向同一件事物祈祷时，一个全新的团体被秘密建立了起来。

yakita:ItemInfo_70050053_BgDescription.text:
According to legend, the Thorncrown Rises, located in Thessaleo Fells, holds the lost glory of the Fisalia family. 
Through the painter's delicate brushstrokes, one can sense her upset and confusion.
yakita:ItemInfo_70050053_BgDescription.zh:
传说中，伫立于狄萨莱海脊的三重冠塔埋藏着翡萨烈家族最初的荣誉。
能从作画者细腻的笔触里感受到不安和迷惑。

yakita:LoadingTipsText_200008_TipsText.text: The rugged mountains of Thessaleo Fells always seem shrouded in the darkness of night, their gloom as deep as the abyssal sea. Once the domain of the Fisalia family, the oldest lineage in Ragunna, this desolate place remains one few outsiders dare to tread.
yakita:LoadingTipsText_200008_TipsText.zh: 嶙峋险峻的山脉似乎永远被长夜笼罩，呈现出深海一般的神秘幽暗。这片区域是拉古那最为古老的家族——翡萨烈家族的旧时领地，鲜有外人敢踏足。

yakita:POI_LGNJR_2_3.text: After many years, the old nobility, led by the Fisalia family, eventually left Thessaleo Fells.
yakita:POI_LGNJR_2_3.zh: 而经历了漫长的年岁以后，以翡萨烈家族为首的旧贵族们离开了海脊。
yakita:POI_LGNJR_2_3.speaker: Phoebe

datamine:InfoDisplay_102900005_Text.title: Summary of the case of the assassination of Chief Mornguard
datamine:InfoDisplay_102900005_Text.text:
Date: AL159
Confidentiality: level S
Case Chronology:
In AL159, former Mornguard head Syuwan was assassinated on the outskirts of the Resonance Nexus Command Hall and died after resuscitation.
Upon investigation, there were obvious signs of a fight at the scene, and multiple people saw fire that night accompanied by the sound of an explosion, and based on the analysis of the residual data, the suspect was a Resonator with the Forte Force.
Mornguard patrol team arrived, the suspect has disappeared, blockade of the entrance to the city did not find any suspicious people, the suspect is presumed to have an unusual means of movement.
A red fragment was left in the hand of the head of the Seokan, which is suspected to be a clue, but due to the small size of the fragment, it is impossible to pinpoint the target for the time being.
As this is a serious matter, it is recommended that the details of the case be kept quiet for the time being, and that the investigation be conducted in secret.

Jinhsi's endorsement:
Agreed. Chief Syoguan is highly trusted, and this matter may shake people's hearts and cause panic, so it is important to do a good job of calming them down.
datamine:InfoDisplay_102900005_Text.zh:
日期：新历159年
机密性：S级
案件纪要：
新历159年，前晓卫团长叙观于中枢指挥厅外围遇刺，经抢救无效身亡。
经调查，现场存在明显打斗痕迹，当晚有多人看到火光，并伴随爆炸声，根据残留数据分析，嫌疑人为具备异能力的共鸣者。
晓卫巡防小队赶到时，嫌疑人已消失，封锁全城入口均未发现可疑人员，推测嫌疑人拥有异于常人的移动手段。
叙观团长手中残留了红色碎片，疑为线索，但因碎片过小，暂时无法锁定目标。
兹事体大，建议暂时不公开案件细节，转为秘密调查。

今汐的批注：
同意。叙观团长深受信赖，此事恐动摇人心，造成恐慌，务必做好安抚工作。

datamine:InfoDisplay_120101049_Text.title: Sumika's Notes - Entry 1
datamine:InfoDisplay_120101049_Text.text:
Day 1 – Unknown (The sky looks like broken, fractured glass)

15:49. I'll never forget this number. Just one minute before the observation was complete, a dark rift suddenly tore open from the device in front of me, shredding the stream of data across the screen. My boots were still stuck to the lab floor, but my upper body had already been pulled into a strange, chaotic storm.

That was the beginning.

Now I find myself in a city I don't recognize, having just survived a bizarre Lament. It slices through buildings, people, space, everything two-dimensional, three-dimensional… and maybe things beyond that, though my eyes can't quite make sense of it anymore.

My Forte is Sealing, something that might be considered a way to resist the passage of time. Maybe, if I keep trying, I can use it to record the abnormalities in this city and figure out how to break through it.

I'm not going to sit here and wait for the end.
datamine:InfoDisplay_120101049_Text.zh:
第1日 无天气（天空被切割成了碎玻璃一样的形状）

15:49——我忘不了这个数字。距离观测完成仅剩下1分钟，我身前的仪器突然吐出条暗色的裂缝，撕开了满屏的数字。我的靴子还卡在实验室的地板上，上半身已经没入怪异而陆离的风暴。
这是起因。

现在我身在一个陌生的城市，刚历经一场怪诞的悲鸣。它切割建筑，切割人类，切割空间，切割一切二维三维的……甚至更高维的东西，只是我的肉眼已经无法辨别。
我的共鸣能力是「封存」，大概能算是一种与时间相对抗的手段。或许我可以通过这样的尝试，收集这座城市的不寻常之处，从而破解它。
我不要坐以待毙。

datamine:InfoDisplay_121000004_Text.title: Record: Temporal Disruption and Sonoro Sphere
datamine:InfoDisplay_121000004_Text.text:
The Temporal Disruption and the Sonoro Sphere became intricately linked because of malfunctions in the Sentinel's Temporal Mandate, making them inseparable. To safeguard against any deviations, my old friend offered to encase the Sonoro Sphere within a specific medium, turning it into our fail-safe plan.

My new apprentice’s Forte of Flame Manipulation is crucial for destroying the Sonoro Sphere, a task that only she can accomplish. On the other hand, my old friend is the only one who can unlock said Sonoro Sphere. Both individuals are vital to the success of our goal. Yet, unleashing the full power of Flame Manipulation would exact a toll far too heavy for a mere child to endure.

It seems this game shall stay unfinished for many moons to come.
datamine:InfoDisplay_121000004_Text.zh:
那位奇人说因岁主缺损之故，蜃境与时流相互纠缠，最终紧密难分，无法剥离。
那个人表示自己可将这混杂了时流异象的蜃境锁于某样媒介之内，若计划有变，便可以此蜃境为后手。
时流蜃境唯离火可破，而只有那位奇人能通过与媒介共鸣开启这方蜃境，二者缺一不可。然而烧尽整个蜃境所需的代价非同小可，并非一个孩童所能承受。
这将是一场漫长的棋局。

yakita:FavorGoods_110602_Content.text:
An ice mask conjured by Youhu's Forte. The design differs from the original, but the sly grin on the mask mirrors Youhu's own when she's scheming up some mischief. 
 
Youhu often toys with this mask in her spare time, keeping it as a reminder of how she was nearly deceived when appraising the original antique early in her career. 
 
Beyond serving as a cautionary symbol, it's also the perfect prop for giving people a good scare or pulling a fast one on those who catch her interest.
yakita:FavorGoods_110602_Content.zh:
一枚由共鸣能力化出的冰制青铜面具，样式和当初经釉瑚手的正品有所区别，正露出和釉瑚想鬼点子时相似的笑容。
釉瑚时常将它拿在手中把玩欣赏，这是她入行之后险些打眼的一件古物，给那时的小釉瑚留下了极为深刻的印象。
除了提醒自己干活时谨慎判断外，有时候她也会忽然将它遮在脸前，用以吓唬和捉弄那些感兴趣的对象。

yakita:FavorGoods_110603_Content.text:
A jade ring once cracked, now repaired by Youhu with her cryogenic Forte.
 
Once lost in the chaos of a fire, this family heirloom has finally found its way back to Youhu after an arduous search spanning miles. She still dreams of the old days—the gentle breeze from her mother's fan, the sound of her father brewing tea. When she wakes, she often finds the Ruyi ring clutched in her hand.
 
Ruyi, a symbol of peace and happiness, is believed to grant one's wishes. To Youhu, it's more than just an antique.
yakita:FavorGoods_110603_Content.zh:
曾一度碎裂过的如意环，如今已经被釉瑚的凝冰能力重新修复。
这枚传家宝在火光和混乱中与她失散，她远渡万里，才终于重新将它寻回。后来，釉瑚有时做梦，会梦到母亲给她摇扇子的风声，以及父亲给茶壶添水的声音。醒来后，才察觉到自己握着如意环睡着了。
如意，如意，圆满如意，顺遂平安。

yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1512_TalentCertific.chapter: 莉莉档案_共鸣能力鉴定报告
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1512_TalentCertific.text:
This student's waveform graph shows elliptical fluctuations. The Time Domain pattern is regular, with no sign of abnormal fluctuation. Examination results are determined to be within normal parameters.
Resonant Criticality: High. This member demonstrates high stability with minimal risk of Overclocking. Records indicate no history of Overclocking.
A solitary acute fluctuation is present in the subject's historical curve. Readings normalized thereafter.
Given the subject's background, the fluctuation is dated to the Resonator War, when an incident drove her to overuse her Forte to the verge of Overclocking. The subsequent rapid return to baseline remains unexplained and is pending further testing. Preliminary analysis suggests the involvement of an external force acting on her frequency.
"This Overclock assessment has been re-tested and confirmed by Startorch Academy."
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1512_TalentCertific.zh:
受试成员样本波形检测图呈椭圆形波动，时域表示稳定，未见任何异常波动倾向，检测结果判断为正常阶段。
当前超频临界值高，稳定性高，无超频风险，无过往超频史。
但对象检测图曲线，在过往曾有一次强烈的波动，随后恢复正常。
结合对象身份背景，报告判断曲线波动时间节点发生在共鸣者战争期间，对象因遭遇某个事件，过度使用共鸣能力而濒临超频，至于其为什么短时间内就能恢复正常，还有待后续检测鉴定，初步推断是某种外来力量影响了对象的频率。
“对象超频鉴定报告现由星炬学院重新检测确认。”

yakita:FavorStory_110602_Content.zh:
釉瑚随身带着一个小匣子，内藏她用共鸣能力制作的袖珍古物仿品，它们既是她对于鉴定过的好东西的留念，也是她抵御残象的道具，乃至于她夏日解暑的帮手——水果藏在冰古董里，凉凉的，可好吃。
匣中另有一本小册子，用一首首胡诌的打油诗，记录她邂逅的每一件古物。
“天工的人托我帮忙寻找瑝珑失踪的珐琅彩缠枝瓷，这个记起来。”
“商人手里拿的青釉三足香炉，一看就是靠邪门歪道得来的，我暗示他尽快归还，也不知道听进去没有，还是继续管管这桩事吧，记起来记起来！”
“城门口的张木匠，居然拿着几百年的古刀劈柴，不敬，大大的不敬，我要记……算了，我大人有大量，改天先给他好好宣扬下那把刀的价值吧！”
编成诗句写进小册子里，也便是记在心上了。
比如那个手持青釉三足香炉的商人，这两个月屡遭诡谲之事，夜不能寐时，他终于想起当初有个街头鉴宝师提点过自己——
“咿呀咿呀，这香炉来路不正，你的命格压不住污秽，必遭祸殃呀！”
那个鉴宝师说得眉飞色舞，活脱脱一个江湖骗子，他本没有把话放在心上。但这段时间的遭遇，让他不敢怠慢这位大师的说辞。
这一晚，自家屋檐第十五次飘过幽深的黑影，还伴随着惊悚的尖啸，他终于忍受不住煎熬，连夜将盗来的香炉归还原处。
当然，如果那晚他胆敢往屋檐多张望几下，或许能看到另外一场闹剧：
今巡尉发现了一人在屋檐上装神弄鬼，安全起见，他们上前准备盘问这个“黑影”。
釉瑚被假扮黑影的衣服包得严严实实，见今巡尉朝自己走来，赶紧包裹着这身衣服拔腿就跑，期间还被磕绊了几下。
但她一边跑，一边还不忘在小册子上添一笔：青釉三足香炉，已物归原主。

yakita:FavorStory_110605_Content.zh:
釉瑚阅宝无数，遇到自己喜爱的古物，她便照着样式，凝冰造物，供自己把玩。
她造出一排冰编钟，敲敲打打，虽未能还原编钟的韵律，但冰块碎裂的声音倒也清脆悦耳；她又凝出一柄如意，乱挥一通，差点劈裂了一旁的冰大鼎和冰面具。
大家不免好奇，釉瑚最为喜爱的，又是哪件古物？釉瑚总是一愣，目光停留在身前的如意环。
确切地说，那是几块玉石的碎片，在断裂处凝水成冰，重新连接为如意环的形状。
妈妈曾告诉釉瑚，这是她们家族的传家宝，意为圆满如意。玉石剔透，辉光流转，釉瑚看直了眼。
但在那场掠夺中，釉瑚只能眼睁睁看着如意环与其他古物一起，装箱登船，飘零异国。
三年后，她终于找到了那些被掠夺的古物，它们被粉饰为掠夺者的藏品，陈列在场馆中。
但釉瑚搜寻了好多天，都未能找到那枚如意环。
直到她进入蒙尘的仓库，在凌乱的杂物里，她看到了如意环的碎片，还有一个【价值较低，不予展出】的鉴定标签。釉瑚最为珍视的古物，在一些人眼中，甚至不配得到妥善的保管。
原来古物落在不懂得珍惜的人手中，会是这样的下场。釉瑚捧着如意环的碎片，失魂落魄地走在及膝的积雪中，眼泪夺眶而出。眼泪落在碎片上，凝结成冰块。
她似乎想到了什么，不顾自己骤降的体温，蹲进雪中，如意环的往事在脑海里翻飞，频率从手中溢出，凝为冰霜，化为如意环的形状。
等她从昏迷中醒来，双手已被冻结出无法融化的冰花，手臂横陈着上一道声痕。
声痕尽头，一枚冰晶凝结而成的如意环正静静相伴。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_36.text:
The performance ends abruptly. You awaken to find yourself back in reality, but Grimm is nowhere to be seen. Lily is just as bewildered. Then, a frantic flurry of piano notes erupts from the Lounge Carriage. You and Lily rush over to find Mr. Grimm pouring his anguish into the keys. The dream has restored his memories, and he now understands that the piece he played tells the story of his own life.

Grimm cannot come to terms with the sins he has committed. You and Lily speak up to stop him from giving in to despair. He turns toward you both, his expression growing troubled when he sees Lily. He asks whether she could ever forgive him. Lily hesitates, and you step forward to offer your thoughts. Your words reach Grimm, giving Lily the opening she needs to weave an apparition of his old friend with her Forte. At last, the two reunite on that small stage and fulfill the promise they once made.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_36.zh: 演奏突然中断，你睁开眼发现自己已从梦中醒来，可房间内已经没有了格姆的踪影。莉莉也不知道刚刚发生了什么。这时候大厅传来杂乱的钢琴声，你和莉莉赶过去发现格姆先生正在宣泄自己的情绪。通过幻梦，他找回了所有的记忆，也明白那首曲子讲的就是他的故事。格姆无法接受自己犯下的罪行。你们出声制止了他自暴自弃的行为，格姆望向你们，当注意到莉莉时，他的表情十分复杂，询问着莉莉是否愿意原谅他。莉莉陷入了犹豫，随后你向前一步说出了你的想法，你的言语似乎触动到了格姆，莉莉借此机会发动能力编织了格姆友人的幻影，在这小小的舞台上，格姆和友人完成了约定。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_69.text:
When Lily awakens, she finds herself in an unfamiliar room, face-to-face with a colorful cat. The cat introduces itself as Meta, the owner of the Somnoire, and explains that Lily is now within its domain. Lily's Forte is connected to dreams, and her excessive use of it on the battlefield led Meta to mistake the disturbance for an outflow of the Somnoire's power. In response, Meta drew the entire battlefield into the realm.

Sensing Lily's desperate wish to save the soldiers, Meta proposes a bargain. It will lend her a portion of its power, allowing her to extract the corruption tainting the soldiers' souls. In exchange, Lily herself must become the vessel that contains it. Without hesitation, Lily agrees, asking Meta to destroy her if she ever becomes a monster.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_69.zh: 莉莉醒来后，发现自己位于一个陌生的房间。面前有一只彩色的小猫打量着自己，小猫向莉莉解释她现在所在的空间是心之集域，而自己叫做梅塔，是这里的主人。因为莉莉的共鸣能力与梦境有些关联，刚刚莉莉在战场上过度使用力量，让梅塔误以为心之集域的力量外泄，所以梅塔把整片战场收容进了心之集域。梅塔察觉到莉莉想要拯救战士们的强烈愿望，于是向她提出了一个交易——自己赐予莉莉部分力量，让莉莉能够提取出污染战士们灵魂的污秽。但这样做的代价，便是莉莉将成为那些污秽的容器。莉莉没有犹豫就答应了下来，她请求梅塔在自己变成怪物后，毁灭自己。
