yakita:AreaReportContent_Text94.text:
[…]

As written in "Golden Scales of Outer Huanglong," the Gorges of Spirits Battle is given particular emphasis as a campaign part of the "Fortress and Gorges War." The "Fortress" refers to Yuan Fortress, a place whose origins trace back to before the founding of Jinzhou.

Before that, the region lay in ruins, with only a few Huanglong border garrisons stationed there.

Their duties included re‑surveying the Jinzhou territories after the Lament and responding to small‑scale Tacet Discord outbreaks.

[…]

Firmament in the southeastern corner also showed signs of Waveworn Phenomenon, Jué’s descent preserved the people of Hongzhen from the flow of time.

However, Jué had already been gravely wounded upon Its arrival and began experiencing frequency overflow.

It was then that Norfall Barrens saw a Tacet Discord outbreak emerge, targeting Hongzhen...

For beings that feed on frequency, the Sentinel's frequency was a magnificent feast.

To protect the newborn flame of civilization from being extinguished, and to prevent the Tacet Discords of Norfall Barrens from spreading to the other cities of Huanglong, Mengzhou, being the closest, made the choice to construct a City of Mechanisms at one of its passes to serve as a blockade.

That pass is the Land of Xuanfang.

During this time, Mengzhou's Zhuojun Atelier dispatched large numbers of personnel to support the Ministry of Development, working together to complete Yuan Fortress, which delayed the Tacet Discord outbreak's advance into Mengzhou.

Yuan Fortress, built using Automata Mechanics by human hands, became the predecessor to the Xuanfang Hold that would later hang suspended among the peaks and mists.

[…]
yakita:AreaReportContent_Text94.zh:
在《关外金铃》中，着重描写了今州的云陵谷之役，而此役乃是“云渊之役”的一部分。“云渊之役”的“渊”字，指的是渊城，而此城的渊源则需要追溯到今州建立之前。
在今州建立前，地域内百废待兴，只有几支戍边瑝珑军驻扎于此，重新勘探着悲鸣后的今州地块，并应对地域内的小规模残象潮。
位于东南角的乘霄山虽也有海蚀现象出现，但由于角的降临，人们居住的虹镇得以被时流保全。
然而，角于此处降临时自身已受重伤，并开始了频率外溢。北落野于此时出现了残象潮，并以虹镇为目的地开始移动——对以频率为食的存在而言，岁主的频率正是一席饕餮盛宴。
为了保护新生的文明之火不至于熄灭，并阻止北落野的残像潮向瑝珑其他州域扩散，距离最近的梦州决定于关隘处建设一处机关城，阻止北落野的残象涌入梦州——而这处关隘，正是玄方地界。
在此过程中，梦州的琢钧堂派出了大量的人手支援天工部，协力建成了名为渊城的机关要塞，延缓了残象潮往梦州侵袭的进程。
这座以人力所建的机关城“渊城”，成为了后来高悬于山峦云雾间的玄方城的前身。前文所说的爆发于云陵谷与渊城的“云渊之役”，促成了玄方城的落成，给了玄方地界与今州一个完全不同的未来。

yakita:FavorStory_141302_Content.zh:
雨水正缓缓升起，清宵呼出一口气，持剑望向夜空中的两个月亮。
最醒目的那轮满月泛着紫色幻光，几乎占据了大半夜空——无相燹主正冷眼注视着云陵谷，注视着她。无论她用飞剑斩杀了多少残象，都会有源源不断的兵力填补空缺。必须尽快找到鸣式力量的源头，了结它，否则残象便会无穷无尽。
——要快些了，渊城还在等她。

雪从树梢上落在了肩膀上，打坐的清宵睁开眼，从回忆中脱离。
云渊之役结束后不久，玄方地界反常地下了三天大雪，就连她居住的这座无名峰也覆上了白雪。
一个身材高挑的黑发女子踩着雪来到了清宵身后，双手端庄地安放在身前。
“你是……心。”清宵轻轻地说。
“哎，清宵仙子怎么认出来的？因为味道吗？”
心有些诧异，抬手对着自己东嗅西嗅。随着黑发变得雪白，祂的一对狐耳再也藏不住，自头顶冒了出来，服饰妆容也随之一变。清宵起身，面色沉静地凝视着眼前的“神明”。
“先前鸣式来袭的时候，你在什么地方？”她冷冷地问。
隐约有凛冽的剑意化作无形的锋芒，笼罩在两人的周围。
“当时我就在神宫之内，清宵。大家……都已经尽力了。“心的狐耳微微耷拉下去。
两人就这样对视着，直到又有些积雪从树梢上落了下来。
“……是我急躁了。”清宵垂下眼帘。
“其实，我是来邀请你的。”心向清宵走近了一步，“如今玄方地界百废待兴，隐患众多。我想向军策府提议增加一个为你而设的职位，镇玄司骑。有个官方的身份，想必许多地方会方便不少。”
“镇玄司骑……”
“你无需承担什么俗务，只要在紧要关头帮帮玄方地界就行。即便你接了，哪天想走也可以随时退出。不知你意下如何？”
见清宵沉默着，心露出微笑。
“倒不用现在就答复。既然玄方城已经建好了，你可以先搬过去慢慢想。”
清宵摇摇头：“……不了。此地清幽僻静，远离人烟，于修行正合适。”
“还是这个理由吗？没关系，玄方城随时欢迎你。”
心说完便转身走去，似乎就要离开。走出几步后，她停了下来，侧过头。
“再过几个月……就又要举办朝月会了，也算是大家的想法。到时候，一起来过节吧，清宵。”
清宵看着心化作一道狐影离去。她走到崖边，眺望刚经历过战火的玄方地界。原本渊城所在的位置，只剩下一片寂静的深渊。长风掠过她的耳…

datamine:InfoDisplay_102189701_Text.title: Discarded Log I
datamine:InfoDisplay_102189701_Text.text:
[…]

I had originally hoped for you to record the effects of the Void Storm on the human body and the surrounding environment when I entered it, then deliver the data to the Spacetrek Collective.

[…]

As a researcher who once held science as my faith, I believed that the pursuit of knowledge is civilization's most noble mission.

[…]

I later discovered he was a Fractsidus spy.

[…]

Perhaps I'll stay with the Roya tribe until I'm ready.
datamine:InfoDisplay_102189701_Text.zh:
已经过去48小时了，他们……应该找不到我们了。
辛苦你了，老伙计，你的路也到此结束了。没想到路上遭遇了锯袭铁影的袭击，没有工具，我是修不好你了。
唉，我果然到死都毫无价值，本想让你记录下虚质磁暴席卷我时，它对人体、周遭环境参数的变化，送交给深空联合，算是我这个怯懦者最后的尊严。
再过几天，学院就会发现我房间里的遗书吧，是啊，这是一场赴死之旅，我想要利用虚质磁暴杀死自己。
也许会有人找到这篇日志，那个时候，我早已不再属于这个世界。这篇日志就当作写给陌生的你的一封遗书吧。
请原谅我以这种方式不告而别，也请相信，这并非一时冲动，而是漫长挣扎后对自我最终的妥协。
作为一名曾以科学为信仰的研究者，我一度坚信人类对知识的探索是文明最崇高的使命。我踏足的研究领域曾让我窥见宇宙之美，那些黑板上的美丽方程，曾牵引着我推开文明进步的大门。
但是，每个时代或许都有相同的悲剧——研究者以为自己站在巨人的肩上，某天低头却发现，脚下踩着的不过是理想主义的废墟。失败、失败、失败……我能到达的极限就是如此了吗？
就在那时，一位同僚向我伸出了手，他说能帮我解决技术的瓶颈，但一切都要秘密进行。后来我才知道他是残星会的间谍，他被抓的那一天，他没有向任何人说他和我的合作关系，只是向我露出微笑，我不知道他在笑什么，是在笑下一个轮到我了吗？还是笑，我不是原来的那个我了。因为在和他的合作中，我已经做了一些逾越科学道德的事情了。
我眼中知识的纯粹性早已被腐蚀。每当在学术会议上听到同事称赞我时，我都感到胃部一阵抽搐——他们赞美的，正是我背叛科学的证据。
所以，留给我的只有死亡，但如此肮脏的我也想在死亡前留下一点点价值。
虚质磁暴，没有人自愿踏入其中，我想如果有人能走进去……这一定是份宝贵的数据。
我不求原谅，也不期待理解。只愿我的离开能成为一个问号，悬在每一个仍相信知识纯粹性的心灵中……
死亡只有一次机会，我不能浪费，我必须先仔细观察虚质磁暴，或许我可以在罗伊部族待上一段时间。

datamine:InfoDisplay_21020108_Text.title: Notice of Auction Suspension
datamine:InfoDisplay_21020108_Text.text:
[Warning: For Vault Employees with Level 2 or Higher Clearance Only]
 
Due to the security risks posed by Fractsidus activities, the Family has decided to temporarily suspend the Ducat Auction. A date for its resumption will be announced in due course.
 
During this suspension, relevant staff members will be reassigned to other duties. The auction hall will temporarily be repurposed into a banquet hall and ballroom.
 
The official public statement for the suspension will be: "The auction center is undergoing renovations in line with applicable regulations from other regions." Employees are strictly prohibited from disclosing the true reason for the suspension to outsiders. Violators will be considered to have breached confidentiality and will face appropriate penalties.
datamine:InfoDisplay_21020108_Text.zh:
【警告：仅限持有二级或更高权限的金库员工阅读】
由于残星会活动带来的安全风险，家族决定暂时停办「杜卡特拍卖会」。恢复举办的具体时间待另行通知。
在拍卖会停办期间，相关员工将被重新指派其他工作。拍卖会会场将暂时作为宴会厅和舞厅使用。
拍卖会停办的对外说法为“拍卖会在参考其他地区的相关规范进行升级”，禁止所有员工对外提及停办的真正原因，违者将被视为泄露机密，承受相对应的处罚。

yakita:InfoDisplay_101400002_Text.text:
[…]

Of course, we couldn't do it without the financial support of that Fractsidus Overseer.

[…]

[…]

I still remember the moment Professor Heisen announced the trial's success at the meeting.

[…]

I believe each one of you, genius or not, would rather leave your mark in history than end up living an uneventful life in a place like this."
If successful, our names could be immortalized with Professor Heisen's in history, known for generations to come even as ordinary people.

[…]

yakita:InfoDisplay_101400002_Text.zh:
日期：[--16]
以模块化的方式组装机械……这门古老的“机关术”还真是神奇啊。多亏了这项技术，我们的新实验室才能在这么短的时间里建造起来。当然也缺不了那位残星会会监的资金支持。尽管他总是对我们的研究指手画脚，但看他们出手阔绰的份上，我们的意见也都保留了下来。
唉，没办法，被总部逐出以后，搬到怨鸟泽后，工作比以前更累了，不过一切都是值得的。虽然选址是有些偏僻，但是胜在没有什么外人会来打扰，对我们这些“疯子”而言。
我仍记得海森教授在会议上公布试验结果成功的那一刻，他告诉着我们：“我老了，但趁我还有些时间，还是想做些有价值的事。而你们还年轻，还有无限的未来，我相信你们每一个人，无论天才与否，都想把自己的名字留在时间与历史的丰碑中，而不是碌碌无为地从这扇单门走出去。”
是啊，如果这次研究能够成功，我们这些本该无名的普通人也许也能跟着海森教授的名字一同出现在历史的教科书上。
我们是来自各地研究院被遗弃、落选的失败者，我们之中也有靠自主学习的民间科学爱好者，甚至还有一些曾做出危险行为而被禁止研究的学者。我们也曾愤懑，也曾不甘，也曾悔恨。如今我们都将这些无谓的情感抛诸了脑后，一心着眼于人类的未来。
至于原因……除却那些个人的情怀，我想，更多的还是因为——我们都曾目睹过“神迹”。

yakita:FavorStory_141105_Content.zh:
自打他从明庭逃得生路，沦为六州通缉的逃犯，已经过去五年了。
五年的光景过去，明庭这座大城一点没变，繁华依旧，只是他身上的行装愈发破烂，浸染着六州旅尘风霜。谛天鉴的林监正身染沉疴，老病致仕。那个从他手中活下来的年轻人，成了镇守边陲的将军，却又堕入鸣式的魔障。
他的师父告诉他要懂得什么时候拔剑，什么时候收剑，可当他收住剑的时候，一切都滑向了深渊之中。
他的救命恩人告诉他剑能杀人亦能救人，可他却没能救下他想要救下的人。
变幻莫测的命运始终纠缠着他，一切都变了，一切却又好像没变。
而如今未曾改变的是，他始终没有追寻到那个杀害了他恩公的凶手，不过，他也从未放弃寻找真相。
如果不是林监正托人找到他，告诉他明庭军策府的本兵有重要线索，可能他根本不会在这个节骨眼上犯险重返明庭。
“你来了。”
连缀成线的暴雨之中，一个同样戴着斗笠看不清面庞的人从漆黑的桥洞底下走了出来。
“前些阵子残星会那个名叫「伤痕」的会监，从今州的大牢里逃出去了。”
“根据我们的线报，他前几天在黎那汐塔的七丘城附近出现了。他是今州的犯人，是我瑝珑的犯人，无论怎么说，也得给他缉拿归案。”
“这事你们自己做不就行了。”
“只是那黎那汐塔有些不一样，那里有着类似于鸣式共鸣者的人存在。”
“……所以你们想起我了？”
“东园案的疑点在你，你的疑点在哥舒临，哥舒临身上的疑点在今州鸣式，顺藤摸瓜，也许能知道当时东园为什么会给你下那道命令，也就能找到真凶的线索。”
“关于残星会和黎那汐塔鸣式，都在这份卷宗里了。拿着我的印信文书，先去今州问话。”
“你的那个亲族，那个令尹近卫就在今州，查清楚那伤痕是怎么从大牢里被人救出去的，然后再向东渡海去黎那汐塔。”
仇远的确有这么一位远房表亲，不过各州之间山高路远几乎没什么交集，只知道那人近来成了今州令尹的近卫。
“她未必见我。”
“再怎么说，你们叔侄一场，你说话，她会信的。对了，从今州出发的话……那个漂泊者，眼下也在黎那汐塔。”
“漂泊者……这人也在那儿吗？”
“是的，有关今州的事，你也可以问问{TA}。”
“……行了，卷宗给我吧，我这就准备出发。”
“等等！”
仇远接过卷宗转身就要走，却被那人…

yakita:FavorStory_151002_Content.zh:
在多年以后，陆意识到了事情的不对劲。
尽管顶着诺维尔再生医药继承人的头衔，但在董事会那些老狐狸眼中，那时的他不过是个尚未成年的傀儡，理所当然不足为惧。但……
陆一页页翻过那些看似无关的财务异常，实验室的非常规操作，以及父亲生前最后几个月被刻意抹去的行程，像一块块拼图，在眼前逐渐拼凑出支离恐怖却名为“真相”的图景。他目光愈沉。
——但这和手术没什么不同。不过都是割开状似完整的表皮，一点点将尖利刀刃扎进那些腌臜之处，挖出那些附骨之疽。
他早就习惯且擅长。

于外界而言，那段时期只是看到了一位年轻得过分的新任执行官。他总是维持着恰到好处的稳重与从容，却以强硬之姿主持起整个集团的发展，那些起初质疑的声音，很快便在事实面前逐一噤声。他一面加快了药物研发的推进，一面以雷霆速度将此前用于研发“黄金血”的实验室逐一关闭。
深夜的房间里，陆摘下手套，凝视着掌心伤口处淌出的日髓。金色的血液漫溢过皮肤，逐渐自液体凝聚成具有实形的刀刃状，又随着他手腕一转，再度化为温驯的液体。
时隔这么多年——曾经父亲所渴望的“异变”终于出现，他有了控制它的能力。
“但我不想再为研究你而牵扯更多人了。”陆盯着视野中唯一可以辨别的那抹金色，声音很轻，“我要……利用你。”

“潜入残星会？”终端中传来的声音明显一顿。
“嗯。”陆站在天台边缘，任由强风吹拂过衣摆，“已经有不止一条线索指向了这个组织，我怀疑它与我父亲的死亡有关。”
“……你想清楚了？一旦潜入，就再没有回头路了。”
陆望着脚下的光景。灯火散落在大地上，有多少被药物维系的生命有如这般风中残烛，在漫长不见尽头的黑夜中，等待假象消散、曙光破晓的那一刻——
“正是因为没有回头路，”他纵身跃入夜色，声音消散在风里，“才值得一走。”

yakita:MAIN_RGLC_10_10.zh: 一瓶“黄金血”，陆·赫斯的养父拥有的诺维尔再生医药研发的“进化药物”，引来了残星会的注意。

yakita:MAIN_RGLC_11_7.text: A Fractsidus Overseer's report on its way to the New Federation?
yakita:MAIN_RGLC_11_7.zh: 残星会会监发到新联邦的报告……？
yakita:MAIN_RGLC_11_7.speaker: Rover

yakita:MAIN_RGLC_13_1.text: Those three items you just showed me... Did the Fractsidus get into Novialle's work after learning about the Ichor's potential for "evolution"?
yakita:MAIN_RGLC_13_1.zh: 刚才那三样东西……残星会因为日髓的“进化”可能性，介入了诺维尔再生医药？

yakita:MAIN_RGLC_34_46.text: As for the New Federation, you'll likely end up there eventually if you plan to counter the Fractsidus's operations in the future.
yakita:MAIN_RGLC_34_46.zh: 至于新联邦……如果你未来准备干涉残星会的行动，迟早也会去吧。
yakita:MAIN_RGLC_34_46.speaker: Luuk Herssen

yakita:MAIN_RYAM_37_22.text: Scar, your nameless ally, and you... The Fractsidus seems to revel in the company of those with twisted obsessions.
yakita:MAIN_RYAM_37_22.zh: 你也好，伤痕也好，还有这位不知名字的残星会成员……这种所谓的偏爱还真是泛滥啊。
yakita:MAIN_RYAM_37_22.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_40_51.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_0_主线_拉海洛主线_上半_1_18_1
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_40_51.text:
Lynae finally reveals her true identity: she is a former government-hired mercenary from the New Federation's "Lawless Zone." During a mission, she found an admission letter in one of the dead's belongings. Seeing a chance to escape her old life, she took on the dead girl's name and identity to enroll in Startorch Academy.
What she didn't expect was that the dead girl, the real "Lynae," had been a Fractsidus plant, sent to infiltrate the Academy. Wanting to stay in the place she's come to call home, she asks to work with you to uncover the truth and thwart the Fractsidus's plans.
She then takes out the device that caused Hyvatia's malfunction and prepares to investigate its origin in the Department of Engineering.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_40_51.zh:
琳奈向你坦白了她的身份：她来自新联邦，曾是一个生活在“无法地带”，受政府雇佣的佣兵。在执行某次任务时，琳奈意外获得现场死者的录取通知书，她将它视作逃离组织的机会，顶替死去“琳奈”的身份，来到了星炬学院。
但让她没有想到的是，那位被她顶替身份的“琳奈”是残星会准备安插在学院中的内应，为了留在这个已经让她产生归属感的学院，她主动向你提出合作，与你联手追查事情的真相，阻止残星会的阴谋。
琳奈拿出了那个令海维夏失控的仪器，打算先去工学部调查线索。

datamine:InfoDisplay_11070102_Text.title: Work Log
datamine:InfoDisplay_11070102_Text.text: Last month, while taking inventory in the yard, I spotted a spider web. Normally, I would have cleared it but this one was different. Its intricate design drew me in, with expanding polygons that seemed to follow a calculated pattern. It reminded me of a legendary tale - that TDs are attracted to similar frequencies. In that moment, I felt a connection to the spider and its creation. I couldn't bring myself to destroy it, hoping no one else would disturb its beauty. I wonder if the spider and I share a similar frequency?
datamine:InfoDisplay_11070102_Text.zh:
《港口工作日记》 佚名

大约是在上个月的某个午后，我在堆场清点货物，低下头，发现蜘蛛结了张网。正当要像往常一样清理它的时候……我发现那张网的形状如此规律，若精密计算过的、逐级扩张的多边形，我为它深深着迷了！
我听过一个美丽的传说，残象会被相近的频率吸引，那一刻我仿佛也被戳中了什么！噢，也许那只蜘蛛亦拥有与我相近的“频率”？
最终，我小心翼翼地避免破坏那只蜘蛛的网，希望其他人不会发现它……

datamine:InfoDisplay_133002005_Text.title: Gondola
datamine:InfoDisplay_133002005_Text.text:
A common boat-shaped Echo in Ragunna.

Ragunna's intricate network of waterways, coupled with its narrow streets and rugged terrain surrounding the city has made Gondolas the preferred choice for transporting both people and goods. For most Ragunnesi, they offer a peaceful, smooth alternative to the discomfort of navigating crowded streets or bumpy countryside roads.

Beneath their unassuming exterior, Gondolas are highly intelligent and deeply emotional. They communicate through distinct vocal frequencies, expressing their moods or responding to the command of their gondolier. Some, through specialized training, can even climb waterfalls.
datamine:InfoDisplay_133002005_Text.zh:
一种在拉古那随处可见的船形声骸。
拉古那城坐落于水面之上，城市内外水网纵横，而受限于城市建造时的规模，拉古那的街道较为狭窄，城外地势也崎岖不平。因此，贡多拉成为了人们出行，或运输货物的最佳选择。
比起乘坐陆上交通工具，在狭窄的街道或颠簸的郊外旅行，大多数拉古那人都宁愿乘坐贡多拉，享受一段闲适而充满诗意的水上旅途。
与第一印象不同，贡多拉实际上是一种具有较高智力，且情感丰富的声骸。它们能够通过不同频率的叫声来表达出自己的情绪，或是对船夫的命令进行回应。经过特殊训练的贡多拉甚至可以逆激流而上攀登瀑布。

datamine:InfoDisplay_186700013_Text.title: Ragunna Echoes Archive
datamine:InfoDisplay_186700013_Text.text:

Ragunna Echoes Archive

...The energy of the Common Echoes comes from the Sentinel and unknown realms deeper than the ocean.

With the Sentinel's guidance, the Order of the Deep swiftly gained control of the Common Echoes and used them to guide Their people...

[…]

There is an immediate need to upgrade the frequency-cutting technology to reduce the time needed to cut and merge different TD frequencies, ultimately establishing a mass-production line for creating Echoes of diverse forms and abilities...

[…]

The Common Echoes they created would remain in a perpetual frequency-aggregate state within the boundaries of Rinascita, only to be disassembled under rare circumstances.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_186700013_Text.zh:
……公共声骸的能量来自岁主的馈赠以及那比海底更深的未知领域中蕴藏的纯净能量，经过岁主指引，隐海修会很快拥有了掌控公共声骸的能力，并以此帮助祂引导人民……

……出现了第一次公共声骸需求告急的情况，私运、私购声骸事件已在城内贵族中出现，急需更新频率剪切技术，降低剪切桥接不同残象频率过程所消耗的时间，最终完成批量创造形态、能力各异的声骸流水生产线……

……隐海修会已获得对超距聚合技术的直接控制权，自此之后，隐海修会创造的公共声骸将在黎那汐塔境内永续维持频率聚合状态，除非出现特殊状况，隐海修会才会将声骸回收销毁，公共声骸在突破时空限制上更进一步，稳定性也大幅提升……

……反对意见增加趋势明显，隐海修会针对这一现状制造出了新型声骸：卫冕节使。作为修会无处不在的眼睛和令人无法反抗的双手，这些新型声骸的出现，提升了人们对普通公共声骸的信任……

……对试验场中生产的声骸进行意识植入与塑造试验初见成效，但初始样本的试验数据还不能复用于任何种类的公共声骸，意识稳定性仍待提升……

datamine:InfoDisplay_186700024_Text.title: Fabricatorium of the Deep Summary Report (Extract)
datamine:InfoDisplay_186700024_Text.text:
The production of Echoes in Anima Cradle has doubled, with defective outputs reduced to 1.5%.
The transport pipelines in the Fallen Grave's disposal zone have been optimized to ensure a more efficient transfer of recycled frequencies to the Energy Hub for storage.
Routine inspections of Lumen Tower's control center have been completed, and no irregularities have been detected.
datamine:InfoDisplay_186700024_Text.zh:
「生灵显地」区域声骸产量已成功实现翻倍，残次品占比低至1.5％。
已优化「千殁沉岛」销毁区域输送管道，使其更有利于将可回收频率运至能源储存区域「蓄能中枢」。
「涌明高塔」控制中心日常检修已完成，并无异常。

datamine:InfoDisplay_21020109_Text.title: Research Log
datamine:InfoDisplay_21020109_Text.text:
Specimen Name: ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇

Specimen Description: A sub-species of the Spearback Tacet Discord obtained from the ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇ region. Its strength and agility far surpass that of other Spearbacks. After receiving authorization, the expedition team successfully captured this specimen, with plans to use it for further research.

Specimen Status: Active. A dedicated experimental zone has been established for this specimen by the research team.
Experiment Plan: N/A
Experiment Goal: To reconfigure the frequencies that led to the formation of the specimen's abnormal physique, and attempt to apply the findings to other Echoes in order to enhance their performances.
datamine:InfoDisplay_21020109_Text.zh:
样本名称：▇▇▇▇▇
样本描述：从▇▇▇▇▇地区获得的箭簇熊亚种残象样本。其力量与敏捷性均远超同类残象。在获得授权后，分遣队成功捕获了该残象，计划将其用于后续研究。
样本状态：存活。研究组为该残象建立了独立实验区。
实验方案：略
实验目的：将导致该样本出现异常体质的频率进行重组，尝试运用于声骸，以改良声骸性能。

datamine:InfoDisplay_31000020_Text.title: "Archive: Tacet Discord"
datamine:InfoDisplay_31000020_Text.text:
[…]

[Entry]  
Tacet Discord

[Known Types]  
Whisperin, Howler, Tranquilite, Clamorling, Staticoid

[Overview] 
Ever since the emergence of the Waveworn Phenomenon, humanity has been fixated on researching the enigma known as the Tacet Discords.

These entities are seen as sources of destruction and embodiments of chaotic energy.

[…]

As time passes, this gap in knowledge will only widen, resulting in the gradual decay and eventual annihilation of these discords.

To sustain itself, the Tacet Discords possess an instinctual drive to consume and merge with other frequencies, in a constant battle to maintain its existence.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_31000020_Text.zh:
【名称】
 残象
 
 【分类】
 呓语种，啸叫种，静默种，轰鸣种，噪声种等
 
 【档案历史】
 自海蚀现象诞生起，人类对残象的研究便不曾停止。它是毁灭的具象化，是混乱能量的构成体。
 就目前学界的主流观点来看，残象是由一系列信息频率构成的生物体，但由于不知名的原因，构成它们的信息存在缺失。
 随着时间推移，这份信息频率的缺口将不断扩大，它们自身也将逐渐衰减，走向毁灭。
 为了维系自身的存在，残象有着吞噬、融合频率来补全自身的本能。
 
 【附录索引：《档案：声骸》】
 在灭亡之际，残象的频率不会立刻消失，而会逐渐衰减，这些残留的频率可以被捕捉与利用。
 当捕捉并储存的频率达到一定量时，可用于模拟原本残象的能力。
 而这种击溃残象后残余的足以复现残象能力的频率，便被称之为声骸。

datamine:InfoDisplay_31000023_Text.title: Tattered Diary
datamine:InfoDisplay_31000023_Text.text:
[…]

(smudged water stains) 
If only I weren't so weak, I could've driven away those Tacet Discords...

[…]

Father said I can manipulate the frequencies of Tacet Discords...

[…]

But if anyone finds out about the truth — that Sissi, who went missing, actually died trying to protect me, and then I turned her into a horrifying Tacet Discord...

[…]

But I am trapped, like a moth to a flame, unable to escape this dark path.

[…]

If I must pay the price for Qichi Village...

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_31000023_Text.zh:
6.19
今天家里来了一个奇怪的哥哥，他很友好，但是不知道为什么，那种友好和村里的家人不太一样……他似乎知道很多我的事情，说‘我们是同类’，还给我讲很奇怪的童话。童话的结局有点可怕……那位哥哥却说现实比故事要更加残酷，还问我，如果我就是故事中的小黑羊会怎么办，我不知道怎么回答，他只留下一句”下次再来看我“就消失了。我把这件事告诉父亲，父亲却说，根本没有来过这样的人……他究竟是谁呢？
……
7.20
抱歉……对不起……（钢笔写下的字体被水渍洇开）如果不是我太弱了 我没办法驱离那几只残象 如果不是要保护我……
一定还会有办法的，父亲说我的共鸣能力能够操纵残象转化残象的频率，小西你现在的样子只是暂时的……我会用尽全力让你恢复到原本的样子。我知道你还有意识。
父亲答应了我，他那么厉害，一定能帮我找到挽救这一切的办法
……
12.17
距离那件事发生已经三个月了。
养父似乎完全忘记了我有写日记的习惯……这个日记本还是他送给我的。如果被他知道我在日记里记录这些，大概会勃然大怒吧。
养父命令我必须听从他的指令，操纵重组残象的频率。如果事情一旦败露，失踪的小西实际上是为了保护我死亡，又被我变成了残象这件事……足以让我被当作怪物杀死。我会被大家驱逐，没有人会理解、接纳我这样可怕的能力……除了他。
就算是逝去的生命……真的能够通过频率重组而重新回到我身边吗？如果真有那种可能性，到那时，在那躯壳之中破碎的灵魂，又会被缝补成什么样子呢？
我不知道。
……
2.8
我总觉得越来越不安……村子里的人越来越少……而养父带回来的那些残象……
一定是错误的，我有这样的预感，自己行走在一条无法通向未来的道路上，却无法逃脱，无法停下来。
我不知道养父到底做了什么……村里死气沉沉又一触即发的氛围是出自什么缘由。我已经很久不被允许出门了，每当我问及这些时，他都只是敷衍我几句。
如果实现我愿望的前提是更多血腥的代价……
……
（没有写日期）
家门外被村民们围堵了。
看样子是事情败露了。
杀人犯……那是在叫我吗？还是养父？
又有什么区别呢？
事到如今……有人可以来救救我吗？
如果祈池村必须要以我为代价……
如果有神…

yakita:InfoDisplay_133002014_Text.text:
The Remnant Creature dwelling within Nimbus Sanctum. Legend holds that it was Lorelei's power that restrained the violent sea of clouds, sparing Ragunna from flooding.

Lorelei has the ability to cleanse the dark frequencies within the clouds, but she is not immune to their corrosive influence. As they accumulate to a breaking point, Lorelei will eventually become the Queen of the Night, unleashing her wrath upon all life that comes near.
yakita:InfoDisplay_133002014_Text.zh:
居住在氤柔水境的回音生物。传说中，正是罗蕾莱的力量约束了狂暴的云海，使得拉古那城免遭被淹没的厄运。
罗蕾莱具有净化云海中负面情绪的能力，但她本身也会受到这些恶念的影响。当这些恶念累积到临界点时，罗蕾莱便会成为「夜之女皇」，将怒火倾泻到任何附近的一切生物身上。

yakita:ItemInfo_42601180_BgDescription.text:
A mineral soaked in the waters of Nimbus Sanctum, its surface gleaming with an iridescent sheen. Resonant Calcite is an excellent conductor of Remnant Energy.
The origins of Resonant Calcite are still debated. Some believe its unique properties come from prolonged exposure to the flow of frequencies in Nimbus Sanctum, while others argue that these frequencies seeped into geological fissures, where they influenced the mineral's formation.
yakita:ItemInfo_42601180_BgDescription.zh:
长期浸淬于氤柔水境中的矿物，矿体呈现为变幻莫测的珠光釉质，是传导回音能量的天然介质。
关于云母釉岩的形成原因，学界尚未达成共识：一说云海能量经年累月的冲刷，改变了矿物内质的排列结构，使其发生了质地变化；另一说为云海渗入地质的裂隙后，经板块的挤压后形成。

yakita:Term260003_Desc.text: A unique Resonance Ability of Qiuyuan. By perceiving the nature and differences of surrounding frequencies, he can discern an enemy's location and even state of mind. In extreme cases, this perception can be amplified through Sonoro Spheres, bringing to life the mental imagery of his enemies—or even his own.
yakita:Term260003_Desc.zh: 仇远拥有的特殊共鸣能力。通过感知周围频率的性质和差异，勘破敌人的位置甚至心境。在极端情况下，这种感知可以藉由其他的索诺拉被进一步强化，将敌人或是仇远自己的心境外化为短暂存在的场景。

yakita:FavorStory_160105_Content.text:

In the midst of chaos, Taoqi's soft voice can always calm the storm.

[…]

As Taoqi walks home, she enjoys strolling through the streets of Jinzhou and chatting with its residents.

She loves hearing stories from elders about the city's history and having lighthearted conversations with children that remind her of the hope within Jinzhou.

[…]

Once in the past, the Midnight Rangers were always struggling to defend against surprise attacks from the Tacet Discords.

[…]

As she watched children playing in a sandpit, an idea came to her - just like how they filled the gaps in their sandcastles, they could also fill the gaps in the frontlines.

She proposed building a sand wall at the frontline during Tacet Discord assaults.

[…]

With fewer spots to defend, the Midnight Rangers would have more time to assess each attack and respond accordingly based on the varying frequencies caused by sand deformation.

yakita:FavorStory_160105_Content.zh:
工作就是工作，生活就是生活，一定要界限分明，否则就会什么也做不好。
这是桃祈的一贯作风，在今州内，似乎没有什么事能阻止她准时下班。
天工部人来人往，大家常常都因为手里的事情忙的不可开交，在快速翻动文件的嘈杂声中，总会传出一声细语突然将节奏慢了下来。
”到点了，终于可以回家咯。”
“桃祈前辈，等等，这是刚刚发下来的新文件，可能需要您处理一下。”
“诶？嗯……我看看，不是什么大事，那……明天再说吧。”
脱离工作后的桃祈有独特的”休闲“方式，对于她来说，“休闲”可不单是闭上眼睡大觉，也可能是一次随性的漫游。
回家的路上，她喜欢漫步在街头，观察着今州城的一草一木，也会与今州的大家闲聊谈心。有时，会是一位老人的长谈，诉说着城市的变迁；有时也会是一个孩子的童言趣语，让桃祈感受到未来的希望。“休闲”的生活方式就像一颗颗珍珠，串联起了她与这座城市的联系，也默默地成就了她的工作。
过去，前线的夜归军在面对残象突袭时由于防线过长，而短时间内无法做出判断及时堵住突破口，常常被各地的残象所牵制住，为此夜归军曾向天工寻求解决之法，这件案子的负责人也自然落在了在天工里人气上升的桃祈身上。被问题困住的她坐在秋千之上散心，意外地在孩子们修补沙堡的过程中发现了答案的足迹，哪里有缺口，就补哪里。她照着自己的奇思妙想在前线巧立了一堵沙墙，在残象潮对沙墙发动大规模攻击时，反而缩短了防线长度，限制了它们的进攻路径，只能对沙墙一点或几点打开突破口，而夜归军则根据沙子因形变产生的不同频率来判断突破口的攻击程度，便有了充足的反应时间和应对方式。
在桃祈看来，埋头于天工部苦干，面对的只会是枯燥的文字和一成不变的图形，想要找到正确的方向和更高效率的工作方式，还需要通过其它途径。也许，正是在工作后的那段时间里，她从这些不起眼的地方找到了无形的帮助与指引。

yakita:GuideLZDG02_3_3.text: Drawing on the mechanics of the Thorncrown Rises and the Remnant Energy within Nimbus Sanctum, I have recreated powerful frequencies from various dimensions.

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_11.text: Oops. My mistake. Poor choice of words. How about I put it in a way you prefer... A war-born curse? Frequencies that got a little corrupted?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_11.zh: 噢，抱歉抱歉，是我用词不对，不然换个你喜欢的说法吧……战争降下的诅咒？频率的异常？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_30.text: Every perfumer knows a craft called "refinement." Perhaps I can learn from it. Draw out their corrupted frequencies.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_30.zh: 调香师会一种名为“精炼”的工艺，也许我能效仿这种方法，提炼出他们被污染的频率。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_57.text: But... here's the thing! After everything you've been through, not a single trace of those nasty frequencies stuck to you. You're still you.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_57.zh: 不过……好神奇！经历了这一切，你丝毫没有被那些异常的频率污染，依旧维持着正常的模样。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_57.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_161_1.text: I've gotten the hang of extracting those corrupted frequencies now. The first fallen soldier should be arriving any time...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_161_1.zh: 提炼污秽频率的方法我大致已经掌握了，第一位亡魂战士快到了……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_43.zh: 我清除了你吸收的所有“污秽频率”，你没有必要变成怪物了，我还需要你活下去。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_29.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束2_10_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_29.text: Lily answers your questions one by one. The battlefield you crossed was part of the Resonator War, and she and the other passengers all died in that conflict. Their lingering frequencies were tainted by the suffering and resentment of war, preventing their souls from finding peace. Unlike the other passengers, who retain only fragments of their memories, Lily remembers everything. She has discovered that the train travels endlessly between battlefields, drawing fallen soldiers aboard. As she did in life, she now tends to their psychological wounds, drawing on her experience as a military medic. In time, she has found that when a soul's trauma is fully healed, it transforms into a lily.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_29.zh: 关于你提出的问题，莉莉一一向你解答。你穿越的那片战场是共鸣者战争的一角，而莉莉和列车上的其他人都是在那场战争中死去的人。他们死后的频率被战争中的苦痛、怨恨污染，所以灵魂未得到安息。莉莉是列车上最特殊的亡魂，其他亡魂只记得生前部分记忆，而莉莉记得所有。她发现这辆列车会不断穿梭在战场里，吸引死去的战士登上列车。于是她开始效仿生前，利用军医的身份去治疗战士们的创伤，渐渐地，她发现精神创伤被完全治愈的亡魂会变成百合花。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_77_8.text: (They're all trapped in fragments of their own memories. And as their frequencies fade, they forget more and more. Until there's nothing left.)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_77_8.zh: （他们看上去，都被困在自己的一小段记忆里了，并且因为频率的衰减，忘记的东西越来越多，直至消失……）

yakita:Side_HSMY_1_14.text: Although you managed to halt the Ovathrax's hatching, its residual frequencies are still spreading from Norfall Barrens.
yakita:Side_HSMY_1_14.zh: 尽管无相燹主的孵化已经被你阻止，但它残留的频率，正在以北落野为圆心不断扩散。

yakita:LoadingTipsText_201204_TipsText.text: Once a forest-thick fjordland in the frigid zone, this region was home to the nomadic Roya. Then came Lahai-Roi's first recorded Lament that triggered a geomagnetic pole shift. The land was transformed into the new polar extremity of Solaris, buried beneath endless snow and ice. The violent shift also dragged near-orbit satellites and space stations from the sky. Their wreckage still litters the frostlands to this day.
yakita:LoadingTipsText_201204_TipsText.zh: 原为一片寒带峡湾，地表分布着广袤的森林，罗伊人在此游牧栖居。拉海洛记载的第1次悲鸣引起地磁极变化，此地成为新的索拉里斯之极，被一望无际的冰雪覆盖。磁极变化引发索拉里斯地外的近地卫星与空间站坠落，至今仍可在冰原地表发现大量残骸。

yakita:InfoDisplay_121000001_Text.zh:
4月8日
医师建议伏翎出院修养，姑息治疗。
伏翎笑着说这并不是放弃，她还有很多想去的地方，想和我继续去探索那些我们曾经一起约定去看的奇景。
……我明白她其实并没有抱什么期望，但只要她能开心，我愿意实现她的任何心愿。
况且，我还没有放弃。

4月15日
伏翎说我们可以分工合作，她来调查这个病存在的治愈案例和有可能找到特效药的地方，我来规划行程。伏翎查到的地方有一些在很偏远的州城，我担心她的身体吃不消，但她很坚持，说自己还能跑能跳。
我会照顾好她，我不想让她失望。

5月1日
我们拜访了明庭的那位名医，但她也表示对这种罕见病症束手无策。
没关系，我们去下一个地方，一定还有希望。

5月30日
到现在还是没有找到真正有效的治疗方法，她的身体状况越来越差，已经不能走太远的路了。我从先行公约借来了投影设备，她很喜欢。
我仍然忘不了她看着那些虚拟风景的时候眼中的向往和难过，即使她掩饰得很好。

6月13日
伏翎说，希望我记录下沿途的风景发给她，因为这样就是和我一起旅行了。我知道她是在用自己的方式安慰我，但我自己早都已经无心去看那些风景。

6月15日
必经之路上形成了无音区，我只能绕远避开，却因此在树林深处发现了一片非常美丽的湖泊。
那是难以用言语形容的景色，风吹落树上的花瓣，带来一场缤纷的雨，就连手中的相机都无法承载那样绚烂的色彩，在那一瞬间，我忘掉了现实中的一切，完全沉浸在奇景带来的震撼里。
但震撼之后是巨大的恐惧和悲伤，现在根本就不是在意这些的时候，我的身边没有她。
或许是巧合，在这几次寻药的过程中，我总是能路过很多我曾经计划想要探险的地方，有些甚至连伏翎也不知道，那些景色是我想要留给她的惊喜。
如果是伏翎，一定能完完整整地画出那些地方最美丽的样子，只要经由她手，哪怕是灰败寂寥的废墟，都能绽放出更富生机的色彩。
……如果她也能在这里，该多好。

6月16日
遇到了一个可疑的红衣人，装腔作势的样子让人有些不适，他对我讲了一个奇怪的传说，意有所指。
他知道我们的事情，甚至还说知道让伏翎活下去的方法，他告诉的信息似乎真假参半，还说只有我答应他们的条件才会告诉我更多事情，我不知道该不…

yakita:InfoDisplay_121000002_Text.text:

My Dearest Wuli,

[…]

In this world scarred by the Lament, beauty and hope persist, sprouting anew from the depths of despair.

[…]

Fuling
yakita:InfoDisplay_121000002_Text.zh:
当你看到这则留言的时候，是否还在继续我们的旅程呢？
抱歉……或许你已经察觉到了，那些我以寻药为由调查到的位置里，有很多是曾经我们有计划探险的地方。我希望你寻找和看到的，一直是那些让我们魂牵梦萦的风景。毕竟……我自己的身体状况，我再清楚不过了。
我希望梧黎能回想起刚开始踏上旅程的心情，还有我们的愿望。我们曾经一起去过很多地方，记录过许多在毁灭中新生的事物，我们想让更多人看到那些奇景，这个星球在悲鸣中变得满目疮痍，但正因如此那些新生之物才如此美丽。
记得我们总是能在旅程中遇到很多很好的朋友，我们会在同行一段时间后分别，或许还能够在下一趟旅程中与他们相遇，也或许那就是我们的最后一次见面，但我们从来没有因为离别而失去继续向前探险的勇气，不是吗？
那么这一次，也是一样的。
我们终会离别，但也终会重逢，请你不要停下脚步……继续将我们共同的愿望带向未来吧。

yakita:Character_ChangLi_20_10.speaker: Youning

yakita:Character_ChangLi_20_12.text: Yes, Fuling, his girlfriend. I think they're visiting Hongzhen together. They're staying at the inn over there.
yakita:Character_ChangLi_20_12.zh: 啊，伏翎是他的恋人，这次也和他一起来虹镇了，就在那边的旅馆落脚。
yakita:Character_ChangLi_20_12.speaker: Youning

yakita:Character_ChangLi_20_13.text: Oh, Fuling asked us about his whereabouts not long ago. She seemed quite worried.
yakita:Character_ChangLi_20_13.zh: 伏翎不久前还来打听他的消息，看上去挺担心的。
yakita:Character_ChangLi_20_13.speaker: Youning

yakita:Character_ChangLi_20_15.text: No, I'm not going... Fuling... She's waiting for me...
yakita:Character_ChangLi_20_15.zh: 不，不去医馆……伏翎……她在等我……
yakita:Character_ChangLi_20_15.speaker: Wuli

yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_19.text: May I please ask... what on earth happened? I've never seen Wuli like that...
yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_19.zh: 请问……究竟发生了什么？我从来没有见过梧黎那副样子……
yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_19.speaker: Fuling

yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_26.text: It's not unusual for Wuli to be out of touch for a few days when he goes on long trips. This time, however, seemed longer than usual. If it weren't for you two showing up, I would have asked the Midnight Rangers to help me search for him in the mountains.
yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_26.zh: 因为他经常出远门，三四日无音讯的情况也是常事，只是这次实在太久，如果不是两位及时出现，我就要去请求夜归军带我进山寻人了……
yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_26.speaker: Fuling

yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_29.text: I used to work as a landscape painter. Wuli and I met through work, and we traveled to many places together.
yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_29.zh: 我原本是一个风景画师，因为工作和梧黎结识，我们一起游历了很多地方。
yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_29.speaker: Fuling

yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_30.text: A few months ago, I got really sick. It affected my ability to walk, which got worse over time. We couldn't go on our adventures like we used to. Wuli stopped taking on work and traveled all over the world to find a cure for me.
yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_30.zh: 半年前我生了一场重病，行动越来越困难，已经不能像以前那样和他一起探险写生……梧黎就推掉了所有委托，为我四处寻医问药。
yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_30.speaker: Fuling

yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_38.text: Yes... Wuli told me that he's researched and found an untouched paradise on Mt. Firmament. A place where time stands still. He said if I lived there, my condition would never worsen...
yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_38.zh: 嗯……梧黎说，他查阅了很多资料，得知乘霄山中有一片不被打扰的世外桃源，那里有着永恒停滞的时间，只要在那里生活，我的病就永远也不会恶化。
yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_38.speaker: Fuling

yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_43.text: Those were my thoughts as well, but Wuli seemed very certain.
yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_43.zh: 我原本也是这样猜测，但梧黎非常肯定地对我说，他寻找的那个传说是真实存在的。
yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_43.speaker: Fuling

yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_61.text: Once Wuli wakes up, I'll explain everything to him.
yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_61.zh: 等梧黎醒来的时候，我会和他好好解释的。
yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_61.speaker: Fuling

yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_7.text: Wuli... You're hurt?! I've been looking for you... You didn't pick up my calls...
yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_7.zh: 你……你受伤了？！我一直在找你，你的终端一直没有回应……
yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_7.speaker: Fuling

yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_70.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_1_角色_长离线_1_17
yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_70.text: At the hotel, you meet Fuling, the gravely ill girlfriend of the adventurer Wuli. He had gone into the mountains seeking a way to slow her condition but mistakenly believed that the Temporal Disruptions held the key to immortality. Accepting her fate, Fuling pleads with you to put a stop to the dangerous Disruptions.
yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_70.zh: 你们在旅馆见到了等待梧黎的少女伏翎。原来伏翎身患重疾，梧黎进山是为了找延缓她病情的办法。他很可能将山中的时间乱流误认为了传说中的「长生秘法」。伏翎并不在意能否得救，反而拜托你们解决危险的时间乱流。

yakita:Character_ChangLi_22_23.text: About Fuling's attitude towards all of this...

yakita:Character_ChangLi_59_2.text: Wuli, this is the miracle we've been waiting to see! It's hope reborn after destruction...
yakita:Character_ChangLi_59_2.zh: 梧黎，这就是我们一直想要追寻的，跨越毁灭后新生的奇景啊。
yakita:Character_ChangLi_59_2.speaker: Fuling

yakita:Character_ChangLi_59_20.text: Wuli is fine now, thanks to his doctor's help. As for me... Well, at least I can still walk a bit.
yakita:Character_ChangLi_59_20.zh: 多亏了医生，梧黎已经没有大碍了，至于我……现在多少还是能走一些路的。
yakita:Character_ChangLi_59_20.speaker: Fuling

yakita:Character_ChangLi_59_27.text: As for the truth behind the so-called Secret of Immortality... Fuling has told me everything.
yakita:Character_ChangLi_59_27.zh: 至于那长生秘法的真相……伏翎已经和我说过了。
yakita:Character_ChangLi_59_27.speaker: Wuli

yakita:Character_ChangLi_59_30.text: I've talked about it with Fuling. From now on, I'll take her on more trips to see more new places together.
yakita:Character_ChangLi_59_30.zh: 我已经和伏翎谈过了，从今以后，我还会带她继续去更多地方，探索更多风景。
yakita:Character_ChangLi_59_30.speaker: Wuli

yakita:Character_ChangLi_81_6.text: Wuli is an experienced adventurer, always wary of hidden dangers. He's highly cautious and never lets his communication get cut off.
yakita:Character_ChangLi_81_6.zh: 梧黎是经验丰富的探险家，他最常说的一句话就是“越是美丽的奇景就意味着成倍的危险”，他从来都是谨慎的，绝对不会让自己陷入通讯断绝的境地。
yakita:Character_ChangLi_81_6.speaker: Fuling

yakita:Character_ChangLi_81_8.text: However, since I became unable to accompany him on his journeys, Wuli has given up chasing his dreams.
yakita:Character_ChangLi_81_8.zh: 可自从我不再能与和他一起行动，他就再也没有关注过他曾经想要追寻的梦想……
yakita:Character_ChangLi_81_8.speaker: Fuling

yakita:LNXTSJZL_2_8.text: Rinascita has always been on our list. Fuling talked about painting the sunset in Ragunna City and visiting the Salotto Open Air Gallery.
yakita:LNXTSJZL_2_8.zh: 以前，我们就想来黎那汐塔看看，伏翎还说过，要画下拉古那城的日落，还想去萨尔洛托露天画廊看看。
yakita:LNXTSJZL_2_8.speaker: Wuli

yakita:LNXTSJZL_4_2.text: Some notes on them are really interesting. Fuling even marked them.
yakita:LNXTSJZL_4_2.zh: 这上面的备注很有意思，伏翎还特地标记出来了。
yakita:LNXTSJZL_4_2.speaker: Wuli

yakita:STNPC_RCGCST_28_1.text: Miss Fuling's illness is really something else...
yakita:STNPC_RCGCST_28_1.zh: 那位叫伏翎的姑娘的病真是少见……

yakita:STNPC_RCGCST_29_4.text: He even told the person beside him that thanks to Fuling, he actually got to see the sunrise over Xuanfang Hold for once.
yakita:STNPC_RCGCST_29_4.zh: 他还跟旁边的人说，多亏有了伏翎，他才能早起看到玄方城的日出。

yakita:Side_QZFZZFHXM_23_2.text: I know the two of you grew up together, Fuling. But...
yakita:Side_QZFZZFHXM_23_2.zh: 我知道你和他从小就认识，但是……

yakita:Side_QZFZZFHXM_24_2.text: I know the two of you grew up together, Fuling. But look around! Where is he? Where is this caravan? Where is our money?!
yakita:Side_QZFZZFHXM_24_2.zh: 我知道你和他从小就认识，浮绫。但他和他说的那支商队在哪呢？我们的钱又在哪？

yakita:Side_QZFZZFHXM_25_1.text: (This should be the place where Fuling last saw Jianji.)
yakita:Side_QZFZZFHXM_25_1.zh: （这应该就是浮绫最后见到简集的地方。）
yakita:Side_QZFZZFHXM_25_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:LGNCZST_34_15.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_5
yakita:LGNCZST_34_15.text: ...I see. Thank you for your contribution to the Order, Mr. Fulmine.
yakita:LGNCZST_34_15.zh: ……可以。感谢您为修会的贡献，斐林先生。

yakita:LGNCZST_34_9.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_5
yakita:LGNCZST_34_9.text: This is Fulmine from the Pioneer Association. You may have heard of me.
yakita:LGNCZST_34_9.zh: 我是先行公约的斐林，您应该听说过我。

yakita:XJXYSDJ_41_4.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院商业街生态_42_1
yakita:XJXYSDJ_41_4.text: Haha, Mr. Fulmine, my colleague, mentioned you.
yakita:XJXYSDJ_41_4.zh: 哈哈，是从我的同事“斐林”先生那听说的。
yakita:XJXYSDJ_41_4.speaker: Hermann

yakita:ItemInfo_70140039_BgDescription.text:
A photo captured by Fulmine, recording the moment you shared the curtain call with your companions.
You can zoom in to view the photo.
yakita:ItemInfo_70140039_BgDescription.zh:
一张由斐林拍摄的照片，记录了你与伙伴们一同谢幕时的情景。
可放大查看。

yakita:CJBOC_8_2.text: You look where Fulmine points to—some Plushies are playing as knights, wielding the rock-hard, dry baton bread Old Bake made as swords.
yakita:CJBOC_8_2.zh: 你看向斐林手指的方向，布偶们正在用老焙烤出来的面包玩骑士游戏。又干又硬的面包用来做骑士剑正合适。

yakita:CJBOC_9_3.text: (Did Fulmine help them take this photo? I should ask him about this.)
yakita:CJBOC_9_3.zh: （是斐林给他们拍的吗，问问他吧）
yakita:CJBOC_9_3.speaker: Rover

yakita:GFKTZ_1_2.chapter: 剧情_3_0_支线_不只是装饰而已_1_1
yakita:GFKTZ_1_2.text: Mr. Fulmine from Ragunna mentioned you in a postcard he sent me.
yakita:GFKTZ_1_2.zh: 拉古那的斐林先生寄给我的明信片里，提到过您。

yakita:GFKTZ_1_8.chapter: 剧情_3_0_支线_不只是装饰而已_1_1
yakita:GFKTZ_1_8.text: That way, I'd have some actual printed photos to send back to Mr. Fulmine.
yakita:GFKTZ_1_8.zh: 这样我也有能够打印出来的照片寄回给斐林先生了。

yakita:GFKTZ_2_4.chapter: 剧情_3_0_支线_不只是装饰而已_2_1
yakita:GFKTZ_2_4.text: Are you friends with Mr. Fulmine fom Ragunna?
yakita:GFKTZ_2_4.zh: 你和拉古那城的斐林先生是朋友吗？
yakita:GFKTZ_2_4.speaker: Rover

yakita:GNNPC_LGNC_1_12.chapter: 剧情_黎那汐塔基础功能NPC_1_1
yakita:GNNPC_LGNC_1_12.text: Pleasure to meet you! I am Fulmine, the head of the Wutherium Film Studio. We are the visual production division of the Pioneer Association.
yakita:GNNPC_LGNC_1_12.zh: 很高兴认识您！我是拉古那城先行公约旗下“潮汐影像工作室”的主理人，斐林。
yakita:GNNPC_LGNC_1_12.speaker: Fulmine

yakita:GNNPC_QQCDST_23_3.chapter: 剧情_2_4_支线_彩蛋NPC对话+包装_3_2
yakita:GNNPC_QQCDST_23_3.text: You tell Fulmine what happened at the Plushie Village in Septimont.
yakita:GNNPC_QQCDST_23_3.zh: 你将发生在七丘布偶村的事情和斐林讲述了一下。

yakita:GNNPC_QQCDST_23_9.chapter: 剧情_2_4_支线_彩蛋NPC对话+包装_3_2
yakita:GNNPC_QQCDST_23_9.text: After Fulmine hangs up, Tubpup looks at you, eyes filled with anticipation.
yakita:GNNPC_QQCDST_23_9.zh: 斐林挂断电话后，浴缸犬看着你，露出了期待的眼神。

yakita:LNXTSXYD_3_4.text: Oh, sorry, you're right. Mr. Fulmine also taught me that "It's the glimmer of each and every soul that forges the glories in history."
yakita:LNXTSXYD_3_4.zh: 抱歉抱歉，您说得对。斐林前辈也教过我，“历史之所以璀璨，是因为每个灵魂都在闪光。”

yakita:LNXTSXYD_4_3.text: Mr. Fulmine and I have been grabbing as many Caskets as we can, but it's still not enough to power the painting fully. That's why we need your help.
yakita:LNXTSXYD_4_3.zh: 过去一段时间，我和斐林前辈已经把我们能找到的声匣都收集了过来，但距离让声骸画完全恢复还有一定距离，所以才想要请您帮忙。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_26.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_20_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_26.text: Don't be hard on yourself, Mr. Fulmine. You've been a tremendous help. At least we're not flying blind anymore. But 漂泊者, we need a new plan.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_26.zh: 已经很了不起了，斐林先生，至少我们不用像无头呼咻咻那样漫无目的地乱撞，让我们再想想有没有什么别的线索……
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_26.speaker: Zani

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_3.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_20_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_3.text: No, I'm here for something else. This is Mr. Fulmine from the Pioneer Association.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_3.zh: 今天是为了别的事……这是先行公约的斐林先生。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_3.speaker: Zani

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_4.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_20_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_4.text: Oh, hello! You've brought a new friend! Pleasure to meet you. I'm Fulmine, head of the Wutherium Film Studio under the Pioneer Association in Ragunna. How should I address you?
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_4.zh: 哎呀，您带来了新朋友……您好，我是拉古那城先行公约旗下“潮汐影像工作室”的主理人，斐林。该怎么称呼您？
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_4.speaker: Fulmine

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_14.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_21_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_14.text: You elaborate on the mask design you saw in Fulmine's memory to Nyarla.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_27_14.zh: 向奈亚拉详细描述了在斐林的回忆中看到的面具样式。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_31_2.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_26_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_31_2.text: He looks like the man we saw in Mr. Fulmine's memory. Isn't that Gilberto?
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_31_2.zh: 和照片里的人很相似，难道是吉尔贝？
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_31_2.speaker: Zani

yakita:ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_16.chapter: 剧情_2_2_支线_布偶小队历险记_2_1
yakita:ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_16.text: You find a Seaside Cendrelis from your bag and hand it over to Fulmine.
yakita:ZX_BOXDLXJ_2_16.zh: 你从背包中翻出了一株海浮棘，递给斐林。

yakita:ZX_BOXDLXJ_3_1.chapter: 剧情_2_2_支线_布偶小队历险记_3_1
yakita:ZX_BOXDLXJ_3_1.text: Fulmine wants me to take pictures of unique views... Wonder where the Plushies want to visit first?
yakita:ZX_BOXDLXJ_3_1.zh: 斐林说想要奇特风景的照片……不知道布偶们想先去哪里看看呢？
yakita:ZX_BOXDLXJ_3_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:jiabeilina_shengtai_2_19.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_嘉贝莉娜_2_7_七丘彩蛋_2_1
yakita:jiabeilina_shengtai_2_19.text: I hear Miss Lupa is the most celebrated Gladiator at the moment? I would enjoy seeing her in action.
yakita:jiabeilina_shengtai_2_19.zh: 我记得，露帕小姐是时下最当红的竞技明星吧？有机会的话，我也想见识下她在赛场上的表现。
yakita:jiabeilina_shengtai_2_19.speaker: Galbrena

yakita:jiabeilina_shengtai_9_13.chapter: 剧情_角色生态_嘉贝莉娜_2_7_4_1
yakita:jiabeilina_shengtai_9_13.text: I think it stands for a power... completely unlike fear.
yakita:jiabeilina_shengtai_9_13.zh: 我想，它代表的……是一种与“恐惧”截然不同的力量。
yakita:jiabeilina_shengtai_9_13.speaker: Galbrena

yakita:AVG_Farewellday_80_12.text: So... when you leave here, keep being honest with yourself. When the time comes to make a choice, don't back down out of fear, and don't let past regrets make you lose sight of what you believe in.
yakita:AVG_Farewellday_80_12.zh: 那么……祝你毕业之后，依然能够诚实地面对自己的心。在该做出选择的时候，不因恐惧而放弃，也不因过去的遗憾而动摇本心。
yakita:AVG_Farewellday_80_12.speaker: Galbrena

yakita:AVG_HAOGANDU_22_14.chapter: 剧情_3.8索拉学院_非邀约角色好感度文本_3_3
yakita:AVG_HAOGANDU_22_14.text: Galbrena spares you a glance, then turns to the bright fire, a smile rising on her face.
yakita:AVG_HAOGANDU_22_14.zh: 嘉贝莉娜看了你一眼，随即看向了明亮的火焰，脸上浮现出微笑。

yakita:AVG_Specialapproval_110_7.chapter: 剧情_3.8索拉学院_特批剧情_1_11
yakita:AVG_Specialapproval_110_7.text: No fear, no crime, no danger that could strike at any moment... Only in a safe world can kids sit in a classroom and study in peace, growing up without a care.
yakita:AVG_Specialapproval_110_7.zh: 没有恐惧，也没有犯罪，没有随时可能降临的危险……一个安全的世界，孩子们才能安心地坐在教室里读书，才能无忧无虑地长大。
yakita:AVG_Specialapproval_110_7.speaker: Galbrena

yakita:FavorGoods_120803_Content.chapter: 嘉贝莉娜档案_珍贵之物
yakita:FavorGoods_120803_Content.text:
[…]

The "first bullet" condensed from Galbrena's own blood.

[…]

During her travels in the Lawless Zone of the New Federation, Galbrena encountered a secret association and learned a brutal technique known as the Blood Pact.

[…]
yakita:FavorGoods_120803_Content.zh:
嘉贝莉娜利用血液凝聚而成的“第一颗子弹”，如今她已将其赠送予你。

在旧日新联邦的“无法之地”游历时，她于一处秘密结社，习得了这项名为“血誓”的“残忍技艺”。学习者或是走投无路的亡命之徒，或是与她相同的沾染黑暗之人。出于各种缘由，他们选择了这样一条“猎人之道”，只求在对抗邪恶的仇敌时，能够以最意想不到的方式发出最致命的一击。嘉贝莉娜学习得很快，成果也更为显著——她的血液早已化作烈火，她也早已熟稔于这条道路。
而作出血誓的猎人们，都会拥有这样一颗子弹，它也被称作“最初的血誓”。在他们之间，还有一句俗语广为流传：“子弹上刻着你的名字”，象征着他们至死追杀猎物的决心。只是，在那时的无法之地，昔日盟友化作仇敌不过瞬息，而这些离群索居者，通常更为珍视同道之人，为此，他们曾发明了一种“誓盟仪式”……嘉贝莉娜未曾缔结盟约，却仍旧记得那仪式与意义。
当一位猎人将“最初的血誓”赠予出去时，也会在其上刻下受赠者的名字——这即是那最为简易，却永不磨灭的古老盟约：她将化作{TA}的子弹，永不背叛，永不弃逃，直至鲜血干涸，烈火燃烬。

datamine:InfoDisplay_11010105_Text.title: Knell Garden
datamine:InfoDisplay_11010105_Text.text:
Even if the darkness of the night drowns the tracks, as long as we always have the courage to explore the unknown, we will eventually arrive at a faraway place.
 --To the warriors of the long night.

 Background
The Garden of Bells was established in AL155 to remember every warrior who sacrificed his life for human civilization. Every flower in the garden was sown and watered by Jiyan, the fifth leader of Midnight Rangers. The flower seeds were specially cultivated by Verina, a plant researcher, according to the geology and climate of Huanglong to ensure 100% survival rate even in bad weather, symbolizing the unyielding spirit of Huanglong.
Members of the public are requested to respect the deceased and not to trample on the flowers during condolences, offenders will be referred to Mornguard for action.
datamine:InfoDisplay_11010105_Text.zh:
即使暗夜淹没了足迹，只要常怀探索未知的勇气，我们终将抵达远方。
 ——致献身长夜的战士们 
 
 【鸣钟园背景】
鸣钟园建立于新历155年，意在铭记每一位为人类文明献身的勇士，园内每朵花均由第五任夜归团长忌炎亲自播种、浇灌。花种由特聘植物研究员维里奈根据瑝珑地质、气候特殊培育，即使在恶劣天气下也能保证100%存活率，象征着不屈的瑝珑精神。
各位市民在吊唁时，请尊重逝者，勿踩踏花海，违者将交由晓卫处理。

yakita:FavorStory_141104_Content.zh:
手上枷锁，脚下镣铐。
许多贪官污吏江洋大盗被他亲手送到这里，那时他乃是槛外人，如今，他却和那些人一样，成了槛中人。
“打开吧。”
“林大人，马上就是时辰了，这……”
"打开。"
一连串榫卯栏杆窸窣作响，来人坐到他身前，随之而来的还有隐约的饭菜酒香。
“谛天鉴问话，你也要在这里看着吗？”
“大人，下官只是奉命办差而已……”
“好，那我告诉你，我也是奉命办差，天牢重犯行刑历来要有谛天鉴过问，我有要紧的话要问死囚，你们都给我退了。”
“是，大人……”
“把牢门关了，等我要出来时，再叫你们给我打开。”
一阵匆忙的脚步声过去，牢房里只剩下两人。
“午正三刻才会杀人，现在是午初一刻。”
“林大人，是来送我。”
“先饮此杯。就当做是，祭奠他了。”
他没有饮下林监正给他倒满的酒，而是拖着沉重的镣铐，举杯倾倒在地上。
“哎，那时节只有你们二人，东园他就那么惨死在那里……奈何这是通天的大案，只是那真凶没留下半点罪证，三法司也只能拿你顶罪。”
“是我没能救下梁大人。”
“你还记得那从东园身上……‘剥离’出来的凶手吗？”
“就是化成灰了，那气息我也会记得。”
“谛天鉴遍查史书，也没找到有这样能够幻化成他人模样，剥离他人身形的共鸣者……”
“那时候，也不知梁大人到底还有多少神志了……”
“也许东园最后交给你办的今州那场案子，不是东园的本意。以他的为人，绝不可能对一个能杀残象的小卒下追杀令。”
“所以……我放过了他，那个叫哥舒临的人。那时我想，如果是我熟悉的恩公，不会下这样的命令的。”
“东园他果然没有看错你，若是要查，只能从那场案子查起，不过这里面……也许永远也查不清。”
“仇某一生，欠下血债不少，又受恩于梁林二位大人，还有张太医……”
“仇某，只能来世再还了。”
“我记得东园曾说，不会让你死在牢房里或是病床上。”
谛天鉴监正起身走到牢门前，语重心长地说着。
“明庭天牢重犯，午正三刻杀人，午初三刻就要有三法司发往谛天鉴请龙主和岁主明断的行文。有了龙主和岁主的文书，一个小时之后才能杀人。”
“没有谛天鉴发还给三法司那份龙主和岁主的文书，谁也不敢杀人。”
“往后的路，你只能自己走了。你要记住，这场案…

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_7.text: Actually, I've had my eye on you for far longer than you'd think. The cat prints, the pictures, the cameras tucked in the corners, and even the gateway Lily opened for that Goldrunner. Every one of them was left by me.

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_211_12.text: War. Goldrunners. Ladies and gentlemen... none of that is why we're gathered here today.

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_211_3.text: Word is the Goldrunners have had quite a few complaints about us lately. They've even spoiled a handful of my deals.

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_211_5.text: Our attention should be on the city. Keeping the factions in balance is a far more delicate game than handling a few Goldrunners.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_211_5.zh: 还是把目光放回城内吧，解决城内各个势力的关系问题，远比对付淘金客棘手得多。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_10.text: He says Goldrunners are adventurers who chase freedom across the New Federation.

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_9.text: Yes. He says his name is Jedediah, a Goldrunner from the New Federation. My sister confirmed it through the Guild's network.

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_4.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_9.text: The Goldrunner mentioned the name Promeus. I'd like to know, whose side was It on?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_9.zh: 我从那位淘金客口中听到过普罗米厄的名字，我想知道祂站在哪一方？

yakita:InfoDisplay_11040137_Text.text:
Hardness: 6
Density: 3.0-3.5 g/cm?
Compressive Strength: 3000-5000 kg/cm?

The specimen is named Moire Stone, characterized by its fine structure, high hardness, and strong compressive strength. It exhibits excellent chemical stability and can withstand extreme temperature variations.
Moire Stones are widely distributed in the Gorges of Spirits, forming large-scale deposits that faciliate easy mining. Sizable blocks can be easily mined. All these factors make Moire Stones excellent construction materials suitable for large-scale sculptures, exterior walls of buildings, and hard paving.

Note: It is used in the construction of Jinzhou and the creation of the Sentinel sculpture.
yakita:InfoDisplay_11040137_Text.zh:
硬度：6度
密度：3.0-3.5g/cm³
抗压强度：3000-5000kg/cm³

该样本被命名为云纹石，其结构细密，硬度、抗压强度高，化学稳定性好，能适应极端温差变化。
云纹石在云陵谷内分布广泛，形成规模大，因此开采方便，易出大料，是极佳的建筑原材料，可用于修筑大型雕塑、房屋外墙、硬质铺装等。

备注：用于今州城建、岁主雕塑修筑。

yakita:InfoDisplay_11040139_Text.text:
Today, the captain had another discussion with me. He hoped that, as a technical backbone, I could provide a decisive opinion on whether the exploration work could still be completed as scheduled. Both he and I, and even everyone else, understand the importance of excavating the second long-distance transportation route. This route, starting from Jinzhou, passes through the Gorges of Spirits to connect the remaining areas in Huanglong. It is important for Jinzhou to have closer and more convenient interactions with other territories in Huanglong. To put it bluntly, in case there are issues with one transportation route in the future, we can still rely on the other, avoiding falling into a desperate situation.

Recent monitoring indicates the potential emergence of Tacet Fields around the Gorges of Spirits at any time, but we can't stop now as we have already come this far. If we stop now, all our hard-earned achievements will be in vain. However, if we don't stop, we may risk the lives of our team members.
yakita:InfoDisplay_11040139_Text.zh:
内容：今天队长又来找我谈话了，他希望我作为技术骨干能给出一个具有决断性的意见——是否还能如期完成勘探工作。我和他，甚至是所有人都明白第二条长途运输线的开凿是至关重要的，这条通路将以今州为始，途径云陵谷通向瑝珑关内其余的一庭五州，今州亦需要与瑝珑的其它地域更密切地、更便捷地往来。说句不好听的，万一未来其中一条运输线出现了什么状况，我们还能指望另外一条，不至于孤立无援。

近期监测表明，云陵谷周边随时可能有无音区出现，但我们已经走到了这一步。如果就此停下，这些年来的成果将会付诸东流，但如果再进一步，赔进去的也许就是队员的性命……

内容：进入云陵谷的道路于今日正式打通，夜归特种小队在谷中遭遇大量累积的残象兽潮，此次的兽潮危险性极高，死亡、重伤及失踪人数过多，尚且无法完全统计。总指挥在作战中英勇牺牲，暂命忌炎为临时总指挥。

【 过期公告】  
日期：新历140年
内容：受天工委托，夜归特种小队将由今日开始负责云陵谷地块的调查清理工作，以便后期天工进驻谷内开展勘测。初步预计将于150年之前打通进入云陵谷的道路。

yakita:InfoDisplay_11050104_Text.text:
Hardness: 6
Density: 3.0-3.5 g/cm³
Compressive Strength: 3000-5000 kg/cm³

The specimen is named Moire Stone, characterized by its fine structure, high hardness, and strong compressive strength. It exhibits excellent chemical stability and can withstand extreme temperature variations.
Moire Stones are widely distributed in the Gorges of Spirits, forming large-scale deposits that faciliate easy mining. Sizable blocks can be easily mined. All these factors make Moire Stones excellent construction materials suitable for large-scale sculptures, exterior walls of buildings, and hard paving.

Note: It is used in the construction of Jinzhou and the creation of the Sentinel sculpture.
yakita:InfoDisplay_11050104_Text.zh:
硬度：6度
密度：3.0-3.5g/cm³
抗压强度：3000-5000kg/cm³

该样本被命名为白纹石，其结构细密，硬度、抗压强度高，化学稳定性好，能适应极端温差变化。
白纹石在云陵谷内分布广泛，形成规模大，因此开采方便，易出大料，是极佳的建筑原材料，可用于大型雕塑、房屋外墙、硬质铺装等。

备注：拟用于岁光雕塑修筑。

yakita:InfoDisplay_11050105_Text.text:
Date: AL154
Contents: In the operation to recover the Gorges of Spirits, Midnight Rangers encountered extremely unfavorable circumstances such as the death of the commander-in-chief and the disparity between the enemy and us. However, our warrior Jiyan was outstanding in battle, and fought against the large-scale TDTD Outbreak for three days with only a single special team left, and stood firm until the arrival of support from large troops, and then merged the military forces and successfully defeated most of the exploration results. The TDTD Outbreak was defeated in one fell swoop, and most of the exploration results were successfully preserved.
yakita:InfoDisplay_11050105_Text.zh:
日期：新历154年
内容：在收复云陵谷的行动中，夜归遭遇了总指挥阵亡、敌我势力悬殊等极端不利情况，但我方战士忌炎战功卓著，以仅剩的单支特种小队对抗大规模残象兽潮长达三天之久，坚守至大部队支援赶到，后合并军力，一举击溃残象兽潮，成功保住了大部分勘探成果。

yakita:ItemInfo_42300090_BgDescription.text:
A flower blooming on the high shores.
Legend has it that the Wintry Bell does not really wither. When the ancient bells born by the giant Turtoise in Gorges of Spirits resonate, they will rise again from the ice and snow.
yakita:ItemInfo_42300090_BgDescription.zh:
盛开在高岸的清冷之花。
传说中，傲寒钟不会真正地枯萎。当云陵谷巨鼍驮负的古钟轰鸣之时，它们便会从冰天雪地中复苏。

yakita:ItemInfo_72010010_BgDescription.text: "The culture and spirit of Jinzhou all included in this book, begins with the battle in the Gorges of Spirits."
yakita:ItemInfo_72010010_BgDescription.zh: “以云陵为序，以今州为始，今州人文、瑝珑风骨，皆在此书中。”

yakita:Term750053_Desc.text:
A large-scale war that broke out simultaneously in the Gorges of Spirits and Yuan Fortress, aimed at preventing the spread of the Tacet Discord Outbreak from the Norfall Barrens into Huanglong via the Land of Xuanfang. 
Following this war, Jinzhou was formally established. 
Yuan Fortress was ultimately destroyed during the war, and Xuanfang Hold was later constructed upon its ruins.
yakita:Term750053_Desc.zh:
为了阻止北落野的残象潮从玄方地界向瑝珑其他州域扩散，当年曾在云陵谷与渊城同时爆发了规模空前的战役。
经云陵谷一役，今州才终于建立了起来。
而在渊城战场，渊城被彻底摧毁，但在其废墟之上，玄方城得以建成。

yakita:Flow_310000001_16.text: If I make a run for the Gorges of Spirits now, these goods definitely won't be delivered in time.
yakita:Flow_310000001_16.zh: 现在再回云陵谷的话，这些货肯定没办法准时送达。

yakita:Flow_31000001_29.text: He was out there, digging canals in the Gorges of Spirits, right up until the Tacet Discord outbreak.
yakita:Flow_31000001_29.zh: 他一直都坚守在云陵谷开凿运河，直到残象潮……

yakita:Flow_31000001_38.text: That being said, from what I've figured out, there should be giant Tacet Discords in the Gorges of Spirits' water system that mimic normal animals.
yakita:Flow_31000001_38.zh: 说起来，根据我的推演，云陵谷的水系中应该有模拟普通生物的巨型残象存在。

yakita:HuanglongXZ_4_6.text: We are in the Gorges of Spirits. It's on the outskirts of Jinzhou, Huanglong.
yakita:HuanglongXZ_4_6.zh: 这里是云陵谷，瑝珑属下今州城的边地野外。
yakita:HuanglongXZ_4_6.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_35.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_7_2
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_35.text: And you said it was flowing in a certain direction. The nearest places are the Gorges of Spirits and the Norfall Barrens...
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_35.zh: 最近的方向是云陵谷和北落野……
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_35.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_47_2.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_25
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_47_2.text: The Gorges of Spirits Battle sparked Jinzhou's founding.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_47_2.zh: 建州的契机是云陵谷一役……
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_47_2.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_38_25.text: You were found in the Gorges of Spirits only recently, and this is your first time setting foot in Jinzhou, ruling out that possibility.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_38_25.zh: 你不久前刚从云陵谷苏醒，亦是初到今州，并不具备这两点条件。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_38_25.speaker: Jiyan

yakita:MAIN_YHX_66_14.text: Since I woke in the Gorges of Spirits, I've met many people from my past. They've helped me recover pieces of myself. It's a good thing.
yakita:MAIN_YHX_66_14.zh: 自云陵谷苏醒开始的这段旅途，我遇到的故人都让我更了解自己，这没什么不好的。
yakita:MAIN_YHX_66_14.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_HuangLong_LLZQMXY_12_75.text: The figure draws Yangyang into a Sonoro Sphere that recreates the landscape of the Gorges of Spirits. There, the figure reveals that Yangyang meeting you carried an indelible significance, and her that her path as the Votary of the Voice is about to begin. When Yangyang asks about the figure's identity, it simply replies that it is merely the echo of a passing breeze before dissolving.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_LLZQMXY_12_75.zh: 光影将秧秧带到了一处索诺拉内，此处复现的，是曾经云陵谷的光景。光影告诉秧秧，她与你的相遇有着不可磨灭的重大意义，并提醒秧秧，她作为祀声之人的旅途也即将开始。秧秧询问光影的身份，光影回答她，自己只是一道风残留的声音，随后便消散而去了。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_141_20.text: To reach Xuanfang from Jinzhou, we'll need to cross through the Dreaming Cavern, north of the Gorges of Spirits. Since you've never been, I'll lead the way.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_141_20.zh: 自今州取道至玄方地界，需要穿过云陵谷以北的梦窟。你应该还没去过，就让我带路吧。
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_141_20.speaker: Suisui

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_30_10.text: (But that moment in the Gorges of Spirits, the first time we met, is a reality we share that no number of dreams could ever erase.)
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_30_10.zh: （然而，那场在云陵谷的邂逅，我们最初的相遇，是无论再多的梦也无法抹去的，属于我们的现实。）
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_30_10.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_6.text: Forgive me, Grandmother. But my mind is made. My husband never came home. A Xuanling brought word that he was slain by Tacet Discords in the Gorges of Spirits...
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_6.zh: 对不住，阿婆。可我已经决定好了。囡囡她爹没能回来，玄翎告诉我，他是在云陵谷被残象所害……

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_86_36.text: Well, it all started back at the Gorges of Spirits...
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_86_36.zh: 这还要从云陵谷开始说起……

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_146_7.chapter: 剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_三段回忆_1_4
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_146_7.text: {Male=He's;Female=She's} in the Gorges of Spirits. Care to witness it firsthand?
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_146_7.zh: {TA}现在就在云陵谷，你要去看看吗？
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_146_7.speaker: Scar

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_212_1.text: Ovathrax, Retroact Rain, and the Gorges of Spirits... They're talking about the battle that occurred years ago.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_212_1.zh: 无相燹主、溯洄雨、云陵谷……他们说的是那场发生在很久以前的战役。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_212_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_215_4.text: I heard two moons appeared in the sky above the Gorges of Spirits. And the rain was going up, not down.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_215_4.zh: 听说云陵谷那一带出现了两个月亮，雨水还倒着往天上飞。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_215_7.text: The Cloud Shuttles and Autopuppets weren't bothered by that strange rain. After they cleared the Tacet Discords in Xuanfang, they went on to the Gorges of Spirits and destroyed the source of the outbreak.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_215_7.zh: 不过云梭和机傀可不怕这种古怪的雨，解决完玄方地界的麻烦后，就到云陵谷把残象潮的源头打散了。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_22.text: In a single day and night, from Yuan Fortress to the Gorges of Spirits, the Threnodian of War's vanguard was reduced to nothing.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_22.zh: 只消一昼夜，从渊城到云陵谷，战争鸣式的先锋军便彻底化为乌有。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_310_16.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_6_神宫幻境_39_1
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_310_16.text: Qingxiao confides that, as far as she can recall, most of the Artisans aboard this Shuttle are among those who perished when Yuan Fortress self-destructed. Back then, the last Artisans and soldiers holding the Fortress had no choice but to detonate it to prevent the Tacet Discords from reaching Mengzhou. Qingxiao had been in the Gorges of Spirits supporting local forces at the time, and by the time she returned to Xuanfang, Yuan Fortress was already in ruins, and with it, those who had made their final stand there.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_310_16.zh: 清宵向你坦言，云梭上大部分的工匠在她的印象里，都是当年随着渊城自毁而逝去的人。当年最后留守渊城的工匠和军人不得已只能亲自炸毁城池来阻止残象进入梦州。当时，清宵在云陵谷支援当地守军，等她赶回玄方地界，渊城已化作了一片废墟。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_310_7.text: No. I was... with the defending troops in the Gorges of Spirits.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_310_7.zh: 不，当时……我在云陵谷支援当地的守军。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_310_7.speaker: Qingxiao

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_452_2.text: That day, the Xuanling Bird told you the Gorges of Spirits and Yuan Fortress were burning. Where did you go?
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_452_2.zh: 那一天，玄翎雀告诉你云陵谷和渊城都陷入了战火，你下山去了哪？

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_460_1.text: You are back at the Gorges of Spirits... The battlefield that haunts you. Your fear. Your regret.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_460_1.zh: 你又回到了云陵谷……你记忆深处的战场，你的恐惧，你的遗憾。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_490_30.text: From Yuan Fortress, to the Gorges of Spirits, to the Land of Xuanfang... No matter how hard I try, my sword cannot save everyone.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_490_30.zh: 渊城、云陵谷、玄方城……无论怎么努力，我的剑始终救不下所有人。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_490_30.speaker: Qingxiao

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_54.text: The situation at the Gorges of Spirits is no better. We have to rely on these Autopuppets...
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_54.zh: 云陵谷那边的情况应该也不乐观，只能靠机傀了……
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_54.speaker: Hsin

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_276_1.text: The Tacet Discord Outbreak at the Gorges of Spirits grows fiercer every day, and the Threnodian is showing signs of waking... At this rate, even Mengzhou won't come out unscathed.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_276_1.zh: 云陵谷的残象潮愈发猖獗，鸣式亦有苏醒征兆……长此以往，梦州也无法全身而退啊。

yakita:Side_CXLR_6_39.text: Well, we're heading to the Gorges of Spirits to investigate a giant Tacet Discord found there.
yakita:Side_CXLR_6_39.zh: 是这样的，我们正准备前去云陵谷那里调查那里发现过的巨大残象……

yakita:Side_CXLR_8_15.text: Bell-Borne Geochelone lives in the Gorges of Spirits, which is the source of the Qing River flowing through here. I can sense the state of a TD through the remaining frequency in the medium.
yakita:Side_CXLR_8_15.zh: 鸣钟之龟的所在地是云陵谷，那里正是流经到此处的青河的发源地，我能够通过感知介质里的残留频率感知到残象的状态。
yakita:Side_CXLR_8_15.speaker: Lianfeng

yakita:Side_CXLR_8_21.text: Plus, it seems that those from the Pioneer Association are planning to go to the Gorges of Spirits along the river.
yakita:Side_CXLR_8_21.zh: 而且还有一个原因，那些先行公约的人似乎也打算从这里沿着溪流出发，前去云陵谷……
yakita:Side_CXLR_8_21.speaker: Lianfeng

yakita:Side_CXLR_8_31.text: Yes, that's the story. Later, someone found a rusted ancient bell in the Gorges of Spirits, similar in style to the bronze bell the ancient army used.
yakita:Side_CXLR_8_31.zh: 是的，故事里是这么说的，后来有人在云陵谷发现了一只锈蚀的古钟，而其制式与瑝珑的铜钟如出一辙。
yakita:Side_CXLR_8_31.speaker: Lianfeng

yakita:Side_XJBGZMTX_6_4.text: (It reminds me of the Sentinel statue in the Gorges of Spirits and the workers at the Tiger's Maw Mine. I saw them use similar abilities to cut stone.)
yakita:Side_XJBGZMTX_6_4.zh: （我在云陵谷的岁主雕像，还有今州的虎口矿场那里见到过工匠们用类似的能力来切割石块。）
yakita:Side_XJBGZMTX_6_4.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_146_15.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_5_隐海试验场_三段回忆_1_4
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_146_15.text: In Phrolova's third flashback, you see her and Scar in Jinzhou, standing before a hatching Ovathrax. Her presence in Norfall Barrens was mostly for personal reasons. Despite the Grand Architect's orders, she cared little about Jinzhou or you. She was more there for the countless Reverberations of the dead scattered across the battlefields. Experimenting with merging Reverberations and Tacet Discords there could offer valuable insights for the ultimate success of the Lost Beyond.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_7_146_15.zh: 你以弗洛洛的视角发现了她与伤痕曾在今州的对话，了解了当时她出现在北落野背后的个人原因：执行会长命令的她对今州和你都没有过多上心，她更在乎的，是战场上充斥着大量人们死后的残响。在这里尝试残响与残象躯壳的融合，或许能为失亡彼岸最终的成功提供些不错的参考价值。

datamine:InfoDisplay_125000120_Text.title: Daily Scoop
datamine:InfoDisplay_125000120_Text.text:
[…]

To add fuel to the fire, fresh rumors claim both teams may be sponsored by the same noble house, staging the drama to drum up attention for the next Great Agon...

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_125000120_Text.zh:
昨日在卡庇托山山麓小型竞技场内爆发了一场贵族与商队之间的激烈冲突，双方最终决定以声骸角斗划分胜负，没想到不知名海外战队横插一脚打败双方夺得了胜利，这支队伍的出现到底是新选手无知造成的干扰还是故意将场面变为一场闹剧的棋高一着，敬请期待后续报道……
……
昨日结束的第三十二场声骸角斗专项训练赛以斑斓沙海队选手主动弃赛告终，这场期待已久的新星对抗赛就这样戛然而止，令不少人唏嘘不已。据不愿透露姓名的人士提供的情报，此次比赛双方选手隐瞒已久的伴侣关系影响了比赛结果，同时，又有新的流言出现，表明两个战队背后支持者实为同一贵族，此举只为制造噱头，扩大宣传，为下一届角斗冠军赛做准备……
……
近日，角斗士伤员激增，「玛卡翁」药铺的一只医疗声骸不堪重负、离家出走，如遇到街上落单的医疗声骸，请联系「玛卡翁」药铺。
……
本报由伏尔甘矿业赞助发行，请支持伏尔甘矿业声骸角斗战队！

yakita:Side_BVBSTTZ_2_5.text: You never know. I heard an octopus clam in the Riccioli Islands once successfully predicted the outcome of Septimont's Great Agon.
yakita:Side_BVBSTTZ_2_5.zh: 也不尽然，我听说黎乔利群岛的章鱼蛤，曾经预测过七丘角斗冠军赛的结果。

yakita:Side_BVBSTTZ_2_6.text: You know, I heard an octopus clam in the Riccioli Islands once successfully predicted the outcome of Septimont's Great Agon.
yakita:Side_BVBSTTZ_2_6.zh: 我听说黎乔利群岛的章鱼蛤，曾经预测过七丘角斗冠军赛的结果。

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_48_2.text: Grimm remains silent, simply playing one note after another at the piano. No one knows when he will stop.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_48_2.zh: 格姆保持着沉默，只是不断用双手敲出一个个音符，没人知道他什么时候会停下来。

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_56_1.text: A broken record player, apparently left here by Mr. Grimm.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_56_1.zh: 一部坏掉的唱片机，似乎是格姆先生放置在这里的。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_12.text: The soul needing our help this time is Mr. Grimm. Have you had the chance to meet him yet?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_12.zh: 这次我们需要安息的是格姆先生，在列车上，你见过他了吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_12.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_14.text: Yes. He's been like that ever since he boarded, never speaking a word to anyone.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_14.zh: 格姆先生自上车以来就一直坐在钢琴前，没有与任何人交流过。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_14.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_35.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束3_3_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_35.text: Following the broadcast's instructions, you find the room for the next stop and discover that the soul awaiting release is Mr. Grimm, the pianist from the Lounge Carriage. Lily had intended to handle this alone, unwilling to involve an innocent bystander or expose anyone else to the horrors of war. You explain that helping the departed find peace is your choice, and the least you can do as someone still alive. After a moment's thought, Lily agrees to let you help.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_35.zh: 你根据广播的提示找到了新的站点房间，你发现需要被安息的亡魂是大厅里的那位钢琴家——格姆先生。莉莉本来打算独自一人行动的，因为她觉得不该把无辜的人牵扯进来，让他人经历战争的残酷。你回答这是你的选择，也是你作为生者对逝者能做的最后一点事情。莉莉思索了一番，最后接受了你想要帮忙的请求。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_102_10.text: Come on. Let's go help Mr. Grimm finish his farewell performance.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_102_10.zh: 走吧，我们去完成格姆先生的告别演出。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_102_10.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_102_15.text: ...Tch, that's all I could make out before his voice faded away.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_102_15.zh: ……嘶，我只听到了这些声音……格姆先生的声音消失了。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_102_16.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束3_4_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_102_16.text: Upon entering the dreamland, you discover that, unlike in Liam's case, you are experiencing this dream directly through its owner's eyes. Lily suspects that something in Mr. Grimm's past has left him afraid to confront his own feelings. Soon, you hear another voice within the body you inhabit, faint, fragmented words that seem to come from Grimm himself. From them, you gather that he has one last farewell performance left to give.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_102_16.zh: 入梦后，你发现与利亚姆的幻梦不同，这次你直接变成了幻梦的主人。莉莉猜测也许是格姆先生经历了什么事情，导致他不愿直视自己的内心。你察觉到这副身体还有其他声音，似乎是格姆先生内心的声音。在他的只言片语中，你明白了他有一场告别演出要去完成。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_102_3.text: This has happened with other souls before. Perhaps Mr. Grimm's self-loathing runs so deep that he can't bear to face his own heart, so he simply gave up on himself.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_102_3.zh: 曾经也有亡魂像这样。也许是因为格姆先生憎恶自己，不愿直视内心，所以连身体都舍弃了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_102_3.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_102_7.text: It's Mr. Grimm's voice. His consciousness is still hiding inside this body, but he sounds weak.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_102_7.zh: 是格姆先生的声音，他似乎藏在这副身体里，而且声音有些虚弱。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_104_1.text: Good evening, everyone. It's a great honor to spend this beautiful night with all of you...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_104_1.zh: 各位，晚上好，很荣幸和大家共度这个美好的夜晚……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_104_1.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_104_2.text: The next piece I'm going to play is dedicated to a dear friend of mine. Please enjoy... "The Dawn That Sheds Its Blue."
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_104_2.zh: 下面这首曲子，我想把它送给我的一位朋友……《脱下蓝色衣装的黎明》……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_104_2.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_104_8.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束3_34_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_104_8.text: You step onto the stage, and Grimm's inner voice grows clear enough to guide you through the performance as a musician.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_104_8.zh: 你登上舞台，格姆内心的声音越来越清晰，开始引导着你如何作为一个音乐家去表演。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_105_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_85_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_105_1.text: This tune tells the story of a musician who went to war
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_105_1.zh: 这首曲子讲述的是一位参加战争的音乐家
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_105_1.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_10.text: And I was the one who led them here. I got them killed! I took part in this war and hurt innocent people!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_10.zh: 是我带着伙伴们参军入伍，害死了他们。是我参加战争，伤害了无辜的人。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_10.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_11.text: No one's ever gonna forgive me! NO ONE! And if that's the way of it...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_11.zh: 没有人会原谅我，没有人！如果是这样的话……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_11.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_14.text: Please stop, Mr. Grimm. A musician should treat his instrument with more care.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_14.zh: 格姆先生，停下来吧，作为音乐家，要好好珍惜自己的乐器哦。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_14.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_15.text: I... I'm sorry, Miss Lily. But... please. As the audience to this song and this story... will you forgive me?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_15.zh: 我……我，对不起，那，莉莉小姐，作为听众，听完这首曲子和音乐家的故事，你愿意原谅我吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_15.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_17.text: I knew it. You can't answer. How could someone like me ever be forgiven?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_17.zh: 对吧，很难回答吧，像我这样的人怎么可能得到原谅。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_17.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_18.text: No, Mr. Grimm. We can't forgive you on behalf of those you've harmed. We're not them.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_18.zh: 不，格姆先生，我们是无权替那些被你伤害的人原谅你，我们并不是他们。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_20.text: Yes. So, please, Mr. Grimm, keep playing. Your music has the power to save those who come after.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_20.zh: 嗯，所以格姆先生，继续把曲子弹下去吧，你的曲子能拯救未来的人。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_20.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_26.text: Mm. Looks like Mr. Grimm ended it himself. It all happened so fast.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_26.zh: 嗯，似乎是格姆先生主动结束了幻梦，一切都发生得太突然了。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_34.text: Atone for my sins with a few songs? Play medic? Don't make me laugh!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_34.zh: 用曲子来赎罪？成为医护兵来赎罪？可笑！
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_34.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_4.text: But where is he now? There's no lily here, which means he hasn't found peace yet. Did Mr. Grimm...?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_4.zh: 那格姆先生去哪里了？没有百合花就意味着他没有得到安息，格姆先生他……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_4.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_8.text: Hahaha... All this time, I just sat at this piano, playing it over and OVER again!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_8.zh: 哈哈哈……一直以来，我坐在钢琴前，不停地弹奏，弹奏！
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_8.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_109_1.text: {PlayerName}, let's bring Mr. Grimm's lily back to where it belongs.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_109_1.zh: {PlayerName}，我们把格姆先生的百合花，带回属于它的地方吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_109_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_1.text: Mr. Grimm, you may rest now. May your soul wander no more.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_1.zh: 格姆先生，现在，您可以安息了，愿您的灵魂不再迷惘。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_2.text: Thank you, {PlayerName}. When Mr. Grimm asked me that question, I couldn't bring myself to answer.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_2.zh: 谢谢你，{PlayerName}。格姆先生当时提出的问题，我没有办法回答。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_2.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_12.text: But that puts an awful lot of pressure on you...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_12.zh: 但这样的话，莉莉小姐你的压力会……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_12.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_15.text: Yes... It's shameful. A young girl with more resolve than I've ever had.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_15.zh: 嗯……真丢脸，我反而不如一个小姑娘坚定。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_15.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_4.text: Heh, borrowed it from the commander. I'm a musician, after all. Sometimes music is the only way I can let things out.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_4.zh: 嘿嘿，那支口琴是我找指挥官借的，我是音乐家，有些东西只能依赖音乐来发泄。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_4.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_8.text: Mm... Thank you, Miss Lily. When this war's over, I swear I won't give up music again. I'll treasure my instrument.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_8.zh: 嗯……谢谢你，莉莉小姐。战争结束后，我不会再丢下音乐了，我会好好珍惜我的乐器。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_8.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_197_3.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_26_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_197_3.text: Thank you, Miss Lily. It was you who gave me the courage to take up an instrument again.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_197_3.zh: 谢谢你，莉莉小姐，是你让我能再次拾起乐器
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_197_3.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_197_4.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_26_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_197_4.text: The blue night will pass, and the dawn we've been waiting for will rise.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_197_4.zh: 蓝色的夜晚终将过去，我们期待的黎明终将升起
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_197_4.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_203_10.text: Thank you, Miss Lily. The dream you left behind gave me the courage to take up my instrument again. I finally finished playing the piece I wrote for my friend.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_203_10.zh: 谢谢你，小护士。你留下的梦，让我重拾乐器，演奏完了那首送给友人的曲子。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_203_10.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_231_1.text: Let's begin, {PlayerName}. Time to finish Mr. Grimm's final performance.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_231_1.zh: 开始吧，{PlayerName}，去完成格姆先生最后的演出吧。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_256_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_35_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_256_1.text: At a corner, he found two soldiers dozing off
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_256_1.zh: 拐角时他看见了两个战士在打盹
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_256_1.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_257_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_36_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_257_1.text: "New recruit? Registration's over there," they said, like he was just another piece of rubble
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_257_1.zh: “新来的？报到去那边。”他们的语气像对待一块石头
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_257_1.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_258_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_37_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_258_1.text: Behind the bunker, a young nurse was patching up a female soldier
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_258_1.zh: 简陋的掩体后，年轻的小护士正为一名女战士包扎伤口
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_258_1.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_259_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_38_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_259_1.text: "Greetings. I'm ▇▇, the commander of this sector."
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_259_1.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_259_3.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_38_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_259_3.text: He couldn't answer. Swept up by the orators' speeches, he had led his entire orchestra to enlist
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_259_3.zh: 他不敢回答，因为他是被演说家煽动，带着乐团主动参军的人
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_259_3.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_259_4.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_38_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_259_4.text: Yet when real blood stained his hands, he realized this was nothing like he'd imagined
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_259_4.zh: 手染鲜血后，他意识到一切与自己的理想相去甚远
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_259_4.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_259_5.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_38_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_259_5.text: The female soldier pointed to the nurse: "▇▇, he's your problem now."
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_259_5.zh: 女战士指了指小护士：“▇▇ ，他就先交给你带了。”
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_259_5.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_260_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_39_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_260_1.text: The musician followed the nurse to his quarters
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_260_1.zh: 音乐家跟着小护士的指引，来到了他的住处
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_260_1.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_262_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_41_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_262_1.text: The shells hit loud and close, showering him with dust
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_262_1.zh: 炮声很响很近，沙子不断落在他的脸上
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_262_1.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_264_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_43_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_264_1.text: The first soldier was young. His lips trembled, but he didn't cry
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_264_1.zh: 第一位伤员是个年轻的小战士，嘴唇一直在哆嗦，但没有哭
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_264_1.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_265_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_44_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_265_1.text: He patched him up, whispering: "It's alright. You're gonna be alright."
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_265_1.zh: 他边包扎边安慰着说：“没事的，没事的。”
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_265_1.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_266_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_45_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_266_1.text: He pressed on. Cries for help came from every direction
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_266_1.zh: 他继续前进，四面八方都传来了求救声
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_266_1.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_267_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_46_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_267_1.text: At a crossroads, the Grim Reaper offered him two choices
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_267_1.zh: 他来到岔路口前，死神出了一道选择题
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_267_1.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_269_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_48_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_269_1.text: He ran left, repeating the choice he'd just made
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_269_1.zh: 他向左跑去，自言自语着左边的声音更密集
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_269_1.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_272_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_51_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_272_1.text: The cries from the right sounded more desperate
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_272_1.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_273_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_52_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_273_1.text: He arrived too late. The soldier lay staring, unblinking, at the sky
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_273_1.zh: 他来晚了，战士的双眼死死地盯着天空
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_273_1.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_274_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_53_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_274_1.text: It was already midnight when he opened his eyes. Through the dense fog, a figure emerged
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_274_1.zh: 醒来后已是深夜，浓雾中，他看见了一个身影
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_274_1.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_275_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_54_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_275_1.text: An enemy soldier. But without a word, he offered bandages
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_275_1.zh: 没想到走出来的是敌人，但他却默默替音乐家包扎
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_275_1.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_276_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_55_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_276_1.text: Before he left, the soldier asked: "You're that famous pianist, aren't you?"
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_276_1.zh: 到最后，敌人突然问了一句“您是那位有名的钢琴家吧！”
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_276_1.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_277_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_56_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_277_1.text: Turns out, he was a musician too. The two talked through the night
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_277_1.zh: 敌人原来也是乐手，两人开始聊起了音乐
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_277_1.speaker: Grimm

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_278_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_57_1

datamine:InfoDisplay_102801011_Text.title: Study on Mythical Beasts in Huanglong
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801011_Text.text:
[…]

"Here comes a beast, akin to a lion.

It exudes might and intellect, embraces a human's act..."
Long ago, a recluse beast "Suan'ni" inhabited the distant jungle of Huanglong.

[…]

To commemorate such success and pass down its blessings, human created the Liondance that adopted their moves into dancing footwork.

[…]

Unfortunately, the Waveworn Phenomenon began to flourish, devouring living beings and the vibrant jungles where the connection between humans and Suan'ni moored.

[…]

And they were the harbinger of Tacet Field.

[…]

As researchers achieved further discovery, it's acknowledged by most that Resonance Ability can be an acquired strength that stems exactly from one's heart.

Without proper treatment, it begets destruction.

[…]

Even a powerful Suan'ni can "Overclock" like Resonators.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801011_Text.zh:
“有兽焉，其状如狮，睁崃威武，存灵性，通人理……”
很久以前，在瑝珑尽头的土地上，存在着一种深居山林的生物——狻猊。
据说，它们骁勇善战、嫉恶如仇，又愿为善人施予“生命”与“勇气”的祝福，若遇一同作战、共御家园之事，狻猊会奔跃在战场前方，以其威武的外形、强大的力量、睥睨一切的威压，以一敌百，同人类一道击溃进犯山林的残象大军。受其勇武之姿及良善之意的感召，人类将其视作了祥瑞之兽，慢慢与它们建立起了深厚的友谊。
为了纪念与狻猊一同作战时的场面，并将狻猊所赐予的祝福传递下去，人类模仿着它们的外形与身姿，取班“师”回朝的谐音，创造出了“狮子舞”这一舞蹈仪式。时至今日，在瑝珑境内还能看到这种艺术形式的流传。
人类与狻猊的友谊维持了百年时间。
这之后海蚀现象大规模爆发、生灵涂炭、瘴地遍野，森林也变得难以涉足，天灾异象切断了人类同狻猊之间的联系。
再后来，民间有一种谣言开始流传，人们传说狻猊已经变为了“凶兽”。
它们侵占人类领地，令百里生灵震惶，以其凶猛之姿与强大的力量喝退了不少人类……也有人说，这怪兽一出来，天下就要有无音区之灾。
不过，在民间流传的诸多传说之间，也提及曾有狻猊会提前出现在即将爆发的无音区附近，发出吼声，为人类做出预警，驱使他们远离无音区。
狻猊这种亦善亦邪的特质曾在民间引起了不小的争议……但，笔者猜测，这类被冠以凶兽之名的，很可能只是狻猊中的一小部分族群。
至于为何狻猊中有一部分族群会变成凶兽……或是因为领地被毁，资源稀缺而产生的种群内王权争夺……又或是因为，是海蚀现象导致了它们能力的失控而令他们变得暴戾。
随着科学家们的不断深入研究，已经发现——共鸣力并非是一种完完全全的馈赠。它的力量源自内心，若不能妥善使用，共鸣力也会招致毁灭。狻猊们拥有着特殊的力量，在后来的研究中发现，它大概率是与共鸣能力一致的力量。即使强大如狻猊，也有可能在不慎之下，被这份力量反噬。
如今有不少学者已经判定，狻猊正是在与内心兽性与海蚀现象的不断争斗中，逐渐自然灭绝了。
但……笔者相信，一定仍有狻猊留存于世。笔者也相信，狻猊曾与人类建立的友谊，不会因为海蚀或是部分族群的恶行而磨灭。
本着自幼…
