datamine:InfoDisplay_125000117_Text.title: The Septimont Tribune Special Issue
datamine:InfoDisplay_125000117_Text.text:
This special issue offers a detailed look at the legendary figures who once shone brightly in the history of Septimont. 

From Fabius and Atilius to Valeria, tales of the Hero of Heroes occupy half the pages.

The remaining half pays tribute to those who never wore a crown, yet gave everything for the glory of Septimont. Many met their end in the hunting grounds—names like Tercules, Magna, and Taurus, lost to time, yet remembered still.

In contrast to the lyrical prose favored by Ragunnesi writers, the style here is bold and unadorned. Yet, the punchy words always evoke the most epic imagery. Though born of the same origin, the voices of Rinascita's isles have long diverged in art and expression.
datamine:InfoDisplay_125000117_Text.zh:
一份《七丘报》出品的特刊，详细描述了诸多在七丘历史上大放光芒的英雄人物。
法比乌、阿提留斯、薇利芮尔……关于王者们的故事占据了特刊的二分之一篇幅。
另外一半则是并未为王，但同样为七丘之荣光献出了一切的人们，他们大多葬身于猎场。
特库斯，玛格娜，陶鲁斯……诸多名字在历史中消逝，又被后人铭记。
相较于拉古那人调子优美婉转的文风词藻，七丘人的记述大多粗粝直白，又能从其中感受豪放壮丽。尽管出自同源，黎那汐塔的群岛却孕育出了走向不同的艺术风格。

datamine:InfoDisplay_26020002_Text.title: Note from an Unknown Source
datamine:InfoDisplay_26020002_Text.text:
6:00 Morning
Woke up a little earlier than usual. Still thinking about the prophecy Grandmother Lillibet mentioned yesterday, I guess… On the bright side, I won't be late for morning oration!

8:00 Morning
Breakfast was milk, fruit, and herb bread. I'm still not used to eating on a fixed schedule, but the senior Priestesses say discipline makes a proper Priestess.

12:00 Noon
Classes are over. I think I managed to see a little farther today. We all went for lunch together. Bland as ever. Nothing worth writing about.

2:00 Afternoon
The Senate sent someone to speak with Grandmother Lillibet. Something about the prophecy of Septimont and the Hero of Heroes… I didn't catch the rest. Will I be able to have visions like that?

5:00 Dusk
I wish I could go outside and play. Or just go home. But everyone else is so focused… Sister Sophia carved an entire wall today. She's amazing.

7:00 Evening
Went for a little stroll after dinner. Saw a few stars!

11:00 Late Night
Time for bed, though I'm not sleepy at all. Sometimes following the schedule feels like a chore. But today was... not bad, I guess.
datamine:InfoDisplay_26020002_Text.zh:
晨间六点
今天醒得略早了一些，大概是放心不下莉莉贝婆婆昨天说的预言……但好处是，早上的诵读不会迟到了。

晨间八点
早餐是牛奶、果子和香叶面包，我还是不太适应定点吃饭这事，但前辈们都说谕女该保持规律的生活。

午间十二点
放课了，我好像看得更远了些。大家一起去吃午饭，味道很寡淡，没什么可记的。

午后两点
元老院派人来找莉莉贝婆婆，七丘预言、英雄王……其他的没太听清，我什么时候也能看那种程度的未来？

黄昏五点
想出去玩了，想回家，但大家都好专心……索菲亚姐姐刻完了满满一石壁，她好强！

晚间七点
吃完晚饭到殿外走了一圈，看到了一点星星！

晚间十一点
该睡了，虽然我完全不困。有时候，规律也挺让人嫌烦的，今天是……还算可以的一天吧。

yakita:LoadingTipsText_200801_TipsText.text: A natural pass of solid bedrock, marked by jagged cliffs and towering stone pillars. As the gateway to the Sanguis Plateaus, it has stood witness for generations as Gladiators embarked on their sacred hunt, all under the silent watch of the stone colossus of Atilius, the Hero of Heroes.
yakita:LoadingTipsText_200801_TipsText.zh: 由坚硬磐石所构建的天然隘口，石柱横亘，陡峭嶙峋。作为进入桑古伊斯狩原内部的主要通道，代代七丘人在英雄王阿提留斯石像的见证下，由此踏上狩猎的征途。

yakita:LoadingTipsText_200806_TipsText.text: The highest peak in the Sanguis Plateaus, named for both its unique summit and the three Heroes of Heroes who once stood there. To Gladiators, it is sacred ground. Legend says that each Hero of Heroes faced their final trial there, and only then would they conquer fate and be cloaked in glory.
yakita:LoadingTipsText_200806_TipsText.zh: 位于桑古伊斯狩原最高处的山峰，因其独特的峰峦结构和三位英雄王造访的典故因此得名，被角斗士们视为心中的圣地。据传说，每一位英雄王都将在此完成最后的磨砺，此后，他们必将战胜命运，满载荣光。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_16.text: Are we done here, Doctor? Time's a luxury we don't have. The next ward's waiting.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_16.zh: 好了吗，医生，现在时间可非常宝贵，该去下一个病区了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_16.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_5.text: Please mind your tongue, Officer Herriman! They're my patients. I won't have you speak about them that way.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_5.zh: 赫利曼军官，请注意你的言辞！他们是我的病人，请不要用这种口气说话。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_5.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_6.text: Alright, alright. Whatever you say, Doctor. Just finish your rounds and sign off on today's chart already.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_6.zh: 好好好，随你的便，医生，巡诊完的话，赶紧在今天的检查单上签字确认。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_6.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_122_36.text: You're a doctor. Your job is to save lives. You keep fixing them until they have served their purpose.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_122_36.zh: 你是医生，医生就是要救人。你要继续治疗他们，直到他们死去。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_122_36.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_122_41.text: Mhm... it's not serious. See, Doctor? That's why I told you to keep your distance from these people. They're all unhinged.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_122_41.zh: 嗯……只是小伤，唉，正因为这样我才叫医生你离他们远点，一群疯子。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_122_41.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_122_46.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束3_22_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_122_46.text: During another round, Lily is stabbed by a soldier who seems to harbor a deep hatred for her. He has been keeping a tally of how many times she has treated him, convinced that Lily and the officers are demons who keep sending him back to hell. Lily has no answer to his accusations. Just then, Officer Herriman intervenes, warning her that her duty as a doctor is to save lives and that she must not let the soldiers' words shake her resolve.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_122_46.zh: 莉莉在病房巡视时，被一位战士刺伤。这位战士似乎相当憎恶莉莉，他在墙上记录下了莉莉治愈自己的次数，认为莉莉和军官都是把他送往地狱的恶魔。莉莉无法回答战士的质问，这时候军官赫利曼威胁着莉莉，你作为医生的职责就是要救人，可不要被战士们的话动摇了。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_1.text: My brave soldiers, today you march on the frontlines! Before you board this train, I have a few words for you to carry into battle.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_1.zh: 我的孩子们，现在你们要奔赴伟大的前线了，上车前，有几句话，我想送给你们。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_1.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_10.text: Of course... none of them have any idea why you actually went there.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_10.zh: 虽然……他们都不知道你去那里的原因……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_10.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_3.text: Step aboard, Doctor. I'm sure your courage and spirit today will earn you endless praise for generations to come.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_3.zh: 上车吧，医生，你今日的勇气和意志，将赢得后世的赞美与歌颂。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_3.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_4.text: The enemy hides among us, wearing the faces of our brothers and sisters as they encroach on our homeland.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_4.zh: 你们都明白，那群伪装成我们同胞的敌人，正在一步步蚕食我们的家园。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_4.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_5.text: They would turn our bones to fertilizer for their ambitions. They would grind our dignity into the dust, and make slaves of us all, and our children, and our children's children!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_5.zh: 他们想把我们的尸骨变成肥料，滋养他们的野心。他们践踏我们的尊严，想把我们、我们的子孙贬为低贱的奴隶！
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_5.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_7.text: I am proud of every single one of you! Fight for yourselves! Fight for your children! Fight for the glory of our Federation!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_7.zh: 孩子们，我为你们感到骄傲，去为了你们自己而战，去为了你们的子孙而战，去为了我们伟大的联邦而战！
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_126_7.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_1.text: Do I need to remind you of your crimes, Doctor? Surely you weren't naive enough to think this would go unnoticed.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_1.zh: 要我陈述你的罪行吗，莉莉医生？你以为你逃得过我们的眼睛。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_1.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_12.text: Oh, I know that too, Doctor. But what does any of that have to do with winning?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_12.zh: 我明白，我明白。医生，可这些跟胜利有什么关系？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_12.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_13.text: It doesn't matter if they're innocent, or if they even know why they're fighting. The war moves forward, and it takes us all with it. All we can do is follow.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_13.zh: 无辜的人也好，不知道为什么而战也好，这场战争正推着我们每个人向前走，我们只要顺着它的方向就好。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_13.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_14.text: Of course, there's always a fool who thinks they are the exception... In this case, you, Doctor.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_14.zh: 当然，这个过程中总会有人想当被丢下的傻瓜，比如……医生你。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_14.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_16.text: Then let me tell you something else, Doctor. Those soldiers you tried so hard to protect? An order came to intercept them on their way to the rear.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_16.zh: 那我再告诉你一件事吧，医生，你保护的那些战士在去后方的路上，就被一张命令单截回来了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_16.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_20.text: Very well. Time to deliver the verdict to the accused—Doctor Lily, Head of the Mental Health Care Center at the Federated Field Hospital.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_20.zh: 好了，现对被告——联邦战区医院，精神疗愈科负责人莉莉宣读判决。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_20.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_21.text: Upon review of the evidence, you have been found to openly defy military orders and falsify official records during your term of service...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_21.zh: 经调查审理，被告莉莉在任职期间，公然违抗军令，伪造证明……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_21.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_27.text: Just as you wished, you'll be keeping them company soon enough.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_27.zh: 如你所愿，现在你可以去陪他们了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_27.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_3.text: A month ago, the military ordered you to sign discharge papers for the newly stationed troops. Instead, you went behind our backs and shipped them to the rear for recovery.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_3.zh: 一个月前，军部下令让你替新入驻的战士开具出院证明，你却绕过所有人，将他们送往后方疗养。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_3.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_8.text: Is that so? Tell me, Doctor, do you even understand what "rules" are?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_8.zh: 这样啊，但医生你真的明白规则是什么吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_8.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_9.text: Only the victors get to make the rules. And this war is past the point of stopping. Everyone will do whatever it takes to win.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_9.zh: 规则是赢家才有资格定的，战争打到现在已经停不下来了，为了赢，所有人会不择手段。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_9.speaker: Herriman

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_65.text: Of course, there's always a fool who thinks they're the exception... In this case, you, Doctor.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_65.zh: 当然，这个过程中总会有人想当被丢下的傻瓜，比如……医生你。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_65.speaker: Herriman

yakita:XCLST_11_2.text: I know you're scared of the High Tide. But it’ll help take some of the edge off once you're in a hunt yourself.
yakita:XCLST_11_2.zh: 我知道你很害怕「涨潮期」，但你只要亲眼看一次行猎的过程，就不会再胡思乱想了。

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21053_2.text: At your voice, Hiyuki stops her quiet muttering and discreetly closes her fingers around a note in her hand.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21053_2.zh: 随着你的搭话，绯雪停下了口中的默念，似乎悄悄将一张便签握紧在手心。

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21058_1.text: Hiyuki sits there quietly, resting against the white bird.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21058_1.zh: 绯雪安静地坐在那里，与白鸟依偎在一起。

yakita:HD_JYZDFY_21_13.text: I've already set a timeline with Hiyuki. This next trip is the last one the Collective is authorizing.
yakita:HD_JYZDFY_21_13.zh: 我和绯雪约定了时间，最近就是深空联合容许她进行的最后一次探查。
yakita:HD_JYZDFY_21_13.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_1.text: It's just the two of us now. No need for all the formality, Hiyuki.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_1.zh: 这里没有其他人了，在我面前就不用这么拘谨了，绯雪。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_47_1.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_27_7.text: Hiyuki is just doing her job. And she's kinder than she looks.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_27_7.zh: 绯雪只是在履行自己的职责。而且，她是个很温柔的人。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_27_7.speaker: Rover

yakita:MapMark_3340002_MarkDesc.text: The Voidbane Eldertree in the Sealed Fissure is protected by Hiyuki's Resonance Ability. Though not severely contaminated by Voidmatter, the tree is frozen under thick ice.
yakita:MapMark_3340002_MarkDesc.zh: 位于封存地样方内的虚蚀古代乔木。受绯雪的共鸣能力庇护，未遭遇过度虚质侵蚀，但被冻结在坚冰之下……

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_111_3.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_13_2
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_111_3.text: That said, where there's a will, there's a workaround. Hiyuki found one, though it took her some time.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_111_3.zh: 不过，路是死的，人是活的。绯雪花了些时间总算找到了通路。
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_111_3.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_114_3.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_15_1
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_114_3.text: (But the frost seems to be slowing the spread. That frequency... it feels like Hiyuki's.)
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_114_3.zh: （冰霜似乎在延缓它被虚质侵蚀的速度，这频率……似乎是绯雪留下的。）
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_114_3.speaker: Rover

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_115_2.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_16_1
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_115_2.text: (This white bird... did Hiyuki leave it here?)
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_115_2.speaker: Rover

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_193_22.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_21_2
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_193_22.text: After Hiyuki, there will be no more Mikos of Flaming Sakura.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_193_22.zh: 自绯雪以后，不会再有下一任灼樱巫女。
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_193_22.speaker: Hiyuki

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_193_34.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_21_2
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_193_34.text: That must be difficult for you to bear, little Hiyuki.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_193_34.zh: 这对小绯雪而言，有些难以忍受吧。

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_2_16.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半序章_2_1
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_2_16.text: ...N-Nothing! Lady Hiyuki, it's just... Ugh, thank you for everything you do! Goodbye!
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_2_16.zh: ……没什么的！绯雪大人，嗯……就是……您辛苦了！再见！

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_8_5.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半序章_5_1
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_8_5.text: Yes! Hiyuki, that's it! Such a pretty name, just like Lady Gyokuro's!
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_8_5.zh: 对，就是这个名字！和玉露大人的名字一样好听！

yakita:NPC_HZ_105_12.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_33_1
yakita:NPC_HZ_105_12.text: I get it. Even though Xinyi's ancestors were from Hongzhen, she came to the mountains later on. While her abilities are impeccable, her way of doing things is still a bit different from the locals here.
yakita:NPC_HZ_105_12.zh: 大家伙的想法我也理解，辛夷虽然祖上是虹镇的，但毕竟是后来进山，她的能力虽说挑不出毛病，可立身行事还是与虹镇人不大一样。

datamine:InfoDisplay_102801019_Text.title: Communication Log: That Child
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801019_Text.text:
Reply: That Child
Unfortunately, C-001 did not respond to the matter concerning that child. However, the fact remains that the dead baby did come back to life. We do not need C-001 to confirm anything for us, or else the strange occurrences of that day would be meaningless. As for the child's identity, there can be no other answer besides ■■■.
As for how the dead baby was brought back to life, I suspect it has something to do with the turning back of time, but neither you, I, nor the people of Hongzhen are able to remember the events of that night in detail. If we rule out the possibility of a collective hallucination, this at least indicates that the phenomenon of turning back time on that day only affected individual entities and not all of Mt. Firmament...
A citizen of Hongzhen told me that a child is now being fostered in the town. Maybe we should go and take a look...
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801019_Text.zh:
回复：“那个孩子”
很抱歉，关于“那个孩子”的事C-001并没有给予回应，但“死婴复生”，事实就是如此，我们不必与祂确认，否则那日的异象将毫无意义，甚至于那个孩子的身份，除了███，不会有别的答案。
至于“死婴”缘何“复生”，我猜测是与时间回溯有关，不过你、我还有虹镇人能够清楚地记得那夜之事的诸多细节，排除某种集体性幻想的可能，至少说明那天的时间回溯，并没有作用于整座乘霄山，而是仅仅针对个体施展的……
我从一个镇民那里了解到，“那个孩子”现在被寄养在镇上，也许我们该去看看……

datamine:InfoDisplay_102801021_Text.title: Hongzhen Chronicle Volume XIX: Major Events I
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801021_Text.text:
...
March. Various lands were ravaged by TD Outbreaks, and 31 victims climbed the mountain.
April 9. A TD Outbreak approached Mt. Firmament. On the night of the same day, a stream of fire fell on Empyrean Cliff. (Note: Empyrean Cliff was later renamed as Loong's Crest)
April 21. Two townspeople lured an outsider to the place where the stream of fire fell on Empyrean Cliff.
April 22. A TD Outbreak invaded Hongzhen. The Sentinel called Jué emerged from Empyrean Cliff, slowing the flow of time with its Temporal Mandate to repel the TD Outbreak and forming Mt. Firmament.
April 23. An outsider visited Hongzhen with the Sentinel Jué and left the mountain with 17 other townspeople later.
...
July 3. The outsider returned to Mt. Firmament, seemingly unaffected by the Temporal Disruptions. The locals have been referring to them as "that peculiar visitor" ever since."
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801021_Text.zh:
……
三月，诸地现残象潮，灾民三十一人入山。
四月九日，残象潮近乘霄山。是日夜间，西南天空有流火坠于凌空崖。（注，凌空崖后更名为“盘龙崖”）
四月廿一日，有镇民二人引一外乡者至凌空崖流火落点。
四月廿二日，残象潮侵入虹镇，岁主「角」自凌空崖出，以时序之能缓时流、退残象，乘霄秘地终成。
四月廿三日，外乡者随岁主「角」访至虹镇，后同镇民十七人离山。
……
七月三日，外乡者复返乘霄山，似不受时流所扰，得名“奇人”。

datamine:InfoDisplay_102801022_Text.title: Hongzhen Chronicle Volume XIX: Major Events II
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801022_Text.text:
...
March 5. Thunder started roaring at about 21:00–23:00, and the Sentinel Jué returned with a dead baby.
March 6. The thunder stopped around 01:00–03:00. Something strange was happening in the sky, and the stars were moving in reverse.
At 05:00–07:00 of the same day, the Sentinel Jué came to Hongzhen to entrust the baby to the townspeople. The baby looked completely normal with no signs of lifelessness.
(Note: It should be impossible for a dead baby to be brought back to life. I would never believe this if this was not my personal experience.)
...
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801022_Text.zh:
……
三月五日，夜亥时许，雷声大作，岁主「角」负一死婴归。
三月六日，丑时，雷止，天现异象，群星逆行。
是日卯时，岁主「角」临虹镇，托婴孩于镇人。婴孩面色如常，不复有死气。
（注，死婴复生，本是世间不可能之事，若非笔者亲历，实难置信。）
……

yakita:AreaReportContent_Text23.zh:
一份先行公约撰写的旅游指南，是关于乘霄山虹镇温泉的特别报道。

【极致治愈的仙境旅馆】落泉居！
落泉居是虹镇传承数百年的温泉旅馆，依山而建，靠泉坐落，和其他店家一样保有着独特建筑的风貌。自乘霄山的时流解封后，落泉居也终于开放了对外接待的服务——清冷的白雪飘舞，蒸汽在橘黄灯光中升腾，躺在这样惬意的温泉中凝望乘霄山上层层叠叠的山峦和朦胧雪景，能够治愈您心中一切疲惫和创伤！大部分游客都在离开虹镇后有种亦真亦幻、如访仙境的留恋感，使这里一跃成为全瑝珑最受欢迎的温泉圣地！

【温泉蛋挑战】完美流心！
作为全索拉里斯至今传承最久的温泉旅馆，落泉居从住宿到吃食，都完整地保留了原汁原味的乘霄山特色，受到广大住客的一致好评。落泉居的旅馆老板是远近闻名的饕餮，最懂得享受生活，享受美食。依靠温泉得天独厚的优势，他独创了温泉漫煮烹饪法，可以将食物放入密封陶罐，再放于温泉水中浸煮。
每年落泉居会举办温泉蛋挑战赛，根据参赛者煮出温泉蛋的流心状态来决定胜负，据说冠军可以获得一年的免费住宿权！

yakita:Guide_CLLJ_1_5.chapter: 剧情_活动_1.1历程记忆手册_1_1
yakita:Guide_CLLJ_1_5.text: I'm the one who had witnessed Hongzhen grow into what it is today before I handed it over to Xinyi.
yakita:Guide_CLLJ_1_5.zh: 我是看着虹镇长大，然后亲手把它交到辛夷手上的人。

yakita:Guide_CLLJ_1_57.chapter: 剧情_活动_1.1历程记忆手册_1_1
yakita:Guide_CLLJ_1_57.text: Back then, I thought Hongzhen needed Xinyi more than me, just like Jinhsi did Jué.
yakita:Guide_CLLJ_1_57.zh: 当年的我觉得，就像角需要今汐一般，虹镇比起我，更需要辛夷。

yakita:NPC_HBGC_25_6.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_15
yakita:NPC_HBGC_25_6.text: There's a caption here. Let me see... Verina in Hongzhen...?
yakita:NPC_HBGC_25_6.zh: 照片下面有注解啦……我看看……维里奈于虹镇……？

yakita:Side_CFYW_2_18.chapter: 剧情_1_1_支线_乘霄山灵异事件_28_1
yakita:Side_CFYW_2_18.text: Yes, that's me. And you must be the Rover, the hero Madam Xinyi spoke of from Jinzhou and Hongzhen?
yakita:Side_CFYW_2_18.zh: 嗯嗯，没错。啊……难道你就是辛夷大人所说的漂泊者，那个拯救了今州和虹镇的英雄？

yakita:ZXZTC_1_12.chapter: 剧情_2.0剧情直通车活动剧情梗概_1_1
yakita:ZXZTC_1_12.text: Xinyi, the mayor of Hongzhen, informed you that Jinhsi had only recently departed for Mt. Firmament's peak, in search of the Sentinel. Due to the temporal distortions, what had been days to you was merely moments inside the mountain.
yakita:ZXZTC_1_12.zh: 虹镇的管理者辛夷告诉你，因为山内外时间流速的差异，今汐才刚刚从虹镇出发前往乘霄山顶寻找岁主……

yakita:MAIN_YGDX_74_1.text: May applause greet you. Lupa from House Silva.
yakita:MAIN_YGDX_74_1.zh: 以呼嚎向你致意，西尔瓦家的露帕。

yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_50_4.text: Lady Hsin, surely You will show Yourself soon as well!
yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_50_4.zh: 心月狐大人，您想必很快也会现身了吧！

yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH_81_2.text: As things stand, even Lady Hsin's residence may not be called safe. Do take the utmost care.
yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH_81_2.zh: 如今形势特殊，心大人的行宫也难说安全无虞，请务必多加小心。

yakita:HXPOIST_3_2.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦枢天罗_火匣POI生态_3_1
yakita:HXPOIST_3_2.text: That's Lady Hsin's touch, isn't it? She's made this place grander than before.
yakita:HXPOIST_3_2.zh: 那当然是因为心月狐大人妙手生花，把这儿变得格外雄伟了。

yakita:MXXSST_11_1.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_11_1
yakita:MXXSST_11_1.text: 漂泊者! You really kept your word! So you and Lady Hsin already dealt with Suhsin?
yakita:MXXSST_11_1.zh: 漂泊者！你果真说到做到！溯心已经被你和心大人解决了？

yakita:MXXSST_11_4.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_11_1
yakita:MXXSST_11_4.text: That's not quite right. It isn't truly back to its "original state." Before, the Fox Shadow would either aid us on its own, or after we'd asked Lady Hsin for help.
yakita:MXXSST_11_4.zh: 你这话不太严谨，现在可不是所谓“最初的状态”，以前狐影要么是主动协助，要么是我们向心大人求助后祂才出手。

yakita:MXXSST_11_5.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_11_1
yakita:MXXSST_11_5.text: But now that Lady Hsin is no longer within the Simulacrum Nexus, we can only reach it through the Shadow Binder. That's a world of difference.
yakita:MXXSST_11_5.zh: 如今心大人不在梦枢天罗，我们只能通过「缚影璇玑」呼唤狐影，这可和以往大不同。

yakita:MXXSST_11_7.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_11_1
yakita:MXXSST_11_7.text: But at its core, the Fox Shadow is a creation of Fractal Proliferation. And Suhsin's power likely shares the same origin as Lady Hsin's. So perhaps all we need to do is adjust—
yakita:MXXSST_11_7.zh: 不过，狐影本质还是分形权能的产物，且溯心的权能和心大人应该是同源的，或许只要改变其中——

yakita:MXXSST_11_8.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_11_1
yakita:MXXSST_11_8.text: (I'd been worried the Fox Shadow might turn on them once Hsin was gone. Looks like I can finally put that fear to rest.)
yakita:MXXSST_11_8.zh: （原本还担忧心离开这里后，狐影是否对他们不利，看来可以放心了。）
yakita:MXXSST_11_8.speaker: Rover

yakita:MXXSST_13_3.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_14_1
yakita:MXXSST_13_3.text: That's right. They're projections from Lady Hsin's memory data. I was completely baffled the first time I met them.
yakita:MXXSST_13_3.zh: 对，他们都是心大人用记忆数据投射出的存在，第一次看见他们的时候，我还有些疑惑呢。

yakita:MXXSST_13_5.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_14_1
yakita:MXXSST_13_5.text: But after Lady Hsin explained it, I understood. She believes the people of Mengzhou are part of its civilization too. That's why She did it.
yakita:MXXSST_13_5.zh: 听心大人解释后才明白，祂认为梦州人也是文明的一部分，所以才这么做。

yakita:MXXSST_14_1.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_15_1
yakita:MXXSST_14_1.text: All these "phantoms"... Can Lady Hsin really sustain every one of them?
yakita:MXXSST_14_1.zh: 这些“幻影”是……心大人能维持住吗？

yakita:MXXSST_15_4.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_16_1
yakita:MXXSST_15_4.text: I have. They're Hsin's memory projections, so it makes sense.
yakita:MXXSST_15_4.zh: 嗯，既然他们都是心的记忆投影，有这种情况也在情理之中。
yakita:MXXSST_15_4.speaker: Rover

yakita:MXXSST_15_5.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_16_1
yakita:MXXSST_15_5.text: Exactly. But that means it costs Lady Hsin extra computational power to reunite people who could never otherwise have met, just to give them a chance to make up for their regrets.
yakita:MXXSST_15_5.zh: 对，但心大人还会额外消耗算力，让那些原本不可能相见的人重逢，弥补他们的遗憾。

yakita:MXXSST_15_6.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_16_1
yakita:MXXSST_15_6.text: That sounds just like Hsin. She can't bear to see people suffer. Is there some problem with that?
yakita:MXXSST_15_6.zh: 这确实是心会尽力去做的事，祂最不忍见人们悲伤的模样，有什么问题吗？
yakita:MXXSST_15_6.speaker: Rover

yakita:MXXSST_16_1.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_17_1
yakita:MXXSST_16_1.text: Look at this! My hands are trembling. The level of detail in Lady Hsin's simulation is really that precise.
yakita:MXXSST_16_1.zh: 你看，我的手在颤抖，心大人对知觉的模拟竟能深入到这种地步。

yakita:MXXSST_17_2.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_18_1
yakita:MXXSST_17_2.text: Ugh, every time it comes to this, I always wonder why Lady Hsin even bothered to simulate a feeling like this. Rest, sleep, hunger… it's all just noise. It only gets in the way.
yakita:MXXSST_17_2.zh: 唉，每次这种时候我都要说，心大人何必为我们模拟这些感觉，我们要休息、要睡觉、甚至还会肚子饿，这些都只会妨碍我。

yakita:MXXSST_19_10.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_20_1
yakita:MXXSST_19_10.text: Hsin will gather every Celestial's frequency into a Prism of Fate and sustain your existence with Her own computational power. And once the people of Solaris grow strong enough to reach a level of power comparable to a Sentinel's, She'll grant you new bodies.
yakita:MXXSST_19_10.zh: 心会将所有天人的频率收进宿镜，以自己的算力维持你们的存在。等索拉里斯人靠自己拥有比肩「岁主」的能力时，祂会赋予你们新的躯体。
yakita:MXXSST_19_10.speaker: Rover

yakita:MXXSST_19_2.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_20_1
yakita:MXXSST_19_2.text: I accepted my fate the day I swore my oath. But I never expected that the one I'd find hardest to let go of... would be Lady Hsin.
yakita:MXXSST_19_2.zh: 虽然在立誓的那天就做好了准备，但没想到此刻心中的不舍，竟更多是对心大人。

yakita:MXXSST_19_4.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_20_1
yakita:MXXSST_19_4.text: Haha, I suppose it would. You know Lady Hsin better than most. I imagine you understand exactly what I'm feeling right now.
yakita:MXXSST_19_4.zh: 哈哈，的确，比我们更了解心大人的你，很能理解我此刻的想法吧！

yakita:MXXSST_19_6.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_20_1
yakita:MXXSST_19_6.text: Lady Hsin, though... She'd come right up to us, praise our work, and gush about Her favorite stalls at the Waking Moon Festival. And when someone was lost to the anomalies... She'd cover her face and weep for them.
yakita:MXXSST_19_6.zh: 可心大人会来到我们身边，夸赞我们的成果，还会兴高采烈地诉说祂在朝月会上最喜欢的摊位，也会在有人卷入异象消亡时……掩面而泣。

yakita:MXXSST_19_7.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_20_1
yakita:MXXSST_19_7.text: My resolve has never once faltered. Still, I count it as the fortune of three lifetimes—that the Sentinel I gave my oath to was Hsin the Moon Fox.
yakita:MXXSST_19_7.zh: 尽管我的决心从未动摇过，可还是要感叹，我所献身的「岁主」是心月狐，可谓三生有幸。

yakita:MXXSST_21_2.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_22_1
yakita:MXXSST_21_2.text: Lately, Lady Hsin has been acting much more as She did back then...
yakita:MXXSST_21_2.zh: 最近的心大人，倒是更像那个时候的样子了……

yakita:MXXSST_2_3.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_2_1
yakita:MXXSST_2_3.text: Come on, it can't be that hard. You met Lady Hsin at the Waking Moon Festival. What else could you be but happy?
yakita:MXXSST_2_3.zh: 哪有这么复杂，在朝月会上见到心月狐大人，除了开心还能有别的？

yakita:MXXSST_32_5.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_33_1
yakita:MXXSST_32_5.text: But then again, why did Lady Hsin preserve our senses, our living forms, and all our emotions? When I think of that, I can't help but feel I've failed to live up to what She wanted for us.
yakita:MXXSST_32_5.zh: 可心大人保留我们的知觉、活着时的模样、还有万般情绪是为了什么呢？一想到这里，我便不禁自省是否辜负了祂的心意。

yakita:MXXSST_32_7.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_33_1
yakita:MXXSST_32_7.text: Heh... Hearing you say that, I can almost picture the look on Lady Hsin's face right now.
yakita:MXXSST_32_7.zh: 呵呵，听你这么说，似乎能想象心大人的表情了。

yakita:MXXSST_33_1.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_34_1
yakita:MXXSST_33_1.text: Flying lanterns as far as the eye can see across the Heart of Flames today. This must be the most unforgettable Waking Moon Festival in Lady Hsin's memory.
yakita:MXXSST_33_1.zh: 今日烬心域灯火满天，想必那是心大人印象最深的一次朝月会吧。

yakita:MXXSST_36_1.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_37_1
yakita:MXXSST_36_1.text: Do you think Lady Hsin can actually take on the form of a young girl?
yakita:MXXSST_36_1.zh: 你说心大人……果真能变成少女的模样吗？

yakita:MXXSST_36_2.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_37_1
yakita:MXXSST_36_2.text: Here we go again! I told you it was just your eyes playing tricks. Still rambling about "Lady Hsin in her maiden form"?
yakita:MXXSST_36_2.zh: 还说呢！说了是你眼花，还一口一个“少女模样的心大人”。

yakita:MXXSST_39_1.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_12_1
yakita:MXXSST_39_1.text: 漂泊者! Look! The Fox Shadow is completely different from before! So I take it you and Lady Hsin have already dealt with Suhsin?
yakita:MXXSST_39_1.zh: 漂泊者！你看，狐影和之前大不一样了！溯心已经被你和心大人解决了？

yakita:MXXSST_3_1.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_3_1
yakita:MXXSST_3_1.text: Still no sign of Her this year. Could it be... Lady Hsin won't ever come again?
yakita:MXXSST_3_1.zh: 今年还是没见到祂，难道……心月狐大人不会再来了？

yakita:MXXSST_4_1.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_4_1
yakita:MXXSST_4_1.text: Granny! I gave the Gilded Ball to Lady Hsin! And She smiled back at me!
yakita:MXXSST_4_1.zh: 奶奶！我把玲珑球交给心月狐大人啦！祂还对我笑了！

yakita:MXXSST_5_1.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_5_1
yakita:MXXSST_5_1.text: Of course she did. Lady Hsin would never miss the heart behind it.
yakita:MXXSST_5_1.zh: 当然啦。玥儿的心意，心月狐大人一定收到了。

yakita:MXXSST_5_10.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_5_1
yakita:MXXSST_5_10.text: The uncles and aunties in the village look after me like their own. And I met Lady Hsin! Remember the Gilded Ball you gave me? I got to give it to Her, just like you asked!
yakita:MXXSST_5_10.zh: 村里的伯伯、阿姨都很照顾我，还见到了心月狐大人。奶奶交给我的玲珑球，我也送到了祂手里！

yakita:MXXSST_5_3.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_5_1
yakita:MXXSST_5_3.text: I had the best time! Granny, you won't believe what happened! At first, Lady Hsin wasn't really Lady Hsin. Oh no, how do I explain this...
yakita:MXXSST_5_3.zh: 开心！奶奶，你听了一定会吓一跳！心月狐大人一开始……不是心月狐大人。哎呀，这要怎么说呀……

yakita:MXXSST_5_5.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_5_1
yakita:MXXSST_5_5.text: Mm! Lady Hsin came with me to buy sugar paintings. Then we solved word riddles, took a boat ride, and watched the Loong dance! The performance was amazing!
yakita:MXXSST_5_5.zh: 嗯！心月狐大人陪我买了糖画，猜了字谜，后来又一起坐了小船，还看了舞龙呢，可威风啦！

yakita:MXXSST_5_6.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_5_1
yakita:MXXSST_5_6.text: And at the end, we set off fireworks. They were huge! Lady Hsin flew up into the sky, and bursts spread out behind Her, all bright and sparkly... It was so, so beautiful.
yakita:MXXSST_5_6.zh: 最后还放了好大好大的烟花！心月狐大人飞到天上，烟花就在祂身后，一闪一闪的……特别漂亮。

yakita:MXXSST_7_13.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_7_1
yakita:MXXSST_7_13.text: Exactly. Oh, if your granny knew that you met Lady Hsin, and you delivered that Gilded Ball on her behalf... She'd be so proud.
yakita:MXXSST_7_13.zh: 对，若你奶奶知道，你真的见到了心月狐大人，还替她送出了玲珑球……一定很高兴。

yakita:MXXSST_7_2.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_7_1
yakita:MXXSST_7_2.text: I did. Lady Hsin will surely be glad to read it too. I just hope I get to see Her this year.
yakita:MXXSST_7_2.zh: 是呀，心月狐大人看了一定会开心，希望今年能见到祂。

yakita:MXXSST_7_4.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_7_1
yakita:MXXSST_7_4.text: Oh? We must've gone to the Festival at the same time. I met Lady Hsin, too.
yakita:MXXSST_7_4.zh: 哦？看来去年我们参加的是同一场朝月会呢，我也见到祂了。

yakita:MXXSST_7_7.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_7_1
yakita:MXXSST_7_7.text: But Granny always said I had to hand the Gilded Ball to Lady Hsin myself. So I went.
yakita:MXXSST_7_7.zh: 可是奶奶说，要我把玲珑球亲手交给心月狐大人，我就去了。

yakita:MXXSST_8_2.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_8_1
yakita:MXXSST_8_2.text: If even the artifacts Lady Hsin made are failing, then Her condition must be...
yakita:MXXSST_8_2.zh: 如果连心大人亲设的物件都效果欠佳，那祂的状态恐怕……

yakita:MXXSST_9_6.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_9_1
yakita:MXXSST_9_6.text: Here's how it is. Long ago, Lady Hsin used Her power of Fractal Proliferation to create the Nexus Fox Shadow. She entrusted it to watch over the entire Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou, and lend us aid whenever we called.
yakita:MXXSST_9_6.zh: 嗯……是这样的，当初心大人用自身分形权能，塑造了天罗狐影，祂让狐影代替自己俯瞰梦枢天罗全境，随时为我们伸出援手。

yakita:MXXSST_9_7.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_9_1
yakita:MXXSST_9_7.text: So, if the authority sustaining the Fox Shadow is starting to falter, then Lady Hsin... I'm sorry. That's all we can say.
yakita:MXXSST_9_7.zh: 所以，若连维系狐影的权能都开始动摇，那心大人……抱歉，我们只能说到这了。

yakita:MXXSST_9_8.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_9_1
yakita:MXXSST_9_8.text: Got it. Don't worry, Hsin and I will solve it together.
yakita:MXXSST_9_8.zh: 好，放心吧，我会和心一起解决这件事。
yakita:MXXSST_9_8.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_286_3.text: You'd never guess. Lady Hsin came and repaired it Herself!
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_286_3.zh: 想不到吧，这是心大人亲自来修的！

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_286_5.text: Agh, just a bit earlier and I'd have caught it... I really wanted to see how Lady Hsin did it in person!
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_286_5.zh: 唉……要是我再早来一点就好了……真想亲眼看看心大人是怎么做到的！

yakita:QingXiao_Shengtai_1_9.text: My disciple, you accepted Hsin's power before, and your body still needs time to adapt to it. You have been running ragged across Xuanfang lately without a moment's rest.
yakita:QingXiao_Shengtai_1_9.zh: 徒儿，你先前接受了心的力量，身体还需要适应，近来又在玄方地界奔波不休，似乎一直没好好休息。
yakita:QingXiao_Shengtai_1_9.speaker: Qingxiao

yakita:STNPC_JZST_32_1.text: I heard that if you toss a coin into the Four Chime Shaftpost, you'll be blessed by Hsin the Moon Fox!
yakita:STNPC_JZST_32_1.zh: 听说往四鸣井里投币，就能获得心月狐的赐福！

yakita:STNPC_JZST_33_4.text: You think Lady Hsin might have accepted it? My dream is going to come true!
yakita:STNPC_JZST_33_4.zh: 难道心月狐大人悦纳了？我要美梦成真了！

yakita:Side_XYHTZST_15_4.text: The Fox is one of the Sentinels in Huanglong. People often call it "Hsin."
yakita:Side_XYHTZST_15_4.zh: 心狐，指的就是心月狐了，瑝珑人大多称之为“心”。
yakita:Side_XYHTZST_15_4.speaker: Xianchen

yakita:Side_XYHTZST_15_5.text: Like our Sentinel "Jué," Hsin has its own state to protect.
yakita:Side_XYHTZST_15_5.zh: 和今州的“角”一样，都是一方岁主。
yakita:Side_XYHTZST_15_5.speaker: Xianchen

yakita:Side_XYHTZST_15_6.text: But Hsin loves to join in the celebrations with its people.
yakita:Side_XYHTZST_15_6.zh: 据说“心”是一位非常喜好热闹、也非常好动的岁主，也喜爱与民同乐，频频混迹在热闹处。
yakita:Side_XYHTZST_15_6.speaker: Xianchen

yakita:Side_XYHTZST_15_8.text: It's said that if you hear the leaves rustling, it must be Hsin wandering in the woods. Sometimes, it even leaves behind small, whimsical gifts, like this lottery wheel here.
yakita:Side_XYHTZST_15_8.zh: 传闻中，当枝叶传来簌簌声时，就是“心”穿行于林间之时。有时候，祂还会在林中留下一些无关紧要、但是惹人高兴的小东西。
yakita:Side_XYHTZST_15_8.speaker: Xianchen

yakita:StJCFYLQ_24_9.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_军策府和园林区配音生态_25_1
yakita:StJCFYLQ_24_9.text: It's said that their leader is still walking among us today, and has a deep connection to Lady Hsin the Moon Fox...
yakita:StJCFYLQ_24_9.zh: 据说那十人的首领仍存活于世，且与心月狐大人颇有关联……

yakita:ZXHXYHST_6_4.text: Joy and sorrow flicker across Hsin's face in turn, and every shift in Her expression makes the telling sweeter.
yakita:ZXHXYHST_6_4.zh: 心的神情映着喜悲，祂的每一个反应，都让你更享受讲述故事。

yakita:ZYHSGST_14_1.text: Say, if Paragon Qingxiao and Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox actually went all out, who do you think would win?
yakita:ZYHSGST_14_1.zh: 你们说，若是心月狐大人和清宵司骑打起来，谁会赢？

yakita:ZYHSGST_14_2.text: Is that even a question? Lady Hsin is a Sentinel. Who in this world is more powerful than a Sentinel?
yakita:ZYHSGST_14_2.zh: 这还用问嘛！心月狐大人可是岁主，这世间哪有比岁主还强的人？

yakita:ZYHSGST_14_4.text: Oh yeah? Lady Hsin can conjure an entire city out of thin air and drop it right on her head. Boom.
yakita:ZYHSGST_14_4.zh: 那心月狐大人还能凭空造出一座城呢，然后把城“轰”地砸下来……

yakita:ZYHSGST_14_6.text: ...Then Lady Hsin could just turn all of Xuanfang Hold into one giant Autopuppet that swallows the Paragon whole, swords and all!
yakita:ZYHSGST_14_6.zh: ……那心月狐大人还能让玄方城变成一只巨大的机傀，一口连人带剑都吞了！

yakita:ZYHSGST_14_8.text: Then... then Lady Hsin would just conjure another city!
yakita:ZYHSGST_14_8.zh: 那……那心月狐大人就再建一座城！

yakita:ZYHSGST_16_17.text: Mmm... When I broke through the restrictions back then, I thought my time as a Celestial was over. But Lady Hsin pulled me back from the brink.
yakita:ZYHSGST_16_17.zh: 嗯……那时候强行突破禁制，原本以为我的天人生涯就要到此为止，结果是心大人把我捞回来了。

yakita:ZYHSGST_16_21.text: Alright, fine. Lady Hsin loosened the restrictions so we could use these Autopuppets to explore the Hold. Everyone was so excited about the Waking Moon Festival...
yakita:ZYHSGST_16_21.zh: 好吧，其实是心大人暂时放宽禁制，让我们借着机傀去逛逛如今的玄方城呢……见朝月会举办，大家都很开心。

yakita:ZYHSGST_20_9.text: So, I heard Lady Hsin the Moon Fox has appeared? Where is She right now?
yakita:ZYHSGST_20_9.zh: 听说心月狐大人现身了？在哪儿呢？

yakita:ZYHSGST_2_1.text: "I am Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox. A sudden crisis has struck the Sanctum, leaving me trapped in its deepest depths..."
yakita:ZYHSGST_2_1.zh: “我是岁主心月狐，因神宫突发异变，我被困于深处无法脱身……”

yakita:ZYHSGST_3_4.text: Left nothing behind but a tuft of tail fur on the blueprints. That's when it hit them... she was Hsin the Moon Fox in disguise, come to help the Artisans crack what they couldn't!
yakita:ZYHSGST_3_4.zh: 只留下图纸间的一缕尾巴毛，大家这才发现……她实际是心月狐所扮，来帮天工们突破技术难关的！

yakita:ZYHSGST_3_5.text: Yeah, yeah, keep making things up. She's a Sentinel! Hsin the Moon Fox doesn't shed.
yakita:ZYHSGST_3_5.zh: 你就编吧，心月狐可是岁主，祂怎么可能掉毛？

yakita:ZYHSGST_4_2.text: Grandma... Hsin the Moon Fox isn't coming. Just try not to think about it.
yakita:ZYHSGST_4_2.zh: 奶奶……心月狐不可能出现的，别等了……

yakita:ZYHSGST_4_7.text: ...Xuanfang's been doing just fine on its own, even with Hsin the Moon Fox gone!
yakita:ZYHSGST_4_7.zh: ……就算没有心月狐，玄方地界靠我们不也还是好好的！

yakita:ZYHSGST_5_2.text: Of course I do! They say that Intendant is no small figure, plus she's got history with Lady Hsin...
yakita:ZYHSGST_5_2.zh: 当然！据说谛天鉴的那位州监来头不小，还和心大人颇有渊源……

yakita:ItemInfo_71200023_BgDescription.text: An item which Xuanqing refers to as the "Feeling Capsule," seemingly affiliated with Hsin the Moon Fox. Its frequency is linked with a certain location within the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou. When placed in the Inner Threshold, one can view the memories stored within.
yakita:ItemInfo_71200023_BgDescription.zh: 被璇情称为「情匣」的物件，似乎与心月狐有关。频率与梦枢天罗中的某处相互连通，放入心钥井后，可以查看储存其中的记忆。

yakita:Term852015_Desc.text: One of the Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox's manifestations, capable of fulfilling certain duties in Its place in the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou.
yakita:Term852015_Desc.zh: 岁主心月狐的法相之一，可代替其履行部分管理「梦枢天罗」的职责。

yakita:FavorWord_131210_Content.text: I've always dreamed of returning to Huating one day to live in a small cottage. If I am needed, I will help. If not, I will simply watch the world go by in peace, alongside Ninth and the others. That would be enough for me. But of course, that is still a long way off. For now, Hsin and Mengzhou's future must come first.
yakita:FavorWord_131210_Content.zh: 我始终想着，有一日能回到华亭，住进一间小屋。若这里需要我，我便出手相助；若不需要，便与九契他们一同，看小城在风平浪静中日来月往，如此便足够了。当然，那还是很遥远的事，眼下，心月狐与梦州大局为先。
yakita:FavorWord_131210_Content.speaker: Suoming

yakita:JSZYH_1_15.text: Mm-hm. {PlayerName}... let me call you that, just this once. I wish you all the best from here on. May all be well in Hsin's keeping.
yakita:JSZYH_1_15.zh: 嗯，{PlayerName} ——请让我这样称呼你一次吧，祝你今后诸事顺利，心驭万全。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_210_26.text: ...Miss Suisui, you are claiming you entered into a direct deal with Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox?
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_210_26.zh: ……穗穗小姐，你是说，你与岁主心月狐有一个交易？
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_210_26.speaker: Jinhsi

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_240_27.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_穗穗线_玩法副本_1_3_19
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_240_27.text: Hsin the Moon Fox projects a reality-based deduction of the current world crisis to make Suisui understand Her concerns.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_240_27.zh: 心月狐借由索诺拉复现的场景，希望穗穗理解祂如今的处境，并展开了一场基于现实的推演……

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_15.text: I discovered the connection in a dossier collected by the Commanders who came before me. Everyone knows when the Threnodian stirred at Norfall Barrens and Tacet Discords swelled beyond control, Sentinel Hsin looked ahead. She chose to build this Hold.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_295_15.zh: 这也是我闲暇时查阅历代定玄卫长留下的卷宗时看到的。当年，在北落野的鸣式复苏，残象潮愈演愈烈之际，岁主心未雨绸缪，决定修建玄方——这是众人皆知的事实。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_472_40.text: Mengzhou's Sentinel, Hsin the Moon Fox, has gone missing.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_472_40.zh: 梦州的岁主心月狐，如今似乎下落不明。
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_472_40.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_10.text: It is Hsin's residence, and the control mainframe of Xuanfang Hold.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_10.zh: 那是「心」的行宫，也是玄方城的控制中枢所在。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_150_10.speaker: Qingxiao

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_5.text: In short... Xuanfang Hold has weathered the storm.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_5.zh: 简而言之……玄方城算是安然地度过了此次危难。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_640_5.speaker: Hsin

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_142_2.text: Has Hsin reclaimed more of Her authority? Or... did Suoming do something?
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_142_2.zh: 或许是心收回了更多权限，还是锁暝做了什么……
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_142_2.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_26.text: Yes! Intendant Suoming, may all be well in Hsin's keeping.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_14_26.zh: 嗯！锁暝州监，祝您心驭万全。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_172_1.text: I've been waiting for you, little Suoming. Did you enjoy the journey?
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_172_1.zh: 锁暝妹妹，可算等到你了，这一路，玩得开心吗？
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_172_1.speaker: Hsin

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_51.text: How is our communication with Mingting? Any news?
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_51.zh: 向明庭发出的联络如何了，有消息了吗？
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_206_51.speaker: Hsin

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_1.text: What's that... Suoming gave it to you, didn't she?
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_1.zh: 怎么还拿着这种东西……是锁暝给你的吧。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_215_1.speaker: Hsin

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_217_2.text: Hsin, we'll discuss this more after we find Suoming and handle Suhsin.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_217_2.zh: 心，等找到锁暝，解决溯心后我们再谈吧。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_217_2.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_16.text: The Zhaoming Commerce Guild will provide us with cover along the way. Besides that, three more skilled individuals are joining us.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_16.zh: 昭明商会会给我们提供沿途的掩护，除此以外还有三位身手不错的能人异士。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_250_16.speaker: Hsin

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_25.text: As for the "Resonator War" you mentioned, we have analyzed Hsin's fragmented frequency and re-examined the Tethys System's data using that information.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_25.zh: 另外你提到的“共鸣者战争”，我们解析了「心」残缺的频率，依据其中的信息重新筛查了泰缇斯系统的数据。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_25.speaker: Shorekeeper

yakita:MapMark_3760008_MarkDesc.text:
A mysterious girl named Xuanqing asks for your help collecting the Feeling Capsule shards scattered by the Tuntun.
As you go deeper into this matter, a story surfaces about Hsin the Moon Fox, the Sentinel of the past.
yakita:MapMark_3760008_MarkDesc.zh:
你受身份成谜的少女璇情所托，帮她收集被屯屯毁坏的「情匣」碎片。
随着事件深入，一段有关过去的岁主「心月狐」的故事也浮出水面。

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_14_1.text: (Just as I thought. Xuanqing is Hsin's Resonator.)
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_14_1.zh: （果然，璇情就是心月狐的共鸣者。）
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_14_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_28_1.text: Hsin was talking about abandoning Mengzhou's borders… Was this before Xuanfang Hold was built?
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_28_1.zh: 心月狐说要放弃梦州边界……这是，在玄方城建立之前的事？
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_28_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_30_4.text: (So "I" am that strand of frequency Hsin gave Xuanqing in this memory.)
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_30_4.zh: （在这回的记忆中，“我”是由心月狐交给璇情的那段频率吗。）
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_30_4.speaker: Rover

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_34_2.text: That tail… it's just like Sister Xuanqing's… A-Are you Lady Hsin?!
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_34_2.zh: 和璇情姐姐一样的尾巴……你、你是心月狐大人吗？！

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_34_4.text: Thank goodness… Sister Xuanqing told me that if there's ever danger, I just need to follow Lady Hsin's shadow, and I'll be taken somewhere safe.
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_34_4.zh: 太好了……璇情姐姐说过，如果遇到危险，只要跟着心月狐大人的影子，就能被带到安全的地方。

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_36_7.text: (The leader of Xuanfang Hold should be Hsin, yet these people believe it's Xuanqing.)
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_36_7.zh: （玄方城的最高决策者应该是「心」，这里的人却认为是璇情。）
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_36_7.speaker: Rover

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_37_1.text: Lady Xuanqing, a letter has come from Mengzhou. From Lady Hsin.
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_37_1.zh: 璇情大人，梦州城有心月狐大人传给您的信。

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_38_12.text: (Building Xuanfang Hold was a decision Hsin made during the meeting with the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs. It had nothing to do with Xuanqing.)
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_38_12.zh: （修建玄方城，应该是心月狐在与谛天鉴的会议上所决定，与璇情无关。）
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_38_12.speaker: Rover

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_44_3.text: (It looks like, following the previous memory, Hsin took back the frequency She gave Xuanqing.)
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_44_3.zh: （看来上一段记忆后，心月狐交给璇情的那段频率，由祂本人接管了。）
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_44_3.speaker: Rover

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_49_19.text: Now, as Resonator of Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox of Mengzhou, I, Xuanqing—
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_49_19.zh: 那么，梦州岁主心月狐的共鸣者，璇情——
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_49_19.speaker: Xuanqing

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_51_7.text: Resonator of Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox... Xuanqing.
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_51_7.zh: 心月狐的岁主共鸣者……璇情。
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_51_7.speaker: Hsin

yakita:Side_GMXQ_10_1.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_10_1
yakita:Side_GMXQ_10_1.text: Hsin. Suoming and I are at the Simulacrum Nexus.
yakita:Side_GMXQ_10_1.zh: 心，我和锁暝在「梦枢天罗」了。

yakita:Side_GMXQ_46_1.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_46_1
yakita:Side_GMXQ_46_1.text: The task's done, Hsin. I believe Suoming is pretty satisfied.
yakita:Side_GMXQ_46_1.zh: 心，结束了，我想锁暝很是满意。

yakita:XJXYSSQTST_13_1.chapter: 剧情_学院宿舍前庭碎片化_14_1
yakita:XJXYSSQTST_13_1.text: Hsin the Moon Fox, Fang the Sun Hare, Promeus... Oh Sentinels above, I need your help...
yakita:XJXYSSQTST_13_1.zh: 心月狐、房日兔、普罗米厄……四方岁主保佑……

yakita:YBWP_1_7.text: Autopuppets. Creations of the Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox of Mengzhou. Powered by Kernels.
yakita:YBWP_1_7.zh: 机傀，梦州岁主心月狐的造物，以枢芯作为驱动核心。

yakita:FWNPC_QQYC_6_4.text: I wish they'd build a fancy place like this back in Huanglong.
yakita:FWNPC_QQYC_6_4.zh: 如果能在瑝珑也盖这样一个高档会所就好了。

yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_36_2.chapter: 剧情_七丘_列奥尼达广场生态_8_2
yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_36_2.text: So, do you prefer the Septimont or Huanglong styles?
yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_36_2.zh: 不知道你是更喜欢七丘的还是更喜欢瑝珑的风格呢？

yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_3_4.chapter: 剧情_七丘_列奥尼达广场生态_1_4
yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_3_4.text: Don't worry... Once I've earned enough credits, I'll head back to Huanglong and take all of you to Mingting. That way, my little sis can go to school there.
yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_3_4.zh: 放心吧……等我赚够了钱，就回瑝珑，到时候给你们搬到明庭去，让小妹去那的学校念书。
yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_3_4.speaker: Lane

yakita:NPC_24_JISHI_7_6.text: So I want to sell Huanglong spices in Septimont.
yakita:NPC_24_JISHI_7_6.zh: 所以，我想在七丘贩卖来自瑝珑的调味料。

yakita:Side_XYHTZST_41_11.text: Fighting crime is everyone's duty in Huanglong.
yakita:Side_XYHTZST_41_11.zh: 支持打击犯罪可是瑝珑人的义务。

datamine:InfoDisplay_102011901_Text.title: "Dream Return Song III: Stone Leaf Tears"
datamine:InfoDisplay_102011901_Text.text:
[…]

Intro:
Starry night, two farewells, leaves fall without a sound in another country.

[…]

After the Threnodian War, there was a pair of childhood sweethearts in Qichi Village, on the banks of the Xingtui River.

Zhisheng fifteen years old, valiant, good at water, not afraid of TD in wartime, once led the crowd to cross the Starry Night, is a young hero.

[…]

There was an ancient tree with flourishing leaves standing in the center of the curve, where Huanglong had won a great victory over Threnodian, and the people thought it was auspicious, and wanted to rebuild a new home here to seek blessings.

[…]

More strange place, said he heard the Lament, like crying like howling, endless.

[…]

Exactly:
Yesterday how to know today's things, can not look back to say unusual.

This side of the words just fell, there are people broke Gate and entered, dragged away the branch of life.

[…]

Zhisheng alone leaning against the tree, remembering the Lament last night, a piece of leaf fall, pick up the hand, even like a crystal, through the moonlight and flicker, such as tears fall without words.

I sighed and recited a poem:
Sinking night to sit and ask the return date, the wind over the leaves fall like tears condensation.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_102011901_Text.zh:
入话：
星垂一别两茫茫，叶落无声在他乡。
夜夜悲风谁有泪，石叶可证爱恨长。
话说鸣式战争后，中曲地星垂江畔祈池村，有一对青梅竹马。枝生年十五，生性英勇，善水，战时不为残象所惧，曾领众人夜渡星垂，是少年英雄。叶生年十三，见地独到，颇识大局，每做决断，便能使众人逃脱险局。两人感情甚好，多有扶持。
时有古木一株，枝繁叶茂，立于中曲。瑝珑曾于此大胜鸣式，众人以为祥瑞，欲在此重建新居，以求庇佑。战事既停，两人理应清闲下来，却遇上此事。叶生曰：“战事虽去，人心却仍有戚戚。如说古木能予以慰藉，许是好事，我决意与他们同去。”当下便与枝生分别，两人分居两地，各自帮助两村重建。好在通信不断，情未疏远。正是：
天高枝叶茂，地远根相连。
叶生一行到了古树地界，便着手行土木之事。村民欲得古树庇佑，便将村名与树名一同，唤作开觅，意为开地觅新，告别故旧。某一日，村民忽拾得一奇叶。叶甚新，未有干枯，却是白翠相间。村民大喜：“定是开觅回应，以此征兆奖我等。这就找一方小台，呈于家中，便可时时感开觅护佑。”其余村民若拾得此叶，也跟随效仿。正是：
叶生翠白色，心有祸福想。
吉兆须常在，佑以福绵长。
不多日，村中出一奇症怪病。病者夜中发作，浑身奇痛无比，似有重锤击之，又似刀剑割肉。更奇怪处，自言听闻悲鸣，似哭似嚎，不绝于耳。患病者不出五日，便难逃精神萎靡，浑身无力。时人曰：“当时选址邻树，是为开觅予我庇佑，枝叶通我气根。今日我命不久，定是开觅告信我等；夜声悲鸣，正是开觅求救之呼喊！”村民均以为善，自省建村时伐木有报应，不许再伐。
却说叶生在开觅难逃一劫，也患上了这“夜痛症”。枝生远在祈池听闻此事，心急如焚，不及天亮，便夜渡星垂，顺流而下，赶至开觅。见人人屋旁邻一树，白叶落于房梁沿，立刻心觉不安。又见开觅也如此，叶尖渐白，不似良兆。待见叶生，见其神色威垂，不禁潸然，曰：“你当日便知所谓古木祥瑞，不过人心苦楚，祈求慰藉。今日古木似有异常，为何不阻止他等愚行，早早放弃，同我重回祈池啊！”叶生欲言又止，痛苦难言，唯有泪眼相对。正是：
昨日怎知今日事，不可回首道寻常。
这边话音刚落，竟有人破门而入，拖走枝生。缘是众人听闻…

datamine:InfoDisplay_11010111_Text.zh:
学术交流周讲座安排：

讲座题目：残象分类及其能源学研究意义——以湮灭棱镜为例
讲座地点：第一报告厅
主讲人：詹斯曼
主讲人简介：新联邦科学院首席研究员，残象研究中心审核评估专家，新联邦鸣潮生态研究学会常务理事。主要研究领域为残象分类学、鸣潮生态学等。

datamine:InfoDisplay_11020112_Text.title: Exile's Diary
datamine:InfoDisplay_11020112_Text.text:
You can see the whole neighborhood from here, and I love to laze around ......
In order to follow in Big Brother's footsteps, I left Jinzhou behind and joined the Old City Gang.
This is a place that symbolizes the ruins of a place where prosperity is easily lost, but Big Brother believes it can usher in a renaissance that will surpass Huanglong's. I believe in Big Brother and look forward to working with him!
I believe in Big Brother and look forward, together with him, to witnessing the beautiful look of this long street once again lit up with streetlights.
datamine:InfoDisplay_11020112_Text.zh:
从这里可以看清整个街区，我很喜欢在这里发呆……
为了追寻大哥的步伐，我离开了背后的今州，加入了旧城帮。
这里是象征着繁华易逝的废墟，但大哥相信这里可以迎来超越瑝珑的复兴！
我相信大哥，并期待着，和他一起见证这条长街再次亮起街灯的漂亮样子。

datamine:InfoDisplay_11020118_Text.title: "Cat Tree"
datamine:InfoDisplay_11020118_Text.text:
The boss of the old city used to love to collect some fabrics from Huanglong, before I thought he had some weird pursuit of clothing, but I didn't realize that it was used to make this big shelf, maybe it is to be used as a proof of turning his back on Huanglong. ......
But this thing in addition to take up space, really not much use, recently, except for the little rice they love to come over to play, the other people simply do not care ......
datamine:InfoDisplay_11020118_Text.zh:
旧城的老大过去爱收集点瑝珑的布料，之前还以为他是对服装有什么古怪的追求，没想到是用来搞了这个大架子，也许是想作为背弃了瑝珑的证明吧……
但这玩意除了占地方，真的没啥用，最近除了小咪它们爱过来玩，其他人根本就不在意……

考察地点：瑝珑-归墟港市
关联项目：科考摩托原型机迭代研发

一、背景
在瑝珑归墟港市一带观察到名为「燎照之骑」的强大残象，其使用的载具可以在悲鸣后的环境中稳定运行，载具结构与运动模式有望为科考摩托的原型机开发提供参考。

地点：归墟港市-高架桥遗迹区域

· 高速状态下的操控响应逻辑；
· 非平整地形下的机动能力。

三、技术转化
基于对其运动模式与结构特征的逆向推演，工程团队对科考摩托原型机进行了以下改进：
……………………

研究员的字迹：
原型机完成了。没想到故乡当年的技术，能在今天被运用在科考摩托的开发上。
如今人们说起「燎照之骑」，依然会感到畏惧。我无法抹去残象带来的阴影，也无法让那些早已逝去的魂灵真正安息。但至少这台科考摩托原型机能证明，先祖的牺牲留下的，并非只有伤害和恐惧。
还有对未来的期许。
这台科考摩托会承载他们的意志，守护探索者们前行的路。

新历110年  岁主岁光击败鸣式，一位名叫辛夷的少女借着点点火种，重塑人们心中的希望。她在一个临时避难所发表了振奋人心的演讲，重建瑝珑的热潮于各地涌起。辛夷带领大家围绕岁主沉睡之地乘霄山开启了重建的第一步。

新历115年  经过中枢信标的推算，确定了新都选址，即如今的今州所在地。

新历116年  新年第一天，新都今州动工建设。

新历120年  今州完成了第一阶段建设，大部分居民从各地迁居今州，此后数十年今州的基础建设陆续完善。

新历134年  今州首次遭遇残象兽潮的袭击，此后残象兽潮频发，至今仍是威胁瑝珑的巨大危险之一。

新历155年  为鼓舞人心，举办了瑝珑四杰的表彰仪式。同年，与岁主岁光产生共鸣的今汐，成为新任龙主。

新历157年  瑝珑遭遇重建以来规模最大的残象袭击，被称为“巨浪兽潮”，此役付出惨重代价，最终由今汐唤醒岁光，才保住了重建的今州。

如今，瑝珑正从创伤中恢复，今州已成为所有瑝珑人的希望之所。

yakita:FavorStory_120404_Content.zh:
上流阶层虚与委蛇的礼仪与话术曾充斥着莫特斐的童年，父母的严苛与冷漠将莫特斐囚禁在了冰冷的书房之中，让莫特斐只能将怒火泄向家中的种种物件。
单纯的破坏并没有带给莫特斐更多的愉悦——大人们只是信手一挥，崭新发亮的物件便又被成套摆上，放置整齐。
真正让莫特斐感知到片刻平静的，是在一次次的拆解与重组的过程中，同这些机械造物“对话”时产生的交流感：无需察言观色，无需阿谀奉承，更不用承受没来由的怒火。一就是一，二就是二，机器坏掉，一定是哪里出了问题。只要找到问题，逐个攻破，一切都能够迎刃而解。
当莫特斐的所为被父母发现时，取代呵斥的，是父母洋溢自豪的认可——这即是烙印在新联邦人骨血中的技术崇拜。
在父母的支持下，莫特斐拥有了得天独厚的资源：价值不菲的材料，顶尖学者的指点，参与科研峰会的资格……众人的溢美为莫特斐戴上了一顶小小的王冠：莫特斐被誉为了新联邦最年轻的科研天才。
……直到那位少年的出现。
莫特斐仍记得17岁那年，在新联邦的万国博览会上遇见的那位少年。
明明是最低级的材料，却通过巧妙的组合方式实现了顶尖材料的稳定性。看似随意的设计，却值得用数十篇论文进行研究。简陋，低廉，但无论是实用性还是易用性，都远超自己的发明……这是真正为人所创造的发明，是真正的天才之作。
莫特斐在人群中望向少年，少年如同心有感应，也在人群中予以回望。
在众人的呼喊声中，他只记住了那位少年的来历——瑝珑。

yakita:FavorStory_130305_Content.zh:
渊武所在的拳馆曾是名盛一时的雷煌拳馆。
该拳馆曾经赢下无数荣誉，历代师傅也都是名贯瑝珑的武学名家。
雷煌拳速来以刚猛闻名，只可惜刚极易折，最近三代师傅都没能落个好下场。
特别是最后那代，据说在台上跟人比武时一拳打穿拳具，坏了规矩被赶出门。人生失意的他乘船出游却遇上雷暴，最终葬身鱼腹。说来也巧，最后那代师傅善使雷法，最终也为雷电所吞噬，一切都是因果宿命，可悲可叹呐。
中介说完这些，看向眼前这个慈眉善目的中年人：“这屋子可不算吉利，你真要买？”
中年人微笑着点了点头。
“好吧，该说的我可都说了啊。”中介叹了口气，“要买就买吧，可别再开拳馆了，不吉利。”

渊武推开那扇吱嘎作响的木门，阳光照进屋内，沉寂已久的灰尘被门风带起，漂浮在来之不易的温暖阳光中。
屋内陈设变化不大，摩擦得有点秃噜的木桩，地板破损的擂台，静静伫立一旁的展柜，展柜里的荣誉奖章落满了灰尘。
渊武仔细擦拭着这些旧物件，连同尘封的回忆一起。
木桩是师兄弟们练功时打秃噜的，展柜中的奖章是师傅们赢回来的，至于那地板，确实是自己打坏的。
彼时的他不知畏惧，不知收敛，那一拳打穿了拳具，打坏了地板，打碎了师傅苦心维持多年的微妙平衡，也将自己打进了风暴中央。名为现实的风暴将那个空有一身力气的青年拳师撕得粉碎，或许他真如传闻那般葬身鱼腹了吧。

拳馆重新开张了，笑容亲和的中年老板站在门口，招呼着来往的客人：
“欢迎来到渊武拳馆。”

yakita:FavorWord_110607_Content.text: Treasures are plenty if you look, but stealing is a total bore. yakita:FavorWord_110608_Content.text: Loong Buns are cool, they're like our tribute to the great Loongs. Food Ration Bars are cool too, they remind me of our soldier's dedication. Obviously, only the best meaningful food could ever impress Master Youhu!
yakita:FavorWord_110608_Content.zh: 小龙包是瑝珑人对龙的尊奉，喜欢！戍边粮是镇戍军的守护与思念，喜欢！食物也得有内涵，才配得上本大师的品位嘛。

yakita:FavorWord_121213_Content.text: The famous Madam Chongming Pruner... efficient, sharp-minded, and knows her way around all sorts. The Zhaoming Commerce Guild keeps growing with her at the helm. Rare goods from cities in and even outside of Huanglong keep flowing through her hands. Hm, color me impressed—I've seen my fare share of relics and curios. But if she's got the touch to gather all these lost treasures and put them back on the market... hah, that takes real skill.
yakita:FavorWord_121213_Content.zh: 大名鼎鼎的「重明折花」女士……行事利落，头脑清明，待人接物亦是八面玲珑。听说昭明商会在她主持之下日益兴盛，更有各州乃至瑝珑之外的奇珍古物，都在其中流转往来——这倒让我有些在意。我见过不少埋没的古物残器，若真有人能将这些散落之物一一收拢，再重新送入人间流转……倒也算是本事。
yakita:FavorWord_121213_Content.speaker: Jingran

yakita:FavorWord_141102_Content.text: Rules bind all. Those who breach them must be held to justice, regardless of background or past merits. The Internal Security Agency's work is never simple. When Grandmaster Liang led, our every action fulfilled our duty to Mingting and Huanglong's greater good. But much has changed since...
yakita:FavorWord_141102_Content.zh: 纪纲所系，即便兰芝当道，也不得不锄。镇抚司的差事，远没有那么单纯。梁先生还在的时候，我们做的事，也都是为了明庭，为了瑝珑。只是现在，时过境迁，物是人非……

考察课题：残象「燎照之骑」及其载具动态特征
考察地点：瑝珑-归墟港市
关联项目：科考摩托原型机迭代研发

一、背景
在瑝珑归墟港市一带观察到名为「燎照之骑」的强大残象，其使用的载具可以在悲鸣后的环境中稳定运行，载具结构与运动模式有望为科考摩托的原型机开发提供参考。

二、考察记录
地点：归墟港市-高架桥遗迹区域
通过布设感应器捕捉动态数据，发现「燎照之骑」在以下方面表现超出平均水平：
· 高速状态下的操控响应逻辑；
· 非平整地形下的机动能力。

三、技术转化
基于对其运动模式与结构特征的逆向推演，工程团队对科考摩托原型机进行了以下改进：
……………………

研究员的字迹：
原型机完成了。没想到故乡当年的技术，能在今天被运用在科考摩托的开发上。
如今人们说起「燎照之骑」，依然会感到畏惧。我无法抹去残象带来的阴影，也无法让那些早已逝去的魂灵真正安息。但至少这台科考摩托原型机能证明，先祖的牺牲留下的，并非只有伤害和恐惧。
还有对未来的期许。
这台科考摩托会承载他们的意志，守护探索者们前行的路。

yakita:ItemInfo_80001095_BgDescription.text:
When Suoming first arrived at Xuanfang Hold, she came across a dish flavored with tea broth called "Memories of Autumn," which awakened memories of the white tea from home. It was Tangning who later told her that this dish originally used no tea at all, but due to the lack of its true ingredients locally, it was a traveling soul yearning for the taste who used tea as a substitute, thus giving it its present form.
Suoming then procured Huating white tea and personally remade the dish. The tea's fresh aroma gave it a delicate flavor, and from then on it frequently graced her table. Those under her command secretly lamented that her homesickness was difficult to dispel, which accounted for her singular fondness for the flavor. Yet to her, it was merely a preference for that fresh and clear taste, and perhaps, without intention, this dish had also retained within it the flavor of her homeland.
yakita:ItemInfo_80001095_BgDescription.zh:
锁暝初到玄方城时，偶然尝到一道名为「客途秋忆」以茶汤入味的菜肴，这令她忆起故乡白茶。又从棠宁那得知，此菜本非以茶入馔，只是此地寻不到原本的食材，但思念这口味道的游子借茶寄思，方有今日模样。
锁暝听后取来华亭白茶，亲手改制此菜。茶香清鲜，滋味淡雅，自此便常见于她案前。属下见状，暗中哀叹她乡思难遣，才独钟此味。然而，于她而言，不过是偏爱那一口清鲜，只是无意间，这道菜似乎也将故乡的滋味一并留在其中。

yakita:FavorWord_131208_Content.text: The Huating of the past was mired in hardships. Resources were scarce, and fine cuisine a distant dream. The only exception was the local white tea. Truly exceptional. Even now, at the Ministry, I often find myself craving it. Every time I drink it, I think of them. As if that chapter of my life is... steeped in the color of the tea.
yakita:FavorWord_131208_Content.zh: 过去华亭在那般苦境中物资匮乏，自然没什么美食可言。唯有华亭自产的白茶，可称绝品。后来到了谛天鉴，我仍时常回味，每每品尝，总会回想起他们，好像那段回忆……都融在那茶色中。
yakita:FavorWord_131208_Content.speaker: Suoming

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_172_23.text: Our cause began in Huating. We refused to bow to a "greater good" that treated lives as expendable.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_172_23.zh: 我等自华亭而起，本就是不服大局为先，视小我如草芥。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_172_23.speaker: Suoming

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_11.text: Yes... They were willing to die for Huating. Still, I hated the Sentinel for never reaching out to help us.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_11.zh: 嗯……他们愿为华亭而死，但我愤恨于「岁主」从未向我们伸出援手。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_11.speaker: Suoming

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_9.text: My homeland, Huating, was ravaged by it. Countless lives were lost.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_9.zh: 我的故乡华亭受「恶瘴」威胁，生灵涂炭。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_248_9.speaker: Suoming

yakita:Side_GMXQ_13_2.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_13_1
yakita:Side_GMXQ_13_2.text: I've never seen a house like this in Huating. We'd better ask the boss next time. She'll know for sure.
yakita:Side_GMXQ_13_2.zh: 在华亭可没见过这种房子，下次问问老大吧，她肯定知道。

yakita:Side_GMXQ_15_4.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_15_1
yakita:Side_GMXQ_15_4.text: Still, a structure this grand... brings to mind an old story from Huating.
yakita:Side_GMXQ_15_4.zh: 不过，如此宏伟的……倒是让我想起一件华亭的旧事了。
yakita:Side_GMXQ_15_4.speaker: Suoming

yakita:Side_GMXQ_15_6.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_15_1
yakita:Side_GMXQ_15_6.text: A small matter. Back then, there was no place in Huating more extravagant than the estate of that ruthless ruler.
yakita:Side_GMXQ_15_6.zh: 小事而已，当年华亭就数那黑心主簿的宅邸最奢靡。
yakita:Side_GMXQ_15_6.speaker: Suoming

yakita:Side_GMXQ_19_2.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_19_1
yakita:Side_GMXQ_19_2.text: Oh, Seal Master, we swore to protect Huating from such fate, did we not?
yakita:Side_GMXQ_19_2.zh: 契主，你我约定华亭不会有这样的未来，对吧？

yakita:Side_GMXQ_20_2.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_20_1
yakita:Side_GMXQ_20_2.text: Huating's mountains and rivers are clearer and more serene than they were ever before...

yakita:Side_GMXQ_21_1.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_21_1
yakita:Side_GMXQ_21_1.text: The Seventh Seal was very forthright. As part of Huating's Ministry of War, even with a ruler as vile as sin, he couldn't bring himself to defy orders.
yakita:Side_GMXQ_21_1.zh: 七契性子太直，身为华亭军策府的一员，即便主簿恶贯满盈，他难以违抗军令。
yakita:Side_GMXQ_21_1.speaker: Suoming

yakita:Side_GMXQ_41_19.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_41_1
yakita:Side_GMXQ_41_19.text: I know the weight of my responsibility. I know they laid down their lives for the real Huating—the home we left behind.
yakita:Side_GMXQ_41_19.zh: 可我知晓肩负的责任，也清楚他们的死是为了在这之外，那真实存在的故乡华亭。
yakita:Side_GMXQ_41_19.speaker: Suoming

yakita:Side_GMXQ_41_20.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_41_1
yakita:Side_GMXQ_41_20.text: We made a promise. The path of righteousness we vowed to walk from Huating still stretches ahead, and I cannot stop halfway.
yakita:Side_GMXQ_41_20.zh: 我和他们约好了，从华亭起步的正道，还未走到尽头，我不会停在途中的。
yakita:Side_GMXQ_41_20.speaker: Suoming

yakita:Side_GMXQ_43_6.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_43_1
yakita:Side_GMXQ_43_6.text: I met with the Sixth Seal, as well. She was always far more eloquent than I was. Without her, we never would have gained support from Huating's people.
yakita:Side_GMXQ_43_6.zh: 六契也见上面了，她远比我能言善道，最终华亭百姓能支持我，她功不可没。
yakita:Side_GMXQ_43_6.speaker: Suoming

yakita:Side_GMXQ_43_7.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_43_1
yakita:Side_GMXQ_43_7.text: The Seventh Seal still wears that same worried look. None of us loved Huating more than he did.
yakita:Side_GMXQ_43_7.zh: 七契到现在也还是忧心忡忡的模样，要论对华亭的情感，他比我们都深。
yakita:Side_GMXQ_43_7.speaker: Suoming

yakita:Side_GMXQ_52_1.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_56_1
yakita:Side_GMXQ_52_1.text: I don't know what hole you fiends crawled out of, but don't you dare set foot in Huating!
yakita:Side_GMXQ_52_1.zh: 你们是何处来的邪魔怪道，别想进入华亭！

yakita:POI_HKSM_XZ_9_16.chapter: 剧情_剧情_虎口山脉_世界任务_13_2
yakita:POI_HKSM_XZ_9_16.text: Yes, rebooting the Refinery Tower requires sufficient power. Uncle Lei'li, you know the best about the power equipment. What's your advice?

datamine:InfoDisplay_11010104_Text.title: Work Report
datamine:InfoDisplay_11010104_Text.text:
Date: December 31, AL 159
Reporter: Huaijin

In collaboration with the Huaxu Academy, the Ministry of Development has issued the latest edition of the Energy Safe Transportation Guide. 
Acknowledging the importance of thorough comprehension, the foreman entrusted me with the preliminary study, emphasizing subsequent training for our fellow miners. Additionally, I am working on compiling accident case analyses to reinforce our collective safety awareness.
To facilitate better understanding among my fellow miners, I have taken on the responsibility of distilling and highlighting key points for the team.
datamine:InfoDisplay_11010104_Text.zh:
新历159年 12月31日
 记录人：怀瑾
 
研究院和天工联合发布了最新版的《鸣潮子泄漏应急手册》，工头说这里就属我最懂黑石能源，让我先学习学习，过两天给其他矿工们培训下。六十多页的说明，两天哪够，怎么着也得两周吧。
“对于沾染了放射性粉尘的人员、装备、物资，可通过洗消措施降低放射性污染。”
 “被污染的废水，必须经过离子交换处理，不可随意排放。”
研究院的人不知道怎么想的，既然是给矿工的手册，就应该用简单直白的话。什么离子交换，矿工哪懂这些。
 算了，算了，虽然麻烦了点儿，看在工头的面子上，我给大家提炼提炼重点吧。
哎，大过节的还要加班，真希望干了这活儿，能给我放一周假。

datamine:InfoDisplay_11040134_Text.title: Jiting's Research Note
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040134_Text.text: "Field Investigation Notes of CSC Ruins - No. 13"  The mystery of the CSC's disappearance has not been solved by the re-investigation of the site. Documents of the site, transcripts of residents from surrounding areas, and the archives of the Huaxu Academy... All remain very few in quantity even combined. Some remarked that CSC paid the price for their arrogance, and others said that CSC led the way toward the future of mankind.  But what exactly did the most advanced research institute at the time intend to achieve when they left behind these perplexing facilities all across Jinzhou?  (No offense intended! Personally, I believe CSC's behavior of leaving equipment everywhere is not very environmentally friendly. I condemn them only from my personal point of view.)
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040134_Text.zh:
《稷廷遗址实地考察手记·十三》
重新实地探访考察稷廷消失的谜团，没有增加任何有用信息。
现场遗迹、周边居民的笔录、华胥研究院的档案……整合起来的记录，依旧寥寥无几。
有人说，稷廷为自己的傲慢付出了代价，也有人说，稷廷为人类的未来指明了一条道路。
而彼时最先进的研究机构，在今州多地留下了难解的机巧，这究竟是意欲何为？
（无意冒犯！私以为稷廷到处遗留装置的行为非常不环保，仅从我个人的角度予以谴责。）

datamine:InfoDisplay_11040145_Text.title: Work Report
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040145_Text.text:
Date: December 31, AL 159
Reporter: Huaijin

In collaboration with the Huaxu Academy, the Ministry of Development has issued the latest edition of the Energy Safe Transportation Guide. 
Acknowledging the importance of thorough comprehension, the foreman entrusted me with the preliminary study, emphasizing subsequent training for our fellow miners. Additionally, I am working on compiling accident case analyses to reinforce our collective safety awareness.
To facilitate better understanding among my fellow miners, I have taken on the responsibility of distilling and highlighting key points for the team.
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040145_Text.zh:
新历159年  12月31日
记录人：怀瑾

研究院和天工联合发布了最新版的《能源安全运输手册》，工头说这里就属我心细，让我先学习学习，顺便给其他矿工们培训下。百来页的守则，怎么着也得一两周才能讲明白吧，而且这讲明白和想明白还是两码事，我还得整理一批事故案例分析，才能加深大家的安全意识。

呐，你看扉页就写着：“每一个规定都是教训换来的。”
今州的工业能走到今天，说到底还是安全、安全，全靠的安全。

这本矿工专用的说明手册，措辞也算简单直白，不拽文也不掉书袋，才能最快进脑子。听说桃祈事务长在修订的事儿上没少下功夫。

哎，算了，算了，虽然麻烦了点儿，看在工头的面子上，我给大家提炼提炼重点吧。
哎，大周末的还要加班备课，真希望干了这活儿，能给我来点调休。

datamine:InfoDisplay_31000018_Text.zh:
主题帖：那位神奇的客人现在在哪里？
 
 八焖炖甲
 那位能够肉身吸收声骸的神奇客人现在在哪？重金聘请这位客人立即到实验科报道！
 
 青河的尺度
 啥神话故事？肉身吸收声骸？
 
 打工皇帝
 不愧是被令尹指名的今州的客人，这究竟是怎么做到的？
 
 八焖炖甲
 有这位客人做研究对象，未来二十年的研究指标都不用愁了，大家有信息记得在这里分享啊！
 
 骊骊原上草
 据说，目标今天就会出现在今州的华胥研究院。
 
 萍水相逢
 今天？但今天我要在外头采样，可恶啊！
 
 梨园雪
 对待客人还是要维持基本的礼貌，像看猩猩一样围着只会把客人吓跑。
 
 八焖炖甲
 那肯定的，我一定让这位移动的珍贵素材自愿走上实验桌。
 
 骊骊原上草
 你这听起来就很恐怖好吧！
 
 大风吹
 说起这个，大伙还记得一百多年前的“危城”事件吗？巨浪级的残象攻入了城内，所幸将军及时赶回，将残象斩于马下！但是当时并没有技术可以处理遗留的残响，而巨浪级的残响能量甚至可能会引发小范围的海蚀现象！
 但是据说在未时，城内出现了一个黑发金瞳的神秘人，他凭空吸收了遗留的残响，阻止了灾难的发生，事了拂衣而去。
 
 打工皇帝
 历史总是惊人的相似。
 
 大风吹
 比肩百年前的神秘人，这就是客人的实力！
 
 八焖炖甲
 说得我越来越期待了，大家一定要共享关于这位客人的情报啊！

yakita:AreaReportContent_Text21.text:
[…]

Report on Lampylumen

The Tiger's Maw Mine primarily produces Lampylumen along with other ore deposits, as well as a minor quantity of Tacetite ores.

Following years of joint research by Huaxu Academy and the Ministry of Development, a unanimous conclusion has been reached regarding the formation of the Tiger's Maw.

They found that tectonic shifts caused by the Waveworn Phenomenon altered the plate tectonics in Jinzhou, uplifting ore deposits formed tens of millions of years ago to the upper crust and introducing Lampylumen into the domain of human knowledge.

[…]

Application: Lampylumen can be used in chips for Terminals and Resonance Beacons, as well as in the manufacturing of various high-precision components (further assessment required).
yakita:AreaReportContent_Text21.zh:
《关于辉萤矿的报告》

虎口矿场为复合型矿场，主要产出资源为辉萤石，同时有多种伴生矿物与少量黑石矿产出。

关于虎口矿坑的形成，华胥研究院与天工经过历时多年联合考察一致得出结论——
海蚀现象引发的地壳变动，改变了今州的板块结构，将千万年前的矿石翻到了上层，辉萤石继而进入了人类的视野。
关于辉萤石矿脉的初步勘察结论如下：

形态：大部分辉萤石的结构为立方体单体或多个穿插，其方正的形状也为采集提供了一定的便利。高温可融，融化后易塑形。
特性：辉萤石因其特殊的形成方式，使得辉萤石的内部结构呈现出如同电路一般的排布方式，是绝佳的半导体片材。
应用：可作为终端与信标的晶片，用于各类精密元器件的制造（需进一步评估）。

yakita:NPC_HBGC_2_2.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_2_1

yakita:Flow_311000010_69.chapter: 剧情_虎口生态_NPC_虎口矿场_7_1
yakita:Flow_311000010_69.text: It's been a while, Rover! We solved the mine's crisis all thanks to your help.

yakita:Term750042_Desc.text: A special pharmaceutical substance developed for extremely rare diseases. However, its severe side effects make it intolerable for most, keeping it under ongoing research and validation. In its natural form, Ichor is a volatile golden liquid that radiates intense heat at room temperature. In rare cases, it can be controlled and stabilized into a solid form.
yakita:Term750042_Desc.zh: 一种用于治疗极端罕见病的特殊药物，但因鲜少有人能负担其强副作用，至今仍还处于研究及验证阶段。常态呈黄金色液态，常温下不稳定，具高热特征。极少数情况下，可经由控制呈现为固态。

yakita:Term750043_Desc.text: A pharmaceutical corporation based in the New Federation. Its core technology originates from the development of Ichor, a groundbreaking medical advancement shadowed by perpetual controversy.
yakita:Term750043_Desc.zh: 扎根于新联邦的中小型医药集团，其核心技术源于一种被称为“日髓”的特殊药物——既被视为突破性的成果，也始终伴随着争议与审视。

yakita:FavorGoods_151002_Content.text:
A pair of pristine white medical gloves. They conceal his Tacet Mark and the old, unhealing wound from which flows the golden blood he calls "Ichor."
 
To him, this blood is a source of power. To others, it is a searing danger. So he keeps that gleam, and the history it represents, neatly contained beneath the spotless fabric.
yakita:FavorGoods_151002_Content.zh:
一副纯白色的医用手套。手套下掩藏着声痕，同时也是旧伤的所在之处，伤口处至今仍会渗出被称为“日髓”的黄金血液。
血液于他是力量之源，于常人却是灼人的危险。因此，他将这抹金色连同过往的痕迹，一并妥帖地收敛于洁净的布料之后。

yakita:FavorStory_151001_Content.text:
[…]

The man known as his "father" gripped his palm, still unmistakably a child's, and watched as golden blood, "Ichor," oozed from the wound like molten gold.

[…]

The words shook the child's eardrums like thunder.

[…]

Luuk Herssen gazed at the soft curls on the boy's head and felt the urge to stroke them.

[…]

The frail flame flickered in the night wind, reflecting in Rhein's wide, shining eyes.

"Make a wish, then blow it out," Luuk said, trying to sound cheerful.

[…]

...So many years had passed.

He let out a breath and pressed the memories back into the far reaches of sleep.
yakita:FavorStory_151001_Content.zh:
屋内的冷光总是彻夜昏沉。陆坐在灯下，顺从地将手掌摊开——名义上的“父亲”握着那只还明显属于孩童的手，眼见金色的、被称为“日髓”的血液如同融化的黄金一般从伤口处汩汩流出。他知道父亲在透过自己看另一个人，那个因罕见病而早逝的、真正的孩子，自己只是被挑选来承载这份执念的容器，一个或许能用以填补那一空缺的可能性。然而所渴望的异变并没有发生，日髓只是安静地流淌，父亲的目光从狂热渐渐转向失望。
“……为什么不会有变化呢，明明你是少数能够接纳日髓的人。”父亲的喃喃声落在孩子耳中，闷重如同滚雷，敲得鼓膜都在发抖，“明明日髓是最有希望治愈罕见病的东西……明明我们投入了这么多……为什么总是没有变化呢？”

莱伊就是在这样的时期，来到这个“家”中的。
陆看着父亲兴奋到连声音都维系不稳，说这是个和你一样身患罕见病却能承受住“日髓”治疗的孩子，以后就是你的弟弟了——陆望着这个并未被血缘所牵连着的“弟弟”，小小的男孩比自己还矮上一头，肤色是与自己一样长期受病痛折磨的苍白，显然还不是对这世界能有独立认知的年纪，也显然并不知道这个“黄金血”的治疗研究意味着什么、自己已经被动背负起了何种期冀，他只是像所有同龄小孩一样，为这个全新的“父亲”塞到自己手里的糖而开心得忘乎所以。
是喜欢糖的孩子啊。陆·赫斯望着小朋友蓬着卷发的头顶，想摸一摸，但一想到自己掌心还没能愈合的伤口，又很快收回了手。

与父亲料想相同的是，莱伊非常喜欢自己，还没学会太多生词，就已经能黏黏糊糊地追在“哥哥”背后喊名字了。
与父亲料想不同的是，莱伊比自己更快产生了对于日髓的排异。治疗不再对他有效，他以肉眼可见的速度消瘦了下去，很快便几乎难以离开病床。
这天是莱伊的生日。陆背着他，贴着墙壁阴影，穿过漫长走廊，偷偷溜出了房子。奔跑，不停地奔跑，直到清新的、带着植物鲜嫩气息的自由空气灌满肺叶，直到璀璨得近乎奢侈的星空取代了惨白的诊疗室顶灯。
他们停在庄园边缘一片荒废的小花园里。
这里堆满了破损的花盆和枯叶，委实算不上一道好看的风景，但泥土是松软的，空气是流动的，太久没能离开病房的莱伊还是瞬间亮了眼睛。
“生日快乐，莱伊。”
陆喘息着，从怀里掏出一…

yakita:FavorStory_151004_Content.text:

The Ichor chose you."

yakita:FavorStory_151004_Content.zh:
冬日的末尾，空气里还凝着未散的寒意。当陆终于从堆积如山的集团事务与私下调查中抽身，推开特别监护室的门时，几乎认不出床上那个消瘦的身影。
莱伊靠在枕头上，曾经蓬松的卷发如今枯黄地贴在额前，听到动静，他只是眼珠微微转动了一下，嗓子里没有发出任何声音。
陆蓦地想起父亲曾经说过的话——“你应该感到幸运，你被'日髓'选中了。”
尽管伴随着色觉障碍与不时的全身灼痛，但他确实是唯一，真正被日髓治愈了病症的人。其他绝大部分的受疗者，最终结果都与如今的莱伊别无二致。

陆在床边的椅子坐下，房间里只有仪器规律的滴答声。他试图打破这令人窒息的沉默。
“前阵子我去进修了心理学，想着……也许能更好地理解一些事，帮助一些人。”他顿了顿，“现在我厨艺也进步了很多，不再是当年那个把蛋糕烤焦的笨蛋了。莱伊你有什么想吃的吗？我都可以做。”
没有回应。陆并未气馁，又换了个话题。
“我最近……认识了一个朋友。很聪明，也很可靠，打破了我一些陈旧且固执的想法，我想我应该去尝试着改变……”
“你需要改变吗？”莱伊突然开口了，声音嘶哑，却像一把冰冷的锥子径直扎下，“你不是，一直优秀得不同于我们这些凡人的吗？”
陆喉中一梗，所有努力维持的平和在一瞬崩解。他看见莱伊那双曾经亮晶晶的眼睛，此刻只剩下一种近乎麻木的淡漠，而深处，翻涌着不易察觉、却无法错辨的恨意。

……

“他拒绝再跟我对话。”房间里，陆低声说。
终端那头，对方的声音一如既往地冷静：“他恨的不是你，是‘赫斯’这个姓氏所代表的一切。你只是他唯一可以安全投射这种恨意的对象。”
陆沉默了片刻：“……谢谢。”
“查到什么了？”
“很多线索快要连起来了。”陆的目光投向窗外，天边黑云翻滚，风雨欲来，“今晚……我会去验证真相。”

那个暴雨夜，雨水像是要把整个世界都砸进地底。他独自走进荒芜墓园，惨白闪电撕裂天幕，映亮矗立于前方的、父亲的墓碑。
然后他看见了——
雨幕深处，一个撑伞的身影静立在碑前，仿佛早就预料到自己会来这里。雨水在伞面上炸开成水花，又顺着边缘汹涌淌下，几乎织成一道瀑布。可就在那一片混沌迷蒙的灰与黑之间，他竟清晰地看见了那双望来的眼睛。
……金色。像熔化的日…

yakita:FavorStory_151005_Content.text:
[…]

Students fresh from training crowded around the treatment bed, watching as Luuk Herssen wrapped the ankle of their particularly unlucky friend.

[…]

Or rather, it was hard to say whether the "creature" whose skin was veined with gold could still be called Rhein.

[…]

The Ichor, once believed to be his salvation, had completely consumed him.

[…]

Using his own body as the anchor, he drove Rhein beneath the frozen earth.

[…]
yakita:FavorStory_151005_Content.zh:
午后的日光穿过玻璃，在洁净的地板上切出明暗交错的条纹。几个刚结束体能训练的学生热闹地挤在诊疗床边，看着陆·赫斯给其中一个扭伤脚踝的倒霉蛋包扎。
“陆医生你这包扎技术也太帅了！”被包扎的男生龇牙咧嘴，“能不能教教我？！”
陆利落地打了个结，拍拍他肩膀：“正好，学费医药费一起结吧。”看着学生瞬间僵住的表情，他忍不住弯起嘴角，“开玩笑的。不过下次训练前记得热身，我可不想在校运会上看到你坐着轮椅参赛啊。”

学生们都笑起来，气氛轻松愉快。
“赫斯医生，我们一会儿要去游牧集市逛逛！你去吗？”
陆看了眼墙上的时钟，摇了摇头，语气中带着恰到好处的遗憾：“今天不太行，待会儿还有别的学生的预约。”他眨眨眼，压低声音，“而且我听说……食堂的蛋糕今天半价，你们要是去晚了可就抢不到了。”
学生们一拍脑袋，立刻热热闹闹地鱼贯而出。校医室的门合上，将外面的喧嚣隔绝，骤然降临的寂静里，消毒水的气味似乎变得浓重起来。陆望向窗外，想起上一次看到这样的日光的时候。

那也是他最后一次见到莱伊。
——或者说，很难确认那个皮肤上爬满金色纹路的“生物”还是不是莱伊。全集团倾注半生心血的治疗计划，最终还是没能治愈除陆·赫斯以外的罕见病患者，但在生命的最后时刻，莱伊甚至也没能死于这种疾病——曾被寄望于能够拯救他的“日髓”彻底反噬了他，已然神志不清的他连伤数人，一路奔离诊疗室，眼看就在彻底崩溃失控的边缘。陆感受到日髓在掌心发烫，俨然是已迫不及待要化为刀刃，但是……
但是，还有其他方法吗？
陆望着那双曾经会因为一颗糖而露出烂漫笑意的眼睛，里面已找不出一丝清明。日髓烫得可怕，在亢奋地催促他，他却迟迟没有动作，他在想……有除杀掉莱伊以外的、制止他的方法吗？
暴雪与失控的嘶吼声一齐汹涌而来，模糊了他的视线。
有办法的。他握紧手心。
因为我跟他一样。因为我们……流着同一种血。

在最后一刻，陆反转了掌心日髓的相态，以自身为锚点将莱伊钉在冻土之下。瞬间固化的日髓不仅束缚了对方，也将源头处的他一并暂时固锁于此。冰霜自脚下蔓延，灼痛自掌心回涌，二者在躯体内达成一种汹涌而寂静的相持。
当意识临近消散之际，他察觉到有人赶来了他身边，轻声…

yakita:FavorWord_151001_Content.text: Funny thing. When I first went color blind from the side effects of Ichor, the world turned into an old black‑and‑white movie overnight. The only color I saw was the mesmerizing golden hues gilding the world around me: the morning light dancing on the windowsill, students' smiles as I unwrapped their bandages, and the vibrant energy they brought to the room as they pushed open my door... Look, even this bouquet the students brought me this morning glows faintly with the same golden light. Perhaps when I have time, I'll go pick out new specimens myself.
yakita:FavorWord_151001_Content.zh: 说来有趣，刚因为日髓副作用而失去色觉那会儿，世界像是一夜之间变成黑白老电影，唯独日髓的金色愈发鲜活。窗棂上跃动的曦光，学生们拆绷带时的笑容，以及推门进来时所带的朝气，在我眼里都会化成深浅不一的金色……你看，连这捧今早学生们送来的花束，也泛着细细的金光。等下次有空了，我也去挑些新的品种吧。
yakita:FavorWord_151001_Content.speaker: Luuk Herssen

yakita:FavorWord_151011_Content.text: These restraint devices on my neck and arms... they're for containing the Ichor, or what they call the "Golden Serum." Nothing mysterious here. I'm sure you've heard the story, haven't you? They're just "surgical scars." The Ichor can remold itself into any form I desire. As long as I need it, it always appears in my hand in perfect shape. Thanks to these, the Ichor stays quiet within me. I don't... pose any threat now, and I'm in full control.
yakita:FavorWord_151011_Content.zh: 我在脖颈和手臂上装了用于拘束日髓的装置——啊，也就是他们口中的“黄金血”，其实不过是一些陈词滥调之事，你应该早听过了吧？没什么神秘的，只是“治疗”留下的残迹。离体后能变成任意形态，根据需要自动塑形，总是以最称手的姿态出现在我掌心。有这些小玩意儿帮忙，它能听话地待在体内，现在的我……很安全，也能控制它。
yakita:FavorWord_151011_Content.speaker: Luuk Herssen

yakita:FavorWord_151029_Content.text: ...The Ichor's stirring. It burns a bit, but still tolerable. It's fine. Pain is the doctor's language. It reminds me why I took on this duty, and where I must go.
yakita:FavorWord_151029_Content.zh: ……日髓在流动。有点烫，但尚在能够忍受的范畴。没关系，疼痛是医者最熟悉的语言，它在时刻提醒我为何执起这份职责，又该去向何方。
yakita:FavorWord_151029_Content.speaker: Luuk Herssen

yakita:MAIN_RGLC_10_4.text: The "Golden Serum" developed by the Novialle Group. But I prefer its other name—Ichor.
yakita:MAIN_RGLC_10_4.zh: 诺维尔再生医药研发的“黄金血”，但我更习惯喊它的另一个名字——日髓。
yakita:MAIN_RGLC_10_4.speaker: Luuk Herssen

yakita:Side_Coop_StingerDate_3_16.text: I'm not much of a movie buff, to be honest. Thanks to the Ichor, I see everything in shades of gray, no matter how vibrant it's supposed to look.
yakita:Side_Coop_StingerDate_3_16.zh: 坦白说，我在电影鉴赏这方面可没什么天赋——因为“日髓”的影响，再美丽的色彩，在我眼里，都只是不同程度的灰罢了。
yakita:Side_Coop_StingerDate_3_16.speaker: Luuk Herssen

datamine:InfoDisplay_133002004_Text.title: Pilgrim's Sail
datamine:InfoDisplay_133002004_Text.text:
Those deemed faithless by the Order of the Deep are sent to voyage upon the Pilgrim's Sail, following the ancient path of those who once braved the mist and maelstrom seeking the Sentinel's guidance.

The Order claims that only Imperator can grant absolution to these transgressors. They must endure a grueling pilgrimage, suffering both body and soul until their repentance is complete. At the journey's end, it is said Sentinel Imperator will offer them forgiveness and the promise of new life.

But no one in Ragunna has ever heard of a faithless "pilgrim" returning from this sacred journey. The Order asserts that they reach Imperator's place of dwelling and devote themselves to Their service for eternity. While many still harbor doubts, few dare to openly challenge the Order—none wish to suffer the same tragic fate as those branded Fools.
datamine:InfoDisplay_133002004_Text.zh:
被隐海修会所判定的无信者，将会搭上修会所建造的朝圣船，效仿昔日穿越浓雾与惊涛骇浪，只为亲身聆听岁主教诲的虔诚信徒进行朝圣之旅。
修会认为，这些罪人所犯下的亵渎之罪只能由岁主英白拉多亲自赦免。他们必须经历一段艰苦的朝圣之路，任由苦难洗涤身心，并对自己所做的一切进行发自内心的忏悔——岁主会在朝圣之旅的终点迎接他们，并赐予他们赦免，让他们重获新生。
然而，直到现在为止，拉古那人都未曾听说过任何一名无信者从朝圣之旅中归来。修会声称他们抵达了岁主的居所，并自愿在那里虔诚地侍奉岁主。即使对此说法抱有疑虑的人不在少数，也几乎没人敢公开质疑修会的权威——没人想要重蹈那些愚人的覆辙。

datamine:InfoDisplay_133002010_Text.title: Common Echo
datamine:InfoDisplay_133002010_Text.text:
In Rinascita, most Echoes can exist independently from Reserved Terminals within the radius of the Genesis Nexus. They are known as Common Echoes.

In Ragunna, the Order of the Deep governs the allocation and use of these Echoes. The people of Ragunna revere them as divine gifts, even as envoys of Sentinel Imperator. They treat them as friends and trusted allies, incorporating them into every aspect of daily life. This deep, symbiotic bond with Common Echoes is what has earned Rinascita its name as the "Land of Echoes."
datamine:InfoDisplay_133002010_Text.zh:
在黎那汐塔，大多数声骸都能够不依靠私人终端，在「起源信标」的影响范围内长期存在。这些声骸被称为「公共声骸」。
在拉古那，公共声骸由隐海修会进行管理和分配。拉古那人将公共声骸视为岁主的赐福，甚至岁主的使者，他们以对待朋友和伙伴的方式与这些声骸相处，同时，他们也广泛将公共声骸用于生活中的方方面面。可以说，黎那汐塔之所以被称为「声骸之国」，正是因为这些形形色色的公共声骸。

datamine:InfoDisplay_133002011_Text.title: Genesis Nexus
datamine:InfoDisplay_133002011_Text.text:
Rinascita's central Resonance Nexus, also known as the Genesis Nexus. According to legend, Imperator revealed the secrets of the Genesis Nexus to the Rinascitans, enabling them to construct other such towering monuments that stand as symbols of the Sentinel's power and sovereignty.

Within the reach of the Genesis Nexus, Echoes can endure in physical form without relying on Terminals.
datamine:InfoDisplay_133002011_Text.zh:
黎那汐塔的中枢信标又被称为「起源信标」。传说中，岁主将起源信标的秘密分享给了黎那汐塔人，让他们得以建起这些象征岁主权能的丰碑。
在起源信标的影响范围内，声骸可以不依靠终端而长久存在。

datamine:InfoDisplay_142000002_Text.title: A Segment of Davide's Voyage Log
datamine:InfoDisplay_142000002_Text.text:
Day 16.
They all say that Rinascita's outer sea is riddled with dangers—storms, mist, reefs, and TDs that could swallow a ship whole. Some even claim that the world beyond Rinascita had already died in the Lament long ago, with only our isles left under Imperator's protection.
Pure rubbish.
They've let fear of the unknown take over. They think I'd never dare take a Gondola out to the open waters, saying I'm just a river rat full of big talk. Well, I'll prove I'm no coward like them!
Today I caught a fine fish. A good sign, I'd say, and a nice meal. Now I have the stars above to guide my way, what's to fear? Storms? Waves? Bring them on! As long as I have my Gondola, there is no place in Rinascita I can't reach.
datamine:InfoDisplay_142000002_Text.zh:
航行的第十六天。
他们都说黎那汐塔的外海满是危险，到处都是风暴，能够吞下一整艘船的残象，武器和礁石。甚至有人信誓旦旦地声称黎那汐塔之外的世界早已在悲鸣之中死去，英白拉多只来得及庇佑我们脚下的这些微不足道的岛屿。
要我说，这都是胡说八道。
那些家伙早就被未知和挑战吓怕了。他们不相信我敢只驾着一条贡多拉驶向远洋，他们觉得我只是个能在拉古那的河流间混混日子的吹牛大王。我就要让他们看看，我不是和他们一样的胆小鬼！
今天钓到了一条大鱼，可以好好吃一顿了。天上的群星会指引我的方向，那我还有什么好怕的呢？
风暴？怒涛？让它们放马过来！只要有我和我的贡多拉，黎那汐塔就没有我去不了的地方！

datamine:InfoDisplay_160000002_Text.title: Audio Log 4
datamine:InfoDisplay_160000002_Text.text:
The bastard and that lapdog of hers are still on my tail. But this is as far as I can go for now. I need to rest. My right hand hurts so much I think it might be broken. As for my mind... I still feel dazed, but already much clearer than before. I thought I was losing it... I need to sit here for a while. Here's hoping those traps can buy me some time...

Soon I'll be able to see the sun, see the moon... the skies. Sometimes I forget I once belonged there, a place with sunlight and order. And here? Even the air reeks with despair... By Imperator, may this cursed dump and all its evil slowly rot in these dark sewers.

I couldn't find Brandon, but I have a feeling he was here—I can't tell if it's a hunch or if I'm being delusional. He must've made it out already... Yeah, that's right. The fellow's got more tricks up his sleeves than I do. He must've dropped his ID card in those vents as a distraction. Even got me fooled. Just like when we played pool... And here I am worrying about him. Ha, I'm such an idiot.

It's fine, I'll be out soon enough. Brandon, when I find you... I'm going to give you a good punch in the face. Just you wait.
datamine:InfoDisplay_160000002_Text.zh:
那家伙和她的走狗还在追我。但我不能再往前了，我必须先休息一下。右手很痛，可能断掉了。意识……不太清醒，但我觉得比之前好多了。之前的我快要疯了……我要在这坐一会，希望这里的机关能为我争取到足够的时间……
很快我就能看到太阳，看到月亮……看到天空。我都忘记了我曾经属于那里，属于一个有着阳光和秩序的地方。不像这里，连空气都充满着绝望……英白拉多在上，让这个受诅咒的鬼地方，还有一切罪恶和疯狂都在暗无天日的下水道里慢慢腐烂吧。
我并没有找到布兰登，但我觉得他来过这里——我不知道这算是直觉还是妄想？他一定比我先逃出去了……对，那家伙可比我狡猾多了。他一定是故意把身份牌丢在了那条通风管道内，借此来分散那个疯子的注意力，甚至连我都被骗到了。他在打台球的时候不就这么做过吗？我居然还在担心他的安全……哈哈，我真是个笨蛋。
没关系，我很快也能出去了。布兰登，等我在外面找到你……我一定会狠狠给你一拳的，给我等着吧。

datamine:InfoDisplay_160000013_Text.title: Audio Log 3
datamine:InfoDisplay_160000013_Text.text:
[…]

Maybe by the time I make it out of here, Ragunna City will already be a burning ruin with only the criminals left, throwing an endless carnival of destruction and evil.

[…]

Imperator protect me...

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_160000013_Text.zh:
我看到了那些失踪的人到底遭遇了什么。我不能继续再在这里待下去了。这里的空气都弥漫着疯狂，我怕……我待久了以后，会变得和他们一样，残忍，扭曲，并漠视法纪。
我已经在这里待了多久了？地下水道里并没有昼夜的概念，也许一周？也许一个月？也许等我离开这里的时候，拉古那城已经成了一片燃烧的废墟，而只有罪犯们幸存下来，他们将举办一场关于毁灭和邪恶的无止尽的狂欢夜？
……他们会毁掉我会毁掉这座城市就连海洋也无法浇熄他们内心的火焰它会在废墟上熊熊燃烧我们都会燃烧殆尽……
英白拉多庇佑我……对，没错。希望仍在，祂会庇佑我的躯体与心灵……一定会的。
现在我要履行我的职责，以一名学生，一名记者，以及一名信徒的名义，我……我必须离开这里，把真相告知所有人，赶在那个塔洛斯用罪恶的暴行荼毒我们之前阻止她。
……对，我知道，我可能会死去，可能会更惨……如果他们抓到我……
但我不能什么都不做。该死的，动起来！我的腿！不能在这个时候……
他们被塔洛斯叫走了……好机会。盯着我的人也变少了。一定是布兰登，我就知道……他引开了那些人。
我还藏了一把短刀，我一直在等待今天……我把我的日志藏在了黑街的许多地方，如果我遭遇不测，那么后来者也会因此了解这里到底发生过什么。勇气……对，唯有勇气，唯有身为人类最宝贵的品质……才能制止疯狂。
啊求求你了万能的无上的英白拉多愿你从高天赐予我垂怜愿你的目光永远凝视你的信徒愿你将勇气和胜利带给信众愿你的光耀粉碎此地的一切黑暗愿正义携你的羽翼降临于尘世……

datamine:InfoDisplay_21020113_Text.title: Confessions
datamine:InfoDisplay_21020113_Text.text:
—O Supreme Sentinel, the Great Imperator, I have never questioned you.
 
You led us from the farthest reaches of the sea to this land, teaching us to walk the righteous path and embrace joy.
 
Yet those who claim to be your servants have distorted your teachings. The masses remain silent, while those who stand by the truth are banished here.
 
May you forge our faith into spears, and our suffering into hardened shields. May you… grant us vengeance, or at the very least, a merciful rest.
datamine:InfoDisplay_21020113_Text.zh:
——无上的岁主，伟大的英白拉多，我从未质疑过您。
您将我们从大海彼端带到这片土地，教导我等走向正途，拥抱欢乐。
然而，那些自诩为您仆从之人，他们篡改了您的教谕。众人缄默不语，而坚持真理之人，却被流放于此。
愿您将我等信念塑为长矛，愿您将我等苦难铸为坚盾。愿您……赐予我们复仇的力量，或至少给予我们慷慨的安眠。

datamine:InfoDisplay_311000010_Text.zh:
《隐海圣典·导论（第137次修订版）》

世人或许对隐海修会存在着诸多误解，对圣典中屡次提及的诸如恩典、救赎、怜悯、信心等奇异的词语望而却步，又或是怀疑，岁主英白拉多又从未在人们面前显露过自己真正的样貌，我们又何以笃信其真实？
事实上，黎那汐塔卷帙浩繁的史书，均记载了岁主英白拉多默默对抗悲鸣的功绩。黎那汐塔境内的宏伟遗迹，风景奇观，无不缘自岁主的权能。而今，祂已为人类创造出了更良好的生存环境，完成了祂应行的路。祂将权柄授予了人类，交由我们开创崭新的未来。而岁主自己，则化身至黎那汐塔的万事万物之中，默默关照着我们的一切。
我们感念祂的洪恩，并尊崇着祂善意的教导与行径，愿循祂所愿，向人们传递同样的理念，指引人们向善——这也正是隐海修会的使命。
为此，在大博学者卡丝琳教士的带领下，我们编纂了这份导论，希望能够帮助世人理解岁主及修会的理念，化解人们对修会的种种误会。也希望有更多的人能藉此行上良善的道路。
以下，我们将以修会所接收到的，最具代表性的疑问作启：

一、岁主英白拉多是何种存在？
岁主英白拉多乃是和平、谦卑、公正、仁慈的神。需要注明的是，我们并非将岁主英白拉多视作唯一神存在。
英白拉多曾亲口诉说，在存在文明的其他疆域，同样存在着岁主。祂们司掌着不同的权能。或掌控日月交替，星斗移转，时间流逝，又或许司掌着古今全部的知识与智慧。无一例外的是，祂们都在无私地教授着人类，引导文明的发展。所谓岁主，皆为伟大的神明。
然岁主英白拉多掌握着名为「分离」的权能，我们相信是英白拉多分离了海洋，给予了人类「呼吸」的空间——大地，自己则栖息在了天空之上。换言之，我们有理由相信，是英白拉多创造了这个世界，其地位于岁主之中极为崇高。

二、修会是否具有教义？
在我们看来，尘世是一片隐秘巨大的海洋，每个人都在其中沉沦，向下坠落。凡不愿溺毙于水中之人，必学会不断向上，直至头颅浮出水面，方能窥见神明所在的国度。生命在浪潮中漂流，靠岸后方才形成文明。恰是岁主使狂风止息，波浪平静，在海上拯救了人们的性命，并指引人们从尘世的汪洋中逃离，建立了如今名为黎那汐塔的文明。
如今，我们将修会的教义总结为：「拯救」、…
