yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_65_6.speaker: Ivory Gatekeeper

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_65_7.text: Anyway, the boss finds all of you endlessly entertaining. And it just loves to get nice and close to see what you'll do next.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_65_7.zh: 总之，你们的存在能够满足主人的好奇心，祂也非常乐意与你们近距离接触。
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_65_7.speaker: Ivory Gatekeeper

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_65_9.text: In that case, {PlayerName}, if you ever get the chance to meet, I can teach you a thing or two about getting along with the boss, meow.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_65_9.zh: 既然这样，{PlayerName}，有机会的话，我可以教教你和主人如何相处喵~
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_65_9.speaker: Ivory Gatekeeper

yakita:Event_TSHJMY_3_7.text: ...No, that's still too wild a thought. As far as I know, the only one lurking in the Dreamfield with that kind of power is...
yakita:Event_TSHJMY_3_7.zh: ……不，这还是有点太夸张了。据我所知，潜伏在梦野之中，还具有这种力量的只有……
yakita:Event_TSHJMY_3_7.speaker: Ivory Gatekeeper

yakita:Event_WGZM_6_10.text: That's reassuring. Please do keep exploring the Somnoire.
yakita:Event_WGZM_6_10.zh: 嗯，请继续向梦境的深处前进吧。
yakita:Event_WGZM_6_10.speaker: Ivory Gatekeeper

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_100_15.text: That depends on Lucy... This is her Somnoire, after all.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_100_15.zh: 这就取决于露西了……毕竟这里是她的心之集域。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_100_15.speaker: Ivory Gatekeeper

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_246_22.text: I know that, meow! Why do you think I didn't say this in front of Lucy or Rebecca?
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_246_22.zh: 这点我当然知道啦喵！所以我才没有当着露西和丽贝卡的面说这件事。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_246_22.speaker: Ivory Gatekeeper

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_50_12.text: Lucy, do you have the frequency band's shard with you?
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_50_12.zh: 露西，那块捡到的频段在你身上吗？
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_50_12.speaker: Ivory Gatekeeper

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_50_14.text: I'll explain. This shard Lucy recovered is part of what my colleague and I call a Dream Band.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_50_14.zh: 我来解释一下喵。露西捡到的这个碎片，我和小黑称呼它为幻梦频段。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_50_14.speaker: Ivory Gatekeeper

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_50_24.text: I do not know this "David," but from what I can tell, he is the embodiment of Lucy's happiness.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_50_24.zh: 虽然我不认识你们所说的大卫，但根据现状来看他多半就是露西梦境的具象化。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_50_24.speaker: Ivory Gatekeeper

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_50_30.text: The Nightmare Tacet Discord and the Dream Band were born in Lucy's dream. They are figments of her imagination.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_50_30.zh: 幻梦频段和梦魇残象都是由露西梦境诞生的产物，是如同幻想一般的存在。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_50_30.speaker: Ivory Gatekeeper

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_50_36.text: Oh, meow... This is more complicated than I thought. Lucy, you haven't told her the truth?
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_50_36.zh: 呜喵，事情看来比我想得更加复杂啊。露西，你还没有告诉丽贝卡真相吗？
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_50_36.speaker: Ivory Gatekeeper

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_50_6.text: While the Gatekeeper and I were researching solutions, Lucy contacted me...
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_50_6.zh: 在我和白色守门人研究解决方案的时候，露西小姐刚巧发来通讯……
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_50_6.speaker: Mornye

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_55_1.text: Now let's discuss getting Lucy back home, meow.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_55_1.zh: 我们来聊聊露西回去的事情吧喵。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_55_1.speaker: Ivory Gatekeeper

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_5_8.text: I'm not a cat! I'm the Ivory Gatekeeper of the Somnoire!
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_5_8.zh: 我不是猫，是心之集域的白色守门人啦！

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_13_4.text: Ivory Gatekeeper. I was about to try to contact you.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_13_4.zh: 小白，我也正打算联系你。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_20_3.text: (These voices are closing in... This isn't right. It can't be the Ivory Gatekeeper...)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_20_3.zh: （这些声音越来越密集了……不对……它不是白色守门人……）

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_213_2.text: Why are you using the Ivory Gatekeeper's account?

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_226_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_通用和碎片化文本_4_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_226_1.text: A cat's footprints? Could they have been left by the one impersonating the Ivory Gatekeeper?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_226_1.zh: 猫的脚印？会是那个假扮小白的人留下的吗？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_85_3.text: Hello, Ivory Gatekeeper? I'm having some trouble in the Somnoire.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_85_3.zh: 小白，在吗？我在心之集域遇见了一些麻烦。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_13_1.text: This must be the pocket of the Somnoire Jedediah mentioned.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_13_1.zh: 看起来，这里就是杰凯德先生所说的那片空间。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_19.text: What did Jedediah say before he lost control?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_19.zh: 杰凯德失控前还说了什么？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_20.text: Let me think... Oh, right. He mentioned a name. Promeus, the New Federation's Sentinel. He said that was the name he kept hearing, over and over.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_20.zh: 我想想……对了，他还提到了一个名字，普罗米厄，也就是新联邦的岁主，杰凯德先生说这是他反复听到的名字。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_20.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_24.text: (And Promeus. Why would a Sentinel be mentioned in something like this? Could It be connected to the war Jedediah spoke of?)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_24.zh: （而且普罗米厄的名字也出现在其中，难道祂与杰凯德先生提到的战争也有关系？）

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_3.text: ...Damn it! Damn it! These damn voices just won't leave me alone!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_3.zh: ……该死！该死！这些该死的声音还在响个不停！
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_3.speaker: Jedediah

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_4.text: Promeus, the Resonator War... Get it all out of my head!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_4.zh: 无论是普罗米厄，还是共鸣者战争，你们都从我脑袋里滚出去！
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_4.speaker: Jedediah

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_7.text: Please take Mr. Jedediah to the Ministry of War to rest. I'll check in later.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_7.zh: ……辛苦你们先把杰凯德先生带到军策府上休息吧，我晚点也会过去。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_7.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_9_2.text: {PlayerName}, Mr. Jedediah has been settled in.

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_9_3.text: Don't worry, I'll make sure this Goldrunner is seen to before I leave.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_9_3.zh: 放心，我会在离开玄方城前帮你处理好杰凯德先生的事情。

yakita:Flow_11000001_495.text: Hehe. I need to put in some more practice, that way one day I can be just as strong as that girl Jianxin!
yakita:Flow_11000001_495.zh: 嘿嘿，我要更努力地锻炼，争取和常来拳馆的那个小姑娘鉴心一样强！
yakita:Flow_11000001_495.speaker: Yeye

yakita:ItemInfo_80001023_BgDescription.text: Maintaining a healthy body is crucial. The combination of gold and silver lotus seeds in this recipe provides warmth, nourishment, and a calming effect on both the body and mind. It was the first medicinal meal Jianxin learned during her mountain retreat and remains one of her go-to recipes for overall health and well-being.
yakita:ItemInfo_80001023_BgDescription.zh: 固本强身，养生为本。并蒂金银与莲子两种食材搭配在一起，有益气温补、安神醒目之效。这是鉴心在山上修行时最早学会的食补方子，也是她最常做的药膳之一。

yakita:Term850042_Desc.text:
Jianxin can hold up to 120 Chi.
Chi is obtained when Normal Attack Fengyiquan hits the target.
Chi is obtained when the Resonance Skill Calming Air is cast.
Chi is obtained when the Resonance Skills Chi Counter or Chi Parry hits the target.
Chi is obtained when the Intro Skill Essence of Tao hits the target.
yakita:Term850042_Desc.zh:
【气】上限120点。
常态攻击风仪拳术命中目标时，获得【气】。
施放共鸣技能静气循行时，获得【气】。
共鸣技能行气反击或共鸣技能降气反击命中目标时，获得【气】。
变奏技能掌息之要命中目标时，获得【气】。

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_35_17.text: Is that the divination lot you wanted Jianxin to decipher?
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_35_17.zh: 所以，你想让鉴心解开的卦签……

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_35_29.text: Great! I'll be sure to pay you a hefty sum! Best of luck, Jianxin, 漂泊者!
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_35_29.zh: 那太好了。找到之后，我必有重谢！祝你们顺利，鉴心，漂泊者！
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_35_29.speaker: Uncle Dong

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_38_10.text: You and Jianxin open the casket. However, except for some herbs wrapped in silk pouches, there is only a yellowed piece of paper.
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_38_10.zh: 你和鉴心打开了木匣，但里面除了放了一些用锦囊包裹的药材外，只有一张泛黄的纸条。

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_41_2.text: Hold on, Jianxin. Since it says "in the stall" we can probably cross out large stores from our list.
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_41_2.zh: 等等，鉴心。既然卦辞中说的是逐利之亭，那想必指的不是大型的商铺。
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_41_2.speaker: Rover

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_42_5.text: You and Jianxin open the wooden casket. Inside there is an ordinary looking black porcelain bowl.
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_42_5.zh: 你和鉴心打开了木匣，里面放着一个看起来平平无奇的黑色瓷碗。

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_43_21.text: Anyway, thank you, 漂泊者, Jianxin. Thank you for helping me find this bowl.
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_43_21.zh: 不管怎么说，谢谢你们，漂泊者，还有鉴心。谢谢你们帮我找到了这个瓷碗。
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_43_21.speaker: Uncle Dong

yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1405_Info.chapter: 鉴心档案_共鸣能力鉴定报告
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1405_Info.text: Jianxin, a Taoist monk and successor of Fengyiquan, has dedicated her life to mastering the ultimate martial art. With the power to harness and transform environmental Chi, she can create protective barriers that purify both body and mind.
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1405_Info.zh: 一生只追求武术极致的道士，实力莫测、抱朴守一的风仪拳传人。拥有将周围环境气韵化为内在，形成涤净力场的能力。

yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1405_TalentCertific.chapter: 鉴心档案_共鸣能力鉴定报告
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1405_TalentCertific.text:
The waveform graph of Jianxin illustrates a stable Time Domain, matching the standard fluctuation patterns perfectly. No abnormal parameters are observed in the test sample.

Resonant Criticality: High. Resonator Jianxin's frequency displays high stability, and the risk of Overclocking is minimal.

Jianxin has no documented history of Overclocking. Routine counseling and examinations are not required.
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1405_TalentCertific.zh:
受试样本拉贝尔波形时域表示恒定，波形与波动标准完全一致且没有任何异常波动倾向，检测结果判断为正常阶段。当前超频临界值高，稳定性高，超频概率极低，无超频风险。
无过往超频史。
无需定期检查与心理辅导。

yakita:FavorWord_110250_Content.text: Jianxin... her soul has a beautiful golden hue, and she is a person of respectable character.
yakita:FavorWord_110250_Content.zh: 拥有相当漂亮的金色的灵魂，其品行和境界也令人尊敬。
yakita:FavorWord_110250_Content.speaker: Sanhua

yakita:FavorWord_130360_Content.text: I am more than happy to get an outstanding training partner like Jianxin by merely offering her a simple meal... Of course, I'm always pleased to spend time with her over a meal, whether she's here to train with me or not.
yakita:FavorWord_130360_Content.zh: 如果一餐简简单单的粥饭就能寻得鉴心这样的陪练，那可真是求之不得……啊，当然，就算不陪练，光是来吃饭也可以。
yakita:FavorWord_130360_Content.speaker: Yuanwu

yakita:FavorWord_140514_Content.text: Occasionally I'd leave my sect to go on what we call self-cultivating trips. During one of those trips, I visited Mr. Yuanwu's boxing gym and challenged him to fight, and I won. I told Master Shiling about it when I returned, and it turns out Mr. Yuanwu's ancestors used to practice martial arts at our sect. According to the rules, I guess I should call him my "martial senior". I heard that Mr. Yuanwu went through a lot when he was younger, but it seems he doesn't want me to talk too much about it, so let's just drop it there.
yakita:FavorWord_140514_Content.zh: 我在山下游历时曾经去渊武拳馆踢馆，打败了那位大叔老板，后来回到山上十陵师父才告诉我，拳馆老板渊武师叔祖上与我们有武学渊源。渊武师叔年轻时经历坎坷丰富，但他本人好像不太喜欢提起过去的事情，还是不聊这个啦。
yakita:FavorWord_140514_Content.speaker: Jianxin

yakita:FavorWord_140519_Content.text: I am Jianxin, the successor of Fengyiquan. Thank you for your hospitality. Would you mind sparring with me?
yakita:FavorWord_140519_Content.zh: 风仪拳传人鉴心，多有叨扰。不知可否与你切磋武艺？
yakita:FavorWord_140519_Content.speaker: Jianxin

yakita:FavorWord_150413_Content.text: When I am out delivering packages, I can't always find a place to stay, so sometimes I rest outdoors. Once, I woke up to see Miss Jianxin napping on a boulder on the cliff edge! She seemed... so light, like a feather...
yakita:FavorWord_150413_Content.zh: 送件的路上，不是每次都能找到住的地方，有时候也要在野外歇一会儿。那次我睡醒后，睁眼就看到鉴心姑娘正睡在远处山崖的巨石上……轻飘飘的，就像一片云……
yakita:FavorWord_150413_Content.speaker: Lumi

yakita:Flow_313700000_37.text: When you come close, the world around you fades away. You are walking into Jianxin's dream.
yakita:Flow_313700000_37.zh: 靠近少女时，周围的世界变成一片空白，你走进了鉴心的梦境。

yakita:Flow_313700000_84.text: You see Jianxin's figure, but the empty, borderless space unnerves you. Each step you take feels increasingly unreal.
yakita:Flow_313700000_84.zh: 你发现了鉴心的身影，可空白、看不见边界的空间让你有些恐惧，所踏的每一步都没有实感。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_23.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_22
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_23.text: Greetings. I'm Jianxin. Could you please do me a favor?
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_23.zh: 两位少侠，小道鉴心，有一事相求。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_45.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_22
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_45.text: At the city gate, you encounter Jianxin, a Taoist who is being denied passage. After learning she is searching for a missing person, you use your authority to help her leave the city.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_45.zh: 你们在城门口遇见了想要出城寻人但因没有权限被阻拦的小道士鉴心，你决定使用权限带她一起出城。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_1.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_23
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_1.text: Jianxin explains why she wants to leave the city. She tells you about the person she is looking for.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_1.zh: 鉴心向我们讲述了出城的缘由和所寻之人情况。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_32.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_23
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_32.text: Jianxin explains she is searching for a boy named Zhiyuan. He vanished after leaving the city, and his grandfather tasked her to find him. Sadly, she has no information about the tokens you are investigating.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_3_32.zh: 鉴心向你们讲述了出城的缘由和所寻之人情况，原来是一位退役军士名叫致远的孙儿出城后没了消息，她受老人之托前去寻找。你也向她询问了有关线索的情况，很可惜她并不知晓。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_22.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_6
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_22.text: If you really can't find any job in the city, come to Liuxian Teahouse and ask for Jianxin. I'll gladly help you search for jobs and work alongside you.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_22.zh: 若是入城后确实找不着活计，可以到六羡茶馆寻小道，小道名鉴心，可以同诸位一起找活，做活。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_44_22.speaker: Jianxin

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_4_3.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_2
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_4_3.text: Yangyang showed her Midnight Rangers badge and Jianxin asked him about Zhiyuan.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_4_3.zh: 秧秧向其出示了夜归凭证，鉴心向其打听了所寻之人。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_12.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_14
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_12.text: Jianxin asked the quartermaster about Zhiyuan's whereabouts.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_12.zh: 鉴心向军需官询问了情况。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_30.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_14
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_30.text: Excuse me. I'm an Outrider of the Midnight Rangers. This is Rover, and this is Master Jianxin who came here to look for someone.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_30.zh: 叨扰了，我是夜归军属下踏白成员，这是漂泊者和来寻人的鉴心小道长。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_30.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_39.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_14
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_39.text: The quartermaster reveals Zhiyuan's likely whereabouts. Jianxin leaves to continue her search for Zhiyuan. You show the quartermaster the mangosteen, which he mistakes for a grenade. After the misunderstanding is resolved, he tells you about the dire situation in the Norfall Barrens.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_39.zh: 你们从军需官这里了解到了致远的所在，鉴心去寻致远时，你们也趁机向军需官询问有关莽吉柿的线索，军需官错将莽吉柿看成了榴弹，向你们讲述了北落野前线战事的紧张。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_5.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_14
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_5.text: (Tell him about the person Jianxin's looking for.)

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_6.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_14
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_6.text: Master Jianxin, do you want to go look for Zhiyuan first?
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_5_6.zh: 鉴心小道长要不要先去寻人？

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_1.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_25
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_1.text: Master Jianxin, have you found the person you're looking for?
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_1.zh: 鉴心小道长可寻到所要寻之人？
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_1.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_32.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_25
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_32.text: Reuniting with Jianxin, you learn she has successfully found Zhiyuan and convinced him to return to Jinzhou. This journey has been enlightening for her, and she looks forward to seeing you and Yangyang again.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_6_32.zh: 你们与鉴心汇合，她已经找到致远并劝他回了今州城，这次出行令她有了诸多体悟，她也期待与你和秧秧能有缘再会。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_7_1.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_19
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_7_1.text: Us running into Master Jianxin was a one-off incident. If the mangosteen indicates something about war, what is Madam Magistrate trying to convey?
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_7_1.zh: 遇到鉴心小道长应当是意外，如果莽吉柿指向的是战争，今令尹想要说的究竟是什么呢？
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_7_1.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_40_13.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_21
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_40_13.text: Oh dear! Thank the heavens you saved it in time, Jianxin!
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_40_13.zh: 哎呦幸好幸好，谢谢你啦鉴心。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_40_16.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_21
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_40_16.text: *Chuckle* Oh, it's you Jianxin, you silly girl.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_40_16.zh: 呵呵……鉴心，小丫头，是你啊。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_40_16.speaker: Zongye

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_40_18.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_1_21
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_40_18.text: Jianxin, disciple in training. We've met before.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_40_18.speaker: Jianxin

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_3_56_25.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_18
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_3_56_25.text: Hehe, actually, the words of Master Jianxin inspired me. The things she used to help others with, I think I can do them too.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_3_56_25.zh: 嘿嘿，其实鉴心道长的话启发了我，她以前帮助别人的那些事情，我觉得这些我也可以做嘛。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_3_56_27.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_18
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_3_56_27.text: The words of Master Jianxin inspired me. The things she used to help others with, I think I can do them too.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_3_56_27.zh: 鉴心道长的话启发了我，她以前帮助别人的那些事情，我觉得这些我也可以做嘛。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_3_56_30.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_18
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_3_56_30.text: So why shouldn't I go back to a place that suits me better? That way, I might be able to help more people, just like Master Jianxin, and also gain more recognition.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_3_56_30.zh: 那我干嘛不回到更适合我的地方去呢？那样说不定能和鉴心道长一样，帮到更多的人，也能获得更多的认可。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_42_18.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_第五章1_9_4
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_42_18.text: You are surprised to find Jianxin at camp. Jiyan decides to allocate roles and tasks for the looming battle against the Tacet Discords.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_42_18.zh: 你们来到军营，意外发现小道士鉴心也在这里，获得你们几人的助力，忌炎决定再分配下各自的职责与任务。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_42_3.text: Master Jianxin? Didn't know I'd be seeing you here...
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_42_3.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_42_4.text: Jianxin recently arrived at our base with one of the supply delivery teams. She has been a great help.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_42_4.zh: 鉴心随补给队伍来到前线营地已有多日，她心性沉稳，帮我解决了不少麻烦事。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_42_4.speaker: Jiyan

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_42_6.text: I've heard people comparing the Norfall Barrens to a massive graveyard. Whenever it rains, cries and moans can be heard, as if many ghosts are weeping...
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_42_6.zh: 小道也曾听闻，每到滂霈时分，北落野都会传出无数呜咽嘶嚎，有如百鬼夜哭……
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_42_6.speaker: Jianxin

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_43_3.text: We have the special task force of Rover, Yangyang, Jianxin, and me.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_43_3.zh: 由我，漂泊者，秧秧与鉴心四人为代表所组成的突击小队。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_43_3.speaker: Jiyan

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_43_67.text: And I'll join Rover, Yangyang, and Jianxin to create an opening for our main forces and take down the Threnodian.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_43_67.zh: 我将与漂泊者，秧秧，鉴心一同，带领突击小队突入腹地，为投入后续力量创造条件。全力以赴，消灭鸣式。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_43_67.speaker: Jiyan

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_43_68.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_第五章1_9_5
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_43_68.text: With your input, Jiyan quickly draws up the battle strategy. The ranged units will secure the high ground to support the close-combat troops in the valley as they break through the Tacet Discords' ranks, creating a passage for you, Yangyang, Jiyan, and Jianxin to launch a commando assault on the Threnodian.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_43_68.zh: 在你的建议下，忌炎很快就确定了此次行动的战略：远程部队将占领山崖两侧的制高点，援护峡谷中的近卫部队将残象潮撕出一个缺口，而由你、秧秧、忌炎、鉴心带领的突击小队将对鸣式发起突袭。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_44_42.text: Jianxin, please stay and guard the base. I’ll draw those Tacet Discords away.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_44_42.zh: 我去吸引其他残象的注意，尽可能帮你们减轻威胁。鉴心，你继续在这里，保护营地。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_44_42.speaker: Jiyan

yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_13.speakerZh: 清贫落魄的道士【抱朴守一】
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_13.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_13.text: "Do you two know me? Jianxin? Could it be one of the names I used during my training years? I see, meeting you here must be fate."
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_220041_13.zh: “莫非二位认识我么？鉴心？这难道也是小道过去修行时用过的化名之一？原来如此，道法自然，二位在此和我重逢也是一场造化。”

yakita:Flow_311000010_28.chapter: 剧情_虎口生态_NPC_虎口矿场_3_1
yakita:Flow_311000010_28.text: But occasionally I can hear the miners talking about it. It is said that the Tiger's Maw Mine was built on the ruins of a city.
yakita:Flow_311000010_28.zh: 但偶尔也能听到矿工们唠起这个话题，据说虎口矿场是建立在城市的遗址之上。
yakita:Flow_311000010_28.speaker: Jifeng

yakita:Flow_311000010_30.chapter: 剧情_虎口生态_NPC_虎口矿场_3_1
yakita:Flow_311000010_30.text: So the Tiger's Maw Mine became an indispensable source of energy supply in the founding of Jinzhou.
yakita:Flow_311000010_30.zh: 所以在今州建立之初，虎口矿场也成为了它不可或缺的能源支撑点。
yakita:Flow_311000010_30.speaker: Jifeng

yakita:Flow_311000010_35.chapter: 剧情_虎口生态_NPC_虎口矿场_3_1
yakita:Flow_311000010_35.text: Apart from the Tacetite, which is the largest in demand, the Tiger's Maw Mine also produces Lampylumen.
yakita:Flow_311000010_35.zh: 除开需求量最大的黑石外，虎口矿场还有一类稀有的矿石名为辉萤石。
yakita:Flow_311000010_35.speaker: Jifeng

yakita:JingRan_Shengtai_1_12.text: You sound like you actually enjoyed it, Jingran.
yakita:JingRan_Shengtai_1_12.zh: 你看起来倒是乐在其中啊，景燃。
yakita:JingRan_Shengtai_1_12.speaker: Rover

yakita:JingRan_Shengtai_1_8.text: Leaning in next to Jingran, you lose yourself in the wild tale of his recent plunge into the Mirage Realms.
yakita:JingRan_Shengtai_1_8.zh: 你和景燃站在一起，开始听他讲起最近入蜃境时的诸多奇闻异事。

yakita:JingRan_Shengtai_1_9.text: You've faced your fair share of high-stakes adventures, but none of them carry quite the same eerie, twisted horror that leaks from Jingran's storytelling.
yakita:JingRan_Shengtai_1_9.zh: 虽然你也经历过许多奇妙的冒险，但那毕竟都是在光下，与这些鬼气森森的阴凉故事还是不太一样。

yakita:Term800054_Desc.text: A Remnant Creature sealed within Jingran's Life Lamp, bound to him through a special pact.
yakita:Term800054_Desc.zh: 关押在景燃命灯中的回音生物，与景燃之间存在着特殊的契约。

yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_10_9.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_11_1
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_10_9.text: Jingran takes the object from your hand, studies it carefully, frowns.
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_10_9.zh: 景燃把你手里的东西接了过去，仔细查看了一番，皱了皱眉。

yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_12_15.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_13_1
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_12_15.text: Jingran hands you a piece of metalwork. It looks just like the one you found earlier by Jiang Laowu's place, as if…
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_12_15.zh: 景燃递给你一块金属制的东西。这东西和你之前在姜老五那里找到的很像，似乎……

yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_12_7.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_13_1
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_12_7.text: Jingran's eyelids flutter. It takes him a few tries to force them open.
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_12_7.zh: 景燃的眼皮微微颤抖，他睁了好几次，才勉强睁开眼睛。

yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_15_7.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_16_1
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_15_7.text: Then to keep him from dragging you down, help us out. Let's get Jingran to a doctor together.
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_15_7.zh: 那为了让他别连累你，你也帮个忙，我们一起把景燃送到医师那里去吧。
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_15_7.speaker: Rover

yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_18_1.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_19_1
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_18_1.text: Come to think of it, Jingran calls you something different every time. What's your real name?
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_18_1.zh: 说起来，景燃每次喊你的名字都不一样，你的本名是什么？
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_18_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_20_3.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_21_1
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_20_3.text: That thing just now... Is that what will cure Jingran?
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_20_3.zh: 刚才那东西，就是用来救治景燃的？
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_20_3.speaker: Rover

yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_22_1.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_23_1
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_22_1.text: When you two return to the sleeping Jingran, the lynx spirit slips into the Life Lamp. The pale blue flame flickers, beat by beat, then burns bright.
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_22_1.zh: 回到睡着的景燃身边后，山猫妖钻入那盏命灯之中，幽蓝的火一下一下地闪烁，而后变得明亮起来。

yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_22_12.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_23_1
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_22_12.text: Jingran slots the coin into the compass disc. The pointer starts to turn slowly, until it settles on a direction.
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_22_12.zh: 景燃把那枚铜钱嵌在了指针圆盘上，指针开始晃晃悠悠地转了起来，指向了某处。

yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_22_2.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_23_1
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_22_2.text: After the room flickers between dim and bright a few times, Jingran wakes up.
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_22_2.zh: 满室昏暗与明亮的交替后，景燃醒了过来。

yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_32_15.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_33_1
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_32_15.text: Jingran pockets the dagger. He chooses not to use it.
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_32_15.zh: 景燃把那柄匕首收起来，并没有用它。

yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_4_29.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_5_1
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_4_29.text: Pale blue flame flickers to life. You watch Jingran's fingers brush lightly across the camera's casing.
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_4_29.zh: 幽蓝的火焰燃烧着，你看到景燃的手在相机的外壳上轻轻一抹。

yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_7_7.chapter: 剧情_3_6_每日_景燃与山猫妖_8_1
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_7_7.text: (Now that Jingran's got the merchant distracted, I should go check it out.)
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_7_7.zh: （趁着景燃吸引了那个商人的注意力，去看看吧。）
yakita:KuZhouYeDuan_7_7.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_151_7.text: His full name is Jingran. Sandao and I raised him. He followed at Sandao's heels, learned what he could, and became a Nethermancer himself.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_151_7.zh: 全名叫景燃。他算是我和三刀抚养大的，跟着三刀有样学样，成了一名寻幽客。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_2_1_10.text: Liangyu passes along a message from Granny Yanshu: Jingran is back. You decide to go see him.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_2_1_10.zh: 椋羽给你带来了烟舒婆婆的话，你得知景燃回来了。你决定去见见他。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_2_2_1.text: (I still have Jingran's Qingfu pendant. It's time to return it.)
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_2_2_1.zh: （我身上还带着景燃的青蚨挂饰，是时候去还给他了。）
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_2_2_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_2_40_22.text: Jingran, I think it's time... to give you this back.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_2_40_22.zh: 景燃，这个挂饰……也该物归原主了。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_2_40_22.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_2_50_12.text: Hey, remember that Bladepuppet incident in Mengzhou... what, ten, fifteen years back?
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_2_50_12.zh: 说起来，你还记得十多年前，在梦州城的那次刃偶事故嘛？
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_2_50_12.speaker: Jingran

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_552_1.chapter: 剧情_3_6_神宫幻境_地境接舷战_82_1
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_552_1.text: Jingran, we'll fly up there on swords. What about you?
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_552_1.zh: 景燃，我们会御剑穿过去，你呢？
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_552_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_590_3.text: The wound was fatal. It must have been the strike Jingran landed earlier.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_590_3.zh: 身上的创口是致命伤，应该就是景燃留下来的。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_590_3.speaker: Qingxiao

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_282_1.text: Jingran is surrounded on all sides by children clamoring for a story.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_282_1.zh: 景燃正被缠着他听故事的孩子们团团围住。

yakita:JinXi_Shengtai_1_11.text: Under the same gentle moonlight as nights past, you share the tale of your journey with Jinhsi.
yakita:JinXi_Shengtai_1_11.zh: 你在和过去别无二致的月色下，与今汐谈起一路的旅程。

yakita:JinXi_Shengtai_1_16.text: Of course. I left Jinzhou in such a rush last time that we didn't have the time to catch up. Jinhsi... how have you been lately?
yakita:JinXi_Shengtai_1_16.zh: 当然可以。说起来，上次回今州走得太急，还没来得及问……今汐，你最近还好吗？
yakita:JinXi_Shengtai_1_16.speaker: Rover

yakita:JinXi_Shengtai_1_22.text: But it worked out perfectly, didn't it? Though you really need to keep yourself safe, Jinhsi.
yakita:JinXi_Shengtai_1_22.zh: 但挺有效的，不是吗？就是别再把自己弄伤了，今汐。
yakita:JinXi_Shengtai_1_22.speaker: Rover

yakita:JinXi_Shengtai_1_9.text: Yangyang told me about your journey after leaving Jinzhou, and how you always managed to turn the tide. But I know so few of the details...
yakita:JinXi_Shengtai_1_9.zh: 离开今州后你的去向，虽然我曾听秧秧谈起，知道你总能转危为安，具体经历却并不清楚。
yakita:JinXi_Shengtai_1_9.speaker: Jinhsi

yakita:Side_XYHTZST_59_2.text: Memories of the time you sent off Loong Lanterns with Jinhsi and the conversations you shared seem like yesterday.
yakita:Side_XYHTZST_59_2.zh: 与今汐一同许愿谈心的时光似乎并未远去。

yakita:Character_ChangLi_1_34.text: I'm experienced. Dealt with Jinhsi's riddles already.
yakita:Character_ChangLi_1_34.zh: 似曾相识的做法，这次更简单些。

yakita:Character_ChangLi_8_12.text: It's okay. Jinhsi had explained your reasons.
yakita:Character_ChangLi_8_12.zh: 无妨，今汐已经解释过了。

yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_1.text: I believe you are here for Magistrate Jinhsi?
yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_1.zh: 两位此番前来，是为了令尹吧。
yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_1.speaker: Xinyi

yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_14.text: Lady Xinyi, I need to know where the Sentinel was last seen.
yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_14.zh: 辛夷大人，我需要知道乱流爆发前岁主的位置。
yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_14.speaker: Jinhsi

yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_25.text: I implore you, Xinyi. Help me keep our people safe.
yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_145_25.speaker: Jinhsi

yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_205_13.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山主线_岩壁遗迹_8_1
yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_205_13.text: A destined fight between Jinhsi and the Sentinel...

yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_23.text: Jinhsi updates Xinyi on her findings at Truthseeker's Pass and shares her theory about the situation. She then outlines her current plans.
yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_23.zh: 今汐将在叩天关的发现、以及自己的猜测与决定告知辛夷。

yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_33.text: Lady Xinyi... I was born with my life, my everything connected to our Sentinel.
yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_33.zh: 辛夷大人，自我诞生之时，我就与岁主命蒂相连。
yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_33.speaker: Jinhsi

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_29_15.text: This is merely our personal preference. It may be helpful to get others' input as well, Uncle Li.
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_29_15.zh: 这只是我们的个人口味，要不黎叔再多问问别人？
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_29_15.speaker: Jinhsi

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_29_19.text: Thank you, Uncle Li. If you need any assistance, please let me know. I'll be sure to help.
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_29_19.zh: 谢谢黎叔。如果您有需要帮忙的地方，请随时告诉我，我一定会来的。
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_29_19.speaker: Jinhsi

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_29_6.text: Hehe, Uncle Li is having people taste-test some pastries. I happened to be passing by and decided to stop in.
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_29_6.zh: 黎叔在请人帮忙试试点心的味道，我正好路过，就过来看看。
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_29_6.speaker: Jinhsi

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_29_7.text: Actually, I came to see if I could help with something, but Uncle Li told me that…
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_29_7.zh: 原本我是想来问问，宵月会上有没有需要帮忙的地方，没想到黎叔却说……
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_29_7.speaker: Jinhsi

yakita:FavorWord_130415_Content.text: Taoqi is able to breeze through mountains of workload with ease, despite her frequent yawns. Her efficiency is truly remarkable.
yakita:FavorWord_130415_Content.zh: 桃祈呀，她总是一边打着哈欠，一边飞速处理完一大堆工作……那种效率，连我都自叹不如。
yakita:FavorWord_130415_Content.speaker: Jinhsi

yakita:Flow_31000071_184.text: It seems Jiyan and I were right in our suspicions. It really is that guy causing trouble.
yakita:Flow_31000071_184.zh: 看来我和忌炎的推测没有错，果然是那个家伙在搞鬼。
yakita:Flow_31000071_184.speaker: Jinhsi

yakita:Flow_31000071_185.text: Jiyan, you see, never speaks without solid evidence.
yakita:Flow_31000071_185.zh: 忌炎这个人呀，没确凿证据前从不轻易开口。
yakita:Flow_31000071_185.speaker: Jinhsi

yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_5_16.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_5_1
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_5_16.text: The order to hunt down Scar in Rinascita came straight from Mingting. Even Jinhsi was left in the dark.
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_5_16.zh: 甚至他来黎那汐塔追杀伤痕的命令都直接来自明庭，连今汐都不知道……
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_5_16.speaker: Rover

yakita:HuanglongM1_1_11_52.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第一幕_嘤鸣初相召_4_2
yakita:HuanglongM1_1_11_52.text: You ask Sanhua about Jinzhou, Jinhsi, and the tokens.
yakita:HuanglongM1_1_11_52.zh: 你从散华处有了解到了一些有关今州、今汐还有与信物相关的事情。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_78_37.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第五幕_庭际刀刃鸣_3_2
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_78_37.text: You defeat Scar, but he appears unbothered over what will happen to him. He is more curious to know when you and Jinhsi hatched this trap.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_78_37.zh: 你将伤痕击败，但相比自己的下场，他更好奇你和今汐究竟是何时谋划了这一切？

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_79_76.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第五幕_庭际刀刃鸣_1_7
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_79_76.text: Sorry, but I don't know. Jué's last piece of information pointed to the Norfall Barrens, where you should find the Threnodian.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_79_76.zh: 这个可能需要你自己去寻找了。角向你传达的最后一条信息就是前往北落野，找到鸣式。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_79_76.speaker: Jinhsi

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_81_18.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第五幕_庭际刀刃鸣_5_2
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_81_18.text: "To the Awakened One: When raindrops fall upstream, please head to the Norfall Barrens, and seek General Jiyan of the Midnight Rangers."
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_81_18.zh: “瀑雨逆流之时，苏醒之人，请前往北落野，寻找夜归的将军，忌炎。”
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_81_18.speaker: Jinhsi

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_81_21.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第五幕_庭际刀刃鸣_5_2
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_81_21.text: I suppose so. General Jiyan is currently battling another TD Outbreak in the Norfall Barrens, which will also serve as our frontline against the Threnodian.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_81_21.zh: 是的。忌炎将军，正在北落野率军抗击残象潮，那里也是我们对抗鸣式的最前线。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_81_21.speaker: Jinhsi

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_83_10.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第五幕_庭际刀刃鸣_5_4
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_83_10.text: Sanhua, you can place more trust in Rover and me.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_83_10.zh: 相信我，也相信那位漂泊者吧。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_83_10.speaker: Jinhsi

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_83_9.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第五幕_庭际刀刃鸣_5_4
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_83_9.text: If {Male=he;Female=she} runs into another powerful enemy like Scar, {Male=he;Female=she}'ll eventually have to confront them on {Male=his;Female=her} own.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_83_9.zh: 如果再次遇到伤痕这般难缠的敌人，{TA}终究需要依靠自己的力量解决。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_83_9.speaker: Jinhsi

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_21_23.text: Now we have raindrops that fall upstream, and the Midnight Rangers' General in the Norfall Barrens, ready to take on the Ovathrax.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_21_23.zh: 溯洄的雨幕已经降下，夜归的将军，此刻正在北落野的前线，准备对战争的鸣式「无相燹主」，发起最后的进攻。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_21_23.speaker: Jinhsi

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_110_21.text: Please forgive Sanhua. I truly did not share my whereabouts with her.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_110_21.zh: ……还请谅解散华的所为，我确实没有告诉她我到底去了哪里。
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_110_21.speaker: Jinhsi

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_210_38.text: Miss Suisui, you're wondering if that Prism of Fate can be used to find Yangyang, aren't you?
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_210_38.zh: 穗穗小姐，你是在想，那枚「宿镜」是否能用来寻找秧秧，对吧？
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_210_38.speaker: Jinhsi

yakita:TZZNQ_15_2.text: (I think this is Jinhsi's specialty dessert?)

yakita:TZZNQ_7_6.text: 漂泊者, do you know the whereabouts of Sanhua, Ms. Taoqi, and General Jiyan?
yakita:TZZNQ_7_6.zh: 漂泊者，你知道散华、桃祈小姐还有忌炎将军现在何处吗？
yakita:TZZNQ_7_6.speaker: Jinhsi

yakita:XDQY_4_4.text: You share the details of the strange candy and Xiangli Yao's theory with the three of them. Before you can even finish, you notice Jinhsi is a bit out of it.
yakita:XDQY_4_4.zh: 你转述了那颗奇怪糖果的事，也将相里要的猜想告知了三人。然而话还没说完，你就注意到……今汐的反应，似乎慢了半拍。

yakita:Flow_311000000_358.text: There are many stories like that. Take our General Jiyan, known for his extraordinary deeds across Jinzhou.
yakita:Flow_311000000_358.zh: 这箩筐事可多了，就说我们忌炎将军，他的经历可不一般。
yakita:Flow_311000000_358.speaker: Yihu

yakita:ST_LL_2_20.text: But maybe, one day I'll visit Jinzhou, Rinascita, Mengzhou...
yakita:ST_LL_2_20.zh: 不过……也许未来我会去往今州、黎那汐塔、梦州……
yakita:ST_LL_2_20.speaker: Lily

yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_610_1.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第二幕_玄方城生态_4_7
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_610_1.text: I saw Watcher Liangyu bringing in another group of civilians, including some from Jinzhou.
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_610_1.zh: 我看椋羽骑使又带回来一批平民……还有今州的人……

yakita:lmzxst_22_1.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建生态支线_8_5
yakita:lmzxst_22_1.text: Wait, you're 漂泊者, aren't you? I'm Xiaobei, from Jinzhou. We met back at the Tiger's Maw Mine!
yakita:lmzxst_22_1.zh: 呀，你不会是漂泊者吧！我是小北，今州来的，我在虎口矿场见过你！
yakita:lmzxst_22_1.speaker: Xiaobei

yakita:lmzxst_22_4.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建生态支线_8_5
yakita:lmzxst_22_4.text: And it just so happened that Manager Maji pulled some strings with Jinzhou and Septimont through Lollo Logistics and got us official contracts.
yakita:lmzxst_22_4.zh: 正巧那个叫马计的老板通过呜呜物流联系到了今州和七丘方面，走特批通道给了我们补了一份正式合同。
yakita:lmzxst_22_4.speaker: Xiaobei

yakita:lmzxst_29_2.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建生态支线_8_6
yakita:lmzxst_29_2.text: I'm Xiaobei, from Jinzhou. We met back at the Tiger's Maw Mine!
yakita:lmzxst_29_2.zh: 我是小北，今州来的，我在虎口矿场见过你！

datamine:InfoDisplay_101400011_Text.title: The Séance Society
datamine:InfoDisplay_101400011_Text.text:
Solitary visitor in Jinzhou,
Feeling weighed down by the burdens of the past that you cannot share? Is there someone beloved you wish to see again?
We, the Séance Society, understand your pain, as we all carry regrets of lost loved ones. Join us. We offer a solution. 
(Coordinates shared)
datamine:InfoDisplay_101400011_Text.zh:
孑然一身来到今州的客人，你一定有着难以对他人言说的过去，有着想要再见一面的重要之人。
我们是归魂互助会，这里每个人都有着失去了重要之人的遗憾，如果你不愿意就此带着遗憾度过一生，请加入我们，我们有办法可以帮助你。
（坐标已接收）

datamine:InfoDisplay_102900007_Text.title: Restoration of records
datamine:InfoDisplay_102900007_Text.text:
Date of restoration: AL158
Restorer: Code name Ma Liang
Restoration Record:
This collection of paintings excavated from the old ruins is fairly well preserved, with only 47 points of damage.
This scroll painting is a bit interesting, recording the lifestyle of a certain region in a horizontal scroll, and there is something unheard of in it, so if the restoration is completed, it will surely give a glimpse of some remnants of the time before the Lament.


Anonymous Reply:
The food at the third stall on the left looks so good, I'll make a note to ask Auntie Phan Hua to try making it.
Ah, and the ornament in the Gate opening of the sixth stall, is that a ...... toy?
What interesting people in this area! I hope to exhibit this one in Jinzhou next festival!
datamine:InfoDisplay_102900007_Text.zh:
修复日期：新历158年
修复人：代号马良
修复记录：
这批从旧日遗迹挖掘出的画作还算保存完善，损毁点仅有47处。
这幅长卷画作有点意思，用横版绘卷方式记录了某个地区的生活方式，其中竟有众人闻所未闻的东西，若是修复完成，必定能窥见悲鸣前的某些时光残片吧。


匿名的回复：
左边第三个摊位上的食物看起来好好吃的样子，记下来找攀花阿姨试着做一下好了。
啊，还有第六个摊位门口的摆件，是……玩具吗？
这个地区的人真有趣啊！希望下次节庆能在今州展览这幅画！

datamine:InfoDisplay_104134002_Text.title: AL XXXX Cloudy
datamine:InfoDisplay_104134002_Text.text:
The mine has been getting colder and colder lately, and the miner brothers operating at the bottom say that they still hear strange noises occasionally, and such rumors have now become the nightly talk among miners, but it's better to investigate the bottom.
Busy all day, and then eat a bowl of Jinzhou chowder, the taste ...... don't mention it, the strange thing is that the bottom of the bowl is stuck with a note, which is painted with a messy stone pattern, do not even need to think about it, this note is sitting on the opposite side of the dining table the boy wrote, learning from the story according to the Gourd draw a dipper, saying that this is to facilitate the communication of the unique language. I didn't expect the ever-steady Dr. Hua to get involved, but it's nice to eat noisily with three people like this.
datamine:InfoDisplay_104134002_Text.zh:
矿场最近越来越冷了，在底部作业的矿工兄弟们说偶尔还会听见奇怪的声音，这样的传闻现在成了矿工间的夜话，不过还是对底部调查一下吧。
忙碌了一整天，再美美地吃上一碗今州烩，这滋味……别提了，奇怪的是碗底贴着一张纸条，上面画着乱七八糟的石头图案，想都不用多想，这纸条就是坐在饭桌对面那小子写的，学着故事里依葫芦画瓢，说着这是方便通讯的独特语言，没想到一向稳重的骅医生也参与了进来，不过像这样三个人一起吵吵嚷嚷地吃饭也挺不错。

datamine:InfoDisplay_10900007_Text.title: Mochelin Dining Guide: Tasty Jinzhou - Food Exploration
datamine:InfoDisplay_10900007_Text.text:
[…]

I recently received an invitation from the Pioneer Association to explore the culinary delights of Jinzhou.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_10900007_Text.zh:
在接到先行公约的这份邀约后，我思来想去，最终还是决定走遍今州的大街小巷，重新尝遍今州的每一道菜。在寻味的过程中，还是有很多让我感到惊喜的地方，这些惊喜最终连缀成这本小册，让我绘制出属于今州城的美食地图。如果你看到这本书的时候，会萌生出一些“我也想去试试”的想法，那真是再好不过！尽情去尝试就好，美食的意义，就在于尝到嘴边、吃进肚中的一刻！
攀花饭馆：☆☆☆☆☆
写这本册子的时候，我正坐在攀花饭馆的小座听着周围聊着家长里短。有位巡尉似乎刚下班，火急火燎地跑进来，点上一份香汁鸡、一份凉拌香苏和一份冒菜。接着，她的小蓝帽朋友和冷冰冰朋友走了进来，她们坐在一起，开始聊自己的生活趣事，那位巡尉还分享了自己作为社区民警的一天，最让我印象深刻的还是她跟一个难过的小女孩大讲英雄戏，结果两人成了好朋友的故事。要想在吃饭的时候有个轻松、热闹的氛围，攀花饭馆一定是最好的选择！
写到这里，我点的香汁鸡也上了，这香汁鸡看上去淡而无味，但要是将肉浸入攀花饭店特制的香汁里搅过，让酱汁充分浸入到肉的油脂部位，一口下去，肉汁迸溅在口中，鲜香四溢。而搭配的青菜也是刚炒过的，被精心择过的菜叶还呈现出翠绿的颜色，表面上滚过一层薄薄的、还在跳动的油珠。搭配店里特烹的颗颗饱满珠圆玉润的米饭一起吃下，美味、美味、美味！
我还要再点上一盘！
珍宝糖水：☆☆☆☆
噗噗咩咩好喝到好耶！珍宝糖水！要说这今州菜和糖水啊还是会分装到两个胃里，今州菜在左，那糖水一定在右！而糖水去哪喝——我会推荐珍宝糖水。毕竟，这珍宝糖水已经是三十多年的老字号了，还是这样好喝不贵！写着写着，我终于排到队，刚点上一杯新出的买一送一款糖水！据说这是因为前几天有对恩爱小情侣来店里喝糖水，刚好二人在庆祝生日，老板高兴就送上一杯特调，二人喝过后连声称赞，老板就顺势推出了这款新品——不过，像我这样一个人来喝糖水的，拿着两杯还是会难过。糖水好买，朋友难求啊。这香甜好喝的糖水，只好我一人满满喝下啦！
六羡茶馆：☆☆☆☆
要想吃茶谈天，最好去六羡茶馆；要想进行勇气的挑战，也最好去六羡茶馆。六羡茶馆的金铃子茶，苦得分明，苦得让人怀疑人生。不过，这金铃子茶虽苦，但入口久…

datamine:InfoDisplay_10900009_Text.title: We Promise, We Deliver—Lollo Logistics
datamine:InfoDisplay_10900009_Text.text:
We Promise, We Deliver—Lollo Logistics

Away from Jinzhou and yearning for its specialties? Look no further–Lollo Logistics has got you covered!
Staying in Jinzhou and craving specialties from the Six Countries? No problem–Lollo Logistics is here to help again!
Picture this: when you open those take-out boxes, hot steam rises, carrying the aroma that wafts into your nostrils, igniting your appetite for these delights.
For unrivaled quality and swift delivery, make the smart choice–choose Lollo Logistics!

BodyBuilder: Totally! Wasn't in Jinzhou before, but I was craving Panhua's Restaurant's Pulled Chicken so bad. Every sec, min, hour, couldn't stop thinking about it, lost sleep over it. Finally gave in, called Lollo Logistics, and ordered takeout. However, the delivery guy forgot pickup, but drove me to Jinzhou for that Pulled Chicken!
AM JUST A BRUSH: Hahaha! Bad News: Forgot to pick up the takeout; Good News: Ended up bringing the customer to the restaurant.
AAA Fresh Ingredients Wholesaler: Definitely fresh. Trustworthy!
Green Light Forever: Thanks, mate! You can count on us. We always keep our promises!
datamine:InfoDisplay_10900009_Text.zh:
呜呜物流，使命必达！
出门在外，想要吃到今州本帮菜？没问题，呜呜物流来帮你！
人在今州，想要尝到六国特色菜？还是没问题，呜呜物流来帮你！
呜呜物流，采用特色冷链技术，让你最爱的菜肴在运输过程中享受到最顶级的看护，让它到你面前的时候还保持着新鲜出炉的品质！
放心，就用呜呜物流；特快，就用呜呜物流！
———————————————————————
健将健将：这是真的！之前我不在今州，但特想吃攀花饭馆的手撕鸡。思来想去抓耳挠腮家人们都汗流浃背了，最后叫了个呜呜物流小哥点了个外送，结果小哥忘取餐，但好心把我载到今州吃饭了！
就是刷子：好家伙！坏消息：忘记取外卖了，好消息：把食客带到店里吃了是不？
AAA新鲜食材批发：确实新鲜，放心！
红绿灯灯灯：嘿嘿，咱办事你放心，咱说到做到！

datamine:InfoDisplay_10900012_Text.title: Meeting Jinzhou: A Visit to Mahe's Grocery
datamine:InfoDisplay_10900012_Text.text: Every morning, well before the sun graces the sky, Mahe, the owner of Mahe's Grocery, has already begun his work. Over the next few hours, he carefully prepares the ingredients for today's sale. With changing seasons come distinct selections of vegetables and fruits. How does Mahe choose seasonal ingredients, and how does he ensure them reaches households far and wide? Join us today on "Meeting Jinzhou", as this episode takes you on a visit to Mahe's Grocery.
datamine:InfoDisplay_10900012_Text.zh: 每天，在天还蒙蒙亮的时候，马和杂货的店主马和就已经开始了一天的工作。在接下来的几个小时里，他要准备今日要贩卖的食材。一年四季，时节不同，择选的蔬菜瓜果，也都有不同。马和是如何依据时节选择的食材百货，又是如何让这些新鲜食材送入千家万户？让我们收看今天的《走进今州》，本期节目将带你探访马和百货。

datamine:InfoDisplay_11010114_Text.title: Shiyu's Letter
datamine:InfoDisplay_11010114_Text.text:
Here's Shiyu's stamp of approval: Shixia has officially reached the summit where this letter resides!

Shixia recently got accepted into the top school in Jinzhou and has set her sights on working for the Ministry of Development. She's come a long way and I can't help but feel proud and a little envious. Meanwhile, I'm still figuring out my own career path. Shixia joked about her intense studying habits again today, but I know she'll pass with flying colors — she's always been dedicated and doesn't even take breaks to hang out with me during vacation. I can hardly believe her good luck, but I couldn't be happier for her.
datamine:InfoDisplay_11010114_Text.zh:
经试语认证，试夏已经成功爬到这封信所在的高度了！

试夏考上了今州最好的学宫，她说她以后想要去天工部。嗯……她果然又比以前厉害了，我很骄傲，也很羡慕。我还没有想好自己长大后的目标。
她今天又说了那些蠢话。我早就知道她会考上，她从早学到晚，放假也不和我出去玩，什么好运，我才不信。

datamine:InfoDisplay_11010115_Text.title: Shiyu's Letter
datamine:InfoDisplay_11010115_Text.text:
[…]

Shixia just got accepted into the top school in Jinzhou, and she's set her sights on working at the Ministry of Development.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_11010115_Text.zh:
经试语认证，试夏已经成功爬到这封信所在的高度了！

试夏说她不愿意继续爬山了，可是看到我开始爬之后，她很快追了上来，拼了命手脚并用跟在我身后，终于和我一起爬到了这么高的地方。我就知道她不是那么轻易认输的人。
试夏考上了乐肄太学。还好她考上了，否则，她的卧室里真的要迈不开腿了。我从来没见过那么多学习资料，没见过有人卧室里的灯在近一年的时间里一直彻夜亮着，学霸真是恐怖啊……好在她看起来乐在其中。
我不明白，为什么成功考上后她的心情会这么差……她在看风景呢，我要现在趁机去问问。

datamine:InfoDisplay_11040103_Text.title: Package List
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040103_Text.text:
Spicy Meat Slices 1 portion, Loong Buns 1 portion, 10 skewers
-Bring the Food Ration Bars. 
-I don't like Food Ration Bars... Can we have Helmet Flatbread?
-Sorry sweetie, mommy doesn't have time to make Helmet Flatbread.

10 Cans of Energy Drink
-Why are we bringing these... Just bring some inhibitors!
-But what if we get thirsty?
-Just tough it out. I'll buy you Salted Milk Tea once we’re in Jinzhou. 

1 Set of Mahjong, 1 Tent
-Sweetie, we're not going camping.
-Dad said we're going camping though?
-Well... It’s not the usual type of camping. Do we still have grandma’s jade pendant? Let’s bring that too.
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040103_Text.zh:
辛香肉片1份、小龙包1份、烤串10根
-带戍边粮。
-我不爱吃戍边粮……锅盔可不可以？
-妈妈没时间做锅盔了。

活力饮料10罐
-带这些又重又没用的干什么……带点阻滞剂就好，省省空间吧！
-那口渴了怎么办？
-忍一忍，我们去今州喝咸奶茶。

麻将1套、帐篷1顶
-宝贝，我们不是去露营。
-爸爸说是去露营啊？
-嗯……不是普通的露营。奶奶做的平安扣还在吗？都带上。

datamine:InfoDisplay_11040123_Text.title: About the Persona
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040123_Text.text:
Name: Qiao Yang
Age: 17
Date of Birth: May 4th
Family: Father Qiao Er’shou (Butcher, died 5 years ago). Mother Lin Ru (Teacher, missing for 10 years). Older brother Qiao Sheng (Member of this camp). Younger sister Qiao Qiao (In school at hometown).
Social Relationships: Friend Bo’jun (Fruit grocer at hometown). Friend Yizhou (Exile).
Personal Experiences: Started school at 8. Held in a juvenile center for intentional wounding during a dispute with a classmate. Taken away to a shelter due to lack of guardianship at 12. Expelled from school due to serious fighting at 15. At 16, spent a year recovering in the hospital. Been a temporary worker at Jinzhou after discharge from hospital until now, when he came to seek refuge with his brother.
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040123_Text.zh:
姓名：乔阳
年龄：17
出生日期：5月4日
家庭关系：父亲乔二手（屠户，五年前死亡），母亲林如（教师，已失踪十年），哥哥乔升（营地成员），妹妹乔巧（正在家乡念书）
社会关系：朋友伯俊（正在家乡经营自己的水果店），朋友一昼（流放者）
个人经历：8岁上学，10岁因与同学发生口角致故意伤人接受管制，12岁时因无看护人而被收容所接走，15岁因恶劣斗殴被退学，16岁医院养伤一年，出院后来到今州打零工，直到现在来投奔自己的哥哥。

datamine:InfoDisplay_11040124_Text.title: About Qiao Sheng:
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040124_Text.text:
[…]

Settled in Fireflies Sea's Exile camp at 22 and continued occasional weapon transfers for the Hall of Six in and out of Jinzhou.

At 23, became an ordinary exile during the first crackdown by Public Security Bureau, causing all weapon transfers to cease for two years.

[…]

Usually found guarding camp gate)
Prosper (Male, camp guard, younger brother to Auspice.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040124_Text.zh:
姓名：乔升
年龄：25
出生日期：12月13日
个人经历：
6岁开始盗窃补贴家用，9岁盗窃时被店主发现，逃跑时摔断了右腿至今留有残疾，10岁开始介入街头组织的武器交易，11岁因组织内信息泄露被逮捕接受管制，13岁逃离管制，出境加入六合草堂东堂口，15岁在交易任务中遇到买家生变，对敌时身中三弹，替换过肝脏，勉强活命，17岁成为六合草堂东堂口其中一支小队的队长，18岁受到六合草堂内部大清洗事件影响，停止一切行动，19岁调任中堂口，21岁因与中堂口负责人不合而降级调离，同年脱离六合草堂未果，遭到堂内惩戒，脸上留下特殊烫疤，随后选择转移活动区域，22岁在萤泊海流放者营地落脚，偶尔帮助六合草堂将武器在今州中转，23岁时六合草堂遭到治安署第一次打击，武器线静默两年，因此他跟随营地变成普通流放者等待消息。
营地内人际关系：
朋友：
大吉（男，营地守卫者，大利的哥哥，心无城府，喜欢打架，通常在门口站岗）
大利（男，营地守卫者，大吉的弟弟，喜欢耍小聪明，热衷金钱，通常在门口站岗）
魁枭（男，信息处理人员，喜欢一个人待着钻研技术，通常在营地二楼）
仔伽（男，管理人员，嗜肉，非常忙碌，无固定出现地点）
仇敌：
福泽（男，营地打手，曾因不服乔升指挥直接导致营地利益受损，遭到首领惩罚，自此仇视乔升）
阿坚（男，营地副首领，心狠手辣，专横独断，看不惯乔升曾经的六合草堂身份和他对自己地位的威胁）

datamine:InfoDisplay_11040179_Text.title: [Packing List]
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040179_Text.text:
Dried Wuthercake, Loong Buns, and the family cookbook.
-Enough packing dry foods, did you get my cookbook?
-Mom, I'll just learn the recipes from you when we get to Jinzhou. This cookbook is falling apart, I'd say we just leave it.
-What would you know! Wherever this cookbook goes, there will be the taste of home. What happens if I'm not around anymore sometime in the future...

A pack of energy drinks.
-Energy drinks are too heavy to carry. Can't we just bring a water bottle?
-What if there's no clean water source on the way? These canned drinks will be the only thing we can rely on!
-Well, if you say so. You carry it then.
-Oh, you better not drink a single can when the time comes!

Tents and outdoor equipment.
-We're not going on a camping trip, honey.
-But Dad told me we are going camping.
-Hmm... Not just any camping trip. Oh, don't forget to put on your fortune pendant from Grandma.
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040179_Text.zh:
干燥潮饼、小龙包、家庭菜谱。
-别只顾着拿干粮，我的菜谱拿了吗？
-妈，等进了今州你再教我就好，这本菜谱都快翻烂了，不拿也罢。
-你懂啥！有这本食谱在的地方，就有家的味道。万一以后我不在了......

活力饮料一组。
-活力饮料也太重了，带个水壶不行吗？
-万一路上没有干净的水源，能靠得住的就只有罐装饮料了吧！
-既然你都这么说了，那你自己背着吧。
-你有本事就一罐都别喝！

帐篷、户外装备若干。
-宝贝，我们不是去野炊。
-爸爸说是野炊。
-嗯……不是普通的野炊。别忘了系上奶奶做的平安扣。

datamine:InfoDisplay_11090103_Text.title: Unnamed Wish List
datamine:InfoDisplay_11090103_Text.text:
I hope my family escapes safely. (AL 100 years)
If only I could have another drink with my old comrades from the 1st Division. (AL102)
I heard there was a big harvest this year. I wish I could taste my mom's cooking again. (AL105)
May the True Dragon program be a success. (AL107)
Jinzhou must be very beautiful. I wish I could see it with my own eyes. (AL120)
We will return to our hometown. This is home. (AL124)

......

希望我的家人能平安逃出去。（新历100年）
要是能和第一师的老战友们再喝一杯就好了。（新历102年）
听说今年大丰收，真想再尝尝妈妈做的菜啊。（新历105年）
愿真龙计划能圆满成功。（新历107年）
今州一定很美吧。能亲眼看看就好了。（新历120年）

请让她忘了我吧。（新历127年）
……
我们终将穿越长夜，胜利归来。（新历139年）

datamine:InfoDisplay_31000022_Text.title: Stone Tablet
datamine:InfoDisplay_31000022_Text.text:
In the lower left corner, among numerous stone tablets, stands one that remains remarkably intact despite the passage of time and elements. It recounts the founding history of Jinzhou.
"The armies are poised for destruction as the black moon eclipses the sun…" 
"…In the midst of battle, a golden-eyed visitor appears in the hazy sky. Our troops raise their blades in anticipation, while the jade dragon soars overhead…" 
"…But even as they long for home, these conscripts do not falter in defending their land. And thus, in this world of strategic passes, Jinzhou was built and this monument erected to forever remember this momentous event…"
datamine:InfoDisplay_31000022_Text.zh:
在耸立的碑林中，左下角的这块石碑尤为显眼。
在不知是风沙还是刀剑留下的斑驳印记之下，可以模糊辨得今州建立时的历史：
“……黑月蔽日，三军欲摧……纵有陷阵之志，亦有死无生……”
“……之际，见金瞳异人于云霞明灭之间……将军一时刃如列缺，玉龙自横……”

yakita:FavorStory_110601_Content.zh:
今州城里最繁华的街头，偶尔会支起一个鉴宝小摊，让这条长街再增添几分热闹。
摊主名叫釉瑚，按她自己的描述，她已是资深的鉴宝大师，那些被岁月淘洗过的器物，她只消轻轻那么一摩挲，便能窥得磨痕之间流淌的岁月。
据她说，除了刚入行时曾经看错了一尊鼎外，鉴宝一道，她几乎再没出过岔子。而那尊鼎也被她从委托人那里买下，用凝冰之力补好，一直带在身边引以为戒。
这番自吹自擂，加上她吊儿郎当的举止，总有几分江湖骗子的意味，但大家觉得，信她一回也未尝不可，毕竟她的鉴宝费堪称良心。
只需付出一顿饭的钱，并在话语间夹杂几句客套与奉承，便可以呈上手中的器物，让这位釉瑚大师帮你掌掌眼。
“这扇古屏，可是今州建立前的工艺，见证了今州潮起潮落，想不到能保存如此完好，可谓瑰宝啊！”
“釉光温润，如玉如脂，虽然年头不久，但此等工艺，还是值得珍藏的！”
从制作工艺到历史价值，她说得头头是道，大家对她也愈发信服。
何况，鉴宝的过程，还附赠一场妙趣横生的……表演？
别的鉴宝师，都是细细端详，她却不同，一边将古物里里外外看个遍，一边还在手舞足蹈，嘴里念着她胡诌的打油诗，像极了跳大神这类神秘仪式。
起先，大家还怕自己的宝物在她手中有什么闪失，见她未曾失手，才放下心来任她胡闹。或许大师就是会有些怪癖……吧？

yakita:FavorStory_111003_Content.zh:
秋来明庭，风卷着枯黄落叶贴上窗棂，又被揭走，像有人慢慢翻着一本旧书。
秧秧要走了，去今州，做踏白。这事定下来已有半月，家里人嘴上不说，却各自忙着，像有什么活计是赶在她走前必须做完的。
穗穗在屋里帮妹妹收拾行囊，樟木箱开了大半日，箱底铺着去年晒过的艾草，闻着仍有一股清苦。她把秧秧的衣裳一件件抖开，又依次叠紧，窗外有虫还在叫，断断续续，像是不甘心入秋。

掺着樟木气息的秋阳，温和地落在她手背上。她抬眼，看见堂屋那根承重柱。
柱上一道道横刻，从膝盖那么高，一直爬到她耳侧。最低的两道是秧秧的，七岁，九岁，是父亲蹲下来替她比划的，刀痕很浅，怕伤了孩子。穗穗记得那年的秧秧还站不太稳，要扶着柱子，幼小的孩子却分外乖巧，自己看了心中都隐隐生出骄傲之意——这是我的妹妹。
再往上，就是自己的那道了，落于十四岁那年。那年她曾闹着要出门闯荡，要随人去别处学医，父亲没说不许，只让她在这柱子前站了半日：柱上的刻痕一道压着一道，她盯着看，看自己一寸一寸往上长……穗穗有些茫然地想，自己的成长速度似是很快，又似是很慢。个头窜了不少，但论及处世经验，又好像还多的是要学的。
属于秧秧的刻痕越往上越密。去年腊月那道，是秧秧自己刻的，比自己只矮半指。今年开春以后，她便基本和自己一样高了。

院外零星传来几声鸟叫，穗穗推门出去，秋阳撞在脸上，裹着几分暖意。檐下那只蓝背的雀正从枝桠间跃起，翅膀扑扇两下，惊得几片黄叶簌簌而落。秧秧正从院子另一头过来，她在阶前停了停，看见姐姐站在廊下，便走过来。穗穗也冲她笑了笑。
“什么时候动身？”
“明早。”
穗穗“哦”了一声。她想再说点别的，话到舌尖又咽了回去。她伸手替秧秧拢了拢披风的领子，秧秧没动，等姐姐手收回去，秧秧才低声说了句：“我会回来的。”
穗穗笑了一下：“去吧。今州风大，照顾好自己。”
秧秧应了，刚巧父母喊她，她便往那边过去。她走得不快，腰板挺得很直，像已经在习惯做一个踏白。
于是廊下又只剩穗穗一个人。那只蓝背的小鸟不知什么时候回来了，再次站在那枝桠上，仰着头叫了两声。叶子落了一阶又一阶，她弯腰捡起，想着该把它夹进哪一本书里，又觉得夹进哪里都一样。
毕竟秋天总是要过去的…

yakita:FavorStory_130301_Content.zh:
渊武的日程很简单，每天上午拉开店铺门，挨个擦亮悬挂着的练习用拳具。然后煮上一壶茶，边饮边招呼客人。
有兴趣学拳的人，渊武会根据他们的身体素质和当前状况推荐适合练习的拳法。练到何种境界就全看个人意愿了，只求强身健体也好，想要打出名堂也罢，渊武会静静地听着顾客们的诉求，然后制定出合适的练习方案。就算不知道自己具体有什么诉求，只是懵懵懂懂走进来，想看一眼凑个热闹的客人，渊武也能招待周到。

从进门开始，渊武那深邃的目光就会温和地落到客人身上。
“既然来了拳馆，就把眉头舒展开，忘掉那些烦心事吧。打上一两套拳放松放松，或许能让你开心些。”
只要比划几下，他就能看出客人当前的身体状况，并推荐合适的方案。
“体态不正，下盘不稳……唔，腰肌看着有些劳损。可以试试这套拳路，三静一动。”
按他说的练上两套，身体和心情总有一个能放松不少。临出门前，他也会像老朋友一样，送上恰到好处的关心。
“嗯？轻松了不少？那就好，平时也记得不要太过紧绷。带上这包茶吧，喝了能让你放松些。”

今州城里大大小小的武馆不少，唯独渊武拳馆的生意一直这么好。

yakita:FavorStory_130302_Content.zh:
据说只要成为了渊武拳馆的常客，就连锻炼之外的事情，只要渊武老板能解决的，都会帮忙解决。
一次，锻炼时总是板板正正的马和频繁漏招，发力方式也和平时有所不同。渊武问他是否遇到了什么烦心事，马和沉着脸，思索再三，垂头丧气地带渊武来到拳馆的寄存柜，从自己的包裹中翻出一个精巧的餐盘。

餐盘四周绘制着一圈红艳艳的小花，色泽鲜丽，光彩夺目，渊武一眼认出这是海外的珐琅彩工艺。美中不足的是小花上的掐丝金边少了一段，整个盘子缺了这处，看起来就不再圆满。
这是马和给攀花准备的礼物。几年前攀花饭馆开张时，马和就说过，要找一个世上最好看的餐盘来盛这世上最香的饭菜。即使后来两人因理念不合而分道扬镳，马和还是记得自己当初的承诺。
他坚持自己的道路，却也放不下对她的情谊。
这些年他一直在寻找好看的餐盘，有的太艳，有的太俗。直到这个白底红花、艳而不俗的餐盘闯进他的眼帘。
餐盘昂贵，他好不容易凑钱买齐，又辗转反侧，不知道如今的自己该不该送出手。在他犹豫的这些时日里，餐盘上装饰着的掐丝金边莫名其妙少了一段。他问遍了今州城里的商贩，要么不熟悉舶来品，要么嫌餐盘太贵不敢修，实在不知道该怎么办才好。

渊武听罢，轻轻拿起餐盘，说一周后来取。
一周后，小花圆圆满满簇成一团，甚至看不出修补的痕迹。
而渊武要求的报酬，仅仅是让马和带上餐盘，和他一起去找攀花吃上一顿。
麻辣鲜香的菜肴配上红花簇拥的盘子，确实相得益彰，鲜艳诱人。攀花的笑容愈发明丽，寡言少语的马和脸上也有了笑意，这顿饭吃得很是畅快。

就算拳馆再怎么生意兴隆，收这么点报酬办这么一桩事，怎么看都是亏本生意。
渊武却只是笑笑，仿佛钱财对于他来说，是最不重要的事。

yakita:FavorStory_130303_Content.zh:
今州地处边塞，城中好武之风盛行，大大小小的武馆开了不少。在如今这个相对和平的年代，曾经严格残酷的打擂机制渐渐淘汰，演化成武馆间“友好”的磋商交流。
有人的地方就有江湖，虽说是以交流为名，却有人暗自较劲，动用一切手段，试图在比赛中拔得头筹。毕竟这可是个不可多得的展示机会，只要将自家武馆推上首位，收获关注，各种生意合约不就源源不断地来了？

就这样，打擂活动越办越大，参加的武馆越来越多。今年这届，就连一向淡泊名利的渊武老板都报名参加了。
渊武拳馆本就生意兴隆惹人眼红，渊武这么一参加，很快就有些人坐不住了。最坐不住的当属上届榜首玟玺。玟玺是个商人，无论是开设拳馆还是参加打擂，都只是为了给自家武器厂搏一些知名度，获取商业效益。榜首之位自然也是买来的。

玟玺知道渊武的实力，也知道渊武拳馆并不算大。于是早早就亲自登门拜访，开出诱人的价码，企图买通渊武。
渊武自然是一口回绝。玟玺一计不成又生一计，花重金买通数位场内人员，将渊武的出招路数和力度了解了个十成十，又买通决赛当天的裁判和场务，在各自使用的拳具里做了手脚。

决赛当天，雷光瞬间暴涨，又在瞬间熄灭。一闪一灭之间，两幅拳具各被击破，雷击的焦灼精准停留在快要触碰到皮肤的位置，再往前一点就会灼伤关节。破碎的拳具吐出暗藏玄机的内里，一切小算盘都暴露在雷光之下。全场哗然，比赛中止。
经过调查，擂台上那骇人的雷光被定义为拳具中机关引发的意外，而制造这种机关的玟玺武器厂也受到了调查。
没过多久，玟玺武器厂就和不公正的打擂比赛一起，默默消失在了时代的尘埃中。

风波过后，渊武拳馆还是一如往常，地方不大，门客熙攘。如果说有什么不同，眼尖的熟客会发现，店里进进出出的人群中，少了几张熟面孔。

yakita:FavorStory_160101_Content.text:

That new Director at the Ministry of Development's Defense Division doesn't let anything get past her!" This rumor spread quickly through Jinzhou, soon becoming the city's hot topic.

[…]

"Director Taoqi, you have to help us sort this out.

[…]
yakita:FavorStory_160101_Content.zh:
“你知道吗？听说天工防事科新上任的事务长，任何东西都逃不过她的眼睛。”
不知从何时起，在今州的市井长巷间有了这样一则逸闻，成了今州人饭后的茶余笑谈。
某次天工用于修建新防线的订购材料中有一箱质量并不达标，但那箱并没有贴明原产厂商的标签，而供应这批材料的有三家厂商，三家厂商现在都不愿承认这箱是他们的东西。
“诶，桃祈事务长，你可得给我们评评理，就算是天工，也可不能乱冤枉人啊。”
三位厂商逐渐放大音量，试图引起围观人群的热议。桃祈慢悠悠地从人群中钻出，嘴上轻声搪塞着吵闹的老板们“好啦，好啦，我知道了。”实则屏蔽掉了声音，俯下身开始查看起这箱“无名”的材料，桃祈拿出少许用手仔细掂量了一番便有了一丝思绪，随后她以慵懒的口吻转身向三位老板说道：“但你们三人中肯定有一个人撒谎了吧，或者是，你们三个人都在撒谎。”
事后，桃祈便带着事务科的后辈小钰悄然拜访了三座生产厂，在了解完各个厂的机械装置、当晚的运输路径、运输时间后，桃祈已经得到了自己想要的答案了，撒谎作假的人，可需要好好地教训一顿呢。
没过几日，街上便流传出了消息来，那天参与闹事的厂商中，有一位被天工的“桃祈”大人请去喝茶了。
后来又紧接着流传出第二位、第三位厂商的消息，直到今州新闻刊登出了三位厂商材料合作造假的消息，这让大家一时摸不着头脑，而知道事件来龙去脉的也只有身在“聊天室”的桃祈和小钰。
“我明白了，前辈，这就是，那个叫做……囚徒困境！单独聊天，再放出消息给其他人，包括你那天所说的话，这一切都是在对他们施压，对吧。但你是怎么知道他们三个人都在撒谎呢？”
“人会撒谎，可机器不会啊，每个厂的机器规格不一样，仔细看看那些材料之后，就明白了。呼啊……可是浪费了我好几个午休呢。”
桃祈有些埋怨地拉下了眼罩，心里暗想着剩下来的时间一定要把失去的午休好好地补回来。

yakita:FavorStory_160102_Content.zh:
“呜啊……又要上班了。”
桃祈挣扎着从温暖的被窝里爬了出来，看着逐渐攀上今州的阳光，这对于她来说，普通的一天又重新开始了。
街头早早地支起了早餐摊，不用老板主动招呼，上班族已经在摊前排好了队，也有人因单位离得较远，放下钱后，匆忙地便抓起一袋包子就跑走了。
休息了一整晚的今州，再次热闹了起来。
熙熙攘攘的人群里，桃祈慢悠悠地从人群里冒出，眼罩还挂坠在头上，不时打着哈欠，一副没睡醒的样子。
“该排在哪支队伍后面呢？”
趁着揉眼的间隙，桃祈端量了各个摊位一番，在心里默念着数字：“三、二、一……”
数完后，排在队首的人便拿着热乎乎的包子离开了。
她似乎在数着各个摊位蒸好包子的时间，桃祈看了看时间和排队的人数，心里便拿定了主意。
“呜啊，今天应该不会迟到了。”
桃祈用右手轻敲着另一只手以示时间节奏，随着队伍的徐缓推进，她发现三二一的节奏似乎比队伍前进的速度快了几拍。
“啊？看样子又要迟到了呢。”
为了准时打卡，桃祈开始一步步的审视周围的因素，是自己敲打的节奏快了吗？她试着重新来一次，节奏似乎并没有问题。
是老板动作慢了下来吗？她小心地将头伸出队伍观察，但老板的手脚看上去都快用不过来了。
“哦，原来是这样吗？”
她的目光被一旁孩子手中的风车所吸引，她再次察看着灶台，破着大洞的一侧，燃烧的方向正与风向相反，老板并没有注意到火势越来越小。
桃祈走出队伍将摊位旁的桌子横置在灶台受风影响的一侧。
“小姑娘，你这是干嘛？”
“为了决不迟到！”
桃祈心满意足地回到了队伍，但……好像又得重新排队了。
“完了，完了，这下肯定迟到了。”

yakita:FavorStory_160104_Content.text:

Taoqi endured unfounded ill will for her slowness as a child.

[…]

[…]

[…]
yakita:FavorStory_160104_Content.zh:
小时候，桃祈也曾因为“慢”遭受了许多无故的恶意，但也因此遇见了不在意她的“慢”，愿意保护她的朋友。
几个朋友一起长大，选择的未来而各不相同。老大奔赴前线成为了无畏的夜归战士，老二去了偏远地方成为老师，照顾新一代的孩子们。老四将捣蛋的树枝换作了笔，成为了一名游历四方的旅行作家。
彼此的距离越来越远，但总归会回到家乡，而待在今州的老三桃祈，则成了和他们见面次数最多的人，也是离别次数最多的人。
老友们再次聚在了一起，等待着迟到的客人，不知是谁起了个头突然聊起了那位客人，立刻吸引了周围年轻人的注意，她似乎在这里相当有名。
“这是我们印象里的桃祈吗？”
“桃祈姐姐不是从第一次见就一直是这样慢悠悠的吗？”
“桃祈是慢悠悠的啦，但和现在不一样吧。同样是跟在我们后面，现在总感觉气定神闲的，当时可是一不注意就会跟丢，还会偷偷哭呢？”
“也有被人欺负过。”
“真的是那个桃祈前辈？”
“嘿完全看不出吧。这种时候就轮到我们这些朋友出场了，小孩子打架这种事情，我们最在行了。”
“哇……那桃祈前辈呢？”
“呃，后勤？干一些杂事，比如说叫家长，商量赔偿……”
“也不仅仅是这些，她还掌握了很多能够决定战斗局势的信息。”
“唉，真不知她怎么突然就开始擅长这些了，本该是我们保护她的，结果慢慢地就反过来被她保护了。”
“明明还是那个慢悠悠的桃祈，却让人觉得很可靠。”
“不愧是桃祈前辈，原来一直以来都被大家信赖着啊！”
“咦？我们不是想说她不一样的地方来着吗？”
老友们从回忆中抽身，对偏离了一圈又绕回原点的话题，怀念地大笑了起来。
“呼啊……大家下午好，在聊什么？看起来真开心。”
“等你好久了，难得的老友聚会，你果然又是睡午觉睡过头了吧！”
“我们啊，正在聊关于你的事呢……”
桃祈刚坐下来，揉了揉眼睛，似乎还没睡醒呢。
“这次又有什么好玩的事情让我听听吗？”

yakita:FavorStory_161001_Content.chapter: 秧秧·玄翎档案_角色故事

yakita:FavorStory_161001_Content.zh:
那是她向母亲表明志向的三天之后。
那天傍晚，秧秧家的饭桌上多了一双筷子。
“听说，你家的娃娃想要从军？是哪一个？”饭后闲聊时，宾客饮下一杯茶，向她的父母问起。
“嗯……目中有神，心无杂质，是能吃苦的性子吧。”宾客端详着那尚未脱去稚气的脸庞，笑着说道，“看你应该有些基础，在哪里学的？道场？那里不是教真本事的地方，想要上阵杀敌，光会那些还不够。”
“来，让我看看你此前学了什么。”宾客起身，走到宅中院下，“可不能白蹭你母亲做的饭。”
“好。”得到父母的应许后，她取出平日练习用的木剑，走至宾客面前，摆出架势。
她不知道宾客是什么身份，只知道是父母的亲友。但聪明如秧秧，也知晓宾客为何会在这个时候前来赴宴，并提出要试试她的本事。
父母支持她的愿望，却也要让她看到，为了实现愿望，她还要经历多少考验。
她向自己的第一道考验发起冲锋，就像雏雀第一次振动翅膀，想要飞向天空。
……
“心性不错，可惜，资质平平，不像那些万里挑一的天才，武学之道，哪怕穷极一生，你也定走不到终点。”
瘫倒在地的那一瞬间，她仿佛回到了第一天前往道场的那一刻。
一无所知，茫然失措。
“我听你的母亲谈起过你的天赋，若是继承她的衣钵，想必不假时日，你便能青出于蓝吧。”宾客拾起她脱手的木剑，“即便如此，你还打算坚持下去么？”
她点点头，伸出手，攥住了递在她身前的剑柄。
……
那之后，每隔十数日，宾客便会来到秧秧家中做客，每次临走之前，她都会指点秧秧一二，时为剑术，时为兵法。她不允许秧秧称她为老师，表示自己只是一个来蹭饭的客人，对朋友家中的小孩有莫名的指导欲而已。
“请问……我什么时候才能知道，我已经准备好了？”
“嗯……这样好了。”
次日清晨，秧秧家里多出了一节木桩。那木桩通体黑灰，表面坚硬如铁，即便是真正的刀剑，也难以在上面留下痕迹。
宾客取过秧秧的木剑，随手一挥，一阵劲风过后，剑身已入木三寸。
宾客指着那道深深的剑痕，“什么时候你不用共鸣力也能做到一样的事，就算你准备好了。”
……
时光飞逝，两年过去。
少女的脸上已不见稚嫩，而那道木桩上，也留下了无数道深浅不一的剑痕。
她屏息凝气，端正架势。剑芒如风，带起一地落叶。
…

yakita:FavorWord_110415_Content.text: The Qixing Drum's sound echoes far and wide, and people say it scares evil spirits and beasts away. I never thought anyone could sleep through that loud banging, but then I met this pink-haired lady called Taoqi... Turns out she's the Chief Officer of border defense at the Ministry of Development. With all the defenses in Jinzhou, I'd be tired too... Maybe she is just too exhausted from work? I hope she can catch some good rest.
yakita:FavorWord_110415_Content.zh: 都说七星鼓的鼓声通天，连恶鬼凶兽都能吓跑，要在七星鼓的鼓声中悠然安睡，只是想想都觉得不可能。那位粉色头发的姐姐倒真是令我开了眼界……我后来才知道，原来她就是天工的事务长。转头再看看今州城周围各类坚固的防御工事……或许她平时真的是太累了吧？希望今后的夜里，她都能拥有安然的好梦。
