yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_21.zh: 难道，是之前在今州出现的，那个伤痕的同伴？
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_21.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_61_13.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_梦州主线_中_1_5
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_61_13.text: As you pursue Muyu, you rescue Uncle Dong, who was kidnapped and brought to Xuanfang. He tells you and Liangyu that all the missing citizens from Jinzhou have been imprisoned in the Skyworks by unidentified thugs.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_61_13.zh: 在深入悬天构的途中，你解救下了被绑架至玄方地界的董叔。从董叔的口中，你与椋羽得知，今州此前失踪的人，都是被身份不明的歹徒囚禁在了悬天构中。

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_29.text: I didn't know you worked with Verina before. She helped me out back in Jinzhou.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_29.zh: 原来你还跟维里奈合作过，我之前在今州的时候，她帮过我。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_9_29.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_170_9.text: Jinzhou answered at once, but recent activity from the Threnodian in the Norfall Barrens has tied down their main force.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_170_9.zh: 今州第一时间回应了我们的求援，但北落野近期出现了鸣式的异动，牵制住了夜归的主力。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_170_9.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_2_60_18.text: So, you are the Jinzhou Patroller seconded to Mengzhou?
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_2_60_18.zh: 你就是那名借调梦州的今巡尉？
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_2_60_18.speaker: Suoming

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_106_2.text: The future of Mengzhou and Jinzhou rests on this.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_106_2.zh: 梦州与今州日后的时局皆系于此。

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_44_9.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_37_2
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_44_9.text: Prisoner Scar of Jinzhou. Surrender now. One strike is all it would take to end you. Surrender, and you may be spared pain.
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_44_9.zh: 今州重犯伤痕，束手就擒，横竖一刀，或可免遭痛苦。
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_44_9.speaker: Qiuyuan

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_1.text: Through {Male=his;Female=her} eyes, I finally saw the world. First came Jinzhou. {Male=He;Female=She} had lost {Male=his;Female=her} memory, but there were those who guided {Male=him;Female=her} forward.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_1.zh: 借由{TA}看见的世界，我来到了今州。{TA}说自己失去了一段记忆，一路上被他人指引着前进。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_46.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束4_11_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_46.text: Drawing on your memories, Lily weaves a series of dreams that take you around the world. Together, you wander the streets of Jinzhou, dance on a stage in Ragunna, experience student life at Startorch Academy, chase the auroras across the frostlands, and finally celebrate the Waking Moon Festival in Xuanfang Hold. Before the dream ends, Lily writes a message on a Moon Lantern: "Thank you. This final journey made me very happy."
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_46.zh: 借由你的记忆，莉莉编织出了前往世界各地的幻梦。你和她在今州的街道漫步，在拉古那的舞台共舞，在星炬学院感受校园生活，在冰原上追逐极光，最后在玄方城游玩了朝月会。莉莉在月灯上写下了一句——谢谢你，最后的旅行，我很快乐。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_6.text: Jinzhou's streets held a trace of each season: chilled desserts, steaming meals, falling petals, and old folks waiting for their children to return.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_6.zh: 今州的街道就像藏着四季本身，清甜的糖水、滚烫的热食、纷飞的花瓣以及等待子女归来的老人。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_6.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_9.text: The people of Jinzhou and Mengzhou suffered from war just like us, but they knew what they were fighting for.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_9.zh: 我羡慕今州人和梦州人，我们同样饱受战争之苦，但他们明白为何而战。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_9.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_9_20.text: But actually... I don't think I'll be staying in Jinzhou for long either.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_9_20.zh: 只是……这一次，我可能也不会留在今州太久。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_9_24.text: Words like "friends" and "family" are the same way. Tomorrow, and every day after that... in Jinzhou, in Mengzhou, anywhere on Solaris...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_9_24.zh: 就像朋友、亲人这些字眼，在明天，在以后的每一天……在今州，在梦州，在索拉里斯的每一处……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_9_36.text: It feels like... something unseen at work? I can't explain it. Once, the Streams led me to Jinzhou. And now they're calling me to Mingting...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_9_36.zh: 总觉得……这算是某种冥冥之中的……？我也说不清，当年，流息带着我来到今州，如今，它却又想让我回去一趟……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_9_38.text: But whatever happens, I'm part of Jinzhou. That will never change. So this time... Mm. Let's just say I'm taking some time off.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_9_38.zh: 不过，不管怎样，我始终是今州的一分子，这次……嗯，就当是我要请一个长假吧。

yakita:SIDE_WTSZYWL_16_3.text: If only I could get to Jinzhou City and meet Master Lingyang... He's the liondance expert...
yakita:SIDE_WTSZYWL_16_3.zh: 要是能去今州城里请教凌阳师傅就好了，听说他的狮子舞可是一绝……

yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_160_2.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_主线差分配音_2_7
yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_160_2.text: The savior of Jinzhou... No, wait. The savior of Jinzhou and Xuanfang Hold!
yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_160_2.zh: 是拯救了今州……啊不，拯救了今州和玄方城的大英雄！

yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_210_3.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_主线差分配音_1_2
yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_210_3.text: Yes, sir. Jinzhou and Mengzhou have dispatched reinforcements...
yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_210_3.zh: 嗯，今州、梦州，两州都已派军前来驰援……

yakita:Side_HSMY_1_2.text: It's been a while. You came here as a rookie, and now you're Jinzhou's hero. Looks like the battle at Norfall Barrens really honed your skills.
yakita:Side_HSMY_1_2.zh: 一段时间没见，训练场的新人已经成为了今州的英雄。看来之前北落野的大战，愈加磨砺了你的战技。
yakita:Side_HSMY_1_2.speaker: Yhan

yakita:Side_TFSJJKYY_2_2.text: So this is the style of Mengzhou? It's nothing like Jinzhou...
yakita:Side_TFSJJKYY_2_2.zh: 这就是梦州的风格吗，和今州截然不同……

yakita:POI_YNAQGS_25_8.text: Hmm... It's is still in working condition, and there's enough backup power... Now, according to Mr. Xiangli Yao's instructions... Username, and then...
yakita:POI_YNAQGS_25_8.zh: 嗯……检查完毕，设备状态完好、备用电源还有剩……按照相里要之前说的，用户名，然后是……
yakita:POI_YNAQGS_25_8.speaker: Jiuyue

yakita:POI_YNAQGS_42_66.text: Yes. For the settlers of the Whining Aix's Mire, a thorough extermination of the remains may be the most direct and efficient way, but may not be the best.
yakita:POI_YNAQGS_42_66.zh: 是，对生活在怨鸟泽的居民来说，清剿或许是最直接高效的手段，但可能并不是最好的。
yakita:POI_YNAQGS_42_66.speaker: Jiuyue

yakita:POI_YNAQGS_42_75.text: Yes. For the settlers of the Whining Aix's Mire, a thorough extermination of the remains may be the most direct and efficient way, but may not be the best.
yakita:POI_YNAQGS_42_75.zh: 而且，就算真的验证过，对生活在怨鸟泽的居民来说，清剿可能也不是最好的方法。
yakita:POI_YNAQGS_42_75.speaker: Jiuyue

yakita:POI_YNAQGS_4_75.text: I've been digging through all the data on Whining Aix's Mire, and I think I found a way to make it work. We just have to find the site, reboot the device, clear the fog, and investigate the source!
yakita:POI_YNAQGS_4_75.zh: 我可是翻阅了和怨鸟泽相关的所有实验记录，才找到了这么一个可行的方法……寻找站点、重启装置、驱散迷雾、调查源头！
yakita:POI_YNAQGS_4_75.speaker: Jiuyue

yakita:POI_YNAQGS_7_9.text: This place is called the Whining Aix's Mire. Named after the bird-like Tacet Discord, Mourning Aix, that lives here. Additionally, as you can see, this place has a lot of marshes.
yakita:POI_YNAQGS_7_9.zh: 这里叫做怨鸟泽，其一是因为盘踞着的鸟形残象哀声鸷，其二嘛，如你所见，是因为这边有着大片大片自然沼泽地形。
yakita:POI_YNAQGS_7_9.speaker: Jiuyue

yakita:Flow_11000006_25.text: The legendary battle between General Jiyan and the Ovathrax up in the Norfall Barrens was brutal and ferocious...
yakita:Flow_11000006_25.zh: 之前忌炎将军在北落野大战无相燹主的时候，打得那么激烈……

yakita:Flow_11000006_545.text: When General Jiyan was a medic, he never neglected his training.
yakita:Flow_11000006_545.zh: 忌炎将军还是军医的时候，就不会疏于训练。
yakita:Flow_11000006_545.speaker: Lingfeng

yakita:Flow_11000012_12.text: Although he doesn't talk much, he is very dedicated to his work and skilled, which is why General Jiyan specifically appointed him to guard this place.
yakita:Flow_11000012_12.zh: 没错，就连原本驻守军营的一部分人最近也被调去战场上了……
yakita:Flow_11000012_12.speaker: Tianhe

yakita:Flow_11000012_27.text: But luckily, General Jiyan is here. That's why I was able to recover from my injuries so quickly.
yakita:Flow_11000012_27.zh: 不过还好有忌炎将军在，我才能这么快就把伤养好。
yakita:Flow_11000012_27.speaker: Tianhe

yakita:Flow_11000012_35.text: General Jiyan has been leading the Vanguard in battle for more than ten days and has not returned. This situation is very rare...
yakita:Flow_11000012_35.zh: 忌炎将军率领破阵出战已经十几日未归，这种情况太少见了……
yakita:Flow_11000012_35.speaker: Tianhe

yakita:Flow_11000012_7.text: The Midnight Rangers have three divisions: Outrider, Vanguard, and Rearguard, all under the command of General Jiyan.
yakita:Flow_11000012_7.zh: 夜归军下设有踏白、破阵和伏波三部，统一由忌炎将军统率。
yakita:Flow_11000012_7.speaker: Tianhe

yakita:NPC_HSGD_7_1.text: Is General Jiyan still fighting on the front lines? I heard that he hasn't taken a rest for a long time.
yakita:NPC_HSGD_7_1.zh: 忌炎将军还在前线奋战，他是不是很久没休息过了？

yakita:NPC_HSGD_7_2.text: Yeah, no one could talk him out of it. Sigh, General Jiyan used to be a doctor. He should know better than anyone else...
yakita:NPC_HSGD_7_2.zh: 是啊，也没人劝得动。明明将军他从前也做过医生……

yakita:StJCFYLQ_15_4.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_军策府和园林区配音生态_16_1
yakita:StJCFYLQ_15_4.text: Yes! I mean—no offense—but is it true you fought in the Norfall Barrens alongside General Jiyan?
yakita:StJCFYLQ_15_4.zh: 啊，是的！呃，敢问阁下是否曾与忌炎将军并肩奋战于北落野？

yakita:ZXHJYST_2_4.text: Rover? ...That'll be all. Go on ahead, all of you.
yakita:ZXHJYST_2_4.zh: 漂泊者？好了，你们先去吧。
yakita:ZXHJYST_2_4.speaker: Jiyan

yakita:ZXHJYST_2_5.text: The Midnight Rangers salute you and Jiyan, then turn to leave.
yakita:ZXHJYST_2_5.zh: 夜归军们朝你和忌炎行礼后，转身离开。

yakita:ZXHJYST_3_1.text: Reporting in, General Jiyan. The Norfall Valley patrol is complete. There are matters to bring to your attention.
yakita:ZXHJYST_3_1.zh: 报告，忌炎将军，北落峡谷的巡视任务已完成，有些情况要汇报。

datamine:InfoDisplay_11040117_Text.title: Temporary Team's Group Photo
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040117_Text.text:
"Jiyan, let's join together next time." 
 At your invitation, Jiyan participated in the Gulpuff Relay, and after ten years, the makeshift squad was once again formed. Those memories that had been smeared by the years resurfaced across the long lonely night. That unfulfilled promise was also brought to a close by you.
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040117_Text.zh:
“忌炎，下次再一起参加吧。”
在你的邀请下，忌炎参加了咕咕河豚接力赛，时隔十年，临时小队再次结成。那些被岁月涂抹的记忆，跨越孤寂的长夜重新浮现。那个未完成的约定，也因你而画下句号。

yakita:ItemInfo_70130002_BgDescription.text: You and Jiyan are preparing for the race, and the careful photographer has captured an interesting scene.
yakita:ItemInfo_70130002_BgDescription.zh: 你与忌炎正在进行赛前准备，细心的摄影师捕捉到了有趣的画面。

yakita:Character_JiYan_27_21.chapter: 剧情_角色_忌炎线_副本临时_21_1
yakita:Character_JiYan_27_21.text: Jiyan... Let's go bid them farewell one last time.

yakita:Character_JiYan_2_30.text: On the other hand, we couldn't have brought the situation at the borders under control without Jiyan's prudence...
yakita:Character_JiYan_2_30.zh: 不过也正因为有他这样未雨绸缪的领军人，如今边境的情势才能得到控制……

yakita:Character_JiYan_33_13.text: I trust you as always, Mortefi. But this sample... It means a lot to me.
yakita:Character_JiYan_33_13.zh: 并无此意，只是……他们对于我意义不同。
yakita:Character_JiYan_33_13.speaker: Jiyan

yakita:Character_JiYan_33_26.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_角色_忌炎线_4_1
yakita:Character_JiYan_33_26.text: Jiyan gives Mortefi the recorded frequency samples, and Mortefi promises the Academy will use them well.
yakita:Character_JiYan_33_26.zh: 忌炎将他在领域中记录的频率样本交给了莫特斐，莫特斐表示研究院一定会小心对待、认真研究这份珍贵的样本。

yakita:Character_JiYan_34_1.text: 漂泊者, I heard you've returned to the city with General Jiyan?
yakita:Character_JiYan_34_1.zh: 漂泊者，我听说你和忌炎已经回到今州了？

yakita:Character_JiYan_35_26.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_角色_忌炎线_6_2
yakita:Character_JiYan_35_26.text: Wenshu shares the full story of the temporary team and gives you a photo of you and Jiyan's team as a keepsake.
yakita:Character_JiYan_35_26.zh: 文叔向你讲述了十年前竞渡会上那支临时小队比赛时的故事，并将你与忌炎组队时留下的照片送给了你。

yakita:Character_JiYan_44_16.text: Jiyan and I are joining the relay race together.
yakita:Character_JiYan_44_16.zh: 我和忌炎一起参加比赛。

yakita:Character_JiYan_44_26.text: I suppose that's why you asked me to check the monitoring data for you, Jiyan?
yakita:Character_JiYan_44_26.zh: 你也是发现了这一点，才会让我收集水域监测数据的，对吧？
yakita:Character_JiYan_44_26.speaker: Mortefi

yakita:Character_JiYan_44_32.text: The lack of perceivable warning signs typically suggests unknown risks. Jiyan, 漂泊者, stay safe.
yakita:Character_JiYan_44_32.zh: 没被预警的突发状况，往往意味着未知的风险，两位，注意安全。
yakita:Character_JiYan_44_32.speaker: Mortefi

yakita:Character_JiYan_4_33.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_角色_忌炎线_1_5
yakita:Character_JiYan_4_33.text: You invite Jiyan to join the team. He agrees to be a substitute after careful consideration.
yakita:Character_JiYan_4_33.zh: 你向忌炎发出邀请，希望他能作为临时队员一起参加比赛，忌炎思考过后，接受了你的邀请。

yakita:Character_JiYan_5_17.text: Wow, so even General Jiyan has heard of that race!
yakita:Character_JiYan_5_17.zh: 原来将军也知道那场比赛！

yakita:Character_JiYan_5_30.text: Hmm... As for General Jiyan and 漂泊者, I think...
yakita:Character_JiYan_5_30.zh: 嗯……至于漂泊者和将军，我是这么想的。

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_21_2.text: Jiyan? Did something happen on the front lines?
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_21_2.zh: 忌炎？难道是边关出问题了？

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_25_28.text: Jiyan never seems to stop working. He keeps skipping meals once he gets busy.
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_25_28.zh: 每次大伙休假的时候，忌炎总是不休息，他一忙起来就又会忘了吃饭。
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_25_28.speaker: Ningwei

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_25_31.text: Hey, no sneakin' bites! Well, maybe a nibble, but leave some for Jiyan, okay?
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_25_31.zh: 喂，你可不许偷吃啊！算了，你可以偷偷吃一点，别都吃光了就行。
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_25_31.speaker: Ningwei

yakita:Event_WWPDJSBF_3_10.chapter: 剧情_春节活动角色邀约_忌炎_1_1
yakita:Event_WWPDJSBF_3_10.text: Vacation…? I fear you misunderstand. I'm not here in a personal capacity.
yakita:Event_WWPDJSBF_3_10.zh: 休假……？你一定是误会了。我此行并非以私人身份前来。
yakita:Event_WWPDJSBF_3_10.speaker: Jiyan

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_10.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_22
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_10.text: Besides, General Jiyan is currently there at the Norfall Barrens base. Dangerous as it is, he will keep an eye on every soldier, including the one you're looking for.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_10.zh: 况且，忌炎将军就带着兵在北落野，战场危险是危险，有忌炎将军在，他会看好每一个兵的。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_6_15.text: Jué asked me to go find Jiyan in the Norfall Barrens at a specific time.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_6_15.zh: 角要我在某一时刻前往北落野寻找忌炎。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_178_5.text: None other than General Jiyan and the legendary Rover!
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_178_5.zh: 正是漂泊者与忌炎将军。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_179_11.text: General Jiyan kicked me back here to heal after the Norfall Barrens battle.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_179_11.zh: 我吗？北落野大战结束后，我就被忌炎将军“赶”回来养伤了。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_1_7.text: We march on to the Norfall Barrens as soon as the rain stops.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_1_7.zh: 等待雨停，即刻启程，进军北落野。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_1_7.speaker: Jiyan

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_25_4.text: The Tacet Field Director Taoqi mentioned should be right up ahead. We must pass through it to reach our base and find General Jiyan.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_25_4.zh: 再往前，就是桃祈事务长先前所说的无音区了。只有穿过那片无音区，才能抵达忌炎将军所在的营地。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_25_4.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_38_13.text: Yes, allow me to introduce myself. I am Jiyan, the current General of the Midnight Rangers.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_38_13.zh: 容我正式介绍一番，我正是夜归军的现任将军，忌炎。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_38_13.speaker: Jiyan

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_38_16.text: Madam Magistrate and Taoqi have informed me of your willingness to assist us. Thank you for lending us a hand.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_38_16.zh: 令尹与桃祈已经将你出城前来支援的事情告知于我，感谢你前来。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_38_16.speaker: Jiyan

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_38_27.text: I was told you'd come to the Norfall Barrens one day... To reclaim your lost power from Ovathrax.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_38_27.zh: 在祂的预言之中，你会来到北落野。要从鸣式那里，取回你失去的力量。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_38_27.speaker: Jiyan

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_38_39.text: The Norfall Barrens have become a massive graveyard of weapons after countless battles. Those weapons would've made it even stronger than before.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_38_39.zh: 北落野在经历了无数场战争之后，已经成为了一座“万剑冢”。它的力量相比之前，恐怕又要增强几分。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_38_39.speaker: Jiyan

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_42_12.text: The Academy determined they were not native to the Norfall Barrens, and instead had been conjured by a mysterious power.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_42_12.zh: 研究院对此已有结论。北落野的残象并非是一种原生残象，而是基于某种力量的灌输而突然诞生的存在。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_42_12.speaker: Jiyan

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_43_6.text: This is a topographic map of the Norfall Barrens.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_43_6.zh: 这是目前我们所探查到的北落野的地形图。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_43_6.speaker: Jiyan

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_43_7.text: The Ovathrax's power limits our reach. Outrider scouts can't go beyond the Norfall Barrens and Valley junction.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_43_7.zh: 受制于鸣式力量的影响，踏白小队成员所能抵达的最深处，仅止步于北落山谷与腹地交界处的断崖。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_43_7.speaker: Jiyan

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_6_7.text: Our strategic plan was crafted 3 years ago, taking into account the terrain in Norfall Barrens. Its value remains crucial today.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_6_7.zh: 三年前，这一针对北落野地形地势总结出的部署方针，放到今日依然具有十分重要的战略价值。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_6_7.speaker: Jiyan

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_85_2.text: Yangyang, an Outrider. General Jiyan sent us here to help. How are things going?
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_85_2.zh: 踏白小队，秧秧。忌炎将军派我们前来支援，现在情况怎么样？
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_85_2.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_8_28.text: Jiyan, I have a question for you... What would you have done on that day, if you were in my position?
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_8_28.zh: 忌炎，我很好奇，如果我们互换位置……那时的你，会做出怎样的选择？

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_14.text: Could it be—you're the one from the Battle of Norfall Barrens? The one who fought alongside General Jiyan and drove back the Threnodian Ovathrax... 漂泊者?
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_14.zh: 莫非——你就是之前那场北落野之役里，和忌炎将军一起，击退鸣式无相燹主的那个……漂泊者？

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_855_1.text: By order of General Jiyan, our unit has arrived to provide reinforcements.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_855_1.zh: 我部奉忌炎将军命令，特来驰援。

yakita:POI_DANJIN_2_4.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_3_1
yakita:POI_DANJIN_2_4.text: You and General Jiyan were at Norfall Barrens and—Ow, gotta take it easier.
yakita:POI_DANJIN_2_4.zh: 你和忌炎将军在北落野——啊，轻点，轻点。

yakita:POI_DANJIN_2_6.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_危构悬天问丹心_3_1
yakita:POI_DANJIN_2_6.text: Every Midnight Ranger knows the legends of you and General Jiyan at Norfall Barrens!
yakita:POI_DANJIN_2_6.zh: 你和忌炎将军在北落野的事迹，夜归军里当然无人不晓！

yakita:XDQY_4_13.text: Ensuring the Gulpuff is held securely in both hands, Jiyan finally speaks.
yakita:XDQY_4_13.zh: 在确认河豚已经被完全举稳之后，忌炎才开口。

yakita:zhuiyuejie_first_38_21.text: A fine suggestion. I have always admired General Jiyan.
yakita:zhuiyuejie_first_38_21.zh: 很不错的提议，忌炎将军也是我一直以来最为敬佩的人之一。
yakita:zhuiyuejie_first_38_21.speaker: Xiangli Yao

yakita:LGNCZST_14_1.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_旧贵族生态_1_2
yakita:LGNCZST_14_1.text: Alice, when will Phoebe bring the Echoes back here?
yakita:LGNCZST_14_1.zh: 阿莉切姐姐，菲比姐姐什么时候才能带着声骸回到这里？
yakita:LGNCZST_14_1.speaker: Juno

yakita:LGNCZST_14_4.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_旧贵族生态_1_2
yakita:LGNCZST_14_4.text: Yeah! Every time Phoebe comes here, she tells us new stories.
yakita:LGNCZST_14_4.zh: 是啊！菲比姐姐每次来这里都会给我们讲新的故事。
yakita:LGNCZST_14_4.speaker: Juno

yakita:LGNCZST_14_6.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_旧贵族生态_1_2
yakita:LGNCZST_14_6.text: Our elders always say the other side is dangerous, full of bad people. But the new stories Phoebe brings back are always exciting!
yakita:LGNCZST_14_6.zh: 长辈们总说对岸很危险，那里全是坏人。可是，菲比姐姐从外面带来的新故事总是很有趣。
yakita:LGNCZST_14_6.speaker: Juno

yakita:BBTTC_25_3.text: This simulation models that exact scenario: a hacked defense grid and Overlord Class Tacet Discords running wild in Tethys's Deep.
yakita:BBTTC_25_3.zh: 我们就演算出了一种十分可怕的情景，被篡改的防卫系统和怒涛级的数据残象肆虐于泰缇斯之底……
yakita:BBTTC_25_3.speaker: KU-Cage

yakita:BBTTC_9_1.text: Lorelei, the Queen of the Night... embraced isolation to protect the Nimbus Sanctum, locking herself in a lonely prison.
yakita:BBTTC_9_1.zh: 「夜之女皇」罗蕾莱……为保护云海，甘愿承受陷入孤独囚笼之苦。
yakita:BBTTC_9_1.speaker: KU-Cage

yakita:Event_JXWJ_3_17.text: It uses data from all over Solaris-3, to simulate Crisis Trials that put the combat capabilities of its participants to the test under extreme conditions.
yakita:Event_JXWJ_3_17.zh: 它可以根据索拉里斯各地数据和过往案例模拟出一些「危机情景」，从而检验挑战者在严苛条件下的实战能力。
yakita:Event_JXWJ_3_17.speaker: KU-Cage

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_17_40.text: This a new rookie? You've got skills if you snagged that abnormal frequency from Port City of Guixu. Better not underestimate you.
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_17_40.zh: 哦吼，是新人吗？居然能拿回归墟港市的异常频率，看来不容小觑嘛。
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_17_40.speaker: KU-Money

yakita:TZZNQ_10_1.text: Ah, Shorekeeper. Are you also here to join us?
yakita:TZZNQ_10_1.zh: 哦，是守岸人呀，你也是来加入我们的吗？
yakita:TZZNQ_10_1.speaker: KU-Money

yakita:Flow_311000000_316.text: If only the butterfly nymph were here, she'd definitely scare away that whale...
yakita:Flow_311000000_316.zh: 要是有那个蝴蝶仙女姐姐在，一定会把大鲸鱼赶跑吧……
yakita:Flow_311000000_316.speaker: Kangjiu

yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_30_1.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第一幕上生态_14_1
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_30_1.text: I heard Yangyang went somewhere called the Land of Xuanfang... What kind of place is that, really?
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_30_1.zh: 秧秧她去了玄方地界……那是个什么地儿啊？
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_30_1.speaker: Kangjiu

yakita:NPC_LNXTMDST_21_18.text: You see the scar on my nose? The Acolytes were so afraid I'd sneeze on the Troupe of Fools that they actually clipped my nose before I boarded.
yakita:NPC_LNXTMDST_21_18.zh: 你看我鼻子上的伤疤——那群教士怕我在愚人船上打喷嚏，上船之前还给我夹了个鼻夹。
yakita:NPC_LNXTMDST_21_18.speaker: Kasper

yakita:Side_CXLR_14_29.text: Uncle Lianfeng, what do you think about continuing hunting those giant TDs? If you happen to get any rare materials, I'm still willing to buy them at a good price!
yakita:Side_CXLR_14_29.zh: 那不如继续去讨伐那些大型残象吧？获得稀有素材的话我这里可以继续高价回收哦！
yakita:Side_CXLR_14_29.speaker: Koko

yakita:Side_CXLR_14_32.text: Really? That's good news. Rover's much more reliable than Uncle Lianfeng.
yakita:Side_CXLR_14_32.zh: 真的吗？漂泊者的话肯定比炼风大叔靠谱多了吧！
yakita:Side_CXLR_14_32.speaker: Koko

yakita:InfoDisplay_201001102_Text.text:
Winter is here. Time to take a break and use this time to sharpen my sword skills.
Speaking of which, I met a couple of knights today. They seem to have come here drawn by the legends, hoping to continue their quests from Whisperwind Haven.
Each of them bore a family crest on their armor. It was easy to learn their identities. "In the name of the family, I shall..."
I'm sorry I lied to you, Joanna. Korlacchi. The holy name... doesn't exist. Because of the snowstorm, I was not able to attend the banquet where they were recruiting household knights.
That name, I only borrowed it from a novel about knighthood I found on a dusty shelf... I was never granted knighthood...
Forgive me...
yakita:InfoDisplay_201001102_Text.zh:
入冬了，就在这里暂时歇歇脚吧，趁这段时间也可以磨练磨练剑技。
说起来今天遇见了几位过路的骑士，他们似乎也是被骑士传说吸引而来，打算以拂风水畔为起点向更远处进发。
他们的盔甲上都印有家族的骑士纹章，很容易便能辨认出他们的身份，以家族之名，我将……
抱歉，吉安娜，我欺骗了你，科拉基之名……根本不存在。因为大雪的原因，我并没有赶上招揽家族骑士的宴会。
那个名字，不过是从书架上一本骑士小说里摘出的名字……我没有成为被认可的骑士……
对不起……

yakita:ST_LL_1_16.text: To me, these small, ordinary things shine as bright as stars. You were right—the "starry sky" of Lahai-Roi truly is breathtaking.
yakita:ST_LL_1_16.zh: 这些稀松平常的事物在我眼中，亮得就像一颗颗星星，你说的没错，拉海洛的“星空”真的很美。
yakita:ST_LL_1_16.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_1_18.text: Lily nods. You can't say what season Lahai-Roi is in right now, but surely a warm one.
yakita:ST_LL_1_18.zh: 莉莉点点头，你不知道现在是拉海洛的什么季节，但那一定是个很温暖的季节。

datamine:InfoDisplay_102181707_Text.title: Lahai-Roi Stargazing Guide
datamine:InfoDisplay_102181707_Text.text:
Under the stars, we are both observers and part of the cosmos itself. When you close this guide, your real journey has only just begun.

Forget the names of the constellations. What matters is that you looked up and let the starlight in. The moment you first lost yourself in the beauty of the stars is more precious than any astronomical fact.

A gentle reminder for every stargazer:
1. There's no need to bring advanced telescopes. A curious heart is all you need.
2. Pick a night when the moon is shy, and the sky is clear.
3. Bring a star chart, a flashlight, and a friend who'd love to share the quiet of a starlit night with you.

When the starlight touches you, remember this: every cell, every fiber, every element that makes you you was born in the heart of a star. You are, in your own way, stardust made manifest.

May the stars always bring you peace and inspiration.

Dedicated to all those who have ever stopped and looked up.

Appendix: Lahai-Roi Stargazing Calendar
...
datamine:InfoDisplay_102181707_Text.zh:
星空之下，我们每个人都既是观星者，也是星辰间的一分子。当您合上这本指南，真正的旅程才刚刚开始。
不必记住所有星座的名字，重要的是您曾抬头，将璀璨星光收入眼眸。您第一次沉醉于星空美景的心情，比任何天文学知识都更珍贵。
观星提醒：
1.昂贵的设备是您持续的好奇心。
2.观星地点请选择光线黑暗，视野开阔，避免过于明亮月光的环境。
3.带上一张星图、一支手电，和一位愿意陪您一同静默欣赏的朋友。
最后，当您从星空收回目光，请记得——从宇宙的尺度来说，您身体里的每一个细胞、组成这些细胞的所有元素，都生于一颗恒星的熔炉中，您本就是星辰知晓自身的一种方式。
愿星空永远给您好奇，予您宁静。
谨以这些文字，献给所有曾在夜空下驻足的人。

datamine:InfoDisplay_72010106_Text.title: Relay Station Rental Service Notice
datamine:InfoDisplay_72010106_Text.text:
"The Relay Station combines garage, warehouse, rest areas, and basic laboratory facilities in a single complex, providing support for arduous field research and logistics operations. One of its key services is vehicle rental.

The station primarily offers three types of vehicles:
- Hauler: A large vehicle designed for transporting heavy cargo.
- Pathfinder: A medium-sized vehicle for personnel transfer, with limited cargo capacity.
- Sprinter: A small vehicle optimized for rapid, solo transport.
 
Due to limited vehicle availability, all applicants must submit a formal request. The staff will review each application and assign vehicles based on demonstrated need.

'Lately, it seems like all the Haulers in Lahai-Roi are heading to the Spacetrek Observatory. Just how massive is that project?'"
datamine:InfoDisplay_72010106_Text.zh:
"整流车站是集车库、仓库、休息区和简易实验设施于一体的建筑区，为应对艰辛的野外科考工作与物资中转为科考提供便利，其中一项重要的服务便是提供车辆租用。
 整流车站主要提供如下三种车辆，用于运输物资的大型车辆，重载者。用于转移人员，兼有部分载货能力的中型车辆，巡路者。适合用于单人快速转移的小型车辆，疾行者。
 当前车辆资源紧张，提交申请单并通过审核后，工作人员会根据申请者的需要分配合适的车辆。
 “最近感觉全拉海洛的重载者都往深空测界台跑了，他们的工程规模居然这么大？”"

datamine:InfoDisplay_72010107_Text.title: Rakosan's Speech (Excerpt)
datamine:InfoDisplay_72010107_Text.text:
[…]

"The Spacetrek Observatory stands as a monumental achievement co-built by the Spacetrek Collective and the Roya.

Its mission is to map Lahai-Roi's various data points.

Unlike the Casettes that store personal data, the Observatory primarily captures and tracks the changes in Lahai-Roi's terrain, ecology, climate, and sky under the influence of Void Storms and Threnodian activity.

[…]

A devastating Void Storm swept through, leaving the structure in ruins.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_72010107_Text.zh:
"深空测界台是由深空联合主导，与罗伊人合作建造完成的大型装置，用于测绘拉海洛的各项数据，和记录人本身的磁带相对，深空测界台记录的更多是在虚质磁暴和鸣式的影响下，拉海洛地形、生态、气候、天穹的变化。
 随着罗伊人提供了更多帮助，深空测界台也会记录罗伊人的各种建筑、人文景观，而后虚质磁暴席卷深空测界台摧毁了大部分结构，学院尽管已经着手重建，但由于在拉海洛的研究项目繁多，很难在短时间内分出足够资源，加上拉海洛各处道路的损毁，也让这座远离拉海洛中心的巨型建筑修复进度缓慢。
 对深空测界台的介绍就到这里，我相信各位一定能感受到它的重要性，尽管现在困难重重，但对它进行重建是必须的！为此我呼吁各位，加入我，加入重建工程，无论是什么样的帮助我都非常需要！我是拉科萨！我在深空测界台等着各位！"

yakita:Term700004_Desc.text: An amalgamated horror that often emerges alongside Void Storms. During lulls between Storms, it primarily inhabits the highly concentrated Voidmatter environment of the Mawburrow Desert. The Voidmatter Regulators on its head serve as both its power source and its weakness.
yakita:Term700004_Desc.zh:
具有高危险性的构造实体，常伴随虚质磁暴一同出现。
在磁暴的非活跃期，主要活动于拉海洛腹地“隐喙深腹”的高浓度虚质环境中。其头部携带的虚质反应炉既是其能量核心所在，也是其关键弱点。

yakita:AreaReportContent_Text63.text:
The mountains crumbled as the iron star fell.
Beneath its wreckage, there we stood.
No more fruit upon the trees, no more fires for the night.
 
O Sun and stars, you answered us no more.
O clouds and night, you wept in silent tears.
 
In the hush of a lightless night,
Across frostlands stripped of warmth,
 
Only the Giant, blazing like the sun, remained.
Only the Giant, blazing like the sun, remained.
 
"Keep living,"
So It said.
 
—An excerpt from the Royan folksong For the Giant Was Here
 
According to Royan myth and surviving historical records, before the Lament fell upon Lahai-Roi, the Roya lived on the surface, amidst the fjord forests. But in the aftermath of the Lament, Solaris's ▇▇▇▇▇▇ underwent significant changes. Temperatures plunged, followed by the fall of ▇▇▇▇ and ▇▇▇. 

The Roya of that era could only take refuge within the remains of the ▇▇▇▇, wandering the desolate frostlands in search of life upon newly snow-covered plains.
yakita:AreaReportContent_Text63.zh:
山峦倾倒，铁星坠落
我们在铁星的残骸下
今日没有果树，今夜没有篝火

太阳与星辰，你不再应答
流云与夜空，你满覆泪水

没有光的寂夜中
没有火的雪原中

只有如太阳般耀眼的巨人
只有如太阳般耀眼的巨人

祂说
活下去

——节选自罗伊古遥《因为巨人来过》其一

根据罗伊神话与相关史料记载，在悲鸣降临拉海洛地区前，罗伊族生活在地表的峡湾森林中。
而在悲鸣发生后，索拉里斯的▇▇▇▇▇▇发生变化，地区内气温骤降，并引发了▇▇▇▇与▇▇▇的坠落。
彼时的罗伊人只得栖身于▇▇▇▇的残骸中，在荒芜的冰原上探索满覆冰雪的原野。

yakita:BYCZ_2_14.text: Maji said it best. To really unlock Lahai-Roi's economic potential, you gotta streamline the foundational pipeline, build a synergistic vertical, and create a seamless UX loop for user onboarding and retention...
yakita:BYCZ_2_14.zh: 马计师傅说的好啊，要想为拉海洛的区块经济赋能，就得先打通底层逻辑，创造垂直矩阵，实现端到端用户跃迁无缝流转的闭环……

yakita:FavorWord_151012_Content.text: The day before I came to Lahai-Roi, I dumped all of Novialle's mess onto my assistant. I felt oddly at ease when I saw the look of sheer shock and confusion on his face. You were right. I needed to loosen the string I'd kept too tight, and move somewhere new for a fresh start.
yakita:FavorWord_151012_Content.zh: 决定来拉海洛的前一天，我把诺维尔那些复杂到令人头疼的事务全都丢给了助理。看着他一脸震惊和迷茫，我竟意外地感到几分轻快……果然，如你所说，我确实该松开那根绷得太久的弦，换一个全新的环境了吧？
yakita:FavorWord_151012_Content.speaker: Luuk Herssen

yakita:LoadingTipsText_201106_TipsText.text: A terrifying creature born from the Threnodian's influence, found primarily in the hinterland of Lahai-Roi known as the "Mawburrow Desert." Its source of power and its fatal weakness are the Voidmatter Regulators on its head. Wherever it passes, life is extinguished, leaving only the void in its wake.
yakita:LoadingTipsText_201106_TipsText.zh: 鸣式力量影响下诞生的可怖生物，主要活跃于拉海洛腹地，名为「隐喙深腹」的山谷。其头部的虚质反应炉既是动力源，也是要害所在。凡为它所踞之处，万物寂然，唯余虚无。

yakita:LoadingTipsText_201203_TipsText.text: Located within the research base zone, the Icebreak Port is the only regular access point into the Roya Frostlands. Upon arrival, personnel and supplies may be transferred via the Starward Riseway to the underground haven of Lahai-Roi, or routed deeper into the frostlands through the inter-outpost roads.
yakita:LoadingTipsText_201203_TipsText.zh: 位于科考基地区域内的不冻港，是外界人员和物资进入罗伊冰原的唯一常规途径。登陆港口后，人员与物资可经由「联运椎骨」转运至地下绿洲拉海洛，也可通过各科考站点间的道路前往冰原其他区域。

yakita:LoadingTipsText_608201_TipsText.text: Officially Spacetrek Collective: Research Institute, it stands as part of the same borderless research initiative—the Spacetrek Collective—as Startorch Academy. Its mission is to extract and apply advanced technologies. Linked directly to the Starward Riseway, the Institute rests above the greatsword's tip like a guarding Stargram, watching over Lahai-Roi from above.
yakita:LoadingTipsText_608201_TipsText.zh: 全称「深空联合：研究院」，与星炬学院同属无国界科研共同体「深空联合」，专注前沿研究与技术的提取与转化。它与交通枢纽「联运椎骨」相接，高悬于巨剑顶端，形如守护的星环，俯瞰拉海洛的大地。

yakita:MAIN_RGLC_28_3.text: Lahai-Roi was just a minor setback! I'm still useful! I still have work in the New Federation, I still—
yakita:MAIN_RGLC_28_3.zh: 拉海洛……只是个小失误！我还有用，我还有新联邦的活儿，我还——
yakita:MAIN_RGLC_28_3.speaker: Warren

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_23_9.chapter: 剧情_3_0_深空联合主线_上半_2_2_3
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_23_9.text: Yep. They connect Lahai-Roi to the surface frostlands. But with all these Void Storms, surface trips—except for the supply runs—are on hold. Every train turns back here once it reaches the Institute.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_23_9.zh: 嗯，这就是连通拉海洛和地上冰原的列车，最近虚质磁暴频繁，除了必要的补给班次，前往地上的列车全都暂时停运了，所有车在抵达研究院之后就会回返。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_23_9.speaker: Lynae

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_56_27.text: Fifteen months later, this very component became the final piece for the construction of the Starward Riseway, the bridge between Lahai-Roi's earth and the sky.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_56_27.zh: 而在十五个月后，这枚机械元件成为了如今联运椎骨的最后一块拼图，联通了拉海洛的天与地。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_56_27.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_215_11.text: My lovely students and colleagues are all throwing themselves into Lahai-Roi's reconstruction efforts with the usual enthusiasm.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_215_11.zh: 我可爱的学生们、同事们现在都兴奋地投身于拉海洛的重建工作。

yakita:NPC_YJYFB_19_17.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_研究院副本_1_15
yakita:NPC_YJYFB_19_17.text: The Starward Riseway is a colossal elevator system connecting Lahai-Roi and the Roya Frostlands, named after its shape.

yakita:NPC_YJYFB_19_17.speaker: Receptionist

yakita:SIDE_SKFHJH_100_4.text: It reminds me of the Starward Riseway in Lahai-Roi.

yakita:SIDE_SKFHJH_100_6.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_深空孵化计划_14_1
yakita:SIDE_SKFHJH_100_6.text: It looks like the Starward Riseway in Lahai-Roi.

yakita:Side_mnwjndyj_5_5.text: She was Roya. She was always going to stay in Lahai-Roi. I planned to go back to the New Federation after graduation.
yakita:Side_mnwjndyj_5_5.zh: 她是罗伊族人，以后要留在拉海洛，而我准备毕业后返回新联邦。

yakita:STNPC_JZST_15_2.text: According to Suisui, first, we're going to come up with a way to boost Xuanfang's economy. We're going to export our specialty products and make everyone prosperous.
yakita:STNPC_JZST_15_2.zh: 据穗穗所说，我们会先想办法提振玄方地界的经济，把这儿的特产卖出去，让人们富裕起来。

yakita:YangYang_Shengtai_10_26.text: And yet, the harm he caused to the Ministry of Development and to Xuanfang is undeniable.
yakita:YangYang_Shengtai_10_26.zh: 然而，他对天工，对玄方地界造成的伤害是板上钉钉的。
yakita:YangYang_Shengtai_10_26.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_20_1.text: I heard Yangyang went somewhere called the Land of Xuanfang... What kind of place is that, really?
