yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_640_3.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第二幕_玄方城生态_3_2
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_640_3.text: Every other time the Land of Xuanfang was in need, Qingxiao the Perfected would descend from the mountain. But this time... could something have happened...?
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_640_3.zh: 以前玄方地界出了大事，清宵真人都会下山来……莫非……

yakita:Term750049_Desc.text: The soldiers responsible for guarding Xuanfang Hold are known as Xuanfang Wardens.
yakita:Term750049_Desc.zh: 隶属于玄方地界的守城士兵被称为「定玄卫」。

yakita:Term750050_Desc.text:
A factory in the Land of Xuanfang's Western Fang Peaks. 
It comprises the Thousandfold Foundry, which produces Autopuppets ceaselessly, and the Myriad Snare, which suppresses and exterminates powerful Tacet Discords. The Skyworks runs day and night in service to  Xuanfang Hold.
yakita:Term750050_Desc.zh:
位于玄方地界西侧，方擎西峰中的机关工厂。
「悬天构」由负责制造机傀的流水线工坊「千形坊」，以及专用于镇压、绞杀强大残象的「万囮牢」共同构成，它们昼夜运转不息，为玄方城提供源源不断的增援与助力。

yakita:AreaReportContent_Text95.text:
[…]

Ladies and gentlemen, today we set aside tales of Sentinels and speak instead of a curious old legend from the Land of Xuanfang, a hundred years past!

In those bygone days, in the Western Fang Peaks of the Land of Xuanfang, there lived a family by the name of "Bi." From the moment Bizhong drew his first breath, he was unlike any other child of his age.

[…]

If it fell, countless beams of wood, jade, and metal would come crashing down from the peak, straight toward the village below.

[…]
yakita:AreaReportContent_Text95.zh:
诸位，今日咱们不说那岁主逸事，单表一段玄方地界百年前的旧日奇闻！
话回当年。玄方地界，方擎西峰，住着一户姓毕的人家，其独子单名一个“重”字。这毕重自打落地，就与人不同——别的孩童追追卷鳞甲，逗逗敲浪獭，叽叽喳喳终日闹腾，他却是沉默寡言。一天到晚，他只爱蹲在墙根码石头、拆木锁。
岁月如梭，毕重二十有余时，已长成一条铁塔般的汉子。身长八尺，宽肩厚背，膀大腰圆。这人生得高大健硕，搭配一副冷面孔，日常里不苟言笑。家中老母病逝后，身边竟没个能说贴心话的亲近人。但若当他是个莽汉，那可就大错特错！
毕重在机巧工艺一道，可称是天赋异禀。寻常工匠钻研半个月的图纸，他扫一眼就能瞧出承重与榫卯的缺漏；再复杂的千机阵盘、高城重构，他皆是信手捏来。不仅如此，他心性之坚，执念之深，堪称西峰一绝。一旦画定了图纸，便是坚信其确凿无误，多大的险阻都定要迎难而上。
诸位可知？那如今矗立于西峰间，宏伟通天的「悬天构」，正与这毕重息息相关！
却说那年西峰之上，「悬天构」入口——「百节廊」之承重枢纽突发倾斜，砖石如雨，濒临崩塌！若是一倒，数不胜数的巨木、玉石、金属便要从山巅滚落，直逼山脚村落，一时百姓惊呼奔逃不断！
真确是千钧一发之际，西峰百姓安危如何？毕重在此局面，又能有怎样作为？且听下回分解！

yakita:FavorStory_111005_Content.text:
[…]

Nightfall descended upon the Land of Xuanfang, the twilight sinking inch by inch across the horizon.

Suisui walked along the thoroughfare, her steps clicking softly against teal stone slabs.

[…]

The Waking Moon Festival was drawing near.

[…]

Taking the steamer, Suisui paid her tab, then slid a few extra Shell Credits across the counter.

[…]

When the wind blew a stray lock of hair across her face, she didn't even have a spare hand to brush it away.

It suddenly occurred to her that she had left her water fan behind.

[…]

The real storm had already been weathered during the Siege of Xuanfang Hold.

[…]

She wondered if they had already lit the lanterns, and whether they would enjoy this dish.

She had walked through the spring and summer of Mingting, where her young self ran through bustling crowds with her hair flying in the wind, her heart captivated by the vibrant tapestry of the world.

She had walked through the autumn and winter of Mengzhou, rowing into misty mornings to negotiate trade, and sitting alone on snowy nights to read family letters over and over by the hearth.

[…]
yakita:FavorStory_111005_Content.zh:
入夜时分的玄方地界，暮色正从天际一寸一寸沉下去。
穗穗走在城中长街上，鞋底踏过青石板，步子不紧不慢。天边的余晖还没散尽，将整条街都镀染上淡淡的橘色，檐角挂着的灯笼还未点亮，只在风里轻轻晃着。铺子陆续开始收摊，人们进进出出，搬着门板，偶尔传来几句闲话，散在暮风里，听不真切。穗穗从那些光影里穿过去，身影被拉得很长很长。

快到要举办朝月会的时节了。街边铺子门前堆着几十匹彩绸，伙计搬进搬出，老板娘靠在门框上点数，嘴里念着数字，眉梢带笑。几个孩子从穗穗身边跑过去，路过拐角处那几只正热腾腾冒着香味的机关炉鼎时，又纷纷驻足，眼睛发亮地咽了半天的口水，这才终于恋恋不舍地走了。
穗穗支着下巴，打量了一会儿。店家摆的是个卖“锦霞珠”的摊，那油亮软糯、喷香扑鼻的肉丸缀着碧色葱花，齐齐整整列在蒸笼中，看着就叫人食指大动。穗穗伸手点了点。
“烦请来一笼锦霞珠。”
店家抬头，瞧见面前站着个年轻姑娘，笑眼盈盈的，便也笑着应了声。穗穗接过装好的锦霞珠，付过钱，又多递了一份贝币过去。
“方才跑过去的那几个孩子，一人给装一个吧。”她拎起袋子，声音轻盈地飘回来，“不用说谁买的。”
店家愣了愣。那钱留在摊面上，身影已经消失在了人群中。

暮色沉下去，茶楼酒肆的灯陆续亮起来，暖黄的光从窗格子里漏出来铺在地上。穗穗踩着那些光走，手里拎着那袋热气腾腾的肉丸，风将耳边碎发吹到脸上也没腾出手去拢。
想起今天出门急，水扇忘带在身上了。她笑了一声，倒不在意，能让她动扇子的时候本来就不多，真正要紧的风浪早在守城战那几天翻过去了。眼下的日子寻常得很，寻常到她有空在街上闲逛，有空停下来看人们是怎样度过一个再普通不过的黄昏。
脚步不知不觉快了。
穿过前头那条窄巷，再过一座小桥就到了。妹妹在那里，那个人也在那里。她不知道那头此刻是不是已经点起了灯，不知道{Male=他们;Female=她们}能不能吃得惯这道菜？
她曾走过明庭的春夏，水面波光粼粼，美不胜收，小小的穗穗奔跑在喧嚷人群中，任风扬起她的长发，满心满眼只有那生动、鲜活直叫人不舍移开目光的烟火万象；亦走过梦州的秋冬，于湖上起雾的早晨泛舟去谈生意，于落雪的傍晚独坐窗下，炉火噼啪…

yakita:FavorWord_161016_Content.chapter: 秧秧·玄翎档案_角色语音
yakita:FavorWord_161016_Content.text: In Xuanfang, Liangyu has been such a huge help to me. Since I'm serving as an acting Xuan Watcher, that technically makes her my superior. She often wears a frown, but once you get to know her, you'll see how deeply she cares for the people she holds dear. Like soft spring rain that quietly nourishes the land, she gives so much of herself in secret—and she gets so shy whenever anyone finds out.
yakita:FavorWord_161016_Content.zh: 在玄方地界，椋羽帮了我很多。说起来，我暂代后玄骑使的这段时间里，她还是我的前辈呢。虽然她平日里总是皱着眉头，但和她熟络之后就能明白，她的心中装着所有她重视的人。就像无声细雨，总是默默付出，却害羞到不想让任何人知道。

yakita:JSZYH_1_6.text: The Hold has never seen a livelier Waking Moon Festival... And now that the Sentinel has appeared, everyone is breathing a little easier. I'd say things in Xuanfang will only improve from here.
yakita:JSZYH_1_6.zh: 这玄方城的朝月会，今年可是最热闹的一回了……岁主大人也已现身，大家都安心许多，此后的玄方地界，想也必能越来越好吧。

yakita:LoadingTipsText_201401_TipsText.text: A way station in the Land of Xuanfang's Southern Yuan Hills. Every shipment, commodity, and traveler entering the territory must first submit to inspection by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
yakita:LoadingTipsText_201401_TipsText.zh: 位于玄方地界南侧的落渊南丘的驿站。所有入城的物资、商品以及人员都要在此接受「外事府」的审查。

yakita:LoadingTipsText_201601_TipsText.text:
A factory in the Land of Xuanfang's Western Fang Peaks. 
The Thousandfold Foundry within it produces Autopuppets for Xuanfang ceaselessly, while the Myriad Snare disposes of powerful Tacet Discords too terrible for Censure Courts to hold.
yakita:LoadingTipsText_201601_TipsText.zh:
位于玄方地界西侧，方擎西峰中的机关工厂。
此中的流水线「千形坊」为玄方地界源源不断地生产着机傀，而其深处的「万囮牢」则专用于绞杀咎庭难以处理的强大残象。

yakita:LoadingTipsText_923601_TipsText.text:
A factory in the Land of Xuanfang's Western Fang Peaks. 
It comprises the Thousandfold Foundry, which produces Autopuppets ceaselessly, and the Myriad Snare, which suppresses and exterminates powerful Tacet Discords. The Skyworks runs day and night in service to  Xuanfang Hold.
yakita:LoadingTipsText_923601_TipsText.zh:
位于玄方地界西侧、方擎西峰深处的庞大机关工厂。
此地由负责制造机傀的流水线工坊「千形坊」，以及专用于镇压、绞杀强大残象的「万囮牢」共同构成，悬天构昼夜运转不息，为玄方城提供源源不断的增援与助力。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_48.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_拉海洛今州_53_13
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_48.text: Guided by the Rafter Kite, you manage to escape the fog but lose contact with Suisui. Nearby, you encounter Liangyu, a Xuanfang Warden. She explains that rogue Autopuppets and escaped Tacet Discords are now threatening the land, but that she had traveled with Yangyang days prior and the letter Suisui found was indeed written by Yangyang.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_48.zh: 你在梁鸢的带领下成功走出了迷雾，却在途中与穗穗失散。此时，一名名叫椋羽的定玄卫正在井栈附近徘徊，经过与她的交流，你得知了玄方地界此刻正在经历的危机——机傀叛乱，残象外逃。好消息是，几天之前，秧秧曾与椋羽同行过一段时间，而穗穗此前发现的信件，似乎正是秧秧所写。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_430_9.text: In Xianling Village, I met Liangyu. She is young, yet she already holds the title of Xuan Watcher. She told me of the chaos that has swept across Xuanfang. Her squadmates were slaughtered in a Censure Court.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_430_9.zh: ……在衔翎村，我认识了椋羽，她年纪很轻，但已经是玄方城的「后玄骑使」。是她告诉我玄方地界近日的异变，而她的同伴此前牺牲在了咎庭中……
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_430_9.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_520_15.text: The Western Fang Peaks houses the Skyworks, Xuanfang's largest Autopuppet production plant and Tacet Discord disposal facility. If that place falls, rogue Autopuppets and Tacet Discords will spill into every corner of Xuanfang. The consequences are unthinkable.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_520_15.zh: 方擎西峰，坐落着玄方地界最大的机傀生产工厂，以及残象的销毁炉——悬天构。一旦那里沦陷，异常机傀和残象一并涌入玄方地界各处，后果不堪设想。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_1_19.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_梦州主线_中_1_1
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_1_19.text: Tracking Yangyang's frequency, you trace her movements over the past few days in Xuanfang. Following the clues from her letter, you head to the Skyworks in the Western Fang Peaks for more answers. Liangyu joins you, determined to find out why the Autopuppets went rogue.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_1_19.zh: 通过追踪秧秧的频率，你了解了这几日秧秧在玄方地界的行迹。根据秧秧在信上留下的线索，你决定前往位于方擎西峰的悬天构一探究竟。而椋羽为了查明机傀暴乱的真相，也选择和你同行。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_2_60_13.text: Ah... Lady Suoming. What brings you to Xuanfang?
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_2_60_13.zh: 原来……是锁暝女士。你怎么来了玄方地界？
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_2_60_13.speaker: Yinlin

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_20_20.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_7_梦枢天罗_5_2
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_20_20.text:
You come upon a family in the middle of an argument. Wanhong, an old man, refuses to leave the Land of Xuanfang, the only home he has ever known. His daughter Qingchen, however, is convinced the Hold is heading for another disaster and insists on moving the family out.
 
As father and daughter stand at an impasse, Qingxiao receives word from Liangyu: a woman claiming to be an Intendant of the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs tried to force her way into the Sanctum and was stopped by the Wardens.

You decide to head to the Sanctum and find out what's happening.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_20_20.zh:
你们遇到了正在争执的一家人，老人挽鸿不愿离开生活了一生的玄方地界，而他的女儿青沉则担忧玄方城又生变故，打算举家搬离，就在父女僵持间，清宵接到了椋羽的通讯——一位自称是谛天鉴州监的人试图私自闯入神宫，被定玄卫拦下。
你们决定前往神宫了解情况。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_59.text: She was already losing her grip on things by then. On her own, she could never have aimed that gateway precisely at the Land of Xuanfang. I gave it a little nudge.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_59.zh: 那时的她，已经开始走向失控。凭她的力量根本无法将门准确传送到玄方地界，是我帮了她一把。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_59.speaker: Meta

yakita:STNPC_RCGCST_31_6.text: Xuanfang is just a rest stop for them. Mengzhou City's next.
yakita:STNPC_RCGCST_31_6.zh: 这玄方地界是他们的歇脚处，下一站，他们要去梦州本部。

yakita:Side_BGJSY_120_9.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_历程记忆手册_不改旧时影_16_1
yakita:Side_BGJSY_120_9.text: This counts as one of Xuanfang's "local specialties," right? I was thinking, if we could make miniature replicas of them and turn them into little toy trinkets... they might sell pretty well in Yuezhou...
yakita:Side_BGJSY_120_9.zh: 这也算玄方地界的“特产”吧？我在想，若是能复刻外形，制成玩具一类的小物件……放在越州卖的话，说不定会很有市场……

yakita:Side_BGJSY_70_16.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_历程记忆手册_不改旧时影_9_1
yakita:Side_BGJSY_70_16.text: So... I came to Xuanfang from Yuezhou all by myself, without telling my father... But when I went to the address my mother gave me, another family was already living there. I worked up the courage to ask a few people, but nobody knew who I was talking about...
yakita:Side_BGJSY_70_16.zh: 所以……我就瞒着我父亲，一个人从越州来了玄方地界……可我按着母亲给的地址找去的时候，那里住的已经是别户人家，我也鼓足勇气问了几个人，但他们都说不认识我说的人……

yakita:Side_BGJSY_70_8.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_历程记忆手册_不改旧时影_9_1
yakita:Side_BGJSY_70_8.text: Here's the thing... My parents are both from Xuanfang. They moved away when they were young and went to Yuezhou to make a living... All my life, they never once talked about going back.
yakita:Side_BGJSY_70_8.zh: 是这样的……我父母都是玄方地界人，他们年轻的时候就离开了玄方地界，去到越州讨生活……我从出生起，直到现在，父亲和母亲一次都没提过要回老家的事。

yakita:Side_TFSJJKYY_8_1.text: Phew… are all vases in Xuanfang Hold that dangerous?
yakita:Side_TFSJJKYY_8_1.zh: 呼……难道说玄方地界的花瓶都这么危险吗？

yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_2_13.chapter: 剧情_七丘_列奥尼达广场生态_1_2
yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_2_13.text: What a convoluted name. How does a New Federation company even end up registered in Septimont? Is it one of those shell companies?
yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_2_13.zh: 这名字还挺复杂的，你说一新联邦的公司怎么注册到七丘来了？难不成是传说中的空壳公司？
yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_2_13.speaker: Lane

yakita:Character_Rococo_77_16.text: Ah, the Laureate. How could I forget? Then I guess Roccia is in safe hands.
yakita:Character_Rococo_77_16.zh: 啊，有「桂冠」在，确实没啥好担心的。
yakita:Character_Rococo_77_16.speaker: Tina

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_40_17.chapter: 剧情_3_0_主线_拉海洛主线_上半_1_18_1
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_40_17.text: It's called the Lawless Zone. Let's just say... you'd see blood spilled every three days, on average. That's where I grew up.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_40_17.zh: 那里被称为“无法地带”，无法的程度大概在……平均每活三天就要见一次血吧，我就是在那种地方长大的。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_40_17.speaker: Lynae

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_18_10.text: Ha, no way. We just got here. Hurry up, greet our boss, Uncle Li!
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_18_10.zh: 呵……呵呵，黎哥您说的哪里话。我们也是刚到。快，叫黎叔！
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_18_10.speaker: Lei

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_19_16.text: Uncle Li knows life ain't easy for a man with a past like mine. Used to run with the Savage Beasts, know how to hunt, so he hired me and my crew to fetch meat for him.
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_19_16.zh: 黎哥知道我金盆洗手不容易，又知道我以前在 野兽帮干过，知道怎么狩猎，所以才雇我带兄弟们打猎的。
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_19_16.speaker: Lei

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_19_30.text: Uncle Li, heading back to the stall already? Let us handle the boxes. We'll get 'em close to the venue, but the rest...
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_19_30.zh: 黎叔，你要回宵月会的摊位吗？我们帮你抬箱子吧。不过我们只能送你到会场附近，剩下的路……
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_19_30.speaker: Lei

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_19_9.text: I'll spill everything! It was all Uncle Li's idea!
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_19_9.zh: ……我交代，我坦白！都是黎哥让我们做的！
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_19_9.speaker: Lei

yakita:Daily_MGLTJRTC_14_4.chapter: 剧情_2_0_每日_玛格烈特今日套餐_11_1
yakita:Daily_MGLTJRTC_14_4.text: And Ms. Margherita is so fast! I'm out of breath just trying to keep up.
yakita:Daily_MGLTJRTC_14_4.zh: 玛格烈特女士的动作真的好快，光是跟上她的节奏我就已经竭尽全力了。
yakita:Daily_MGLTJRTC_14_4.speaker: Lelia

yakita:Daily_MGLTJRTC_16_1.chapter: 剧情_2_0_每日_玛格烈特今日套餐_6_1
yakita:Daily_MGLTJRTC_16_1.text: Lately, Ms. Margherita has been sharing all sorts of cooking tips with me.
yakita:Daily_MGLTJRTC_16_1.zh: 说起来，最近我从玛格烈特女士那学到了很多做菜的心得呢。
yakita:Daily_MGLTJRTC_16_1.speaker: Lelia

yakita:Daily_MGLTJRTC_5_9.chapter: 剧情_2_0_每日_玛格烈特今日套餐_3_1
yakita:Daily_MGLTJRTC_5_9.text: To capture true Egla flavor, I got up early and went to the Gondola Market to buy wild mushrooms from Whisperwind Haven.
yakita:Daily_MGLTJRTC_5_9.zh: 为了还原埃格拉小镇的风味，我可是特意起早，在水市上买了产自拂风水畔的野生蘑菇。
yakita:Daily_MGLTJRTC_5_9.speaker: Lelia

yakita:Daily_MGLTJRTC_6_3.chapter: 剧情_2_0_每日_玛格烈特今日套餐_3_2
yakita:Daily_MGLTJRTC_6_3.text: I did! Today was supposed to be Margherita Pizza, but...
yakita:Daily_MGLTJRTC_6_3.zh: 做了的，今天学着做了「玛格烈特披萨」，但是……
yakita:Daily_MGLTJRTC_6_3.speaker: Lelia

yakita:POI_PSAYZX_11_5.text: I actually heard the original prototype was lost in a lab accident. So... this might be the one that got swallowed by the Void Storm.
yakita:POI_PSAYZX_11_5.zh: 听说，当年第一代原型机在实验中遇到事故，下落不明……说不定，这就是那台被虚质磁暴吞没的机器。
yakita:POI_PSAYZX_11_5.speaker: Lenie

yakita:ATYDZH_26_4.text: You should be grateful you saved Lenore back when you'd forgotten your memories.
yakita:ATYDZH_26_4.zh: 庆幸自己失忆时救了伊诺尔吧。

yakita:ATYDZH_38_11.text: Oh, Miss Lenore... I was once a warrior, one who stood by the Sentinel's side. Only those who give everything for glory earn a place in Septimont.
yakita:ATYDZH_38_11.zh: 伊诺尔小姐，我们是与岁主并肩的战士，只有为荣誉献上一切的人才能得到七丘的垂青。
yakita:ATYDZH_38_11.speaker: Medulius

yakita:ATYDZH_4_42.text: Or, if you prefer, I'll give you the Lumenstone locations and stay behind with Miss Lenore. She's a sharp mind. Conversing with her has been enlightening.
yakita:ATYDZH_4_42.zh: 或者我将灵炬的位置告知于您，我在这里保护伊诺尔小姐。伊诺尔小姐是一位非常渊博的学者，跟她交流我很有收获。
yakita:ATYDZH_4_42.speaker: Medulius

yakita:ATYDZH_4_45.text: (If I leave Lenore alone with this thing, she might be in danger...)
yakita:ATYDZH_4_45.zh: （再让它和伊诺尔待着并不安全）

yakita:ATYDZH_4_46.text: Tell me where the Lumenstones are. I'll take Lenore with me. You stay here.
yakita:ATYDZH_4_46.zh: 把地点告诉我，我带伊诺尔过去，你留在这。
yakita:ATYDZH_4_46.speaker: Rover

yakita:ATYDZH_4_6.text: Miss Lenore, is this the 漂泊者 you've been going on about?
yakita:ATYDZH_4_6.zh: 伊诺尔小姐，这位就是您一直提及的漂泊者大人吗？
yakita:ATYDZH_4_6.speaker: Medulius

yakita:ATYDZH_5_5.text: But when I arrived, she was nowhere to be found. An employee with exceptionally dark circles told me she'd headed off to the Riccioli Islands. So I scraped together everything I had and got myself a ticket.
yakita:ATYDZH_5_5.zh: 但等我到金库之后转了一圈都没找到。一个黑眼圈很重的员工跟我说菲比去了黎乔利群岛，所以我又花了好大力气买了票赶到那边去。
yakita:ATYDZH_5_5.speaker: Lenore

yakita:YYYHZG_10_16.text: You tell Lenore about the two times you saw the white phantoms.
yakita:YYYHZG_10_16.zh: 你将之前两次看见白色虚影的事情告诉了伊诺尔。

yakita:YYYHZG_10_17.text: So... you saw white phantoms lingering in Nimbus Sanctum, preaching blasphemous thoughts?
yakita:YYYHZG_10_17.zh: 徘徊于云海中的白色幻影，而且还在宣扬着一些亵渎的言论？
yakita:YYYHZG_10_17.speaker: Lenore

yakita:YYYHZG_17_12.text: Thank you, {Male=Mr.;Female=Ms.} 漂泊者! I swear by Lenore—the name given to me by His Holiness the Primus—that I will repay this kindness with all my heart.
yakita:YYYHZG_17_12.zh: 谢谢您，漂泊者大人！以主座赐予我的教名伊诺尔起誓，这份恩情我将用一生偿还。
yakita:YYYHZG_17_12.speaker: Lenore

yakita:YYYHZG_25_1.text: That must be the spot Lenore said the record would be. What are the Vitreum Dancers doing over there?
yakita:YYYHZG_25_1.zh: 伊诺尔提供的位置就是那吧，琉璃刀伶似乎正围着什么？
yakita:YYYHZG_25_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:YYYHZG_2_17.text: I will cross the treacherous Nimbus Sanctum, battle ferocious Tacet Discords... and, well, I may have to face the wrath of the Queen of the Night herself... Uhh...
yakita:YYYHZG_2_17.zh: 我必须穿越诡谲的云海！对抗凶恶的残象……呃，还有可能面对愤怒的夜之女皇……唔……
yakita:YYYHZG_2_17.speaker: Lenore

yakita:YYYHZG_2_48.text: I'm Lenore, the dean of the Minor Forbidden Archive in the Order of the Deep. If I make it back alive today, please find me at the Minor Forbidden Archive. I'll do everything I can to repay you!
yakita:YYYHZG_2_48.zh: 我是隐海修会小禁书院的院长，伊诺尔。如果我今天能活着回来的话，请来小禁书院找我，我一定会尽我所能报答您！
yakita:YYYHZG_2_48.speaker: Lenore

yakita:lmzx_16_26.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_7_5
yakita:lmzx_16_26.text: Haha, the Phoebe I know wouldn't care about such things!
yakita:lmzx_16_26.zh: 哈哈，菲比才不会在乎这些呢！
yakita:lmzx_16_26.speaker: Lenore

yakita:lmzx_22_1.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_4_3
yakita:lmzx_22_1.text: As you stroll through the celebration, Lenore steps onto the stage.
yakita:lmzx_22_1.zh: 就在你游览庆典时，伊诺尔跳上了舞台。

yakita:lmzx_22_4.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_4_3
yakita:lmzx_22_4.text: Hello everyone. My name is Lenore, and I'm an Acolyte of the Order of the Deep!
yakita:lmzx_22_4.zh: 大家好，我叫伊诺尔，我是隐海修会的一名教士！
yakita:lmzx_22_4.speaker: Lenore

yakita:lmzx_23_14.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_5_1
yakita:lmzx_23_14.text: Lenore places her hands together in prayer. A faint but steady warmth flows into your body, like a quiet tide of life itself.
yakita:lmzx_23_14.zh: 伊诺尔向你摆出虔诚祈祷的手势，你感觉一股微弱但是坚定的生机自你身体里散出。

yakita:lmzx_23_20.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_5_1
yakita:lmzx_23_20.text: Go to where your heart tells you. And do what you believe is right, Lenore.
yakita:lmzx_23_20.zh: 去你想去的地方，做你认为正确的事吧，伊诺尔。
yakita:lmzx_23_20.speaker: Rover

yakita:lmzx_4_27.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_2_3
yakita:lmzx_4_27.text: Black water spews from the ground before vanishing just as quickly. In its place stands a girl—Lenore.
yakita:lmzx_4_27.zh: 黑色的潮水自地下涌出又退去，一名少女出现在了那里——是伊诺尔。

yakita:lmzx_5_18.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_2_4
yakita:lmzx_5_18.text: Lenore, it was Rinascita's kindness that carried you this far. This journey deserves a better ending.
yakita:lmzx_5_18.zh: 伊诺尔，是黎那汐塔的善意陪伴你走到了今天。我想，这趟旅途值得一个更好的终点。
yakita:lmzx_5_18.speaker: Rover

yakita:lmzx_5_4.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_2_4
yakita:lmzx_5_4.text: Death is only another way of escaping reality, Lenore.
yakita:lmzx_5_4.zh: 死亡不过是换个方向的逃避，伊诺尔。

yakita:lmzx_6_4.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建七丘水下旧城_2_5
yakita:lmzx_6_4.text: Hello. I am an Acolyte of the Order, Lenore. Any harsh work or dirty job you have, do feel free to send them my way!
yakita:lmzx_6_4.zh: 您好，我是修会的教士伊诺尔，有什么脏活累活请随意使唤我！
yakita:lmzx_6_4.speaker: Lenore

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_52_1.text: Liam's stuffed toy sits quietly on the sofa, keeping its place. You hope that it, and Liam, can finally rest in peace.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_52_1.zh: 沙发上摆放着利亚姆的玩偶，它静静地坐在那里，你希望它，也希望利亚姆就此幸福地沉睡下去。

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_54_1.text:
[…]

To my ten-year-old Liam,

[…]

I will always be right there beside you, watching over you quietly, just like the moon.

[…]

"Mama still treats me like a little child."
Well, here's something you should know, sweetheart.

[…]
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_54_1.zh:
写给十岁的利亚姆：
恭喜你，利亚姆，你已经十岁了！我教给你的摇篮曲，学会了吗？学会的话，也不要太骄傲哦，接下来你还有许多许多曲子要学习，而且一定会吹得越来越好，总有一天，会比妈妈我还厉害呢。
对了，十岁的小男子汉，要开始习惯一个人睡觉了。妈妈会永远在你身边，像月亮一样安安静静地守着你。

写给二十岁的利亚姆：
利亚姆，生日快乐。从今天起，你就是个二十岁的小伙子了。我猜，你是不是已经有喜欢的女孩子了呢？虽然妈妈我没法给你恋爱的建议，但无论对方是谁，妈妈都会支持你。

写给三十岁的利亚姆：
利亚姆，现在，你已经是三十岁的大人了。和喜欢的女孩子结婚了吗？又或者说……已经当上爸爸了！
如果是利亚姆的孩子，一定继承了你的可爱吧，不过可千万别继承你的调皮哦。读到这里，你八成又在心里笑着想：妈妈怎么还把我当小孩子。可妈妈想告诉你，你永远是我的孩子，无论你是十岁、二十岁、三十岁……妈妈对你的爱永远不会消失。

写给四十岁的利亚姆：
亲爱的利亚姆，真快呀，一转眼，你的年纪都已经比妈妈大了。
从十岁、二十岁、三十岁，一路努力走到现在，你真的很了不起。所以，请你把现在感受到的幸福好好收在心里，今天、明天，往后的每一天，都带着这份心情活下去，去尽情享受属于你的人生吧。
…………
…………
写给利亚姆最后一封信：
虽然很不想这样说，但读这封信的时候，你的生命大概要走到尽头了。恭喜你，我亲爱的孩子，你度过了很充实、很完整的一生。面对死亡，你现在一定很害怕吧，妈妈知道那种感受，也恨自己不能赶到你身边，不能像小时候那样，在你痛苦时坐在床边，握住你的手。妈妈唯一能做的，只有通过这些文字告诉你：不要害怕，孩子，我们就把死亡当做另一段旅程的起点。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_102_2.text: {PlayerName}, unlike Liam's dreamland, you're experiencing this one directly through its owner's eyes.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_102_2.zh: {PlayerName}，与利亚姆的幻梦不同，这次你直接扮演的是幻梦的主人。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_102_2.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_20.text: If I see Liam again, do you reckon he'll be angry with me? For lying to him all this time?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_20.zh: 但如果再见到利亚姆，你说他会不会生气我骗了他？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_20.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_38.text: Now that I think about it, is it really a lullaby? The first time I heard him play it on the train, there was a hint of sadness in it.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_38.zh: 说起来，那真的是摇篮曲吗？在列车上，我第一次听利亚姆吹响时，能感觉到它藏着一丝悲伤。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_38.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_165_5.text: Don't you worry. I'll help you find Liam. I promise.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_165_5.zh: 放心，我一定会帮你找到利亚姆的，我一定会的……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_165_5.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_171_1.text: Still waiting for the person sent to pick you up, Liam?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_171_1.zh: 今天也在等那个来接你的人吗，利亚姆？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_171_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_171_8.text: I'll let you be for now, Liam. I'll see you tomorrow.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_171_8.zh: 利亚姆，姐姐不打扰你了，明天见。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_171_8.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_172_1.text: Why have I become like this? The moment Liam reached out for a hug, my first instinct...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_172_1.zh: 我怎么会变成这样？刚刚利亚姆想拥抱我时，我的第一反应……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_172_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_203_40.text: And! I dreamed I grew up! But somehow, when I woke, I was still little...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_203_40.zh: 对了！我还梦到自己长大了，但不知道为什么，醒来后我还是小小的……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_203_40.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_203_7.text: That's right, Miss Lily! I heard Mama playing the harmonica again! I threw myself right into her arms, and she held me for a long, long time!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_203_7.zh: 是啊，莉莉姐姐！我又听到妈妈的口琴声了，我还扑倒在妈妈的怀里撒娇，度过了好长好长的时间。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_203_7.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_36_13.text: I don't know. All I know is this train is taking me to my mama. Can't remember much else.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_36_13.zh: 不知道，我只知道这辆列车能带我去找到妈妈，其他我什么都想不起来。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_36_13.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_36_3.text: Oh. Guess it isn't this stop, either. Then it must be the next one. That's alright. Liam will be a good boy and wait here.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_36_3.zh: 这样啊，这一站也没有，那一定就是在下一站。没关系，利亚姆会在这里一直等下去的。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_36_8.text: Lemme think... I've never really thought about it. I just know this is where I'll find my mama.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_36_8.zh: 我想想……我好像从来没有想过这个问题，我只知道这里是能够找到妈妈的地方。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_36_8.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_36_9.text: Sorry, {Male=mister;Female=ma'am}. I should keep looking for the person my mama sent. Goodbye.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_36_9.zh: {Male=大哥哥;Female=大姐姐}，我要继续去寻找妈妈派来接我的人了，再见。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_36_9.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_1.text: Miss Lily! Oh... and you too, {Male=mister;Female=ma'am}.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_1.zh: 莉莉姐姐，哇……还有刚上车的{Male=哥哥;Female=姐姐}。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_1.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_19.text: Mm. Ever since Liam came aboard, he's been standing at the door, asking every new passenger the same question...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_19.zh: 嗯，自从利亚姆上车以来，他就一直守在车门口，一遍遍地向上车的人询问——
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_19.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_26.text: Liam, you heard the broadcast. We've arrived at the "Station of the Lost." It's time to get off. Are you ready?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_26.zh: 利亚姆，你听见广播了吧，“迷途之站”已经到了，我们要准备下车了，你准备好了吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_26.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_27.text: Ready... Miss Lily, if I'm ready, will the person Mama sent to pick me up be there?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_27.zh: 准备……那莉莉姐姐，准备好了的话，妈妈派来接我的人就会来吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_27.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_51_1.text: I'm in... Liam's dreamland now. But they're not here. Did they go on ahead?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_51_1.zh: 这里……就是利亚姆的幻梦。他们不在这里，是先离开了吗？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_51_2.text: And no response. Is it because we're inside the dream? I need to find Lily and Liam.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_51_2.zh: 没有反应，是入梦的缘故吗？我得尽快找到莉莉和利亚姆。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_55_9.text: (They're seeing someone else. Different clothes, different voice. Is it because everything in this dreamland is woven from Liam's frequency?)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_55_9.zh: （服饰和声音在他人眼中都变了另一个人吗？难道是因为幻梦的本质是利亚姆的频率……）

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_12.text: Hugs and cheek-rubs! Yes! Mama's hands are so warm.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_12.zh: 拥抱、揉脸，没错，妈妈的手掌十分温暖。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_12.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_17.text: After every battle, she'd treat us just like she treated you, Liam. She'd smile at us. Reach out and take our faces in her hands...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_17.zh: 每次战斗结束后，她就会像对待小利亚姆一样，对我们投以笑容，用双手托起我们的脸……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_19.text: Then... are you the one Mama sent to pick me up?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_19.zh: 那姐姐你就是妈妈派来接我的人吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_19.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_22.text: I just boarded. Still gotta report to my new unit. I should go, but I hope you do find your mama. Goodbye, Liam.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_22.zh: 姐姐刚上车，还没去新队伍报到，我得走了。希望你能找到你的妈妈，再见了，利亚姆。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_25.text: The ones who're always pushing the soldiers around.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_25.zh: 就是那群喜欢对战士哥哥、战士姐姐们指手画脚的人啊。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_25.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_26.text: You're the one who told me that if I ever saw them on the train, I'd better hide right away.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_26.zh: 这还是你告诉我的，你告诉我在列车上遇见他们一定要躲起来。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_26.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_27.text: Good job, Liam. That was just a test to make sure you remembered what I taught you.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_27.zh: 嗯，利亚姆真棒，刚刚乘务员{Male=哥哥;Female=姐姐}只是在考验你哦，有没有好好听话。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_28.text: They wear real clean clothes and spray weird stuff on themselves. I hate that smell. Makes the carriage all stinky.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_28.zh: 他们总是穿得干干净净，还会喷很多莫名其妙的东西在身上，我不喜欢那个味道，弄得车厢老是臭臭的。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_28.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_4.text: I didn't mean to scare you! Some bad people came by, this soldier lady and I hid.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_4.zh: 我不是故意吓你的，刚刚有一群坏人路过，所以我和这位战士姐姐先藏了起来。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_57_4.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_58_1.text: C'mon, {Male=mister;Female=ma'am}. Let's go find more nice soldier ladies and fellas to ask!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_58_1.zh: 乘务员{Male=哥哥;Female=姐姐}，我们再问问其他战士叔叔和战士阿姨吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_58_1.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_58_2.text: Hold on, Liam. Those bad people could show up again any minute.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_58_2.zh: 等一下，利亚姆，那群坏人不知道什么时候又会出现。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_58_4.text: Uh... okay then. I'll be good and wait right here. But come back quick, kay?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_58_4.zh: 唔……那好吧，我会乖乖在这里等你的，乘务员{Male=哥哥;Female=姐姐}快点儿回来哦。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_58_4.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_59_1.text: There's nobody here we can ask? Well shucks, {Male=mister;Female=ma'am}. Will you keep looking with me?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_59_1.zh: 这里也没有我要找的人吗？乘务员{Male=哥哥;Female=姐姐}你要继续和我一起去找吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_59_1.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_10.text: Oh, Liam. The handyman gentleman on board did you a favor and fixed your harmonica. Better take good care of it this time.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_10.zh: 对了，利亚姆。你的口琴，车上的工匠叔叔帮你修好了，这次可要好好保管哦。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_11.text: A story? That's odd... Anyway! Look, this harmonica was a birthday gift from my mama!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_11.zh: 故事？奇奇怪怪……算了，你们看，这支口琴其实是妈妈送给我的生日礼物。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_11.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_12.text: I've just gotten the hang of it though... Do you think, when the game's over, I can still surprise her with it?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_12.zh: 直到现在，我才慢慢掌握。你们说，等到游戏结束时，我是不是还能给妈妈一个惊喜？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_12.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_19.text: Shh! Don't talk so loud about secret things! Okay, after Mama left, she called me on the telephone one time.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_19.zh: 嘘……你既然知道是秘密就不要那么大声了。其实妈妈在离开后，给我打了一通电话。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_19.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_20.text: Really? But you've never played a game like this one. After Mama left, she called me on the telephone one time.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_20.zh: 是吗？但你一定没玩过这样的游戏。妈妈在离开后曾给我打过一通电话。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_20.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_22.text: I asked her when she was coming back. She said she wasn't, 'cause she was getting ready for a surprise. The biggest game of hide-and-seek ever.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_22.zh: 我问妈妈什么时候回来。她说没回来，是在为我准备惊喜：一场史上规模最大的捉迷藏。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_22.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_23.text: "Liam, the game starts now. You hide, and everyone wearing the same clothes as Mama is the seeker. You've got to stay hidden, alright?"
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_23.zh: “利亚姆，游戏现在开始。由你扮人，所有穿妈妈衣服一样的人扮鬼，你可要藏好哦。”

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_25.text: "Wow! But what if you never find me? When does the game end?"
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_25.zh: “哇！那要是妈妈你们一直找不到我该怎么办，游戏什么时候结束呢？”
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_25.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_26.text: "My little Liam, when you no longer hear the rumbling overhead, and when you can fall asleep without humming Mama's lullaby..."
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_26.zh: “我的小利亚姆，当你不再听见头顶轰隆隆的声音，当每晚你不再需要哼唱妈妈教给你的歌谣就能入睡。”

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_30.text: I'm tired of hide-and-seek. It's not fun anymore. I just want my mama.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_30.zh: 可捉迷藏……我腻了，这样的游戏一点都不好玩，我只想要妈妈。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_30.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_35.text: I'm not scared of anything if it means finding my mama. Besides, I got this harmonica to keep me company.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_35.zh: 只要能找到妈妈，我什么都不怕，而且……有这支口琴在路上陪着我。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_35.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_36.text: You've already figured it out, haven't you? This hide-and-seek game was always just a lie.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_36.zh: 你已经意识到了吧。利亚姆口中的捉迷藏只是他妈妈留下的一个谎言。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_45.text: Miss Lily... There's still time today to go with the nice Attendant {Male=gentleman;Female=lady} to keep looking for the person Mama sent!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_45.zh: 莉莉姐姐……今天还有点时间，我就和乘务员{Male=哥哥;Female=姐姐}继续去找接我的人了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_45.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_50.text: Lily, I think I understand the situation now. I'm playing the Attendant from Liam's memory, and you're playing a soldier.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_50.zh: 莉莉，我大概理解了现状，我扮演的是利亚姆记忆中的乘务员，而你扮演的是战士。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_54.text: What, what? What's the secret? I wanna hear too!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_54.zh: 什么，什么，你们在聊什么悄悄话？我也要听！
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_54.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_57.text: (Unless this Lily really existed in Liam's memory. Could they have met before?)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_57.zh: （难道眼前的莉莉是利亚姆记忆中本身就存在的，他们在过去已经见过面了？）

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_6.text: No, no! I just ran into {Male=him;Female=her} in the lounge and asked for help finding clues about my mama.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_6.zh: 没有没有，我是在大厅偶遇到乘务员{Male=哥哥;Female=姐姐}，然后才拜托{TA}帮忙寻找与妈妈有关的线索。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_6.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_68.text: But I never got to learn the tune she tried to teach me before she left.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_68.zh: 不过到妈妈离开前，我都没学会她教我的摇篮曲。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_68.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_73.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束2_24_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_73.text:
You and Liam continue searching for clues about his mother. In a passenger carriage, you find Lily seated in a room, dressed in her military medic's uniform. Liam seems to recognize her. She hands him a harmonica and tells him to take good care of it. Assuming Lily is playing a role just as you are, you lean closer and quietly ask what you should do next. She looks at you in confusion, however, prompting you to reconsider. If she were merely playing a part, why would she have changed into a specific uniform? Perhaps Lily is part of Liam's actual memories, and the two met long ago. 

Liam reveals that the harmonica was a birthday gift from his mother and that he has finally learned to play the lullaby she left him. During your conversation, he accidentally lets slip something about a game. Lily assures him that he can trust you, playing the role of a train attendant, and Liam recounts the last game he played with his mother. By the end of his story, you and Lily realize that the game was built around a lie his mother had told him.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_73.zh: 你带着利亚姆，继续寻找与他妈妈有关的线索。你们来到一间客房车厢，身着军医服饰的莉莉坐在房间内。利亚姆似乎认识她。莉莉将一支口琴交给了利亚姆，并嘱咐他要好好保管。你第一反应是莉莉也和你一样，在扮演着某种角色。于是你凑到她身旁，小声说着我们下一步该怎么做。可莉莉却一脸疑惑地看着你。你才意识到如果是角色扮演，莉莉根本没有必要换上特定的服饰。也许莉莉是利亚姆记忆中本身就存在的，他们在过去已经见过面了。利亚姆说这支口琴是妈妈送给自己的生日礼物，而自己现在终于学会了妈妈留下的那首摇篮曲。在与利亚姆的交谈中，他口误，提到了一场游戏。莉莉告诉利亚姆可以相信你扮演的乘务员，于是利亚姆将自己和妈妈的游戏告诉给了你。听完后，你和莉莉都明白那是他母亲留下的一个谎言。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_65_1.text: Miss Lily, y-you're going? But I don't want you to.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_65_1.zh: 莉莉姐姐，你要下车了吗？好舍不得你。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_65_1.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_65_14.text: No. If you're going to carry on this lie, you have to believe they'll do the same and trust them. Just like Liam and I have trusted you.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_65_14.zh: 不，既然要延续谎言，你就必须选择相信他们，就像我和利亚姆一直以来相信你一样。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_65_16.text: Attendant, I have to go now. Keep Liam hidden. Let him win this game.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_65_16.zh: 乘务员{Male=先生;Female=小姐}，我该走了，请让利亚姆藏到最后，赢下这场游戏吧。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_65_9.text: I hope you can get all the soldiers on the same page. And find a chance to let Liam off safely at the right stop.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_65_9.zh: 我希望你能把这个谎言告诉给上车的每一位战士，并找机会让利亚姆在安全的站点下车。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_67_1.text: Liam, stop staring out the window. Let's go back to our compartment.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_67_1.zh: 利亚姆，不要盯着窗外看了，我们回房间吧。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_67_8.text: This is the Sixth Sector, Liam. The train didn't stop at the Fifth this time.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_67_8.zh: 利亚姆，这里是第六战区哦，这次列车没有在第五战区停靠。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_71_2.text: {Male=Mister;Female=Madam} Attendant, do they have to get off?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_71_2.zh: 乘务员{Male=哥哥;Female=姐姐}，他们非得下车吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_71_2.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_71_6.text: Then Miss Lily, and all the nice soldiers.... and Mama... have you all already...?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_71_6.zh: 那莉莉姐姐、战士叔叔和战士阿姨们，还有……妈妈，你们是不是已经……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_71_6.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_15.text: Liam, do you hate this world you're living in?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_15.zh: 利亚姆，你讨厌你所处的世界吗？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_16.text: Yes! I hate waking up to a gray sky. Oh, and I hate walking through the streets and smelling that awful burning smell!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_16.zh: 讨厌！我讨厌起床就看到灰蒙蒙的天空，还有还有，我讨厌走在路上，闻到那股臭烘烘的烧焦味道。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_16.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_23.text: Yeah... {Male=Mister;Female=Madam} Attendant. I... I think I understand.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_23.zh: 嗯，乘务员{Male=哥哥;Female=姐姐}，我……我明白了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_23.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_24.text: Um, I'm still a little scared. Will you count down with me?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_24.zh: 乘务员{Male=哥哥;Female=姐姐}，我还是有些害怕，你能和我一起倒数吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_24.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_25.text: Let's pretend it's the countdown to the end of hide-and-seek. Doesn't matter what's behind that door, I just want this game to be over...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_25.zh: 就把这几个数字当作捉迷藏游戏结束的倒计时，无论门背后是什么，我都想把这场游戏结束了……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_25.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_28.text: That's... that's the song Mama used to play...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_28.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_32.text: I did work hard. I didn't let the people in uniforms find me. I did everything you said.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_32.zh: 嗯，利亚姆很努力了，没有让街上穿制服的人找到我。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_32.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_33.text: But, but... I don't wanna play this game anymore. It's gone on too long.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_33.zh: 但，但……我不想继续这场游戏了，这场游戏太漫长了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_33.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_34.text: I hate counting numbers that never end. I hate falling asleep and dreaming about you. I... want to lose the game. I want you to find me.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_34.zh: 我讨厌怎么也数不完的数字，我害怕睡着以后梦见妈妈。我……想输掉游戏，被你找到。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_34.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_35.text: It's okay. The game is over now. Because you came to me. I found you, Liam. You lose.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_35.zh: 没关系，游戏结束了哦，因为你不是出现在妈妈面前了吗？我，找到你了，利亚姆你输了。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_36.text: Yeah, I lose. I lose, Mama. Let's go home... the game... it's finally over...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_36.zh: 是啊，妈妈我输了，是我输了，我们回家吧……游戏……终于结束了……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_36.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_47.text: Yeah. Miss Lily said I should always listen to the nice Attendant {Male=gentleman;Female=lady}.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_47.zh: 嗯，莉莉姐姐说过，在列车上我要好好听乘务员{Male=哥哥;Female=姐姐}的话。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_47.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_49.text: ...A door? It really is. But why... why did it show up again right in front of me?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_49.zh: ……门，真的诶，门就在这里。可为什么，为什么它重新出现在了我面前？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_49.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_7.text: I'm scared that the person I've been looking for isn't here anymore. So... guess that makes me a coward, doesn't it?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_7.zh: 我害怕我一直在找的人已经不在了。所以……乘务员{Male=哥哥;Female=姐姐}，我是个胆小鬼，对吧？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_7.speaker: Liam

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_13.text: I'm fine. We're awake now, right? How's Liam?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_13.zh: 我没事，我们已经从梦中醒来了吗，利亚姆怎么样了？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_14.text: Don't worry. Liam... he's already found his way home.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_14.zh: 别担心，利亚姆他……已经找到回家的路了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_14.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_19.text: You did well. The first time I saw Liam, I recognized him as the boy I'd looked after before.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_19.zh: 你已经做得很好了。我第一次见到利亚姆时，就认出来他是我过去照顾的孩子。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_19.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_21.text: I think he was happy in the end. Thank you for giving him a good dream.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_21.zh: 我想利亚姆在最后是开心的，谢谢你给了他一个好梦。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_22.text: You're the one who should be thanked. And Liam himself. {PlayerName}, you played the Attendant every step of the way and led him to that door.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_22.zh: 最应该感谢的是你，和利亚姆他自己。{PlayerName}，是你努力扮演乘务员一步步将他带到了门前。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_22.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_24.text: Liam was a brave boy. He pushed that door open himself and ended that long game.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_24.zh: 利亚姆是个好孩子，是他自己主动推开门，结束了这场漫长的游戏。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_24.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_26.text: I'll join you in a bit. I need to take Liam's lily back to the conservatory first. See you soon.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_26.zh: 稍后我也会去，我先把利亚姆化作的百合花带回花房，我们待会儿见。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_26.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_27.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束2_33_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_27.text:
After helping Liam's soul find peace, you return to the train. Lily thanks you for your help and reveals that she knew Liam when he was alive. Unable to accept his mother's death, he had trapped himself in their game of hide-and-seek rather than face the truth. All Lily could do was weave a dream in which she took his mother's place, allowing him to see her one last time. 

Another announcement signals dinner time, and Lily asks you to head to the Lounge Carriage ahead of her.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_27.zh: 安息利亚姆的灵魂后，你们回到了列车上。莉莉感谢你的帮忙，她坦白自己过去与利亚姆见过。莉莉明白利亚姆的心结在于他没有勇气面对母亲已经离世的事实，所以一直将自己困在了捉迷藏游戏里。莉莉能做的只是编织幻梦，代替利亚姆的母亲与他见一面。广播再次响起，列车似乎到了晚餐时间，莉莉让你先行前往大厅车厢。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_43.text: My work log. See—"Day 727 in the world of the dead. I met a living person today. Together, we laid Liam's soul to rest."
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_43.zh: 工作日记，看——这是在亡魂世界的第727天，我遇见了一位生者，我们一同安息了利亚姆的灵魂。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_43.speaker: Lily

yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_14_2.text: Her and Watcher Liangyu together? Devastating. It's just a pity that... Ah.
yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_14_2.zh: 椋羽骑使和她的配合也非常默契，只可惜……哎。

yakita:StJCFYLQ_11_3.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_军策府和园林区配音生态_12_1
yakita:StJCFYLQ_11_3.text: I have to credit Watcher Liangyu for that. She made the training much more effective for me.
yakita:StJCFYLQ_11_3.zh: 先前受椋羽骑使指点，事半功倍呀！

yakita:YangYang_Shengtai_1_4.text: Liangyu offered us her house. She said we could stay as long as we need… I tried to turn her down, but she wouldn't hear it. So I ended up taking the keys.
yakita:YangYang_Shengtai_1_4.zh: 椋羽把她家的屋子腾了出来，说如果是我们的话，想住多久都可以……我怎么也劝不过，就只好把钥匙收下了。
yakita:YangYang_Shengtai_1_4.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:YangYang_Shengtai_1_6.text: Everyone here is eager to meet you. They're already planning a welcoming feast for when Liangyu gets out of the hospital.
yakita:YangYang_Shengtai_1_6.zh: 村子里的大家都很想认识你，还说等椋羽出院后，要一起办场接风宴招待你呢。
yakita:YangYang_Shengtai_1_6.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_130_2.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第一幕_衔翎村+战场生态_1_1
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_130_2.text: Liangyu said it herself. It has to be true...
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_130_2.zh: 椋羽都这么说了，应该是真的吧……

yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_140_6.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第一幕_衔翎村+战场生态_1_2
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_140_6.text: Just listen to Liangyu and the others for now...
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_140_6.zh: 现在还是乖乖听椋羽他们的吧……

yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_160_5.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第一幕_衔翎村+战场生态_1_4
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_160_5.text: I was one of the lucky ones. Liangyu got us out. But so many of our people... They...
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_160_5.zh: 我都还算好的，椋羽带着我们冲了出去……但很多弟兄姐妹……都……

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_18.text: Yes. My name is Liangyu, and I serve under Mengzhou's Ministry of War, as part of the Xuan Triad. But now, I'm the only one left...
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_18.zh: ……我叫椋羽，梦州玄方城军策府下属后玄三骑——话是这么说，如今后玄三骑，也只剩我一个……
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_18.speaker: Liangyu

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_280_19.text: Watcher Liangyu! Someone's fighting the Autopuppets over there!
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_280_19.zh: 椋羽骑使——那边有人在和机傀交战——！

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_291_20.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_玄方城_秧秧_2_1_28
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_291_20.text: After exchanging information with Liangyu, Yangyang volunteers to help the Xuanfang Wardens evacuate the villagers to safety.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_291_20.zh: 在与椋羽简短交换情报之后，秧秧主动请求协助定玄卫们，带领村民撤离到安全的地方。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_294_23.text: Liangyu gives Yangyang a brief account of events.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_294_23.zh: 椋羽简单地向秧秧讲述了事件的经过。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_300_14.text: (Come to think of it, it was this little thing that led Liangyu and the Wardens to my aid before.)
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_300_14.zh: （说起来……之前它也引了椋羽他们来帮我……）
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_300_14.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_302_22.text: He... he's been missing ever since Liangyu came back...
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_302_22.zh: 他……从椋羽回来后就不见了……

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_12.text: A leader cannot afford to show weakness before the ranks. Liangyu is too proud for that. She will only bury it inside.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_12.zh: 领兵之人，不可在将士面前露怯。椋羽性格要强，恐怕只会把这些心绪咽进肚里。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_19.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_玄方城_秧秧_2_1_5
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_19.text: A Xuanfang Warden named Yanlang confides that Liangyu recently lost two comrades to Autopuppet ambushes. Out of concern, he asks Yangyang to keep an eye on Liangyu.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_19.zh: 在与定玄卫颜朗的交谈中，秧秧得知椋羽的两名战友皆在不久前死于机傀的袭击中，颜朗出于对晚辈的关心，希望秧秧能够对她施以关照。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_6.text: But now the Autopuppets have turned on us, the Paragon is trapped in a Censure Court, and of the Triad, only Liangyu remains... Even if we retreat to the Hold, we still will not be able to stop what's coming.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_6.zh: 但现在，机傀倒戈，镇玄司骑被困在咎庭，后玄三骑也只剩下椋羽一人……说实话，即便退守玄方城，我们也根本拦不住机傀和残象的攻势。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_9.text: If you are willing, comrade, do us one favor. Look after Liangyu.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_310_9.zh: 这位袍泽，如果你愿意，还请替我们关照一下椋羽的情况。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_315_2.text: (His sister must've been in Liangyu's unit...)
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_315_2.zh: （他的姐姐……应该就是椋羽的队友……）
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_315_2.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_19.text: You... you were the one speaking with Liangyu earlier.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_19.zh: 您是……刚才与椋羽说话的那位……
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_19.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_20.text: Yes. I am Qiankun, the village chief. I have watched over Liangyu since she was just a child.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_20.zh: 嗯……老拙是衔翎村的村长，椋羽那孩子算是老拙看着长大的。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_322_36.text: Would you do an old man a favor? Take this sword and pass it to Liangyu. Let the Wardens carry it back to the Hold.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_322_36.zh: 不知姑娘可否帮老拙一个忙，取下这把剑，将它交予椋羽，让定玄卫们把剑带到玄方城？

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_340_1.text: (The Chief was right... I should go talk to Liangyu.)
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_340_1.zh: （按村长先生说的，去找椋羽聊聊吧。）
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_340_1.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_345_18.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_玄方城_秧秧_2_1_26
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_345_18.text: Yangyang presents the blade to Liangyu and relays the chief's wish. Overwhelmed by anxiety, Liangyu refuses to take it, so Yangyang decides to keep it for now. Seeing how disheartened Liangyu is by the loss of her comrades, Yangyang steps in to comfort her.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_345_18.zh: 秧秧带着长剑找到了椋羽，并告诉了她村长的意愿。由于椋羽因焦虑拒绝了保管剑的请求，秧秧便决定代为保管。见此时的椋羽正因战友的死伤处于失落之中，秧秧决定同她谈一谈……

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_35.text: Was that how you all felt, too? During the Battle of Norfall Barrens?
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_35.zh: ……在那场北落野之役里，你们也是这么想的吗？
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_35.speaker: Liangyu

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_66.text: But Liangyu, we're soldiers. We have our duties. This is no time to indulge ourselves.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_66.zh: 但是椋羽，我们是军人，我们有职责在身，不能在这种时候任性。
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_66.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_67.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_玄方城_秧秧_2_1_26
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_67.text: Yangyang comforts Liangyu with a few gentle words and sings a song she heard from Liangyu earlier to ease the tense, suffocating atmosphere hanging over the village.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_350_67.zh: 秧秧用简短的话语稳定了椋羽的情绪，并唱起了她先前从椋羽口中听到的歌谣。村子内原本紧张压抑的氛围被秧秧的歌声冲淡了不少。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_355_57.text: Watcher Liangyu, a Skywatch Ring has detected Autopuppets moving this way. They will reach Xianling Village in about two hours.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_355_57.zh: 椋羽骑使，「巡霄环」监测到有机傀正往这里行进，预计再有两个小时就会抵达衔翎村。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_400_2.text: (That must be the garrison camp Liangyu mentioned.)
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_400_2.zh: （应该就是椋羽提到的营地吧。）
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_400_2.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_410_3.text: So Watcher Liangyu sent you to map a route. Good! We've been waiting a long time.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_410_3.zh: 原来如此……椋羽骑使派你来测绘路线，太好了，终于等到了。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_410_6.text: No time to lose. We must send word to Liangyu immediately.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_410_6.zh: ……事不宜迟，我们现在就立刻通知椋羽骑使。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_16.text: Watcher Liangyu! The Hold is answering our signal!
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_16.zh: 椋羽骑使！城内有回应了！

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_17.text: Liangyu, one of us has to stay behind to hold them off...
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_17.zh: 椋羽小妹，看样子，我们中得有人留下来断后啊……

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_18.text: Liangyu, you are our captain now. Don't lose sight of that.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_18.zh: 椋羽，现在你是这里的指挥官，别忘了你肩上的职责。
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_440_18.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_460_6.text: Heh... Now you sound... just like... little Liangyu.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_460_6.zh: 呵呵……你怎么跟……椋羽小妹……说一样的话……

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_510_24.text: Zhuojun Atelier... Liangyu mentioned them... a Mengzhou organization devoted to the mechanist arts.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_510_24.zh: 琢钧堂……椋羽提到过……那是梦州的机关术组织……
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_510_24.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_37.text: I'm... I'm alright. Liangyu, the civilians... did everyone make it back to the city?
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_37.zh: 嗯……嗯……我没事，椋羽，大家都平安撤回城里了吗？
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_37.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_39.text: (I didn't see Yanlang and Mingyu. I fear they have...)
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_39.zh: （没看到颜朗和明煜的身影，恐怕他们已经……）
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_39.speaker: Liangyu

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_55.text: Liangyu contacts the nearby Xuanfang Wardens. After arranging for the civilians to be escorted to safety, you prepare to head toward Xuanfang Hold.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_121_55.zh: 椋羽联系上了在附近驻扎的定玄卫，众人安排完护送平民的事宜后，准备前往玄方城。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_1_5.text: A factory in the Western Fang Peaks. It is where Xuanfang Hold produces its Autopuppets and "disposes" of Tacet Discords.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_1_5.zh: 那里是位于方擎西峰的工厂，玄方城生产机傀，以及「销毁」残象的地方。
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_1_5.speaker: Liangyu

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_28.text: Let's find Liangyu and the Warden Commander. Maybe they can help us make sense of these leads.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_28.zh: 带着这些线索去找椋羽和定玄卫长吧，说不定他们听了之后，能有一些新的头绪。
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_28.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_31.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_玄方城_决战_4_1_1
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_31.text: You, Yangyang, and Suisui exchange the intel you have gathered. Piecing the clues together, Suisui believes that Zhuojun Atelier, a prominent Automata Mechanics organization based in Mengzhou, is heavily implicated. To gather more evidence, you seek out the Warden Commander and Liangyu.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_31.zh: 你与秧秧、穗穗各自交换了取得的信息。结合已有的情报，穗穗认为扎根于梦州的机关术组织——琢钧堂有着重大嫌疑，为了取得更多的线索，你们决定去寻找定玄卫长与椋羽。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_290_7.text: ...You three must be the ones Liangyu spoke of. In these desperate hours, your willingness to stand with us is a comfort beyond words. I, Qiuhong, owe you a debt!
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_290_7.zh: ……三位想必就是椋羽提到的协助者了。如今玄方城战情窘迫，三位的义举无异于雪中送炭，秋鸿感激不尽！

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_290_8.text: Commander Qiuhong, there are things we need to discuss with you and Liangyu.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_290_8.zh: 秋鸿卫长，我们有些事想与您和椋羽商议。
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_290_8.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_313_30.text: I brought back the blade you entrusted to Liangyu. There was... some trouble along the way, but I managed to keep it safe.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_313_30.zh: 对了，您让椋羽保管的这柄剑……虽然途中经过了一些波折，不过我完好地带回来了。
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_313_30.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_10.text: (She's the one I saw in those memories. She and Liangyu... Could it be...)
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_10.zh: （她……就是之前在记忆里看到的那位……难道说……她是椋羽的……）
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_10.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_46.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_5_玄方城_决战_4_4_2
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_46.text: Inside the Sonoro Sphere, you see the memories of Lingfang, Liangyu's ancestor from two hundred years ago. Her husband had been killed by Tacet Discords, and she was about to march onto the battlefield. Before departing, she sang the familiar song once more as a thank-you to Yangyang for comforting her.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_46.zh: 在索诺拉中，你与秧秧见到了椋羽两百年前的祖先——铃坊。铃坊的丈夫被残象所杀，而她此刻也即将要踏上战场。临行之际，为感谢秧秧对她的宽慰，铃坊再度唱起了那首熟悉的歌谣……

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_8.text: Liangyu? Liang... Yu... Hmm. A beautiful name, but it is not mine.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_8.zh: 椋羽？椋……羽……真不错，念起来很好听。可惜，我不叫这个名字。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_480_49.text: Yangyang, would you be willing to serve as a Xuan Watcher during this time? I believe Liangyu would be happy to hear it.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_480_49.zh: 秧秧，可否请你在这段时间，出任后玄骑使一职？我想，椋羽应该也很乐意听到这个消息。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_340_19.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_6_神宫幻境_45_1
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_340_19.text: Conditions around Xuanfang Hold continue to worsen: more Censure Courts have gone dark, and Tacet Discord hordes are closing in. As Yangyang rallies the vanguard troops before battle in her new role as Xuan Watcher, Liangyu returns, recovered and ready to fight alongside her. Together with the soldiers, they prepare to meet the oncoming hordes.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_340_19.zh: 玄方城周边的情况正在恶化，更多的咎庭停摆了，残象潮在逼近玄方城。秧秧以后玄骑使的身份给担任先锋的将士们做了战前动员。此时椋羽伤愈归来，准备与秧秧并肩作战。她们与将士们即将迎战来袭的残象潮。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1372_2.text: Liangyu told me you went into the Sanctum with that Ministry of Sentinel Affairs Intendant... Are you all right?
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_1372_2.zh: 听椋羽说，你已经和谛天鉴的那位州监进入了神宫……一切还好吗？

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_23_2.text: Watcher Liangyu... The way you carry yourself reminds me of an old friend.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_23_2.zh: 椋羽骑使……身形气质，确有故人之姿。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_23_2.speaker: Suoming

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_26.text: It seems... that "time" is now. Watcher Liangyu, kindly let her through.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_26.zh: 看来……那个“时机”就是现在了，椋羽骑使，还请放行。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_24_26.speaker: Qingxiao

yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_110_5.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_主线差分配音_8_3
yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_110_5.text: All I know is Ms. Liangyu rarely comes back to the village after she became one....
yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_110_5.zh: 椋羽姐姐当了定玄卫后，就很少回村子里了……

yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_560_5.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_主线差分配音_5_10
yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_560_5.text: Between being short-handed, losing Duzhong and Qingzhi, and Liangyu still being on the mend, the Commander is bound to be on edge. He's just not showing it, that's all.
yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_560_5.zh: 现在人手短缺，杜仲大哥和青枳大姐不在了，椋羽也还在养伤，卫长虽然没有表现，但心里应该也很不踏实吧。

yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_567_4.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_主线差分配音_4_7
yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_567_4.text: But... you knocked out most of the people from the Ministry of War all by yourself... Even Liangyu knows about it. She said once she's back on her feet, she absolutely wants to have a round with you!
yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_567_4.zh: 可是……你一个人把大半个军策府的人都打败了欸……这消息都传到椋羽骑使那去了，她说等养好了伤，一定要和你比试一场呢！

yakita:Side_DXZW_QE_12_10.chapter: 剧情_3_6_支线_定玄之外·其二_12_1
yakita:Side_DXZW_QE_12_10.text: There you are, Liangyu! I could use a quick favor.
yakita:Side_DXZW_QE_12_10.zh: 原来你在这儿啊！椋羽，我正有事要找你呢。

yakita:Side_DXZW_QE_12_18.chapter: 剧情_3_6_支线_定玄之外·其二_12_1
yakita:Side_DXZW_QE_12_18.text: Liangyu! 漂泊者! Dinner's ready! Hurry, come eat!
yakita:Side_DXZW_QE_12_18.zh: 椋羽姐，漂泊者{Male=哥哥;Female=姐姐}！饭好啦，你们快来吃饭！

yakita:Side_DXZW_QE_3_9.chapter: 剧情_3_6_支线_定玄之外·其二_3_1
yakita:Side_DXZW_QE_3_9.text: You need people for the rebuild? Count me in, Liangyu! I want to help, too!
yakita:Side_DXZW_QE_3_9.zh: 重建缺人？椋羽姐！我也要去帮忙！

yakita:Side_YJYAHXWJ_56_2.text: Miss Liangyu of the Xuan Triad mentioned that she granted you access to use the Skywatch Rings to interface with the Mingshen System.
yakita:Side_YJYAHXWJ_56_2.zh: 我听后玄三骑之中的椋羽小姐说，她已经为你开放了调用巡霄环，以及访问「明慎台」的权限。

yakita:Side_YJYAHXWJ_57_4.text: Miss Liangyu should've already granted you emergency access to the Mingshen System. I will formally authorize your credentials shortly.
yakita:Side_YJYAHXWJ_57_4.zh: 椋羽小姐应该已经为你开放了「明慎台」的紧急访问权限，我之后会为你进行正式授权。

yakita:ST_LL_1_1.text: ...It's you. Are you here for that rumor going around the Academy, too? Honestly, I reckon folks have spun it far past the truth.
yakita:ST_LL_1_1.zh: ……是你啊，你也是听学院那个传闻来的吗？老实说，我觉得大家的说法太夸张了。
yakita:ST_LL_1_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_1_10.text: Mm... I'll try. That was my promise to them, after all.
yakita:ST_LL_1_10.zh: 嗯……我会试试的，这也是我与他们的约定。
yakita:ST_LL_1_10.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_1_13.text: It's even lovelier than the Academy I saw in my dream. And that's all thanks to you and President Lucilla, of course.
yakita:ST_LL_1_13.zh: 比我梦中的那个学院还要美，当然，这也是多亏了你和洛瑟菈校长的帮忙。
yakita:ST_LL_1_13.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_1_14.text: Now, I get to sit in as an auditing student, and finally taste the school days I never had.
yakita:ST_LL_1_14.zh: 我才能以一个旁听生的身份，去体验未曾拥有的校园时光。
yakita:ST_LL_1_14.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_1_15.text: Chalk dust drifting down from the blackboard. The laughter of students heading home together when the day's done...
yakita:ST_LL_1_15.zh: 黑板上落下的粉笔灰，放学后，同学们结伴而行的笑声……
yakita:ST_LL_1_15.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_1_2.text: That a sincere prayer or a whispered worry to me will make a wish come true... I've no such magic in me. As for this outfit of mine...
yakita:ST_LL_1_2.zh: 向我虔诚地祈祷或是倾诉烦恼就能实现心愿，我没有那种神奇的力量啦，包括我穿的这套服饰……
yakita:ST_LL_1_2.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_1_21.text: But to the students here, I suppose it makes me look like an Acolyte. Still, perfumer or Acolyte... none of that matters.
yakita:ST_LL_1_21.zh: 不过大家似乎觉得这条裙子像教士的装扮，但无论是调香师，还是教士都没关系了……
yakita:ST_LL_1_21.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_1_22.text: As long as I can bring peace to others' hearts, that's more than enough for me.
yakita:ST_LL_1_22.zh: 只要能为他人带来心灵的抚慰，就够了。
yakita:ST_LL_1_22.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_2_10.text: ...Nothing wrong at all. Perhaps it was those cold eyes. At first she felt like a lost soul, drifting somewhere apart from everyone else.
yakita:ST_LL_2_10.zh: ……没有任何问题。也许是因为那双冰冷的眼睛，她给人的初印象，像是走丢的灵魂，游离在人群之外。
yakita:ST_LL_2_10.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_2_11.text: But deep down she holds a quiet, unbending strength. She knows, better than anyone, what she carries and what she has to protect.
yakita:ST_LL_2_11.zh: 但她的内心藏着一股坚韧的力量，比任何人都清楚自己背负的责任和必须守护的事物。
yakita:ST_LL_2_11.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_2_12.text: Honestly, I'd like to become as strong as she is.
yakita:ST_LL_2_12.zh: 老实说，我也想变得和她一样强大。
yakita:ST_LL_2_12.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_2_15.text: My first day as an auditing student, I was scared and thrilled all at once. I nearly lost my way at the foot of the stairs on my way in.
yakita:ST_LL_2_15.zh: 作为旁听生入学的第一天，我既害怕又兴奋，走进教学楼的时候，我差点在楼梯口迷路。
yakita:ST_LL_2_15.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_2_16.text: In class, Sigrika always slides her desk up beside mine, then lays her notes and books in the space between us to share.
yakita:ST_LL_2_16.zh: 上课时，西格莉卡同学总是会把课桌拼在我的桌旁，然后把笔记、课本放在两张桌子的中央。
yakita:ST_LL_2_16.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_2_17.text: The truth is, the formulas in the books, the theories on the board... none of them makes any sense to me.
yakita:ST_LL_2_17.zh: 其实……课本上的公式，课堂上讲的那些理论我都听不懂。
yakita:ST_LL_2_17.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_2_18.text: But just getting to sit here is happiness enough for me.
yakita:ST_LL_2_18.zh: 但我觉得坐在这里就已经是一种幸福了。
yakita:ST_LL_2_18.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_2_19.text: The future... I haven't thought that far yet. Living each day well... that's the whole of my wish for now.
yakita:ST_LL_2_19.zh: 未来的事……我还没有想太多，把当下的每一天过好，就是我现在最大的心愿。
yakita:ST_LL_2_19.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_2_22.text: Mm. In that dream, a shadowy figure took me to all these places, and we made such wonderful memories together.
yakita:ST_LL_2_22.zh: 嗯，在那个梦里，我和一个黑影去了这些地方，留下了美好的回忆。
yakita:ST_LL_2_22.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_2_23.text: I want to make everything from that dream real. And... {PlayerName}, if the chance ever comes, would you come along with me?
yakita:ST_LL_2_23.zh: 我想把梦里的一切变成现实，那个……{PlayerName}，如果有机会的话，你能陪我一起去吗？
yakita:ST_LL_2_23.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_2_24.text: You said you knew those places like the back of your hand.
yakita:ST_LL_2_24.zh: 你曾说过，你对那些地方很熟悉。
yakita:ST_LL_2_24.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_2_26.text: Somehow, whenever I talk with you, the time just slips clean away.
yakita:ST_LL_2_26.zh: 和你聊天，总会觉得时间过得特别快。
yakita:ST_LL_2_26.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_2_27.text: I know my days at Startorch Academy won't last. One day, I'll have to return to the New Federation.
yakita:ST_LL_2_27.zh: 我知道，星炬学院的生活，对我来说只是暂时的，总有一天，我还是会回到新联邦的。
yakita:ST_LL_2_27.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_2_28.text: But don't worry about me. Now, I've found the courage to face a homeland gone strange. It's the promise I made to those soldiers, and a road I mean to walk to its very end.
yakita:ST_LL_2_28.zh: 别担心，我已经有勇气去面对那片变得陌生的故土了。这是我和战士们的约定，也是我必须走完的路。
yakita:ST_LL_2_28.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_2_7.text: I did meet that Lady Miko once, the one the rumors say can grant wishes. President Lucilla brought her to me.
yakita:ST_LL_2_7.zh: 传闻中那位能实现愿望的巫女大人，我见过一次了，是洛瑟菈校长把她带到我面前的。
yakita:ST_LL_2_7.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_LL_2_8.text: It seemed the President wanted me to assess her state of mind.
yakita:ST_LL_2_8.zh: 校长似乎想让我诊断一下她的心理状况。
yakita:ST_LL_2_8.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_21_2.text: Miss Lily said that once we arrive, we'd have to return to our rooms and get ready. Should I be doing something now...?
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_21_2.zh: 莉莉小姐说过，到站后，要先回到自己的房间做好准备，我现在是不是应该……

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_34_1.text:

LB-3562            Seventh     Burns, insomnia, severe depression

Signed and confirmed: Lily
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_34_1.zh:
病员编号            所属战区               主要伤情
LB-2391            第三战区               枪伤，左前臂贯穿伤，心理出现对枪械的排斥反应
LB-3562            第七战区               烧伤，出现失眠，严重抑郁的症状
LB-9248            第二战区               轻度脑震荡，心理上出现对声响的严重排斥反应
LB-2584            第六战区               大腿骨折，易怒暴躁，出现严重抑郁的症状
签字确认：莉莉

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_38_1.text: Oh, Doctor Lily. What're you doing out at this hour?
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_38_1.zh: 噢，是莉莉医生。这么晚有什么事吗？

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_38_2.text: Mm-hmm. Just making my usual rounds. And giving "her" the day's report.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_38_2.zh: 嗯，和往常一样看看大家的情况，也向“她”汇报一下今天的工作。
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_38_2.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_38_5.text: Sigh... Lily, you're a psychotherapist. See if you can help her through it, too.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_38_5.zh: 唉，莉莉，你是精神科医生，你也多帮帮她。

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_38_7.text: I know. And thank you, all of you, for looking out for her.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_38_7.zh: 嗯，我明白，也谢谢你们对她的关心。
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_38_7.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_39_1.text: Doctor Lily, here to check on the wounded? They're being treated farther up. Just keep going.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_39_1.zh: 莉莉医生，是来检查伤员情况的吗？伤员今天都被安置在了前面，你再往前走走吧。

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_39_11.text: I... It's complicated. And there's no point in talking about it now.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_39_11.zh: 我……我来到前线的事很复杂，而且再谈论那些事情也没有意义了。
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_39_11.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_39_12.text: What I can tell you is that I absolutely did not come here because I support the war, no matter what the officers have said.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_39_12.zh: 我能告诉你的是，我绝不是像军官们宣传的那样，因为支持战争而来到这里。
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_39_12.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_39_13.text: My wish has never changed. I want all of you to make it out of this war alive.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_39_13.zh: 一直以来，我的愿望都没有改变，我希望你们都能活着走出这场战争。
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_39_13.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_39_4.text: ...You still don't care to talk to me, do you? There's something I've always wanted to ask. Why is it you dislike me?
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_39_4.zh: ……你还是老样子不愿和我多说一句话，其实我一直有个疑问，能告诉我，你为什么讨厌我吗？
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_39_4.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_39_6.text: Doctor Lily, I'd heard about you when I was stationed in another sector. Everyone spoke of the kind, beautiful "angel" at the Field Hospital.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_39_6.zh: 莉莉医生，我在其他战区时就听说过你，当时大家都在传战区医院里有个人美心善的“小天使”。

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_42_2.text: Wouldn't count on it. The enemy ain't a bunch of scarecrows... And just between you and me, we broke through once before. Doctor Lily can back me up on that.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_42_2.zh: 我看未必，敌人又不是木头人。悄悄告诉你们，我们之前曾推过去一次，莉莉医生可以为我作证。

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_42_3.text: ...Yes. But a week later, the enemy took the position right back.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_42_3.zh: ……嗯，但过了一周，那片阵地又被敌人夺回去了。
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_42_3.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_44_10.text: You're worried you're not doing enough? Here, look me in the eyes. You're already doing more than enough.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_44_10.zh: 你是担心自己没做好吗？来，看着我的眼睛，你已经做得够好了。
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_44_10.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_44_11.text: Think about it. No soldier has ever disliked you, have they? And no one has ever complained about you behind your back. You just need to trust yourself a little more.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_44_11.zh: 你想想看，没有战士讨厌过你吧，也没有战士在背后埋怨过你，你只是需要多一点自信。
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_44_11.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_44_12.text: That's important when you're caring for patients. If you have confidence in yourself, they'll find it easier to put their trust in you, too.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_44_12.zh: 在病人面前，这一点非常重要。只有这样，病人也才会给予你信任。
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_44_12.speaker: Lily

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_44_13.text: Confidence and trust... Right. I'll give it a try next time. Thank you, Doctor Lily.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_44_13.zh: 自信和信任……我明白了，下次我会试试看的，谢谢你，莉莉医生。

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_44_4.text: Doctor Lily, you came to check on the wounded, right? Don't worry. Everything's fine on my end today.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_44_4.zh: 莉莉医生是来了解伤员情况的吧，放心，今天我这边一切正常。

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_44_6.text: It's nothing. Actually, Doctor Lily, I was wondering if I could ask you a favor...
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_44_6.zh: 没有没有，对了，莉莉医生，我有个小请求，可不可以……

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_45_1.text: Doctor Lily, curfew's in effect. The area ahead is off-limits.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_45_1.zh: 莉莉医生，现在是宵禁时间，前面的区域禁止通行。

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_51_3.text: The Lily fan group? There are over 999 unread messages! Why's everyone spamming prayer-hand stickers?
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_51_3.zh: 莉莉粉丝群，群消息都999+了，大家怎么都在发祈祷的手势表情包？

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_51_4.text: You know the Miko legend in the Academy, don't you? Supposedly, praying to Lily works just like making a wish to the Miko. All your troubles disappear.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_51_4.zh: 你知道学院的巫女传说吧，就和向巫女许愿一样，据说向莉莉祈祷就能消除烦恼。

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_3.text: No. I came to thank you for stabilizing Lily's frequency, and for keeping that diary safe.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_3.zh: 不，我这次来，是为了感谢你，谢谢你稳定了莉莉的频率，也谢谢你保留了那本日记。

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_4.text: Thank me? I was only keeping my end of the deal. That diary... what is it, anyway? A piece of Lily's lost memories?
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_4.zh: 谢谢？我只是按照契约行事。日记本，那是什么东西？是莉莉丢失的记忆吗？
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_4.speaker: Meta

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_7.text: You tell Meta all about Lily's life at Startorch Academy. Every now and then, it yawns or stretches, putting on a rather unconvincing show of disinterest.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_7.zh: 你向梅塔讲述了莉莉在星炬学院暂住的生活趣事，祂偶尔打打哈欠，偶尔伸伸懒腰，装作不在意的样子。

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_9.text: Things are so much more interesting in the Somnoire... Never mind. I'll just have to hear all about it from Lily herself when she comes back.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_9.zh: 还是心之集域有趣……算了，等莉莉回来报告时，我再听听她自己的感受吧。
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_9.speaker: Meta

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_67_2.text: Maybe Lily is resting. Best not disturb her for now.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_67_2.zh: 也许莉莉在休息，还是先不要去打扰她了。

yakita:ItemInfo_42601650_BgDescription.text:
The petals of the Reverie Lily are as pure and flawless as moonlight. The slender flower sways and releases wisps of delicate fragrance with every gentle breeze that passes. The scent is not quite sweet but faintly bitter, like old dreams steeped in the night's dew. Those dreams hold a thousand unspoken words, yet the flower remains silent.
It stays rooted in the earth, lifting all its whiteness toward the heavens. A quiet compassion lives in that unblemished white, as though the flower has witnessed all the world's imperfections and still chooses, in the depths of night, to shine like a tiny "moon" for souls who have lost their way.
yakita:ItemInfo_42601650_BgDescription.zh:
绮梦百合的花瓣宛若月光洁白无瑕。每当微风拂过，它便摇曳着孱弱的身姿，送出缕缕幽香，那香气算不上甜，略略有些苦，像是被夜露浸透的旧梦，梦中有千言万语，但花终究保持着沉默。
它始终扎根在泥土里，把所有的洁白都举向高处。那份无瑕之白仿佛带着一种温柔的悲悯，仿佛看尽了世间的不完满，却仍愿意在黑夜里，为迷路的灵魂，亮一枚小小的“月亮”。

yakita:ItemInfo_80001062_BgDescription.text:
A snack Lily came up with on a whim as a child. It's simple to make: wash the lily petals, coat them in egg and breadcrumbs, and fry until golden brown. Sprinkle with a light dusting of sea salt, or serve with a side of honey for dipping.
"Mm, it tastes just like it did when I was little. The outside is crisp and golden, while the inside retains the lilies' delicate, slightly bitter sweetness. It's almost like..."
She trailed off, saying no more. A faint smile played on her lips, as though she were gently savoring a taste of those bygone days.
yakita:ItemInfo_80001062_BgDescription.zh:
莉莉小时候突发奇想制作的零食。做法简单，只需将百合花瓣清洗干净，裹上蛋液和面包糠，炸至金色捞出，再撒上薄薄一层的海盐，或配一碟蜂蜜蘸食。
“嗯，还是和小时候一样的味道，外层是酥脆的焦香，内里却锁住了百合那清幽微苦的甘甜，就好像……”
她没有继续说下去，只是淡淡一笑，就好像把那段回不去的时光轻轻含在了嘴里。

yakita:FavorGoods_151201_Content.text: The first perfume Lily ever got right. It was high summer, and she built it around lemon and citrus so that whoever opened the bottle would catch the sun at its strongest. Even on days when rain drummed against the windowpane, this scent would still fill the room with sunlight.
yakita:FavorGoods_151201_Content.zh: 莉莉制作成功的第一瓶香水。当时正值夏日，她特意选择了柠檬、柑橘等材料进行调香，希望给他人带来盛夏阳光的香气感受，即便窗外下着暴雨，但屋内装满了阳光。

yakita:FavorGoods_151202_Content.text: The working notebook from Lily's perfumery days. When the war broke out, it became a journal instead, and what it holds now are the soldiers she knew, the years spent among them, and a piece of New Federation history that must not be forgotten.
yakita:FavorGoods_151202_Content.zh: 莉莉调香时使用的工作手记，后来战争爆发，这本手记逐渐变成了她的工作日志，记录着她与战士们的故事，也记录着新联邦那段不容遗忘的历史。

yakita:FavorStory_151201_Content.text:
[…]

Lily's home."
The neighbours waved her over, and Lily, in her black-and-white dress, lifted the flowers from her basket one and two at a time and put them into their hands.

[…]

Some celebration in the city, maybe."
People put their heads out, had a look, and went back inside.

It was only afterward, long afterward, that Lily learned what it had been: the first shell of the war, on its way to her home.
yakita:FavorStory_151201_Content.zh:
“晚风把口琴声吹进云里；
夕阳在影子里渐去；
萤火虫提着灯笼在草丛里赶路；
数着星星直到它们都睡去……”
悠扬的歌声伴着轻盈的脚步穿过了街巷，歌声主人的影子斜斜地铺在石板上，被风吹得微微晃，仿佛那影子不是她的，是黄昏暂时借给她的。
“哟，是我们的花园里的小精灵，莉莉回来了。”
街巷的邻居向名为莉莉的女孩挥手招呼着，女孩身着黑白衣裙，从花篮里拿出一束束花递给他们。
“愿您能继续欢笑，迎来明天。”
她是镇上花店老板的女儿，对她的父母，对镇上的人来说，莉莉是他们珍视的宝物，捧在手心中的公主。她在春天用小铲子为花园翻土，在夏天和蝉鸣共舞，在秋冬对着窗户呼气，用手指在雾气中画出全家福。
花园里的小精灵，镇上人的小公主理应在四季中陪伴着花朵成长，凋零，一切本该如此……
直到一声巨响打破了女孩宁静的生活。莉莉记得那一天的情景，先是北边的天空暗了下来，随后林中的鸟雀一跃而起，散成一片灰影，盖住了天空。没有人出声，世界在巨响后仿佛安静了下来，安静得能听见石子在石板上滚动的声音……
“那是什么声音？”
“不知道，也许是城里的人在庆祝什么吧？”
镇上的人探头看了看，很快便散去了。
后来，莉莉才知道，那是战争逼近她家乡的第一声炮响。

yakita:FavorWord_151201_Content.text:
They say that when we die, we turn into stars... so the ones who love us can look up and find us anytime they so please.
I once dreamed those stars came down and became people I could hold. I didn't have to look up anymore. Didn't have to cry. I sat beside them on a beautiful train, riding through the stars, flying through the night. I thought my time would stay frozen right there, forever. Then a new passenger stepped aboard. And time... started moving again.
yakita:FavorWord_151201_Content.zh:
人们常说，人死后会化作天上的星星，让思念他们的人一抬头就能看见。
我曾做过一个梦，在那里，星星落地变成了我触手可及的人，我不用再抬头，不用再流着眼泪思念，而是和他们一同乘坐上美丽的列车，在星空下飞驰。我以为我的时间会永远停滞在那一刻，直到一位新的乘客闯入了列车……让时间，再度流动了起来。
yakita:FavorWord_151201_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:FavorWord_151202_Content.text:
[…]

All I had left was one thought: "Lily" ought to disappear along with all the smells.

[…]
yakita:FavorWord_151202_Content.zh:
我的人生被那场战争分割成了两段。
一段是平凡的调香师生活，如果要描绘它样子的话，我想想……也许是被晴天时的麦香，雨后的泥土香，和盛花期那满溢的花香填满的。这些奇妙而幸福的味道，总是推着我憧憬着明天。
另一段属于战场，我成为了一名军医。我闻到的味道越来越少，最后只有一种——刺鼻的消毒水，它仿佛消除了我生活中的一切，我开始害怕着明天的到来。
后来我逃到了列车上，不知道什么时候起，我……什么味道都闻不到了。调香师和军医的两种味道仿佛变得不再重要，我内心只剩下一个想法：“莉莉”，也该跟着味道一起被消除了。
直到经历了一场梦，我才恍然明白……
那些曾经的美好与苦痛，不断交织融合，似乎构成了一种新的味道。它孕育着生命的美好，又藏着生命的厚重
。所以，我还想再努力一次，循着新的味道去寻回那些被遗忘的美好。
yakita:FavorWord_151202_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:FavorWord_151203_Content.text:
Would you like me to pick out a scent for you? Hm... let me think. I'd start with an oceanic-woody accord as the base, and finish with a white musk. Yes, I think that would suit you. You're a wanderer, roving across every corner of Solaris. The tide may carry your voice away, and the wind may blow away your scent. But an oceanic-woody composition like this? It's you. It carries both the freshness of sea mist, and the quiet, solitary calm of wood.
You walk your path alone, but little by little, you've been making your way into this world. I can feel it. That warm heart beating in your chest. It moves you, always in the moments that matter, to step forward and help. I feel like I saw such a figure in a dream once... So I'd finish with white musk, to bring out that unique quality of yours.
Do you like it? If you do, I'd be happy to blend it for you.
yakita:FavorWord_151203_Content.zh:
要我帮忙挑选适合你的香水吗？嗯……我想想，或许海洋木质调为主，以白麝香收尾的香水很适合你。你是索拉里斯四方漂泊的人，浪潮会带走你的声音，海风会吹走你的气息。海洋木质调恰恰兼具了水汽的清新与木质的孤独沉稳。
你虽独自一人前行，却也一点点与这个世界建立了连结。我能感觉到，在你胸口跳着的，一直是一颗温热的心，它鼓动着你，总在关键时刻为他人挺身而出。那个身影，我仿佛在梦中也见过……所以用白麝香来收尾，能完美映衬你这份独特的气质。
喜欢吗？如果你喜欢的话，我可以试着帮你调配。
yakita:FavorWord_151203_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:FavorWord_151204_Content.text:
On that train, so many soldiers' last wish was simply to go home. They all said "home" meant happiness.
For someone like me, what would "home" even be...? Hm, perhaps it's the Somnoire?
I had my own little room there, and company to talk to. Even if... they were three inscrutable cats who came and went as they pleased.
Sometimes I'd brew flower tea, and they'd curl up beside me, and we'd watch all sorts of dreams drift by outside the window. Happy dreams. Sad dreams. Empty dreams... I'd take a sip of that warm tea, and it would spread through me. Was that... happiness? Or was it just the warmth of the tea?
yakita:FavorWord_151204_Content.zh:
列车上，许多战士最后的愿望都是回家，他们都说“家”就是幸福。
对我来说，能被称为“家”的地方……嗯，应该是心之集域吧？你看，我在那里拥有自己的房间，还有聊天的对象，虽然……是三只捉摸不透的小猫。
有时我会泡好花茶，它们挤坐在我周围，我们一同窥看着门内形形色色的梦。快乐的梦，悲伤的梦，空洞的梦……我喝下花茶，一股暖流流过我的心间，这……就是幸福吗？还是，这只是花茶的温度……
yakita:FavorWord_151204_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:FavorWord_151205_Content.text:
Do I have any plans for the future?
I don't rightly know. The "future" always felt so far away to me. I could never quite picture what it might look like. But someone in a dream once told me: "A blank canvas means endless possibilities. You can paint it with whatever colors you choose." So maybe I don't need to worry so much about what's coming. Maybe all I need to do is paint today, as best I can, with whatever colors I've got.
yakita:FavorWord_151205_Content.zh:
未来的我有什么打算吗？
暂时还没想好，“未来”这个词曾离我太遥远了，所以我无法想象它于我来说是什么模样。不过，梦里曾有人告诉过我：“空白也意味着我们有无限的可能性，我们可以尽情用色彩去描绘一张白纸。”我想，或许我不需要刻意去幻想未来是什么样子，我只要好好地描绘今天就好。
yakita:FavorWord_151205_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:FavorWord_151206_Content.text: I do so enjoy the process of making perfume. It takes so much imagination and creativity. Standing at my workbench, surrounded by all those little bottles of essential oils, I sometimes feel like a painter before her palette. Except my colors are invisible. I have to rely on my sense of smell to catch 'em, and coax 'em all into singing together in balance.
yakita:FavorWord_151206_Content.zh: 我很享受制作香水的过程，因为这是一项极具想象和创造力的工作。在调香台前，面对数以百计的精油瓶，有时我觉得自己像极了面对调色盘的画家——只不过我的颜料是看不见的，只能靠嗅觉去捕捉与权衡。
yakita:FavorWord_151206_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:FavorWord_151207_Content.text: The New Federation's culture, its way of life—it's all changed so much since my time. Since I came back, I can't help but feel like I don't quite belong anymore. There's so much I've got to learn if I want to find my place in this new world.
yakita:FavorWord_151207_Content.zh: 新联邦如今的文化、生活习惯，与我的时代相比，都发生了不小的变化。再次回来后，我总觉得自己与周遭格格不入。面对新生活，我还有许多东西要重新学习。
yakita:FavorWord_151207_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:FavorWord_151208_Content.text: I do so love a creamy fruit cake. The fresh tang of the fruit balances the sweetness of the cream perfectly. And the decorating! There's just something lovely about piping those little scallops and swirls. Ivory and Ebony have been trying their hand at it, too. Though kittens being kittens, they always manage to turn our "lessons" into outright "cake fights." You should see the kitchen after we're done...
yakita:FavorWord_151208_Content.zh: 我很喜欢清新的水果蛋糕，酸甜的果肉恰好能中和奶油的甜腻。而且制作奶油裱花也是件有趣的事情，小黑小白最近也在学习这门技能。不过，也许是因为小猫天生活泼好动，它们总是把“课堂教学”变成“蛋糕互扔大战”，把厨房弄得一团糟……
yakita:FavorWord_151208_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:FavorWord_151209_Content.text: Anything with a strong, pungent smell... I can't help it. My whole body recoils. I imagine it's because my nose is so finely tuned, being a perfumer and all. When I'm around that kind of food, the smell just about takes over every thought. My mind keeps whispering: "It stinks. Trust me, it stinks," over and over...
yakita:FavorWord_151209_Content.zh: 对闻起来臭臭的食物……我有一种生理性抗拒。我猜是因为调香师的嗅觉比较灵敏，所以当面对这类食物时，嗅觉会占据我所有的思考，在脑袋里不断对我重复：“它是臭烘烘的，相信我，它是臭烘烘的……”
yakita:FavorWord_151209_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:FavorWord_151210_Content.text: My dreams... Suppose it's more like my reason to keep going each day. I'll carry the memory of that war for everyone who can't. I'll stop that tragedy from ever happening to anyone else. And I'll hold onto those words I wrote in my diary—"May your soul wander no more." One step at a time, till my very last breath.
yakita:FavorWord_151210_Content.zh: 理想……不如说是支撑我前往明天的理由。我会替所有人铭记联邦城那场战争，我会阻止过去的悲剧重演在其他人身上。我会守着日记里写下的祝福语——“愿您的灵魂不再迷惘”，一步一步，直到呼吸的尽头。
yakita:FavorWord_151210_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:FavorWord_151211_Content.text: I still keep a diary. But I reckon I ought to change how I start my entries now. No more "Day such-and-such in the world of the dead." Instead, I should write the month and day. And the weather. Something like, "Clear skies..."
yakita:FavorWord_151211_Content.zh: 我依旧保持着写日记的习惯，不过文字的开头也许该换一种写法了。不再是“这是我在亡魂世界的第几天……”，而是“几月几日，天气晴……”
yakita:FavorWord_151211_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:FavorWord_151212_Content.text: When the war first broke out, I had all these feelings bottled up inside. I wanted to find some way to let 'em out, but who was I supposed to be angry at? The officers who gave the orders? The enemy? I don't know... Sometimes, I even doubted myself—did this world hate me? Maybe that was its way of punishing me.
yakita:FavorWord_151212_Content.zh: 战争刚爆发的时候，我也有想要发泄情绪的念头。但我应该怨恨谁呢？是发号施令的军官吗？还是敌人？我不知道……有时，我甚至会怀疑起自己——是因为世界讨厌我吗？所以它用这种方式惩罚我。
yakita:FavorWord_151212_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:FavorWord_151214_Content.text: Meta calls itself the owner of the Somnoire and likes to compare itself to a Sentinel. But it doesn't carry that same weight or authority. Honestly, it's more like a child sometimes—mischievous, playful, curious about every little thing. I know it's got secrets, plenty of 'em. I know it probably saved me for its own reasons. But I don't need to know why. I have this life now, this quiet, simple life, and that's more than enough for me.
yakita:FavorWord_151214_Content.zh: 祂自称是心之集域的主人，常将自己比作岁主，可祂远没有岁主那般威严。老实说，祂有时像孩子般淘气，对世间所有事物感到好奇。我知道，祂身上有许多谜团，祂救我也许另有目的，但我没有必要去了解真相，能拥有现在这样的生活，我已经很满足了。
yakita:FavorWord_151214_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:FavorWord_151217_Content.text:
Before I returned to the New Federation, I spent some time at Startorch Academy. That's where I met Sigrika. We became fast friends. She has a rare gift for knowing when not to pry. She never pressed me about my past, and she never tried too hard to lift my spirits. But sometimes, she'd wear this quiet, lonely look on her face when she thought no one was watching. That's when it struck me. Here was this bright, vivacious girl, and yet she had no one waiting for her after her lessons.
I don't like to assume, but... I think she might've suffered a loss too. Someone dear to her. And that's why she clung to me the way she did.
yakita:FavorWord_151217_Content.zh:
返回新联邦前，我在星炬学院停留了一段时间。西格莉卡，是我在那里交到的好朋友。她似乎很懂得把握与人相处的距离，既不会过多追问我的过去，也不会刻意逗我开心。不过开朗的她有时候一个人也会露出落寞的表情。那时候我才意识到这么开朗活泼的女孩，放学后为什么会没有朋友等她呢？
