我不想胡乱猜测，但……她可能也失去过重要的人，所以面对我，她才想要紧紧抓住。
yakita:FavorWord_151217_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:FavorWord_151218_Content.text:
Close your eyes! I'll count to three, and then you can open 'em. Three, two, one... Happy birthday!
I made this cake myself. Though I confess, Meta and the little ones pitched in a bit too. The candles are already lit, so go on, make a wish. I'll be right here, adding one of my own: "May your tomorrows be filled with the sun's light, and may this world treat you gently..."
yakita:FavorWord_151218_Content.zh: 先把眼睛闭上，我数三二一再睁开眼哦。三、二、一……生日快乐！这是我做的生日蛋糕，梅塔和小黑小白也帮了点忙，蜡烛已经点上了。来，许个愿吧。我也会为你送上祝福的：“愿你的明天铺满阳光，愿你永远被这个世界温柔以待……”
yakita:FavorWord_151218_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:FavorWord_151221_Content.text: Just call me Lily. If something's weighing on you, know you can always confide in me.
yakita:FavorWord_151221_Content.zh: 叫我莉莉就好，如果你有什么烦心事，都可以向我倾诉。
yakita:FavorWord_151221_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:FavorWord_151222_Content.text: Past sorrows scatter with the wind. I pray this fragrance guides you forward.
yakita:FavorWord_151222_Content.zh: 过往的痛苦随风消散，愿这缕花香指引你的方向。
yakita:FavorWord_151222_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:FavorWord_151224_Content.text: I'm not much of a fighter, but... I'll give it my best.
yakita:FavorWord_151224_Content.zh: 我不擅长战斗，但……我会尽我所能。
yakita:FavorWord_151224_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:FavorWord_151225_Content.text: In your dream, I'll be there to light the way.
yakita:FavorWord_151225_Content.zh: 在梦中，我会为你指引方向。
yakita:FavorWord_151225_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:FavorWord_151227_Content.text: The "monsters" in my dreams... This time, I'll face 'em on my own.
yakita:FavorWord_151227_Content.zh: 梦中的那些“怪物”，这一次，我会靠自己，打败它们。
yakita:FavorWord_151227_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:FavorWord_151228_Content.text: I'm grateful to Meta for the strength it gave me, truly I am. But to keep the promise I made to those soldiers, I need to grow stronger from within.
yakita:FavorWord_151228_Content.zh: 我很感谢梅塔赐予我力量，但为了履行和战士们的约定，我自己也要变得更强才行。
yakita:FavorWord_151228_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:FavorWord_151229_Content.text: May every dream from here on become a beautiful memory.
yakita:FavorWord_151229_Content.zh: 愿此后每一个梦，都化作美好记忆。
yakita:FavorWord_151229_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:FavorWord_151230_Content.text: My fears, my worries, the ones I wanted to protect... they were all tucked away in a beautiful dreamland. I meant to stay there forever, to sleep and never wake. Then a dark silhouette, a face I can't quite recall, became a breath of wind and stirred me. In that moment, I knew. It was time to wake from that dream.
yakita:FavorWord_151230_Content.zh: 我的恐惧、忧虑……我想守护的人，都藏在绮丽的幻梦里。到最后，我沉溺于幻梦打算长眠于此时，一个模糊的黑影化作一缕风将我唤醒。那一刻我才明白，梦，该醒了。
yakita:FavorWord_151230_Content.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_11.text: Alright, {PlayerName}. But if their memories ever become too heavy for you, please let me know.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_11.zh: 那{PlayerName}，如果你因他们的经历而感到有精神上的负担，一定要和我说。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_11.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_15.text: Even now, with his station just ahead, he remains completely silent.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_15.zh: 即便是到达站点的此时此刻，他仍然保持着沉默。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_15.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_16.text: I'll let you uncap the perfume bottle this time. Whenever you're ready.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_16.zh: 这次就由你来揭开香水瓶吧，准备好的话，我们开始吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_16.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_27.text: Good morning, {PlayerName}. What brings you here? Did you sleep well last night? Is your headache any better?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_27.zh: {PlayerName}，早上好啊。你怎么来了，昨晚睡得还好吗？还有没有头痛的症状？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_27.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_3.text: About that... I thought it over last night. I really shouldn't let the cruelty of war burden another innocent soul.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_3.zh: 这个……昨晚我回去后想了一下，我觉得不该把无辜的人牵扯进来，让他人经历战争的残酷。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_3.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_31.text: (Lily's the most unique soul on this train, and she hasn't shown me a single hint of hostility.)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_31.zh: （莉莉虽然是列车上最特殊的亡魂，但她目前对我没有展现任何敌意。）

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_34.text: It's just...? {PlayerName}, is something wrong? You're looking at me like you've just had a nightmare...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_34.zh: 但……{PlayerName}，怎么了，你一直盯着我，像是做了噩梦的一副表情……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_34.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_4.text: Besides, bringing peace to these soldiers is my duty, not yours.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_4.zh: 安息战士本来就只是我的工作，你没有必要继续帮忙。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_4.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_102_4.text: No need to rush, {PlayerName}. We can go at your pace. Is there anything you want to do first?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_102_4.zh: 不用着急，我们慢慢来，{PlayerName}，现在的你，有什么想做的吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_102_4.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_102_9.text: Take your time. Since there's no one else here, I suppose... I'll be his audience.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_102_9.zh: 慢慢来吧，这里没有其他人了，听众的话……就由我来扮演吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_102_9.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_33.text: {PlayerName}... You're yourself again. Did we already wake from the dream?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_33.zh: {PlayerName}……你变回来了，我们是已经从梦中醒来了吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_108_33.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_110_3.text: Missing the piano, hm? If memory serves, Miss Lily plays. Why don't you ask—
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_110_3.zh: 你是想听钢琴曲了吧，我记得莉莉小姐就会钢琴，要不……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_110_5.text: I can play, yes. Just tell me what you'd like to hear, and I'll do my best to...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_110_5.zh: 好啊，大家想听什么曲子可以悄悄跟我说，我尽量……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_110_5.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_110_6.text: Now don't you go troubling Miss Lily when she's already got her hands full on this train.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_110_6.zh: 你们就别麻烦莉莉小姐了，她还要应付列车上的其他工作。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_110_7.text: Pay 'em no mind, Miss Lily. They're only teasin'...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_110_7.zh: 莉莉小姐，没事，他们只是开个玩笑……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_111_4.text: Those words... Did you hear them from the officer before you boarded?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_111_4.zh: 这些话……是军官上车前告诉你的吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_111_4.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_111_5.text: Haha, so you've heard them too, Miss Lily. Yeah, the very words that fooled me into signing up. What about you, {Male=sir;Female=ma'am}?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_111_5.zh: 哈哈哈，看来莉莉小姐也听过。当初我就是被这些东西给骗到了军队里，这位战士{Male=先生;Female=小姐}呢？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_112_14.text: I reckon... they were terrified. But the music, and their hope for peace, gave 'em the strength to face that fear.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_112_14.zh: 我想……他们都很害怕，但音乐和对和平的期望给了他们克服恐惧的力量。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_112_14.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_10.text: Oh, and the broadcast announces each station as we arrive. If it's no trouble, and you'd like to keep going together, you could... keep an ear out for it.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_10.zh: 对了，广播会播报站点的到达情况，你之后如果不嫌麻烦，还想一起行动的话，可以……稍稍注意一下。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_10.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_13.text: I've written down everything I've experienced on the train. I thought it might help you understand what life is like here, and the soldiers who've passed through.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_13.zh: 这上面记录着我在列车上的点点滴滴，我想它也能帮助你熟悉这里的生活，了解每位战士。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_13.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_22.text: Personal? Oh, don't fret about that. My days here are as plain as can be. Even if you read every page, you wouldn't find anything all that special.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_22.zh: 隐私……不会不会，我的生活很普通，就算你看完了，也不会觉得有什么特别的地方。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_22.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_23.text: I just figured, since we'll be spending time together, trust and understanding are the least we can offer each other.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_23.zh: 我只是觉得这段时间既然要一起生活，那相互信任和了解是最基本的。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_23.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_3.text: It was your words that gave him the strength to forgive himself.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_3.zh: 是你的那番言语，给了他与自己和解的机会。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_3.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_6.text: It pales in comparison to the power of your words.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_6.zh: 可我觉得那份力量远没有你的言语强大。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_6.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_7.text: All I could ever give them was a fleeting dream, and dreams always come to an end.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_7.zh: 我只能赐予他们一场短暂的梦，但这场梦终究会醒来。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_7.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_8.text: Mm. I hope you can find a way out of here safely. And then, just as you said, carry their stories forward to save more in the future.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_8.zh: 嗯，我也希望你能顺利离开这里，然后就如你所说的，用他们的故事去拯救未来更多的人。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_8.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_9.text: There's still some time before dinner. You might rest in the Lounge Carriage for a bit. I'll leave you to yourself, then.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_9.zh: 距离晚餐还有一段时间，你可以在大厅车厢休息一下，那接下来的时间我就不打扰你了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_113_9.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_114_2.text: "Somehow, I've come to accept the help of that living soul."
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_114_2.zh: 不知不觉，我开始接受那位生者的帮忙。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_114_2.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_114_3.text: {Male=He's;Female=She's} growing accustomed to life on the train...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_114_3.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_118_11.text: I-I'm fine. Thank you. What's happening...? Why have our lives turned into this?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_118_11.zh: 没……没事，谢谢。究竟发生了什么……我们的生活为什么会变成现在这样？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_118_11.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_118_12.text: Why is everyone taking up arms? They were my neighbors just yesterday. Why are they pointing a gun at me now?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_118_12.zh: 为什么大家都拿起了枪，为什么昨日还是邻居的他们都把枪口对准了我？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_118_12.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_118_24.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束3_18_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_118_24.text: A painting on the wall offers a glimpse into Lily's past. Shortly after the war began, a soldier came to her aid and explained why they had to keep fighting: to protect others and give more people the chance to live.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_118_24.zh: 通过挂画，你仿佛看见了莉莉的过去。似乎是战争刚爆发时，一位战士救助了莉莉，并告诉了她战斗下去的理由——战斗是为了保护更多人活下去。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_120_1.text: This is Lily's past. What is that cat trying to show me?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_120_1.zh: 这是莉莉的过去，那只猫究竟想给我看什么？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_1.text: How are you feeling today? Can you try repeating after me? "Ah"... "Oh"...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_1.zh: 今天怎么样？来跟着我一起试着发声，a、o……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_10.text: Are these monsters? Are you saying there were a lot of them out there?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_10.zh: 你画的是怪物吗，你是想说战场上出现了许多怪物？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_10.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_15.text: ...No. You mean to say they don't exist in the real world. Only you can see them.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_15.zh: 不，你是说这些怪物现实中不存在，只有你能看见。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_15.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_17.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束3_21_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_17.text: Lily becomes a psychotherapist in the army. During her rounds in the ward, she encounters a soldier who has lost her voice and keeps scribbling on the walls. From these drawings, Lily manages to decipher what the soldier is desperately trying to communicate: monsters have appeared on the battlefield, but she is the only one who can see them.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_17.zh: 莉莉成为了军队中的精神疗愈师，在病房巡视时，她遇见了一名失声的战士，战士一直在墙上乱涂乱画。莉莉从战士的画中读出了她真正想要传递的信息——战场上出现了许多怪物，而这些怪物只有战士自己能看见。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_4.text: Don't waste your time, Doctor Lily. It's been a month since this coward lost her voice when she panicked on the battlefield.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_4.zh: 别白费力气了，莉莉医生，这家伙在战场上吓破胆都失声一个月了。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_8.text: These drawings on the wall... Are you trying to tell me something?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_8.zh: 墙上这些画……你是想通过它们告诉我什么吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_121_8.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_125_1.text: Those soldiers were in so much pain... and so was Lily.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_125_1.zh: 我能理解那些战士的心情，但……莉莉她自己也很痛苦吧。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_130_1.text: Doctor Lily, my uniform got torn up. Do you think there are any spares in the supply chests?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_130_1.zh: 莉莉医生，我的军衣坏掉了，麻烦你看看物资箱里还有多余的衣服吗？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_131_4.text: Come on, everyone! Clap along and give Miss Lily a beat!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_131_4.zh: 来，大家把手都借给莉莉小姐，替她打节拍。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_132_38.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束3_32_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_132_38.text: As you move forward, the conservatory begins to transform until the room becomes the battlefield of the past. You witness fragments of Lily's life among the soldiers on the front lines, followed by a haunting image of her holding a gun to herself amid the flames of war. You reach out to stop her, but the same agonizing sensation you felt upon first entering the Somnoire overwhelms you, leaving you unable to move. Just then, a hand reaches from behind and pulls you out of the dream.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_132_38.zh: 随着你的前进，花房的空间也在发生变化，直至变成了过去的那片战场。你看见了莉莉在前线和战士们生活的点点滴滴，以及战火中她把枪对准自己的背影，你想要伸手去阻止时，刚进心之集域时的苦痛感袭来，你无法前进一步。这时候，一只手仿佛从后面拉住了你，将你从梦中唤醒。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_2.text: I'm okay. This wasn't like the other nightmares. I saw Lily's past. But right when it came down to it...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_133_2.zh: 没事了，这次的梦与之前的噩梦不同，我在里面看见了莉莉的过去，但在最关键的时候……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_1.text: Good morning, {PlayerName}. You've done so much for me lately. I'd have thought you might like to sleep in a little...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_1.zh: 早上好啊，{PlayerName}，这段时间辛苦你了，其实你可以再多睡一会儿的……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_13.text: Come now, don't make things so gloomy. For me, this isn't just a goodbye. It's a new beginning.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_13.zh: 不要把气氛搞得这么僵了，对我来说，这既是告别，也是新生。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_13.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_14.text: You said you'd take our stories out into the world. But if you tell them with a face like that, I don't reckon anyone will want to listen.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_14.zh: 你说过，你会把我们的故事带到外面，如果以这副表情去讲故事的话，我想没有人会喜欢。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_14.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_16.text: May your soul wander no more. May you welcome a tomorrow of your own.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_16.zh: 愿你的灵魂不再迷惘，去迎接属于你的明天。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_16.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_19.text: All this time, we've been praying for the departed. But at the very end, I thought to turn it around—a blessing from the departed to the living.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_19.zh: 一直以来我们都在为逝者祈祷。到了最后，我觉得应该反过来，这是我作为逝者对生者的祝福。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_19.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_2.text: I turned off the broadcast. There's only one soul left, so we're in no rush.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_2.zh: 我把广播关掉了，毕竟只剩下最后一个亡魂了，我们不用着急。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_2.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_20.text: {PlayerName}, we talked before about how this train, and all of us who died here, might be tied to the anomaly you're investigating.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_20.zh: {PlayerName}，之前我们曾聊过，这辆列车，我们这些死去的人，也许就和你要调查的异变有关。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_20.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_29.text: You're familiar with life on this train now. You know where to get food, when the lights shut off at night...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_29.zh: 你们已经熟悉列车上的生活了，你们知道该如何获取食物，知道晚上什么时候会关灯。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_29.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_30.text: And you know how to tend to the lilies we turn into.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_30.zh: 你们也知道该如何照顾变成百合花的我们。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_30.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_32.text: Once I'm gone, perhaps all your answers will finally come to light. I truly hope you make it out of here safely and leave all of this behind.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_32.zh: 当我消失后，说不定你的疑惑就会解开了。我希望你能顺利离开这里，不再与我们牵扯上关系。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_32.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_33.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束4_9_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_33.text: Lily is the last remaining soul on the train, but you're not good at saying goodbye. Just as the silence grows heavy, she smiles and offers a peculiar prayer. She hopes you will find your way out safely and never again become entangled with the souls of the dead.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_33.zh: 莉莉是列车上最后一个亡魂，你不擅长与人道别，在气氛变得凝重时，莉莉向你微笑并做了一个独特的祈祷。她希望你能顺利离开这里，不再与亡魂们牵扯上关系。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_8.text: So, until this train reaches its final stop, please take over as the temporary conductor. Look after everything for me.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_8.zh: 所以，在列车到达终点前，接下来就拜托你们担任临时列车长，打理车上的一切了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_139_8.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_12.text: Lily, this dream is your reward for saving all those lives. You can paint this world with whatever colors you choose.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_12.zh: 莉莉，这是幻梦对你拯救他人的奖励，你想用什么色彩去填满这个世界都行。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_14.text: ...But, the colors I want might be a little complicated. Back when I was a perfumer, I had a little dream.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_14.zh: ……但，我想用的色彩可能很复杂。我曾有过一个小小的心愿，那还是我当调香师的时候。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_14.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_15.text: If the war hadn't happened, I wanted to travel the world. Gather rare flowers, blend new scents, experience different cultures.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_15.zh: 如果战争没有发生，我想要去世界各地，去收集不同的花，尝试不同的香料，体验不同的文化。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_15.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_17.text: Even dreams need reality to anchor them, don't they? I've never seen the world outside, so even here, I can't imagine what it looks like.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_17.zh: 就算是梦，也得靠现实里的东西来支撑想象吧。我没见过外面的世界，所以哪怕在梦里，也实现不了这个心愿。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_17.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_25.text: (On my very last day in the Somnoire, I embarked on my first and final journey.)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_25.zh: （这是在心之集域的最后一天，我开始了人生中第一次，也是最后的旅行。）
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_25.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_32.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束4_10_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_32.text:
Lily's dream is nothing but a blank expanse. She explains that perhaps all her wishes have already been fulfilled, and there's nothing left in the world for her to hold on to. But you don't believe that has to be the case. You offer another interpretation: a blank canvas also means endless possibilities.

You encourage her to think of something she still longs to do, no matter how small. Lily recalls a dream from her days as a perfumer. Had the war never happened, she would have traveled the world, gathering flowers, experimenting with fragrances, and experiencing different cultures. You decide to share the world through your memories and help her fulfill that dream on one final journey.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_32.zh: 属于莉莉的梦是一片空白，莉莉解释大概是自己的愿望已经实现了，世界上没什么值得留恋的东西。你觉得不该如此，给出了另一种解释——空白也意味着你们有无限的可能性。你鼓励莉莉说出自己还未完成的心愿，哪怕很小很小。莉莉想起了自己做调香师时的一个心愿，如果战争没有发生，她想要去世界各地，去收集不同的花，尝试不同的香料，体验不同的文化。你决定把自己见过的世界借给她，完成最后的旅行。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_4.text: Maybe my wish has already been fulfilled. After all, we laid every last soul to rest, didn't we?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_4.zh: 大概是我的愿望已经实现了吧，我们不是已经安息好了所有亡魂吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_4.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_5.text: I failed to save most of them when I was alive. But after I died, I was given a second chance. And this time, I could make a difference.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_5.zh: 生前我没有救到他们大多数人，死后的我有了第二次机会，这一次，我做到了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_5.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_6.text: So maybe there's simply nothing left for me to hold onto. Maybe we just wait here until the dream ends.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_6.zh: 这世界上或许已经没什么值得我留恋的东西，那我们只要等着从这个梦醒来就好。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_6.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_10.text: Next came Rinascita. Gondolas glided across the water—I'd never seen anything so gracefully imagined.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_10.zh: 下一站是黎那汐塔，贡多拉跃动在海面上，像这样富有想象力的载具，我以前从未见过。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_10.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_11.text: After sharing a bite of cake, {Male=he;Female=she} put on a mask and led me to an open-air stage. {Male=He;Female=She} had a small wish, too.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_11.zh: 吃完蛋糕后，{TA}戴上面具把我带到了一个露天舞台，{TA}也有个小心愿。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_11.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_14.text: {Male=He;Female=She} couldn't bring {Male=himself;Female=herself} to tell {Male=his;Female=her} friends. Some things were {Male=his;Female=hers} alone to carry. So {Male=he;Female=she} never let {Male=his;Female=her} guard down, not even for a moment.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_14.zh: {TA}说自己不太好意思告诉朋友们，因为有些事情必须{TA}来做，所以{TA}不能松懈一刻。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_14.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_16.text: {Male=He;Female=She} invited me to dance, but I was clumsy and kept stepping on {Male=his;Female=her} feet.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_16.zh: {TA}邀请了我上台，但我的步伐有些笨拙，老是踩着{TA}的脚。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_16.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_19.text: Later, we reached Startorch Academy. Haunted by the war, I'd always assumed anything related to "science" was a weapon...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_19.zh: 后来，我们到了星炬学院。受战争的影响，我以为与“科学”相关的东西，都是武器……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_19.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_21.text: "Academy"... that word felt so distant. At the age when I should've been in school, I was learning to hold a gun instead.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_21.zh: 学院，这个名字离我太遥远了。在我本该上学的年纪，我不得不拿起枪参加了军事训练。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_21.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_24.text: They came from different places, carried different stories, but they all gathered here for the same hope.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_24.zh: 他们来自世界各地，虽然出身不同，性格不同，但却为了同一个理想聚集在一起。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_24.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_25.text: I wanted to stay, but I could feel my time drawing near.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_25.zh: 我很想继续走下去，但我觉得时间快到了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_25.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_27.text: Later, {Male=he;Female=she} took me out on a motorbike, racing fast enough to catch a fading aurora.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_27.zh: 再后来，{TA}骑着摩托载着我，像是要追赶即将消逝的极光。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_27.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_28.text: {Male=He;Female=She} wanted me to try driving, as if it might help me hold onto the world's last bit of warmth. But my body was growing weaker.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_28.zh: {TA}想让我试试驾驶，仿佛这样，我就能握住世界最后的温柔，可我能感觉到，我的身体越来越虚弱了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_28.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_3.text: But with me, {Male=he;Female=she} became the guide. I could tell how much {Male=he;Female=she} loved this place. {Male=He;Female=She} remembered every shop, every face.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_3.zh: 但在我面前，{TA}成了那个引路者。我看得出来{TA}很喜欢这里。{TA}记得每家店的模样，这里的每个人。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_3.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_30.text: Mengzhou. The place {Male=he;Female=she} came from. Under the night sky, Moon Lanterns drifted down the stream, melting into the glow of the Waking Moon Festival.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_30.zh: 梦州，是{TA}来的地方。夜色中，一盏盏月灯顺流而下，落入名为朝月会的万家灯火。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_30.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_32.text: {Male=He;Female=She} showed me the lantern tradition—writing your happiest memory of the year on a lantern, then letting it float away.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_32.zh: {TA}向我示范着怎么使用月灯，似乎是要把一年中最喜悦的事情写在上面，然后推入水中。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_32.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_33.text: I didn't want {Male=him;Female=her} to see mine, so I scrawled it in messy handwriting. Only I know what those few words said—
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_33.zh: 为了不让{TA}知道我写了什么，我故意把字写得东倒西歪，只有我知道那是很简短的一句——
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_33.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_34.text: Thank you, {PlayerName}. This final journey made me very happy.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_34.zh: 谢谢你，{PlayerName}，最后的旅行，我很快乐。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_34.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_41.text: It struck me then. {Male=He;Female=She} was just like everyone else. With the same ordinary worries, the same ordinary thoughts...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_41.zh: 原来{TA}也只是一个普通人啊，也有着普通人的烦恼，普通人的想法……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_41.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_42.text: In the end, I made {Male=him;Female=her} finish the dance with a plushie Echo. Though {Male=he;Female=she} insisted I take a turn dancing with one, too.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_42.zh: 最后我让{TA}和一只布偶声骸跳完了整支舞。但{TA}不满足于此，让我也尝试着和声骸跳了一曲。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_42.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_43.text: {Male=He;Female=She} encouraged me to look closer. So I reached out and touched a robot named "TARD-E."
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_43.zh: {TA}鼓励我去重新认识它们，我摸了摸被叫作“准时宝”的机器人。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_43.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_44.text: Its shell felt cold, but it was nothing like a war machine.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_44.zh: 虽然还是冰冷的温度，但我知道，它和战争机器不一样。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_44.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_45.text: Everything here was wonderful. The strange inventions, laughter spilling out of classrooms, students dreaming freely about tomorrow.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_45.zh: 这里的一切都很有趣，稀奇古怪的发明，课堂上的欢笑声，学生们畅谈着明天和未来。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_45.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_8.text: {Male=He;Female=She} told me the people here had weathered many wars, too. But their enemies were Tacet Discords...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_8.zh: 我从{TA}口中得知这里的人们也经历过多次战争，不过他们的敌人是残象。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_8.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_9.text: ...While mine were the ordinary people I once lived alongside.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_9.zh: 而我的敌人，是曾经一同生活过的普通人。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_141_9.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_12.text: Protecting their home. See, such a simple thing, yet so powerful. For me, I... I still don't know what we were fighting for...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_12.zh: 保家卫国，你看，如此简单又振奋人心的目标。可我到现在都不知道我的战争是为了什么……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_12.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_13.text: I admire the people of Rinascita. They had their differences, but they set it all aside to sing and dance together. Seems disagreement doesn't always need to end in bloodshed.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_13.zh: 我很羡慕黎那汐塔的人，他们虽有分歧，最后仍能放下隔阂一起歌舞，原来有分歧也不一定会流血。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_13.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_14.text: And at Startorch, no one cared where you came from. Only where you were going next.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_14.zh: 我更羡慕学院的人，没有人在乎你从哪里来，只在乎你要往哪里去。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_14.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_16.text: If I could, I would've loved to see it all for real... To touch a flower. To speak without fear. To talk and laugh with those folks...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_16.zh: 如果有机会的话，我真想去现实亲眼看看幻梦里的世界……亲手采一朵花，自在地与人交谈，欢笑。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_16.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_19.text: Sometimes I wondered, did this world hate me? Why was I the one caught in all that misery? Did I do something to deserve it?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_19.zh: 我有时候会想，这个世界是不是很讨厌我？偏偏是我遭遇战争……是我做过什么错事吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_19.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_2.text: This journey was more than enough for me. Now I know what the world really looks like. It's so much gentler than I ever imagined.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_2.zh: 这趟旅行我已经很满足了，原来外面的世界是这个样子的啊，比我想象中的还要温柔。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_2.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_29.text: Thank you, {PlayerName}. You showed me there's still tenderness and beauty in this world.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_29.zh: 谢谢你，{PlayerName}。是你让我在最后知晓了世界也有温柔和美丽的一面。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_29.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_30.text: This was the happiest day I've spent in the Somnoire. If only... it could have come... a little sooner...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_30.zh: 这是我在心之集域最快乐的一天，如果它……能……来得更早一点，就好了……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_30.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_43.text: You shared your dreams and the worlds you've seen... Now, it's my turn.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_43.zh: 你把你的梦，你见到的世界借给了我……现在轮到我了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_43.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_53.text: Don't worry, I won't turn into a lily before you finish. I'll hear every word you have to say. But if it's too hard to watch...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_53.zh: 别担心，我不会擅自变百合花的，我会好好把最后的话说完，要是你觉得不安的话……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_53.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_56.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束4_12_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_56.text:
The dream fades, and you return to the train. Lily thanks you for giving her such a wonderful journey. As farewell draws near, she confesses that she envies the people in the places you visited. They all know what they are fighting for. You reassure her that she was never the one at fault, and that the blame lies with the war itself. As Lily grows weaker, you struggle to bear the thought of losing her. She gently covers your eyes with her fingers, asking you to close them for one final goodbye.

When her voice suddenly falls silent, the train is overcome by stillness. You open your eyes, but instead of the farewell you expected, you find Lily before you, her face twisted by something unknown.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_142_56.zh: 幻梦消散，你们回到了列车上。莉莉感谢你带给她的梦，临别之际，她袒露出了自己的心声。莉莉很羡慕幻梦中那些国度里的人，他们都知道自己在为什么而战。你告诉莉莉错的从来都不是她，而是那场战争本身。莉莉越发虚弱，你有些不忍心看着她消失。于是莉莉轻抚你的眼睛，让你闭上眼完成最后的道别……当莉莉的声音戛然而止，一切安静下来后，你睁开眼，等待你的却是脸部被某种东西侵蚀的莉莉。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_10.text: Those soldiers aren't pawns to be sacrificed for the higher-ups' victory.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_10.zh: 但那些战士的生命，不应该成为上位者为了赢的牺牲品。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_10.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_11.text: They have families, friends. People waiting for them, same as you.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_11.zh: 他们和你们一样，也有家人、朋友。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_11.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_15.text: Then I'd rather be the fool you think I am, than go numb the way you have.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_15.zh: 那我也不愿像你们一样麻木地活着。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_15.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_5.text: As their doctor, I had to assess whether they were fit to be discharged. They were on the verge of Overclocking. They couldn't fight. Not for a while.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_5.zh: 作为医生，我必须判断他们是否符合出院标准。他们已经濒临超频，短时间内无法继续战斗了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_145_5.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_147_2.text: We're to launch an assault tomorrow, orders from the top. I wonder how everyone's holding up tonight...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_147_2.zh: 上面传来命令，让我们明日组织一场冲锋，不知道大家今晚过得怎么样……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_147_2.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_148_10.text: You're both recovering nicely. Get some real rest while you still can.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_148_10.zh: 你们身上的伤已经快好了，两位先好好休息吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_148_10.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_148_9.text: Please, you two. There's no use dwelling on this. Though Mr. Rogett's right about one thing: what matters now is the battle ahead.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_148_9.zh: 两位都不要胡思乱想了，罗杰特先生有一点说得对，当下的战斗最重要。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_148_9.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_10.text: You've only just recovered, and we're short-staffed as it is. Aside from me, you're the most experienced when it comes to mental health care.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_10.zh: 你的伤才刚刚好，现在医护班的人员所剩无几了，关于精神疗愈的工作，除我之外，你的经验最丰富了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_10.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_11.text: If I don't come back tomorrow... the soldiers will need you and the other doctors to carry that weight.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_11.zh: 要是我明天没能回来……战士们就拜托你和其他医生照顾了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_11.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_14.text: Don't you worry about me. Our job is to keep every soldier alive as long as we possibly can. Even one more minute is worth fighting for, isn't it?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_14.zh: 不用担心我，我们的职责是尽可能救下每一个战士，尽可能让他们多活一分钟，对吧？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_14.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_5.text: The pieces you played were lovely. And the choice of songs—there was something in them, almost like you were speaking to someone far away.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_5.zh: 嗯，你吹奏的曲子都很好听，选的曲子也很有意思，像是在和某个遥不可及的人聊天。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_5.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_7.text: It's okay... no need to say more. You weren't passing intel. There's been no violation. You were simply enjoying music, weren't you?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_7.zh: 好了……到此为止。你不是在传递情报，也没有任何违纪行为，你只是在单纯地享受音乐，不是吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_7.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_9.text: One more thing, I've taken you off tomorrow's roll. I'll be enough to accompany the team.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_9.zh: 嗯，还有一件事情，我把你从明天的队伍名单里除名了，由我一个人跟随队伍就行了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_149_9.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_12.text: Something... No, I... Honestly, what's gotten into everyone tonight? You're the second person to say that to me.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_12.zh: 了不起，不……我……大家是怎么了，今晚你是第二位说这个话的人了……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_12.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_16.text: Stop, don't go jinxing us like that. We're all making it through tomorrow, same as always. Nothing's gonna go wrong.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_16.zh: 停，你又在说不吉利的话了。我们啊，明天肯定都能活下来，就像以前一样，明天根本没有什么意外。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_16.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_2.text: Yes... Just here for the usual update. The wounded are all recovering well. You can rest easy.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_2.zh: 嗯……照例跟你汇报一下，伤员们的伤势都在好转，你不用担心了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_2.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_23.text: That's all right. If that happens, I'll just do what you do and hum that lullaby you taught him, wait until he falls asleep, and stay 'til he's ready to forgive me.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_23.zh: 没关系，到那时我就模仿你，吹响你教他的摇篮曲，慢慢哄他入睡，等他消气吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_23.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_27.text: Not knowing what happiness is, yet still having to carry all that sorrow... It really is a strange story.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_27.zh: 不知道幸福是什么，却要去跨越悲伤，的确……真是奇怪的故事啊……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_27.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_31.text: I only did what I should. I'm a doctor, after all.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_31.zh: 我只是做了我应该做的事情，毕竟……我是医生。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_31.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_4.text: He must get it from you, always pestering people for hugs. I wonder how he's doing on the train right now.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_4.zh: 所以那孩子也是跟你学的吧，他总喜欢向大家索取拥抱，不知道他在列车上怎么样了？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_152_4.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_154_1.text: Calm down, Lily. The battle's begun. You've seen scenes like this before, more times than you can count.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_154_1.zh: 冷静，战斗已经打响了……这样的画面，你见过很多次了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_154_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_156_1.text: The soldier's eyes stare straight into Lily's, yet his soul seems to have drifted somewhere far away.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_156_1.zh: 战士的眼睛一直凝视着莉莉，但又好像去了很远的地方。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_156_2.text: Lily realizes he died in that pose to shield something clutched in his arms.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_156_2.zh: 莉莉发现他摆出这样的姿态，是为了保护怀里的某物……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_158_20.text: No... no... I'm not trying to ease your pain. I'm trying to save you!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_158_20.zh: 不……不……我不是想减轻你死前的痛苦，我是想救回你。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_158_20.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_158_21.text: Why... Why can't my Resonance Ability mend a body? Why... Why can't I do anything at all...!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_158_21.zh: 为什么……为什么我的共鸣能力无法治愈身体。为什么……为什么我什么都做不到……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_158_21.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_158_22.text: Please... don't go with that peaceful look on your face. I want to save you. Save all of you! That's all I've been fighting for.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_158_22.zh: 求求你们……不要再带着没有苦痛的表情死去了……我想救回你们，我一直想做的事是想救回你们。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_158_22.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_158_3.text: Miss... Miss Lily... I just... want to go home...

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_27.text: No, no... That's just lying to myself. They wouldn't really find peace that way.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_27.zh: 不……不要……这只是自欺欺人，他们根本没有得到安息。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_27.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_29.text: Eternal... Time. That's it. If I can use dreams, then at the very least, I'll have all the time I need.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_29.zh: 永恒……时间，对，如果利用梦的话，至少我有了充足的时间。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_29.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_54.text: Lily. From this day on, our deal is in effect.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_54.zh: 莉莉，从今日起，我们的交易生效。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_54.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_61.text: Then I'll be that vessel. I'll bear all the "curses," all the "corruption" myself.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_61.zh: 那就由我来当那个容器，所有的“诅咒”和“污秽”由我一人承担。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_61.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_67.text: Stay alive... Yes. I'll live on, for all of you.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_67.zh: 好好活下去……是啊，我会为你们好好活下去。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_67.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_7.text: Meta, the Somnoire... Why am I here? And the s-soldiers—
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_7.zh: 梅塔，心之集域……我为什么会在这里，战，战士他们……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_7.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_161_2.text: Not sure it'll go quite as planned. Perhaps I should fix something to help them feel at ease.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_161_2.zh: 不知道能不能成功，要不要再准备一些其他东西，让他们放松下来。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_161_2.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_162_1.text: Herbal tea ought to help. I'll brew it a little milder.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_162_1.zh: 花茶怎么样，尽量把味道调制得更柔和一点吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_162_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_163_1.text: Mm... The vase suits this spot perfectly. I hope they like the scent.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_163_1.zh: 嗯……花瓶放在这里就合适，希望他们喜欢这个香味。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_163_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_164_1.text: This... is my diary. Before the war, back when I still worked in a conservatory, I used to write down the little things about my days.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_164_1.zh: 这是……我的日记本，战争爆发前，我还在花房工作，每天都会记点日常。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_164_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_164_2.text: Time flows differently here in the Somnoire. I'll need to keep that in mind. Perhaps this diary can help me track the days.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_164_2.zh: 心之集域的时间和现实不同，我得留心一下，就用这本日记来记录吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_164_2.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_164_3.text: These old entries... They don't need to be here anymore. I should tear them out.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_164_3.zh: 前面写的这些……已经没有必要存在了，撕掉吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_164_3.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_165_3.text: I know. You don't remember me now. But that's alright. This time, I promise I'll protect you.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_165_3.zh: 是啊，你们现在已经认不出我了，没关系，这次我一定会保护好你们。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_165_3.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_166_17.text: I'll take you home, to the one place that'll still have us...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_166_17.zh: 我带你们回家，接纳我们的地方……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_166_17.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_166_20.text: I'm back here once again. May we never wake from this dream
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_166_20.zh: 我又回到了这里，愿这个梦永远不会醒来
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_166_20.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_166_3.text: Day 128. At last, I've fulfilled my deal with Meta...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_166_3.zh: 直至和梅塔完成交易的那一天，第128天……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_166_3.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_166_5.text: It broke the deal and cleansed the curses I'd been carrying
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_166_5.zh: 祂违反了约定，反而清除了我身上的诅咒
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_166_5.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_167_2.text: Same as always, once I draw all their curses onto myself, they can...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_167_2.zh: 只要和以前一样，我把大家身上的诅咒全都转移到我自己的身上，就能……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_167_2.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_167_3.text: ...Strange. Something feels different this time. Like something inside me shifted.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_167_3.zh: ……奇怪，总觉得这次转移后我的身体发生了些变化。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_167_3.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_169_1.text: Miss Lily, they say this train'll carry us home...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_169_1.zh: 莉莉小姐，他们都说这辆列车会带我们回家……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_170_2.text: Mm. You left off just as you were leaving your hometown.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_170_2.zh: 嗯，我记得你讲到了你刚离开家乡……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_170_2.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_170_8.text: You really ought to have been more careful, sir.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_170_8.zh: 战士先生你应该更小心一点。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_170_8.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_171_5.text: Miss Conductor...? Call me Miss Lily. You may not remember me now, but you used to talk my ear off.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_171_5.zh: 列车长姐姐……叫我莉莉姐姐吧，也许你已经不记得我了，但以前的你可是个小话痨哦。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_171_5.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_173_1.text: My head's splitting... I can't stay here any longer. I need to get back to the conservatory...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_173_1.zh: 头好痛……不能继续留在这里了，我得回到花房去……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_173_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_174_1.text: Where are all these Tacet Discords coming from? And why's everyone acting like they can't see them...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_174_1.zh: 这些残象是哪里来的？为什么大家像完全看不见它们一样……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_174_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_14.text: I couldn't just turn away from them. That wouldn't be fair.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_14.zh: 我无法对他们视而不见，这对他们不公平。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_14.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_25.text: I can't allow myself to harm others. The one to end me must be someone I choose myself.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_25.zh: 我不能伤害到其他人，毁灭我的人，我也能自己选择。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_25.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_44.text: Did I do something wrong when I drew out the curses this time? Or... has the method itself stopped working?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_44.zh: 是我这次诅咒的转移，出现差错了吗？还是说……转移的方法已经失效了？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_44.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_47.text: If that day comes, will you really destroy me...?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_47.zh: 如果真到了那一天……你……真的会毁灭我吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_47.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_48.text: You lied to me once already. How can I trust you again?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_48.zh: 你已经骗过我一次了，我还能再相信你吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_48.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_8.text: Every one, except you, Lily. A poor, desperate girl who held onto her kindness through it all.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_8.zh: 唯有你，莉莉，一个可怜、绝望的少女竟然始终未动摇内心的善良。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_8.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_1.text: I waited so long for a chance to draw close to you. Until a New Federate stumbled into the Somnoire by chance.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_1.zh: 我一直等待着与你接触的机会，直到一位误入心之集域的新联邦人出现……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_11.text: A chance... And what if I don't want this chance? When the girl called Lily turned the gun on herself, she asked herself three questions—
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_11.zh: 机会……那如果是我想要放弃掉这个机会呢？那个名叫莉莉的女孩把枪对准自己时，曾想了三个问题——
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_11.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_12.text: Why were we fighting this war? For that future they all talked about? But was there even a place for her in it?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_12.zh: 这场战争究竟是为了什么？是为了他们口中的未来吗，可她在这个未来还有一席之地吗。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_12.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_13.text: Why did these people have to die? Why did she get to decide who lived and who didn't?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_13.zh: 为什么死的是地上这些人？为什么她能有权力决定他人的生死？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_13.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_14.text: Even if she never pulled the trigger, in that moment, the girl called Lily was already dead.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_14.zh: 即便女孩那一枪没有叩响，但在那一刻，名为莉莉的女孩已经死了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_14.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_19.text: Soldiers told me to live. And then they all died. Became souls that don't even remember me.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_19.zh: 战士们死前让我好好活下去，可他们都死了，变成了不认识我的亡魂。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_19.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_20.text: And me? I had to force a smile and see them off, one by one, in the name of laying them to rest. And in the end, I was the only one left.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_20.zh: 我还得强撑着笑脸，以安息的名义送他们一个个离开，到最后只剩自己孤零零一人。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_20.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_22.text: I stood at the crossroads of the New Federation. Everyone around me kept moving forward, and I was the only one left behind. Falling further and further away...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_22.zh: 我站在新联邦的路口，身边的人都在向前走。只有我被甩在时代的后面，远远地……远远地……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_22.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_24.text: The one who lives is the one left with all the pain, aren't they? And now you're telling me to live.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_24.zh: 活下来的那个人才是最痛苦的，不是吗？现在，你告诉我好好活下去。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_24.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_3.text: I used the fragrance diffuser and dreams to sway your thinking—to kill me. That's the only way you get to leave.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_3.zh: 后来我不断利用香薰和幻梦来影响你的思考——杀了我，你才能离开这里。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_3.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_37.text: Everything's changing. Lily, what are you doing?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_37.zh: 空间在发生变化，莉莉，你要做什么？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_38.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束4_52_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_38.text:
The scene returns to the present. You are the person Lily has been searching for.

She begs you to kill her, but you refuse to accept that she has no other choice. You try to calm her, only for one of your words to strike a painful nerve. Her transformation accelerates, and she realizes she can no longer control her power. Fearing she might hurt you, Lily immediately sends you to another pocket of the Somnoire.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_38.zh: 时间线被拉回到了现在，你就是莉莉寻找的那个人。她请求你杀了她，你无法接受莉莉做出这样的选择，试图用言语稳定莉莉的情绪，可你其中的一句话却刺痛了莉莉。莉莉异变加剧，她意识到自己控制不住力量，想要伤害你，于是立刻把你传送到了另一片空间。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_4.text: But the white cat I played, the nightmares I wove... None of it moved you an inch.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_4.zh: 但无论是我扮演成白猫，还是我编织的噩梦，我做的一切似乎都没有影响到你。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_4.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_8.text: You should've told me all this sooner. Lily, let's think this through. Same as we did laying those soldiers to rest.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_177_8.zh: 你应该把这些事情更早告诉我。莉莉，我们先冷静一下，就像之前我们安息其他战士一样。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_179_2.text: Lily, can you hear me? This isn't the time for either of us to give up...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_179_2.zh: 莉莉，你能听见我说话吗？现在我们还没到放弃的时候……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_14.text: All this time you chose not to end her. What is it you want with Lily?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_14.zh: 你一直没有选择毁灭她，你究竟打算利用莉莉做什么？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_23.text: On the train, I lent Lily a dream. The ordinary life she might have had, if the war had never come.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_23.zh: 列车上，我借给了莉莉一个梦。如果战争没有发生，她本该拥有这样的日常。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_33.text: With all that said, {PlayerName}, let's strike a deal. One to save Lily.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_33.zh: 说了这么多，{PlayerName}，我们来做一次交易吧，关于拯救莉莉。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_33.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_35.text: Listen closely. Saving her comes down to three things. First is the source of the "curse." It springs from Lily's own pain and fear.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_35.zh: 听好了，要拯救她有三个关键点要记住，其一是“诅咒”的来源，那是莉莉自己的痛苦和恐惧化成的存在。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_35.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_41.text: I've fashioned a dreamland whose frequency closely mirrors a human's. Once you sever the curse from Lily, I can seal it away there forever.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_41.zh: 我备好了一片频率接近人类的梦境空间，当你将莉莉身上的诅咒分离后，我便能把它们永远地关进去。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_41.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_42.text: And that's the deal, terms and all. To save her, it'll take Lily, you, and me. All of our power. Not a single one of us can do it alone.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_42.zh: 交易的注意事项到此结束了，想要拯救她，莉莉、你、我，我们三人的力量都不可或缺。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_42.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_184_2.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_10_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_184_2.text: Lily is on the verge of losing control. Her fear might manifest in the form of monsters of flesh and form.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_184_2.zh: 莉莉处于濒临失控的状态，她心中的恐惧或许会异化成实体的怪物出现。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_188_5.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_14_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_188_5.text: But I've got nothing left... There's nowhere in this world that'd still have me...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_188_5.zh: 可我已经一无所有了，已经没有能容纳我的地方了……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_188_5.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_191_1.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_19_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_191_1.text: Where am I...? Who am I? Where am I going? I feel so sad. I can't remember anything at all.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_191_1.zh: 这里是……我是谁？我要去哪里？好难过，我想不起来
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_191_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_192_4.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_21_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_192_4.text: Don't be afraid, Miss Lily. We're all here with you...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_192_4.zh: 别害怕，莉莉小姐，我们都在……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_203_36.text: I'm sorry... I tried everything I could, and still, I couldn't save you...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_203_36.zh: ……对不起……无论怎么做……我还是救不了大家……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_203_36.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_203_4.text: But... I never made your wishes come true. All of it was only a dream I wove.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_203_4.zh: 可……你们的愿望根本没有实现，所有的一切，只是我编织的梦……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_203_4.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_204_1.text: I have to run. I can't let everything they entrusted to me be for nothing...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_204_1.zh: 跑起来，我不能辜负大家托付的东西……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_204_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_14.text: Yes. Maybe it doesn't matter what "happiness" truly is...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_14.zh: 嗯，也许真正的幸福是什么样子不重要……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_14.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_16.text: I'll carry what they left me. All of it. And I'll live.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_16.zh: 我会带着他们托付的那份东西活下去。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_16.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_20.text: I know they will never heal, and they're still hurting. But that's proof that the dead once lived.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_20.zh: 我知道它永远不会痊愈，也很疼，但它是那些已逝之人活过的证明。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_20.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_25.text: That frequency that just held me... It was yours, wasn't it? Thank you for bringing them all here.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_25.zh: 刚刚环绕我的频率，是你的力量吧，谢谢你把他们带到这里来……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_25.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_34.text: But my world's still crawling with monsters you can't even see...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_34.zh: 可我的世界里，还充斥着你们看不见的怪物……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_34.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_36.text: My real enemies... I have to... raise my gun...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_36.zh: 真正的敌人……我……我必须……拿起枪来……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_36.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_45.text: And that's something I'll protect no matter what.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_45.zh: 也是我必须要守护的东西。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_45.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_46.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束5_13_2
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_46.text:
As Lily begins to run, a familiar voice calls out to her.  It is her younger self, still trapped in the war, asking repeatedly whether Lily is truly ready to face tomorrow. Lily gives her answer, and the two embrace, a sign that she has finally accepted the scars of her past.

Having made peace with who she once was, Lily is ready to move forward. You approach and offer her your hand. One final step remains: you encourage her to raise the gun and aim at the monsters only she can see. They, not the people around her, are the true enemies she must face.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_207_46.zh: 莉莉向前跑时，熟悉的声音叫住了她。原来是战争中过去的自己，她不断质问着莉莉是否真的决定好要前往明天。莉莉告诉了她答案，随后两人相拥，也代表莉莉接纳了过去的伤疤。现在，莉莉与过去的告别已经完成了，你从远处走来，向莉莉伸手，还剩下最后一步。你鼓励莉莉拿起枪，把枪口对准她眼中那些不存在的怪物，它们才是莉莉真正的敌人。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_208_12.text: I'll collect all kinds of scents, make the best perfume in the whole world!
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_208_12.zh: 收集不同的香料，做出最厉害的香水！
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_208_12.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_209_56.text: I'm fine. Just a little weak, and... Never mind. Don't fuss over me.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_209_56.zh: 还好，只是有些使不上力气，而且总觉得……没什么，不用担心我了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_209_56.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_1.text: ...You're back? I'm sorry. I don't know why, but I feel so terribly sleepy... Who was at the door?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_1.zh: ……你回来了，不好意思，总觉得很困……刚刚外面是？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_14.text: Is that so? It didn't mention anything about "price"?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_14.zh: 真的吗？难道没有什么代价的话题吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_14.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_16.text: It's a deity that lives for its bargains. To save me, you must've struck a deal with it.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_16.zh: 祂是一个喜好做交易的神明，为了拯救我，你一定跟祂做了交易吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_16.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_17.text: Besides, I can feel something's still wrong with me. More and more memories are slipping away.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_17.zh: 而且，我也能察觉到我身体仍有些异样，我感觉我忘记的东西越来越多。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_17.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_20.text: ...So that's why I've been forgetting so much. In the end, I won't even remember you.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_20.zh: ……所以我忘记的东西才越来越多，到最后我或许再也不记得你。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_20.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_21.text: It's alright. At the very least... you'll remember for me. Won't you? The world is a big place. I'm sure we'll meet again someday.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_21.zh: ……没关系，至少你记得，不是吗？世界这么大，我们总有机会，再次相遇的。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_21.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_22.text: Besides, in that dreamland you gave me, I found myself thinking about something...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_22.zh: 而且在你给我的那场幻梦中，我就抱有一个这样的想法了……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_22.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_23.text: Let me think... I suppose I should start with the very first time we met.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_23.zh: 我想想……应该从我们最初的相遇说起。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_23.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_24.text: If I could do it all again, I'd rather have met, talked, and walked with you as an ordinary perfumer girl.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_24.zh: 如果能重来，我更想以普通调香师女孩的身份与你相遇、聊天、同行。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_24.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_29.text: This is my last day in the Somnoire. I'll be leaving soon. Perhaps I'll cross paths with {Male=him;Female=her} again, in...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_29.zh: 这是我在心之集域的最后一天，我会离开这里。也许我会和{TA}重新相遇，相遇的场景是……是……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_29.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_32.text: In Startorch Academy. I'd tell people from all over about the soldiers' stories, so they'd know how cruel war can be.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_32.zh: 是星炬学院。我把战士们的故事告诉给了世界各地的人，让大家知道战争是很可怕的东西。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_32.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_34.text: And I'd learn those dances from Rinascita. I wouldn't step on my partner's toes anymore. I imagine the day we cross paths again might fall on a...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_34.zh: 我也学会了黎那汐塔的舞蹈，不会再踩着舞伴的脚，相遇的那天也许是个……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_34.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_42.text: Yes... that's it. No lies. No pain. Our first meeting might just be that simple and ordinary.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_42.zh: 嗯，一定是这样，没有骗局，也没有苦痛，初次相遇就应该如此平凡又普通。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_42.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_45.text: Thank you... To be honest, I'm still a little frightened. You, the soldiers, Meta—you all saved me. But you're the only one who has to be erased from my memory.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_45.zh: 谢谢你……到最后，其实还是有点儿害怕，是你和战士们、梅塔一同拯救了我，可唯独你消失了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_45.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_48.text: I'm scared... I want to make that journey we took in the dreamland come true...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_48.zh: 我很害怕……我很想把幻梦里的旅行变成现实……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_48.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_49.text: But... why do you have to be the one who disappears...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_49.zh: 可是……为什么偏偏你要消失……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_49.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_53.text: Well. I think it's time for me to go. Please take care of Lily for me.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_53.zh: 我也该离开了，接下来，莉莉就拜托你们照顾了。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_58.text: Right then. It's time we helped Lily settle her frequency.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_58.zh: 好了，接下来我们该帮莉莉稳定她的频率了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_58.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_60.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束5_16_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_60.text:
Meta leaves you and Lily alone for your final moments together. Lily senses that something is wrong with her body and realizes that you must have struck a deal with Meta to save her. Whatever you say, she knows there will be a price. When she learns what it is, she comforts you instead, reminding you that the world is vast and that you may yet meet again.

As Lily grows increasingly drowsy, you suggest writing in her diary together to help her stay awake. Side by side, you record a scene of your imagined reunion in the future.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_60.zh: 梅塔把最后时光留给了你和莉莉。莉莉察觉到了自己身体的异常，无论你如何选择，她都明白你为了拯救她，一定和梅塔做了交易，而梅塔会向你索取代价。在得知代价后，莉莉倒安慰起你来——世界如此之大，我们总有机会再次相遇。后来，莉莉越来越困，为了保持住意识，你提出用写日记的方式来集中精神，随后你们一同写下了未来再次相见的场景。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_25.text: For so long, all I could think about was destroying myself... so I never let myself grow close to you. I threw away every hope, and refused to lean on anyone.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_25.zh: 以前的我，一心想着毁灭自己……所以不想靠你太近，放弃希望的我，不想依赖上任何人。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_25.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_40.text: This is the price I have to pay. I've no right to refuse. Besides...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_40.zh: 这是我必须支付的东西，我没有选择的权利。而且……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_40.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_44.text: What about the things you told me when we struck the deal...?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_44.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_45.text: But... thank you. Truly. Because of your power, the soldiers and I finally have a place where we belong.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_45.zh: 但……真的谢谢你，因为你的力量，才让我和战士们有一个容身之处。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_45.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_51.text: Say, Little Ebony, do you think the boss has started treating Lily like an adopted daughter meow...?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_51.zh: 喂，小黑，你说主人是不是把莉莉小姐捡回来当女儿了喵……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_54.text: Go on, Lily. It doesn't matter that this was a dream. What matters is the choice you made because of it.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_54.zh: 向前走吧，莉莉，是不是梦并不重要，重要的是你因梦做出了何种选择。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_54.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_56.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束5_18_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_56.text: When Lily awakens, her memories of you have faded into a dream, leaving only a vague impression of your figure. As agreed, Meta asks whether she is willing to become its helper in the world beyond the Somnoire. Lily accepts and embraces the mysterious cat in gratitude. Her sincerity seems to move Meta, who grants her freedom and asks where she would like to go. Lily names a place, and Meta appears to have anticipated her choice. With that, it opens a gateway to the outside world.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_56.zh: 醒来后的莉莉，果然把与你之间的经历当作了一场梦，只记得你模模糊糊的身影。梅塔按照之前的交易，询问莉莉是否愿意成为祂的帮手。莉莉答应了梅塔，并拥抱祂来表达感谢。莉莉的真诚似乎打动了这位神秘的彩色小猫。梅塔给予了莉莉自由，询问她有没有想去的地方。莉莉说出了一个地名，这个地名似乎在梅塔意料之中，随后祂为莉莉打开了通往外界的门。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_213_7.text: Lily is awake now. Sorry to say she's completely forgotten you, though. But just as I did before, I gave her freedom and sent her off into the world...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_213_7.zh: 莉莉已经醒来了，遗憾的是她的确忘记了你，我和以前一样，重新给了她自由，让她去了外界……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_220_1.text: It's Lily. So she chose Startorch Academy. I wonder why...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_220_1.zh: 是莉莉，她的选择是星炬学院，可为什么……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_1.text: (After stepping through that Somnoire door, I found myself in Startorch Academy...)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_1.zh: （从心之集域的门离开后，我来到了星炬学院……）
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_14.text: I once had a dream about this place. But in the dream, my body just wouldn't let me, and I lost my chance. So I...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_14.zh: 其实我曾做了一场关于这里的梦，但在梦中我因为身体原因，错失了机会，所以……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_14.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_2.text: (In that dream, those soldiers and a dark silhouette kept telling me to keep going...)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_2.zh: （在那场梦里，战士们和一个模糊的黑影一直鼓励着我前进……）
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_2.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_22.text: (I don't know why I chose this place. Was it just a whim? Or did it have something to do with that dream and the diary?)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_22.zh: （我不知道为什么要选择来这里。是一时冲动，还是因为那场梦和那篇日记？）
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_22.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_23.text: (The only thing is, that person mentioned in those entries is...)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_23.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_24.text: R-really...? That would be wonderful! But could you give me just a moment? I want them to see this view, too.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_24.zh: 可，可以吗……那麻烦你了，不过请你先等一下，我想让他们也看看这般美丽的风景。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_24.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_26.text: I... I want to try riding the expedition motorbike.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_26.zh: 我……想试试驾驶科考摩托。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_26.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_27.text: (I'm starting to believe that maybe it wasn't just a dream after all. But it doesn't really matter anymore.)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_27.zh: （我开始觉得那不是一场梦，但是不是梦已经不重要了。）
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_27.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_28.text: (Because my quiet life begins today. Even if some scars will take a long, long time to heal.)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_28.zh: （因为我平凡又普通的生活就此开始了，尽管有些伤疤还需要漫长的时间去治愈。）
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_28.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_29.text: (This is my first day away from the war... and the tomorrow I promised them I would see...)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_29.zh: （这是我离开战争的第一天，也是我答应他们要去看的明天……）
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_29.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_3.text: (Everything here looks just like it did in the dream. Robots of all kinds, students chattering excitedly about their futures and passions.)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_3.zh: （这里的一切和梦里一模一样，各式各样的机器人，畅谈未来和理想的学生。）
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_3.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_31.text:
Lily leans against a railing at Startorch Academy. Although she remembers her experiences with you only as a hazy dream, she has been following what the two of you wrote in the diary. You realize that Meta never destroyed the diary, allowing you to find Lily once more. This time, there is no need for dreamlands. You can take her into the real world and let her experience all the things she once longed for.

This is Lily's first day beyond the war, and the tomorrow she promised the fallen soldiers she would live to see.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_31.zh: 莉莉靠在学院的栏杆上，她把与你的经历当作了模糊的梦，并按照日记中你们所写的内容行动。你意识到梅塔并没有把日记销毁，于是重新出现在了莉莉面前，不用再依靠幻梦，这次你能带着莉莉真实地体验她所想要的一切。这是莉莉离开战争的第一天，也是她答应战士们要去看的明天。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_4.text: (And just like what was written in the diary, it's the afternoon, and I've drawn quite a few curious looks from the students...)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_4.zh: （这里和日记里写的也一样，现在是下午，我被学生们用好奇的目光围住……）
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_4.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_9.text: Mm... Hello. My name is Lily. I'm a traveling perfumer.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_9.zh: 嗯……你好，我叫莉莉，是旅行到此的调香师。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_221_9.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_225_2.chapter: 剧情_3_8_通用和碎片化文本_3_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_225_2.text: I don't trust anyone here, except Miss Lily and the train broadcast.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_225_2.zh: 这里除了莉莉小姐和列车广播能相信外，其他人我都不相信。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_230_1.text: What a good seat. It's right in front of the stage.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_230_1.zh: 这个位置不错，面朝着舞台。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_230_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_230_2.text: Go on, {PlayerName}. The stage is just ahead.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_230_2.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_234_1.text: Miss Lily, I had a nightmare. Everyone was...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_234_1.zh: 莉莉小姐，我刚做了一个噩梦，我梦见大家都……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_234_2.text: Shh. It was only a dream. Don't dwell on it. Try to rest now.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_234_2.zh: 嘘，那只是梦而已，不要想太多了，好好休息吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_234_2.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_235_1.text: I haven't finished checking on all the wounded yet. I'll talk to her afterward.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_235_1.zh: 伤员的情况还没有了解完，等会儿再去找她吧……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_235_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_236_1.text: All the wounded have been seen to. Time to find her.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_236_1.zh: 伤员的情况了解得差不多了，现在去找她吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_236_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_237_8.text: Today I find myself in the Somnoire... No. For them, this is the world of the dead...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_237_8.zh: 今天是我在心之集域……不，对他们来说，这里应该叫做亡魂世界……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_237_8.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_241_5.chapter: 剧情_3_8_主线钢琴家、迷宫和花海玩法_20_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_241_5.text: The wind... Where did it come from? Where are you taking me?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_241_5.zh: 风……又是从哪里来的，你要带我去哪里？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_241_5.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_5.text: You've noticed it too, I'm sure. Even with the curses purged, Lily is still weak.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_5.zh: 你也注意到了吧？就算把莉莉身上的诅咒清除掉了，她的状态还是很虚弱。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_5.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_67.text: Lily won't stay awake much longer. I'll leave these last few moments to the two of you.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_67.zh: 莉莉保持清醒的时间不多了，最后的时光，我就留给你们吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_67.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_75.text: But Lily, my Resonator... I only hope she'll prove herself useful.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_75.zh: 至于莉莉，我的共鸣者吗……希望真的能起作用吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_75.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_41_13.text: Then let me introduce myself. I'm Lily, a psychotherapist with the army, and the conductor of this train for now. If anything's weighing on you, I'm here to listen.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_41_13.zh: 还没向你介绍自己，我叫莉莉，是军队里的心理疗愈师，也是这辆列车的临时列车长，你有什么烦恼都可以告诉我。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_41_13.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_41_17.text: That's right, soldier. Are you having trouble with your memory? Don't fret. We'll take it slow.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_41_17.zh: 对啊，战士{Male=先生;Female=小姐}是遇见了失忆的问题吗？没关系，我们可以慢慢来。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_41_17.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_41_25.text: Come with me. I've got a feeling another soldier's been swallowed by their own "guilt."
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_41_25.zh: 先跟我来吧，或许又有战士被自己背负的“罪”吞噬掉了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_41_25.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_41_52.text: Let's start with something simple. Can you recall your name?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_41_52.zh: 战士{Male=先生;Female=小姐}还记得自己的名字吗，我们从名字开始回忆吧……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_41_52.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_41_53.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束2_9_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_41_53.text: Following the onboard announcement, you arrive at the Conservatory Carriage, where a soldier's prayer to return home drifts from within. Deeper inside, you witness the soldier transform into a lily before a young woman. Mistaking you for a fellow Resonator soldier, she invites you to sit. Her name is Lily, a military psychotherapist currently serving as the train's conductor. Believing you have lost your memory, she gives you an opportunity to explain who you really are. Before you can ask her more, a commotion erupts beyond the door. Lily asks you to follow her and investigate.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_41_53.zh: 根据广播提示，你来到了花房车厢，花房深处传来一位战士祈祷回家的声音。你继续向前，目睹了战士在一位少女面前化作了百合花。少女似乎把你也当作了共鸣者战士，邀你入座。她名叫莉莉，是军队里的心理疗愈师，也是这辆列车的临时列车长。莉莉误以为你是失去了记忆的战士，你趁此机会解释了自己的身份。在你要追问其他问题时，门外传来了吵闹声，莉莉让你先跟上她，出去查看情况。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_42_2.text: It's a kind of brokenness that takes root in their minds after all the fighting...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_42_2.zh: 战后心理创伤引发的一种精神障碍……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_42_2.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_42_4.text: {PlayerName}, stay close to me from here on. The ones consumed by their guilt... they're dangerous.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_42_4.zh: {PlayerName}，接下来请你紧紧跟在我身后，负罪的他们……很危险。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_42_4.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_44_28.text: Don't worry. I've done this more times than I can count. I know how to handle it.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_44_28.zh: 别担心，像这样的情况我遇见很多次了，我能应付。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_44_28.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_44_30.text: Soldier. Look at me. Breathe. This train isn't taking you to another war. It's taking you home.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_44_30.zh: 战士先生，冷静下来，看着我的眼睛，这辆列车不是送你前往下一个战场的，它是带你回家的。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_44_30.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_44_36.text: {PlayerName}, I imagine you've got questions. Based on what you told me earlier...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_44_36.zh: {PlayerName}，现在你应该有很多疑惑吧，接着刚刚我们的话题……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_44_36.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_44_37.text: You're still alive, and you shouldn't be here. This is a Train of Souls.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_44_37.zh: 你是生者，你不应该出现在这里，这是一辆灵魂列车。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_44_37.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_44_57.text: No crackling fires. No thunder of shells. No voices calling roll. I promise you... you'll never hear those sounds again.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_44_57.zh: 木头燃烧的声音，炸弹爆炸的声音，报数的口号声……请相信我，你不会再听见这些声音了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_44_57.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_44_59.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束2_53_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_44_59.text: In the Lounge Carriage, you find a soldier pointing a gun at those around him, shouting, "Someone stop this train!" Fearing for Lily's safety, you try to stop her from approaching him. She simply shakes her head, assuring you that she has handled such incidents countless times. She then approaches the soldier and gently calms him. Just as before, he transforms into a lily before her eyes. No one around you seems surprised; the passengers simply disperse as though nothing happened. Lily turns to you and quietly explains, "You're still alive, and you shouldn't be here. This is a Train of Souls."
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_44_59.zh: 你们来到大厅，发现一名战士正举枪威胁着周围的人：“谁来把这辆车停下来！”你害怕莉莉受伤，想要制止她上前。莉莉摇摇头，告诉你别担心，这样的情况她已经遇见很多次了。随后莉莉走到战士面前，用温柔的话语安抚战士的情绪，和在花房一样，战士在莉莉面前化为了一束百合。你发现周围的人对此都没有感到意外，仿佛什么事都没发生，众人就散去了。莉莉此时回过头望向你，轻轻说道：“你是生者，你不应该出现在这里，这是一辆灵魂列车。”

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_10.text: When I woke up after I died, I was already here. I had the same questions you do. What is this place? What is this train?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_10.zh: 死后的我，醒来时已经在这辆列车上了。刚开始我抱着和你相同的疑惑，这辆列车究竟是什么？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_10.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_12.text: Then I realized it was carrying me through war zones. And it draws the dead aboard. One by one.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_12.zh: 后来我发现它带着我不断穿梭在战场里，吸引死去的战士登上列车。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_12.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_15.text: I reckon it's something the train gave me. I was a medic in life. All I ever did was try to soothe the wounded. This isn't so different.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_15.zh: 那似乎是这辆列车赋予我的能力，我是军医，我只是像生前一样，尽量去安抚战士们所受的创伤。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_15.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_16.text: Over time, I noticed when a soul's wounds are fully healed, they transform. Into a lily.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_16.zh: 渐渐地，我发现精神创伤被完全治愈的亡魂，会化为一束百合。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_16.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_18.text: So I keep doing it. The therapy. The praying, all of it. I want their souls to find peace.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_18.zh: 于是，我就一直重复着这样的行为，治愈并为他们祈祷——愿这些灵魂不再迷惘。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_18.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_21.text: A new stop. Come with me, {PlayerName}. There's something I want to show you. It'll help you understand this train a little better.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_21.zh: 新站点要到了，{PlayerName}，先跟我来这边，你看了这个之后，对这辆列车会有更多的了解。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_21.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_22.text: Maybe it's because they only remember pieces of their lives. But I remember everything. I was the first passenger on this train.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_22.zh: 也许是因为他们只记得生前部分的记忆，而我记得所有，我是这辆列车的第一位乘客。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_22.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_23.text: Forgive me. It's been a long time since I've spoken to someone alive. I'm out of practice. I've been rambling...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_23.zh: 抱歉，太久没和生者说过话，我有点儿不习惯，我是不是说得太多了……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_23.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_25.text: Just what it sounds like. A train that carries the dead to their final rest.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_25.zh: 和它的字面意思一样，一辆搭载着亡魂，开往安息之地的列车。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_25.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_26.text: The battlefield you crossed was a corner of the Resonator War. Everyone on this train, myself included, died in that war.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_26.zh: 你穿越的那片战场是共鸣者战争的一角，我和列车上的乘客都是在那场战争中死去的人。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_26.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_27.text: Pain. Despair. Hatred. All the things that fester out there have poisoned our souls. They keep us from finding peace.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_27.zh: 苦痛、绝望、怨恨……这些在战场上肆意滋生的东西，污染着我们死后的灵魂，让我们不能安息。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_45_27.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_16.text: Investigating... I see. Well then, {PlayerName}, as temporary conductor, I welcome you aboard. If you need anything, you just come find me.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_16.zh: 调查的事件……好吧，那{PlayerName}，我作为临时列车长，欢迎你登上列车，有什么需要可以随时找我。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_16.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_19.text: But let me give you a quick tour first. We've got the Conservatory Carriage and Lounge Carriage, as well as various Private Compartments for passengers.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_19.zh: 先给你简单介绍一下，列车大致分为花房车厢、大厅车厢以及各个乘客的专属客房。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_19.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_2.text: See this? It's a train's station board. Each stop is... how to describe it. It's where certain souls get off.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_2.zh: 看，这是列车的站点表，上面指向的是……我想想，要形容的话，它们是一些特殊亡魂的下车站点。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_2.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_20.text: Make yourself comfortable in the lounge for now. Once I've finished with the souls at this stop, I'll get you checked into your compartment.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_20.zh: 你先在大厅稍作休息，我处理完执念亡魂的事情后，就帮你办理客房的入住。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_20.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_23.text: Oh? No, really, you don't have to. You're a passenger. You should be enjoying the ride.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_23.zh: 诶？不用不用，你是列车上的乘客，好好享受乘客的待遇就好了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_23.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_3.text: Yes. Actually, when you mentioned a "ferry," it reminded me of a story I once heard.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_3.zh: 嗯，你刚刚提到的“摆渡船”，就让我联想到，我曾听过的一篇童话故事。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_3.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_30.text: Their unfinished business runs deep, so I have to find a different way to help them make peace with themselves before they can become lilies.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_30.zh: 他们因为执念过深，我需要通过特殊的方式帮助他们与自己和解，化为百合。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_30.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_32.text: A train that races through the galaxy, carrying the departed from station to station, until finally, it reaches the gates of heaven.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_32.zh: 一辆驰骋在银河的列车，带着逝者驶过一个个特殊的站点，最后奔向幸福的天堂。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_32.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_34.text: Are you sure? A living person, surrounded by the dead. What if...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_34.zh: 没关系吗？生者和死者们待在一起，会不会……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_34.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_36.text: ...You make a fair point. I haven't the faintest idea what might happen to a living person left alone on this train.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_36.zh: ……你说得也有道理，放任生者一个人待在列车上，我也不知道会不会发生意外。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_36.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_37.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束2_12_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_37.text: Lily explains that some souls have much deeper unfinished business. The only way they can find peace and turn into lilies is to get off the train at their own specific stops. You remark that everything here feels like something out of a fairy tale, prompting Lily to recount a story about a train that travels across the Milky Way, carrying the departed from one special stop to another until they finally reach the gates of heaven. Inspired by this tale, Lily has devoted herself to comforting the souls aboard, hoping that one day the train will reach heaven and finally come to a stop. Though she worries about your safety as a living person aboard the train, you reassure her and decide to stay, accompanying her to learn how these souls find peace.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_37.zh: 莉莉告诉你，列车上存在一些执念过深的特殊亡魂，他们会在属于自己的站点下车，并通过特殊的方式化为百合。你觉得这里的一切就像童话故事里描述的场景，莉莉接着你的话，讲述起了一篇童话——一辆驰骋在银河的列车，带着逝者驶过一个个特殊的站点，最后奔向幸福的天堂。原来莉莉一直在安抚亡魂，也是受这篇童话影响。她希望这辆列车能到达天堂，最终停下来。莉莉有些担心你作为生者，在列车上不安全。你让她放心，决定暂时留在这里并跟随莉莉，了解特殊的安息方式。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_5.text: Maybe this train is the same. If I can lay every soul to rest, maybe it'll finally stop at those gates, too.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_5.zh: 也许这辆列车也是如此，那如果我把所有亡魂都安息了，它是不是就会停下，到达故事中幸福的天堂。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_5.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_8.text: Mm, I want to try. But then you appeared... No living person has ever set foot here. This is a world for the dead. You need to leave.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_8.zh: 嗯，我想试试，但现在你出现了……从来没有生者踏入过这里，这里是属于亡魂的世界，你得离开这里。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_8.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_9.text: But I don't know if there's another way to stop the train so you can get off...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_9.zh: 可我不知道还有没有其他办法先让列车停下，让你离开……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_9.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_48_31.text: {PlayerName}, the Station of the Lost is this way. Compartment 01. Let's go.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_48_31.zh: {PlayerName}，「迷途之站」在这边，房间号是01，我们走吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_48_31.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_49_2.text: What is it? Oh, interested in these paintings, {PlayerName}?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_49_2.zh: 怎么了？{PlayerName}，你对挂画感兴趣吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_49_2.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_15.text: It's the key to reaching the stations. See, the train doesn't truly stop, not in the way you'd expect.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_15.zh: 是我们前往亡魂站点的媒介，这辆列车不会真正意义上地停靠在“某个站点”。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_15.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_16.text: Yes. And soon, we'll follow him. The train doesn't stop at real stations. We have to use this perfume to step off.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_16.zh: 嗯，很快我们也会和他一样。这辆列车与现实不同，它不会停靠在真正意义上的站点，所以我们就要借助这瓶香水来下车。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_16.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_17.text: Drawing from each soul's frequency, I use this special perfume to weave a brief dreamland for them.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_17.zh: 我能利用特殊的香水，借由亡魂的频率编织出属于他们的短暂幻梦。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_17.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_18.text: That dreamland becomes their "final stop," the place where I say goodbye to them.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_18.zh: 以这场幻梦作为他们旅途的最后“站点”，以此送别他们。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_18.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_20.text: It isn't hard to guess. That question is his unfinished business.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_20.zh: 其实不难猜测，这个问题就是他的执念。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_20.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_22.text: Can you smell it? Top note is jasmine, light and fresh. Then the rose, warm and full. And at the very end, a deep, deep sleep...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_22.zh: 闻到了吗？这瓶香水前调带着一丝茉莉的清香，随后是馥郁的玫瑰，最后就是深沉的梦……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_22.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_33.text: "Mister, miss, are you the person Mama sent to pick me up?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_33.zh: “大哥哥，大姐姐，你是妈妈派来接我的人吗？”
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_33.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_34.text: ...{PlayerName}? Perfume's starting to work on you. Don't fight it. Just relax, let your head rest back, like you're drifting off to sleep...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_34.zh: ……{PlayerName}？看起来香水开始对你起作用了，接下来放轻松，头轻轻往后靠，就像你平常入梦那样……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_50_34.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_59_2.text: (This dreamland is holding steady. Until I find Lily, I'll keep playing as this Attendant.)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_59_2.zh: （幻梦目前一切正常，在找到莉莉前，先继续扮演好乘务员的角色吧。）

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_56.text: (Wait, if Lily were playing a role like me, she wouldn't have needed to change into a different uniform.)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_64_56.zh: （不对，如果莉莉跟我一样是扮演角色的话，她根本没有必要换上新的服饰。）

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_67_15.text: Remember what Lily said before she left? Kids who follow the rules get the best rewards at the end.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_67_15.zh: 还记得莉莉姐姐走之前怎么说的吗？遵守规则的孩子，才会获得最终的奖励哦。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_20.text: Like Miss Lily, the soldiers who protected you, and this door... showing up right when you needed it.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_20.zh: 莉莉姐姐也好，保护你的战士叔叔，战士阿姨们也好，还有这扇重新出现在你面前的门。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_51.text: (That smell... flowers. Is Lily in there...?)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_72_51.zh: （这是……花的香味，难道莉莉她就在……）

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_11.text: Looks like it's dinner time. You must be hungry, {PlayerName}. You can head to the Lounge Carriage for your meal.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_11.zh: 看来，晚餐时间到了。{PlayerName}，你应该也饿了吧，现在可以前往大厅车厢用餐了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_11.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_12.text: {PlayerName}, are you alright? Did that dreamland make you feel unwell at all?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_12.zh: {PlayerName}，你还好吧？在刚刚的幻梦里身体有没有不舒服的地方。
