yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_12.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_2.text: Did you run into the "me" from his memories in there?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_2.zh: 你在梦中是不是还遇见了过去的我？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_2.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_23.text: For a soul to truly find peace, it has to face what it has lost.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_23.zh: 而亡魂要想得到真正的安息，也需要坦然面对自己曾失去的东西。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_23.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_5.text: And when I saw his dream replaying on this train, it clicked. He never really came to terms with his mother's death. He'd trapped himself in that game to hide from the truth.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_5.zh: 当看到他的幻梦在列车上重演，我就明白，他仍为当初未能勇敢面对母亲的离世而耿耿于怀，将自己困在了那场游戏里。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_73_5.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_77_6.text: Right... right. Miss Lily told me not to dwell on things. But I can't remember anything. I don't know what I'm forgettin'... Or why...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_77_6.zh: 好……好，莉莉小姐也告诉过我不要想太多，可我根本什么都想不起来，我究竟……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_77_9.text: (Will the same happen to Lily one day? If it does, if the train never stops, what becomes of them all...?)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_77_9.zh: （莉莉有一天也会和他们一样吗？到那时，如果列车还没停下，那他们该何去何从……）

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_10.text: See? There it is. Though I reckon this world has its own rules. I've only ever been able to conjure food.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_10.zh: 看，食物出现了。不过这个世界或许还有自己的规则，一直以来我只能成功想象出食物这类东西。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_10.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_14.text: Oh, steaming hot. But... are those chili peppers floating on top?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_14.zh: 哇，热气腾腾的食物，但……汤汁表面漂浮的是辣椒吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_14.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_16.text: I can eat it, just not much. I grew up in a garden. My family grew mostly flowers and herbs.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_16.zh: 能吃，但吃得很少，我是在花圃里长大的孩子，家里种植的大多数是花和药草。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_16.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_19.text: This... looks like field rations, {PlayerName}. Is this what you usually eat?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_19.zh: 这……看上去和军粮一样，{PlayerName}你喜欢吃这样的食物吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_19.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_21.text: Then go ahead and try it, {PlayerName}. See if it tastes the way you imagined.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_21.zh: 那{PlayerName}，赶紧尝尝味道吧，看是不是和你想象中的一样。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_21.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_24.text: Mm, yes. The world of the dead is something else, isn't it?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_24.zh: 嗯，亡魂的世界很神奇吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_24.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_35.text: What started it... I don't know. Before the war, I was just a perfumer. The day before, I was still working on a new scent.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_35.zh: 原因……我也不知道。战争爆发前，我只是一名调香师，前一天，我还在钻研新的香调。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_35.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_36.text: Then, the next day, soldiers kicked down my door. They carried in their comrade, begging me to weave a dreamland to ease his passing.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_36.zh: 第二天，一群战士破门而入，他们抬进来了自己的伙伴，请求我编织幻梦减轻他死前的痛苦。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_36.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_38.text: I did what they asked. I used my Resonance Ability. That was the first time I watched someone die in front of me.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_38.zh: 我按着他们说的，使用共鸣能力，那是我第一次目睹一条生命在眼前消逝。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_38.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_39.text: "Little girl, the war's started. Run." That was the last thing they said to me. I don't think most people ever knew why it began.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_39.zh: “小姑娘，战争开始了，快逃吧。”这是他们留下的最后一句话，我想也许大部分人都不知道战争为何而爆发。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_39.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_4.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, {PlayerName}. Let me show you how to get your meal. Look, out the window there.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_4.zh: {PlayerName}，久等了。我来教你如何领取晚餐吧，来，往窗边这边看。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_4.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_47.text: Don't worry about the missing pages. I've kept a diary since I was a child. My daily life, when flowers bloomed, perfume recipes...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_47.zh: 撕掉的这部分就不用在意了，我从小就有记录的习惯，日常生活、花朵的花期、香水的配方……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_47.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_48.text: When I first arrived here, I didn't know the day or month. So I started this log to keep track of passing time.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_48.zh: 抵达这里时，我不知道是几月几日，为了记录时间和日常，我便想到了这样的方式。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_48.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_49.text: You called this place the Somnoire. Maybe I should rewrite it—"Day 727 in the Somnoire..."
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_49.zh: 你刚刚说这里叫作心之集域，或许我该把这句话改写一下——这是在心之集域的第727天……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_49.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_51.text: {PlayerName}, if there really was a dream that felt exactly like reality, would you want to stay there forever?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_51.zh: 那{PlayerName}，如果存在一个与现实无异的梦，你愿意永远沉溺在其中吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_51.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_54.text: Your room's ready. Compartment 05. Goodnight, {PlayerName}. I hope you rest well.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_54.zh: 对了，房间已经为你准备好了，门牌号是05。晚安，{PlayerName}，希望你能度过一个愉快的夜晚。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_54.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_64.text: A dream... if only this really were a dream I could stay lost in forever...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_64.zh: 梦吗……但如果这真的是一场能永远沉溺其中的梦就好了……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_64.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_7.text: Yes, they're like scattered flecks of silver, aren't they? So close you could almost touch 'em. And that's where your meal is tucked away, too.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_7.zh: 是啊，那些碎银般的星星仿佛近在咫尺，其实你的食物就藏在那些星星里。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_7.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_70.text: Not much luck with anything else. Well, it's your turn to try.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_70.zh: 其他物品一律不行。好了，你也来试试。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_70.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_71.text: My folks always use fragrant herbs in their cooking. They used to say too much spice ruins your skin and dulls your sense of smell.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_71.zh: 所以我父母烹饪食物时，也总喜欢加一些清香的药草作为调料，他们常说吃太辣，对皮肤和嗅觉不太好。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_71.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_72.text: Whatever this place is, I believe you, {PlayerName}. You've been nothing but sincere with the souls on this train. You trusted me. So ask away.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_72.zh: 不管这里是什么，{PlayerName}，我相信你，就像你上车后真诚对待亡魂，愿意相信我一样，所以有什么问题你就问吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_72.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_73.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束2_36_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_73.text:
[…]

You haven't been waiting long in the Lounge Carriage when Lily arrives to show you how to order dinner.

[…]

You know it as the Somnoire, and you have come to investigate the anomalies within it.

[…]

You ask what caused the Resonator War, but Lily knows little about its origins.

[…]
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_73.zh: 你在大厅车厢没等多久，莉莉就走了过来，开始教你如何领取晚餐。只需要对着窗外的星空，闭上双眼去想象食物，食物便能出现在桌上。莉莉向你感叹亡魂的世界有许多神奇的地方。你借此机会也讲述了你对这个世界的看法，在你的认知中，这里被叫做心之集域，你是为调查这里的异变而来，所以你需要莉莉的帮助。莉莉选择了相信你，你询问起那场共鸣者战争的起因，可莉莉在战争爆发前，只是个普通的调香师，她什么都不知道，只是目睹着战火莫名地烧到了自己的家园。广播响起，提醒大家用餐时间即将结束。莉莉像是想起了什么，拿出一本日记，在上面写下了这是在亡魂世界的第727天……她解释说，因为自己没有了时间的概念，只能通过这种方式来记录时间。但如果按你的说法，莉莉有了新的想法，她将亡魂世界改成了心之集域，并询问你如果真存在一个与现实无异的梦，你愿意永远沉溺在其中吗？你摇摇头，给出了否定的回答。莉莉只是温柔地注视着你，没有回答，随后你们互道晚安，就回到各自的房间了。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_8.text: Patience. Think of this as a little magic trick. Your meal is tucked away in those stars.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_8.zh: 不要着急，接下来你就把要发生的事情当作一场小魔术吧，其实你的食物藏在那些星星里。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_8.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_9.text: Close your eyes. Quiet your mind. Picture the food you want, just like this...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_9.zh: 闭上双眼，静下心来，去想象你想要的食物，像这样……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_9.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_1.text: Back already? Want to chat a little more? I've told you so much about myself, now it's your turn...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_1.zh: 怎么了，用餐后还想再聊聊天吗？我说了这么多关于我的事情，你的呢……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_1.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_11.text: A key and a guilty soul... it makes me think of the twisted darkness these soldiers carry. What if this "guilty one" is some kind of vile monster?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_11.zh: 钥匙和罪人……让我联想到了战士们背负的污秽，你口中的那个罪人会不会是一只丑陋的怪物。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_11.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_12.text: Just like in the fairytales, it hides in the corner of the dream, pulling all the strings. The only way out is to kill it.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_12.zh: 就像童话故事讲述的那样，它藏在幻梦里操纵着一切，只有杀掉它，勇者才能脱离困境。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_12.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_13.text: If such a monster exists, {PlayerName}, promise me you'll destroy it.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_13.zh: 如果真存在那样的怪物，{PlayerName}，答应我，一定要杀掉它。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_13.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_17.text: ...I understand. This is only a guess, anyway. We'll cross that bridge if the monster really shows up.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_17.zh: ……也是，这毕竟只是一种假设，那我们就等到真有丑陋的怪物出现，再做打算吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_17.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_2.text: I'd love to hear stories from the world of the living.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_2.zh: 我也想听听生者在外面的故事。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_2.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_6.text: That's good to hear... as long as everyone's alright.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_6.zh: 这样啊……没有人受伤就好。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_6.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_7.text: You've been through a lot. I left a fragrance diffuser in your room. It might help you rest a little easier.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_7.zh: 你的状态也才刚刚恢复好，我在你房间放置了一瓶香薰，它能帮助你在车上睡个好觉。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_7.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_9.text: Not that I recall. Are they connected to what you're looking into?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_9.zh: 应该没有，它们和你要调查的事情有关联吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_79_9.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_81_15.text: Speakin' of which, I heard Miss Lily plays the piano, too.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_81_15.zh: 不过我听说莉莉小姐也会弹钢琴哦。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_81_3.text: Tell me somethin' I don't know. That girl's got more talent than you can shake a stick at. Music, dancin', cookin', paintin', card games, hand-to-hand combat...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_81_3.zh: 这也不是什么新鲜事了，莉莉小姐会的技艺多了去了。音乐、舞蹈、烹饪、绘画、棋牌游戏、格斗术……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_81_4.text: You reckon she comes from one of those noble families? You know, the kind that makes their kids learn a bit of everything?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_81_4.zh: 难道说莉莉小姐是联邦城的名流大小姐吗？小时候家里人让她学完这个，学那个。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_81_5.text: No way. She told us herself, she's just a small-town perfumer. No fancy background.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_81_5.zh: 不对，莉莉小姐不是说过吗，她只是来自小镇上的调香师，没什么特殊的身份。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_14.text: (Lily is the only one I can actually talk to on this train. And the things she told me...)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_84_14.zh: （列车上能正常交谈的只有莉莉，关于她说的话……）

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_86_3.text: Lily said the train might stop when all the souls on board find peace.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_86_3.zh: 莉莉曾说所有战士的灵魂得到安息后，就有可能让列车停下来。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_86_9.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束2_41_2
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_86_9.text: You discover that your WavesLine messages have failed to send, and suspect that the Somnoire is interfering with communications. With no way to reach the outside world, you have little choice but to remain aboard the train. You resolve to continue helping Lily lay souls to rest while searching for the truth.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_86_9.zh: 你发现飞讯消息发送失败，你猜测这也是受心之集域的影响。现在能做的只能是跟着列车继续向前，你决定继续帮助莉莉安息亡魂，查明真相。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_95_2.text: I need to find Lily. She's the most unique soul on the train. She should know what happened.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_95_2.zh: 先找到莉莉吧，她是车上最特殊的亡魂，她应该知道发生了什么。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_12.text: The stars out there are beautiful, aren't they? They say that after we die, we turn into stars, so the ones who love us can still see us when they look up.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_12.zh: 外面的星空很美丽，对吧。有种说法是人死后就会变成星星，挂在天空，这样思念自己的人抬头就能看见。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_12.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_13.text: But... why didn't the soldiers and I turn into stars? Is it because no one remembers us anymore?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_13.zh: 可……我和战士们为什么没有变成星星呢，是因为我们被遗忘了吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_13.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_16.text: Mm... that's a good way to put it, {PlayerName}. A gentle, white lie.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_16.zh: 嗯……{PlayerName}，你的回答是个很不错、很温柔的谎言。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_16.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_17.text: Look, that crimson starlight over there is burning like a flame. Do you remember the story I mentioned before?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_17.zh: 看，那片红色的星光就像一团火焰。还记得我提到过的那篇童话故事吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_17.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_18.text: Yes. In the story, there was a little scorpion who met a vicious beast one day.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_18.zh: 嗯，故事里讲到过去曾有一只小天蝎。有一天，它遇上了一头凶恶的野兽。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_18.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_19.text: Yes, and in its final moments, it began to think. Prayed, even: "How many lives have I hurt, just to end here, fallen and alone..."
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_19.zh: 嗯，所以在生命的最后时光，它开始思考并向神明祈祷：“我以前不知道伤害过多少生命，最终还是落到了这般下场。”
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_19.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_20.text: "If only I'd let that beast eat me. It would've lived another day, and maybe nobody else would've had to die for it."
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_20.zh: “那我为什么不乖乖让那头野兽吃掉自己呢？吃掉我，它或许就不会伤害别人，它也能多活一天。”
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_20.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_22.text: As if hearing the little scorpion's wish, god set its body ablaze, raising it into the sky to light up the dark night...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_22.zh: 神明仿佛听到了小天蝎的愿望，于是让它的身体燃起了火焰，升入星空，照亮了黑暗的四周……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_22.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_23.text: But I think to that little scorpion, sacrificing itself for everyone else's happiness, that joy must've outweighed the sorrow in the end.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_23.zh: 但我觉得在小天蝎眼里，用一个人的牺牲换取所有人的幸福，幸福在最后的重量终究是大于悲伤。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_23.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_3.text: Lily, there are Tacet Discords on the train. The soldiers have all disappeared. Do you know what happened?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_3.zh: 莉莉，车上出现了残象，其他战士都消失了，是发生了什么吗？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_31.text: It must've been a nightmare. I had one, too, and now I can't get back to sleep. How about we chat for a bit, {PlayerName}?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_31.zh: 你是做噩梦了吧，我也是，做噩梦后我就睡不着了，{PlayerName}，陪我聊聊天吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_31.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_33.text: Running for its life, the scorpion accidentally fell into a well. And as much as it tried, it just couldn't climb out.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_33.zh: 小天蝎逃命时不小心掉进了一口井里，它发现自己怎么爬也爬不上来。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_33.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_36.text: Right. Happiness or sorrow... which one was this ending meant to leave us with?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_36.zh: 是啊，幸福和悲伤，究竟哪一个才是这个结局想表达的东西呢？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_36.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_38.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_8_予以明日的花束2_50_1
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_38.text: You arrive at the conservatory and sense something strange about Lily. But the feeling vanishes as quickly as it came. She greets you as usual, assuming you've had a nightmare just as she has, and leads you to the window, hoping for some company. Then, she resumes the story she left unfinished...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_38.zh: 你来到花房，莉莉给人的感受有些奇怪。可眨眼间，那股违和感又消失了。莉莉正常地呼喊着你的名字，她以为你和她一样是做噩梦了，将你带到了花房的窗户前，希望你能陪她聊聊天。接着，莉莉讲述起了之前那篇未讲完的童话……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_4.text: I know. But don't you worry. Once you've fulfilled your mission, everything will be set right.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_4.zh: 我知道，但不用担心，只要你履行完任务，一切都会结束。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_4.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_6.text: Aren't you here to investigate the connection between the Resonator War and the Somnoire? You came to fix the anomaly here... Kill ▇▇, and all shall be well.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_6.zh: 你不正是为了调查共鸣者战争与心之集域的关联，解决这里的异变而来……杀了▇▇ ，一切问题都解决了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_6.speaker: Lily

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_9.text: Lily, are you alright? There were Tacet Discords on the train...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_97_9.zh: 莉莉，你没受伤吧，列车上刚刚出现了残象……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_99_1.text: (Was that... a nightmare? Why would I dream of killing Lily?)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_99_1.zh: （那是……做噩梦了吗，为什么我会梦见亲手杀掉莉莉的画面？）

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_99_4.text: Maybe... We're arriving at the next station. Let's go find Lily.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_99_4.zh: 也许吧……新的站点要到了，我们先去找莉莉吧。

yakita:LGNCZSTBC_1_3.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_旧贵族女补充生态_1_1
yakita:LGNCZSTBC_1_3.text: Then there's Lilyland Fashion Week, and the heart-pounding battles of Septimont...
yakita:LGNCZSTBC_1_3.zh: 还有莉莉兰德的时装周，还有七丘角斗的热血沸腾……

yakita:NPC_LHLSTHY_36_2.text: I remember the way people live in Lilyland is very different from here.
yakita:NPC_LHLSTHY_36_2.zh: 我记得莉莉兰德的生活习惯和这里差别很大。

yakita:NPC_LHLSTHY_3_3.text: He eventually left and traveled to many countries before settling down and spending his remaining days in Lilyland.
yakita:NPC_LHLSTHY_3_3.zh: 后来，他离开新联邦，游历多国，最后在莉莉兰德终老。

yakita:NPC_LNXTMDST_3_7.text: But, whether we head to the Lilyland's Sea of Flowers or the exhilarating spectacles of Septimont, it's up to the captain to decide!
yakita:NPC_LNXTMDST_3_7.zh: 但，是要去莉莉兰德的花海，还是去七丘体验竞技带来的感官刺激，还得船长决定！

yakita:NPC_LNXTMDST_4_1.text: Is there really no hope? If we head to Lilyland or Septimont... surely there's somewhere that will take us in...
yakita:NPC_LNXTMDST_4_1.zh: 真、真的没办法了吗……要是去莉莉兰德、去七丘……总有能接纳我们的地方吧……

yakita:InfoDisplay_32010022_Text.text:
Perhaps the greatest misfortune one can face is falling in love with a Resonator.
On a train bound for Lilyland, a weary traveler fleeing his past in Ragunna stumbles into a designer chasing inspiration. Following that fateful encounter, he resolves to write her one letter every single day until the day he dies.
A century later, the designer steps onto Ragunna's soil, his letters pressed to her heart...
yakita:InfoDisplay_32010022_Text.zh: 普通人最大的不幸，或许就是爱上一个共鸣者。在一辆通往莉莉兰德的列车上，想要逃避现实的拉古那男人，遇上了寻找灵感的设计师女士。他决定每天向他爱慕的女士写一封信，直到他去世的那一天。百年后，设计师带着这些信，踏上了拉古那的土地……

yakita:Flow_11000006_543.text: She's going on and on about the spectacular performance of Lingyang.
yakita:Flow_11000006_543.zh: 她总会提到凌阳那场表演，形容得那叫一个精彩。
yakita:Flow_11000006_543.speaker: Lingfeng

yakita:Flow_11000001_450.text: Have you seen the new Taiping Musical by Lingyang?
yakita:Flow_11000001_450.zh: 你可有看凌阳那场新的太平乐？
yakita:Flow_11000001_450.speaker: Uncle Yun

yakita:Flow_11000001_782.text: The new drumstick doesn't feel quite right. I'll have to ask Lingyang to help me refine it a bit...
yakita:Flow_11000001_782.zh: 上次找人新做的鼓槌不太趁手，得让凌阳帮我再打磨打磨……
yakita:Flow_11000001_782.speaker: Mingzhi

yakita:Flow_11000006_43.text: The last show by Lingyang of the Liondance Troupe was spectacular!
yakita:Flow_11000006_43.zh: 之前瑞狮团凌阳的表演可真是精彩！
yakita:Flow_11000006_43.speaker: Shiyu

yakita:Flow_11000006_50.text: Yes, yes! Did you also watch Lingyang's performance?
yakita:Flow_11000006_50.zh: 是啊是啊！你也看了凌阳的那场狮舞表演吗？
yakita:Flow_11000006_50.speaker: Shiyu

yakita:Flow_11000006_53.text: I can still see Lingyang landing on the highest pole without a flinch or stagger right before my eyes.
yakita:Flow_11000006_53.zh: 还记得凌阳跳最高的那个桩，稳稳的，一点失误都没有。
yakita:Flow_11000006_53.speaker: Shiyu

yakita:Flow_311000013_128.chapter: 剧情_中曲生态_NPC_中曲台地_8_1
yakita:Flow_311000013_128.text: The famous Liondancer Lingyang from the city comes to Taoyuan Vale every year for secluded training!
yakita:Flow_311000013_128.zh: 城里有名的舞狮郎凌阳，每年都来我们桃源乡闭关修习呢！

yakita:Flow_311000013_136.chapter: 剧情_中曲生态_NPC_中曲台地_9_1
yakita:Flow_311000013_136.text: When I grow up, I want to learn the liondance from Lingyang!
yakita:Flow_311000013_136.zh: 等童童长大了，也要跟凌阳哥哥学狮子舞！

yakita:Character_LingYang_1_24.text: You can call me Lingyang, glad to make your acquaintance! Fare thee well, blessings swell!
yakita:Character_LingYang_1_24.zh: 我叫凌阳，很高兴遇见你！祝你所行皆坦途，所求皆如愿！
yakita:Character_LingYang_1_24.speaker: Lingyang

yakita:Character_LingYang_26_38.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_凌阳线_副本_20_1
yakita:Character_LingYang_26_38.text: Lingyang recounts every detail of the events to you.
yakita:Character_LingYang_26_38.zh: 凌阳和你把事情的经过一五一十地讲述了一遍……

yakita:Character_LingYang_32_2.text: Lingyang! You're finally here! Master's been looking for you!
yakita:Character_LingYang_32_2.zh: 凌阳！你可算回来了！师父一直在找你！

yakita:Character_LingYang_3_19.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_角色_凌阳线新_1_55
yakita:Character_LingYang_3_19.text: After talking with the client, Lingyang agrees to celebrate an elderly person's birthday during tomorrow's performance.
yakita:Character_LingYang_3_19.zh: 凌阳与委托人交谈，最终谈妥他会将为老人祝寿的需求融入到明天的狮舞表演中。

yakita:Character_LingYang_53_7.text: Aww, that's so sweet. Did you learn that from Lingyang?
yakita:Character_LingYang_53_7.zh: 哎呀，漂泊者也这么会说话！

yakita:Character_LingYang_54_6.text: My granddaughter said you and Lingyang did a lot for me. Thank you so much.
yakita:Character_LingYang_54_6.zh: 我从我孙女那听说了，有劳你和凌阳为我费心了。

yakita:Character_LingYang_55_8.text: Have fun watching the show! Tell Lingyang I said hi!
yakita:Character_LingYang_55_8.zh: 祝你看得开心！替我向凌阳问声好啊！
yakita:Character_LingYang_55_8.speaker: Shuncai

yakita:Character_LingYang_5_27.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_角色_凌阳线新_1_56
yakita:Character_LingYang_5_27.text: After talking with the clients, Lingyang agrees to include the "Liondance Officiant" ceremony in tomorrow's performance to celebrate their wedding.
yakita:Character_LingYang_5_27.zh: 凌阳与委托人交谈，最终谈妥他会将证婚仪式融入到明天的狮舞表演中。

yakita:Character_LingYang_7_14.text: Haha, looks like Lingyang has made a new friend.
yakita:Character_LingYang_7_14.zh: 看来凌阳是又交到新朋友了呀。
yakita:Character_LingYang_7_14.speaker: Shuncai

yakita:Character_LingYang_83_4.speakerZh: 严肃的瑞狮团工作成员
yakita:Character_LingYang_83_4.text: Lingyang's busy getting ready for the performance, so he can't meet you.
yakita:Character_LingYang_83_4.zh: 凌阳现在正在进行演出前的最后准备，暂时无法走动，还请您理解。

yakita:Character_LingYang_87_15.text: The teahouse Lingyang mentioned is in the residential area, just past the square. Keep walking and you'll find it...
yakita:Character_LingYang_87_15.zh: 凌阳说的茶馆就在居民区里，穿过这个广场再往里走走就能看到……
yakita:Character_LingYang_87_15.speaker: Shuncai

yakita:Character_LingYang_8_19.text: I'm Lingyang from the Liondance Troupe. This is 漂泊者.
yakita:Character_LingYang_8_19.zh: 我是瑞狮团的凌阳，这位，是漂泊者。
yakita:Character_LingYang_8_19.speaker: Lingyang

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_10_3.text: Oh, that's a sweet one! Lingyang, you're truly a master of lucky greeting couplets!
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_10_3.zh: 完美！不愧是吉祥话大王啊，凌阳！
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_10_3.speaker: Mingzhi

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_11_25.text: Looks like 漂泊者 has the upper hand. Now, you go first, Lingyang.
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_11_25.zh: 看来漂泊者稳占上风了。那么，下一题还是由你来出吧，凌阳。
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_11_25.speaker: Mingzhi

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_11_7.text: It doesn't seem to rhyme with Lingyang's line...
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_11_7.speaker: Mingzhi

yakita:FavorGoods_130301_Content.text: Dried fish made from Tetra. The fish is usually brought to Yuanwu Boxing Gym by Lingyang, as a thank-you to Mimi for "sparring" with him. When Mimi can't finish her fish, Yuanwu dries it out for future use.
yakita:FavorGoods_130301_Content.zh: 由群彩制成的小鱼干。群彩几乎都是凌阳带来的，作为找小咪“切磋”的报酬。渊武会收起小咪吃不完的群彩，制成方便保存的小鱼干。

yakita:FavorWord_110416_Content.text: Uncle Yuanwu keeps lots of street cats at his boxing gym. I often bring them fish I've caught as thank-yous for, let's say, helping me practice. I wonder if those cats are picking up on his moves? Maybe I can draw some inspiration from that. By the way, Uncle Yuanwu's dried fish is super delicious!
yakita:FavorWord_110416_Content.zh: 渊武叔的拳馆收留了很多流浪猫，我经常会带着自己抓到的群彩过去，作为和它们“切磋”的报酬。不知它们是否也跟着渊武叔学到了一些“雷煌拳”的门道呢？我想试着在它们身上找些灵感。不过渊武叔做的小鱼干的确很好吃就是啦！
yakita:FavorWord_110416_Content.speaker: Lingyang

yakita:Flow_109000011_87.chapter: 剧情_后空翻挑战·狮童的修业_1_8
yakita:Flow_109000011_87.text: If you're interested in joining the Liondance Troupe, Lingyang and I would love to give you a referral.
yakita:Flow_109000011_87.zh: 漂泊者如果有兴趣加入瑞狮团的话，请务必让我和凌阳一同引荐！
yakita:Flow_109000011_87.speaker: Xiuyi

yakita:Flow_31000186_182.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_凌阳线_副本_16_1
yakita:Flow_31000186_182.text: Lingyang places the Noctemint under the "big guy's" nose...
yakita:Flow_31000186_182.zh: 凌阳将夜息香放到了“大家伙”的鼻子下……

yakita:Side_HKFTZSTDXY_1_3.chapter: 剧情_后空翻挑战·狮童的修业_1_1
yakita:Side_HKFTZSTDXY_1_3.text: Oh, I forgot to introduce myself. I am Xiuyi, a Liondancer at Liondance Troupe! I'm a peer of Lingyang.
yakita:Side_HKFTZSTDXY_1_3.zh: 忘记自我介绍了。在下修义，是瑞狮团的狮童！论辈分的话，我算是凌阳的师弟！
yakita:Side_HKFTZSTDXY_1_3.speaker: Xiuyi

yakita:Flow_11000001_195.text: Just a moment. This penjing was carefully crafted by Verina. I simply can't bear to part with it to anyone else.
yakita:Flow_11000001_195.zh: 等等，年轻人。这是小维里奈亲手做的盆景，我可舍不得让给别人。
yakita:Flow_11000001_195.speaker: Linsu

yakita:Flow_11000001_233.text: Little Verina? She is such a sweet child. Her smiles always make me happy. She reminds me of the lovely Starflowers.
yakita:Flow_11000001_233.zh: 小维里奈呀，小小的，白白的，嫩嫩的……笑起来特别可爱，一双大眼睛忽闪忽闪的……像星星花一样。
yakita:Flow_11000001_233.speaker: Linsu

yakita:Flow_11000001_235.text: All her penjings are something else! So vibrant and enchanting.
yakita:Flow_11000001_235.zh: 经她手设计的盆景啊，都像被施了魔法一样，特别有灵气。
yakita:Flow_11000001_235.speaker: Linsu

yakita:Event_DRSL_10_10.text: It has a short flowering season, making it unsuitable for Penjing. So we usually don't sell them here. But Verina happened to drop by a few days ago and gave me a few.
yakita:Event_DRSL_10_10.zh: 怨鸟泽的鸢尾花花期很短，并不适合做成盆景，所以店里并没有卖。但是前两天，维里奈有给店里送来两朵。
yakita:Event_DRSL_10_10.speaker: Linsu

yakita:Event_DRSL_10_8.text: It originates from Whining Aix's Mire and its flower language is fragile, untold affections. Romantic, isn't it?
yakita:Event_DRSL_10_8.zh: 这种花原产自怨鸟泽，花语是破碎而隐晦的爱哦，很浪漫吧。
yakita:Event_DRSL_10_8.speaker: Linsu

yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_10_1.text: Rover, is that you? You're still up at this hour?
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_10_1.zh: 漂泊者，是你啊？这么晚了居然还没睡吗。
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_10_1.speaker: Liuqin

yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_1.text: Should I join Mr. Mortefi's project? ...Koko, would you support my decision?
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_1.zh: 如果加入莫特斐的项目，会怎么样呢……蔻蔻，你会支持哥哥吗？
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_1.speaker: Liuqin

yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_10.text: He's probably the most respected researcher here, just behind our Principal Investigator, Mr. Xiangli Yao.
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_10.zh: 除了相里要首席之外，莫特斐前辈可以说是现在研究院里名望最高的人之一。
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_10.speaker: Liuqin

yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_14.text: Mortefi's been trying to outdo him in research, but it's not easy. Xiangli is just... built different.
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_14.zh: 莫特斐一直想追赶上首席，但这很难。首席，是特别的。
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_14.speaker: Liuqin

yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_2.text: Ah, you must be the Rover. What can I do for you?
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_2.zh: 啊，漂泊者，你有事找我吗？
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_2.speaker: Liuqin

yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_6.text: Yesterday, Mr. Mortefi invited me to join one of his projects.
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_6.zh: 昨天，莫特斐邀请我加入他的一个项目。
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_6.speaker: Liuqin

yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_9.text: I don't want to pass up this chance. It's more than just a project. Being able to working alongside Mr. Mortefi is an honor itself.
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_9.zh: 不仅是项目，能与莫特斐前辈合作，这本身也是一种荣幸。
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_7_9.speaker: Liuqin

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_8_1.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_2_3
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_8_1.text: Should I join Mortefi's project or not? ...Koko, will you support my decision?
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_8_1.zh: 如果加入莫特斐的项目，会怎么样呢……蔻蔻，你会支持哥哥吗？
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_8_1.speaker: Liuqin

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_8_10.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_2_3
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_8_10.text: I'd say Mr. Mortefi is the most respected researcher at the Academy now, second only to our Principal Investigator, Mr. Xiangli Yao.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_8_10.zh: 除了相里要首席之外，莫特斐前辈可以说是现在研究院里名望最高的人之一。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_8_10.speaker: Liuqin

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_8_12.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_2_3
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_8_12.text: Mr. Mortefi even treats us to afternoon teas. He really looks out for us.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_8_12.zh: 那天下午他还请我们喝了下午茶。说他是部分科室的再生父母也不为过。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_8_12.speaker: Liuqin

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_8_6.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_2_3
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_8_6.text: Yesterday, Mortefi invited me to join one of his projects.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_8_6.zh: 昨天，莫特斐邀请我加入他的一个项目。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_8_6.speaker: Liuqin

yakita:Flow_11000001_726.text: Chenpi likes to have Pu'er, Pianyu prefers white tea, and as for Master Yuanwu...
yakita:Flow_11000001_726.zh: 陈皮喜欢喝普洱、片羽喜欢喝白茶、至于渊武老板么……
yakita:Flow_11000001_726.speaker: Liuxian

yakita:Flow_11000001_728.text: It's a blend Master Yuanwu devised himself. I usually pick the tea leaves and roast them here at the teahouse.
yakita:Flow_11000001_728.zh: 这三清茶的配方是渊武老板亲自调配的，至于那茶叶，可都是我亲手采摘，亲自烘焙的。
yakita:Flow_11000001_728.speaker: Liuxian

yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_4_1.text: The war in the Norfall Barrens has finally ended.
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_4_1.zh: 北落野那边的战事终于告一段落了。
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_4_1.speaker: Lizhu

yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_4_3.text: The Retroact Rain was already scary enough as an illusion... but then actual "ghosts" appeared!
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_4_3.zh: 原本只是幻觉的溯洄雨就已经够吓人了……居然还有实体的“幽灵”产生。
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_4_3.speaker: Lizhu

yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_5_9.text: My favorite is "Savage God of Torn Wings." What do you think, Rover?
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_5_9.zh: 例如我最喜欢这个“残酷断翼之战神”，漂泊者你觉得呢？
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_5_9.speaker: Lizhu

yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_6_3.text: Hang on, you're not planning to snitch to Mr. Mortefi, right...?
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_6_3.zh: 等等，漂泊者你不会去找莫特斐前辈告状吧……
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_6_3.speaker: Lizhu

yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_6_8.text: Just so you know, that's the 17th most brutal line from Mr. Mortefi, as per our rankings on the Huaxu Hive.
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_6_8.zh: 顺带一提，这是今涯论坛上，莫特斐前辈骂人语录攻击性排名第17的例句。
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_6_8.speaker: Lizhu

yakita:ItemInfo_51001_BgDescription.text: These resources come from all over Solaris-3, delivered on time by Lollo Logistics for customers. When traveling in dangerous areas, mutual support is indispensable for safe travel.
yakita:ItemInfo_51001_BgDescription.zh: 这些资源来自索拉里斯的各地，由呜呜物流为客户准时送达。 在危险地区游历时，他人的支援是必不可少的助力。

yakita:ItemInfo_80001011_BgDescription.text:
Long, silky noodles absorb the rich, spicy broth. Chopped scallions adorn generous slices of meat. One bite can make you sweat, even in winter's chill.
In the remote, rustic village of Yuezhou, this dish is Lumi's fondest memory of home. 
Despite her travels after joining Lollo Logistics, tasting a variety of cuisines, Lumi still believes that the steaming bowl of noodles from her hometown is the true definition of happiness.
yakita:ItemInfo_80001011_BgDescription.zh:
柔滑细长的圆粉，在浓郁的辣汤中浸足了味道。葱花点缀着厚实的肉片，一口下去，冬日也能让人大汗淋漓。
在越州那个与世隔绝的淳朴村落中，辣肉粉是灯灯对于家乡味道最深厚的记忆。
即便如今在呜呜物流工作的旅途中远离家乡，吃遍了各色美味，但灯灯仍旧觉得家里灶台上的那热腾腾的一碗，就是幸福的代名词。

yakita:BYCZ_2_13.text: See the Starward Riseway? Lollo Logistics oversaw its construction.
yakita:BYCZ_2_13.zh: 你看这个联运椎骨，当年也是在呜呜物流的指导下建成的。

yakita:BYCZ_2_2.text: Oh! You're... you're 漂泊者! Maji's told me all about you! Thanks for supporting us at Lollo Logistics!
yakita:BYCZ_2_2.zh: 啊，您是……漂泊者{Male=先生;Female=女士}！我听马计师傅经常提起您！感谢您对呜呜物流一直以来的支持！

yakita:Event_TCTL3_4_8.text: "Beep. Thank you for choosing Lollo Logistics—We Promise, We Deliver! For further assistance, press 1. To access the Beyond the Waves campaign, press 2. If you wish to speak to a representative, please contact business manager Maji."
yakita:Event_TCTL3_4_8.zh: 「滴，服务已结束——呜呜物流，使命必达！如有其他需要请按1，打开踏潮探历页面请按2，转人工请联系业务负责人马计……」

yakita:Event_TCTL4_1_12.text: It's me! Your old pal Maji from Lollo Logistics! You helped me out a bunch in the past, remember? What a surprise to run into you here!
yakita:Event_TCTL4_1_12.zh: 我是你的老朋友马计啊，呜呜物流的，以前一直找您帮忙做业务的那个！没想到会在这遇见你啊！
yakita:Event_TCTL4_1_12.speaker: Maji

yakita:Event_TCTL4_4_7.text: "Transferring your call to Manager Maji. Please hold… While you wait, enjoy this brief commercial break: Lollo Logistics shipping service is now fully upgraded! Place your order today and enjoy exclusive discounts!"
yakita:Event_TCTL4_4_7.zh: 「即将为您转接负责人马计的通讯终端，请稍后……等待转接期间，请您欣赏优美的商业广告：呜呜物流闪送服务全面升级，现在订购更可以享受满减优惠！」

yakita:Event_TCTL_4_8.text: Beep. Thank you for choosing Lollo Logistics—We Promise, We Deliver! For further assistance, press 1. To access the Beyond the Waves campaign, press 2. If you wish to speak to a representative, please contact business manager Maji.
yakita:Event_TCTL_4_8.zh: 「滴，服务已结束——呜呜物流，使命必达！如有其他需要请按1，打开踏潮探历页面请按2，转人工请联系业务负责人马计……」

yakita:Event_WWQHEQ_1_16.text: A new chapter for Lollo Logistics: The Maji Era is buzzing with excitement!
yakita:Event_WWQHEQ_1_16.zh: 呜呜物流的全新篇章，马计时代，沸腾期待！
yakita:Event_WWQHEQ_1_16.speaker: Maji

yakita:Event_WWQH_1_16.text: Oh, I almost forgot to introduce myself. I'm the new manager of the Lollo Logistics Station, Maji. By the way, I also go by Ma... M-Maggie! Sounds pretty cool and international, right?
yakita:Event_WWQH_1_16.zh: 忘记自我介绍了！我是今州物流站的新任管理员，我叫马计，你也可以叫我的花名——呣……不对……咩……Maggie！
yakita:Event_WWQH_1_16.speaker: Maji

yakita:Event_WWQH_32_1.text: A few days have passed. Today, the Incubator project's final decisions will be revealed. You meet Maji at the Lollo Logistics Station.
yakita:Event_WWQH_32_1.zh:
几日后，创业企划发布了结果。
你在今州的呜呜物流站见到了马计。

yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1504_Info.chapter: 灯灯档案_共鸣能力鉴定报告
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1504_Info.text:
Navigator at Lollo Logistics and leader of a transport squad.
Born in a mountain village in Yuezhou, Lumi's sincere and caring nature brings warmth to everyone around her.
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1504_Info.zh:
呜呜物流的领航员，运输队的小组长。
出身越州的山中村落，真诚热情，如小太阳般照耀着他人的质朴少女。

yakita:FavorWord_150422_Content.text: Greetings! Lumi here! Need to send some mail? I've got you covered as Lollo Logistics' professional navigator!
yakita:FavorWord_150422_Content.zh: 我是……噔噔噔——灯灯！你有想寄出的邮件吗？呜呜物流领航员灯灯，一定帮你平安送到！
yakita:FavorWord_150422_Content.speaker: Lumi

yakita:POI_SMBD_11_3.chapter: 剧情_遗落原乡_一级POI世界任务_4_1
yakita:POI_SMBD_11_3.text: This is the weather observatory in the Port City of Guixu. You passed out during a battle with the Inferno Rider. Some guys from Lollo Logistics brought you here.
yakita:POI_SMBD_11_3.zh: 这里是归墟港市的气象观测站，你在和燎照之骑的战斗中失去了意识，被呜呜物流那边的人带过来了。
yakita:POI_SMBD_11_3.speaker: Woodrow

yakita:POI_SMBD_5_81.chapter: 剧情_遗落原乡_一级POI世界任务_23_1
yakita:POI_SMBD_5_81.text: That mission left a permanent scar on our company. After that, we made it a rule that any major order had to be handled by Resonators with combat skills.
yakita:POI_SMBD_5_81.zh: 这次订单当成了我司立社以来无法抹去的伤痛，呜呜物流也从此规定大型订单必须要配备有战斗能力的共鸣者。
yakita:POI_SMBD_5_81.speaker: Tang Manliu

yakita:StZLCZ_24_4.chapter: 剧情_拉海洛_整流车站系列_1_23
yakita:StZLCZ_24_4.text: Maji talks about you all the time! Says you're the real innovator at Lollo Logistics. I heard you not only refactored the logical mapping of key routes, but you're also driving our growth metrics!
yakita:StZLCZ_24_4.zh: 我听马计前辈提过您很多次，说您是呜呜物流的真正推送，关键链路的底层逻辑全靠您复盘重组，业务也是您在拉高增长曲线！

datamine:InfoDisplay_102801028_Text.title: Rite of Offering: Volume II
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801028_Text.text:
…Until the almighty Loong guided us to a secure refuge, near what we now call Mt. Firmament…

"To complete the Rite of Offering, seek the glazed lamp on Xuanji Ridge. It is said to be found there. This shall be your first destination." —Uncle Fu
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801028_Text.zh:
见龙现山，庇泽一方，聚民而生，谓曰乘霄。

“完成奉龙仪式需要用到那个琉璃灯盏，按照古籍记载，应该在璇玑岭那边，必须要先去那里一趟。”——福伯

datamine:InfoDisplay_102900003_Text.title: Secret Diary - I
datamine:InfoDisplay_102900003_Text.text: Our Sentinel has been unresponsive lately. I wonder if it's because I angered it by tempting it with Loong Buns yesterday? Next time, I'll bring some from Panhua before visiting Mt. Firmament. But wait, can Sentinels even eat buns? Well, there's only one way to find out.
datamine:InfoDisplay_102900003_Text.zh:
岁光那个家伙，最近又联系不上了。
唔……难道是我昨天用小龙包诱惑它，惹它生气了？
下次去乘霄山看望它之前，先去攀花阿姨那里买点小龙包好了。
咦？不对，岁光真的能吃小龙包吗？嘿嘿，下次试试看。

yakita:LGNCZST_10_13.text: I've been wondering lately... could it be that the Lorelei in Nimbus Sanctum doesn't want that song to be shared with more people?
yakita:LGNCZST_10_13.zh: 难道是歌声的主人……并不希望自己的歌声被带走吗？
yakita:LGNCZST_10_13.speaker: Moriarty

yakita:BBTTC_10_1.text: Malice without end... flooding Nimbus Sanctum. O nightfall... drown all beneath your veil...
yakita:BBTTC_10_1.zh: 无穷的恶意满溢云海……夜幕啊……淹没一切……
yakita:BBTTC_10_1.speaker: Lorelei

yakita:DYHD_2502_3.text: It's a Remnant Creature that dwells in the depths of Riccioli. It may even be the same kind as Lorelei, who we met in the Nimbus Sanctum.
yakita:DYHD_2502_3.zh: 它应该是一种生活在黎乔利海渊，也就是群岛海底的回音生物，也可以说和我们之前在氤柔水境遇到的罗蕾莱是相同的生物。
yakita:DYHD_2502_3.speaker: Phoebe

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_29.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_17_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_29.text:
Despite his defeat, Gilberto continues to preach a dark prophecy: Lorelei will command the sea of clouds to engulf Ragunna, sparing only the faithful. Meanwhile, an anomaly at the Nimbus Sanctum suggests Lorelei might also be influenced by a Lycoris. 
Zani and Phoebe stay behind to watch over Gilberto until the Montelli members arrive. You head to the sea of clouds alone.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_22_29.zh:
击败吉尔贝后，他仍在肆无忌惮地宣扬着邪异的预言：罗蕾莱将令云海吞没拉古那城，届时只有真信者才能获得新生。
此时氤柔水境中央的云海异象突起，恐怕他口中的「罗蕾莱」已经受到了彼岸花的影响。
赞妮与菲比将留在此处看守吉尔贝，等待莫塔里家族人士的接手。你与她们暂时分别，先行前往云海。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_11.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_35_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_11.text: The oathbreakers, hiding behind their Masks of Madness… They tainted the Nimbus Sanctum with corrupted blooms, drowning me in rage and sorrow. Endless nightmares became my prison.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_11.zh: 那些戴着癫狂面具的背誓者……他们用充满恶意的花污染了云海的频率，让我陷入了愤怒与悲哀……用无休止的噩梦困住了我。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_11.speaker: Lorelei

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_13.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_35_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_13.text: Had you not freed me from my nightmare, I would never be able to fulfill the Sentinel's task… The tides of the Nimbus Sanctum would have engulfed the whole of Ragunna, just as they once claimed the sacred temple now lying in ruins beneath you.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_13.zh: 如果不是你们从噩梦中将我解放，我将无法继续履行岁主留下的使命……云海掀起的浪潮将吞没整个拉古那，如同它吞没你们脚下那圣殿的残骸。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_13.speaker: Lorelei

yakita:POI_LGNJR_9_11.text: But I... 漂泊者, do you remember Lorelei? We encountered her in Nimbus Sanctum with Zani.
yakita:POI_LGNJR_9_11.zh: 但是我……漂泊者还记得上次我们和赞妮在云海遇到的罗蕾莱么？
yakita:POI_LGNJR_9_11.speaker: Phoebe

yakita:Side_TJQL_1_15.chapter: 剧情_2_0_世界_最后一次航行_支线任务_2_1
yakita:Side_TJQL_1_15.text: I've crossed Nimbus Sanctum, seen Lorelei dancing among the stars, and ventured to forbidden lands, through reefs sharp as daggers.
yakita:Side_TJQL_1_15.zh: 我曾经驾船横越云海，见过罗蕾莱潜藏在星与云之间的身影。也曾去过无人敢于踏足的禁忌之地，穿越尖牙般交错的礁石。

yakita:34NPCTHST_25_4.text: That's the right call. President Lucilla's speech at the review conference was absolute cinema.
yakita:34NPCTHST_25_4.zh: 你是对的，洛瑟菈校长在审查会上表现很精彩。

yakita:34NPCTHST_7_1.text: Ah, it's you, 漂泊者. I was just about to make adjustments to the majoring policies, and President Lucilla suggested I get your input on it.
yakita:34NPCTHST_7_1.zh: 是你啊漂泊者同学，我正准备调整分部制度，洛瑟菈校长建议我征询一下你的看法。
yakita:34NPCTHST_7_1.speaker: Reilynn

yakita:34NPCTHST_7_4.text: Yes. Now that the Spacetrek Executive Committee has finally approved President Lucilla's proposal to revamp Rabelle College's curriculum and keep the funding flowing...
yakita:34NPCTHST_7_4.zh: 对……既然深空联合理事会最终接受了洛瑟菈校长的提案，接受拉贝尔学部变更教学目标，并继续投资……
yakita:34NPCTHST_7_4.speaker: Reilynn

yakita:LSLSTBC_3_3.text: Oh, he's heading out with the expedition team to the frostlands soon, isn't he? How about knitting him a nice, thick scarf?
yakita:LSLSTBC_3_3.zh: 啊，他不是要跟科考队去冰原考察一段时间吗，给他织一条围巾怎么样？
yakita:LSLSTBC_3_3.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:LSLZXST_1_1.chapter: 剧情_3_4_洛瑟菈线_生态冒泡_1_1
yakita:LSLZXST_1_1.text: President Lucilla has been looking so drained lately. I truly wish she'd take a proper rest.
yakita:LSLZXST_1_1.zh: 洛瑟菈校长最近越来越憔悴了，真希望她能好好休息下。

yakita:LSLZXST_5_3.chapter: 剧情_3_4_洛瑟菈线_生态冒泡_5_1
yakita:LSLZXST_5_3.text: Could you please not? We'd be doing President Lucilla a much bigger favor just by staying out of the way!
yakita:LSLZXST_5_3.zh: 能别胡闹吗，咱们不给洛瑟菈校长添乱就好了！

yakita:Side_XJJSSST_8_3.chapter: 剧情_拉海洛_摩托赛场生态_1_8
yakita:Side_XJJSSST_8_3.text: Rumor has it the fan club challenged President Lucilla to a marathon showdown in Peaks of Prestige to win the event budget!
yakita:Side_XJJSSST_8_3.zh: 我听小道消息说啊，是同好会的一帮人跟洛瑟菈校长约定车轮战打荣耀之丘来拿活动经费！

yakita:StXYYZC_43_4.chapter: 剧情_联动学院相关生态_4_2
yakita:StXYYZC_43_4.text: Right! I'm sure President Lucilla will get everything sorted!
yakita:StXYYZC_43_4.zh: 嗯、嗯！我相信洛瑟菈校长会安排好的！

yakita:XJXYDTK_28_5.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院中枢电梯生态_29_1
yakita:XJXYDTK_28_5.text: Probably because… a few days ago, I literally saw that exact "miko" having tea with President Lucilla in her office.
yakita:XJXYDTK_28_5.zh: 大概是因为……我前几天还在校长办公室里，看到那位“巫女”在和洛瑟菈校长饮茶呢。

yakita:XJXYSSFBST_14_4.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_宿舍副本生态_15_1
yakita:XJXYSSFBST_14_4.text: But we can go talk to President Lucilla. She's from the New Federation, too. And with the resources she has in and around the Academy, maybe she can help you contact your family.
yakita:XJXYSSFBST_14_4.zh: 但我们可以去拜托洛瑟菈校长。她既熟悉新联邦，又能调用学院资源，说不定能帮你联系上你家人。

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_206_1.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半符文生态_40_2
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_206_1.text: Right, now I just need to contact President Lucilla...
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_206_1.zh: 好了，现在只要联系洛瑟菈校长就行……
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_206_1.speaker: Lynae

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21015_1.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半符文生态_44_2
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21015_1.text: Professor! We just got word from President Lucilla, a Void Storm is about to hit up ahead!
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21015_1.zh: 教授！洛瑟菈校长那边发来警告，前面路段不久后会生成磁暴！

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21028_5.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半符文生态_54_1
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21028_5.text: Hah. Whatever else Lucilla may be, she is not a woman who sends students to die.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_21028_5.zh: 哼，洛瑟菈虽然有各种问题，但她可不是那种会派学生送死的人。

yakita:InfoDisplay_125000123_Text.text:
A group is gathered around a plant in what appears to be a Pioneer Association office. You recognize Verina among them.
In the background, a lone figure works facing away from the camera. Is that Lucilla?
yakita:InfoDisplay_125000123_Text.zh:
这似乎是先行公约的一间办公室？照片中的几人正围着一株植物合影，你在照片中还发现了维里奈。
后方的办公桌前，有一个人背对相机依然在工作，那是洛瑟菈吗？

yakita:FavorGoods_110902_Content.text:
Lucilla loves to immerse herself in the lives of characters on screen. These old film rolls of classic movies were the one thing she could not bear to part with when she left the New Federation.
After becoming President of the Academy, she rarely found the time to watch movies. That changed the day she noticed one of her students had appeared on a movie poster.
Now, Lucilla cherishes these film rolls more than ever.
yakita:FavorGoods_110902_Content.zh:
洛瑟菈喜欢通过电影去体验不一样的人生，在她离开新联邦时，唯独这些经典老片的胶片拷贝难以割舍。
当上校长后洛瑟菈很少能抽出时间去看电影，直到有天，她发现自己的学生出现在了一张电影海报上。
如今，洛瑟菈比以往更爱这些电影胶片了。

yakita:FavorStory_110904_Content.text:
[…]

A scrap of paper carefully torn from a notebook.

It bears the Spacetrek Collective's emblem.

[…]

Her survival was purely by chance.

This Roya also showed me the objects Lucilla had used her ability to read—random trinkets, nothing more.

[…]

Naturally, I would not believe this old man understood memory-type Resonators better than the New Federation's finest doctors.

[…]

Life must not be survived, but lived."
"...Lucilla has always chosen her own way of living."
"I have a child too.

[…]
yakita:FavorStory_110904_Content.zh:
一张笔记，被人从某本笔记上小心撕下来，笔记使用的纸上有深空联合的标记。笔记的背面有一则简短留言。
我非常好奇究竟是什么样的奇遇治愈了你，所以我找到了那个罗伊人，问了他一些简单的问题。如果将来的某天你的旧病复发，他那些不明所以的发言或许能帮你想起什么。

       我几乎使用了能调用的所有交通工具，终于从新联邦抵达了报告中提到的这处偏远罗伊人观测站。
       我也再次确认了，救下她的确实不过是一个邋遢且风烛残年的老头子，没有什么阴谋，她是纯凭侥幸活下来的。
       这个罗伊人也向我展示了洛瑟菈使用能力所读取的物品，一些杂物。我看不出这些东西究竟有什么魔力，竟让洛瑟菈从能力带来的癔症中走了出来——我自然也不会相信这个老头子能比新联邦的医生更懂记忆系共鸣者。
       真是一趟毫无意义的旅行，我很快对这个地方失去了兴趣。
       
       “女士，很简单的道理，如果你永远只是通过相机去拍摄，通过照片去观察，你就永远无法理解冰原的寒冷与辽阔。”
       “不要装神弄鬼。”
       “不不，这其实是洛瑟菈校长告诉我的，在她触摸了这些微不足道的小物件后，她终于感受到了。”
       “感受到了什么？”
       “生命，不是照片，而是血肉。不是生存，而是生活。”
       “……洛瑟菈一直在选择自己的生活。”
       “我也有孩子，明白您为什么不能理解。就像我观测冰原，洛瑟菈校长观测旁人，你一直也像现在这样观测着她吗？”那个罗伊人问我。
       傲慢的提问，对我善加揣测。我没有回答他。

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_2_1.text: Not a problem. For project funding approvals, we can follow the New Federation model.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_2_1.zh: 没问题，项目的资金审批流程，我们可以沿用贵方在新联邦的模式。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_2_1.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_25.text: Thank you. I promise, I'd never let the New Federation lay a single finger on my students. But...
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_25.zh: 谢谢，我绝不会让新联邦染指我的学生，只是……
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_25.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_1_13.text: You receive a WavesLine message from Lucilla.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_1_13.zh: 你收到一条来自洛瑟菈的飞讯。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_214_2.text: The New Federation's got more secrets than I expected. Lucilla's from there... Maybe she can help.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_214_2.zh: 新联邦的谜团越来越多了，洛瑟菈是新联邦人，或许可以先问问她……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_215_2.text: President Lucilla, there's something I'd like to ask you. I want to learn about the New Federation's "Resonator War."
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_215_2.zh: 洛瑟菈校长，有件事我想拜托你。关于新联邦，我想了解一下过去那场“共鸣者战争”。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_216_1.text: Lucilla said to give her two days. Guess I'll just have to wait it out.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_216_1.zh: 洛瑟菈约定的时间也是两天……先等等看吧。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_217_1.text: The two days Meta mentioned have passed... Guess I'll head to the meeting spot and find Lucilla first.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_217_1.zh: 时间到了，梅塔说的两天后究竟是……先去约定的地点找洛瑟菈吧。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_11.text: Ugh. New Federation, New Federation. Ever since that review conference, it feels like I can't go a day without that name popping up.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_11.zh: 唉，新联邦……新联邦，上次审查会结束后，我都感觉自己绕不过这个词语了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_11.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_15.text: No one in particular. It's been blowing up in the student group chats all day. You really should check the Academy group chats once in a while, you know.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_15.zh: 不用特意的谁，这个消息今天在学生群都刷爆了，你有时候也多关注下学院的群聊消息吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_15.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_3.text: Long story short, the New Federation keeps anything related to the Resonator War under lock and key.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_3.zh: 先说结论，新联邦对那场共鸣者战争的资料严格保密。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_3.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_4.text: I pulled every string I had there, and still barely turned up anything you don't already know.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_4.zh: 就算我动用了我在新联邦的人脉，也只能查到微乎其微的信息，和你之前了解的相差不大。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_4.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_7.text: I'll keep digging, but I should warn you: the New Fed's been gathering intel on you lately. Seems like you've caught their interest.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_7.zh: 我会继续帮你查查看，但我得提醒你一句，新联邦的人最近在收集你的信息，他们似乎对你很感兴趣。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_7.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_9.text: You're not wrong. I don't know what's piqued your sudden interest in New Fed history, but you need to be careful.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_9.zh: 嗯，我不知道你是遭遇了什么，突然开始调查起新联邦的历史，但你一定要小心。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_218_9.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:Side_LSLCP_25_4.text: Laurene. A memory-type Resonator from Rabelle College.
yakita:Side_LSLCP_25_4.zh: 这孩子叫劳伦妮，是记忆系共鸣者，拉贝尔学部的。
yakita:Side_LSLCP_25_4.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:Side_LSLCP_26_6.text: I offered her support for the paperwork and arranged a medical leave plan with the New Federation, but she chose to stay.
yakita:Side_LSLCP_26_6.zh: 虽然我愿意为她提供一些教学系统方面的支持，也为她沟通了新联邦方面的休学疗养计划。但她还是决定留在这里。
yakita:Side_LSLCP_26_6.speaker: Lucilla

yakita:Side_LSLCP_4_2.text: I'm here for Professor Lucilla's projector repair.
yakita:Side_LSLCP_4_2.zh: 我替洛瑟菈教授来了解下放映机的维修情况。
yakita:Side_LSLCP_4_2.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_100_28.text: Back in our world, David's already dead. And so are you, Rebecca... You both died that night. Adam Smasher killed you.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_100_28.zh: 现实中的大卫已经死了。你也一样，丽贝卡，你们都在那个夜晚死在了亚当·重锤的手里。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_100_28.speaker: Lucy

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_100_37.text: Listen, Lucy... David and I are gone. Nothing's changin' that.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_100_37.zh: 听好了，露西，我和大卫的死亡是无法改变的事实。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_100_37.speaker: Rebecca

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_100_42.text: Lucy, I can't promise that you won't have nightmares again...
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_100_42.zh: 露西，我不能保证你今后是否还会陷入梦魇……
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_100_42.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_12_4.text: Got no idea why... If David and Rebecca hadn't been there, I'd be...
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_12_4.zh: 我不知道……如果当时没有大卫和丽贝卡，我恐怕已经……
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_12_4.speaker: Lucy

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_30_20.text: Lucy. We're tyin' up some loose ends here. Try to stay outta your hair.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_30_20.zh: 露西。因为一些事我们要在这里停留。不会给你们添麻烦的。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_30_20.speaker: Lucy

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_33_4.text: 'Member that shard Rebecca found? Don't think it was random. It's tied to David, I'm sure of it.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_33_4.zh: 还记得丽贝卡找到的频段吗？我认为它的出现并非偶然，和大卫一定存在着某种关联。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_33_4.speaker: Lucy

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_38_19.text: During the examination, I noted Lucy's psychological state isn't stable.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_38_19.zh: 在先前的检查中，我注意到露西的精神状态并不稳定。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_38_19.speaker: Luuk Herssen

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_38_30.text: I'll track her down. Luuk, keep an eye on Lucy for me.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_38_30.zh: 我去找她吧。陆，这段时间露西就麻烦你照看了。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_38_30.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_38_7.text: Anyway, Lucy's been in there forever. What's the holdup?
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_38_7.zh: 说起来，露西这家伙都进去这么久了，怎么还没有消息？
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_38_7.speaker: Rebecca

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_47_25.text: I just got a message from Lucy. She needs more time digging through the archives. Says to wait.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_47_25.zh: 刚才露西发来消息。她让我们再等等，说自己还需要一些时间查阅资料。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_47_25.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_48_6.text: I saw this symbol in Lucy's memories too. What does it mean?
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_48_6.zh: 我在露西的记忆中也看到过这个图案。它有什么含义吗？
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_48_6.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_53_6.text: Lucy... listen... Do not resist... Everything will be easier.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_53_6.zh: 露西……只要……你放弃反抗……一切都会变得轻松。

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_14.text: While we can't fully decode your power, we can study and replicate the frequency signatures of Lucy and Rebecca's weapons, applying it to our own armaments.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_14.zh: 我们无法解析你的能力，但能通过研究还原出露西小姐她们武器的频率，将其作用在我们的武器上。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_14.speaker: Mornye

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_8.text: Both Lucy and Rebecca's weapons are capable of this. Rebecca's firearm, in particular, demonstrates remarkable efficacy against Nightmare Tacet Discords.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_8.zh: 露西小姐和丽贝卡小姐的武器都可以做到这点。尤其是丽贝卡小姐的武器，对梦魇残象的伤害格外显著。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_56_8.speaker: Mornye

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_80_16.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_4_边缘行者联动2_2_12
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_80_16.text: Beyond the door lies the home David and Lucy once shared. Lucy looks at the familiar objects and begins to reminisce.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_80_16.zh: 门扉后所连接的，是过去大卫和露西共同生活过的家。露西看着眼前这些熟悉的物件，开始回忆过去。

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_85_9.text: At the foot of Arasaka Tower that day... He killed Rebecca. Then he killed David.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_85_9.zh: 那天的荒坂塔下，他亲手杀死了丽贝卡和大卫。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_85_9.speaker: Lucy

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_86_22.text: In the end, he did—I lived. But he and Rebecca... they died that night.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_86_22.zh: 最后我活了下来，而他和丽贝卡却一起死在了那个夜晚。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_86_22.speaker: Lucy

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_86_29.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_4_边缘行者联动2_2_16
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_86_29.text: On the rooftop, Lucy watches the city lights below and slowly opens up about her past with David.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_86_29.zh: 天台上，露西看着眼前的夜景，缓缓阐述她与大卫的过去。

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_95_4.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_3_4_边缘行者联动2_2_6
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_95_4.text: Lucy fights with everything she has, but is unable to defeat Smasher and collapses.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_95_4.zh: 露西殊死抵抗，但最终还是不敌梦魇亚当·重锤，脱力倒下。

yakita:Event_DAZYHQLZDST2_56_3.text: Lumi said she'd come see us often. If only this place would fade away a little slower.
yakita:Event_DAZYHQLZDST2_56_3.zh: 灯灯说，她会常常来看我们的，如果这里消失得慢一点就好了。

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_118_22.text: Haha, because I'm Lumi, Luminary of Logistics!
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_118_22.zh: 我也觉得，毕竟我可是——噔噔噔噔，灯灯组长！
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_118_22.speaker: Lumi

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_118_25.text: Again, thanks a bunch for your help! If you ever swing by my hometown, Yuezhou, I'll treat you to some local delicacies!
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_118_25.zh: 这次的事情真的非常感谢你！要是你有机会到我老家越州去的话，我肯定用村里的特产好好招待你！
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_118_25.speaker: Lumi

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_118_29.text: After bowing deeply, Lumi grabs a delivery crate and rushes out of the station.
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_118_29.zh: 灯灯深深地鞠了一躬表示感谢，然后才火急火燎地拿上快递箱，离开了物流站点。

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_118_30.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_4_肉鸽主线剧情_13_1
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_118_30.text:
After Tianhu and his subordinates depart, Lumi expresses her heartfelt gratitude. You ask if she remembers what happened in the Somnoire, and as expected, she has forgotten everything upon waking...

Now, you are the only person in Solaris who still remembers this adventure.
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_118_30.zh:
天胡和小弟离开后，灯灯对你表达了感谢。你问灯灯是否知道心之集域中发生的事，结果果然如白猫所说，脱离了梦境的灯灯已经忘掉了这一切……
如今，索拉里斯只有你还记得这场冒险。

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_16_1.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_灯灯_18_1
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_16_1.text: (Is that... Lumi? The Tacet Discords are after her!)
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_16_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_17_9.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_灯灯_8_1
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_17_9.text: In the dream, you come across Lumi, but it appears she can't hear you.
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_17_9.zh: 在梦中你遇到了灯灯，但她似乎听不见你说话。

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_202_13.text: He mentioned seeing weird things in Whining Aix's Mire, kinda like the stuff happening over in Tacet Fields.
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_202_13.zh: 前几天，他说在怨鸟泽看到了奇怪的景象，感觉就像踏进了无音区一样……
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_202_13.speaker: Lumi

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_202_20.text: I'm not sure if it's related... but ever since I've returned from the Whining Aix's Mire, I haven't had any dreams.
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_202_20.zh: 不知道是不是巧合……从怨鸟泽回来后，我这几天都没有再做过梦了。
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_202_20.speaker: Lumi

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_202_28.text: I was planning to search Whining Aix's Mire again, but now...
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_202_28.zh: 本来我想自己再去怨鸟泽找一次货物，但现在组员突然出现了意外……
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_202_28.speaker: Lumi

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_202_34.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_4_肉鸽主线剧情_1_4
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_202_34.text: You engage in conversation with the Lollo member, named Lumi, who reveals that strange events have been occurring in the Whining Aix's Mire, where her team member lost the package. She asks for your help in recovering it, and to investigate the anomalies, you agree to assist her.
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_202_34.zh: 在与物流员交谈后，你知道了她的名字叫做灯灯。灯灯告知你最近怨鸟泽的情况有些异常，自己的组员正是在那里弄丢了货物。在一番交谈后，灯灯询问你能否帮忙找回这件货物。你为了调查这一系列异常现象，决定帮灯灯这个忙。

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_202_5.text: Hiya! I'm Lumi, the logistics team's good ol' captain. I head up the delivery team.
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_202_5.zh: 而我呢，名字叫作……噔噔噔噔，叫灯灯！是物流小组的组长。
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_202_5.speaker: Lumi

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_202_9.text: His package got lost in Whining Aix's Mire. Speaking of that place, something strange is going on there lately, so be careful when you're there, hmm?
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_202_9.zh: 但是最近，这旁边的怨鸟泽好像有些异常的情况……漂泊者，你要是经过那附近也要小心哇。
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_202_9.speaker: Lumi

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_22_2.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_灯灯_13_1
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_22_2.text: Ugh, I keep getting sidetracked. Focus, Lumi! Think about what you're gonna do next.
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_22_2.zh: 不纠结了，还是想想组员们的事情吧。
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_22_2.speaker: Lumi

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_24_1.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_灯灯_16_1
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_24_1.text: You're here, Lumi! I've been looking for you!
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_24_1.zh: 灯灯组长，终于找到你了！

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_26_15.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_4_肉鸽主线剧情_2_2
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_26_15.text: After aiding Lumi in resolving her issues, you discover that the white cat can now speak. It explains that gateways have emerged across various regions, and it has lost its control over the Somnoire. It requests you to help reclaim its clearance.
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_26_15.zh: 在你帮助灯灯解开了心结，脱离噩梦之后，之前逃出心之集域的白猫也能开口说话了。据它所说，大门出现在了各大地区，而它失去了在心之集域内的控制权限，需要你进入门中的梦境里，帮助其夺回权限。

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_26_9.text: You saw Illusia, not real Lumi. She is safe, don't worry...
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_26_9.zh: 车里灯灯，梦境虚像，不是真人，不用担心……

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_27_1.text: (Lumi hasn't had any dreams since visiting Whining Aix's Mire.)
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_27_1.zh: 灯灯之前提到，她来过这附近后，就没有再做过梦了。
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_27_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_27_3.text: (If this has been going on for a while, Lumi might not be the only one trapped here.)
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_27_3.zh: 如果异变已经持续了一段时间，恐怕被困住的不会只有灯灯一个人。
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_27_3.speaker: Rover

yakita:Event_DAZYHQLZD1_9_1.chapter: 剧情_春节活动引导任务第一天_1_7
yakita:Event_DAZYHQLZD1_9_1.text: Judging by that look on your face, you've dug up a clue, haven't you, Lumi?
yakita:Event_DAZYHQLZD1_9_1.zh: 灯灯，看你的样子，是不是打听出了什么？
yakita:Event_DAZYHQLZD1_9_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Event_WGZM_3_4.chapter: 剧情_1_4_肉鸽_起点房角色剧情_1_3
yakita:Event_WGZM_3_4.text: It's Lumi, the logistics team's good ol' captain.
yakita:Event_WGZM_3_4.speaker: Lumi

yakita:Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_29.text: Then I suggest asking Lumi to deliver you back to the HQ. Maybe she'll go soft on you.
yakita:Event_WWQHGZBKRHZQ_0_29.zh: 我会推荐灯灯做这件事的，也许她会对你温柔一些。

yakita:FavorWord_150408_Content.text: Rice noodles are my absolute favorite! Spice it up with chili, a dash of vinegar, sprinkle some green onions... delicious! Next time you're in Yuezhou, I'll treat you!
yakita:FavorWord_150408_Content.zh: 我可喜欢米粉！加点辣子，加点醋，加点儿葱花……香得很！下次去越州玩，我请你吃好不好？
yakita:FavorWord_150408_Content.speaker: Lumi

yakita:FavorWord_150415_Content.text: Youhu's packages always come with insurance, full of pricey antiques. I don't know much about these stuff, but the way she handles them, you can tell they're her treasures.
yakita:FavorWord_150415_Content.zh: 釉瑚每次寄的东西好像都很值钱，都要上保价。嗯……灯灯我也不太懂古玩啦，但她特别严肃认真的样子，我想肯定是对她来说很珍贵、很爱惜的东西吧。
yakita:FavorWord_150415_Content.speaker: Lumi

yakita:FavorWord_150430_Content.text: They used to call me Jolly Sun in my village. I prefer Lumi though! The sun sets at night, but I'm always ready to illuminate someone's way home!
yakita:FavorWord_150430_Content.zh: 村里人总叫我小太阳，但我觉得当灯灯就很好。太阳总会落山，但夜晚想点一盏灯时，随时都可以！
yakita:FavorWord_150430_Content.speaker: Lumi

yakita:FavorWord_150431_Content.text: So, you are saying I'm already a top-notch navigator? Really?… No, no, don't get too comfortable, Lumi! There's still a long way to go, gotta keep it up!
yakita:FavorWord_150431_Content.zh: 现在的我，算是一名优秀的领航员了吗？呼……不行不行，不能得意！还要更努力才行！路还很长，灯灯我会挺起胸膛，一直走下去。
yakita:FavorWord_150431_Content.speaker: Lumi

yakita:FWNPC_QQYC_44_3.text: They've got Lupa. Honestly, I can't imagine how they'd ever lose.
yakita:FWNPC_QQYC_44_3.zh: 他们队可是有露帕选手，根本想不到怎么输好吧。

yakita:FWNPC_QQYC_45_2.text: I told you, go all in on Lupa and you'll cash in big! Lupa the Dupa. She's the best!
yakita:FWNPC_QQYC_45_2.zh: 早和你说了，买露帕，赚大钱！露帕选手，角斗场里永远的神！

yakita:FWNPC_QQYC_46_1.text: Hey, brother, do you know how to join Lupa's fan club?
yakita:FWNPC_QQYC_46_1.zh: 老哥，你有没有什么露帕选手的粉丝俱乐部的加入方式啊？

yakita:FWNPC_QQYC_48_4.text: I mean, no one would've guessed we'd run into Lupa in the qualifiers...
yakita:FWNPC_QQYC_48_4.zh: 毕竟谁能想到，我们会在预选赛上遇到露帕选手呢……

yakita:FWNPC_QQYC_49_1.text: Well, a loss is a loss. Are we that far removed from the greats? What is it that makes Lupa so strong?
yakita:FWNPC_QQYC_49_1.zh: 输得百口莫辩，这就是我们与天才之间的差距么……露帕选手，到底是因为什么，才能变得那么强啊。

yakita:FWNPC_QQYC_49_10.text: Relax. We didn't lose to just some ordinary noob. Lupa is heading for the bigger stages. She'll become the strongest Gladiator there is.
yakita:FWNPC_QQYC_49_10.zh: 放心吧。我们并没有输给什么随处可见的普通人。露帕选手会走向更大的舞台，她将成为最强的角斗士。
yakita:FWNPC_QQYC_49_10.speaker: Quinta

yakita:FWNPC_QQYC_49_2.text: Don't stress over it. There's only one Lupa in all of Septimont. Losing to her is just something you have to accept.
yakita:FWNPC_QQYC_49_2.zh: 别想太多了，整个七丘也只有那么一位露帕啊，输给她，也是没办法的事。
yakita:FWNPC_QQYC_49_2.speaker: Quinta

yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_17_3.chapter: 剧情_七丘_列奥尼达广场生态_5_1
yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_17_3.text: Top eight? You're supposed to be playing none other than the genius Gladiator, Contender Lupa!
yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_17_3.zh: 八强？你负责扮演的可是那位天才角斗士露帕选手！

yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_17_4.chapter: 剧情_七丘_列奥尼达广场生态_5_1
yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_17_4.text: Miss Lupa would never say something like that!
yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_17_4.zh: 露帕小姐是不会说出这种话的！

yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_13_2.text: Just thinking about the news I saw last night. Something about that champion Gladiator everyone's talking about... Her name's Lupa, right? She looks quite the warrior!
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_13_2.zh: 妈妈在想昨天晚上看的新闻报道哦。这次的热门夺冠选手……名字叫做露帕吗？看上去还挺强的！

yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_13_9.text: Mom, who was the champion twenty years ago? Was she as great as Lupa?
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_13_9.zh: 妈妈，二十年前的优胜者是谁啊？她和露帕姐姐谁更厉害啊？

yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_14_8.text: Again with the story twenty years ago... As far as I'm concerned, there's no one cooler or stronger than Lupa. When I grow up, I want to buy some of your gear, old timer, then go ask Lupa to be my mentor!
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_14_8.zh: 大叔，你怎么又开始讲二十年前的事情了……反正在我心里，露帕姐姐最帅最强。我的梦想就是长大之后从大叔你这买装备，然后去找露帕姐姐拜师学角斗技巧！

yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_21_1.text: Lupa's team won. No surprises there. Still, I'm proud of you, Beasts Beneath! May applause greet you!
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_21_1.zh: 最后果然是露帕{Male=他们;Female=她们}夺冠了啊……以呼嚎向你们致意，我的兽之心队！

yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_21_2.text: Oh? Not calling yourself a longtime Lupa fan, are you now?
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_21_2.zh: 怎么了，这次不改口说自己是露帕的粉丝了？

yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_21_3.text: Please. After today, we're all Lupa fans! Some people already watched the replays of her finals match a dozens times.
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_21_3.zh: 哪有，我们这里不遍地都是她的粉丝？已经有人反复看了十几遍决赛回放了。

yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_41_1.text: You got this, Lupa! No matter how you do in the finals, I'll always support you!
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_41_1.zh: 露帕选手加油啊！无论冠军赛表现如何，我都永远支持你！

yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_41_2.text: With her capabilities, the win's in the bag for sure! I want to get stronger too... Wish I could be in the same training room with Lupa...
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_41_2.zh: 她实力那么强，夺冠肯定没问题的！我也想变强，真希望露帕选手训练的时候可以带我一个啊……

yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_42_1.text: See? I told you all Lupa was going to win the championship!
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_42_1.zh: 哼哼~我就知道露帕选手肯定会夺冠的！

yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_42_3.text: I guess I was wrong about Lupa... It's all pure strength, plain and simple.
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_42_3.zh: 看来是我误会了……露帕的强大毋庸置疑。

yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_51_3.text: Yeah. You think that Gladiator can go up against Lupa, old timer?
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_51_3.zh: 是啊是啊。大叔，你说的那个角斗士有露帕姐姐那么强吗？

yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_5_2.text: That's right. I'm a Lupa superfan! I've watched replays of every single one of her matches at least a million times now!
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_5_2.zh: 是啊，我可是露帕选手的超级粉丝。她的每一场比赛我都看了几十遍了哦！
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_5_2.speaker: Marccia

yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_5_6.text: What's there to be fishy about? It's pure Lupa roflstomp! Besides, Lupa's not the cheating type!
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_5_6.zh: 能有什么猫腻？就是单纯实力碾压罢了！露帕不可能是打假赛的那种人！

yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_6_1.text: Hey! Aren't you one of Lupa's teammates? I didn't recognize you last time. Congrats on winning the championship!
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_6_1.zh: 啊！你不就是露帕选手的队友吗？上次没认出你来，恭喜你们夺得冠军！
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_6_1.speaker: Marccia

yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_6_9.text: Can you help me tell Lupa that I'm sorry for accusing her of cheating earlier?
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_6_9.zh: 能帮我向露帕选手道个歉吗？之前我不该怀疑她打假赛的。

yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_20_7.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府后院生态_1_20
yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_20_7.text: We need fighters like Lupa. Eyes locked on the enemy's throat, always calculating the kill. That's someone who wins, or dies trying.
yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_20_7.zh: 你要找的是露帕那种永远紧盯着对手双眼和喉咙的人，因为我们不需要失败者，要么赢，要么滚。

yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_22_2.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府后院生态_1_22
yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_22_2.text: Yes, these are the worst by far, madam... Only a handful barely made the cut, and Lupa still crushed them five to zero.
yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_22_2.zh: 诶，今年真是有史以来最差的一届了……就这么几个人已经是还算勉强的了，没想到一见到露帕就被打了个五比零。

yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_5_2.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府后院生态_1_5
yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_5_2.text: It depends... But I'd go for Lupa if you ask me.
yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_5_2.zh: 这个要分情况……不过要我说，目前应该是露帕选手吧。

yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_5_3.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府后院生态_1_5
yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_5_3.text: Lupa is the real deal, no doubt. But if the Ephor ever entered the ring? All bets are off.
yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_5_3.zh: 的确应该是露帕选手，但总督要是下场的话就不一定了……

yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_6_1.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府后院生态_1_6
yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_6_1.text: Aha! So even you think Lupa is the strongest out there! I knew it!
yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_6_1.zh: 果然，哥哥们也认为露帕选手是现在最强的角斗士呀！
yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_6_1.speaker: Ricken

yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_6_14.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府后院生态_1_6
yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_6_14.text: Ha! I knew Lupa was unbeatable! No one can take down our champion!
yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_6_14.zh: 耶！果然露帕选手才是最强的！我们露帕选手是不可战胜的！
yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_6_14.speaker: Ricken

yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_7_1.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府后院生态_1_7
yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_7_1.text: All the lads think Lupa is the strongest Gladiator around. But I think her partner also deserves more credit.
yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_7_1.zh: 哥哥们认为露帕选手是现在最强的角斗士……但我觉得她那位搭档也同样优秀啊。
yakita:GNNPC_QQZDHY_7_1.speaker: Ricken

yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_9_11.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府内生态_1_9
yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_9_11.text: But I doubt any of that will trouble you. With you and Contender Lupa on the field, I can't imagine anyone standing in your way.
yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_9_11.zh: ……不过这些对于您来说应该都不是问题吧？我相信以您和露帕选手的实力，可以赢下任何的角斗比赛。

yakita:NPC_204JIUDIAN_6_1.text: Miss Lupa's been making changes to some of her meals lately...
yakita:NPC_204JIUDIAN_6_1.zh: 露帕小姐最近调整了自己的部分餐食……

yakita:NPC_24SIMPLE_30_1.text: Try this Heartpour! Endorsed by Lupa herself. And now we're offering a limited edition special for the Agon! The first 100 orders get a signed autograph from Ms. Lupa!
yakita:NPC_24SIMPLE_30_1.zh: 饮下这杯心吧！由露帕选手冠名代言，先推出竞技赛特别纪念款！前一百名订购还有亲签赠送！

yakita:NPC_24SIMPLE_5_2.text: Did you say Lupa? Just hearing her name gets me so hyped! I'm her biggest fan!
yakita:NPC_24SIMPLE_5_2.zh: 什么什么？你说露帕我就来劲，我超喜欢她的！！

yakita:NPC_24SIMPLE_71_1.text: Heartpour! Drink up and shine brighter than ever! Endorsed by our legendary Gladiator, Lupa!
yakita:NPC_24SIMPLE_71_1.zh: 饮下这杯心！明星角斗士露帕代言，让你更加闪耀。

yakita:NPC_24_GUIZU_11_1.text: Sigh... What should I do? The Gladiator I'm sponsoring is about to go up against Lupa. The fight's already lost.
yakita:NPC_24_GUIZU_11_1.zh: 唉……怎么办啊，我赞助的角斗士对上露帕了，这不是必输吗？

yakita:NPC_24_GUIZU_5_3.text: We were deeply moved by Miss Lupa's spirit during the finals, so we decided to stick to our goals by continuing our fight on our own.
yakita:NPC_24_GUIZU_5_3.zh: 在冠军赛中，我们被露帕小姐的精神所打动，我们决定坚持本心，靠自己的力量继续拼搏。

yakita:NPC_24_GUIZU_7_1.text: Is that 漂泊者? Did you see the game between {Male=him;Female=her} and Lupa?
yakita:NPC_24_GUIZU_7_1.zh: 那是漂泊者吧，你看过{TA}和露帕一起的比赛吗？

yakita:XCLST_5_4.text: Very good. I hope that in time you will become a Gladiator as renowned as Lupa. I trust you will do your best.
yakita:XCLST_5_4.zh: 很好，我对你的期望是成为露帕选手那样名扬七丘的角斗士，好好努力吧。

yakita:lmzxst_3_1.chapter: 剧情_2_7_支线_重建生态支线_5_5
yakita:lmzxst_3_1.text: Just when things got tense, my battle-hardened body didn't fail me. A single sidestep and I dodged Lupa's spear just like that!
yakita:lmzxst_3_1.zh: 就在这个危急时刻，千锤百炼的肉体没有辜负我，我一个闪身就将露帕选手的枪尖躲了过去！

datamine:InfoDisplay_125000115_Text.title: Her Oath
datamine:InfoDisplay_125000115_Text.text:
Lupa gazes at you intensely, her eyes sparkling with passion.

"I swear by the eternal sun." It's more than a promise, but a testimonial to the lone wolf's raw loyalty and sincerity. She may be yet another soul you salvaged in your long journey. But for Lupa, she's found something she never had—something that offers the long-awaited release of her anguish and pain. You'll never know what that is, and she won't tell you either. But that's all right. For both of you, this is enough.
datamine:InfoDisplay_125000115_Text.zh:
露帕的脸孔双眼闪闪发亮，正热切地注视着你。
“以长照不灭的太阳起誓。”是她对你的承诺，也是孤狼的赤诚和真心。这或许只是你漫长旅途中的又一次拯救，但对露帕而言，她终于得到了一些过去不曾得到的东西，也终于对一些焦躁的痛苦释然。这些你不得而知，她也不准备告诉你。这样就好，对你对她，这样就足够了。

yakita:MAIN_RYAM_90_5.text: Lupa, does Domina Julia believe in the Sentinel?
yakita:MAIN_RYAM_90_5.zh: 露帕，那位尤利娅女士信仰「岁主」吗？
yakita:MAIN_RYAM_90_5.speaker: Rover

yakita:MAIN_YGDX_29_2.text: To treat Septimont like a plaything... unforgivable!
yakita:MAIN_YGDX_29_2.zh: 把七丘当做手里的玩具，随意涂抹……不可原谅！
yakita:MAIN_YGDX_29_2.speaker: Lupa

yakita:MAIN_YGDX_36_2.text: The Threnodian's frequency is gone. Well done, Lupa.
yakita:MAIN_YGDX_36_2.zh: 我感觉到鸣式的频率消失了。你做得很好，露帕。
yakita:MAIN_YGDX_36_2.speaker: Rover

yakita:MAIN_YGDX_38_25.chapter: 剧情_2_4_七丘主线_放水后日谈_6_1
yakita:MAIN_YGDX_38_25.text: Do you fear that one day... you might face defeat?
yakita:MAIN_YGDX_38_25.zh: 搭档，你会担心有朝一日……也遭遇失败吗？
yakita:MAIN_YGDX_38_25.speaker: Lupa

yakita:MAIN_YGDX_79_1.text: You're assistance is much appreciated, Contender Lupa!
yakita:MAIN_YGDX_79_1.zh: 感谢你的帮助，露帕选手！

yakita:LHYSTTH_7_3.text: Playing message... 漂泊者, Luuk Herssen reminds you to please see him for your follow-up appointment.
yakita:LHYSTTH_7_3.zh: 触发留言……漂泊者，陆·赫斯医生提醒您按时复查。

yakita:Luuk_Shengtai_1_10.text: That's how I feel now. Life at the Academy is peaceful. The students can be a handful sometimes, but I'd never change their vibrant spirits. To be able to share a casual conversation with you like this... I couldn't feel more at home.
yakita:Luuk_Shengtai_1_10.zh: 像现在这样——学院的日子很平静，学生们偶尔闹腾却始终活泼有生命力。能这样站着和你随意聊聊天，本身就已经让我觉得很放松了。
yakita:Luuk_Shengtai_1_10.speaker: Luuk Herssen

yakita:FavorWord_151027_Content.text: My body's responding... with a frequency so subtle, almost inaudible. Like the quiet instant when a blade is finally honed to perfection. Mm, feels good. Precise, like an extension of my arm.
yakita:FavorWord_151027_Content.zh: 身体在回应……以细微得几乎听不见的频率，就像刀锋被重新打磨的那一瞬。嗯，状态不错，精准，且如臂使指。
yakita:FavorWord_151027_Content.speaker: Luuk Herssen

yakita:MAIN_RGLC_12162_1.text: Luuk Herssen gathered this dirt from the "place where he rests."
yakita:MAIN_RGLC_12162_1.zh: 陆·赫斯从“沉眠之地”取来的一抔冻土。

yakita:MAIN_RGLC_36_34.text: Later, after I inherited Novialle, I realized there were still so many things I couldn't control. So I'd eat them to cope, especially when I was up to my neck in trouble thanks to my business associates.
yakita:MAIN_RGLC_36_34.zh: 后来我继承了诺维尔再生医药，发现还是有很多事我难以处理，我只好再吃一颗，面对合作伙伴带来的糟心官司。
yakita:MAIN_RGLC_36_34.speaker: Luuk Herssen

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_44_12.chapter: 剧情_3_0_主线_拉海洛主线_上半_1_25_1
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_44_12.text: (Brief Luuk Herssen on your investigation and suspicions.)
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_44_12.zh: （向陆·赫斯说明了调查的过程和推论）

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_38_24.text: They have a connection to the Somnoire, don't they?
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_38_24.zh: 她们和心之集域有所关联，是吧？
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_38_24.speaker: Luuk Herssen

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_38_31.text: Of course. While you're at it, could you give Rebecca this Terminal?
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_38_31.zh: 好的。如果你去找丽贝卡，那刚好可以帮我把数据终端带给她。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_38_31.speaker: Luuk Herssen

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_38_8.text: This is Luuk Herssen. One of the Academy's doctors.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_38_8.zh: 介绍下。这位是赫斯医生，星炬学院的校医。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_38_8.speaker: Rover

yakita:Side_Coop_StingerDate_1_25.text: This doesn't seem like Luuk Herssen's kind of movie... You reconsider.
yakita:Side_Coop_StingerDate_1_25.zh: 似乎不是陆·赫斯会喜欢的电影类型呢……再想想吧。

yakita:Side_Coop_StingerDate_3_13.text: Judging from the summary, this seems like a movie Luuk Herssen would like... You invite Luuk.
yakita:Side_Coop_StingerDate_3_13.zh: 看简介，也许是陆·赫斯会喜欢的电影类型……向陆·赫斯发出邀请吧。

yakita:Side_Coop_StingerLHS_2_1.text: New Federation students can't stand organ meat... Better swap it all for soft-boiled eggs...
yakita:Side_Coop_StingerLHS_2_1.zh: 新联邦的学生们不喜欢动物肝脏……都换成流心蛋吧……
yakita:Side_Coop_StingerLHS_2_1.speaker: Luuk Herssen

yakita:Side_Coop_StingerLHS_3_14.text: You stroll through the campus with Luuk Herssen. Sharing this moment is a slice of warmth in your day...
yakita:Side_Coop_StingerLHS_3_14.zh: 你与陆·赫斯漫步在校园的街道上，一同度过了一段美好的时光……

yakita:Side_LHSCP_13_26.text: Luuk Herssen looks down at the calico cat that is slowly playing with its own tail.
yakita:Side_LHSCP_13_26.zh: 陆·赫斯低头看了眼三花猫，猫正慢吞吞地拍着自己的尾巴。

yakita:XDQY_14_1.text: Accident solved. Luuk Herssen flattens his outfit with a tone so casual you'd think he was just passing by.
yakita:XDQY_14_1.zh: 危机解决，陆·赫斯拍拍衣角，语气轻松自然得像是纯路过。

yakita:XDQY_14_13.text: You shake your head to clear out the clutter and refocus your gaze on Luuk Herssen.
yakita:XDQY_14_13.zh: 你晃了晃脑袋，把这些乱七八糟的思考暂且排除出去，再次盯向了陆·赫斯。

yakita:XDQY_14_24.text: Luuk Herssen stays silent for two seconds before sighing in defeat and popping the candy into his mouth.
yakita:XDQY_14_24.zh: 陆·赫斯沉默了两秒，终于叹了口气，认输般把糖放进了嘴里。

yakita:Zuoyequnxing_50_7.chapter: 剧情_3_3_拉海洛主线_上半新_2_1
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_50_7.text: Their biggest financial backer is the New Federation. And of course, they answer to an entire board of investors.
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_50_7.zh: 深空联合背后最大的金主是新联邦，他们的行动也必然要对新联邦的投资人团体负责。
yakita:Zuoyequnxing_50_7.speaker: Luuk Herssen

yakita:34NPCTHST_5_4.text: Others performed just as impressively. Why don't you try asking Lynae again?
yakita:34NPCTHST_5_4.zh: 其他人的应对也很精彩啊，你再私下联络琳奈同学试试呢？

yakita:AYJJST_47_3.text: A race? You're on. I've been training with Lynae. Learnt a bunch of new techniques. I could beat you with one hand tied behind my back.
yakita:AYJJST_47_3.zh: 比就比，谁怕你，我可是跟琳奈同学潜心学习过摩托驾驶技术，让你一只手都能赢。

yakita:LHYSTTH2_10_6.text: To commemorate you and Lynae going toe-to-toe with that Voidworm, our baristas leveled up their latte art. Now we can do custom mini portraits of you two on your drinks.
yakita:LHYSTTH2_10_6.zh: 为了纪念你和琳奈同学与虚诞虫作战的英勇表现，社团咖啡师特意提升了拉花技术，现在可以定制琳奈同学和你的迷你头像拉花哦。
yakita:LHYSTTH2_10_6.speaker: Rafah

yakita:NPC_LCZ_23_1.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院列车站生态_39_1
yakita:NPC_LCZ_23_1.text: Wow... Lynae appeared in S.I.G.M.A.'s traffic safety lecture...
yakita:NPC_LCZ_23_1.zh: 哇……琳奈同学出镜了S.I.G.M.A.先生的交通安全小课堂耶……

yakita:NPC_LCZ_23_3.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院列车站生态_39_1
yakita:NPC_LCZ_23_3.text: It's... SO CUTE! I've got to send this to Lynae!
yakita:NPC_LCZ_23_3.zh: 好！可！爱！我要转发给奈奈！

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_50_1.text: Hey, everyone! Reporting live from the scene! Just like "Reporter" Lynae said, this mysterious girl seems to know the Academy like the back of her hand.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_50_1.zh: 各位，现在我就在现场，和琳奈“记者”报道的一样，神秘的少女对学院的一切都很熟悉。

yakita:XJXYSDJ_12_9.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院商业街生态_13_1
yakita:XJXYSDJ_12_9.text: So the anonymous poster was Lynae?! How did she even figure that out…
yakita:XJXYSDJ_12_9.zh: 那个匿名发帖人，难道是琳奈前辈吗？！她到底是怎么发现的……

yakita:linnai_shengtai_1_31.text: I'm still gonna protect it all, in my own "Lynae" way.
yakita:linnai_shengtai_1_31.zh: 我还是会以“琳奈”的方式，守护珍视的一切……
yakita:linnai_shengtai_1_31.speaker: Lynae

yakita:linnai_shengtai_1_43.text: (You're sure this is exactly the kind of funky-flavored candy Lynae would enjoy.)
yakita:linnai_shengtai_1_43.zh: （……你很确信，这是琳奈会喜欢的“怪味糖果”。）

yakita:linnai_shengtai_1_50.text: Ah—Good times never last! My next class is with Professor Mornye. Can't skip that...
yakita:linnai_shengtai_1_50.zh: 啊——美好的时光总是那么短暂！下节好像是莫宁教授的课来着，她的课我可不好意思再逃了……
yakita:linnai_shengtai_1_50.speaker: Lynae

datamine:InfoDisplay_30010012_Text.title: Group Photo Under the New Sun
datamine:InfoDisplay_30010012_Text.text: A photo of you, Mornye, and Lynae under the New Sun.
datamine:InfoDisplay_30010012_Text.zh: 你与琳奈、莫宁在新日之下的三人合影

datamine:InfoDisplay_30010013_Text.title: Group Photo Under the New Sun
datamine:InfoDisplay_30010013_Text.text: A photo of you, Mornye, and Lynae under the New Sun.
datamine:InfoDisplay_30010013_Text.zh: 你与琳奈、莫宁在新日之下的三人合影

yakita:Event_WWPDJSBF_5_19.chapter: 剧情_春节活动角色邀约_琳奈_1_1
yakita:Event_WWPDJSBF_5_19.text: They've even got New Federation specialties here! Been ages since I last had those…
yakita:Event_WWPDJSBF_5_19.zh: 而且，还把派对办得这么棒……这里竟然还有新联邦的特色菜，我已经好久没吃到了！
yakita:Event_WWPDJSBF_5_19.speaker: Lynae

yakita:FavorWord_150901_Content.text: Hey, you! Brought you some snacks. Nice day, huh? Whaddya say we get some scorch marks on the road? Oh, and I heard the cafeteria is serving some weird new dish. We should try it for lunch! Oh yeah, I also heard the Film Club is screening an old New Federation film this afternoon that I've always wanted to watch! Interested? And then tonight we could... Oh. Uh, yeah, my bad. Should I...? Yeah, I'll let you keep sleeping.
yakita:FavorWord_150901_Content.zh: 你好啊！喏，给你带了点零食，今天天气不错，要不要一起去兜个风？对了，听说食堂上了新的菜式，味道特别怪，中午一起去试试吧？噢！突然想起电影研究部今天下午会放那部我在新联邦一直没机会看的电影，你感兴趣吗？想不想一起去看看？还有晚上……呃，抱歉……要不……你再睡一会？
yakita:FavorWord_150901_Content.speaker: Lynae

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_10.chapter: 剧情_3_0_主线_拉海洛主线_上半_1_35_1
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_10.text: I do. I'm not a Startorch student anymore. Rules are rules, and I should return to the New Federation.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_10.zh: 我知道，我已经不是星炬学院的学生，按照规定，应该遣返回新联邦。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_212_10.speaker: Lynae

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_308_1.chapter: 剧情_3_0_深空联合主线_上半_2_2_7
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_308_1.text: See that? That's the lift to the surface. We call it the Starward Riseway.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_308_1.zh: 那个啊，就是通往地上的运载电梯——联运椎骨。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_308_1.speaker: Lynae

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_38_19.chapter: 剧情_3_0_主线_拉海洛主线_上半_1_24_1
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_38_19.text: One last thing, Miss Lynae. You're from the New Federation, right?
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_38_19.zh: 对了，琳奈同学是来自新联邦吧？
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_38_19.speaker: Warren

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_40_16.chapter: 剧情_3_0_主线_拉海洛主线_上半_1_18_1
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_40_16.text: Professor Warren knows I'm from the New Federation, but not exactly which part.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_40_16.zh: 魏尔伦教授说过我来自新联邦，但他不知道我来自新联邦的哪里。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_40_16.speaker: Lynae

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_45_17.chapter: 剧情_3_0_主线_拉海洛主线_上半_1_26_1
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_45_17.text: ...Whichever "Lynae" I am, I don't belong here.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_45_17.zh: ……但无论是哪个“琳奈”，都终究不属于这里。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_45_17.speaker: Lynae

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_18.text: C'mon, I'm sure Rebecca's already got a plan, right?
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_18.zh: 这种事情丽贝卡应该早就考虑过了，对吧？
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_63_18.speaker: Lynae

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_12_5.text: I say investors, but it's mostly New Federation money. Can't say I'm surprised they're pulling this kinda stunt.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_12_5.zh: 不过叫投资方，其实主要就是新联邦，实话说他们做出这种事我一点都不吃惊。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_12_5.speaker: Lynae

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_41.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_7_2
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_41.text: That girl might be the key to recovering your memories. Madam Magistrate's information aside, it seems to me your dream points toward the Norfall Barrens.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_41.zh: 或许找到那个少女，是找回漂泊者记忆的关键，除去今令尹提供的信息，梦境的指向之一，是北落野。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_480_41.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_110_3.text: Madam Sanhua, I do believe it's been two whole hours. Will you be taking me to see the Magistrate or not?
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_110_3.zh: 散华侍卫，我已在这坐了足足有两个时辰，是否可带我去见今令尹了？

yakita:GNNPC_JDXZRYZQ_46_3.text: I'm Mayou, Maji's brother. He told me all about you. Said you helped him launch a bunch of Lollo apps...
yakita:GNNPC_JDXZRYZQ_46_3.zh: 我叫马游，是马计的弟弟。我从他那里听说了很多关于你的事，他告诉我，你帮他研发了一大堆呜呜系列的应用……

yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_4_1.chapter: 剧情_七丘_列奥尼达广场生态_2_2
