yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_4_1.text: Have you heard? Maji just got promoted again.
yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_4_1.zh: 你听说了么，马计最近又升职了。

yakita:LGNCZST_60_8.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_10
yakita:LGNCZST_60_8.text: Maggie...? Oh, oh! You mean my colleague, Maji!
yakita:LGNCZST_60_8.zh: Maggie……？哦哦哦，您说的是我的同僚马计！

yakita:BYCZ_2_5.text: Oh, I'm pretty new! Just got assigned under Maji myself.
yakita:BYCZ_2_5.zh: 嗨，我也是才入行不久，刚被分到马计师傅的手下。

yakita:BYCZ_2_7.text: Maji's got his hands full with a Lollo Campaign right now. Said a rookie like me could use the field experience, so he… graciously passed this opportunity to me!
yakita:BYCZ_2_7.zh: 马计师傅业务繁忙，光是「呜呜企划」的活动就够他操劳的了。师傅说，年轻人应该多出来历练一下，就把这个宝贵的机会“让”给了我。

yakita:Event_TCTL5_1_3.text: Hehe, with today's sales under the watchful eye of yours truly, Maji, we've got nothing to worry about! Right, 漂泊者?
yakita:Event_TCTL5_1_3.zh: 嘿嘿，今日的呜呜业绩也将由我马计守候……你说对吧，漂泊者？
yakita:Event_TCTL5_1_3.speaker: Maji

yakita:Event_WWCS_12_3.text: Nevertheless, a true man never sheds tears over his career! Pull yourself together, Maji!
yakita:Event_WWCS_12_3.zh: 真男人怎么能为了生计落泪？振作起来，马计！
yakita:Event_WWCS_12_3.speaker: Maji

yakita:Event_WWDG_17_2.chapter: 剧情_V2_2呜呜物流引导和后续任务_4_3
yakita:Event_WWDG_17_2.text: Sounds like Maji is in trouble... I'd better go lend a hand.
yakita:Event_WWDG_17_2.zh: 马计似乎遇到了什么麻烦……过去看看吧。
yakita:Event_WWDG_17_2.speaker: Rover

yakita:Event_WWDH_14_1.text: After some hard work, you and Maji used the data recorded by "Lollo Navigator" to help the couriers verify their goods. In the end, all the couriers gave you a thumbs-up.
yakita:Event_WWDH_14_1.zh:
经历了一段时间，你和马计利用「呜呜导航」记录的数据帮助物流员们重新确认了货物的信息……
物流员们纷纷向你们竖起了大拇指……

yakita:Event_WWDH_16_2.text: I don't remember Maji ever mentioning them...
yakita:Event_WWDH_16_2.zh: 我记得马计没有提到过它们……
yakita:Event_WWDH_16_2.speaker: Rover

yakita:Event_WWDH_17_3.text: Just as Maji is about to explain the details to you, the applet on the "Lollo Navigator" starts chiming…
yakita:Event_WWDH_17_3.zh: 正当马计想向你详细解说时，「呜呜导航」小程序响动了起来……

yakita:Event_WWDH_8_1.text: I remember Maji taught me how to transmit data. Let's see here...
yakita:Event_WWDH_8_1.zh: 我记得马计教给我传输信息的步骤是……
yakita:Event_WWDH_8_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Event_WWQHEQ_1_11.text: What are you talking about? In all of Solaris, you're the most dependable one. Only I, Maji, could find someone as reliable as you.
yakita:Event_WWQHEQ_1_11.zh: 这是什么话，放眼整个索拉里斯，只有你最靠谱，也只有我马计，才能找到你这么靠谱的关系。
yakita:Event_WWQHEQ_1_11.speaker: Maji

yakita:Event_WWQHSQ_2_25.text: For my salary, and for the happiness of my old friend. I, Maji, will do anything!
yakita:Event_WWQHSQ_2_25.zh: 只要能领到工资，只要能让老朋友享受到舒心的服务，马计我义不容辞！
yakita:Event_WWQHSQ_2_25.speaker: Maji

yakita:Event_WWQH_11_2.text: The Tacet Field in the Port City of Guixu is expanding, and the nearby Xiehua Village has been included in the emergency evacuation area. The Ministry of Development and the Patrollers are already very busy.
yakita:Event_WWQH_11_2.zh: 归墟港市的无音区有扩张的趋势，邻近的撷华庄被纳入了应急疏散区，天工和巡尉已经忙得不可开交了。
yakita:Event_WWQH_11_2.speaker: Maji

yakita:Event_WWQH_11_3.text: Merchants willing to go to Xiehua Village are few already because of the short distance to the Port City of Guixu. Now with the trouble in the Tacet Field...
yakita:Event_WWQH_11_3.zh: 撷华庄临近归墟港市，本来愿意去那儿的货商就少，再加上这无音区一闹……
yakita:Event_WWQH_11_3.speaker: Maji

yakita:Event_WWQH_16_1.text: Maji remains silent for a while before calming down.
yakita:Event_WWQH_16_1.zh: 马计沉默了良久，才平复了心绪。

yakita:Event_WWQH_1_10.text: Next to Maji, an expensive-looking magazine titled How to Talk Like a Real Business Elite catches your attention...
yakita:Event_WWQH_1_10.zh: 【马计的身边，一本名为《物联网黑话指南》的精装杂志引起了你的注意——】

yakita:Event_WWQH_21_1.text: You tell Maji about the event, leaving him speechless for a moment.
yakita:Event_WWQH_21_1.zh: 你将方才的遭遇告诉了马计，马计一时无语。

yakita:Event_WWQH_25_1.text:
Order #1: 5 cups, 0 code.
Order #2: 30 cups, 1 code.
Order #3: 22 cups, 1 code.
Order #4: 1 cup, 1 code.
Order #5: 10 cups, 2 codes...

With 68 cups of boba in your stomach, you and Maji call it quits earlier than you expected.
yakita:Event_WWQH_25_1.zh:
第一单，5杯，兑换码0张；
第二单，30杯，兑换码1张；
第三单，22杯，兑换码1张；
第四单，1杯，兑换码1张；
第五单，10杯，兑换码2张……

68杯糖水下肚，你和马计提前结束了战斗。

yakita:Event_WWQH_31_6.text: Alright, enough with the fancy words... Ahem. I hereby declared that "Maji's Lollo Entrepreneur Pilot Business Projects" will end today.
yakita:Event_WWQH_31_6.zh: 算了算了，不和你贫了。本人马计，宣布「马计的呜呜创业企划」今日正式收官。
yakita:Event_WWQH_31_6.speaker: Maji

yakita:Event_WWQH_4_1.text: Maji inspects the codebase and contacts the buyers who canceled the orders.
yakita:Event_WWQH_4_1.zh: 马计查验了系统代码，并逐个联系了撤销订单的委托人。

yakita:Event_WWQH_6_10.text: A new order! An automatic courier truck went missing in the depths of Whining Aix's Mire. I'll send you the coordinates.
yakita:Event_WWQH_6_10.zh: 来活儿了漂师傅！有一辆自动物流车在怨鸟泽深处失联了，我把定位发你。
yakita:Event_WWQH_6_10.speaker: Maji

yakita:GNNPC_SBDTCD2_4_8.text: Hello! This is account manager Maji. How can I help you today?
yakita:GNNPC_SBDTCD2_4_8.zh: 您好，我是客户经理马计。请问有什么需要咨询的？

yakita:StZLCZ_24_5.chapter: 剧情_拉海洛_整流车站系列_1_23
yakita:StZLCZ_24_5.text: Maybe Maji could teach you more about innovation and less about the corporate jargon.
yakita:StZLCZ_24_5.zh: 你还是学学马计的创意和拼劲，呜联网黑话这块就算了。
yakita:StZLCZ_24_5.speaker: Rover

yakita:LGNCZST_3_2.text: Whoa! Welcome! Welcome! Ragunna has an endless array of culinary delights! We have Margherita Steak, Nectarwine, Pizza Classica, and Nuvola Pasta...
yakita:LGNCZST_3_2.zh: 哦！欢迎！欢迎！拉古那的美食数不胜数！玛格烈特牛排、蜜露果酒、传统窑炉披萨、云凝肉酱烩面……

yakita:LGNCZST_46_5.text: Ms. Margherita won't step in as long as they don't disrupt other guests from enjoying their meals.
yakita:LGNCZST_46_5.zh: 玛格烈特小姐也不会想管的……吵归吵，只要不打扰到其他客人的食欲和心情就行了。

yakita:LGNCZST_54_2.text: Two decaf Margheritas, a courtesy from Ms. Zani.
yakita:LGNCZST_54_2.zh: ……两杯玛格烈特低因浓缩，赞妮小姐请的。

yakita:LKKST_1_14.text: When night falls, the curtain will rise at Margherita's Restaurant.
yakita:LKKST_1_14.zh: 当夜幕降临的时候，演出将在玛格烈特餐厅拉开序幕。
yakita:LKKST_1_14.speaker: Roccia

yakita:LKKST_2_5.text: The show begins this evening at Margherita's Restaurant.
yakita:LKKST_2_5.zh: 晚上，在玛格烈特餐厅开演。
yakita:LKKST_2_5.speaker: Roccia

yakita:LKKST_3_10.text: A great rendition of "Starry is the Night" plays out. From among the crowd, you watch the Troupe set Margherita's Restaurant aglow with starlight.
yakita:LKKST_3_10.zh: 一场足够精彩的《今夜星光灿烂》。这次你作为观众，看着愚人剧团的大家将星光洒满玛格烈特。

yakita:LKKST_3_9.text: A marvelous rendition of "Starry is the Night" plays out. Together, you paint every corner of Margherita's Restaurant in starlight.
yakita:LKKST_3_9.zh: 一场异常精彩的《今夜星光灿烂》！你和大家一起将星光洒满了整个玛格烈特餐厅。

yakita:LKKST_4_2.text: And now, it's come true. Starlight and laughter fill… Well, at least they fill Margherita's for now.
yakita:LKKST_4_2.zh: 现在实现啦，星光和欢笑洒满了……呃，至少洒满了玛格烈特。
yakita:LKKST_4_2.speaker: Roccia

yakita:LKKST_6_2.text: The response last time was so good that Margherita's has become one of our regular stages.
yakita:LKKST_6_2.zh: 之前的演出获得了很好的反响，玛格烈特餐厅成为了剧团常驻演出点之一。
yakita:LKKST_6_2.speaker: Roccia

yakita:ItemInfo_80010046_BgDescription.text: A recipe that details how to make Steak Margherita.
yakita:ItemInfo_80010046_BgDescription.zh: 详尽记录着玛格烈特牛排制作方法的食谱。

yakita:Character_Brant_13_38.text: Aye! She's a regular at Trattoria Margherita. Loves their pizzas. I run into her all the time!
yakita:Character_Brant_13_38.zh: 是的，她常去玛格烈特餐厅吃披萨，只要不出航，她就要去那里吃晚餐，我经常去那里找她！

yakita:Character_Brant_16_4.text: Margherita says they're out for a few days. Can you believe it? Even the simplest pleasures conspire against me!
yakita:Character_Brant_16_4.zh: 老板说，橄榄用完了，得过两天才有货。我真是……吃口凉水都塞牙。

yakita:Character_Rococo_13_4.text: It took me back to Margherita's, having the usual from their brunch menu... Oh, that's something I thought I'd get to enjoy for the rest of my life.
yakita:Character_Rococo_13_4.zh: 就好像我还坐在玛格烈特餐馆里，吃着熟悉的早午餐……唉，本来以为能吃一辈子的。

yakita:Character_Zani_9_11.text: You order some late night snacks at Trattoria Margherita and looks for a place to rest.
yakita:Character_Zani_9_11.zh: 你在玛格烈特餐馆吃了点夜宵，随后找了个地方休息。

yakita:DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_96.text: Margherita's signature combo, featuring Pizza Tropicale, Nuvola Pasta, Shell Burgers, and ice cream. It is an unmissable treat for any visitor to Ragunna.
yakita:DIY_FurnitureDic_Desc_96.zh: 玛格烈特餐馆的招牌套餐，由热海皇梨披萨、肉酱烩面、贝壳汉堡和冰激凌组成，是前来拉古那游览的游客不可错过的美食。

yakita:Daily_MGLTJRTC_1_14.chapter: 剧情_2_0_每日_玛格烈特今日套餐_1_1
yakita:Daily_MGLTJRTC_1_14.text: Really? Margherita makes the best food! My mum used to bring me here all the time.
yakita:Daily_MGLTJRTC_1_14.zh: 真的？“玛格烈特”的菜品是远近闻名的地道美味，以前母亲经常带我来这里。

yakita:Daily_MGLTJRTC_1_3.chapter: 剧情_2_0_每日_玛格烈特今日套餐_1_1
yakita:Daily_MGLTJRTC_1_3.text: I... I heard they were hiring, so I thought I'd take a peek. But Ms. Margherita seems really busy, and I didn't want to be a bother.
yakita:Daily_MGLTJRTC_1_3.zh: 那个……我听说这边在招人，所以想来看看。但玛格烈特女士看起来很忙的样子，我不太好去打扰她。

yakita:Event_QDLS_1_1.text: A pizza oven... You mean all of Trattoria Margherita's pizzas are made inside of this Echo?
yakita:Event_QDLS_1_1.zh: 居然是披萨炉……难道玛格烈特餐厅的披萨都是它烤出来的？
yakita:Event_QDLS_1_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Event_WWCS_24_1.text: Bakie joyfully swallows your ingredients, turning them into a delicious dish. You split the dish into three portions, sharing with Margherita and Bakie.
yakita:Event_WWCS_24_1.zh:
焙焙欢快地吞下你给的食材，烘烤出了一道美味料理。
你将料理分成三份，和玛格烈特、焙焙一起分享。

yakita:GNNPC_LGNC_13_6.chapter: 剧情_黎那汐塔基础功能NPC_4_5
yakita:GNNPC_LGNC_13_6.text: Ding! Margherita's Victory Feast, served up with flair!
yakita:GNNPC_LGNC_13_6.zh: 叮！玛格烈特冠军全餐出炉啾！
yakita:GNNPC_LGNC_13_6.speaker: Margherita

yakita:GNNPC_LGNC_15_1.chapter: 剧情_黎那汐塔基础功能NPC_4_1
yakita:GNNPC_LGNC_15_1.text: Welcome to Margherita's! Your pizza will be hot and fresh in no time!
yakita:GNNPC_LGNC_15_1.zh: 欢迎光临玛格烈特家庭餐厅，披萨马上就出炉了啾！
yakita:GNNPC_LGNC_15_1.speaker: Margherita

yakita:HD_XK_30_8.text: Margherita agrees to your request and begins to gather an impressive crowd...
yakita:HD_XK_30_8.zh: 玛格烈特接受了你们的请求，替你们召集了不少人……

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_26.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_3_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_26.text: Yes. The nearest one is Trattoria Margherita. I personally recommend Pizza Tropicale. Would you like to dine there?
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_26.zh: 当然，离这里最近的是「玛格烈特家庭餐馆」，我个人十分推荐那家店的「热海皇梨披萨」，我可以带您前往。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_16_26.speaker: Zani

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_20_14.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_16_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_20_14.text: How about Steak Margherita and Nuvola Pasta? Both excellent choices!
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_20_14.zh: 那当然是玛格烈特特制——「玛格烈特牛排」和「云凝肉酱烩面」！
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_20_14.speaker: Margherita

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_20_22.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_16_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_20_22.text:
You’re taken to Trattoria Margherita, the most popular restaurant in Ragunna.
Zani tells you to order whatever you like, as the Montelli family’s covering the bill.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_20_22.zh:
欢迎来到，拉古那最有名气的玛格烈特家庭餐厅！
来看看吃什么吧，不要客气——开支都会记在莫塔里家族的账上。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_45.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第一幕_20_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_45.text: We're here to ask a favor. We're investigating a Vitreum Dancer who caused a scene around Trattoria Margherita.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_45.zh: 这次找你，是想请你帮个忙……我们正在调查一个「刀伶声骸」的去向，不久前它在玛格烈特家庭餐馆附近引起了骚动。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_1_26_45.speaker: Zani

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_7411_17.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_32_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_7411_17.text: Miss Margherita, one extra large Forte-astic Fizz & Freeze gelato, please. Thank you.
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_7411_17.zh: 还有，玛格烈特女士，请来一份「噗噗咩咩好吃到觉醒共鸣力！」口味的冰激凌。超大杯的，谢谢。
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_7411_17.speaker: Rover

yakita:MapMark_150002_MarkDesc.text: At the heart of Trattoria Margherita is an oven Echo known as Bakie, tirelessly fueling Ragunna with its roaring flames and delicious aromas.
yakita:MapMark_150002_MarkDesc.zh: 玛格烈特家庭餐馆的声骸烤炉「焙焙」，以一己之力撑起了半座拉古那城的烟火气，熊熊燃烧的炉灶永不停息！

yakita:POI_JINKU_91_1.chapter: 剧情_2_1_世界_埃弗拉德金库_POI任务_68_2
yakita:POI_JINKU_91_1.text: Woohoo! A day off! I heard Margherita's just put out something new on their menu. Perfect timing!
yakita:POI_JINKU_91_1.zh: 放假放假！听说玛格烈特的厨房要出新品，刚好试试！

yakita:POI_QSMG_35_11.text: Yep, and he wasn't like any knight I've ever seen in the city. He was handing out these knight rings to everyone and asking if they wanted to be a knight and explore the depths of Whisperwind Haven.
yakita:POI_QSMG_35_11.zh: 嗯，他与我在城里见到的骑士打扮不同，而且他好像在四处分发骑士戒指，询问着大家是否有成为骑士的意愿，是否愿意向水畔深处前进。
yakita:POI_QSMG_35_11.speaker: Margherita

yakita:POI_QSMG_35_16.text: As Margherita waves goodbye, you both wait patiently for Carlow to wake up from his hallucination.
yakita:POI_QSMG_35_16.zh: 玛格烈特向你们挥手离去，你们耐心等待着卡洛从幻觉中醒来。

yakita:RGZYYYGJZ_51_14.text: Ah, Tulip coin... Oh! I remember you. You work at the vault, don't you? We had a drink at Margherita's.
yakita:RGZYYYGJZ_51_14.zh: 是郁金香钱币的郁金香啊……嘶，我想起来了，是金库那边的，我们还在玛格烈特喝过酒。

yakita:RGZYYYGJZ_5_13.text: So, what do you need? We are just about to wrap up and grab a bite at Margherita's. Still got a lot on our plate today.
yakita:RGZYYYGJZ_5_13.zh: 说吧，找哥俩有什么事？这边忙完，我们去玛格烈特对付一顿，还有别的要忙呢。

yakita:RGZYYYGJZ_5_20.text: Oh, Margherita's! Nothing quite like it, hm? And the pizza... Oh, it's a favorite in my circle, too.
yakita:RGZYYYGJZ_5_20.zh: 玛格烈特啊，那边的披萨口味一绝，氛围也好，我也常和家族里的兄弟们一起去。
yakita:RGZYYYGJZ_5_20.speaker: Rover

yakita:XJXYSDJ_24_21.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院商业街生态_25_1
yakita:XJXYSDJ_24_21.text: Note: I, Ramsay, would rather starve in the Mawburrow Desert or jump from the Voidwatch Tower than eat cooked animal liver!
yakita:XJXYSDJ_24_21.zh: 一行留言：我拉姆齐就是饿死，死隐喙深腹里，从对虚数据塔上跳下去，也不会去吃那些烹饪过的动物肝脏！

yakita:MapMark_342003_MarkDesc.text: A cliffside road carved into the mountain. Winds from the Mawburrow Desert often whip sand across the surface of this southern section.
yakita:MapMark_342003_MarkDesc.zh: 依山建成的峡谷公路南段，来自隐喙深腹的风沙时常在道路上肆虐。

yakita:LHYSTTHZB_20_6.text: What you just said reminded me of that saying from the Old Federation.
yakita:LHYSTTHZB_20_6.zh: 你刚刚的回答，让我忽然想起了这句来自旧联邦的名言啊。
yakita:LHYSTTHZB_20_6.speaker: Maxim

yakita:Side_YJYCZNPCST_32_1.text: Ah, the sheer magnificence of the Starward Riseway… I never get tired of this view.
yakita:Side_YJYCZNPCST_32_1.zh: 啊，联运椎骨……不管看多少次，它都真是壮观呢……你说是吧，同学？
yakita:Side_YJYCZNPCST_32_1.speaker: Maxim

yakita:Side_YJYCZNPCST_32_7.text: I dream of the day I can create something as monumental as the Starward Riseway… at least in size.
yakita:Side_YJYCZNPCST_32_7.zh: 唉，希望有朝一日，我也能搞出来一个能够和联运椎骨相媲美的研究成果……至少要像它一样巨大才行。
yakita:Side_YJYCZNPCST_32_7.speaker: Maxim

yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_57_1.text: Mengzhou Fish in Vinegar, recommended by Transcendents themselves!

yakita:MXXSST_30_1.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_31_1
yakita:MXXSST_30_1.text: Sorry to trouble you. You're from outside the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou, aren't you? Have you ever heard of the Myriad Snare?
yakita:MXXSST_30_1.zh: 抱歉打扰你了，你是从梦枢天罗之外来的吧？我想问问你知道万囮牢吗？

yakita:ZXHYLST_4_2.text: Mengzhou. Nowhere else is going to give me anything useful.
yakita:ZXHYLST_4_2.zh: 看来，还是要去梦州才能有所斩获。
yakita:ZXHYLST_4_2.speaker: Yinlin

yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_550_2.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第二幕_玄方城生态_4_2
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_550_2.text: Wait, I think I know her. Isn't she... the head of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild?
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_550_2.zh: 慢着，我好像认得她……那不是梦州昭明商会的会长吗？

yakita:ZYHSGST_20_8.text: But Mengzhou these days... Well. Best not to dwell on it.

yakita:Term852010_Desc.text: Portals in the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou that lead to the Heart Realms. Each Inner Threshold requires a corresponding Realm Key to grant passage.
yakita:Term852010_Desc.zh: 「梦枢天罗」中连接各处心域的通道入口，唯有携带对应的心域秘钥，方可通过心钥井，抵达各心域内部。

yakita:35SLDWD_2_2.text: That's Old Tao. Mengzhou cuisine's living authority!
yakita:35SLDWD_2_2.zh: 陶老啊！梦州菜老吃家了！

yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1312_Influence.chapter: 锁暝档案_共鸣能力鉴定报告
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1312_Influence.text: Ten Seals Covenant; Mengzhou - Ministry of Sentinel Affairs

yakita:Guide_YPGX_1_1.text: Sorry to trouble you. My name is Luojing, and I oversee the seal on a certain mechanism within the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou.
yakita:Guide_YPGX_1_1.zh: 冒昧联系您，我是落京，负责监测梦枢天罗的一处机关封印。

yakita:LoadingTipsText_923801_TipsText.text: A suspended City of Mechanisms under Mengzhou's jurisdiction, built to hold the hordes of Tacet Discords diverted from the Norfall Barrens outbreak. Its intricate construction reroutes and traps incoming hordes through a vast array of mechanisms. Its form shifts at will, deploying Autopuppets to rotate defenses and purge or suppress the Tacet Discords held within.
yakita:LoadingTipsText_923801_TipsText.zh:
隶属于梦州的悬空机关城，关押了北落野残象潮中分流的大量残象。
此城构造精密，其运作原理，乃借机关之术，将涌入关内的残象潮予以分割、围困。亦会变换结构，并启动机傀换防，对封存之残象进行清理与压制。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_9.text: Once this war is over, I... will return to Mengzhou for you.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_321_9.zh: 等打完这场仗，我……再去梦州接你们。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_212_5.text: (I suspect it is the same one I attended back in Mengzhou.)
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_212_5.zh: （恐怕，是当初在梦州，我参加过的那场……）
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_212_5.speaker: Suisui

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_14.text: Oh? I did not expect to be recognized so far from Mengzhou.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_14.zh: 欸……没想到出了梦州，居然还有人认识我啊。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_34_1.text: You mentioned earlier that the Sentinel of Mengzhou is missing?
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_34_1.zh: 之前你说，梦州的岁主如今失联了？
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_34_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_6.text: The villagers said the copper coins on it have ties to Mengzhou's Nethermancers.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_6.zh: 我们向其他村民打听过，这上面的铜钱与梦州的「寻幽客」有关。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_111_6.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_14.text: So you're going back to Mengzhou to try to find answers.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_14.zh: 你认为，这一切在梦州城，或许可以查出些什么。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_14.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_5.text: I only just heard you're heading back to Mengzhou.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_5.zh: 我才刚知道，你要回梦州了。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_8.text: It's very sudden, that's all. Has something pressing come up in Mengzhou?
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_8.zh: 突然回梦州城，是有什么要紧事吗？
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_8.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_12.text: This is the City of Mechanisms built with the aid of Mengzhou's Sentinel, right?
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_12.zh: 这里是梦州岁主所协助建造的机关城，对吗？
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_12.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_39_2.text: Up at last? Suisui's already on her way to Mengzhou City, and Yangyang's out on routine patrol.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_39_2.zh: 你醒了？穗穗刚启程去梦州城，秧秧去参加例行巡逻了。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_39_2.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_14.text: We'd like to know what this pendant means in Mengzhou.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_14.zh: 我们想知道这件挂饰，在梦州有什么来历。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_90_14.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_20_18.text: She said... she's an Intendant in Mengzhou's Ministry of Sentinel Affairs.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_20_18.zh: 她说……她是梦州谛天鉴的州监。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_218_4.text: From my position, I speak from the perspective of Mengzhou's Ministry of Sentinel Affairs.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_218_4.zh: 按我的位置，自然要站在梦州谛天鉴的角度说话。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_218_4.speaker: Suoming

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_22_9.text: That uniform... they're from Mengzhou's Ministry of Sentinel Affairs.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_22_9.zh: 这副装扮……是梦州谛天鉴的人。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_22_9.speaker: Qingxiao

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_242_2.text: What will become of the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou?

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_34_1.text: The way it shifts very much resembles Mengzhou's Automata Mechanics.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_34_1.zh: 这变形的模样和梦州机关术很像。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_34_1.speaker: Suoming

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_43_1.text: So this is the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou today. I wouldn't have guessed...
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_43_1.zh: 如今的「梦枢天罗」，竟是这样一番景象……
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_43_1.speaker: Suoming

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_16.text: Later, when he was trying to find a way out, he came across a door. He opened it without thinking and somehow ended up in Mengzhou.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_16.zh: 后来他寻找出口时，忽然看见了一扇门，没多想便推开了它，结果不知为何被传送到了梦州地界。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_16.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_20_21.text: The Zhaoming Commerce Guild will bankroll a full supply and distribution network to sell Mengzhou's products far and wide.
yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_20_21.zh: 由我们昭明商会出资，搭建向外的供销网络，把梦州的货品卖出去。
yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_20_21.speaker: Suisui

yakita:STNPC_XFCPYST1_1_1.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_华胥天工商业街配音_57_1
yakita:STNPC_XFCPYST1_1_1.text: Any word from Mengzhou? After all that mess...
yakita:STNPC_XFCPYST1_1_1.zh: 梦州那边有消息了吗？出了这么大的事……

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_181_6.text: Coming from the Sentinel of Mengzhou, that's so petty!
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_181_6.zh: 明明贵为梦州岁主呢，小心眼！
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_181_6.speaker: Xuanqing

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_27_3.text: According to the Sentinel's projections for the continuity of civilization, leaving Norfall Barrens to its fate is the optimal course of action. Mengzhou's borderlands are to be abandoned for the greater good.
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_27_3.zh: 依岁主推演文明之序，北落野放任不治，方为至优；梦州边陲，则当弃之以全大局。

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_48_20.text: As Sentinel, I am responsible for every citizen of Mengzhou... including you.
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_48_20.zh: 我身为岁主，当为梦州每一人负责，其中……也包括你。

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_49_11.text: But… I suppose that's exactly what makes It the kindest Sentinel of Mengzhou.
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_49_11.zh: 但是……也正因为如此，祂才是梦州最温柔的岁主大人啊。
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_49_11.speaker: Xuanqing

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_49_18.text: Just like when I was still living in Mengzhou, it was a wonderful, joyful journey.
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_49_18.zh: 就像我还生活在梦州时那样——是一趟快乐又尽兴的旅途呢！
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_49_18.speaker: Xuanqing

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_50_3.text: With this, Mengzhou's border will finally be safe…
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_50_3.zh: 这下，梦州边境就安全了……

yakita:Side_ZZHNY_11_16.text: 漂泊者, 漂泊者! From the look of your clothes, are you from beyond Mengzhou?
yakita:Side_ZZHNY_11_16.zh: 漂泊者漂泊者，看你的衣裳，你是从梦州之外的地方来的吗？

yakita:XFJCFST_2_1.text: I thought we'd never meet again after Mengzhou...
yakita:XFJCFST_2_1.zh: 梦州一别，没想到你我还能再见……

yakita:XFJCFST_3_1.text: I thought we'd never meet again after Mengzhou...
yakita:XFJCFST_3_1.zh: 梦州一别，没想到还能在这儿碰见你。

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_10.text: And what about you, {PlayerName}? I know you've hit a snag trying to learn more about the New Federation. How about I...
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_10.zh: 另外，{PlayerName}，你自己的事情呢？我知道你打听新联邦消息受到了一点点阻碍，要不要……
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_10.speaker: Meta

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_13.text: Well... all right. But if you ever change your mind, the gateway to the Somnoire is always open for you.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_13.zh: 那……好吧。不过你需要的话，心之集域的大门可是永远向你敞开哦。
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_13.speaker: Meta

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_2.text: Come to make another deal with me, {PlayerName}? What fun little things have you brought me this time?
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_2.zh: {PlayerName}，是打算要和我做新的交易吗，这次你带来了什么好玩的东西？
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_2.speaker: Meta

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_5.text: If it's not, I've no obligation to help you get it back. So... if you've got the diary, take good care of it this time, won't you?
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_5.zh: 不是的话，我可没有义务帮你们找回。所以……如果你们找到日记本的话，这次要好好保管哦。
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_5.speaker: Meta

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_6.text: But enough about that! Come now, what interesting news have you brought me?
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_6.zh: 还是回到正题上来吧，快说快说，你带来了什么有趣的新鲜事？
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_6.speaker: Meta

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_8.text: Boring. Going to school, making friends, taking up perfume-making again... Ohhh, so this is the quaint, ordinary little life she's always wanted?
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_8.zh: 没意思，上学、交朋友，还有重新钻研调香，唉呀，这就是她一直想要的平凡又普通的生活吗？
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_66_8.speaker: Meta

yakita:ACTION_AVGspecial_221_12.chapter: 剧情_3.8索拉学院_梅塔差分_2_1
yakita:ACTION_AVGspecial_221_12.text: Few treasures are worth as much as friendship. Wherever life takes you from here, cherish the people it brings your way, meow.
yakita:ACTION_AVGspecial_221_12.zh: 友情是珍贵的宝藏，无论以后去往哪里，都要珍惜身边的缘分喵。
yakita:ACTION_AVGspecial_221_12.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_12.text: You Resonators are different from ordinary folks. You leave behind a frequency even after death.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_12.zh: 你们共鸣者与常人不同，死后的频率仍会残留。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_12.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_13.text: And war? It's the perfect nest for fear and resentment. Only natural they'd end up looking like that.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_13.zh: 而战争本身就容易滋生恐惧、怨恨，他们变成那样也是难免的啦。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_13.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_16.text: You used too much power on that battlefield. I thought it was the Somnoire leaking, so I scooped you all up and brought you here.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_16.zh: 只是你在战场上过度使用力量，让我误以为是心之集域的力量外泄，所以我才把你们全都收容了进来哦。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_16.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_22.text: You weave fleeting dreamlands to soothe people. I can grant you the power to make those dreams last, very nearly forever.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_22.zh: 你能编织短暂的幻梦安抚他人，我能赐予你力量，强化你的幻梦，让它几乎等于永恒。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_22.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_23.text: Then you can save them all. Let them sleep forever. No thoughts, no memories. Like dolls...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_23.zh: 这样的话，你就可以保存下他们啦，让他们永远沉睡下去，没有意识，没有记忆，就像玩偶……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_23.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_28.text: Is that so bad? They'd still be "alive," wouldn't they? And practically eternal, too.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_28.zh: 不好吗？这样不也是一种“活着”吗，而且还是永恒……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_28.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_31.text: Interesting. But once you extract that corruption, what then? You'll need somewhere to put it, won't you? It can be contained in a body, or be devoured by Tacet Discords. But in here...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_31.zh: 有意思。可那些提炼出来的污秽，你打算怎么办，还需要一个容器吧？它们可以寄身于人，也可以被残象吞噬，可这里……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_31.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_41.text: The cost? Why, isn't it obvious? You take in all that corruption, and in its place, you become the monster.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_41.zh: 代价，不是显而易见了吗？吸收所有“污秽”的你，不就要替他们变成怪物了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_41.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_55.text: As for me, call me Meta. You might say I'm the owner of this place.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_55.zh: 至于我，叫我梅塔就好啦，暂且算是这里的主人。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_56.text: Shhh... Keep your voice down. Wake them up, and they'll turn right back into monsters.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_56.zh: 嘘……不要太大声，吵醒他们，他们又会变成怪物哦。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_56.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_59.text: Not in the waking world, of course. But we happen to be in the Somnoire! So... want to make a deal with me?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_59.zh: 现实中是没有办法啦。不过这里是心之集域，所以……要不要和我做个交易？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_59.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_60.text: Oh? You already have a plan? Impressive, cooling that head of yours so quickly. So how would you put my power to use?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_60.zh: 噢，是想到办法了吗？好厉害，这么快就冷静下来了，你想利用我的力量做什么？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_60.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_64.text: We'll cross that bridge when we get to it... If you're ready, push open the door behind you and step through. The dream you asked for is waiting. I'm dying to see whether you can work a miracle.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_64.zh: 等那天到来再说吧……准备好了的话，就推开你背后的门走吧，你要的梦就在后面，我很期待你能不能实现奇迹哦。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_160_64.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_166_4.text: Oh? I've never met a human quite like you before
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_166_4.zh: 哦？这样的人类，还是第一次见
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_166_4.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_11.text: You were still useful to me, so I cleansed the curses you absorbed. Our deal was only a teeny, tiny trial.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_11.zh: 你对我还有用处，所以我清除了你吸收的诅咒。交易，只是一场小小的试炼。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_11.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_12.text: It all went smoothly at first. But I didn't count on just how big your heart is. Soldiers you knew, soldiers you didn't... You wanted to save far, far too many.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_12.zh: 一切本来都很顺利，但我低估了你的善良，你认识的战士，你不认识的战士，你想拯救的人太多太多了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_12.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_16.text: Before, it worked because there were only a handful of people you wanted to save. The pain you absorbed belonged to others, so I could wipe it all away with ease. But now...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_16.zh: 之前你能成功，是因为需要拯救的只有寥寥数人，你吸收的苦痛又都是他人的，我自然能轻松清理掉啦，可现在……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_16.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_20.text: This time the extraction went wrong because your heart's changed. Something has made your fear run deeper. Let me think...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_20.zh: 这次转移出现异常，完全是因为你的内心发生了变化。某种存在深化了你的恐惧，让我想想……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_20.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_4.text: Don't look at me like a child caught misbehaving. We'll get to the part where you spun a second dream behind my back and locked me out soon enough.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_4.zh: 别像做错事的孩子一样望着我啦，你瞒着我二次创梦，把我关在外面的事我们待会儿再讲。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_4.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_43.text: Look me in the eye. No more running. This tea, this fragrance you concocted... They might steady you for a moment, but they can't help you.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_43.zh: 看着我的眼睛，不要逃避哦。这些花茶和你调配的香水，只能暂时稳定你的情绪，它们帮不了你。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_43.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_46.text: Destroy... Let's not get ahead of ourselves. I'll use my power to hold this dreamland steady for now so it doesn't bother the rest of the Somnoire.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_46.zh: 毁灭这个词，现在说还太早啦。我会暂时用力量稳定这片幻梦，避免它影响到心之集域其他地方。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_46.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_5.text: You've felt it too, haven't you? Your dreamland is slipping out of your control.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_5.zh: 你自己也意识到了吧，你的幻梦已经失控了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_5.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_6.text: One question at a time, please. Tension and dread only worsen your symptoms. Let's go back to our very first deal.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_6.zh: 问题要一个一个来，紧张、着急会加剧你的症状哦，先回到我们的第一次交易上吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_6.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_7.text: A little confession: I've made deals like ours with plenty of humans before. But every last one of them lost themselves when they got the power.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_7.zh: 其实，我曾与许多人做过类似的交易，但他们都因获得能力迷失了自我。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_7.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_9.text: But... I tricked you. The price of our deal wasn't you becoming a monster so I'd have to destroy you.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_9.zh: 然后……我骗了你，代价其实根本不是你变成怪物被我毁灭。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_176_9.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_11.text: Mm. That was me. I knocked it over. I wanted you to see her true past. But in the end, she caught on.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_11.zh: 嗯，香薰是我碰倒的哦，本来想让你看看她真实的过往，没想到还是被她发现了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_11.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_15.text: Is that your biggest question? Afraid I might mean her harm?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_15.zh: 最想问我的问题是这个吗？你是担心我对她别有用心？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_15.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_17.text: The reason is simple. She is the Resonator I chose. And I don't let go of the things I choose, not easily.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_17.zh: 很简单的原因，她是我选中的共鸣者，我选中的东西，从不会轻易放手。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_17.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_20.text: My reasons don't matter much, but yours do. You're just an observer with no ties to her. So why not just end it?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_20.zh: 我的原因不重要啦，反倒是你，你只是个旁观者，跟她之前也没有任何联系，你为什么不动手呢？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_20.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_21.text: Isn't that what justice is? Weeding out those roots of disaster so bad things never happen. That's what I always thought.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_21.zh: 所谓的正义，不就是把灾厄的隐患统统拔掉，让坏事消失得干干净净吗？我一直是这么理解的哦。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_21.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_3.text: You have come, at last. If she hadn't used her power to keep me out, we'd have met much sooner.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_3.zh: 你，终于来了。如果不是她用力量将我们隔绝在外，我们早该见面了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_3.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_36.text: Only by facing and overcoming it can she make it vulnerable. That's when it'll crack, and that's our one chance to sever it from her.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_36.zh: 所以只有她直面并克服内心的恐惧，诅咒才会露出破绽。那是它最脆弱的一刻，也是我们分离它唯一的机会。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_36.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_37.text: Second, the power to separate it. When she drew out the curse before, she was imitating the process of "refinement." So we'll need a power that works the same way.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_37.zh: 其二是分离的能力。她之前转移诅咒，其实是在模仿“精炼”工艺，所以我们也需要一个类似的能力来替代才行。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_37.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_4.text: My two little helpers have told me all about you. Thank you for your help settling quite a few of the Somnoire's troubles.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_4.zh: 我的两位仆从，讲过关于你的很多故事，谢谢你之前帮助心之集域解决了不少麻烦。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_4.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_40.text: And last, a new vessel for the curse. Fortunately, I saw this day coming and made a few preparations.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_40.zh: 最后一点，诅咒需要一个新的容器。不过我料想到会有这么一天，提前做了一些准备。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_40.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_48.text: Aren't you the least bit curious about the price?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_48.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_55.text: {PlayerName}. A pleasure. I am the current owner of the Somnoire—Meta.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_55.zh: {PlayerName}，初次见面，我就是心之集域的现任主人——梅塔。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_55.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_60.text: For the longest time, only the black cat, the white cat, and I stayed by her side. But for reasons of her own, she always kept me at arm's length.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_60.zh: 漫长的时间里，只有我和黑白猫陪在她身边，可她不知为何，总是刻意和我保持距离。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_60.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_61.text: I knew I couldn't help her. So I followed the one she'd chosen for herself... and I found you. And your dream.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_61.zh: 我明白，我帮不了她了。于是我就顺着她找到的人选……盯上了你，还有你的梦。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_61.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_63.text: Interesting. A little secret, then, since I've been watching you so closely... Yes, she lied to you, but never once did she mean you harm.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_63.zh: 有意思。那我也站在监控视角上告诉你一个小秘密吧，她虽然欺骗了你，但从未想过伤害你。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_63.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_67.text: Then, {PlayerName}, our deal takes effect from this moment. I'll send you to the train. The rest is up to you.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_67.zh: 那……{PlayerName}，交易从此刻生效，我会把你重新送到列车上，接下来，就看你的了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_181_67.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_10.text: To protect you, I made a deal with Meta. Too much of your mind and memories got worn away inside that dream.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_10.zh: 为保护你，我和祂其实做了一个交易。在梦中，你消磨了太多自己的意识、记忆。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_4.text: Meta was the one who came up with a way to save you. It's been worried about you, so it came to see how you were holding up.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_4.zh: 拯救你的办法就是祂想出来的，祂一直很担心你，来问问你的情况。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_50.text: Fast asleep, at last. She's tougher than I thought. I half expected her to cry her eyes out once she learned the truth.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_50.zh: 她，已经完全睡着了。她比我想象得要坚强，我以为她知晓真相后，还会哭一顿呢。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_50.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_18.text: I need someone to help me in the world beyond the Somnoire, much like a Sentinel's Resonator.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_18.zh: 我需要你做我的帮手，在心之集域外界替我行事，就像岁主共鸣者那样。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_18.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_23.text: Let's just say I was making it up as I went. I wanted to see whether you'd still be you, even with power.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_23.zh: 算我临时起意，为了验证你拥有力量后，是否能坚持自己的初心。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_23.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_24.text: Our deal is now a pact. So... What do you say?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_24.zh: 交易，现在变成了契约，所以……你的回答呢？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_24.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_28.text: ...As my Resonator, a little reward isn't exactly a stretch.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_28.zh: ……作为我的共鸣者，给你点小奖励也没什么。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_28.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_46.text: I won't keep you shut away in here. Is there anywhere you'd like to go?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_46.zh: 我不会限制你的自由，现在，你有想去的地方吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_46.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_47.text: (Last time, her choice ended in tragedy. This time...)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_47.zh: （上次她的选择造成了她的悲剧，这次的话……）
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_47.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_50.text: Oh, one more thing. You said this place is where you belong... So from here on, you might call it "home," too. If you feel like coming back? Come back.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_50.zh: 还有一件事，你刚刚说这里是你的容身之处，那这里以后也是你的“家”了，想回来的话，也可以回来看看。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_212_50.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_13.text: That's the price. She'll likely forget everything she lived through after she created that second dreamland. All she'll keep is what came after her deal with me.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_13.zh: 这就是交易的代价：她也许会忘记第二次创梦的所有经历，只记得第一次交易结束的事情。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_13.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_14.text: Everything you shared will feel like nothing more than a dream to her.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_14.zh: 你和她经历的一切，对她来说只是一场梦。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_14.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_23.text: Well then, as a little thank you for all your help around the Somnoire, I'll give you a little treat.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_23.zh: 那最后，为感谢你对心之集域多次伸出援手，我送你一个小奖励吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_23.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_24.text: Ask me a few questions. I'll tell you what I've seen in the New Federation's dreamscape. No tricks. No lies.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_24.zh: 我可以回答你几个问题，答案都是我从新联邦的梦境中窥视而来的，绝无半点虚假。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_24.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_25.text: Dreams are reflections of reality. So, {PlayerName}, what would you like to ask?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_25.zh: 梦是现实的映射，{PlayerName}，你有什么想问的吗？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_25.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_27.text: Far too many dreams tangle together here. Some people have chosen to forget, and some are still weeping.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_27.zh: 太多人的梦境交织于此，有人选择了遗忘，有人还在哭泣。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_27.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_28.text: Too much noise. Too many knots. I can't see the thread from here. The true answer waits for you in the waking world.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_28.zh: 好多好乱的信息，站在这里我根本看不清。真正的答案，需要你去现实中寻找。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_28.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_31.text: The New Federation's Sentinel, you mean? Let me see... Every dream touching It is blank.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_31.zh: 新联邦的岁主吗？让我看看……关于普罗米厄的梦一片空白。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_31.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_36.text: But no dream comes without a reason. Every last one is tied to reality, somehow.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_36.zh: 不过在这里没有无缘无故的梦，总会和现实存在一定的联系。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_36.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_4.text: Now that our deal is complete, it's time we spoke of the price.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_4.zh: 交易完成了的话，该谈谈我们的代价了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_4.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_40.text: Meet again? Heh. If the chance comes, we can meet as many times as we please...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_40.zh: 再见面？有机会的话多少次都可以啦……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_40.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_64.text: Asking me straight out? That's cheating, you know.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_64.zh: 直接问我吗？这可犯规咯~
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_64.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_65.text: As for just how strong that tie runs, though...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_65.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_66.text: Well then, that wraps up our happy little Q&A.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_66.zh: 好了，我的奖励时间到此为止。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_66.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_7.text: Just as I thought. She let those dreamlands wear away her mind and memories to keep them steady.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_7.zh: 和我想的一样，她为了维持幻梦的稳定，不惜消磨自己的意识、记忆。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_7.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_72.text: Not quite! But I did find one interesting tidbit. Come closer...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_72.zh: 不过我倒是找到了一个有趣的东西，靠近点看吧……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_72.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_8.text: Her memory frequency is slowly sliding into chaos. For her own good, I'll need to make her sleep for a while.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_8.zh: 她现在的记忆频率正逐渐走向混乱，为了她的安全，我必须让她沉睡一段时间。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_8.speaker: Meta

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_9.text: That way, I can use my power to steady her frequency. But the parts she let wear away... there's no getting them back.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_9.zh: 这样我就能用力量稳定她的频率，不过她消磨掉的那部分……永远找不回来了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_242_9.speaker: Meta

yakita:NPC_HZ_65_11.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_66_1
yakita:NPC_HZ_65_11.text: You know Mt. Firmament better than the Midnight Rangers.
yakita:NPC_HZ_65_11.zh: 你比夜归军更了解乘霄山的情况。

yakita:NPC_JC_58_1.text: Thank you, Rover. You ended the conflict with the least price to pay and saved the lives of many Midnight Rangers.
yakita:NPC_JC_58_1.zh: 感谢你，漂泊者。你让战事以最小的代价结束，挽救了许多夜归的生命。

datamine:InfoDisplay_103012507_Text.title: Regarding Rumors of "Loved One's Call" in the Mine
datamine:InfoDisplay_103012507_Text.text: Recently there have been a lot of rumors in the mine, the source of which is a number of cases of missing miners that have not been resolved for the time being. The mine understands everyone's feelings, but for the sake of production safety, please consciously maintain a good working environment, do not spread rumors, and do not believe rumors. Currently Midnight Rangers members have intervened in the investigation of this incident, please be patient and wait for the results of the investigation.
datamine:InfoDisplay_103012507_Text.zh: 近日矿场内传闻频发，源头为暂未解决的多起矿工失踪案件。矿场理解大家的心情，但为了生产安全，请自觉维护良好的工作环境，不传谣，不信谣。目前夜归成员已介入该事件调查，请大家耐心等待调查结果。

datamine:InfoDisplay_11040146_Text.title: Knell Square
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040146_Text.text:
Even if the darkness enguls our footprints, the unwavering courage to venture into the unknown will guide us to distant horizons. Dedicated to the valiant warriors who willingly sacrificed themselves in the lasting night.

[History of the Knell Square]
The Knell Squre is dedicated to honoring every warrior who selflessly gave their all to protect human civilization. Each flower within this space has been tenderly planted by the members of the Midnight Rangers, and the flowers are named "Emortia".
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040146_Text.zh:
即使暗夜淹没了足迹，只要常怀探索未知的勇气，我们终将抵达远方。
——致献身长夜的战士们                                                                      

【鸣钟广场背景】
鸣钟广场的设立意在铭记每一位为人类文明献身的勇士，花甸中的每朵花均由夜归战士亲手种下，花名「如故」。

datamine:InfoDisplay_11050102_Text.title: Report on Exploration Work
datamine:InfoDisplay_11050102_Text.text:
Date of work: October 11, AL155
Work summary: Preliminary completion of the exploration unit distribution map mapping, can be roughly determine the orientation of the canal excavation. When collecting image information, encountered a small-scale TDTD Outbreak, Midnight Rangers special team support in time, only two members of the survey team suffered minor injuries, but the exploration equipment was seriously damaged.
Equipment supplies are expected to arrive in a week, until then the team will suspend all exploration work.
Assessment and observations: A raw mineralization of an unknown type of rock has been discovered within the boundaries of the site, which requires further excavation and testing of its structure and properties to determine its value. Construction and exploration work in this area has a high risk factor, and if any abnormalities are detected, work should cease immediately, the site should be evacuated, and Midnight Rangers should be called in to deal with the situation.
datamine:InfoDisplay_11050102_Text.zh:
工作日期：新历155年10月11日
工作概况：初步完成了勘探单元分布图的测绘，可大致确定运河的开凿方位。采集影像信息时遭遇了小规模残象兽潮，夜归特种小队支援及时，勘测小队中仅两名队员受轻伤，但勘探设备受损严重。
设备补给预计一周后抵达，在此之前全队将暂停所有勘探工作。
评估及意见：该地块范围内发现了未知种类岩石原矿，需要进一步发掘和测试其结构与性质以确定其价值。此区域的施工和勘探工作危险系数较高，如果发现任何异常情况应当立即停止施工，撤出现场，并及时报请夜归处理。

yakita:InfoDisplay_11030101_Text.text:
[…]

Reported by Goose Book
Since the beginning of TD Outbreak (130-155 years), there has been a dramatic increase in the mist in the deep pit located at the bottom of Tiger's Maw, and the Institute has detected a large number of active Wuthering Waves sub-signals at this location, and has dispatched an exploration team to the pit to investigate on a number of occasions, however, personnel have been severely compromised, and the data has been lost, and it has not been possible to actually advance the progress of the investigations.

[…]

The personnel involved were:
Midnight Rangers Pioneer Brigade Specialized Team (111162)
Institute Address Exploration Team
......

[…]

We judge that the danger of the mists comes mainly from its low-temperature characteristics:
① The condensation of water vapor caused by low temperature will greatly obstruct the field of vision, causing investigators to lose their judgment of direction in the misty area.

② Low temperature will directly affect the health of the investigators, long-term low temperature leads to reduced physical vitality, unable to respond to the danger in time.

However, this investigation has not yet identified the positive body of the unusual sound coming from within the misty area.

[…]
yakita:InfoDisplay_11030101_Text.zh:
报告人：雁书
自兽潮（130年-155年）开始，位于虎口山脉底层的深坑内迷雾剧增，研究院在该位置探测到大量鸣潮子活跃信号，已数次派遣勘探队前往深坑调查，然而人员折损严重，数据遗失，无法实际推动调查的进度。
本次勘探的目的一为继续调查迷雾，二为营救被困人员。参与人员为：
夜归先锋大队特种小队（111162）
研究院地址勘探组
……
关于未知迷雾的调查结果分析：
本次勘探收集了，连通虎口矿场和迷雾深坑的甬道内的迷雾样本，并使用队内携带的【简易测谱仪】对其进行了实地测试分析。根据本次测试的结果，我们推测迷雾似乎是一种生物成分，其成分类似于鳞翅目昆虫翅膀上的鳞粉，呈现出无毒、低温的特性。
我们判断迷雾的危险性，主要来自于其低温特性：
①	低温导致的水汽凝结，会极大的阻碍视野，导致调查人员在迷雾区内失去对方向的判断。
②	低温会直接影响调查人员的健康状态，长期低温导致身体活力降低，无法及时应对危险。
然而此次调查尚未查明，迷雾内传来的异常声音的正体，考虑到未知声音可能导致附近人员恐慌，影响到矿场的作业，建议对该情报进行封锁。


以下为近期失踪人员的名单：
茶蒙
括圃
勒允
诵宁
………………
（以上人员的亲属，近期似乎都有不同程度的幻听。幻听内容为失踪人员呼唤他们进入矿场底层的迷雾深坑，怀疑与迷雾的变异有关。因迷雾深坑为封锁状态，无法进一步对其进行调查，建议通告全体作业人员避开迷雾，暂时停止迷雾深坑附近的区域的开采工作。）

yakita:FavorStory_111001_Content.zh:
春日迟迟，明庭的院子里，花开得正盛。
穗穗趴在书案前，手里攥着画笔，腮帮子上还蹭了一抹赭石色。她画了好一会儿，终于直起身来，端详着自己这幅大作——纸上一团一团的色块，青的、蓝的、赭的，交错在一起，说不清画了什么，反正看着暖融融的。穗穗满意地点点头，拎起画纸就往外跑，裙角带起一阵风，吹得纸张翻动，簌簌作响。

“秧秧！秧秧——”

那张薄薄的画纸转瞬就到了秧秧手里。穗穗两手撑着琴案，盯着妹妹的脸："你看出来是什么了吗？"
秧秧看了一会儿，指尖碰了碰右边那团金色的东西，又碰了碰左边那团白色的：“应该是……两只凑在一起的小鸟。”
穗穗眼睛亮了，一掌拍在案上：“对嘛！就是鸟！我就说那些大人眼神不好，他们偏说是鸡仔！”
“不是鸡仔。”秧秧把画纸放平，歪着头看了看，“小鸡的尾巴是耷下去的，这个翘着呢。”
“对吧对吧！”穗穗恨不得把妹妹举起来转一圈，“就你看得懂！”
秧秧被夸了也不怎么得意，只是嘴角弯了弯，伸手指了指右团那只淡金色的：“这只是姐姐？”
“嗯！右边是我，左边是你。”穗穗凑过来，拿画笔杆子指着左边那只雪白的鸟，“你看，小小的，就跟你一样。”

那些年的春天就是这样过的。窗外是满架新开的花，粉白相间，密密匝匝地压低了绿叶，风一过便簌簌落几片花瓣，沾在琴案上、画纸上、姐妹俩的发梢上。日光柔软地铺下来，把院子里的一切都镀上一层薄薄的蜜色，鸟雀在檐下跳来跳去，叫声轻快又明亮，和着琴声悠扬地飘来。穗穗就在这样的光景里趴在案上躲懒，或是干脆坐在廊下，把画纸举得高高的，对着阳光看那些色彩晕开的样子……
那时候日子真是慢啊。檐下的光影一寸一寸地挪，挪着挪着，一个下午就如此过去——再到回神时，便已挥别数十个春日了。

yakita:FavorWord_111002_Content.text:
Speaking of hometowns, my mind wanders back to my childhood in Mingting. Everything felt so impossibly soothing in the March spring breeze—the high grass, the soaring birds, and each dawn less heavy than the last. I often dragged Yangyang out to fly kites. I can still feel the exact moment the wind would catch them, the line snapping taut as if we'd actually hooked a cloud. To ensure my kite soared higher than everyone else's, I'd run as fast as I could.

The courtyard was filled with the chatter of birds, the rustle of leaves, and the sunlight... Oh, how it filtered through the branches like shattered gold, dusting everything it touched. Even after all these years, that remains the most beautiful thing I've ever seen.
yakita:FavorWord_111002_Content.zh: 说到故乡，不由想起小时身在明庭的那段时间。三月里草长莺飞，天色一日比一日轻快，我常拉着秧秧去院里放纸鸢，风一起，线便绷得直直的，迢迢牵着天边的云。我嫌它飞得不够高，总要多跑几步，非要让它压过别人的才甘心。院中鸟雀啁啾，树影婆娑，日光从枝叶间筛下来，碎金似的铺了一身……那就是我记忆中最好看的光景。
yakita:FavorWord_111002_Content.speaker: Suisui

yakita:FavorWord_111018_Content.text: You couldn't find a more open-minded man in this world than my father. A teacher by trade, but never, ever the lecturing sort. He has a gift for tossing out witty lines with such ease that even the dullest classics become engrossing tales. I always laugh out loud over his letters. He writes with such flair that events happening a thousand miles away become just next door's news in his hands. Oh, you'll just have to see for yourself when you visit our home in Mingting someday. Beautiful views, and I promise, the best tea you'll ever taste.
yakita:FavorWord_111018_Content.zh: 我总觉得，这世上再难有比他更开明的父亲了。明明是教书先生，可从不见他摆什么长辈架子，说话风趣得很，信手拈来的典故也能讲得像在说书，每次收到他寄来的家书，总要被逗笑几回——明明千里之外的事，经他一写，就像是邻家的热闹一般。怎么样，等空了要去明庭坐坐吗？那边的风光也很美，我们家有最好的茶。
yakita:FavorWord_111018_Content.speaker: Suisui

yakita:FavorWord_141105_Content.text: I once wielded this sword only for myself. Then, I drew it for the hand that saved me, and then for Mingting. But now, I am a drifter, my sword as aimless as my path... I can't see you, but I can feel your calling. Should you ever need, call my name. This hidden blade shall unsheathe again to defend your faith.
yakita:FavorWord_141105_Content.zh: 过去，我只是为自己而挥剑，后来，我又成了恩人手中的剑，明庭手中的剑，现在，我又只是一把无处安放的剑罢了……我虽看不见你，可我能感知得到你心中的道。等你需要挥剑的时候，就让我来吧，那种信念，正值得我为之出鞘。
yakita:FavorWord_141105_Content.speaker: Qiuyuan

yakita:FavorWord_141108_Content.text: Years ago, I'd just wrapped up a case in Yuezhou and had to rush back to Mingting overnight. I was exhausted and famished when I stumbled into a diner by the roadside. A bowl of rice, braised pork, a bottle of rice wine. A humble meal, yet nothing has ever filled me like that night.
yakita:FavorWord_141108_Content.zh: 很久之前，在越州办案之后又要日夜兼程赶回明庭。我还记得那个回到明庭的晚上，饥肠辘辘，满身风尘，坐在一家路边馆子里，一碗白饭，一壶酒，一盘烧肉。再也没有什么赶得上这样一顿饭了。
yakita:FavorWord_141108_Content.speaker: Qiuyuan

yakita:FavorWord_141109_Content.text: Mingting has a certain... drink. Greenish-gray, with a smell you don't forget. Trust me, you don't want to find out how it tastes...
yakita:FavorWord_141109_Content.zh: 明庭有一种……很微妙的饮品，它有点绿，又有点灰，闻起来有一股非常特殊的味道。相信我，你不会想要试试它的味道的……
yakita:FavorWord_141109_Content.speaker: Qiuyuan

yakita:FavorWord_141114_Content.text: In Mingting, people like me rarely got the chance to meet the high-ups—and understandably so. We only show up where there's trouble. As for her, all I know is that ever since she stepped down as Secretary-General, no one's been able to truly fill her place.
yakita:FavorWord_141114_Content.zh: 从前在明庭，我们这些当差的，平日里没什么机会能接触这样的高官，当然，他们也不愿意见到我们，毕竟见到我们可就没什么好事。说起这位长史，以她的能力，我只知道她从明庭离开之后，她的那个缺，没有任何人能补得上。
yakita:FavorWord_141114_Content.speaker: Qiuyuan

yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_302_13.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_9_1
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_302_13.text: There's no record of you in Mingting's archives.
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_302_13.zh: 明庭的卷宗里，没有关于你的记录。
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_302_13.speaker: Qiuyuan

yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_302_32.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_9_1
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_302_32.text: You said you met with Mingting's officials. That means you had an audience not just with Grandmaster Liang, but with the Grand Marshal, too.
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_302_32.zh: 你若是亲自拜访过明庭要员，除了梁大人之外，那你应该也见过明庭军策府的本兵大人。
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_302_32.speaker: Qiuyuan

yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_302_48.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_9_1
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_302_48.text: Mingting... is not the place you once visited.
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_302_48.zh: 明庭……应该已经不是你曾经以为的模样了。
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_302_48.speaker: Qiuyuan

yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_401_15.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_4_5
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_401_15.text: A wanted criminal of Mingting, and yet the Ministry of War sent you all the way to Rinascita to hunt down Scar in secret.
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_401_15.zh: 倒是你，身为明庭重犯，却带着军策府的命令私下来黎那汐塔追杀「伤痕」。

yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_401_16.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_4_5
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_401_16.text: Who would've thought... Mingting places such importance on him.
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_401_16.zh: 没想到，明庭竟然把他看得这么重。

yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_401_17.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_4_5
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_401_17.text: If you know that, it means you still have eyes and ears in Mingting.
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_401_17.zh: 你知道这件事就说明，明庭里还有你的人。
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_401_17.speaker: Qiuyuan

yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_401_6.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_4_5
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_401_6.text: What a shame you couldn't end "him" in Mingting… and now, you still can't.
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_401_6.zh: 可惜，过去在明庭你没能杀了“他”，现如今也不可能。

yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_5_17.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_5_1
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_5_17.text: Whatever he's carrying... could shake Mingting to its core.
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_5_17.zh: 他身上……恐怕藏着牵动明庭的秘密。
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_5_17.speaker: Rover

yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_603_27.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_5_4
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_603_27.text: You should save your gratitude for her when you visit Mingting someday. She takes great interest in you.
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_603_27.zh: 要谢的话，等你将来去了明庭，亲自向本兵大人道谢吧。她似乎对你很有兴趣。
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_603_27.speaker: Qiuyuan

yakita:Main_HuangLong_LLZQMXY_10_11.text: ...It really has been a long time since I've been home. How are they doing? I wonder what Mingting is like now.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_LLZQMXY_10_11.zh: ……说起来，确实很久没回去了，不知道父亲母亲，还有明庭现在是什么样子。
yakita:Main_HuangLong_LLZQMXY_10_11.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_HuangLong_LLZQMXY_30_24.text: Our tech is standard across the world. Even if you went to Mingting, the results would still be the same.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_LLZQMXY_30_24.zh: 华胥研究院的技术各地互通，即便到明庭去，应该也只能得出一样的结果。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_20.text: Others might have seen only an ordinary painter, but I saw the colors within him. He walked away from a chance to study at the Mingting Institute of Art, all to stay in the hometown he loved so dearly.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_330_20.zh: 我的丈夫，在别人看来没什么特别的，一个落魄画家而已。但我知道，他曾有去明庭画院的机会，只是舍不得这片育他长大的家乡。

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_77_2.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_2_29_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_77_2.text: Still, breaking me out right under Mingting's nose without setting off a single alarm... Delicious. Tell me, how did you come up with that little idea?
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_77_2.zh: 我说，你是怎么想出来那个法子的？甚至能在明庭的眼皮底下，神不知鬼不觉地将我转移走……
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_12_77_2.speaker: Scar

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_9_37.text: I don't know what's waiting for me there. But... I can't ignore the Streams. Every voice behind them belongs to someone in need.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_9_37.zh: 虽然不知道明庭如今发生了什么，但……我做不到无视它们，因为每一道流息的背后，都代表着一个需要帮助的人。

yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_14_26.text: Stop—not another word. I know exactly what you Mingting folks are up to. You're plotting to slowly take over the entire Xuanfang Hold market, aren't you?
yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_14_26.zh: 停，都别说。我知道你们这些明庭来的想做什么，你们不就想慢慢把我们玄方城的生意都吃掉？

yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_20_15.text: That may be true, but I do have several channels at my disposal. With the Zhaoming Commerce Guild's network, we can easily get these goods flying off the shelves in Mingting, all the way out to Rinascita, and maybe even the New Federation.
yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_20_15.zh: 也许是这样吧，但我手里掌握的渠道可不止一条。昭明商会手里的经销渠道可以让这些货畅通无阻地卖到明庭，乃至黎那汐塔，甚至新联邦去。
yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_20_15.speaker: Suisui

yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_80_1.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_主线差分配音_6_3
yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_80_1.text: Mom! I'm home! Where's dad? I've brought him a souvenir from Mingting!
yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_80_1.zh: 妈！我回来了！爸呢？我给他带了明庭的伴手礼！

yakita:GNNPC_TGBST_31_10.text: As for Miss Suisui, I heard she arranged for the Commerce Guild to send a big shipment of emergency supplies to the Hold. The Ministry of Development also received a hefty stock of raw materials, too.
yakita:GNNPC_TGBST_31_10.zh: 至于穗穗女士，我听说她安排商会给玄方城运来了一大批应急物资，天工部也补充了不少原材料。

datamine:InfoDisplay_103012505_Text.title: Electronic Notice for the Annual Inspection of Transport lorry
datamine:InfoDisplay_103012505_Text.text:
Hear me, everyone. The Annual Inspection of the Transport lorries for the mines is about to begin. Bring your license when you go to the inspection. It must be valid.
Anyone with an expired license will all be considered uncertified personnel. You’re gonna be denied access to your vehicle, no matter how experienced you are as a driver.
The inspection will take place from the end of this month to the middle of the next. Bring your ID papers and file your application at Ministry of Development. The time of the examination will be published on another occasion.
Ready the files attached here carefully before you go and get yourself prepared. You’re gonna want to thank me.

Attachments: 1) Particulars of the Annual Inspections of Transport Lorries at the mine
2) Basic Criteria for the Assessments of Vehicle Driving Skills
datamine:InfoDisplay_103012505_Text.zh:
都注意了，近期黑石专用运输车的年审又要开始了，大家多关注自己的驾照到期时间。

yakita:FavorStory_160103_Content.zh:
桃祈平日看似慵懒，总是一副快要睡着的迷糊样子，但经她手的工作却没有一件出过差错。
“喂，你说，桃祈前辈是又睡着了吗？”刚来的新人总会发出相同的疑惑。
与桃祈相处熟悉的同事们则会不厌其烦地向他们解释着，桃祈前辈可是相当值得信赖的“姐姐”。
“桃祈前辈，对不起……关于这个基建方案，我想了很久，还是不知道应该如何去优化了。”
工作之余，桃祈常常会遇见后辈请教问题。
“嗯，时候也不早了，还是先下班吧，走吧，我们去街上逛逛，听说那里又开了一家很好吃的美食哦。”
“啊？”勤奋的后辈们总是跟不上她的节奏。
桃祈很少主导某事、某人，她认为问题的最终答案还是需要自己去追寻。她带着充满疑惑的后辈来到了街市上，这里正是桃祈曾经设计整改的街市，如今已经变得热闹繁华。桃祈默默地推动着他关注周遭细微的一切，品尝美食时也关注着今州人和店铺老板们的闲谈、聊天，而这些所见所闻里，才藏着方案中真正需要改进的问题。后辈像是明白了桃祈的用意，兴奋地向她表达了谢意。而桃祈还是如往常一样，慢悠悠地做着自己的事情。
在生活中，桃祈也是大家的“知心姐姐”。
“桃祈前辈，请听我说……”
这个杂物间原是桃祈偷偷用来午睡的地方，但不知何时，这里变成了后辈与她闲暇之时的聊天室，有软绵绵的沙发、高度适宜的茶几、清甜可口的茶水。
桃祈懒洋洋地坐在沙发上，听着后辈叽叽喳喳地向她倒着苦水。
“最近今州的房价又涨了！”
“唉，是啊。”
“为了还房贷，我得努力工作才行，可我一这样想就觉得压力好大，反而不想工作了……”
“我也不想工作呢。”
“唉……咦？时间过得好快，聊天时间这么快就要结束了……”
也许聊天室之所以能一直开下去，只是年轻人想找个倾诉的地方。
她只需当一个倾听者，把他们的烦恼看在眼里，收在心里，缓缓地为他们卸下心中的压力。

datamine:InfoDisplay_133002007_Text.title: Montelli
datamine:InfoDisplay_133002007_Text.text:
One of the most powerful families in Ragunna, renowned for their pioneering spirit. The Montelli family played an instrumental role in charting trade routes that not only connect Ragunna, but also greater Rinascita to the wider world. As the city opened its doors, the Montellis rose to prominence, amassing great wealth and unmatched influence.

The Montelli family also took the lead in introducing and developing Reserved Terminals across Ragunna. While the Order of the Deep dismissed these Terminals as an inferior mockery of the Genesis Nexus and Common Echoes, the Montellis secured the Order's approval to continue their development in secrecy, offering guarantees of safety and hefty tax payment in exchange.

Unlike the more traditional families, the Montelli family values emotional bonds and shared ideals above bloodlines and social standing. They advocate for the distribution of opportunities and wealth, believing that riches are worth more when they circulate. Though often ridiculed by traditional families as "nouveau riche with Shell Credits running through their veins," the Montellis take no offense—on the contrary, they wear the label with pride.
datamine:InfoDisplay_133002007_Text.zh:
拉古那的主要家族之一，以“永远开拓、永远主动进取”而闻名。莫塔里家族在一定程度上主导了拉古那甚至黎那汐塔贸易航路的开拓，并随着拉古那的开放迅速崛起，积累了难以想象的财富。
莫塔里家族同时也主导了拉古那私人终端的技术引进和开发。虽然隐海修会认为私人终端的存在是对起源信标和公共声骸的低劣模仿和恶意扭曲，但在莫塔里家族对安全性进行了反复保证，并缴纳了巨额税款的前提下，修会最终允许莫塔里家族以秘而不宣的方式继续开发和使用私人终端。
和那些更为传统的家族相反，比起血脉和阶级，莫塔里家族更倾向于情感和相同理念的联结，他们主张将机遇和财富分享给所有人，认为财富只有流动才能产生更大的价值。尽管这使他们被某些保守派家族嘲讽为“血管里流着贝币的暴发户”，但莫塔里人们并不在意，反以此为殊荣。

datamine:InfoDisplay_133002015_Text.title: Averardo Vault
datamine:InfoDisplay_133002015_Text.text: A vault built by the Montelli family on the outskirts of the city. Within its walls lies the family's vast collection of treasures. The vault also provides public services such as secure storage for valuables, appraisals, and acquisition of rare collections.
datamine:InfoDisplay_133002015_Text.zh: 莫塔里家族在城外所修建的金库，内部存放着莫塔里家族收集的各种藏品，同时也开设了保管重要物品、藏品估值与收购等业务。

yakita:LoadingTipsText_601901_TipsText.text: The vault, controlled by the Montelli family, houses an exquisite collection of rare Echoes and artwork. Surrounded by natural barriers and perched atop a high vantage point, it offers a breathtaking view of Nimbus Sanctum.
yakita:LoadingTipsText_601901_TipsText.zh: 由莫塔里家族主控，收藏有大量珍贵声骸与艺术品的金库。天堑环绕，睥睨云海。

datamine:InfoDisplay_120101004_Text.title: Heying's Wish
datamine:InfoDisplay_120101004_Text.text:
To the Moontree Lodge,
 
They say that Moon-Chasing Festival is a time for family reunions, but my son is no longer here. The house feels so empty without him. I miss the old days, with him by my side, the both of us together, sharing conversation... Is he as lonely in that other world as I am in this one? Should I go be with him? But I promised that I'd live a long, full life and take care of myself... Oh, Moontree Lodge, I've gotten so old, what do I have to wish for anymore? If you really can pull off miracles as they say, please, tell me. What should I do?

Heying
datamine:InfoDisplay_120101004_Text.zh:
致月树屋：
都说追月节要团团圆圆，但儿子都不在身边，每天家里都空落落的。唉，还是以前好啊，有儿子陪在身边，大家一起，多热闹……你们说，我儿子一个人在那边的世界会不会和我一样孤单呢，我要不要去陪他，可我答应过他也得好好在这边呆着……月树屋啊月树屋，我年纪大了，没什么特别的心愿，如果你真那么灵验的话，就请你教教老婆子我到底该怎么做？
                                                                                                                                                    禾盈

datamine:InfoDisplay_120101012_Text.text:
Today is the day of the Moon-Chasing Festival, and the teacher at school said that all wishes made on this day will come true.
In that case... I wish that Dad could come home more often.
No, wait, in the magazine, Dad said that █████████
In that case... I want to be just as amazing as him. No, I want to be an even greater scientist than him. I want to find out what the world of truth is really like with him.

那……我要成为和爸爸一样厉害，不，更加厉害的科学家，我要和爸爸一起去看看真理世界是什么模样。

yakita:FavorStory_120904_Content.text:
[…]

There were no stars at Startorch Academy.

Back then, the Sky Projection Array could only manage the most basic precipitation patterns, and the Spacetrek Collective, still in its early exploratory stage, had no spare resources to adorn the unfamiliar underground world with starlight.

But Mornye hadn't realized that the "stars" her mentor spoke of were the ones above the frostlands.

[…]

Normally, no one would have thought to invite Mornye on such a mission, so when her mentor extended a hand toward her, she did not refuse.

She boarded the Starward Riseway bound for the world above.

[…]

Then came the memories she had forced herself to bury.

[…]

And then, a restless yearning surged.

It was unlike anything she had ever felt, a fierce tide rising so violently it felt like a defiance of something vast and incomprehensible.

[…]
yakita:FavorStory_120904_Content.zh:
星炬学院没有星星。彼时的大气拟造阵列还只具备最基础的降水功能，还在探索阶段的深空联合也尚无余力对这片陌生的地下世界进行装点。
但莫宁没有想到，那位前辈所说的星星，是冰原之上的世界。
那是一次前往冰原之上的科考。平日没有人会邀请莫宁参加这样的行动，因此在{TA}向自己伸出手时，她反而没有拒绝。
于是她坐上了通往冰原之上的联运椎骨。意外的，大多数时间她都和其他科考队员没什么不同，安坐在交通工具中，一路计算着那些轰鸣的庞大机械收集得来的数据。偶尔，当他们的交通工具无法通行——或者只是单纯的有什么值得一看的景色时，那位前辈会背着她，走在风雪之中。
雪原中的风夹杂着冰片擦过滚烫的面颊。远方的面貌在雪风中模糊不清，但似乎有崭新的世界在她面前豁然展开。
考察的最后，他们抵达了一片机械的残骸，坐在废墟之上，仰望漫天星辰。
“你喜欢星星吗？”
那个人这样说着。莫宁跟随{TA}抬起头，望向那些自光年外而来的碎片。
“正因为能看到星星，人类才会对天空之外的世界产生好奇。
“我想，你们会证明，这看似永恒的隔绝并非终点。人们终有一日能以自己的意志，迈向星辰大海”
——啊，原来如此。
她首先意识到的，是他人与自己是同等渺小的存在。她，父亲，母亲，故乡的同学，还有{TA}。在浩瀚无垠的群星下，都只是这颗星球里一颗微不足道的尘埃。
紧接着，她回想起那些被自己刻意压制的痛苦。她想起第一次翻越护栏时坠地的疼痛，想起母亲离开家时被她咽下的哭喊，想起故乡的学校里孩子们秘而不宣的眼神，被让出的过道，想起她想象自己结束一切时那令人不安的平静。
最后，不甘翻涌而来。
那是一种前所未有的情绪，它是如此强烈地席卷了她，以至于像是对某种伟大存在的宣战。一簇冰冷的星火在她沉寂的胸腔点燃，带着灼痛的引力，将她因守于狭小世界而维持的平静撕毁殆尽。
然后，星光倾斜而来。
带着泪水，带着心脏的轰鸣，她像身边人一般伸出手，伸向那无穷远处的星光。
——“我也想……抵达那样的未来。”

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_2_48_12.text: That is a serious accusation, Professor Mornye.

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_57_3.text: ...I see. Then what do you plan to do now, Rebecca?

yakita:Flow_11000009_21.text: The most important in research is to block out frequent external disruptions. As a rookie researcher, I had the opportunity to collaborate with Mortefi before.

yakita:Flow_311000000_361.text: There are many stories like that. Have you heard about a researcher named Mortefi at the Academy?
yakita:Flow_311000000_361.zh: 这箩筐事可多了，你知道研究院有个叫莫特斐的研究员吗？
yakita:Flow_311000000_361.speaker: Yihu

yakita:Flow_311000000_362.text: Panhua's Restaurant is so good that even those researchers come here. I often hear them talk about a certain "Mortefi."
yakita:Flow_311000000_362.zh: 咱们攀花饭馆好吃，哪怕是那些研究员也会来这儿吃饭。我就常听他们聊起这叫莫特斐的研究员。
yakita:Flow_311000000_362.speaker: Yihu

yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_28_1.text: Man, every time I read Mr. Mortefi's research, I learn something new...
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_28_1.zh: 莫特斐前辈的研究报告真是每次看都会有新的发现……
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_28_1.speaker: Yeyhe

yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_28_4.text: Did you see Mr. Mortefi shut down that guy making all those crazy demands?
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_28_4.zh: 那你肯定看到莫特斐前辈把那个提出无理要求的家伙驳得一句话都回不了吧。
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_28_4.speaker: Yeyhe

yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_28_6.text: Only Mr. Mortefi has the guts to challenge them openly, it's pretty cool!
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_28_6.zh: 不过也就只有莫特斐前辈敢这么公开和他们叫板了，真是太帅了！
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_28_6.speaker: Yeyhe

yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_28_9.text: Some folks might not get Mr. Mortefi, seeing him as only short-tempered, but there are plenty who secretly admire him.
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_28_9.zh: 虽然其他人可能并不理解莫特斐前辈，会觉得他脾气很差，但其实也有很多人背地里佩服他的。
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_28_9.speaker: Yeyhe

yakita:FavorWord_120453_Content.text: That Xiangli Yao... One day I'll outdo him, and create even better inventions!
yakita:FavorWord_120453_Content.zh: 那个叫相里要的家伙……迟早有一天，我会超越他，创造出更伟大的发明！
yakita:FavorWord_120453_Content.speaker: Mortefi

yakita:POI_SMBD_13_64.text: Here's the short version: we still have some spare parts from the Explosive Spears used in the last battle, stored in the Port City of Guixu. They should work if we assemble them.

yakita:POI_SMBD_23_1.text: That's some spectacular explosions. Don't you think, Mortefi?

yakita:YBWP_10_28.text: (Share your experience regarding Autopuppets with Mortefi.)
yakita:YBWP_10_28.zh: （向莫特斐说明关于机傀的事。）

yakita:YBWP_10_38.text: Mortefi picks up the Terminal and gives it a quick glance. His face immediately darkens.
yakita:YBWP_10_38.zh: 莫特斐拿起终端快速扫了一眼，面色随即沉了下来。

yakita:YBWP_10_42.text: Mortefi lowers his gaze to the Terminal, his fingers moving swiftly across the screen. After a short moment...
yakita:YBWP_10_42.zh: 莫特斐垂眸看向终端，指尖快速划过屏幕。片刻后……

yakita:YBWP_1_6.text: Mortefi has sent you a file: Regarding Autopuppets
yakita:YBWP_1_6.zh: 莫特斐向你发送了一份文件：关于机傀

yakita:YBWP_20_1.text: Any idea of what might've happened, Mortefi? Should we check the last location first?
yakita:YBWP_20_1.zh: 莫特斐，你有什么头绪吗？要不要先去最后的定位点看看？
yakita:YBWP_20_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:YBWP_35_3.text: Heh... Here I am wondering who my savior would be... And it's you, Mortefi...
yakita:YBWP_35_3.zh: 呵……我还以为是哪路来的救兵……原来是你啊，莫特斐……

yakita:YBWP_43_17.text: And who might you be? Sorry, I was too busy ranting at Mortefi just now.
yakita:YBWP_43_17.zh: ……这位是？不好意思，刚才光顾着跟莫特斐“斗嘴”了。

yakita:YBWP_43_6.text: You all look worse off than I do, especially you, Mortefi... Heh, cough...
yakita:YBWP_43_6.zh: 你们一个个脸色比我还难看，尤其是莫特斐……呵，咳……

yakita:YBWP_45_20.text: I'll return to Xuanfang Hold at a later time if needed.
yakita:YBWP_45_20.zh: 之后有必要的话，我会再来玄方城。
yakita:YBWP_45_20.speaker: Mortefi

yakita:YBWP_60_3.text: Any update on the application, Mortefi? The one about the rogue Autopuppet data...
yakita:YBWP_60_3.zh: 莫特斐，上次的审批有结果了吗？就是关于异常机傀的数据……

yakita:YBWP_70_20.text: Hearing those words, Mortefi's expression darkens instantly.
yakita:YBWP_70_20.zh: 闻言，莫特斐的面色瞬间沉了下来。

yakita:GNNPC_AGLXZ_26_2.chapter: 剧情_拂风水畔_人文生态_10_1
yakita:GNNPC_AGLXZ_26_2.text: Stay away from the depths of Whisperwind Haven.
yakita:GNNPC_AGLXZ_26_2.zh: 不要靠近拂风水畔深处，那里很危险。
yakita:GNNPC_AGLXZ_26_2.speaker: Mr. Millkeeper

yakita:GNNPC_AGLXZ_26_8.chapter: 剧情_拂风水畔_人文生态_10_1
yakita:GNNPC_AGLXZ_26_8.text: I'm stationed here to ensure no one strays into the depths of Whisperwind Haven.
yakita:GNNPC_AGLXZ_26_8.zh: 是的，我守在这里防止有人误入水畔深处。
yakita:GNNPC_AGLXZ_26_8.speaker: Mr. Millkeeper

yakita:POI_QSMG_29_15.text: We clung to our notions of the knight's oath, laughingstocks wherever we went, dreaming of exploring Whisperwind Haven and even venturing beyond its limits.
yakita:POI_QSMG_29_15.zh: 一路上恪守着骑士之道，受人嘲笑着来到这里，梦想着向水畔深处，甚至跨越水畔的更远方前进。
yakita:POI_QSMG_29_15.speaker: Mr. Millkeeper

yakita:POI_QSMG_29_26.text: He was right. This was the path we all swore to... and he stuck to it until the very end, right here in Whisperwind Haven.
yakita:POI_QSMG_29_26.zh: 是啊，这条路不就是我们所选择的骑士道……他也在最后践行着这条道路，向着水畔冲锋消失在了自己的骑士梦中。
yakita:POI_QSMG_29_26.speaker: Mr. Millkeeper

yakita:POI_QSMG_30_17.text: I believe he exists because the essence of knighthood has taken root deep in Whisperwind Haven.
yakita:POI_QSMG_30_17.zh: 我想，之所以他会存在，便是因为永不消散的骑士之道在水畔深处生根发芽。
yakita:POI_QSMG_30_17.speaker: Mr. Millkeeper

yakita:POI_QSMG_30_5.text: Everyone who made it here left their marks. The trails they walked, the words they spoke, the tales of the ones who explored the furthest reaches of Whisperwind Haven...
yakita:POI_QSMG_30_5.zh: 抵达这里的大家，留下的足迹，留下的话语，以及那向水畔深处冲锋的背影可都是实打实地存在过。
yakita:POI_QSMG_30_5.speaker: Mr. Millkeeper

datamine:InfoDisplay_102801020_Text.title: CSC Research Memo II
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801020_Text.text:
Research Memo #C501
Date: [--19]
Our visitor shared intricate details about the outside world, describing a new civilization that rose from the ashes of the old. Their narrative held a serene tone, void of personal emotion, as if they were an impartial observer, rather than the one who saved said civilization in the first place.
It became clear to me that they were not like us - their humility and goodwill were meant to guide and integrate us onto a predetermined path.
Despite this, I was grateful for all the knowledge they shared with me. I yearned to see this new world for myself, realizing that I had been cooped up in Mt. Firmament for too long...
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801020_Text.zh:
研究备忘录-#C501
日期：[--19]
那位“奇人”与我讲了许多外面的事，讲了一个新文明是如何建立在满目疮痍的废土之上的，那人的叙述冷静、克制，甚至没有太多的个人情感，仿佛自己是这一切的旁观者而非缔造者。
从这一刻开始，我才真正明白“奇人”与我们是不同的，其所传达的谦逊与善意，是为了更好地融入、引导，最终将我们带上那条预设好的道路。
但我依然很感谢那个人能将这些说与我听。我想去亲眼见见那个新世界，或许，我在乘霄山，待得有些太久了……

datamine:InfoDisplay_102801026_Text.title: Story of the Guqin
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801026_Text.text:
Years ago, there were two close friends who lived on Mt. Firmament. One of them loved stories about the world and wanted to travel around the world, collecting stories while adventuring like the protagonists of stories. When the Sentinel was about to seal Mt. Firmament, this person left Mt. Firmament on horseback.
The other person loved the sounds of the mountain, such as the gurgling water and chirping birds. She hung windchimers everywhere in the mountains and played the guqin on the mountain every day because she wanted to hear the music of the mountains and valleys.
They made a promise to reunite here after a few decades. At their reunion, one would tell stories of the world, and the other would play the beautiful music of the mountains and forests.
However, time flowed differently on Mt. Firmament, and one day there was equivalent to a few decades outside. Time passed mercilessly. The one who left could no longer return home, and the one who stayed could only watch as her guqin decayed.
In this vast expanse, every goodbye could be a farewell for life.
Be well. Farewell.
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801026_Text.zh:
早些年，这乘霄山中有对知己朋友。他们其中一人最爱这人间故事，说自己要像那话本子里的主角一般，行走江湖、收集故事、游历人间。岁主将封乘霄山时，他挑担走马，离开了这乘霄山。
而另一位酷爱这山里的声音，水流潺潺，鸟鸣声声，她在这山间挂满定风铎，想听遍这山乐谷音，便留在此处，每日鼓琴。
他们本约定，几十年后要重聚与此，届时一人要说遍世间故事，另一位要奏遍山林雅乐。
可惜这乘霄山一日，是人间几十载。秋去春回，这离开之人再无法归乡。而留下之人，只见这琴衰弦朽。
江湖路远，人与人之间的每一次平常分别，可能都不再相见。
珍重、珍重。

datamine:InfoDisplay_102801035_Text.title: Private Journal V
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801035_Text.text:
[…]

Bram and I advised them to calm down and at least wait until we resolve the issue of shortened lifespan before making a decision.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801035_Text.zh:
日期：[---]
我是维克托，例行进行语音日志记录。
今天又是美好的一天。大多数研究员都走了，他们打算离开乘霄山。我和布拉姆先生劝他们冷静，至少要先等到解决了时间代偿的问题再说。但他们没听我的。
我没走。研究需要持之以恒——这是布拉姆先生给我上的第一堂课，他也确实在一直以身作则地践行这一信条。呵，在他面前，我永远都是那个不成熟的毛头小子。
 日期：[---]
我抽出时间做了一点新东西：一个呆头呆脑的AI，我给他取名叫卡莱伯，因为它让我想到了我小时候看过的老电影里跟着一个男人和一条狗旅行的铁脑袋。这里没剩几个人了，总得有人负责处理一些不重要的杂活。多一个AI总是好的。
还有一些有趣的岩石机关，反正这里有的是闲置的溯流仪。这让我想到了小时候玩积木的美好岁月。不过，布拉姆先生看起来不太高兴，也许是他的年龄让他接受不了太多新鲜事物……当然，也有可能是他腿脚不太好，可能这些机关会妨碍他的日常行动？
管他呢……生命又不能只有工作和研究，对吧？
 日期：[---]
从零开始教育一个AI还是挺有乐趣的。就像在一张空白的画布上作画——我需要竭力让自己专注，以免我把一幅细致的画作变成了信笔涂鸦。
我回答它所提出的任何疑问，每隔几天就为它编写新的数据库条目。我用布拉姆先生教我的方式教给它我所知的，关于这世界的一切。这种感觉……很奇妙。它的摄像头映照着我所见的世界，它用我的逻辑方式思考，让我得以从它的行动中再次审视我自己。
 日期：[---]
卡莱伯学得还挺快，我一开始只打算让它帮我们做做饭，收拾收拾屋子，我也没想到它的潜力远远超过了我们的想象。看来我是时候把它的头衔从“生活助理”改成“研究助理”了。
布拉姆先生已经病了好几天，躺在床上，哪都去不了。我很怀念他以前中气十足，挨个教训我们这些学徒的样子……唉，不过我现在也变成了中年人，我几天没刮胡子了来着？算了，这不重要。
 日期：[---]
布拉姆先生……他最终还是没挺过这个漫长的冬天。
我和卡莱伯将他安葬在了附近的山上，没留墓碑。反正也不会有人知道我们是谁，没人会记得我们的名字。大家只会看着我们留下的那些微不足道的遗产，嘲笑我们是沉迷于自己妄…

yakita:InfoDisplay_102801032_Text.zh:
//记述人：布拉姆
——我已经看到了我的结局。在死亡到来前，我……必须忏悔。
我不是一个纯粹的学者。
我很羡慕我的同僚们。维克托，阿莱雅，瓦西里，陈学峰……他们都有理想，都有信念。他们真心实意地希望人类能够因为他们的努力而生活得更好，他们想要克服悲鸣，阻绝危机。
但我和他们不同，我是个自私的人。我装作和他们一样为了理想而努力。我在怨鸟泽参与了对溯洄雨的研究， 然后又来了乘霄山。我想要证明，时间是一条河流。我们现在被它裹挟而下，终有一日，我们也能找到逆流而上的方法。
我就像溺水的人那样，拼命寻找着不存在的稻草……很可笑吧，薇薇安。
我不知道我为什么在这时想起了你。或者说……我一直都没忘。乘霄山的奇迹曾经让我产生了许多不切实际的想象。我耗尽了我的一切，耗尽了我前半生所拥有的一切学识，想要把你从灰暗的冥界拉回来，再次拥抱你。
但我没能做到。我的手指开始颤抖，头昏眼花，再也没法摆弄那些精细的仪器。我看到你就站在河边，和我仅仅隔着一层薄薄的帷帐。我随河水一起向下，向下，向下。但你……永远留在了上游的某个地方。
好在，我很快就不需要考虑这一切了。我也即将搁浅……希望我有机会沿岸而上，找到你。

欢迎大家在这里留下自己的想法！总有一天，我会将这里变成全穗波最棒的咖啡厅！——美树

今天美树在店里装了一个风铃，她说风铃能够传达风的旋律，虽然我无法外出，也无法飞翔，但是听到风铃的声音，就会有种愿望被实现了的感觉。——雾音
新年和美树一起做了手工灯笼，希望今年这家店可以生意兴隆。这样我就可以继续打工下去，拿到更多工资。——青豆
菲力放在冰箱里的汽水为什么都是胡椒口味的？太难喝了，心有猛虎的硬汉怎么能喝这种东西？——翔太
没品味的半吊子，总有一天，你会理解胡椒味汽水的好的。——菲力
为什么这里的水豚都以铁道线路为名呢……如果我那天乘坐铁路去找她，结局会变得不一样么？——青叶
……
我来到了青叶说的那间咖啡厅，虽然无法相见，但这里有他留下的笔迹。——一花
今天作为店长接受了本地电视台的采访呢，这是我第一次上电视吧，有点害羞呢哈哈。不过……如果说人与人的牵绊可以结成一张铁道网的话，那从这里出发的列车，是否也有一天也能抵达爸爸在的城市呢？——美树
这咖啡厅我喜欢，有投资的价值！可店长却说她很满意现在的样子，怕换了店面顾客们找不到，真难理解啊，贴张告示不就好了么？——英梨子
……
你小时候最想要的限定版波仔玩偶，我给你带回来了。
你一直以来努力经营的梦想，我会帮你延续下去。

datamine:InfoDisplay_120101053_Text.title: Sumika's Notes - Entry 160
datamine:InfoDisplay_120101053_Text.text:
(The handwriting is noticeably rushed.)
It should be around noon. I've reached the third floor of Neon Tower. Rubble from the buildings is scattered and floating around like a shattered kaleidoscope. Some pieces have even stuck to my clothes. I must look like I'm covered in rainbow frosting.

…But my body is getting colder. Turns out I was right. Either these "sugar crystals" or the entire city are slowly draining the body heat of anyone who doesn't belong here.

I need to keep moving. I have to find the right path to the top, and fast.
datamine:InfoDisplay_120101053_Text.zh:
（略显潦草的字迹。）
现在应该是正午时分，我登上虹音塔三层。这里悬浮散落着许多建筑碎片，仿佛被打翻的万花筒，其中一部分甚至粘到了我的衣服上，此时的我应该像披着一层五颜六色的糖霜。
……尽管我在越来越冷。我的猜测没有错，这些“糖霜”——或者说这座城市，在剥夺外来人的体温。
再往前走走吧，我需要尽快找到通往塔顶的正确路线。
