yakita:LHYSTTHZB_3_3.zh: 你*新联邦粗口*，我昨天刚给你办完葬礼！

yakita:LHYSTTHZB_41_8.text: Shh, keep your voice down. It's just what I heard. Something about the New Federation redoing the budget...
yakita:LHYSTTHZB_41_8.zh: 小点声，小点声……我这也是道听途说的，好像说是新联邦那边重新审计了预算……

yakita:LHYSTTHZB_4_15.text: You didn't record it? *New Federation curse*, Miles! Don't tell me you ripped out my dashcam again without asking!
yakita:LHYSTTHZB_4_15.zh: 没录下来？*新联邦粗口*，你真该死啊！你又擅自拆我行车记录仪是吧！

yakita:NPC_LCZ_15_6.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院列车站生态_24_1
yakita:NPC_LCZ_15_6.text: Who the *New Federation curse* is flashing that at this hour?! I thought the *New Federation curse* Reactor Drive had exploded!
yakita:NPC_LCZ_15_6.zh: 谁他*新联邦粗口*在大晚上的试灯？！我*新联邦粗口*以为炉芯炸了！

yakita:NPC_LCZ_15_8.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院列车站生态_24_1
yakita:NPC_LCZ_15_8.text: Safety my ass! I almost ran down there without any *New Federation curse* pants on!
yakita:NPC_LCZ_15_8.zh: 安全个屁！我差点*新联邦粗口*裤子都没穿就冲下来了！

yakita:NPC_LCZ_16_3.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院列车站生态_26_1
yakita:NPC_LCZ_16_3.text: Midnight Train? The New Federation's Headless Knight at Buffalo is way cooler...
yakita:NPC_LCZ_16_3.zh: 幽灵列车？感觉不如我们新联邦的布法罗无头骑士呢……

yakita:NPC_LCZ_54_2.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院列车站生态_55_1
yakita:NPC_LCZ_54_2.text: I heard that Franka from your department used to be a Tornado hunter in the New Federation.
yakita:NPC_LCZ_54_2.zh: 听说你们学部的弗朗卡，以前可是新联邦的「龙卷风」猎手。

yakita:NPC_LHLSTHY_3_1.text: So... Mr. Rabelle is actually from the New Federation?
yakita:NPC_LHLSTHY_3_1.zh: 所以……拉贝尔先生其实来自新联邦？

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_64_4.text: Come to think of it, as a Gatekeeper, you've probably peeked into the dreams of plenty of New Federates. I'd like to hear what you make of that war, too.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_64_4.zh: 说起来，作为守门人你应该也窥看过新联邦人的梦境，我也想听听你对那场战争的看法。

yakita:Side_HJFBHX_3_2.text: This place has things you don't find in the city. The shabby feeling of industrialism. Like those you see in movies from the New Federation.
yakita:Side_HJFBHX_3_2.zh: 这里可有着城里见不到的那种……破败的工业感，简直就像是新联邦的电影里那样。

yakita:XJXYSSFBST_15_1.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_宿舍副本生态_16_1
yakita:XJXYSSFBST_15_1.text: Look! I can watch New Federation TV series at school now!
yakita:XJXYSSFBST_15_1.zh: 快看！我找到在学院也能追新联邦新剧的方法了！

datamine:InfoDisplay_28010012_Text.title: Writing by the Water
datamine:InfoDisplay_28010012_Text.text:
I'm Strom, an explorer of the Pioneer Association.
I have spent fourteen days and nights in this sinking city...
If anyone is reading this, there's something I need you to do...
If you ever meet Aria of the New Federation, please tell her...
Aria, the time I spent with you... was the most precious treasure of my life.
Thank you...
datamine:InfoDisplay_28010012_Text.zh:
我是先行公约的探险家，斯特罗尔，
我在这座濒临沉没的都市度过了十四个昼夜……
如果有人看到这则留言，请代我……传达……
若你遇到新联邦的亚莉亚，麻烦转告她……
亚莉亚，和你相处的那段时间，是我生命中无可替代的珍宝。
谢谢你……

yakita:InfoDisplay_120101029_Text.text:
[…]

From the Tacetite-eating Wyrm of the New Federation to the memory-devouring Dreadcurl Cuttle of the Forgotten Sea...

[…]

We must kill it.

This is my fate, your fate, and this ship's fate.

[…]
yakita:InfoDisplay_120101029_Text.zh:
我看到它了，绝对不会错。那只尖头上滴着大海漆黑的血的长角，绝对是它。
放下去的船都被顶翻了，后桅折断，少了七根标枪。
很多人都在害怕，他们在劝我返航……不，绝不停下。少的那七根标枪里，除了四根被它摆脱掉之外，另外三根，都已经插进它的身体里去了，就在它的背上，我看到了，那些剥落的晶体也沉到海里去了。
这已经是第五十五天了。
不是我们在追逐着它，而是它挡在了我们面前。你还不懂吗？只有杀死它，我们才能离开这个房间，前往无限的大海的尽头，前往风帆许诺给我们的地方。
你们想一想吧！我们征服了每一片大海！无论是那新联邦吃黑石的海龙，还是那遗忘海里会吞吃人的记忆的鬼乌贼……我，我们！我们杀死了多少这样的东西！现在挡在我们面前的就是它！你们的梦里，你们的记忆里，应当时时刻刻准备着杀死它！
把你手里那烟斗给我，你这老烟鬼。我和你们在这片烟雾中同行……我说，它夺走了我一条腿，我将从它的心脏上讨回！
我已经看到了它死去的那一天，它的血液将在大海中燃尽，它扑腾着的鱼鳍也耷拉下来，翻着肚皮，终于在漆黑的大海上显示出一片乳白和一片殷红……
到那时，我应允你们的，都会实现，你们将得到我的一切，无论是钱、油还是信仰——但我从不信仰任何神——你们都可以拿走，这艘船也不例外。我们会杀死它，我们也必将杀死它，这是我，你们，这艘船的命运。
现在，我要熄灭你们的火了，无论是你们心里的恐惧，还是这烟斗里没抽完的烟。

yakita:ItemInfo_80000028_BgDescription.text: A dish of tender tofu served in chili sauce. The appetizing spiciness of it makes Chili Sauce Tofu a widely popular dish even among the nobles of the New Federation.
yakita:ItemInfo_80000028_BgDescription.zh: 盖有满满一层红油的水豆腐，色泽赤红、鲜香可口。油辣豆腐流传甚广，连新联邦的贵族们都对其赞不绝口。

yakita:AYJJWD_5_6.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_勘踏悖论之森尾段_1_5
yakita:AYJJWD_5_6.text: The last time I was interviewed for a magazine, I was still a visiting scholar in the New Federation... That must have been over a decade ago.
yakita:AYJJWD_5_6.zh: 我上次接受杂志采访时还在新联邦访学，算算也已经过去十几年了……

yakita:BVBHD_116_3.text: There's Peaks of Prestige in the New Federation?

yakita:BYSTMP_15_3.text: That massive ship we saw today... Was it from Triumph Avionics? You know, the company from the New Federation?
yakita:BYSTMP_15_3.zh: 今天那艘大船，是不是来自新联邦的凯旋航电啊！

yakita:Flow_312800004_9.text: You see a shabby man who is selling New Federation magazines.
yakita:Flow_312800004_9.zh: 你看到了一个寒酸的男人，他正在推销手里的新联邦杂志。

yakita:Flow_312800005_9.text: You're in an old New Federation street and around a corner you see a shabby man who is selling the magazine in his hand.
yakita:Flow_312800005_9.zh: 你身处旧日的新联邦街巷，在一个转角，你看到了一个寒酸的男人，他正在推销手里的杂志。

yakita:Flow_313700003_109.text: You meet the shabbily dressed man again, who fervidly greets you and asks for your opinion about the New Federation magazine.
yakita:Flow_313700003_109.zh: 你再次遇见了之前穿着寒酸的男人，这次他主动向你热情地招呼着，询问起你对新联邦杂志的阅读体验。

yakita:HHACZST_41_4.chapter: 剧情_黑海岸_NPC对话与冒泡_2_18
yakita:HHACZST_41_4.text: Oh no, I promised my daughter I'd bring her souvenirs from the New Federation! I told her I'm working there.
yakita:HHACZST_41_4.zh: 糟了，我和女儿说我在新联邦工作，还答应了她要带特产回去。

yakita:HHACZST_50_4.chapter: 剧情_黑海岸_NPC对话与冒泡_2_26
yakita:HHACZST_50_4.text: Speaking of which, bioenergy has been in use in some regions for a while. Take the New Federation, for instance—
yakita:HHACZST_50_4.zh: 不过植物能源的应用早有先例，以新联邦为例——

yakita:HHACZST_5_1.chapter: 剧情_黑海岸_NPC对话与冒泡_2_2
yakita:HHACZST_5_1.text: Confirm with the Eye of Asteria if the Reverberation samples from the New Federation have been compiled.
yakita:HHACZST_5_1.zh: 问询阿斯特莉亚之眼，新联邦悲鸣区的残响样本是否完成了编译？

yakita:MAIN_RYAM_11_7.text: Your clothes aren't from around here. You from the New Federation?
yakita:MAIN_RYAM_11_7.zh: 不常见的打扮啊……从新联邦来的？

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_91_15.text: That means... you'll end up in the New Federation sooner or later, right?
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_91_15.zh: 那……以后，某一天，你肯定也会去新联邦吧？

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_16.chapter: 剧情_3_0_主线_拉海洛主线_上半_1_15_1
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_16.text: It's a multinational project. It's inevitable some New Federation methodologies get in the mix.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_18_16.zh: 这可是多国联合的项目，有一些新联邦来的技术也不奇怪。

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_2_41_14.text: Then I'd finally escape from this frozen wasteland and go start a new life in the New Federation!
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_2_41_14.zh: ——就能送我离开这片封闭的苦寒之地，去新联邦开启新的生活！

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_40_2.text: Congratulations! I'm certain she'll make an immense contribution to the New Federation one day.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_40_2.zh: 恭喜您，她日后一定能为新联邦做出巨大贡献。

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_22.text: Your plan... Are you just following the New Federation's playbook?
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_22.zh: 你的计划，就是按部就班地执行新联邦的计划吗？
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_42_22.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_26_2.text: The vote was jointly conducted by each department's committee and the New Federation Special Investigation Panel.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_YMDDDTY_26_2.zh: 本次结果由学院各学部委员会及新联邦特别调查团共同投票产生。

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_60_1.text: A cabinet filled with various medicines, predominantly from the New Federation, including nutritional agents, antibiotics, suppressants, and other drugs...
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_ZRJDYKX_60_1.zh: 装满了各种药品的柜子，大多数药物来自新联邦，包含营养剂，抗生素，抑制剂等各种药物……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_55.text: Oh, and could you open a gateway to Startorch Academy? It has ties to the New Fed, and I'd like to make a few preparations first.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_55.zh: 对了，能帮我打开通往星炬学院的门吗，学院与新联邦有所关联，我想去那里先做些准备。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_211_1.text: Meanwhile, in a corner of the New Federation...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_211_1.zh: 此时此刻，新联邦的某一角……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_211_7.text: Don't lose your nerve. The chaos of war breeds opportunity. If you ask me, the New Federation is long overdue for a fresh "reshuffling."
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_211_7.zh: 别这么害怕，战争带来的混乱也意味着机遇。我看，新联邦早该迎来一次全新的“洗牌”了。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_215_3.text: "The Resonator War?" Since when have you taken an interest in New Fed history?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_215_3.zh: “共鸣者战争”？你怎么突然开始对新联邦的历史感兴趣了？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_215_4.text: Most people avoid bringing up that war, given the delicate relationship between Resonators and ordinary citizens there.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_215_4.zh: 关于那场战争，因为新联邦内部共鸣者与普通人特殊的关系，绝大部分人对它都闭口不谈。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_3_2.text: Hard to make out. He looks like a New Federate, though.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_3_2.zh: 听不清，看他的打扮是新联邦人？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_30.text: The New Federation is a technologically advanced region in Solaris. Its society values freedom and innovation above all.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_30.zh: 新联邦是索拉里斯科技高度发达的地区，整个地区从上到下都崇尚自由与革新。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_30.speaker: Shorekeeper

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_31.text: But unlike other regions, Resonators there are strictly controlled by the government.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_31.zh: 但与其他地区不同的是，在新联邦的社会体系中，共鸣者受到政府严格管控。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_31.speaker: Shorekeeper

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_33.text: The Federated Army, led by ordinary citizens, ultimately prevailed over the Resonator army. Since then, Resonators in the New Federation have faced unequal treatment.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_33.zh: 普通人领导的联邦政府军最后击败了共鸣者军队，共鸣者也因此在新联邦受到了不公平的对待。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_33.speaker: Shorekeeper

yakita:NPC_HBGC_2_1.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_2_1
yakita:NPC_HBGC_2_1.text: Your reference letter is from... the New Federation?
yakita:NPC_HBGC_2_1.zh: 你的入职推荐信是……新联……？

yakita:NPC_HBGC_31_4.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_17
yakita:NPC_HBGC_31_4.text: No wonder Triumph Avionics and Panovista Transit are getting all the hype at the New Federation World Expo.
yakita:NPC_HBGC_31_4.zh: 也难怪，现在凯旋航电、全景运输在万国博览会上那么多人关注。

yakita:NPC_HBGC_49_4.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_27
yakita:NPC_HBGC_49_4.text: And me! Please bless us with someone filthy rich from the New Federation... preferably Gatsby!
yakita:NPC_HBGC_49_4.zh: 还有我！赐我们小组一个家财万贯的新联邦同学吧，最好是盖茨比！

yakita:NPC_LBEXB_23_1.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院拉贝尔学部_2_13
yakita:NPC_LBEXB_23_1.text: Meetings all *New Federation curse* day long!
yakita:NPC_LBEXB_23_1.zh: 一天到晚全*新联邦粗口*在开会了！

yakita:NPC_NXB_7_7.text: Yeah! And on top of that, it's a pre-Lament lunar soil sample donated by the New Federation!
yakita:NPC_NXB_7_7.zh: 对啊，更何况那还是新联邦捐赠的，“悲鸣”前的月壤样本耶！

yakita:NPC_XYJS_14_3.text: You want to study the Tacetites of the New Federation? Submit the application. Knock yourself out.
yakita:NPC_XYJS_14_3.zh: 想要研究新联邦的黑石种类？提，都可以提。

yakita:NPC_XYJS_281_4.text: That's what happens when you're directly funded by the New Federation.
yakita:NPC_XYJS_281_4.zh: 谁让他们是新联邦直接资助的呢？

yakita:NPC_XYJS_391_3.text: Just say you're a Roya from the New Federation.
yakita:NPC_XYJS_391_3.zh: 就说我是新联邦的罗伊人好了。

yakita:NPC_XYJS_44_5.text: Tell me about it. The deserts outside the New Federation cities don't have fish like that.
yakita:NPC_XYJS_44_5.zh: 是呀是呀，新联邦城外的那些戈壁可没有这样的鱼。

yakita:QDHDNPCST_90_1.text: (Whispering) Hi nice to meet you I'm Ignatius I'm from the New Federation.
yakita:QDHDNPCST_90_1.zh: （小声）你好很高兴认识你我是伊格内修斯我来自新联邦

yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_630_3.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_主线差分配音_3_4
yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_630_3.text: I... Maybe I should check out that new blade-resistant vest from the New Federation tomorrow?
yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_630_3.zh: 我……要不，明天去市场看看新联邦进口的防刃服？

yakita:Side_NXDGZYDYS_1_40.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线彩蛋_你想度过怎样的一生_1_1
yakita:Side_NXDGZYDYS_1_40.text: So I went to the New Federation. Then got transferred to the Spacetrek Collective. I was always alone. Threw myself completely into chasing the truth.
yakita:Side_NXDGZYDYS_1_40.zh: 之后我一直在新联邦工作，又被调来深空联合。我一直都孤身一人。我将自己的全部精力和时间投入在追寻真理上。

yakita:Side_TFSJJKYY_10_5.text: Once, I saw a few tourists from the New Federation in Ragunna.
yakita:Side_TFSJJKYY_10_5.zh: 有一次，我在拉古那城中看到了几个来自新联邦的游客。

yakita:XJXYBGSST_37_1.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院办公室_2_17
yakita:XJXYBGSST_37_1.text: Since the new President took office, both New Federation students and our funding have doubled.
yakita:XJXYBGSST_37_1.zh: 自从换了这位校长，新联邦来的学生和经费都翻了倍。

yakita:XJXYSSQTST_12_3.chapter: 剧情_学院宿舍前庭碎片化_13_1
yakita:XJXYSSQTST_12_3.text: You need to lay off the New Federation conspiracy thrillers...
yakita:XJXYSSQTST_12_3.zh: 求你了，平时少看点新联邦悬疑片吧……

datamine:InfoDisplay_120101041_Text.title: SOS...
datamine:InfoDisplay_120101041_Text.text:
Sender: Ghost Girl A
Time Sent: *&/#%/@▇▇

Content: 
Lost on the cliffs, falling into the deep sea.

If there are gods in this world, please listen to our sincere prayers:

"Let the ghosts sunk in the depths return to the mortal world. Not just on the Night of Remembrance, but let us return permanently to our homeland of Egla."
datamine:InfoDisplay_120101041_Text.zh:
发件人：幽灵少女A
发件时间：*&/#%/@▇▇
内容：迷失于山崖，坠落于深海
如果世上有神灵，请聆听我们虔诚的祈祷——
让沉于深海的幽灵们，重返人间吧
不止是回魂夜这天，让我们永远地，回到故土埃格拉吧

yakita:LGNCZST_112_11.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_16
yakita:LGNCZST_112_11.text: If you're planning to travel to Nimbus Sanctum soon, it's safer to set sail during the day.
yakita:LGNCZST_112_11.zh: 对了，如果您最近要前往氤柔水境，还是尽量选择白日出航，相对安全一些。
yakita:LGNCZST_112_11.speaker: Tulio

yakita:LGNCZST_112_4.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_16
yakita:LGNCZST_112_4.text: Scholars want more frequency samples for analysis. And with the sea of clouds... things have been unsteady, so the Servitude Hall has extended "operations" to Nimbus Sanctum.
yakita:LGNCZST_112_4.zh: 学者们希望有更多的频率样本可供解析。再加上云海那边……有些不太平静，驱役所的“业务”便扩展到了氤柔水境。
yakita:LGNCZST_112_4.speaker: Tulio

yakita:LGNCZST_112_7.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_16
yakita:LGNCZST_112_7.text: While undertaking tasks in Nimbus Sanctum, we often have to ascend and descend through the cloud tunnels of the sea of clouds. That sense of weightlessness is not a pleasant experience.
yakita:LGNCZST_112_7.zh: 嗯……在氤柔水境执行任务时，我们经常要在云海的云洞中直上直下，那种失重感，可不是什么好的体验。
yakita:LGNCZST_112_7.speaker: Tulio

yakita:ItemInfo_80000044_BgDescription.text: Pasta made with Mastic Nuvola, known for its strong, inviting fragrance. It is said that the fragrance attracts the singing wraiths from the Nimbus Sanctum. People often venture out at dawn to gather fresh Mastic Nuvola, hoping to catch the melody it holds within.
yakita:ItemInfo_80000044_BgDescription.zh: 加入云凝乳香的烩面，香气扑鼻。据说云凝乳香散发的香气能够吸引树海中全心歌唱的妖精，人们踩着晨曦去采集未坠入云海中的云凝乳香，是为了听凝固在其中的自然的乐音。

yakita:ATYDZH_5_11.text: This place is far more dangerous than Nimbus Sanctum.

yakita:ATYDZH_7_8.text: Is this an illusion from the past? It looks similar to what we saw in the Nimbus Sanctum, but the frequency is stronger.
yakita:ATYDZH_7_8.zh: 这是过去的幻影？和氤柔水境见到的很像，但频率更加强烈。
yakita:ATYDZH_7_8.speaker: Rover

yakita:DYHD_2502_8.text: Time to put our experience in the Nimbus Sanctum to good use. I'm certain we can make it work.
yakita:DYHD_2502_8.zh: 在氤柔水境我们已经有过这样的经验了，这次一定没问题。
yakita:DYHD_2502_8.speaker: Phoebe

yakita:LoadingTipsText_200005_TipsText.text: The sea of clouds lingering in this place is formed by concentrated Remnant Energy. Local legends of Ragunna speak of a serene, mirror-like area at the heart of Nimbus Sanctum, said to purify the darkest of thoughts and transform them into part of the clouds. At times, a haunting melody can be heard echoing from the depths of the sanctum.
yakita:LoadingTipsText_200005_TipsText.zh: 此地常年不散的「云海」实际上是由高浓度的回音能量构成。在拉古那的传说中，氤柔水境的中心有一片宁静如镜面的水域，它可以净化人们内心的恶念，将其化为云海的一部分。氤氲的水雾中有时会传来一阵摄人心魄的歌声……

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_26_6.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_23_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_26_6.text: Truth be told, I need to catch the final train in the Nimbus Sanctum today. However, this lone Gondola is all the harbor offers.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_26_6.zh: 事实上，我有急事要去云海中的列车站点，赶今天的最后一班车。但港口里只有这一艘船了。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_27_4.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_24_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_27_4.text: Perhaps it's merely my fancy. Regardless, her melody will guide us through fog and storm to the heart of the Nimbus Sanctum.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_27_4.zh: 也许是我的错觉吧。总而言之，跟随着那个歌声，我们就能穿越迷雾和雷暴，抵达云海深处。

yakita:MapMark_133021_MarkDesc.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Nimbus Sanctum area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"A great band doesn't fail—it simply disbands."
yakita:MapMark_133021_MarkDesc.zh: 氤柔水境地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “伟大的乐队不会失败，它们只会解散。”

yakita:MapMark_133022_MarkDesc.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Nimbus Sanctum area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"There's a treasure in the chest—just stick your head inside, and you'll see it."
yakita:MapMark_133022_MarkDesc.zh: 氤柔水境地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “箱子里面有宝物，你把头伸进去就能看见了。”

yakita:MapMark_133023_MarkDesc.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Nimbus Sanctum area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"I can no longer stop running."
yakita:MapMark_133023_MarkDesc.zh: 氤柔水境地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “早已无法停止奔驰。”

yakita:MapMark_133024_MarkDesc.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Nimbus Sanctum area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"On the wings of melody, let me guide you to the river's edge."
yakita:MapMark_133024_MarkDesc.zh: 氤柔水境地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “乘着歌声的翅膀，您请随我前往，去那河水边上。”

yakita:Flow_11000006_8.text: The battle in Norfall Barrens was so intense...
yakita:Flow_11000006_8.zh: 之前北落野那场大战，打得那么激烈……

yakita:Flow_11000011_5.text: It's close to Norfall Barrens, an unpredictable territory of threats... Even powerful Resonators shouldn't underestimate it.
yakita:Flow_11000011_5.zh: 毕竟靠近北落野……无论你多么厉害，都请不要把生命当儿戏。

yakita:Flow_11000012_25.text: Uh... Yes, the Tacet Discord in Norfall Barrens is active and the attacks are intense. It's inevitable to get injured.
yakita:Flow_11000012_25.zh: 呃……是的，北落野的残象活动频繁、攻势激烈，受伤也是在所难免的嘛。
yakita:Flow_11000012_25.speaker: Tianhe

yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_30_2.text: Talking about the Disruptor Cannon in the Norfall Barrens?
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_30_2.zh: 你们是说北落野的裂解炮吗？

yakita:NPC_XZJC_7_2.chapter: 剧情_天城生态_NPC_进城-边庭_7_1
yakita:NPC_XZJC_7_2.text: It was about the Teal General and the Battle of Norfall Barrens.
yakita:NPC_XZJC_7_2.zh: 是青衣将军和关外之战。

yakita:NPC_XZJC_8_2.chapter: 剧情_天城生态_NPC_进城-边庭_8_1
yakita:NPC_XZJC_8_2.text: It's not about the Teal General or the Battle of Norfall Barrens...
yakita:NPC_XZJC_8_2.zh: 不论关外之战，也不谈青衣将军……

yakita:Character_JiYan_50_5.chapter: 剧情_任务专用冒泡_忌炎线_6_1
yakita:Character_JiYan_50_5.text: My dad is a super hero who fights monsters in the Norfall Barrens!
yakita:Character_JiYan_50_5.zh: 我爸爸可是在北落野打大怪兽的英雄呢！

yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_26.chapter: 剧情_1_1_阿布引入间章剧情_4_1
yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_26.text: Our Sentinel Jué can look into the future. Nothing ever deviates from its predictions. It has already sort of guided you to the Norfall Barrens through Madam Magistrate's messages, right?
yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_26.zh: 岁主能知晓未来，一切都会按照祂所预知的轨迹发展，记得之前你也算是遵循岁主和令尹的嘱托前往北落野的吧？
yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_1_4_26.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_117_21.text: Not in that way, of course. I heard you took down that beast at Norfall Barrens. The wilds have been quieter since then, which means more opportunities for folks like us.
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_117_21.zh: 如今，正是蛟龙帮发展的黄金时期，我们正在广纳贤才。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_1.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_22
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_1.text: Access Pass is required if you're heading to the Norfall Barrens. That place is now off-limits.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_2_1.zh: 再往外走就出城了。除非有通行权限，现在北落野方向，不允许通行了。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_17.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_21
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_17.text: The Streams from the Norfall Barrens feel more suffocating than ever.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_17.zh: 从北落野传来的流息，比以往所有时候，都更加压抑，令人窒息。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_17.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_4.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第三幕_撞金止行阵_1_21
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_4.text: It felt as if I was seeing through the eyes of a Tacet Discord. I think... I saw what was happening in the Norfall Barrens.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_4.zh: 我的视野似乎变成了残象的视角，看见了北落野的情景……
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2EX_60_4.speaker: Rover

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_5_4.text: The Norfall Barrens, scarred by countless wars... Discarded weapons scattered like bones.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_5_4.zh: 北落之冢，平沙无垠，剑骸遍野，天沉如幂。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_6_19.text: Rover, it's dangerous there. The Norfall Barrens is the frontline in our defense against the Threnodian. We must be careful about going there.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_6_19.zh: 北落野太过凶险，是今州抵御鸣式的最前线。我建议我们还是谨慎为好。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_6_19.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_19_27.text: In that battle three years ago, our soldiers got into a gruelsome fight against countless Tacet Discords, either native to Norfall Barrens, or produced by the Retroact Rain... and endless swarms of Phantoms.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_19_27.zh: “弯刀之役”那一日，夜归军与北落野的原生残象，溯洄雨形成的残象……以及无数士兵的“幽灵”，四方混战在一起。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_19_27.speaker: Taoqi

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_19_30.text: The Norfall Barrens turned into a living hell, and to this day, we can still hear the desperate cries...
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_19_30.zh: 北落野一时如同人间炼狱，时至今日，仍能听到那些绝望的回响……
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_19_30.speaker: Taoqi

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_25_2.text: Things have gotten even more dangerous out here. The closer we get to Norfall Barrens, the worse it gets.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_25_2.zh: 一路走来，野外的危险程度都高得吓人，越靠近北落野越是如此。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_25_2.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_43_41.text: However, a successful outflank requires a wide battlefield, but the small passage of Norfall Barrens limits our options for movement.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_43_41.zh: （侧翼包抄的前提，是战场需要有足够宽阔的地形与合适的路径。如此狭隘的地形，看来并不支持这一战术。）
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_43_41.speaker: Rover

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_49_4.text: General, the Retroact Rain's effects are subsiding. We are observing a sharp decline in the number of TDs in the Norfall Barrens.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_49_4.zh: 将军，溯洄雨的影响已经逐渐消退，监测到北落野残象数量正在急剧减少。

yakita:POI_WSJL_45_4.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_机关宅邸危行支线_1_30
yakita:POI_WSJL_45_4.text: "Qiaoling, the situation in the Norfall Barrens is critical... We only pray the front line holds. Our plan still needs more time..."
yakita:POI_WSJL_45_4.zh: “悄玲，北落野那边战事告急……希望前线能够顶住。我们的计划，还需要更多时间……”

yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_350_2.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_主线差分配音_10_6
yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_350_2.text: Too right. A TD breakout would affect the entire Norfall Barrens... and then we'd have a crisis spanning two cities on our hands...
yakita:STNPC_XFDJPYNPCZX_350_2.zh: 嗯，残象外逃，必会影响北落野……届时就是两州危机……

yakita:phone_JL_3_4.text: I will continue to stand guard over Norfall Barrens. I will protect this land we defended together.
yakita:phone_JL_3_4.zh: 此后，我会继续戍守北落野，守护好这片我们一起保卫下的清朗山河。

yakita:LGNCZST_29_4.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_市中心生态_1_10
yakita:LGNCZST_29_4.text: I'm headed to Whisperwind Haven to help the Order distribute supplies to poor villagers, which is why this one is with me.
yakita:LGNCZST_29_4.zh: 我正要去拂风水畔帮助修会的兄弟向贫苦的村民们分发物资，也因此它便跟在我身边。
yakita:LGNCZST_29_4.speaker: Oboros

yakita:SZSTBC_32_4.text: I'm headed to Whisperwind Haven to help the Order distribute supplies to villagers in need, which is why it is with me.
yakita:SZSTBC_32_4.zh: 我正要去拂风水畔帮助修会的兄弟向贫苦的村民们分发物资，也因此它便跟在我身边。
yakita:SZSTBC_32_4.speaker: Oboros

yakita:LGNCZST_56_3.text: The clean and vibrant color palette is emblematic of the creator. All proceeds from the auction will be donated to the Order of the Deep.
yakita:LGNCZST_56_3.zh: 用色朴素，明媚，如同藏品的作者那般。拍卖所得将全部捐赠给隐海修会。

yakita:ItemInfo_40_BgDescription.text: A scripture fragment found on the seabed of the Riccioli Islands, documenting what is unrecorded in the Codex of the Order of the Deep. Those fragmentary words seem to respond to the very call of the ocean.
yakita:ItemInfo_40_BgDescription.zh: 在黎乔利群岛海底发现的断章，记录着隐海修会正典中全无记载的经文。只言片语的残片，仿佛响应着大海的呼唤。

yakita:Side_STDHYWB_29_1.chapter: 剧情_2_5_生态冒泡和碎片化_4_2
yakita:Side_STDHYWB_29_1.text: Folks don't often find their way to Ostina. You bringing good news, I hope?
yakita:Side_STDHYWB_29_1.zh: 能来到我们奥第那小镇可不容易。难道，你带来了好消息？
yakita:Side_STDHYWB_29_1.speaker: Pier

datamine:InfoDisplay_120101016_Text.title: Wish Tag
datamine:InfoDisplay_120101016_Text.text: I promised my boy I'd witness the Ovathrax's defeat and the peace he had fought so hard for.
datamine:InfoDisplay_120101016_Text.zh: 我答应过，替那孩子看看鸣式被打败的那一天，也是替那孩子好好看着他所守护的世界。

datamine:InfoDisplay_102801018_Text.title: CSC Research Memo I
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801018_Text.text:
[…]

Research Memorandum — #C532
Date: [--05]
As our 903rd experiment ended in yet another failure, we couldn't help but reminisce about our initial excitement when we completed the first Chronosorter prototype.

[…]

But it successfully restored time for a brief 1.29 seconds, making it a valuable sacrifice.

[…]

I need a more powerful Resonator, but the risk is too great.

No one can withstand the resonance shock of C-001 without enduring catastrophic overclocking.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801018_Text.zh:
研究备忘录-#C532
日期：[--05]
和昨天还有过去的几百天一样，第903次实验，我们依然是失败的。现在，我几乎已经想不起我们刚刚制造出「溯流仪」时的喜悦，尽管从一开始，我们就知道「溯流仪」只是个拙劣的仿造品，甚至于根据我当时的计算，一旦远离时流力场（也许在隙光滩还能发挥效用），「溯流仪」便难以再与C-001共鸣，它无法再回溯时间或做别的什么，它的价值不会高于任何与它等重的废铁。
但我还怀着那么一丝渺茫的希望，我坚信“二次共鸣”不仅仅是一个假说……或者，这是我毕生为之付出心血的东西，我不敢想象假如这一切都是谬说，我又该何去何从。

研究备忘录-#C545
日期：[--26]
第931次，我们离成功很近了。
第931号「溯流仪」，它和它的同胞一样，由于无法承受剧烈的共鸣冲击而支离破碎，但它的“牺牲”是有价值的——它复原了扭曲的时间，即使只回正了短短1.29秒。
我知道的、我就知道，“二次共鸣”理论不会错的，互相共鸣的两个个体，在它们的频率或是说共鸣力发生强烈碰撞的情况下，弱势的那一方即能发挥出超出自身限度的能力。
……只是我的「溯流仪」太过单薄脆弱，可如果有一个足够强大的共鸣者……不，这太冒险了，没有人能强悍到足以担受C-001的共鸣冲击，共鸣者最终会超频……和这931个「溯流仪」得到同样的下场。
批注：我必须和那位“奇人”谈谈，那个人向C-001下达的命令是唯一的变量，第931号「溯流仪」的短暂成功与那个指令，一定存在着某种联系……我不会看错的，C-001是应当是向第931号传递了一种未知的能量，就在我以为931次实验又要一如既往地失败的那一刻……

yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1106_TalentCertific.chapter: 釉瑚档案_共鸣能力鉴定报告
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1106_TalentCertific.text:
The waveform graph for Resonator Youhu shows a non-periodic rectangular pulse fluctuation for once, with sustained peak values during specific time intervals before a gradual decrease. These waveforms currently display clear sinusoidal fluctuations. Both the upper and lower peak values are low.

Resonant Criticality: Relatively high. Resonator Youhu's frequency displays high stability with a low risk of Overclocking.

Regular physical check-ups are recommended, while psychological counseling is currently deemed unnecessary.
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1106_TalentCertific.zh:
受试样本波形检验呈现单次非周期性矩形脉冲波动，峰值维持一定时间，后续平稳下降，当前规律性正弦形波动，上下峰值较低，波形清晰。
诊断结果：当前超频临界值较高，稳定性较高，超频风险较小。
无过往超频史。
建议按时进行定期检查，暂无需心理辅导。

yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1303_TalentCertific.chapter: 渊武档案_共鸣能力鉴定报告
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1303_TalentCertific.text:
Resonator Yuanwu's waveform graph shows elliptical fluctuations. Pattern of the Time Domain appears stable with no abnormal waveforms observed.

Resonant Criticality: Relatively high. Resonator Yuanwu's frequency displays high stability with minimal risk of Overclocking.

Previous records indicate no history of Overclocking; however, in Resonator Yuanwu's adolescence, during the earliest recorded use of his Resonance Ability, there was a near Overclocking event that produced violent frequency fluctuations and uncontrolled behavior. The incident was classified as a Class 2 hazard and archived under code EX42978.

Subsequent examinations revealed that this episode was caused by emotional distress. No aftereffect of Overclocking was noted.

Presently, Resonator Yuanwu's psychological state is deemed stable and healthy. Routine examinations are advised to prevent future incidents of Overclocking.
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1303_TalentCertific.zh:
波形检验图呈椭圆形波动，时域表示稳定，未见异常波形。
诊断结果：超频临界值较高，稳定性较高，暂无超频风险。
无过往超频史，但青年时期某次使用共鸣能力时的状态接近临界值。该次事件中，对象雷电异能呈现爆发态势，频率波动反应较高，几乎无法控制自身行为。所幸未造成人员伤亡，事件归档编号EX42978，定义为二级危害事件。
诊断原因：短时间内受到巨大刺激而引起的频率波动，未出现超频后遗症。
判断青年时期临近超频原因与对象情绪状态呈较大相关性。目前对象情绪状态稳定，无超频风险，按时进行定期检查即可。

yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1601_TalentCertific.chapter: 桃祈档案_共鸣能力鉴定报告
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1601_TalentCertific.text:
The waveform graph for Resonator Taoqi displays stable sinusoidal fluctuations in the Time Domain with no abnormal patterns. Upon examination, all results fall within normal parameters. 

Resonant Criticality: Medium. Resonator Taoqi's frequency displays high stability with a low risk of Overclocking. 

There is no recorded history of Overclocking for Resonator Taoqi. Routine examinations are recommended, while psychological counseling is currently deemed unnecessary.
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1601_TalentCertific.zh:
波形检验图呈正弦波形，时域表示稳定，未见异常波形。
检测结果判断为正常阶段，无超频风险。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_15_21.text: The Remnant Clouds from the sea of clouds drew hordes of Tacet Discords here. Now, their whispers fill the air, turning this once holy place of pilgrimage into the "Penitent's End."

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_21_13.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_2_5
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_21_13.text:
As you journey through the mist, you spot a "Pilgrim's Sail," the ship you saw when you first arrived in the city. Roccia explains that all Pilgrim's Sails eventually end up here, carried by the undercurrents to this island—Penitent's End, a place both destination and grave for every Pilgrim's Sail.
The ship appears abandoned. Its passengers must have ventured deeper into the island. With the mist still thick and danger lingering around, you decide to head toward a nearby lighthouse, hoping to find any scattered survivors along the way.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_21_13.zh:
穿越海雾，你见到了曾在你入城之时出航的“朝圣船”。洛可可解释道，由于这座岛屿下隐藏的暗流，所有朝圣船无一例外最终都会抵达这里——这片名为「悲叹墓岛」的危险岛屿，正是所有朝圣船的终点与坟墓。
朝圣船上空无一人，船上的人们可能已经往岛屿深处走去。如今海雾尚未彻底消散，危险还未解除，你们决定向不远处的灯塔前进，沿途寻找失散的人们。

yakita:AreaReportContent_Text45.text:
A poster advertising tourism in Riccioli Islands

Discover Riccioli Islands, a hidden paradise nestled amidst Rinascita's turbulent waters.
Named after the renowned astronomer and seafarer of the Order, Sir Riccioli, this archipelago has been a sanctuary of natural wonders since its discovery during Rinascita's founding years. From the elusive Riccioli Black Pearls to the ethereal Stygian Phantoms and strange Yarn Eels, the archipelago is teeming with life and natural beauties thanks to the unique qualities of its geographic location with much more yet to be discovered.
yakita:AreaReportContent_Text45.zh:
一份有关于黎乔利群岛观光季的宣传海报。

在黎那汐塔诸多风暴海域之间，有着这样一处平和静谧、风光旖旎的人间天堂——黎乔利群岛。
早在黎那汐塔建立之初，就已经被当时的航海家发现了的群岛，最终以修会的天文学家和航海家黎乔利的名字命名。独特的地理位置成就了此处的天然美景，也成就了生活于这片海域的百余种奇异生物，你将在此处看到珍贵的黎乔利黑珍珠，优雅的冥河水母，奇特的毛线团鳗，以及更多、更多尚未被人们所发掘的未知物种。

yakita:FavorStory_150603_Content.text:
[…]

The storm in the dead of night seemed as if it would drain every last drop of water in Ragunna.

[…]

Phoebe couldn't fall asleep.

[…]

On nights like this, her father used to slip a locket with the Sentinel's portrait under her pillow, telling her that the Divinity would guide her through the storms in her dreams to a safe harbor.

[…]

But now, the Acolytes would simply pat her head and tell her that she was like any other child.

[…]

But still, the relentless thunder and rain dragged her back to that dark night.

[…]

A Tacet Mark shone on her leg.

The Acolytes who found her said no one could survive such a perilous sea, let alone a little girl.

[…]

Then Phoebe saw a pair of button eyes and soft, floppy ears—it was the stray Echo she had met in Whisperwind Haven earlier that day.

[…]

It felt like the wind.

She buried her face into the Plushie's soft fur and slowly drifted back into a peaceful slumber.
yakita:FavorStory_150603_Content.zh:
深夜的暴风雨像是要倾洒尽拉古那全部的水，闪电在薄被上投下窗柩的形状，令交错的暗影压在蜷缩着的女孩身上。
菲比没有入睡，只要闭上眼睛，她便会看到翻滚着惊涛骇浪的海面，其中有一只永远无法归家的孤船，她在与这艘船一起下沉。
曾经在这样的夜晚，爸爸会将那个印着岁主像的相片盒放在她的枕下，告诉她岁主会在梦中带领她穿越风暴，抵达安全的港湾；妈妈会在她的床边放一束雏菊，为她讲述睡前故事，她说岁主会为勇敢而善良的孩子送来神使，护佑她平安幸福。
而现在，教士们会摸着她的头，告诉她还有和她境况相似的孩子们，每个黎那汐塔人都要淌过苦难，才能在人生的尽头获得岁主的宽恕。
越过教士的臂弯，她第一次看到了那样宏伟的岁主圣像，那巨大的鱼尾令她感到一瞬恐慌，而温柔的教士们轻轻扶住她的肩膀，念诵祷文的柔和声音令她逐渐平静。
她被领进温暖明亮的房间，温柔的教士们待她很好，但她们一定更加喜欢不会带来麻烦的孩子。
菲比努力回忆着母亲为她哼唱的歌谣，让它在脑海中回荡，借此盖过窗外暴雨的呼号。
而不停歇的雷雨声仍然将她拉回那个黑夜。

她偷偷溜上远航的商船，透过货仓的舷窗中看着船驶向远方的水平线——爸爸妈妈回来时，他们的船帆就是从那个方向出现，她不想再等着爸爸妈妈来接她了，她要勇敢地去找他们。
而大海并不像母亲讲述的故事里那样温柔，她听到甲板上步伐匆忙，人们的喧闹逐渐变为此起彼伏的惊叫，船只被风暴吞没，又被海浪高高抛起。
她哭着呼唤爸爸妈妈，而汹涌的海浪告诉她，她的父母早已不会归来。
她被冰冷的海水淹没，逐渐模糊的视野中，她看到父亲留给自己的相片盒沉入漆黑的海底，继而消失不见。
再次醒来时，她浑身湿透地躺在岸边，腿上的声痕闪烁着光芒，找到她的教士们说，从没有人能从那样危险的大海中生还，更何况是一个年纪那么小的女孩，这一定是岁主的赐福。
可菲比依稀记得似乎有什么救了她，带着无比温柔的气息，像一缕和风托着她浮上海面，将她轻轻放在了岸边，告诉她……
不要害怕，我在这里。
有什么将菲比从深沉的梦境中拉回，她感到床微微一重，似乎是一个毛绒绒的东西靠了上来，带着雨夜的潮湿和雏菊的香气。
随后菲比看到了一双纽扣眼睛和柔软的布耳…

yakita:FavorWord_150606_Content.text: When I was little, I loved going to Whisperwind Haven with friends. We'd lie on slopes surrounded by flowers and watch the clouds drift by. Tilly would play their accordion, and Livia and Brenno would weave all sorts of garlands that left a wonderful scent in their wake. I still go back sometimes... in secret.
yakita:FavorWord_150606_Content.zh: 小的时候，我最喜欢去拂风水畔找我的朋友们，我们会一起躺在长满花的山坡上看云，听蒂蒂尔演奏好听的风琴曲，拉比贝尼编出各种样式的花环，让奔跑起来的风也带上月桂的味道……现在吗？现在……我会偷偷去。
yakita:FavorWord_150606_Content.speaker: Phoebe

yakita:Side_STDHYWB_33_2.zh: 谢谢你的好意，但是这些你还是拿回去吧，之前弗洛洛送到我家里的那些，我也已经还给她了。

yakita:Side_STDHYWB_35_4.chapter: 剧情_2_5_生态冒泡和碎片化_4_8
yakita:Side_STDHYWB_35_4.text: And look at Phrolova, only a few years older, and yet she's doing extra practice. She even plays me music she writes herself.
yakita:Side_STDHYWB_35_4.zh: 看看你们的弗洛洛学姐，她总是会超额完成练习，还会把自己的编曲给您听！

yakita:Side_STDHYWB_35_9.chapter: 剧情_2_5_生态冒泡和碎片化_4_8
yakita:Side_STDHYWB_35_9.text: Lost! That textbook belongs to Phrolova. I borrowed it from her for you so you could read her notes in the margins! Go find it!
yakita:Side_STDHYWB_35_9.zh: 丢……那可是我专门为你们向弗洛洛借的她当年的笔记，是很珍贵的学习记录，快去找回来！

yakita:Side_STDHYWB_37_2.chapter: 剧情_2_5_生态冒泡和碎片化_4_10
yakita:Side_STDHYWB_37_2.text: Phrolova and I were meant to go to the city... Maybe I'll send her to look for Triss when we get back. Triss will listen to her.
yakita:Side_STDHYWB_37_2.zh: 本来今天要和弗洛洛进城的，嗯……要不等我们回来，让她去叫特莉丝回家？她的话一定可以。

yakita:Side_STDHYWB_41_3.chapter: 剧情_2_5_生态冒泡和碎片化_4_14

yakita:Side_STDHYWB_41_8.text: I thought Betty didn't want Phrolova to perform. The poor child was so upset she almost ran off from home.
yakita:Side_STDHYWB_41_8.zh: 她不是不同意弗洛洛去演出吗？气得那孩子差点离家出走。

yakita:Side_STDHYWB_41_9.chapter: 剧情_2_5_生态冒泡和碎片化_4_14

yakita:Side_STDHYWB_41_9.zh: 她那也不过是气话罢了。弗洛洛太有主见，从不习惯依赖什么，她心里不好受。

datamine:InfoDisplay_103012517_Text.title: Tune of Rocks
datamine:InfoDisplay_103012517_Text.text:
Who said music must be played by instrument?
During my time working in the mine, I kept hearing strange sounds. At first, I thought it was the rumored "sound" everyone talked about... But later on, I discovered that these strange sounds actually came from the minerals themselves, and even more astonishingly, they formed a unique tune!
The shape the Tacetite is cut into and the quality of the Tacetite both dictates how this tune goes.
I sorted through the recordings across the years and arranged them into a song, which is now known as “Tune of Rocks".
I don’t feel quite vigorous lately... But fortunately the Pioneer Association Radio has received the mastertape of “Tune of Rocks”. My wish has been fulfilled!
datamine:InfoDisplay_103012517_Text.zh:
谁说演奏一定要乐器！
在矿下工作的期间，我总能听到一些怪声，一开始还以为就是传闻所说的那个“声音”呢……但随后我发现，这些怪声其实是从黑石中传出的，更神奇的是，它们有自己的韵律！
黑石在被共振箱转化为鸣潮波时，其中部分频域是人耳可以捕捉到的。而黑石切割的形状、矿石的性质好坏，都会影响这段声波奏出不同的旋律。
我把这些年录下的声音整理了一下，重新编曲成了一首歌，就是这首《石之音》。
希望有一天，这种新型的演奏方式，可以获得大家的喜爱。

datamine:InfoDisplay_10900006_Text.title: Last Wish
datamine:InfoDisplay_10900006_Text.text:
As I grow old and reflect on my life, I am haunted by the regret of not fulfilling a legend someone once told me. They said that if the most important person in your life is willing to fulfill this legend, your relationship will be blessed by the heavens until death do you part. I missed my chance and have always felt like we were just passing through each other's lives.
But now, as I face my impending death with only regrets, I feel compelled to find the place where we promised to meet and fulfill the legend. Even though it may be too late for me, I hope this notice can reach young people who still have a chance to hold onto their loved ones. So please, kind lady at the Pioneer Association, share this unknown legend and perhaps someone can finally solve its mystery.
Under the crescent moon, we roam
On a screen court, stars dance and moan
Timeless, by this heart-shaped lake
Together, hand in hand we take
Starry-eyed, our love shall never break.
datamine:InfoDisplay_10900006_Text.zh:
过去，曾经有人告诉过我一个传说，只要和最重要的人完成这个传说，那么这份感情就会得到上天的祝福，至死不渝。
过去，曾经也有人愿意牵起我的手，但我错过了这一切，完全无视了对方的心意，我一直觉得我们不过是彼此人生的过客。
直到我老去，直到双手低垂什么也抓不住，直到双眼模糊什么也看不清，活着的意义已经所剩无几。
但唯独过去的遗憾让我无法坦然面对注定会到来的死亡，我有无论如何都想要完成的事情。
我想要寻找记忆中我们约定相遇的地方，去完成这个传说——即便我早已错过，但年轻人们，你们不一样……你们还有机会，去握紧身边的那个重要的人。
所以我拜托先行公约的那位小姐，为我张贴这则告示，将这个可能已经没人知道的传说告诉大家，希望有人能够解开这个谜题：
共游此夜，明月已过半
今州登高，游星荡屏庭
执手相携，与子沐心湖
星心相印，刹那共永远

datamine:InfoDisplay_11040112_Text.title: Windy Lighthouse Journal
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040112_Text.text:
...... There are a lot of rumors about it, not only from the outside world, but even within the Pioneer Association.
Since igniting an interest in it, I have gone through almost all the information left by previous generations, and have also gone to ask seniors who had taken up the task of investigating it, but nothing has been conclusive, leaving only a few memorized bits and pieces here and there.

"Above the windswept lighthouse is the star that lights the universe."
"Rarely do you see such a rejuvenated antiquity; it is, as those poets say, the lamp of civilization."
"This earth is drenched in Scar, but it has never given up on healing itself, and the light that comes on every night is its very manifestation in Recuperate, one breath, one breath, one breath ...... If one day this light ceases to shine, perhaps... ..."
"The lighthouse, the lighthouse! What exactly does it light up? The hope of light, or a dark, unknown mystery that leads to darkness?"
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040112_Text.zh:
……关于它的传言很多，不仅是外界，就连先行公约内部都有各种不同的说法。
自从点燃了对它的兴趣，我几乎翻阅了所有前人留下的资料，也去询问过曾接下调查任务的前辈，但都没有什么定论，只在这里留下一些有记忆的只言片语。

“风望灯塔之上，是点燃宇宙的星。”
“很少能见到这样焕发生机的古物，它就像那些诗人说的，是文明的灯。”
“这片大地浸满了伤痕，但它从未放弃过自愈，每晚亮起的光，正是它在愈合的表现，一呼一吸，一呼、一吸……如果有一天这光不再亮起，也许……”
“灯塔，灯塔！它亮起的究竟是什么？光明的希望，还是一个通往黑暗的，未知之谜？”

yakita:FavorGoods_150301_Content.text: Verina cherishes her Pioneer Association expedition goggles, remnants of a journey and warm memories like Starflower. Now useless for danger detection, they hold sentimental value to her.
yakita:FavorGoods_150301_Content.zh: 在先行公约时，探险队配发的护目镜，可以监测周围环境是否危险，现在已经不能使用了，但维里奈一直好好收藏。因为这代表着一段生活，一段旅途，一段星星花一样的温暖回忆。

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_6_1.text: A group is gathered around a plant in what appears to be a Pioneer Association office. You recognize Verina among them. A small note in the bottom right corner of the photo reads: Milestone achieved.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_6_1.zh: 照片右下角写着：阶段性成果留影。这似乎是先行公约的一间办公室？照片中的几人正围着一株植物合影，你在照片中还发现了维里奈。

yakita:GNNPC_HEIHAIC_10_4.text: That's probably what Platya felt like when she saw her hometown in a Sonoro… Maybe a nice meal will help cheer her up.
yakita:GNNPC_HEIHAIC_10_4.zh: 桔梗面对这个索诺拉中的穗波，心情大概也会这么复杂吧。改天请她好好吃一顿。

yakita:InfoDisplay_103000002_Text.text:
[…]

...After importing the target data into Tethys, the Stellar Matrix is assigned the designation No.

[…]

The Matrix's equatorial coordinates in the Tethys System range from 02h 11.6m to 03h 09.7m in right ascension, and from 10.11° to 7.18° in declination...

[…]

Detailed data on 1712α and 1712β has been submitted based on the conditions at the Port City of Guixu, as well as other reports under the BS 037/1 catalog.

[…]

I am uncertain why Tethys shows such interest in 1712α.

It might contain information about the Lament, but I cannot be sure.

[…]
yakita:InfoDisplay_103000002_Text.zh:
总第0595号（内）
提审人：提法雷特·费利克斯·格鲁克
BS 037/1/99388*
泰缇斯编号：K-125（已弃用）
——TOP SECRET——
……目标数据导入泰缇斯系统后，构成星图编号生成为1712号，星图在泰缇斯系统的赤道坐标系统的赤经位于02h 11.6m到03h 09.7m之间，赤纬在10.11°到7.18°之间……
根据观测，1712号星图至少拥有两颗超过2.0悲鸣星等的拟算恒星，也即目标数据源由至少两个准悲鸣级别的灾害摧毁，与实际情况相符。
关于1712α、1712β的详细数据，已经根据归墟港市的实际情况提交，同参BS 037/1 目录下的其他报告。已知其同时由严重的重力异常及非自然形成之有害植物共同构成……
1712α目前已呈稳定态，其质量、电荷、角动量参数已经上传至泰缇斯系统。
………………
…………
我不知道为什么泰缇斯系统对1712α这么感兴趣，也许这有助于我们解决悲鸣的问题，但我不能确定。
但实际情况是，我们已经有很多很多的人，在那座城市丢了性命，老布兰登，霍德，提利尔，纪月……

yakita:InfoDisplay_103001004_Text.text:
The Stellar Matrix of the Port City of Guixu displays the records of the final moments leading up to its destruction.
Make your way to the summit of the Central Tower. 
There you will find one of the sources of this city's Lament.
yakita:InfoDisplay_103001004_Text.zh:
……归墟港市星图记录了此地被毁灭前的一段时间。
请前往城市中心大厦的最高处。
那里埋藏着此座城市悲鸣的源头之一。

yakita:ItemInfo_42300070_BgDescription.text:
Once the symbol of the Port City of Guixu, it nearly went extinct when Incinero Petals were rampant.
However, at the outskirts of the city ruins, Belle Poppy was found to bloom still at its home, having endured the disaster.
yakita:ItemInfo_42300070_BgDescription.zh:
妙弋花曾是归墟港市的象征，在焚焰花肆虐时近乎绝迹。
但在城市废墟的外缘，人们发现仍有妙弋花顽强地绽放于故乡。

yakita:ItemInfo_71020001_BgDescription.text: A data chip picked up in the Port City of Guixu. Seems to be a battlefield record of a warrior.
yakita:ItemInfo_71020001_BgDescription.zh: 在归墟港市拾取的数据芯片，似乎是某位战士的战地记录。

yakita:Event_CSCSGSYD_1_8.chapter: 剧情_2.6黎那汐塔塔防活动引导任务_1_1
yakita:Event_CSCSGSYD_1_8.text: But due to the high risks that often come with the tasks, many Bloom Bearers gave their lives while performing their duties, just like... Niya and Hoda did in the previous Port City of Guixu incident.
yakita:Event_CSCSGSYD_1_8.zh: 但这些任务无比危险。有许多执花都在履行职责时不幸牺牲，就像……在之前归墟港市事件中牺牲的妮娅和霍德一样。
yakita:Event_CSCSGSYD_1_8.speaker: Valentina

yakita:Flow_106800000_5.zh: 原来如此，原来如此，那归墟港市空中的列车，还有这样一段有趣的故事！

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_15_12.text: You tell Monica what happened in the Port City of Guixu…

datamine:InfoDisplay_201001003_Text.title: Journal Page III
datamine:InfoDisplay_201001003_Text.text:
Day 17.

We waded through marshland to reach this waterlogged ruin, only to find more disappointment. The knights are losing faith—some doubt we'll ever find this so-called relic. Ennio, who's as close as family to me, stood against my decision to move on. He accused me of straying from the righteous path.

There was no other way to settle it; we dueled, as the knight's creed demands. He cast the gauntlets over to me, his mentor. Our duel ended amidst a strange howl from afar. When he fell, a part of me fell with him.

Ennio... He was set on the ideals of knighthood but was blind to the cold reality facing our branch of the family. I can feel it now—fortune and glory lie to the north. Porto-Veno Castle will have to honor our deeds.

At this point, there's no turning back.
datamine:InfoDisplay_201001003_Text.zh:
第17天。 

我们蹚过池沼，来到这座被水浸没的遗迹，仍然一无所获。骑士们焦躁不安，窃窃私语，怀疑所谓的圣物并不存在。当我宣布继续前进时，埃尼奥站了出来。这个我看着长大的年轻人公开反对我的决议，认为这已经背离了骑士的公义。

争论无法化解当下的局面， 唯有一场决斗可以，埃尼奥向我——他昔日的剑术老师扔来了手套。我们的决斗在一阵从远方传来的奇怪吼声中告结。当他倒在血泊里，我的心也死去了一部分。

埃尼奥……他眼里只有骑士的理想，却没认清家族旁系所面临的冰冷现实。只有向北方前进……我能感受到，梦寐以求的荣光和财富就在那个方向，波蒂维诺堡必将承认我们的功绩。

事到如今，已经无法回头了。

Subject A038 has been assigned to a 6m x 6m x 6m artificial controllable Tacet Field.

datamine:InfoDisplay_101400003_Text.zh:
编号：SY-A038
日期：[---]
实验环境：
实验序号A038一直被收容于6m × 6m × 6m的人工可控无音区中,每天需间隔6小时检查无音区环境的稳定性。相关实验人员进入环境时严禁携带超过标准频率的设备工具，以防止对实验对象造成干扰。

记录内容：
初步观测，由人工无音区诞生的A038残象已能稳定存活.该实验残象尚未呈现具体的形态特征或模拟发声行为，不具形体，只能通过特殊手段进行观测。
根据实验记录，A038目前没有明确的行为目的。无音区环境中的检测器显示其运动轨迹几乎与原点重合，大部分时间处于静止状态，攻击性和活性较低。行为表现与之前的预期出现差异性，尚待进一步研究。
此外，A038在实验中对频率敏感度较高，需严格控制实验环境频率使用标准。
鉴于实验对象A038的特殊性质，我们需要更多时间来重新确立对应的参数与数据语言，以更深入地解析其个体信息。基于我们目前所掌握的技术和相关资料，这项工作可能需要一段时间来完成。

注意：强调严禁以任何传播途径向外界泄露实验信息。若无海森教授许可，严禁私自制造实验对象的照片、录像。

此次实验记录仅为初步观察阶段的记录，我们将持续进行进一步的实验和分析，以获取更多关于实验对象A038的信息。

datamine:InfoDisplay_101400005_Text.title: Memo Recording: A038
datamine:InfoDisplay_101400005_Text.text:
[…]

Even Professor Heisen said he's going back to be with his family...

[…]

Metal parts now adorn its once simple form: steel plates, cogs, clocks, detection devices, blue liquids, white lab coats...

[…]

I can see it...

It’s the Gate we've been searching for.

[…]

My body, it’s so soft now… like water...

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_101400005_Text.zh:
日期：[--08]
实验已经进行到了最后阶段了，但大家似乎都放慢了脚步，越来越多的同事突然就消失不见了。海森教授也说他要回去陪家人了。是吧？我总隐隐约约记得他曾向我提到过，可是，是在什么时候呢？更像是他对我的某种耳语。
漫长的夜晚里，也只有这个小家伙陪着我。
不知不觉，它已经长到这么大了。它的身上多了好多金属零件，钢板，齿轮，时钟，巨型钻头，检测仪，探照灯，蓝色的液体、白色的实验服……嗯？那一块是柴油发电机吗？算了，总之，现在我终于能不借助观测装置看见它了。
今天的你意外的很好动呢。啊，想来，自你诞生之日起，便一直被关在这片牢笼之中，一定也很渴望自由吧。
唉，实验室难得这么安静，姑且破个例，应该没人会发现吧。
原来，你的身体……触碰起来是这种感觉。
你是在笑吗？这还是第一次听你发声，不过这笑声总有些熟悉呢，挺像我的同事朋友呢。
啊，原来……我们一直要寻找的门扉……就在这里……
怎么感觉有些晕晕的呢，身体软绵绵的，像是装满了水，好像不属于自己了。
身体和意识……好像都飘起来了……这个感觉……
你们也都在这里呀……原来你们都已步入了那道门扉……
“不要……跨过……”
你们……在说什么……？
不……不对……
我们所见过的神迹，绝非如此……

datamine:InfoDisplay_11890105_Text.title: Research Memo A038
datamine:InfoDisplay_11890105_Text.text:
[…]

The TD numbered A038 has survived the artificial Tacet Field.

[…]

I have to stare at this dark mass all night long.

It neither moves nor makes a sound, making the nights even more tedious than my stern supervisor.

To maintain stability in the Tacet Field, Professor Heisen had removed all the clocks.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_11890105_Text.zh:
日期：[--25]
我们成功了，实验序号为A038的残象在人工无音区中存活了下来，虽然结果有些差强人意，但现在不是挑剔的时候了。
值班的日子可太难熬了，要一晚上盯着这团黑乎乎的家伙，它既不会动，也不会发声，简直比我导师板着脸还要无趣。而且为了不影响无音区的稳定性，教授还把所有时钟拆掉了，唉，每一分每一秒都过的好漫长啊。平时亲切的海森教授这次意外的很严格啊，从实验开始后，就没怎么见他笑过了。对了，上次有位研究员误把超过标准频率的工具带进了实验环境闹出了好大的动静，整个研究所都拉响了警报，好在无音区和A038似乎没有受到太大的影响，但那团物质体型似乎变大了一点儿，我想，应该没有影响吧？不过那可是我第一次见海森教授发脾气的样子。
好了，今天就写到这里吧。当前还有很多问题需要解决，重新确立的参数和数据语言几乎得全部手打，大家都忙疯了，不过也没有人抱怨。也是，不加班，我们这群天才和疯子又能去哪了？

datamine:InfoDisplay_11890106_Text.title: Research Memo A038
datamine:InfoDisplay_11890106_Text.text:
[…]

Professor Heisen said some of them took leave to spend time with their families, while others decided to take a long vacation before returning.

[…]

So many mechanical parts and metal chunks have appeared on you.

[…]

The body feels so faint it seems a bag of water, not mine.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_11890106_Text.zh:
日期：[--08]
实验已经进行到了最后阶段了，但大家似乎都懒惰了下来，越来越多的同事突然就消失不见了，海森教授说他们有的请假回去陪家人了，有的决定休个长假再回来。这可一点儿都不像他们的风格，大家之前可是为了研究连睡觉都顾不上了。唉，算了，难得这么安静，漫长的夜晚也只有这团黑乎乎的大家伙陪着我，不知道从什么时候开始，你都已经变得这么大了，也会在四周游动了，身上还多了好多机械金属，那一块是柴油发电机吗？总觉得好像在哪里见过……
嗯？总感觉今天有些晕晕的呢，身体软绵绵的，像是装满了水，好像不属于自己了。
今天的你意外的很好动呢，嗯？没想到你还有这样的形态呢，之前的记录里都没看到过，这一定又是新的发现吧，先用个人备忘录记录下来吧。
黑色的球体状分裂开来，里面似乎还藏着某些东西，钢板，齿轮，时钟，巨型钻头，检测仪，探照灯，蓝色的液体，手术钳，厚厚的书本，白色实验服、融化了的糖果、可爱的猫、电子屏幕，还有那，像人类躯体的物质。
全都是实验基地的东西呢，我想起来了，就连那块柴油发电机也是。
你是在笑吗？这还是第一次听你发声，不过这笑声总有些熟悉呢，挺像我的同事朋友呢。
总感觉身体和意识……

yakita:InfoDisplay_101400004_Text.text:
[…]

Research on the Retroact Rain has entered its second phase, yet contrary to expectations, there's been no progress whatsoever.

Perhaps everyone, including Professor Heisen, has questioned if we're doing it wrong.

But all evidence points to the fact that "it" has indeed visited the Whining Aix's Mire.

[…]

And to maintain the stability of the Tacet Field, all clocks were removed.

[…]
yakita:InfoDisplay_101400004_Text.zh:
日期：[--25]
实验室里的雨远比怨鸟泽的雷雨还要连绵，整整下了四年十一个月零二天。
第一次看见悬停雨幕时的惊喜感，已经逐渐被成员们的绝望所淹没。失落与沮丧也如阴雨般在实验室内弥漫，滋生出不少青苔。
在这种潮湿的环境下工作，对于我们的身体和心灵来说都是一种巨大的考验。我们针对溯洄雨的研究早已进入了第二阶段，本以为一切能够顺利进行下去，但却始终没能取得进一步的成果。
包括海森教授在内，所有人都在怀疑，我们的方向是否是选错了？
我们手头已知的种种证据都表明，他们的确曾来到过怨鸟泽。这也是我们迁址于此的原因之一。
而我们想做的，无非是通过溯洄雨的“溯洄”功能，再一次复现神迹，求得启示。
即使消沉，即使怀疑，即使争论不休，我们的研究还是要继续下去。但，我们的时间已经不足以支持我们在一条道路上走到黑了。
我们不得不启动我们的“第二计划”。
这一切都是值得的吗？坦白来说，我不确定。海森教授曾经说过，这是一项风险极大的实验，但一旦成功，它将为我们的实验项目带来飞跃性的进展。
可我们已经失败了37次，37名研究员因此失去了生命。
终于，实验序号为A038的对象在人工无音区中存活了下来。这一成果是突破性的，但我们都并未因此感到过多的喜悦。
因为我们都清楚——它是我们所创造的“仿制品”，是对“神”再拙劣不过的模仿。
值班的日子可太难熬了。因为人手有限，我也是唯一还在这里值班的成员了。要一晚上盯着这团看不见的家伙，它既不会动，也不会发声，简直比我导师板着脸还要无趣。而且为了不影响无音区的稳定性，教授还把所有时钟拆掉了，唉，每一分每一秒都过的好漫长啊。平时亲切的海森教授这次意外的很严格啊，从实验开始后，就没怎么见他笑过了。对了，上次有位研究员误把超过标准频率的工具带进了实验环境闹出了好大的动静，整个研究所都拉响了警报，好在无音区和A038似乎没有受到太大的影响，但那团物质体型似乎变大了一点儿，我想，应该没有影响吧？不过那可是我第一次见海森教授发脾气的样子。
好了，今天就写到这里吧。当前还有很多问题需要解决，重新确立的参数和数据语言几乎得全部手打，大家都忙疯了，不过也没有人抱怨。毕竟，这里是我…

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_28_1.text: Promeus, you said we held the reins of progress in our hands.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_28_1.zh: 普罗米厄，您曾说时代进步的主动权掌握在我们手中。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_27.text: You were thinking about Promeus and the Resonator War, weren't you? I can tell something about it is bothering you.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_27.zh: 你刚刚是在思考普罗米厄和共鸣者战争的事情吧，放不下心来？
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_27.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_10.text: One moment... That's strange. There's only one note about Promeus in Tethys's records.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_10.zh: 稍等……奇怪，泰缇斯系统对祂在内战中的记录只有短短一句——
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_10.speaker: Shorekeeper

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_21.text: I want to see for myself what happened with Promeus and that war.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_21.zh: 普罗米厄与共鸣者战争的事情我要亲自去确认一下。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_35.text: "During the Resonator War, Promeus took no action."
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_35.zh: 普罗米厄在共鸣者战争中，未采取任何行动。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_35.speaker: Shorekeeper

datamine:InfoDisplay_31000026_Text.title: Torn Page
datamine:InfoDisplay_31000026_Text.text:
[…]

My father told me I'm a child of the Qichi Village, and I should consider myself lucky.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_31000026_Text.zh:
3.12
你好，我是■■，我们搬到新家已经二个月了！
这是村长尗又尗又送给我的心本子，尗又尗又告诉我，可以在上面记下来，中要的事。
以前的家，被可怕的怪物占领，所以我们走了很久，找到了第二个家
我问尗又尗又，爸爸妈妈什么时候可以赶上我们，尗又尗又说，他们很快就赶上来找我，我希望爸爸妈妈可以快点来新家。
这里很票亮，有很大的桃花树，城里很闹，虽然大家很少去。
爸爸妈妈快点找到我，是我最中要的事。
……
12.5
今天是■■的生日。
大家都对我很好，说我是大家的护身符，因为我可以让那些怪物离得远远的。我很开心，大家都喜欢我。今天吃了蛋糕、长寿面，还收到了礼物。已经很久很久没有看到爸爸妈妈了，他们还会回来吗？
……
12.5
这是我在这里度过的第四个生日，村长正式收养了我作为养女……虽然在这之前，我也是由大家挨个照顾、吃百家饭长大的，父亲告诉我，我是祈池村的孩子，我应该为自己能够作为”祈池村的孩子“诞生而感到庆幸。
能够被那么多人爱着，我真的感到很幸运。尽管我的力量还很微小……但我会尽自己的能力！继续保护祈池村不受到残象的侵害！

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_64_15.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第四幕_奔策候残星_1_7
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_64_15.text: Your investigation continues. The tragedy that befell the village starts to unravel and Scar persists in trying to sway your judgment.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_64_15.zh: 随着调查的继续，你逐渐意识到祈池村的悲剧缘何而起。伤痕继续向你絮语，企图动摇你的想法。

yakita:Flow_311000012_62.chapter: 剧情_虎口生态_NPC_集散中心_4_1
yakita:Flow_311000012_62.text: Ah, I'm sorry. I'm just a little scared to talk to strangers. Actually... I'm doing anti-fraud publicity.
yakita:Flow_311000012_62.zh: 啊，对不起，我只是有点儿害怕和陌生人说话，其实……我是在做反诈宣传。
yakita:Flow_311000012_62.speaker: Qifan

yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_10_2.text: If Paragon Qingxiao hadn't been there, I shudder to think what might have happened.
yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_10_2.zh: 若不是有清宵司骑助阵，后果可就难说了。

yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_19_2.text: I did. And we all heard Paragon Qingxiao's voice too.
yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_19_2.zh: 看到了。大家不是还听到清宵司骑的声音了吗？

yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_40_1.text: Grandfather, I saw the great Lady Qingxiao again.
yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_40_1.zh: 爷爷，我又看到清宵姐姐了。

yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_40_2.text: Hah! Your imagination's outpaced the truth again, boy. As if you'd run into Paragon Qingxiao.
yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_40_2.zh: 去去，吹牛不打草稿，清宵司骑哪是你能老看见的。

yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_46_3.text: I've told you about her. Daoist Master Jiufeng's favorite disciple? She has a history with Qingxiao the Perfected.
yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_46_3.zh: 就是那位九峰道长的爱徒啊，我跟你讲过的。她和清宵真人有一段渊源。

yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_50_2.text: I've seen Paragon Qingxiao twice just recently. That's got to be a lucky omen.
yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_50_2.zh: 最近我见到了足足两次清宵司骑，绝对会走好运的。

yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_60_1.text: Hello there. I remember you were dining with Paragon Qingxiao earlier.
yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_60_1.zh: 你好啊，我记得之前清宵司骑是和你在同一桌吃饭的。

yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH_10_14.text: Sent a copy to Qingxiao too. She seemed pretty happy after seeing it.
yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH_10_14.zh: 我也给清宵发了一份哦，她收到后似乎心情很好。

yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH_120_1.text: Wait... Is that Qingxiao the Transcendent I'm seeing?
yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH_120_1.zh: 咦，刚才……我是看到了清宵仙子吗？

yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH_21_5.text: Of course. If the Rafter Kite hadn't brought Paragon Qingxiao at the time, us kids would've been swept away in the flood.
yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH_21_5.zh: 当然了。当年要不是梁鸢叫来了清宵真人，我们这几个小孩可都要被山洪冲走喽。

yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH_80_1.text: Paragon Qingxiao, 漂泊者, I wish you both a safe journey.
yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH_80_1.zh: 清宵真人，漂泊者，祝你们一路平安啊。

yakita:GNNPC_TGBST_31_8.text: I ran into Paragon Qingxiao on a job. When she stepped off her flying sword, I thought something was wrong, but she just stopped to ask me for directions.
yakita:GNNPC_TGBST_31_8.zh: 我在出外勤时见到了清宵司骑，她从飞剑上下来时，我还以为出了什么事，原来只是找我问路啊。

yakita:QingXiao_Shengtai_1_20.text: Qingxiao, are you... inviting me into your inner landscape?
yakita:QingXiao_Shengtai_1_20.zh: 清宵，你想……邀请我去你的内景？
yakita:QingXiao_Shengtai_1_20.speaker: Rover

yakita:QingXiao_Shengtai_3_22.text: How do you feel now, Qingxiao? And your Inner Demon... is she taken care of?
yakita:QingXiao_Shengtai_3_22.zh: 清宵，你现在身体情况怎么样了？心魔的事……彻底解决了吗？
yakita:QingXiao_Shengtai_3_22.speaker: Rover

yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_640_1.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第二幕_玄方城生态_3_2
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_640_1.text: With everything that's happened lately, why hasn't Paragon Qingxiao shown herself yet?
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_640_1.zh: 唉，最近出了这么大的事，清宵真人怎么还没露面……

yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_650_1.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第二幕_玄方城生态_4_10
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_650_1.text: Commander, have you heard anything from Paragon Qingxiao?
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_650_1.zh: 卫长，清宵司骑有消息了吗……？

yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_690_4.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第二幕_玄方城生态_3_4
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_690_4.text: Hey... it's going to be alright. Paragon Qingxiao was there when it happened. She... she will definitely keep them safe.
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_690_4.zh: 别……别担心，他们被困的时候，清宵司骑也在那里，她……一定会护他们无事的。

yakita:ZYHSGST_14_3.text: But I heard Paragon Qingxiao can summon countless swords hundreds of meters tall! I'd say she's got a fighting chance.
yakita:ZYHSGST_14_3.zh: 听说清宵司骑还能唤出无数柄百米高的长剑呢！我倒是觉得不是全无胜算。

yakita:EVENT_XYJLN_11_8.text: I have just received it from the Zhaoming Commerce Guild. Freshly picked, still rich with fragrance.
yakita:EVENT_XYJLN_11_8.zh: 是昭明商会派人送来的，都是刚采摘的好茶，香气浓郁。
yakita:EVENT_XYJLN_11_8.speaker: Qingxiao

yakita:EVENT_XYJLN_31_5.text: Let us meet again at the Western Fang Peaks tomorrow. The next section of the piece awaits.
yakita:EVENT_XYJLN_31_5.zh: 明日在方擎西峰相见吧，我会将下一段琴曲教给你。
yakita:EVENT_XYJLN_31_5.speaker: Qingxiao

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_280_1.text: A Xuanfang Hold with no Sentinel, but a Transcendent who preaches mechanist arts...
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_280_1.zh: 这座玄方城没有岁主，却有一位传授机关术的仙人……
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_280_1.speaker: Qingxiao

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_340_4.text: 漂泊者, Paragon Qingxiao... It's been so long...
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_340_4.zh: 漂泊者……清宵司骑……这么久了……
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_340_4.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_341_10.text: Please, Qingxiao. You both have to keep going.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_341_10.zh: 清宵，拜托你们了，请继续前进吧。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_24.text: ...Xuanfang Hold and its people will survive.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_391_24.speaker: Qingxiao

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_418_3.text: Promise me, Qingxiao. No more carrying everything alone.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_418_3.zh: 清宵，答应我，以后别再一个人硬撑了。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_418_3.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_420_1.text: (The cabin has been affected by the fog. Qingxiao...)
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_420_1.zh: （这舱室似乎受到了雾气的影响……清宵……）
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_420_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_50_24.text: ...From now on, please just call me Qingxiao.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_50_24.speaker: Qingxiao

yakita:Character_YinLin_75_3.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_吟霖线新_102_1
yakita:Character_YinLin_75_3.text: Thank you, Miss Yinlin! It's just a scratch... Nothing to worry about.
yakita:Character_YinLin_75_3.zh: 感激不尽！在下这只是小伤……不用记挂。
yakita:Character_YinLin_75_3.speaker: Quxiu

yakita:LoadingTipsText_609001_TipsText.text:
Named after Scott Rabelle, the founder of Resonance Curve Theory and inventor of the Rabelle's Curve, this college—also known as the Synchronist Department—identifies and trains Synchronists through uncompromisingly rigorous, data-driven methods. 
Access to Rabelle College requires special authorization and is ordinarily closed to students from other departments.
yakita:LoadingTipsText_609001_TipsText.zh:
共鸣曲线理论缔造者，拉贝尔曲线发明人史考特·拉贝尔之名命名的学部，又名适格者学部。致力于以绝对严谨、量化的手段，发掘、培育适格者。
拉贝尔学部需要通行权限才可进入，平日不对其他学部的学生开放。

yakita:XJXYDTK_24_7.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院中枢电梯生态_25_1
yakita:XJXYDTK_24_7.text: And don't let the names scare you—it's all just marketing.
yakita:XJXYDTK_24_7.zh: 而且不要被它们的名字吓到，这只是我们的一种营销手段啦。
yakita:XJXYDTK_24_7.speaker: Rafah

yakita:GNNPC_AGLXZ_8_8.chapter: 剧情_拂风水畔_人文生态_2_3
yakita:GNNPC_AGLXZ_8_8.text: He's taken a two-month leave to visit Ragunna City. If business slows down a bit, I can manage the inn by myself.
yakita:GNNPC_AGLXZ_8_8.zh: 他向我请了两个月的假，打算去拉古那看看。如果生意清淡点，我一个人也忙得过来。

yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_19_3.chapter: 剧情_七丘_列奥尼达广场生态_5_3
yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_19_3.text: The one who can quiet every child in Ragunna City—
yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_19_3.zh: 能让整个拉古那城的小孩停止啼哭的——

yakita:LGNCZST_103_6.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_市中心生态_1_13
yakita:LGNCZST_103_6.text: The well was once blessed by the Sentinel. Back when Ragunna City was founded, people used to get their fresh water from it. There are also legends that say the well is bottomless, which connects to the depths of the ocean...
yakita:LGNCZST_103_6.zh: 圣井曾得岁主赐福，在拉古那城刚建立之时，人们通过它得以饮用淡水。还有传说说，圣井深不见底，其根源直通大海渊底……

yakita:LGNCZST_110_11.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_14
yakita:LGNCZST_110_11.text: I want to remind you that recent Tacet Discord activities outside Ragunna City have increased. If you plan to venture into the wild to collect Echoes, please be careful.
yakita:LGNCZST_110_11.zh: 我想提醒您，最近拉古那城外的残象活动变得活跃了，您如果要前往野外收集声骸，务必小心。
yakita:LGNCZST_110_11.speaker: Tulio

yakita:LGNCZST_110_6.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_14
yakita:LGNCZST_110_6.text: The function of the Servitude Hall is to regularly purge the Tacet Discords around Ragunna City, maintain the surrounding safety, and expand the frequency reserves within the Genesis Nexus Data Bank.
yakita:LGNCZST_110_6.zh: 驱役所的职能，便是定期对拉古那城周边的残象进行清剿，维护周边安全，扩充起源信标数据坞内的频率储备。
yakita:LGNCZST_110_6.speaker: Tulio

yakita:LGNCZST_111_1.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_自由广场生态_1_15
yakita:LGNCZST_111_1.text: Recently, the Tacet Discord activity outside Ragunna City has become more active. If you plan to venture into the wild to collect Echoes, please be careful.
yakita:LGNCZST_111_1.zh: 最近拉古那城外的残象活动变得活跃了，您如果要前往野外收集声骸，务必小心。
yakita:LGNCZST_111_1.speaker: Tulio

yakita:LGNCZST_45_3.text: And I was wondering why Ragunna City reeks of money and snobs these days.
yakita:LGNCZST_45_3.zh: 那就不奇怪了，我还在纳闷，怎么这拉古那城里，净是一股不甚优雅的铜臭味道。

yakita:LGNCZST_58_12.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_市中心生态_1_12
yakita:LGNCZST_58_12.text: Have you seen anyone in Ragunna City acting like those characters in the play, brawling and openly breaking the law?
yakita:LGNCZST_58_12.zh: 你在拉古那城看到过像戏里那样，动不动就打架，还公开做违法买卖的家伙吗？

yakita:LGNCZST_67_1.chapter: 剧情_拉古纳_新贵族生态_1_7
yakita:LGNCZST_67_1.text: The route between Ragunna and the Riccioli Islands has been less than peaceful recently.
yakita:LGNCZST_67_1.zh: 拉古那和黎乔利群岛之间的航线最近不是很太平。

yakita:LKKST_1_13.text: Oh, and thanks to you, we've been granted the chance to perform in Ragunna City.
yakita:LKKST_1_13.zh: 对了，托你的福，现在我们已经可以在拉古那城里演出了。
yakita:LKKST_1_13.speaker: Roccia

yakita:NPC_LNXTMDST_26_2.text: I just want to return to Ragunna City… My belongings are still there, left behind in the rush.
yakita:NPC_LNXTMDST_26_2.zh: 我想回拉古那城……我的家产还在城里，还没来得及带走……

datamine:InfoDisplay_120101044_Text.title: "The Golden Anthem Anthology"
datamine:InfoDisplay_120101044_Text.text:
Do not bring flowers to my grave, for I am not there, bound under this tombstone.
I am in the sea winds at Ragunna's walls. I am dawning lights that break through thorns.
I am a night hawk of wings aflame, soaring towards the Celestial Steed, whose praises I sing and whose true form I behold.
The night sky will be illuminated by wings aflame, and I shall be reborn in immortal poetry.
So long as people draw breath, lift your eyes and see: so long as this poem lives, it breathes life into me.
——End

Looking back at what I wrote in the preface:
This anthology is attributed to the Golden Anthem. We wish these poems might offer a glimmer of hope to those lost in fate's journey, and to readers something to contemplate.
Gather these scattered golden syllables, as they are treasures tempered by fire, and lingering sparks of human thought.
And finally, thank you for opening this book.
datamine:InfoDisplay_120101044_Text.zh:
不必在我的墓前献上鲜花，我不会长眠于此，囚禁于石碑之下。
我将化作海风，掠过水畔吹向拉古那的高墙；我将化作曙光，于荆棘谷中破晓而出。
我将成为可摘星辰的夜鹰，燃烧羽翼，朝着天马座高歌飞行，一睹它的真容。
夜空将被燃烧的羽翼点亮，我将重生于这不朽的诗篇。
只要一息尚存，抬头用眼去看。我的生命将随这首诗海枯石烂。
                                                                                                        ——终
回到卷首语我所写的话：
此诗集由「黄金之歌」所著，愿此诗能予以命运迷途之人一些微光，愿阅读者有所思考。
请拾起这些散落的鎏金音节，它们是淬火后的珠宝，也是人文思想遗落的火种。
最后，感谢你们能打开这本书。

datamine:InfoDisplay_120101047_Text.title: Manuscripts Excerpt
datamine:InfoDisplay_120101047_Text.text:
"...
Swept away by the storm are the cicadas of the Water Kingdom,
Wheat straws lay adrift in the village's oaken wine mugs.
Prolonged nights of Summer,
Lost souls, wander between streets and alleys.

Withered leaves fall into autumn's abyssal tranquility,
Rust of decay form on utensils of holy communion.
Desolate winds of Autumn,
Acolytes measure the inclination of Divinity with rotten scales.

Frost cover pupils of stained glass,
The confessional fills with silent ash.
Sleepless night of Winter,
A wandering bard holds a frozen lute,
Playing sounds that never reach.

With our bodies to fuel the fire, the ensuing inferno shall forge Ragunna's true gold.
Like the fire that dragged them to hell, these Daemons will spread throughout the land and burn all of Ragunna.
Let this sail take us past the towers, past the surrounding walls, and past the Sentinel's sculptures, as we descend silently into hell.
Till this song drowns into the brilliance of the sunset.
..."
datamine:InfoDisplay_120101047_Text.zh:

水上之国的蝉鸣被风暴洗净，
乡村的麦浪在橡木酒杯中沉浮。
夏日长夜，
迷途之人于街巷徘徊。

枯叶坠入秋寂的深渊，
圣餐盘上生出腐烂的铁锈。
秋风寂寥，
教士们用腐烂的天平丈量神明倾斜的角度。

冰霜覆盖了彩窗的瞳孔，
告解室积满沉默的灰烬。
冬日难眠，
流浪的诗人抱着冻僵的鲁特琴，
弹奏着遥不可及之声。

烈火将淬炼出拉古那的真金，吾等便是万千柴薪之一。
这「亡灵」如同把他们带入地狱的火苗，不断蔓延，终将烧却整个拉古那。
就让这船带着我们漂过塔楼，漂过圆墙、漂过岁主的雕塑，无声地向地狱坠落。
待这歌流入落日的璀璨。

datamine:InfoDisplay_121000006_Text.title: The Unknown Wine List
datamine:InfoDisplay_121000006_Text.text:
[…]

In Ragunna, becoming a lover of spirits is far easier than steering clear of them.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_121000006_Text.zh:
在拉古那，成为一个嗜酒的酒徒可比滴酒不沾容易得多。
一个配方对应一个故事，一个故事交换一杯酒水……你总能找到能取悦自己的选择，只要你真的清楚酒的秘语。

*那么，这是一张关于莫塔里的酒单
*酒水和简介一览

“蓝调时刻”
嘿，我这有一笔好买卖想和你谈谈。只是，必须要等到天黑以后它才能被正大光明提起。

“血色曼波”
烧灼的疼痛，溢出的温热，被麻痹的神经。
你不是在对抗什么庞然巨物，你只是在与生活中的苦难厮杀。
敬我们的英雄一杯酒吧，你至少值得这么一杯酒。

“鎏金岁月”
被滞留的过往经过幽长的发酵，才化作你喉头的这股甘甜。
你会咋舌，你会喟叹，然后忍不住再来一口，向我感叹那段回不来的好时光。
这种时候，我是你最好的听众。

“缄默法则”
所有莫塔里人需要遵守的第一法则，与家人一样被刻在骨血里不能忘却的。
很遗憾你点了这款酒，看来有人需要得到警告。

*是的，你应该注意到了，上面没有价格，请别讶异，这里的酒水不以金钱衡量价值。
*在合适的时机，带着合适的人来我这里，请记得，拉古那的吧台永远向所有想要点单的人敞开。

datamine:InfoDisplay_121000007_Text.title: Ordinary Wine List
datamine:InfoDisplay_121000007_Text.text:

In Ragunna, becoming a lover of spirits is far easier than steering clear of them.

datamine:InfoDisplay_121000007_Text.zh:
在拉古那，成为一个嗜酒的酒徒可比滴酒不沾容易得多。
一个配方对应一个故事，一个故事交换一杯酒水……你总能找到能取悦自己的选择，只要你真的清楚酒的秘语。

*那么，这是一张关于拉古那的酒单
*酒水和简介一览

“当她步入花园”
吹拂而来的欢欣，萦绕我与你的那份温热……带我去欣赏你盛放的花吧。
幻想的大门就此打开，让我看看那饱满而低垂的花蕾。
交叠的呢喃和絮语使头脑昏沉，放纵、享乐……那不正是你想要的？

“爱情与灵药”
听我说，听我说，药剂和情爱有什么差别？
它们都能带来幻觉，都能疗愈人心，都能带来疼痛。

“惊魂夜”
你要不是醉得不轻，怎么会想要来一杯这个？
你在渴求什么？一个好心人、一位圣人、一只天使？好的，你已经传达了求救的信号。

“皇帝的新装”
这是你能想到最划算的酒水，虽然杯肚看上去空空荡荡什么的都没有。
带着它去什么都有的同桌人那里拼一单吧……这样就有两个喝饱的人了。

“TF10”
真实或谎言，0或1。
共饮这样一杯酒的期间，我们必须保证我们所言非虚，我们向对方袒露无遗。


*是的，你应该注意到了，上面没有价格，请别讶异，这里的酒水不以金钱衡量价值。
*在合适的时机，带着合适的人来我这里，请记得，拉古那的吧台永远向所有想要点单的人敞开。

datamine:InfoDisplay_121000008_Text.title: Casually Jotted Down Snack List
datamine:InfoDisplay_121000008_Text.text:
Feeling a bit tired of drinks? Ragunna's bars also offer a selection of delightful snacks to refresh your palate.
Unlike those drinks full of "codes," these are snacks are simple—and complimentary with drinks.

Snacks and Descriptions

*St. Domingo Chocolate
Smooth and rich, this chocolate teases your taste buds with the bittersweet harmony of orange jam and wine, leaving a lingering aftertaste.

*Earl Grey Cake
The black tea-infused base, combined with the refreshing scent of citrus, delivers a mellow flavor that lingers without a hint of bitterness.

*Wine-Soaked Cherry Sabayon
Ripe, crimson cherries bathed in a creamy blend of eggs and sweet wine, lightly caramelized for a smoky finish.
The dance of warm and cold, sweet and fresh, tipsy and revitalizing… an unforgettable harmony of flavors.

Thank you for your generosity and patronage.
datamine:InfoDisplay_121000008_Text.zh:
如果对酒水感到厌烦，拉古那的吧台同样有一些解腻的小点心。
不同于那些掺杂秘语的酒水，它们真的只是小点心，随酒水附赠的小点心。

*点心和简介一览

*圣多明戈巧克力
入口醇厚，唇齿间是夹杂着橙子酱香和酒香的微苦，却又让人回味无穷‌。

*格雷伯爵蛋糕
红茶基底配合柑橘的清新香气，味道浓密绵长，毫无涩感。

*酒渍樱桃沙巴翁
鸡蛋混合奶油、甜酒，浇在饱满红润的樱桃之上，再加上微微烤过后散发出来焦香。
冷与热，甜蜜与新鲜，微醺与清冽……这味道实在令人迷醉。

*感谢您的慷慨和惠顾。

datamine:InfoDisplay_160000008_Text.title: Audio Log 1
datamine:InfoDisplay_160000008_Text.text:
[…]

Imagine the uproar it would cause in Ragunna if I wrote about its secrets and published them!

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_160000008_Text.zh:
这是我进入黑街的第五天。这里的人都很警觉，他们就像是在害怕着什么一样。当然啦，他们什么也不肯对我说。
黑街，对于拉古那人来说是个相当神秘的地方。年轻人根本不知道它的存在，老人们都将这里视为禁忌。想想看，如果我能够把这里的秘密写成稿件，发表在报纸上，会在拉古那引起多大的轰动！
我找到了一个好心人——大家都说他是个中间人，虽然不知道他背后到底站着谁。在他的慷慨帮助下，我成功进入了黑街，得以接触这个神秘之地的第一手资料。
我前三天的调查基本上一无所获。不过，我和一个叫布兰登的年轻人混熟了，他似乎在这里住了很久。我和他是在打台球的时候认识的，说实话，他的球技很不错，是个不错的对手——只要他不耍诈的话。上次打台球的时候我挂在旁边的外套突然开始冒烟，还好我及时把它扑灭了。但等我回来一看，他已经趁我不在“打”进了三颗球。
虽然布兰登对黑街的事情也绝口不提，而且总是心事重重的样子，但我觉得他会成为我这场短暂采访中的一个良好突破口。他不像那些老人那么执拗，也不像那些戴面具的家伙那么不好说话。我不知道那些面具人到底是什么来路，不过，我觉得我总有一天会搞明白的。
说起来，布兰登已经有两天没露过面了。也许他是去照顾那些饥饿的老人了。如同我之前调查到的一样，黑街的人们靠打零工谋生，所以他们很难获取到足够的食物，布兰登总是把自己的口粮分给他们。
不管布兰登到底去哪了，他总会回来打台球的。我觉得我在这里等着他就好。

datamine:InfoDisplay_160000011_Text.title: Audio Log 2
datamine:InfoDisplay_160000011_Text.text:
[…]

Everyone here seems indifferent to these disappearances.

They're not even remotely curious about where those people went, or what fate they'll suffer.

[…]

As for those masks, I'm now certain they're working for some bigshot who recently showed up in the Black Alley.

They occasionally leave to return to Ragunna City.

[…]

Thugs.

They were in one helluva celebratory mood talking about the "rebirth of the Black Alley." Whoever their boss is, she seems to be planning on making her fortune through crime.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_160000011_Text.zh:
不光是布兰登，还有更多的人莫名其妙地消失了。如果不是我在学校里学会了如何速记别人的长相，也许会很容易忽略这个细节。
因为这里的每个人看起来都对这些失踪事件无动于衷。他们不好奇那些人去了哪里，他们将遭受怎么样的命运，他们只是麻木地干着自己的事，忍受着日渐变少的食物配给。
那些戴面具的人——我现在可以确认，他们是黑街最近来的某个大人物的手下，他们偶尔会离开黑街，到拉古那城里去。我不敢接近他们，但我有一次在他们集会时偶尔听到了一些东西……他们是一群罪犯，一群暴徒。他们兴高采烈地谈论着“复兴黑街”的大计划，不管他们背后那个大人物到底是谁，她似乎都打算通过犯罪来弄到一大笔资金。
但之后呢？复兴黑街之后呢？我不知道。说实话，我自认为我还是个比较有勇气的人，但我确实打从心底感到害怕。害怕那个大人物，害怕她的计划……我现在只想离开这里，让诫令院派人解决这些罪犯。
今天有一个令我意外的发现，我不知道这算是好消息还是坏消息。我在通风井附近的通道里找到了一个身份牌，黑街的居民用它们来证明彼此的身份，那个身份牌，是属于布兰登的。
他是不是已经遭遇不测了？也许……他留下那个身份牌是为了指引我？抑或警告我？那些戴面具的家伙盯得太紧，我没法直接逃出去。也许布兰登有什么办法，我得去找他。

datamine:InfoDisplay_21010004_Text.title: The History of Rinascita (Excerpt 1)
datamine:InfoDisplay_21010004_Text.text:
[…]

The two great families diverged on the question of whether a formal faith should be established for the Sentinel.

The Fisalias argued that Rinascita must not retread the fate of the fallen archipelagos and could no longer endure fragmented governance.

[…]

In the aftermath of the Tacet Discord Crisis and following lengthy negotiations, the Abrogati and their supporters moved westward into the wilds, where they founded Septimont.

Meanwhile, the Fisalias led those who remained in establishing what would become Ragunna.
datamine:InfoDisplay_21010004_Text.zh:
两大家族针对要不要就岁主建立信仰一事上产生了分歧。
翡萨烈家认为，黎那汐塔不能再重蹈群岛覆灭的覆辙，也不能再各自为政，需要一个信仰来引领所有人，而岁主恰好就是最理想的对象，这也是黎那汐塔对岁主表示感谢的方式。
尚武的阿布罗加提家认为，岁主本身即是可遇不可求的奇迹，将希望寄托在一个行踪不定的神身上是一种愚蠢且懦弱的行为。岁主引导黎那汐塔人踏上新土地已是仁至义尽，怎么还可以再祈祷对方帮自己解决后续的麻烦，黎那汐塔人应该要求自己能成为和对方一起对抗天灾的战士而不是卑躬屈膝的仆人。
本就有历史矛盾的两大势力爆发了大规模冲突，直到残象袭击了黎那汐塔，双方这才意识到，黎那汐塔还远不是可以高枕无忧的地方。
残象危机之后，经过漫长的协商，支持阿布罗加提的人们搬离了最初的聚集地，去往荒蛮的西边，建立七丘。而以翡萨烈为首留下来的那部分人则建立了最初的拉古那。

datamine:InfoDisplay_21020112_Text.title: Sheet of Paper
datamine:InfoDisplay_21020112_Text.text:
[…]

Ragunna's most successful investor?

[…]

The thought crossed his mind but quickly vanished without a trace.

He decided to take some time to observe his island—to engrave all of its details deep into his mind, to fill his fragmented memories with them, and to hope that the coming darkness would not turn them to nothingness.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_21020112_Text.zh:
（这里有一叠文稿，看起来像是一本未完成的小说或散文）
……齐格勒被困在独属于他的荒岛上，陪伴他的只有一棵椰子树，和偶尔有铛铛蟹爬过的沙滩。
他是谁？老齐格勒的儿子？拉古那最成功的投资人？在一场赌博中失去所有，失去了一切可供夸耀的财富和头衔的可怜人？疯狂的艺术家？隐士？不幸卷入船难的倒霉鬼？
他看着海面，轻柔的风卷起他花白的头发，也掀起波浪。他在阳光投下的金色的闪光中仿佛看到了迷失在无数段支离破碎的时间中的无数个自己。他感到前所未有的孤独，但也前所未有地满足。
他没有离开这座孤岛的机会了，也许明天，也许后天，他就会在烈日之下死去。
不会再有奇迹发生了。他心中浮现出这个念头，但随后就消散无踪。他决定花点时间看看他的荒岛——他决定把所有印象深深烙印在自己的脑海中，用它们填充自己千疮百孔的记忆，并寄希望于即将到来的黑暗不会将它们化为虚无。
（文章到这里就结束了）

datamine:InfoDisplay_22010101_Text.title: Preliminary Guidelines for Operations in Septimont (Excerpt)
datamine:InfoDisplay_22010101_Text.text:
[…]

Septimont—A City of Warriors Where Faith Runs Thin

In ancient times, Ragunna and Septimont were among the earliest settlements during the Age of a Thousand Islands.

[…]

Unlike Ragunna, the Sentinel's blessings have not reached Septimont, for its people long ago abandoned their faith.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_22010101_Text.zh:
【本手册由教化院分发给各驻外教士，仅供内部参阅，不得私自翻印、誊写、流通。】

七丘——信仰稀薄的尚武之都

久远之时，拉古那与七丘皆为千岛之民的落脚地。古老时代的纷争使得两地决裂，逐渐演变成两个有着不同社会面貌和文化习俗的区域。岁主的福音并未传至七丘，只因七丘人早早地放弃了对岁主的信仰，对一切奇迹和恩惠视若无睹。他们转而崇尚力量和勇武，崇拜那些在战争与狩猎中建功立业的英雄，沉浸于竞技场中举办的近乎野蛮的角斗赛事。

值得一提的是，这些表现并不意味着他们不尊敬岁主。七丘人认为，岁主是足够强大的英雄和领袖，享有着无上的荣耀。他们敬仰岁主，讴歌那些昔日的传说，是因为他们觉得有朝一日能够与岁主并肩同行，达成空前绝后的伟业。此等想法无疑是对岁主的冒犯和僭越，我等须在内心倍加警示。

七丘人曾以荒废的神庙和拆毁的祭坛表达对修会，对岁主信仰的漠视。时过境迁，修会不吝于向七丘展现友好宽容的态度。如今常有客商往返于拉古那和七丘之间，七丘城内亦有虔诚的教士在传播教化，普及岁主的神恩。

……

诸位教士在外须谨记岁主的箴言，恪守缄默审慎之要则，尊重七丘的社会文化，避免与当地居民发生冲突。如遇到特殊阻力，可出示修会文牒，在必要时亦可提请修会外务部介入。

……

datamine:InfoDisplay_26010005_Text.title: Peso's Memo Note
datamine:InfoDisplay_26010005_Text.text:
I found this Chest Mimic while treasure hunting in an underground ruin somewhere in Ragunna, after chasing after some wild myths.
I carried it with me across Rinascita, setting it as a constant reminder for myself—the purpose of our journey is not to pursue wealth. Rather, the process of exploring the unknown is a treasure in itself.
 
(Oh, by the way, I've checked with the Montellis, and due to its mint condition, it's actually worth quite a bit.)
datamine:InfoDisplay_26010005_Text.zh:
这只欺诈奇藏，是我当年盲信传闻，在拉古那某处地下遗迹探宝所得。
我带着它走遍黎那汐塔，是希望时刻提醒自己——我们并非为了得到财富而启程，探索未知的过程本身就是一种财富。

（啊对了，我问过莫塔里的人，其实它品相不错，还挺值钱的。）
