yakita:Guide_XMZMLGNP_1_4.chapter: 剧情_2_0_引导任务_巡礼之梦_1_1
yakita:Guide_XMZMLGNP_1_4.text: There are things best discussed face-to-face. Could you come to Ragunna City if you have the time? I need a favor from you, meow...
yakita:Guide_XMZMLGNP_1_4.zh: 有些事情可能需要当面才能说清楚，有时间的话，能来一下拉古那城么？我有些事想拜托你喵……

yakita:HD_XK_40_16.text: Sweeping through Whisperwind Haven and towards Ragunna's high walls.
yakita:HD_XK_40_16.zh: 掠过水畔吹向拉古那的高墙

yakita:JKXCCZST_17_6.text: Yes, the Echoes here in this section of the depository! They've all got that spooky look on their faces. What are they even for anyway? They're nothing like the ones in Ragunna City.
yakita:JKXCCZST_17_6.zh: 就是这片藏区里的声骸啊！一个个都长得阴森森的，也不知道有什么用，和拉古那城里的那些完全不一样。

yakita:LoadingTipsText_200002_TipsText.text:
Ragunna City, the administrative center of the Ragunna city-state in Rinascita, is a thriving port city by the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways. The Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, who believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel that carry Their divine will.
In addition to their faith, the people of Ragunna are also known for their love of the arts. Magnificent sculptures and paintings grace the city at every turn, and impromptu performances often bring the streets to life.
yakita:LoadingTipsText_200002_TipsText.zh:
黎那汐塔城邦之一拉古那的都城，一座无比繁荣的港口城市。整座城市坐落在海上，城区之间由水道相互联通。民众普遍信奉岁主，将公共声骸视为岁主的赐福，甚至传达岁主意志的使者。
除了广为人知的虔信外，拉古那人还以对艺术的狂热追求而著称。精美绝伦的雕塑和画作在城内随处可见，街头也经常可以看到即兴戏剧上演。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_6.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_11_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_6.text: Actually, there was a similar incident with hostile Echoes in Ragunna City recently.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_6.zh: 咳，其实，就在不久前，拉古那城也发生了类似的声骸失控事件。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_14_6.speaker: Zani

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_29.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_26_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_29.text:
You arrive at the Echo train station and wait for its arrival. 
During the wait, the noble lady shares her thoughts on Ragunna City, the Montelli and Fisalia families... and you.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_30_29.zh:
你们顺利抵达了声骸列车的站点。
在等候列车到来的间隙里，这位贵族小姐向你简单分享了自己的看法：关于拉古那城，关于莫塔里与翡萨烈两大家族，以及，关于……你。

yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_17_19.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_上半_1_13_1
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_17_19.text: Wait, Ragunna City was attacked by a TD Outbreak?
yakita:Main_Rinascita_2_11_17_19.zh: 等等，你说拉古那城遭到了残象潮袭击？

yakita:MapMark_4001_MarkDesc.text:
The Ragunna City's Synthesis platform allows Resonators to create potions, construct materials, and purify substances with ease.
Be hold—the stage now belongs to the combination reaction.
yakita:MapMark_4001_MarkDesc.zh: 拉古那城开放给认证共鸣者使用的操作平台，提供合剂制造，物品构造及纯化服务——此刻，舞台属于独特的化合反应。

yakita:RGZYYYGJZ_7_37.text: The leader of a network of commoners seeking freedom in Ragunna City. They had close ties with Benett. If he was really stealing, I'd wager they were complicit.
yakita:RGZYYYGJZ_7_37.zh: 拉古那城里一伙由平民组成的自由团体的头目。那些人原来就和贝内特来往密切，贝内特监守自盗，那他们就是最可能帮着销赃的。

yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_35.speakerZh: 闪亮的金发少女【礼仪副官】
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_35.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_35.text: "May Ragunna City prosper under the Court of Mercury's guidance."
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_410031_35.zh: “希望在「水星天宫」的带领下，拉古那城能愈加繁荣幸福。”

yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420021_1.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420021_1.text:
A peculiar, disorienting scent drifts through the air.
The idyllic waterways of Ragunna City suddenly darken. The Gondolas are replaced by massive, shadowy sea creatures. The boatmen and citizens transform into strange sea folk, their limbs and torsos becoming tails and fins, their necks marked with gill slits...
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420021_1.zh:
一股奇异的香味令你头晕目眩。
你看向身旁的拉古那城的清澈水道，它突然变得幽暗、深不可测，其中往来的不再是贡多拉，而是漆黑的海底巨兽，而其上的船夫与市民则变成了神秘的海族，他们四肢与躯干的连接处长着鳍，脖子上有着数道鳃裂……

yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420081_1.chapter: 剧情_2.3肉鸽局内对话事件
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420081_1.text: The island lies on the outskirts of Ragunna City, a quiet outpost where travelers come and go. This was also the first stop of your return.
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_420081_1.zh: 离岛位于拉古那城的外围，它是人们进出拉古那城的关口。之前你回到拉古那时，也是在离岛下的船。

yakita:phone_JL_8_12.text: Oh yes. And should anything stand in your way while in Ragunna City, you need only to invoke the Montelli name. I've got your back.
yakita:phone_JL_8_12.zh: 还有，要是在拉古那城内遇到什么情况，报莫塔里家族的名号就行，我在你身后。

yakita:GNNPC_JDXZRYZQ_20_1.text: Years of labor, years of exploitation. And now, my agent has the audacity to ask me for overtime? I'll make sure they know...
yakita:GNNPC_JDXZRYZQ_20_1.zh: 我被工作囚禁了那么多年，又被无良的家主剥削至今。而现在，经纪人竟敢再让我加班。我会让他们知道……
yakita:GNNPC_JDXZRYZQ_20_1.speaker: Raul

yakita:GNNPC_JDXZRYZQ_20_11.text: After all these years, I'm finally about to live my dream! I'll buy a boat at Riccioli Islands and live out my days as a fisherman!
yakita:GNNPC_JDXZRYZQ_20_11.zh: 我忍受了这么多年，终于能过上我所希望的生活了！我要去黎乔利群岛，买条船当个自由自在的渔夫！
yakita:GNNPC_JDXZRYZQ_20_11.speaker: Raul

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_3302_1.chapter: 剧情_3_0_深空联合主线_上半_2_1_30
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_3302_1.text: Massive cultivation tanks house many ancient plant species you've never seen on the surface. Life was once scarce in these underground caverns, until the Reactor Drive ignited here. In its relentless pursuit of progress, the Spacetrek Collective did not forget to retrieve the dormant seeds that slept beneath the Roya Frostlands.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_3302_1.zh: 巨大的培养仓中种植着许多你在地表未曾见过的古老植物，地下空洞中曾鲜有生命，直至炉芯于此点亮，深空联合在求索前行的过程中，也仍不忘拾起罗伊冰原之下沉睡的种子。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_3_1_3302_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:NPC_YJYFB_54_2.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_研究院副本_3_22
yakita:NPC_YJYFB_54_2.text: It came from the Spacetrek Collective's very first frostlands expedition. This ancient plant, extinct on the surface for ages, was preserved in the Roya Frostlands ice caps and revived by the Reactor Drive's light.
yakita:NPC_YJYFB_54_2.zh: 它来自深空联合的第一次冰原考察，这种地表早已绝迹的远古植物，在罗伊冰原的冰盖间被按下生命的暂停键，又因炉芯的光芒再次苏醒。

yakita:FavorWord_130831_Content.text: Check the specs! Got yourself a fully-loaded Rebecca now! Next fight, just cozy up by me. I got your back!
yakita:FavorWord_130831_Content.zh: 现在出现在你面前的是完全体的丽贝卡！下次出门打架躲我后面，我罩着你！
yakita:FavorWord_130831_Content.speaker: Rebecca

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_111_7.text: Because I'll wipe Rebecca's record that way, duh... So second place is the goal.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_111_7.zh: 那样的话，师傅的记录就会被消除了……所以，第二名就好。

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_38_27.text: I'll check with Rebecca first... Hm? Where'd she run off to?
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_38_27.zh: 先问问丽贝卡……嗯？她人去哪了？
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_38_27.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_41_15.text: I'm actually not very good at gaming. I lost every round until Rebecca showed up and gave me a hand.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_41_15.zh: 我其实不是很擅长玩这个，玩了好几次都输了，后来是丽贝卡出现帮了我一把。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_41_15.speaker: Sigrika

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_41_24.text: Yep! Let me introduce you. This is 漂泊者, and that's Rebecca.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_41_24.zh: 是呀，我和你介绍！这位是漂泊者，那边那位是丽贝卡。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_41_24.speaker: Sigrika

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_57_2.text: You can stop callin' me "Ms. Rebecca." Ain't my vibe, like, at all. Just Rebecca's fine.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_57_2.zh: 加个称呼什么的也太见外了，直接叫我丽贝卡就好。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_57_2.speaker: Rebecca

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_59_9.text: I should be on my way now. See you next time, Coach Rebecca!
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_59_9.zh: 那我先走一步去探望学姐了。丽贝卡老师，下次见！

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_97_2.text: If not for you, David and Rebecca would have survived that night.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_97_2.zh: 如果没有你，大卫和丽贝卡也不会死在那一晚。

yakita:NPC_YJYFB_19_6.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_研究院副本_1_15
yakita:NPC_YJYFB_19_6.text: Besides the various research departments, the Institute consists of three main facilities: the Starward Riseway, the Collective Factory, and the "Well of the Threnodian."
yakita:NPC_YJYFB_19_6.zh: 研究院内除了各个科研部门，还有联运椎骨、联合工厂以及“鸣式深井”这三部分，它们构成了研究院的主要设施。
yakita:NPC_YJYFB_19_6.speaker: Receptionist

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_70_21.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第四幕_奔策候残星_4_1
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_70_21.text: Scar's Resonance Abilities appear to involve teleportation and the manipulation of space. He trapped me in confinement, and I could only sense that it wasn't far from here.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_70_21.zh: 伤痕的共鸣能力似乎是空间传送和制造异空间，我被他关在一个封闭的空间里，只能感知到距离这里并不远……
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_70_21.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_71_3.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第四幕_奔策候残星_1_31
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_71_3.text: Did Scar do this? Given his powers, it doesn't seem too hard for him.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_71_3.zh: 难道这是伤痕的手笔？联系到他的共鸣能力，做到此事倒也不稀奇。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_71_3.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_6.chapter: 剧情_2_0_引导任务_巡礼之梦_2_1
yakita:Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_6.text: Originally, I couldn't leave the Whining Aix's Mire or collect dreams from other regions due to restrictions placed upon admin privileges and the Resonance Nexus.
yakita:Guide_XMZMLGNP_2_6.zh: 原本由于管理员权限和集域中枢的限制，我很难离开怨鸟泽，也无法收集其他区域人们的梦境。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_32_17.text: Okay... Rover, I'll tell the Academy about this, and they'll help transmit your data from the Resonance Nexus. Then that Beacon in the Whining Aix's Mire should be unlocked for you.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_32_17.zh: 好吧……漂泊者，我会联系研究院，将你的数据从中枢信标传输过去，帮你解锁怨鸟泽附近的信标。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_32_17.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_4_1.text: Everyone in the barracks is saying the enemy has developed a new type of weapon specifically to counter Resonators.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_4_1.zh: 军营里都在传敌人那边研制出了一种对付共鸣者的新武器。

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_6_2.text: I tried everything to hide being a Resonator, so why couldn't I... just be spared this war?
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_6_2.zh: 我想尽一切办法来掩盖共鸣者的身份，可为什么……我还是摆脱不了这场战争。

datamine:InfoDisplay_102181715_Text.title: Freshman Essential: Startorch's Top Fan Club Picks (Excerpt)
datamine:InfoDisplay_102181715_Text.text:
Most Popular: Peaks of Prestige Fan Club
Mr. Furius of Septimont, creator of the one and only Peaks of Prestige, invites you to experience his masterfully crafted Echo battle strategy game!
Fight thrilling duels, use bold all-or-nothing tactics to defeat powerful foes, and be honored as a true duelist!

Most Quirky: Argus Workshop
Where modern technology and ancient tradition meet, a paradise for arms and armament enthusiasts!
Want to craft a legendary weapon by your own hand? Curious about Resonator weapon-making craftsmanship? Come to the Argus Workshop, where everything you need can be found!
Note: This fan club meets in the Academy's Crafting Bay. For more details, please contact the club leader, Garris.

Weirdest... er, Most Practical: Gastro-Alchemist Fan Club.
datamine:InfoDisplay_102181715_Text.zh:
最人气：《荣耀之丘》同好会
推荐理由：邀您体验由七丘传奇游戏制作人，富里乌斯先生开发的声骸模拟对战游戏《荣耀之丘》！
随时体验紧张刺激的声骸决斗，运用策略和孤注一掷的勇气击败强敌，展现身为决斗家的荣耀吧！

最怪咖：阿格斯工坊
推荐理由：先进技术与古老传承的激烈碰撞，冷兵器爱好者的天堂！
想要从零开始打造一把专属于自己的神兵利器吗？想要了解工匠锻造共鸣者武器的技艺吗？就来阿格斯工坊，这里有你所需要的一切！
备注：该同好会活动区域位于学院印造台附近。关于此同好会的详细情况可咨询会长加里斯。

最猎奇……呃，最实用：美食炼金师

datamine:InfoDisplay_28010011_Text.title: A Note from an Unknown Source
datamine:InfoDisplay_28010011_Text.text:
Come and spread excitement all over the world with ██████ Brigade.

We don't bother with ordinary people. But if you're a Resonator, a time traveler, or even an alien beyond Solaris, then come seek us out!
datamine:InfoDisplay_28010011_Text.zh:
这里是让世界变得更有趣的███组织。
 
我们对普通的人类没有兴趣。
如果你是共鸣者、来自未来的人或者索拉里斯之外的来客，就尽管来找我们吧！

yakita:Term850067_Desc.text:
Developed by Dr. Scott Rabelle, this method was originally designed to examine Resonators. It is also known as "Rabelle's Test."
Known for its safety, reliability, and ease of use, the test has since been adopted across multiple regions.
yakita:Term850067_Desc.zh:
由史考特·拉贝尔博士发明，用于检测共鸣者状态的一种方法，简称“拉贝尔检测法”。
因其安全性、稳定性、易用性而在各个地区得到了广泛应用。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_112_10.text: They promised each other they'd perform together once peace returned. But then, I got drafted into the Resonator forces, and I never heard from him again.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_112_10.zh: 他们还约好和平后，一起登台演出。后来，我被共鸣者军队征召入伍，再也没了他的消息。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_112_4.text: My big brother was a musician. When we were kids, he'd always ask me to be his first listener. But I'm a Resonator, and he's an ordinary person.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_112_4.zh: 我的哥哥是一名乐手，小时候他总会让我当第一个听众，但我是共鸣者，哥哥他是普通人。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_118_13.text: I'm sorry, miss. This is our reality now. The neighbors you knew yesterday are your enemies today—all 'cause you're a Resonator, and they aren't.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_118_13.zh: 抱歉，小姑娘，你口中的邻居从今天开始就是你的敌人，因为你是共鸣者，他们是普通人。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_118_18.text: I am. But I'll die if I stop. Besides... it's our fault that innocent Resonators like you got dragged into this.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_118_18.zh: 害怕啊，但不战斗就活不下去。而且……把你们这些无辜的共鸣者卷入战争，是我们的错。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_211_6.text: You fear the Resonator War of the past might once more...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_211_6.zh: 你是担心过去那场共鸣者战争会再次……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_65_12.text: I do. You may think that foolish of me, but I do. Most of the people on this train are just ordinary Resonators swept up in the war.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_65_12.zh: 我相信，虽然你可能会觉得我很傻。但我愿意抱有这样的想法，列车上大部分都是被战争卷入的普通共鸣者。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_21.text: So he figured the pocket he stumbled into might've been a battlefield from the "Resonator War" years ago.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_21.zh: 因此，他猜测那片空间是多年前“联邦城共鸣者战争”的某处战场。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_21.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_34.text: Do you remember what started the Resonator War?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_34.zh: 你还记得共鸣者战争最初是因为什么而爆发的吗？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_32.text: It was a war between ordinary people and Resonators.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_32.zh: 那是爆发于联邦普通人与共鸣者之间的一场战争。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_32.speaker: Shorekeeper

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_7.text: At first, the Resonators had the advantage. But then a substance called Inverse Tacetite appeared. It suppresses a Resonator's power.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_7.zh: 最初是共鸣者占优，但后来出现了一种名为「逆相黑石」的造物，它能抑制共鸣者的共鸣力。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_7.speaker: Shorekeeper

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_8.text: Once that came into play, the scales began to shift. Eventually, the government forces gained the upper hand.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_8.zh: 受逆相黑石影响的共鸣者，力量和行动会受到限制，于是胜利的天平慢慢地就倒向政府军那边了。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_8.speaker: Shorekeeper

yakita:MapMark_3015_MarkDesc.text: A bustling ore trading hub in Tiger's Maw Mine, providing ore purchase and recycling services.
yakita:MapMark_3015_MarkDesc.zh: 虎口矿场开放给共鸣者交易矿石的平台，提供矿石购买、回收服务。

datamine:InfoDisplay_11060302_Text.title: Time Footnote·X
datamine:InfoDisplay_11060302_Text.text:
It's been so humid lately that I'm afraid it's going to be Retroact Rain again, so I found a weapon wreck to get out of the rain.
I came across a pair of siblings who were also stopping here, they were small and a bit wary of strangers, they looked like runaway kids.
I was going to call Mornguard from the camp over there to come over and take the people back, but the two surprised me by pouncing on me and almost bumping into the brim of my hat.
"Uncle, please, don't take us back. My sister and I just want to visit the sea of flowers over there." The larger boy looked at me sincerely, but I was momentarily stumped.
It's just that, who doesn't have a bit of curiosity when they're young. Anyway, I haven't gotten much lately, so why don't I just accompany them to take a look, just as a chance to go to Sea of Flames.
datamine:InfoDisplay_11060302_Text.zh:
最近这天气潮得不行，怕是又要下溯回雨了，找了个武器残骸避雨。
遇到一对兄妹也在此歇脚，两人个头很小，对陌生人有些警惕，看起来像是离家出走的小屁孩。
本来想叫那边营地的晓卫过来把人带回去，但两人竟然扑过来，差点撞我的帽檐上。
“叔叔，求求你，别带我们回去。我和妹妹只是想去那边的花海看看。”个头大点的男孩诚恳地看着我，倒让我一时犯了难。
罢了罢了，谁小时候没点好奇心呢。反正最近也没什么收获，干脆陪他们去看看好了，就当是去焚焰海碰碰运气。

yakita:AreaReportContent_Text46.text:
Embark on adventures to encounter the mysterious ancient Echo of the sea in secluded coves and hunt for pearls washed ashore. As the tide recedes in the sunset, join friendly locals in nearby Riccioli settlements for a refreshing drink.
And last but not least, don't miss out on the signature Riccioli fishing experience!
There you have it, an enchanted wonderland filled with life where infinite possibilities are immersed in aromas of the sea.
Come to the Riccioli Islands and let your heart race as you discover life's new wonders.
yakita:AreaReportContent_Text46.zh:
在海湾之中，你能邂逅神秘的巨大古老声骸；在滩脊边缘，你能收获落在沙砾里的点点珍珠。当浪潮褪去，余晖洒向这岛屿，你也可以前往黎乔利聚落，与热情的当地人共饮一杯。
当然，最不容错过的，还是最具黎乔利特色的——捕鱼活动！
就是这样一个充满着生机与魅力的奇特地域，能让你在椰香与海风中无限邂逅新的故事。
来黎乔利群岛，体验美景震撼，捕获精彩人生！

yakita:DYHD_3_1.text: You arrive near the Riccioli Islands on the fisherman's Gondola...
yakita:DYHD_3_1.zh: 渔民的贡多拉载着你穿越海洋，抵达了黎乔利群岛附近……

yakita:DYHD_7_27.text: There are four of 'em across Riccioli Islands. As long as their lights are on, the Tidebreaker will answer our pleas as gently as ever.
yakita:DYHD_7_27.zh: 像这样的灯塔在黎乔利群岛一共有四座，只要灯亮着，溯海之鲸就能回应我们的祈求，温和如初。

datamine:InfoDisplay_102801045_Text.title: Black and White
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801045_Text.text:
You who have answered the summon, can you glimpse Rinascita's reality from this board?

"The summoned one sees the black and white pieces moving as though they hold a life of their own."
"The white pieces seem to follow a certain presence, while the black pieces scatter along their own courses across the board."
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801045_Text.zh:
赴约者，汝可在这棋盘中看见了黎那汐塔的现实？

「赴约者看见，那棋盘上的黑白两色棋子如活物一般凭空自走」
「白棋们仿佛追随着何物，亦步亦趋，而众黑棋则于各处奔行」

datamine:InfoDisplay_102801046_Text.title: Shackled Pieces
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801046_Text.text:
Lifer, the imprisoned soul, you shall wield the pieces in my stead, unceasing for all eternity.
My will endures in the board, the pieces, and the shackles that bind you. Rinascita shall tread the sacred path, now and forever.

"Before the summoned one, a shackled prisoner sits across the board."
"In the game between black and white, the summoned one and the lifer, all strive for freedom."
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801046_Text.zh:
深囚于此的灵魂，汝将代我执棋，永世不休。
棋子，棋盘，及汝的镣铐皆是我意志的证明。
黎那汐塔，将永恒行驶在神圣的道途中。

「在赴约者的面前，戴着镣铐的囚徒坐在了棋盘的另一头」
「黑棋与白棋、赴约者与深囚者的缠斗，所求的都是自由」

datamine:InfoDisplay_109000002_Text.title: Divinity of Septimont
datamine:InfoDisplay_109000002_Text.text:
We have conquered the land and built an impenetrable fortress upon the mountain’s crown.
From the very beginning, the Echoes stood with us—loyal, unyielding, and true.
O Brave people of Rinascita, future warriors. Let this monument bear witness to your courage.
In the beginning is the lion, peerless in might.
In the end is the knight, faithful to the last breath.
What we leave behind will one day rise again through you.
datamine:InfoDisplay_109000002_Text.zh:
我们征服大地，在高山上建造了不落之城。
从始至终，声骸都是我们最忠勇的伙伴。
勇敢的黎那汐塔人，未来的战士们啊。
向此碑展现力量与忠勇吧。
最初是至强无匹的狮子，
最后是至死不渝的骑士。
我们留下的一切，终将为你开启。

datamine:InfoDisplay_120101032_Text.title: A Sealed Confession: Part 1
datamine:InfoDisplay_120101032_Text.zh:
从漆黑深渊中逃脱的人，不必给任何人报信。
它像是戏弄着我们一样，也一并切着漩涡的游动，它背上那些蓝色的晶体和漩涡的水线只隔着浅浅的几公分，透过深黑色的大海闪烁着。我们原本已经标进它后背上的鱼叉也都消失了，但我们的确留下了三个明晃晃的窟窿！
每当我们将要追上它的时候，它就加速游入更深的水域里，越是到这漩涡的深水区，速度也就越快，但我们已经没有退路了。
它先是消失，然后再次出现在我们左舷的时候，桅杆就已经卷进了另一侧的水线里断掉了。
紧接着是绞盘绷紧的声音和龙骨的碎裂声。
再然后，就只有一片漆黑了，这漆黑里，我的船，我的人，还有它，我都看不到。
先是我的那条“腿”引起一阵哆嗦……我以为我死了。
我躺在沙滩上，没有船，没有人，也没有它。
我的手上没有它的血，没有舵盘、缆绳和标枪能再让我握住。
但这里的海风我并不熟悉，这里的沙滩我也从未见过。我们从贝孚德角出发后，每一处我中转过的港口和海滩，我都记得，但我对这里没有印象。
直到一个穿着异邦装扮的小伙子踢了踢我的靴子，好像在检查我是不是死了的时候，我才意识到自己并没有下地狱，也没有上天堂。
“啊，这是哪儿？”
“黎那汐塔，黎乔利岛。”
“黎那汐塔……”
“你是遇到了海难吗？”
“我的船，还有我的人……”
“这附近只有你了。”
“这样啊……到最后，也唯有我一人逃脱。”

datamine:InfoDisplay_120101033_Text.title: A Sealed Confession: Part 2
datamine:InfoDisplay_120101033_Text.text:
...Later, I came to realize that we were "blessed."
 
The people of Rinascita said that whale guided ships and sailors who perished at sea to the afterlife, like a ferryman of the underworld. I heard that the merchants of the Forgotten Sea could weigh memories and souls on their scales, exchanging them for an equal weight of gold.
 
But for some reason, we're all still alive. Or rather, we exist in a state between life and death.
 
Yes, in time, I found Starbuck and Queequeg on this island. They're still alive. "It," the whale they call "Cetus the Tidebreaker," was also still alive.
 
How can this be a "blessing"? This is nothing but a "curse!" I cannot accept this!
 
Once I've had my vengeance, death may take me. But if my vengeance fails, I cannot bear to remain in this world as a mere plaything for those I sought vengeance against! My fate is mine to decide, and only true death can end my conquest.
 
They don't understand. That whale, though it appears tame and gentle, is cunning and violent. It transforms death into an unjust eternity, making my vengeance just a footnote in its mockery of the sea… No, I will never accept this. I will never compromise!
datamine:InfoDisplay_120101033_Text.zh:
……后来我才知道，我们被“祝福”了。
这些黎那汐塔人说，那鲸鱼会引渡葬身大海的航船和海员前往来世，应该就像是那种“接引灵魂”的家伙吧。我听说过，遗忘海的商人们能把记忆和灵魂放在他们的天平上，用它来称量等量的金子。
只是不知为什么，我们却都还活着，或者说，像是介于一种活着和死了的中间态。
是的，后来我在这座岛上，也找到了斯塔巴克斯，还有魁格他们，也都还活着。
“它”，那鲸鱼，被称为“溯海之鲸”的家伙，也还活着。
这哪儿算得上是“祝福”，这根本就是一种“诅咒”！我不能接受！
当我完成了我的复仇后，死亡尽可以取走我的性命。倘若我的复仇已然失败，我不能忍受还要被复仇对象当做玩物而停留在这个世界上！我的命运只由我自己做主，唯有真正的死亡能停止我的征服。
他们并不知道，那鲸鱼看起来驯服和蔼，却是如此地狡诈和暴力，将死亡化为不公的永恒，将我的复仇作为它对这片大海的嘲弄的一个注脚……不，我绝不接受，绝不妥协！

datamine:InfoDisplay_133002001_Text.title: Rinascita
datamine:InfoDisplay_133002001_Text.text:
A nation of independent city-states scattered across a vast archipelago, with no central administrative center. Legends speak of Rinascita's founders, who fled their homeland and sailed to these islands to escape the Lament. 

As an island nation reborn from the Lament, Rinascita was long isolated from the rest of the world by relentless disasters and vast distances. It wasn't until recent times that the Rinascitans opened new maritime routes. Ships laden with their spices and minerals began to sail across the world, and in turn, new treasures and wealth began flowing back to Rinascita, enriching its shores.

Rinascita is famed for its unique "Common Echo" technology, which allows Echoes to persist in physical form within the radius of the Genesis Nexus. Through this technology, the Rinascitan people have integrated Echoes into every facet of their lives. This is how the nation came to be known as the "Land of Echoes."

Rinascitans place great value on the identity derived from bloodlines, and their society is built upon a deep reverence for family ties. For them, the welfare of the family always takes precedence over individual fate.
datamine:InfoDisplay_133002001_Text.zh:
由群岛上的数个高度独立的城邦组成的国家，并不存在传统意义上的政治中心。在传说中，黎那汐塔人的先祖为了从悲鸣中幸存，从另一片土地渡海迁徙而来。
作为一个从悲鸣中重获新生的岛国，黎那汐塔曾一度因灾害和空间阻碍而与世界的其他区域隔绝。直到近代，黎那汐塔才开拓了通向其他国家或地区的航路，随着满载黎那汐塔所特产的香料和矿石的船队前往世界各地，奇珍与财富亦随着贸易不断向黎那汐塔汇集。
黎那汐塔拥有被称为「公共声骸」的特殊声骸技术，该技术使得声骸能够在「起源信标」的生效区域内长久存在，黎那汐塔人凭借此技术，将声骸广泛运用在了生活中的方方面面。黎那汐塔「声骸之国」的别称也正是由此而来。
黎那汐塔人非常重视相同血脉带来的认同感，并形成了以血脉作为彼此纽带的家族文化。在黎那汐塔人的传统观念中，家族的福祉远重于个人命运。

yakita:InfoDisplay_102801038_Text.text:
Such is the Quercus, the embodiment of Divinity. 
They bear Rinascita forward, each scar upon Their body an eternal prophecy.

(In the depths of the garden, Rinascita has followed the divine will, treading upon the sacred path.)
yakita:InfoDisplay_102801038_Text.zh:
那青栎的枝桠便是至高者的身躯。
祂以己身承载着黎那汐塔前行，祂的伤痕即是不朽的神谕。

「在庭院的深处，黎那汐塔正顺应至高者的旨意，行驶在神圣的道途中」

yakita:AreaReportContent_Text44.text:
Kindly Note:

Staff and Echo activity take place in the following areas:

1. Office Area (The designated workspace for staff members).
2. Underground Vault Area (Primarily housing Echoes and patrolled by armed Echoes. Do not enter this area without prior authorization and declaration).

As the most secure and reliable place in all of Rinascita, all staff members of the Vault are responsible for ensuring the safety of the items stored inside.

The deposit and withdrawal of all items must strictly follow the prescribed reporting procedures. Violations will be handled according to the rules outlined in the Employee Manual.
yakita:AreaReportContent_Text44.zh:
您须知悉：
职员和声骸，可活动的主要区块有以下：
1.办公区（各位职员日常工作的场所）。
2.地下金库区（声骸为主的区域，由经过武装的声骸巡视着地下金库内的藏品，如未申报，切勿擅自进入）。

作为黎那汐塔地区最为牢固可靠的场所，金库全体职员有责任维护内部所有藏品的安全。
所有藏品的入库出库，均需严格依照流程报备，违者将按职员手册内规定处理。

yakita:LGNCZST_1411_28.text: My mission isn't finished. I'll stay in Rinascita and continue digging into their historical records about the Sentinel. My next stop is Whisperwind Haven. If fate allows, we'll meet again.
yakita:LGNCZST_1411_28.zh: 我的任务还没结束。我会在黎那汐塔境内，继续调查有关岁主的史实。如果有新的情报，我会联络你的。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_28.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕下_狂欢节_64_15
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_28.text: My mission isn't finished. I'll stay in Rinascita and continue digging into their historical records about the Sentinel. My next stop is Whisperwind Haven. If fate allows, we'll meet again.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_240_28.zh: 我的任务还没结束。我会在黎那汐塔境内，继续调查有关岁主的史实……就先从拂风水畔入手吧。期望我们有缘再会了！

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_228_1.text: Divinity of Rinascita... Can you forgive my sins...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_228_1.zh: 黎那汐塔的神明，您能宽恕我的罪吗……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_38_8.text: So I hold this Rinascitan scripture, pretending it means something. Pretending I'll be atoned if I have faith.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_38_8.zh: 只能拿着黎那汐塔的教典装模作样，企图从信仰中得到一丝原谅。

datamine:InfoDisplay_102801029_Text.title: Rite of Offering: Volume III
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801029_Text.text:
…With a mighty roar, it banished all Tacet Discords, using its time-distorting powers to protect us…

"To complete the Rite of Offering, seek the glazed lamp on Xuanji Ridge. It is said to be found there. This shall be your first destination." —Uncle Fu
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801029_Text.zh:
真龙显威，残象皆退，以时为障，岁月须臾。

“完成奉龙仪式需要用到那个琉璃灯盏，按照古籍记载，应该在璇玑岭那边，必须要先去那里一趟。”——福伯

datamine:InfoDisplay_102801030_Text.title: Rite of Offering: Volume IV
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801030_Text.text:
…Now, we must leave our sanctuary and fulfill our duty. We will not return until victory is ours…

"To complete the Rite of Offering, seek the glazed lamp on Xuanji Ridge. It is said to be found there. This shall be your first destination." —Uncle Fu
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801030_Text.zh:
此机已至，兵出乘霄，一去永别，不达不还。

“完成奉龙仪式需要用到那个琉璃灯盏，按照古籍记载，应该在璇玑岭那边，必须要先去那里一趟。”——福伯

yakita:LKKST_1_6.text: Better still, "Roccia the Legendary First Mate."
yakita:LKKST_1_6.zh: 不如演《传奇大副洛可可》。

yakita:NPC_24_JISHI_17_3.text: And his first mate Roccia is super adorable...
yakita:NPC_24_JISHI_17_3.zh: 还有洛可可大副的佩洛，真的超级可爱……

yakita:NPC_LNXTMDST_10_10.text: Roccia. We need our First Mate to step up your game this time!
yakita:NPC_LNXTMDST_10_10.zh: 意思是——这次必须得洛可可大副出马了！

yakita:Term850123_Desc.text: A massive suitcase that never leaves Roccia's side, housing various stage props, play scripts, and Pero.
yakita:Term850123_Desc.zh: 洛可可不离身的巨大手提箱，里面装着各式舞台道具、剧作手稿，同时也是佩洛的住所。

yakita:AVG_Farewellday_60_16.text: What I've always wanted is for everyone to feel free to express their happiness, anger, sorrow, and joy. Without fear. Without sadness.
yakita:AVG_Farewellday_60_16.zh: 洛可可想做的事情，一直都是想让所有人都能无所顾忌地表达自己的喜怒哀乐，不再恐惧、不再悲伤。
yakita:AVG_Farewellday_60_16.speaker: Roccia

yakita:Character_Rococo_10_4.text: Roccia remarks as she hurries back to the tent.
yakita:Character_Rococo_10_4.zh: 洛可可说完，着急地走回医疗帐篷。

yakita:Character_Rococo_10_7.text: It can wait. I'll go see if Roccia needs anything.
yakita:Character_Rococo_10_7.zh: 先不用了，我也去帮忙照顾孩子。

yakita:Character_Rococo_11_6.text: Tina and Roccia manage to treat the little girl's wounds. Her breathing gradually steadies.
yakita:Character_Rococo_11_6.zh: 蒂娜和洛可可又为小女孩做了一些医疗措施，小女孩的呼吸逐渐平缓起来。

yakita:Character_Rococo_18_2.text: They carry all the fear and confusion people felt.
yakita:Character_Rococo_18_2.zh: 上面承载着大家的恐惧与迷惘。
yakita:Character_Rococo_18_2.speaker: Roccia

yakita:Character_Rococo_28_6.text: A frown begins to form on Roccia's face. She wants to comfort Luca but struggles to come up with the right words.
yakita:Character_Rococo_28_6.zh: 洛可可有些为难的样子，似乎想努力说些什么安慰卢卡，但不知道怎么说更合适。

yakita:Character_Rococo_3_18.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_1_角色_洛可可线_1_3
yakita:Character_Rococo_3_18.text:
You repel the Tacet Discords, saving both the pilgrims and the troupe members. 
Roccia thanks you and explains the origins of the pilgrims.
yakita:Character_Rococo_3_18.zh:
你击退了残象，救下朝圣者和剧团众人。
洛可可对你表示了感谢，并说明这些朝圣者的由来。

yakita:Character_Rococo_5_11.text: Roccia instructs Pero to bring out some water and rations from her box for the elderly man.
yakita:Character_Rococo_5_11.zh: 洛可可立刻示意佩洛从箱中掏出水和干粮，递给老人家。

yakita:Character_Rococo_5_15.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_1_角色_洛可可线_1_5
yakita:Character_Rococo_5_15.text:
Together, you and Roccia rescue the pilgrims. 
Some are badly injured, others are starving, and none are in good shape.
yakita:Character_Rococo_5_15.zh:
你和洛可可一起救助朝圣者。
有人身受重伤，有人饥肠辘辘，大家的状况都不是太好。

yakita:Character_Rococo_63_7.chapter: 剧情_2_0_角色_洛可可线_副本_2_7
yakita:Character_Rococo_63_7.text: Roccia asks Pero to bring along the Echoes and their items as they all return to the Troupe.
yakita:Character_Rococo_63_7.zh: 洛可可让佩洛带上这些布偶声骸以及声骸们收集的物品，大家一起回到了剧团。

yakita:Character_Rococo_72_17.text: We may not be rich or perfect, but at least we can sing and laugh whenever we feel like it.
yakita:Character_Rococo_72_17.zh: 这里不一定富裕，不一定完善，但可以随时欢唱，肆意欢笑。
yakita:Character_Rococo_72_17.speaker: Roccia

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_102_1.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_4_21
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_102_1.text: Roccia makes quick work of repairing the Cloudcaster.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_102_1.zh: 洛可可飞快地将造云机修复好……

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_79_7.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第三幕上_帕尔米罗_2_3
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_79_7.text: Following the Golden Phantom, you and Roccia narrowly escape the Dragon of Dirge's ambush in the mist...
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_3_79_7.zh: 你与洛可可跟随“金色的虚影”，顺利躲过了埋伏在海雾中的古龙……

yakita:Side_TZJNSC_1_10.text: How was that? Does my performance resemble what Roccia Cube taught me?
yakita:Side_TZJNSC_1_10.zh: 怎么样，这段洛可可团子教的表演我学得还像吗？

yakita:TZZNQ_14_4.text: Roccia is too hungry and has gone into sleep mode. It's Pero talking now.
yakita:TZZNQ_14_4.zh: 洛可可太饿了，已经进入待机状态啦，现在说话的是佩洛哦。

yakita:TZZNQ_18_2.text: (Did Roccia just eat a piece of the Anniversary Cake?)
yakita:TZZNQ_18_2.zh: （洛可可刚刚吃的似乎是庆典蛋糕的一部分？）

yakita:TZZNQ_63_16.text: Roccia! You and Pero must be the captains of the Cube Adventure Squad! I'm the vice-captain of the Wooly Adventure Squad. We should play together!
yakita:TZZNQ_63_16.zh: 洛可可！你有佩洛，一定就是团子冒险小队的老大！我是羊咩冒险小队的副队长，我们可以一起玩！

yakita:Flow_11000001_183.text: Looks like I'll have to ask Ms. Verina to come and take a look. Her designs always emit a vibrant energy that's simply unmatched.
yakita:Flow_11000001_183.zh: 抽空还是找维里奈小姐过来看看吧，经她手设计出来的景观，总有一种生机盎然的感觉……别人都比不上！
yakita:Flow_11000001_183.speaker: Rongqing

yakita:Flow_11000001_184.text: Ms. Verina's designs are truly enchanting. If only I could be her...
yakita:Flow_11000001_184.zh: 究竟为什么……维里奈小姐的盆景会设计得这么生动呢……
yakita:Flow_11000001_184.speaker: Rongqing

yakita:Flow_11000001_598.text: It's the most cherished penjing in our store, meticulously designed and crafted by Ms. Verina herself! It's truly one-of-a-kind!
yakita:Flow_11000001_598.zh: 这可是由维里奈小姐精心设计、亲手制作、全世界仅有一盆的本店镇店之宝！
yakita:Flow_11000001_598.speaker: Rongqing

yakita:Flow_11000001_602.text: How does Ms. Verina manage to make her penjings look so naturally dynamic? What's her secret?
yakita:Flow_11000001_602.zh: 维里奈小姐设计的盆景为什么那么自然灵动呢，她到底做了什么？
yakita:Flow_11000001_602.speaker: Rongqing

yakita:Flow_11000001_153.text: Rover, do you think you can help find Guhong for me? Here's his contact information.
yakita:Flow_11000001_153.zh: 漂泊者，能拜托你帮忙找找孤鸿吗？我这有他的联系方式。
yakita:Flow_11000001_153.speaker: Shiyu

yakita:Flow_11000007_8.chapter: 剧情_天城生态_NPC_军事基地_3_2
yakita:Flow_11000007_8.text: Excuse me, are you the... Rover? The one who helped Jinyue find that "treasure" a while ago?
yakita:Flow_11000007_8.zh: 打扰了，您是不是就是那个——漂泊者？前些日子帮金悦寻着“宝贝”那个？

yakita:Flow_11000008_13.chapter: 剧情_天城生态_先行公约_3_1
yakita:Flow_11000008_13.text: I've tried every way, but I can't persuade him. What should I do... Rover, you came at the right time. Help me think of a solution.
yakita:Flow_11000008_13.zh: 办法都试过了，还是劝不住他，究竟该怎么……漂泊者你来得真好，也帮我想想办法。
yakita:Flow_11000008_13.speaker: Xianchen

yakita:Flow_11000008_38.chapter: 剧情_天城生态_先行公约_3_1
yakita:Flow_11000008_38.text: Rover, if you have a solution, you must tell me.
yakita:Flow_11000008_38.zh: 漂泊者，你想到办法的话，一定要告诉我。
yakita:Flow_11000008_38.speaker: Xianchen

yakita:Flow_311000008_13.chapter: 剧情_天城生态_SimpleNPC冒泡_边庭_1_2
yakita:Flow_311000008_13.text: Rumor has it, Rover's the guest Magistrate referred to, capable of tearing Tacet Discords apart single-handedly! Quite the feat!
yakita:Flow_311000008_13.zh: {TA}应该就是令尹说的那位客人啦，听说{TA}能手撕残象、碳烤声骸，可厉害了！

yakita:Flow_311000008_15.chapter: 剧情_天城生态_SimpleNPC冒泡_边庭_1_1
yakita:Flow_311000008_15.text: Could it possibly be Rover? You know, the one always hanging around City Hall?
yakita:Flow_311000008_15.zh: 诶，你说，会不会是常出入边庭的那位漂泊者？

yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_17_2.text: Hey, you're the Rover, right? Got important business here?
yakita:Huanglong_NPC_yjy_1_17_2.zh: 嗯？你是那个漂泊者吧，来研究院有要事吗？

yakita:MXXSST_19_1.chapter: 剧情_3_7_梦玄溪山_枢修机坊生态_20_1
yakita:MXXSST_19_1.text: 漂泊者, thank you for your help. With Suhsin gone, the remolding has picked up pace. It won't be long now.
yakita:MXXSST_19_1.zh: 漂泊者，多谢你相助，溯心不在后，重塑进度加快许多，很快就能完成了。

yakita:NPC_JC_60_1.text: You're back, Rover. Must've been a tiring journey back to the city, right?
yakita:NPC_JC_60_1.zh: 你回来了，漂泊者。辛苦了，回城这一路很累吧。

yakita:ZXHSMST_2_11.text: It's been a hundred years, Suoming, and what you feel for them is still strong. Does it hurt?
yakita:ZXHSMST_2_11.zh: 锁暝，已经过去了百年之久，你对他们的情感还是如此强烈，会很痛苦吧？
yakita:ZXHSMST_2_11.speaker: Rover

yakita:ZXHYLST_1_1.text: Rover. We really have to stop "running into" each other like this.
yakita:ZXHYLST_1_1.zh: 漂泊者，看来我们又一次“偶遇”了。

yakita:ZXHYLST_2_12.text: Uh-uh. One question, Rover. Those were the terms. But don't worry, the letters and manuscripts are going to someone you trust.
yakita:ZXHYLST_2_12.zh: 漂泊者，说好了只能问一个问题，不过放心，会有你信任的人来处理这密信与手稿。
yakita:ZXHYLST_2_12.speaker: Yinlin

yakita:ZXHYLST_2_2.text: I've got about a hundred questions. But first... It's been a minute, Yinlin.
yakita:ZXHYLST_2_2.zh: 说实话我有很多想问的，但首先……好久不见了，吟霖。
yakita:ZXHYLST_2_2.speaker: Rover

yakita:ZXHYLST_3_1.text: Yinlin, I know you only gave me one question, but... was this really a coincidence?
yakita:ZXHYLST_3_1.zh: 吟霖，虽然你只让我问一个问题，但是……我想知道我们真是偶遇吗？
yakita:ZXHYLST_3_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_750_4.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第二幕_玄方城生态_5_1
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_750_4.text: Yangyang, 漂泊者... you're heading to the frontlines, aren't you?
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_750_4.zh: 秧秧姑娘，漂泊者……你们是要上前线御敌吧。

yakita:ZYHSGST_23_21.text: Cross my heart. But what about this mister over here? Look... everyone around us thinks he's a bad guy. Grown-ups can get upset, too, you know.
yakita:ZYHSGST_23_21.zh: 真的。不过这个叔叔要怎么办呢？你看……现在周围的人都误会他了，大人也是会委屈的。
yakita:ZYHSGST_23_21.speaker: Rover

datamine:InfoDisplay_101400012_Text.title: Anonymous Message
datamine:InfoDisplay_101400012_Text.text: Same as last time, Rover. You know how to find me.
datamine:InfoDisplay_101400012_Text.zh: 老办法，你应该知道用什么能找到我。

datamine:InfoDisplay_311000005_Text.title: Zhezhi's Message
datamine:InfoDisplay_311000005_Text.text:
Hi Rover,

I'm not sure if this message will reach you, but I hope it does.

There's something I've been wanting to tell you, but I can't seem to find the right words in person... To be honest, I'm afraid you might reject what I'm about to ask.

I'd like to give you this scroll of painting. It's not just because you helped me with Mingyan's situation, but also because you freed me from a worry that's been haunting me for years. The Patrollers returned the "Serenity of Xiehua Village" that I drew during the hearing, but I want you to have it now. After all, it's the reason we met, a testament to our shared journey, and a symbol of the courage you instilled in me. In a way, we created this painting together.

My heart will always be connected to this piece, and I must admit, I have an ulterior motive... I want it to stay with you.

Zhezhi
datamine:InfoDisplay_311000005_Text.zh:
漂泊者：

不知道你会不会看到这条留言呢？
有些话我还不知道该如何开口，不…其实，我是害怕你会拒绝这个有些无礼的要求。
我想把这幅画送给你，不仅仅是为了感谢你帮助我完成明砚之事，更是为了感谢你帮我解开了多年前的心结。这幅《撷华山居图》是我们在论辩真相时画下的，刚才巡尉使用完后将它送还给了我，我却觉得我应该将它送给你。它是我们相遇的契机，是我们一起经历的见证，是你给予我勇气的钥匙，是我们共同的创作。
我把它留在了心里，也有私心的…想把它留在你的身边。

折枝

yakita:AYJJZS_44_1.text: The snow and ice in the Sealed Fissure show no signs of melting...
yakita:AYJJZS_44_1.zh: 封存地的冰雪，没有丝毫消融迹象……
yakita:AYJJZS_44_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:BYCZ_66_2.text: Looks wrecked... I should find a way to get it back to the Starward Riseway.
yakita:BYCZ_66_2.zh: 看起来已经无法正常使用了……想办法将它送回联运椎骨吧。
yakita:BYCZ_66_2.speaker: Rover

yakita:Character_ChangLi_28_1.text: Traces of excavation on the ground... Looks like someone was trying to dig a hole with their bare hands. Could it be Wuli?
yakita:Character_ChangLi_28_1.zh: 地上有被挖掘过的痕迹……看起来像是有人徒手挖出来的，难道是梧黎？
yakita:Character_ChangLi_28_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Character_ZheZhi_14_3.text: (Once Zhezhi has the paintbrush in her hand, she begins to speak calmly.)
yakita:Character_ZheZhi_14_3.zh: （果然，折枝一旦拿起画笔就放松下来了。）
yakita:Character_ZheZhi_14_3.speaker: Rover

yakita:Character_ZheZhi_3_34.text: I was entrusted to investigate a certain "Arcane Artist" in the Tiger's Maw.
yakita:Character_ZheZhi_3_34.zh: 那天，我接到了一个关于奇画师传闻的委托，于是按照要求去虎口矿场调查情况。
yakita:Character_ZheZhi_3_34.speaker: Rover

yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_165_1.text: I assume this is the Truthseeker's Pass Xinyi mentioned.
yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_165_1.zh: 这里应该就是辛夷说的叩天关了吧。
yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_165_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_203_6.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_安可_1_17
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_203_6.text: Those gateways that appeared by the Whining Aix's Mire... It's all because of you.
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_203_6.zh: 除了怨鸟泽，现在其他地方也都出现了心之集域的大门……这些，都是你入侵现实带来的。
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_203_6.speaker: Rover

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_9_1.text: Welcome, 漂泊者 and Lady Sanhua! What can I get for you?
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_9_1.zh: ——欢迎光临！是漂泊者和散华大人啊。二位想来点什么啊？
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_9_1.speaker: Uncle Li

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_9_18.text: ...On second thought, with 漂泊者 and Lady Sanhua, getting those seeds would be a breeze. Can't wait for your Plumpcake!
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_9_18.zh: 不，如果是漂泊者和散华大人的话，弄到这些莲实应该还是没问题的。就让我期待一下吧。
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_9_18.speaker: Uncle Li

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_9_27.text: Sanhua boxes up the fresh Plumpcakes, then hands a box to you.
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_9_27.zh: 散华把烤好的团圆饼分成了两份，并递给漂泊者一份。

yakita:GQWYQX_6_8.chapter: 剧情_3_7_每日_归期未有期_续_7_1
yakita:GQWYQX_6_8.text: All those lights across Xuanfang Hold... They were stunning.
yakita:GQWYQX_6_8.zh: 玄方城的万家灯火……很美。
yakita:GQWYQX_6_8.speaker: Rover

yakita:Guide_XMZMLGNP_1_2.chapter: 剧情_2_0_引导任务_巡礼之梦_1_1
yakita:Guide_XMZMLGNP_1_2.text: (What is this feeling... is it... the Somnoire?)
yakita:Guide_XMZMLGNP_1_2.zh: （怎么回事……这种感觉是……心之集域？）
yakita:Guide_XMZMLGNP_1_2.speaker: Rover

yakita:HD_XK_24_11.text: Their assumptions were challenged, so they traveled to the knight's encampment at Whisperwind Haven to verify the truth for themselves.
yakita:HD_XK_24_11.zh: 遭到质问的诗社成员似乎决定前往骑士驻扎的营地，亲眼见证真相，地点就在拂风水畔。
yakita:HD_XK_24_11.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_28.text: 漂泊者, Sanhua told me about your situation. I take it you'll be heading to Xuanfang Hold soon?
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_28.zh: 漂泊者，散华侍卫和我说了你的事，你接下来，应该是要出发去玄方城吧。
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_120_28.speaker: Xiangli Yao

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_180_2.text: Yeah... we haven't run into any of those Autopuppets Xiangli Yao mentioned yet.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_180_2.zh: 嗯……暂时也没遇到相里要所说的「机傀」。
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_180_2.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_45.text: (Now that she mentions it, Suisui did give me... one of her letters?)
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_45.zh: （说起来，穗穗之前给我的……一封……信？）
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_260_45.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_264_4.text: (Locator readings are normal. Suisui's safe for now...)
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_264_4.zh: （定位器上的指数正常，说明穗穗现在还平安无事……）
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_264_4.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_90_16.text: Don't beat yourself up, Zhezhi. You've already been a big help.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_90_16.zh: 别自责，折枝，你已经帮了很大的忙了。
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_90_16.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_45_1.text: Is that Sundermere? Are we back before the Starward Riseway was even built?
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_45_1.zh: 那边是坠剑湖吗？这是联运椎骨都尚未建成的时期？
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_45_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_975_7.text: Find a suitable place. You know what to do... And keep your wits about you, Rover. Don't get yourself lost in a memory.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_WMXZTK_975_7.zh: 寻找合适的地方，你知道该怎么用……不要被记忆迷惑了，漂泊者。

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_118_5.chapter: 剧情_3_2_拉海洛主线_上半_暗面4_5_1
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_118_5.text: She's lost in a nightmare now. I have to wake her up.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_118_5.zh: 她已经陷入噩梦了，必须喊醒她。
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_YXBLDHJ_118_5.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_160_1.text: (This is... the same music I heard after saying goodbye to Suisui.)
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_160_1.zh: （这是……在送穗穗走后听到过的琴声？）
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_160_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_23.text: I trust you, Suisui. But if anything happens that you can't handle alone, you need to contact us.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_23.zh: 穗穗，我相信你，但如果你遇到了什么解决不了的麻烦，一定要联系我们。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_23.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_307_1.text: So... this Xuanfang Hold isn't as perfect as it seems.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_307_1.zh: 这座空中的玄方城……并没有看上去那么美好。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_307_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_40_1.text: This is the path Suisui described. But I'm not seeing any of the Disorienting Fog she mentioned.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_40_1.zh: 这确实是穗穗曾走过的路线。但她曾提到过的隐息雾，这一路上似乎没有出现。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_40_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_15.text: Hmm, Suisui did mention an informant who met her outside Fogveil Pagoda before—
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_15.zh: 之前，穗穗提到过一位和她在雾隐阁外接头的线人——
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_70_15.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_20.text: It took Suoming too. Do you know where she is now?
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_20.zh: 还有被祂抓走的锁暝，你知道现在她在哪里么？
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_104_20.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_18.text: But you're the one who's been protecting Xuanfang Hold...
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_18.zh: 但，一直以来守护玄方城的人是你……
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_135_18.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_175_9.text: This is Her at the very start of Xuanfang Hold's construction.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_175_9.zh: 刚开始建造玄方城的祂。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_175_9.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_200_2.text: Xuanfang Hold's defense formations... Are they being hacked?
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_200_2.zh: 这是玄方城的防御阵列……被控制了？
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_200_2.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_10.text: She's the Sentinel. Her every move could affect Xuanfang Hold's safety.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_10.zh: 毕竟祂身为岁主，一举一动都可能牵扯到玄方城的安危。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_46_10.speaker: Rover

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_58_2.text: (Suoming didn't seem like she'd lost control. She let herself be taken on purpose.)
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_58_2.zh: （锁暝不像是没有把握，她是故意被抓走的。）
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_58_2.speaker: Rover

yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_5_21.text: As the Chairwoman of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild, you're probably planning to seize a share of the Xuanfang Hold market for the Guild. Now that Huizhen Plaza is running a promotion, this is a perfect chance to do some market research.
yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_5_21.zh: 作为昭明商会理事长的你，应该有让商会进驻玄方城市场的打算。而汇珍坊正做促销活动，你刚好可以来做市场调研。
yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_5_21.speaker: Rover

yakita:Side_BGJSY_120_12.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_历程记忆手册_不改旧时影_16_1
yakita:Side_BGJSY_120_12.text: (I wonder if Suisui would be interested in this...)
yakita:Side_BGJSY_120_12.zh: （不知道穗穗会不会对这有兴趣……）
yakita:Side_BGJSY_120_12.speaker: Rover

yakita:Side_CFYW_12_3.chapter: 剧情_1_1_支线_乘霄山灵异事件_15_1
yakita:Side_CFYW_12_3.text: Have you lost your mind? It's that Rover! Even Mr. Scar is no match for {Male=him;Female=her}!
yakita:Side_CFYW_12_3.zh: 你疯了吗？这家伙可是漂泊者！别说我们了，就算伤痕大人也不是{TA}的对手！

yakita:Side_GMXQ_30_4.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_30_1
yakita:Side_GMXQ_30_4.text: Mm, there are wreckages of fallen Cloud Shuttles there. Also... I met Xuanqing there. I suppose you know her?
yakita:Side_GMXQ_30_4.zh: 嗯，有些云梭坠落在那，而且……我还见到了璇情，你应该知道她是谁吧？
yakita:Side_GMXQ_30_4.speaker: Rover

yakita:Side_GMXQ_34_2.chapter: 剧情_3_7_支线_历程记忆手册_故梦寻契_34_1
yakita:Side_GMXQ_34_2.text: It really is... Aren't you going to introduce those two to me, Suoming?
yakita:Side_GMXQ_34_2.zh: 是啊……锁暝，你不和我说说这两人吗？
yakita:Side_GMXQ_34_2.speaker: Rover

yakita:Side_XJBGZMTX_15_6.text: Now I remember. You're workers at the Tiger's Maw Mine.
yakita:Side_XJBGZMTX_15_6.zh: 我想起来了，你们是虎口矿场的工人。
yakita:Side_XJBGZMTX_15_6.speaker: Rover

yakita:Side_XJBGZMTX_18_2.text: By pure coincidence, they mistook those siblings from the Tiger's Maw for me and kidnapped them under the cover of night.
yakita:Side_XJBGZMTX_18_2.zh: 机缘巧合之下，他们将来自今州虎口矿场的兄妹误认为是我，趁夜晚将他们绑架。
yakita:Side_XJBGZMTX_18_2.speaker: Rover

yakita:Side_YGJJ_5_6.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_下半后日谈阳光季节_1_5
yakita:Side_YGJJ_5_6.text: I'm not talking about physical exhaustion, Sigrika.
yakita:Side_YGJJ_5_6.zh: 我说的不是身体上的疲惫，西格莉卡。
yakita:Side_YGJJ_5_6.speaker: Rover

yakita:Side_YJYAHXWJ_50_1.text: When did the saboteurs' organization infiltrate Xuanfang Hold?
yakita:Side_YJYAHXWJ_50_1.zh: 破坏者所属的组织是什么时候潜入玄方城的？
yakita:Side_YJYAHXWJ_50_1.speaker: Rover

yakita:zhuiyuejie_first_27_3.text: My name is Xiangli Yao, and this is the Rover. I apologize for the unannounced visit, ma'am.
yakita:zhuiyuejie_first_27_3.zh: 我叫相里要，这位是漂泊者，突然叨扰您真是不好意思。
yakita:zhuiyuejie_first_27_3.speaker: Xiangli Yao

yakita:zhuiyuejie_first_32_23.text: Before that... Thank you, Xiangli Yao and 漂泊者.
yakita:zhuiyuejie_first_32_23.zh: 在那之前……相里要，漂泊者，谢谢你们了。

yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_25_11.text: Or maybe... he holds the key? Is it similar to what Scar did to me... No, I can't tell for sure yet.
yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_25_11.zh: 或者说……钥匙？会是和伤痕类似的情况吗……不，还不能下定论。
yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_25_11.speaker: Rover

yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_25_7.text: Sure, if you say so... Now back to the topic. We've been seeing Pascar and Xiangli Yao's past exclusively so far.
yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_25_7.zh: 不过有些奇怪……这些都是帕斯卡和相里要的经历。
yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_25_7.speaker: Rover

yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_25_9.text: But why can't we get through the "doors" before Xiangli Yao opens them?
yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_25_9.zh: 但为何每次只有通过相里要已经打开的“门”，我们才能继续前进？
yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_25_9.speaker: Rover

yakita:NPC_LCZ_25_2.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院列车站生态_41_1
yakita:NPC_LCZ_25_2.text: If you are heading to the Roya Frostlands, please do not board the departing section. Boarding this car will delay your journey.
yakita:NPC_LCZ_25_2.zh: 前往冰原的乘客，请不要进入分离车舱，以免耽误您的行程——

datamine:InfoDisplay_102181710_Text.title: Outpost Log
datamine:InfoDisplay_102181710_Text.text:
[…]

The Shimmer was not present, and Void Storm concentration remains within normal parameters.

[…]

I think our chances are pretty good—after all, the odds of finding something like this in the access-restricted Roya Frostlands were small to begin with, so it looks like our luck is holding up.

[…]

Even so, I'll keep running to minimize Voidmatter corruption to the FCR.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_102181710_Text.zh:
日志-332
记录者：阿穆
拂光没有出现，虚质磁暴浓度正常，但就在刚才，一场虚质磁暴突然发生，吞没了我们的站点。另外两位同事还没来得及行动就被卷入其中，多亏他们最后拉响了警报，我和塔维娅才勉强逃出了科考站。
我们的载具全都被磁暴吞没了。它还在不断扩大，我们被赶上只是时间问题。
……哈哈，听说有极少数人能从虚质磁暴中幸存，我们都碰上突发磁暴这样的小概率事件了，能不能干脆再碰上一次幸存的小概率事件？还有两天就放假了，我还想再回去和我妈打个电话。
磁暴迫近了，好在我找到了一个好东西。这东西大概是哪个研究员带来的冰上滑板。我打算赌一把，如果我们能从这个超级陡的坡上滑下去，说不定能在虚质磁暴吞没我们之前逃走。我觉得希望还是挺大的，毕竟罗伊冰原又不是开放景点，捡到这东西的概率可不高。
老妈，祝我好运。

日志-332-下半
记录者：塔维娅
阿穆被磁暴吞没了。我也快了。
那块滑板是坏的，所以才会被丢掉。我们光顾着检查它，错过了最好的逃跑时间。但就算我们不捡它，被磁暴吞没也只是时间问题……很遗憾，我们赌了一把，赌输了。
虚质磁暴的强度还在增加，我恐怕也逃不出去了。但我还会往前跑，尽可能减少虚质对频录装置的侵蚀。
希望这次虚质磁暴留下的数据，能为后来者做参考。
……
……
我的体温开始降低，手脚也不那么听使唤了。磁暴在减弱，可我已经没力气逃出去了。我打算再赌一把，把记录和我的频录装置从这里丢下去。
如果这份报告还能被完好地发现，那就证明我赌赢了。
科学与真理，祝我好运。

yakita:NPC_HBGC_33_8.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院华表广场_1_18
yakita:NPC_HBGC_33_8.text: Finally, the downward express of the Starward Riseway, straight from the frostlands to the Institute and Academy.
yakita:NPC_HBGC_33_8.zh: 对，最后一步就是联运椎骨的下行列车，从罗伊冰原转运至研究院和学院。

datamine:InfoDisplay_102189703_Text.title: Final Log
datamine:InfoDisplay_102189703_Text.text:
[…]

I am Sestan, a professor from Startorch Academy.

[…]

I was perched at a high point, recording data on the Void Storm.

[…]

In the Roya tribe, I witnessed the strength of the human spirit.

[…]

I will record my physical sensations and the frequency fluctuations, then upload the data to this Cassette and a data drive.

[…]

External sound...

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_102189703_Text.zh:
这大概是我最终的记录，还没正式介绍我的名字，我叫赛斯坦，星炬学院的教授。
我不知道接下来我将面临什么……
我原本坐在高处，记录对虚质磁暴的观测数据。在我调整仪器时，我看见一头机麋毫无意识地靠近那片扭曲的空间边缘。慢慢地，慢慢地，一股无形的力量瞬间攫住了它脆弱的生命。
那一刻，我没有思考。
没有权衡生命的价值，没有计算成功的概率，没有回顾我一生的罪孽与困惑。我的身体先于一切理性做出了反应。
我冲了过去，将机麋推了出来，而我被卷入其中。
人生真是一种戏剧。其实……我已经放下了自杀的念头，因为这段到达虚质磁暴前的旅途经历，因为我路途中遇见的你们。
在罗伊族的部落，我见证了人类的坚韧；在流民营地，我们都同为背叛者，从他们挣扎的生存中我理解了“宽恕”，每个人都在努力地活着，而我却抱着理想主义者的姿态在自甘堕落。
我的生命、理想曾偏离了轨道，所以……我此刻冲了过去，不仅仅是冲向死亡，也是让我与科学最初的精神重逢：守护生命，无论它多么渺小。
在完全消散前，我会尽量保持清醒，记录下我的人体感受与频率数据变化，然后上传到磁带，还有一块数据盘，是我这段时间的观测报告，我希望这些能够帮上你们。
体温正常……手腕还能活动……脚，嗯……似乎开始失去知觉了……
………………
已经过去了二十三分钟……
…………
呼……死亡，是这么安静的事吗？以前总觉得学生们太吵闹，现在，哈哈，有些怀念起来了……
外界的声音……正在迅速衰减……
呼……声音消失之后，轮到光了吗……
我终于……回家了……

yakita:FGGQDJX_8_16.chapter: 剧情_3_3_支线_拂光搁浅的旧讯_9_1
yakita:FGGQDJX_8_16.text: To answer your question, we met at the Sealed Fissure, not far from here. It was a girl. She looked like a Roya student. Very pale, with a distinct carving on her arm. That's all I can tell you.
yakita:FGGQDJX_8_16.zh: 你刚才的问题……交易地点就在封存地，离这不远，样貌……是一位脸色苍白的罗伊族女学生，手臂上有刻痕，我只记得这些。

yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_31_9.chapter: 剧情_七丘_列奥尼达广场生态_4_4
yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_31_9.text: That rainy night, you carried me in your arms and carved a way through the TD Outbreak in the Sanguis Plateaus. To this day, people still talk about how the Odle Family stole an orphan right back from death's grip.
yakita:GNNPC_LANDGC_31_9.zh: 那年的雨夜，您抱着我在桑古伊斯狩原的残象潮中奔驰，所有人都记得，奥德家族曾经从死亡的手中夺回了一个遗孤。

yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_43_1.text: You're a quick learner! Won't be long before you can start heading out to the Sanguis Plateaus.
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_43_1.zh: 你的成绩进步很快。估计再过不久，就能被派往桑古伊斯狩原执行任务了。

yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_44_1.text: When's our next Sanguis Plateaus mission, Captain?
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_44_1.zh: 队长，我们下次什么时候去桑古伊斯狩原啊？

yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_4_1.text: Captain Drusus, when will we be assigned field missions? I've done pretty much everything there is to do around the Citadel. I think it's about time we get to see some action. I've always had an interest in recon missions in the Sanguis Plateaus...
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_4_1.zh: 德鲁苏斯长官，什么时候能给我们分配到要塞外执勤的任务啊？要塞内的工作我都熟悉了，也该去外面看看了吧……我觉得桑古伊斯狩原的侦查任务就挺不错的。

yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_7_1.text: I know you've probably already gone over this in your manual, but there are things I still need to remind you again before you head out to the Sanguis Plateaus.
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_7_1.zh: 虽然你可能之前已经从手册上学习了，但在前往桑古伊斯狩原执行任务前，我还是有几件事想再三叮嘱下。
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_7_1.speaker: Santolicus

yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_8_1.text: Let me guess, you're chomping at the bit thinking about getting out on the Sanguis Plateaus and proving yourself hunting TDs that you're not even interested in any other missions, am I right?
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_8_1.zh: 你这家伙满脑子都想着去桑古伊斯狩原狩猎残象证明自己，别的任务都无心执行了吧？
yakita:GNNPC_QQYS_8_1.speaker: Santolicus

yakita:GNNPC_SJYD_21_3.chapter: 剧情_七丘_建设中的狮鹫营地生态_2_11
yakita:GNNPC_SJYD_21_3.text: The Sanguis Plateaus is very dangerous now. We shouldn't rush in without being fully prepared.
yakita:GNNPC_SJYD_21_3.zh: 现在的桑古伊斯狩原十分危险，没有做好万全的准备，绝不能贸然踏入。

yakita:GNNPC_SJYD_3_1.chapter: 剧情_七丘_建设中的狮鹫营地生态_1_3
yakita:GNNPC_SJYD_3_1.text: ...Okay, I've noted your feedback. You can take a break, and I'll submit the Sanguis Plateaus report for you.
yakita:GNNPC_SJYD_3_1.zh: ……好的，你反馈的情况我都记下了。先在这里休息会儿吧，桑古伊斯狩原的报告我会替你上交的。

yakita:GNNPC_SJYD_5_1.chapter: 剧情_七丘_建设中的狮鹫营地生态_1_5
yakita:GNNPC_SJYD_5_1.text: You're a new guest, right? Although you look pretty strong, I still don't think you should go to the Sanguis Plateaus unprepared.
yakita:GNNPC_SJYD_5_1.zh: 您是刚来这附近的客人吧？虽然看您身手不凡，但我还是不建议您贸然前往桑古伊斯狩原。

yakita:GNNPC_SJYD_5_7.chapter: 剧情_七丘_建设中的狮鹫营地生态_1_5
yakita:GNNPC_SJYD_5_7.text: We will head to the Sanguis Plateaus again to hunt soon. If the situation improves, the next time we meet will be when we're on the hunt.
yakita:GNNPC_SJYD_5_7.zh: 不久后，我们就会再次前往桑古伊斯狩原行猎。如果情况有所好转的话，下次见面就是一同行猎的时候了。

yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_10_1.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府内生态_2_1
yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_10_1.text: Speaking of which, I've never been to the Sanguis Plateaus myself…
yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_10_1.zh: 说起来我还从来没有去过桑古伊斯狩原……

yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_7_8.chapter: 剧情_七丘_总督府内生态_1_7
yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_7_8.text: Normally, it takes three to four weeks to schedule an audience with Her Excellency. However, given the urgency of the hunt in the Sanguis Plateaus, that rule doesn't apply to you.
yakita:GNNPC_ZDGXZ_7_8.zh: 通常与总督会面需要提前三至四周进行预约，但鉴于您所需交涉的是有关狩原的要事，可以不受这条条例的影响。

yakita:ItemInfo_42601290_BgDescription.text:
A rare flower found only in the Sanguis Plateaus, said to glow like moonlight in the dark.
"O warriors, should shadow steal the moon, look down, and the Sliverglow Bloom still shines beneath your feet."
yakita:ItemInfo_42601290_BgDescription.zh:
只在狩原生长的奇特花种，夜晚会散发出酷似月华的光亮。
“战士啊，如果阴霾将月光阻隔，不妨低头见月吧。”

yakita:ItemInfo_42601300_BgDescription.text:
A rare bloom found only in the Sanguis Plateaus, said to thrive where warriors have shed their blood.
When Gladiators die a glorious death in Septimont's wild hunts, their companions often place a Luminous Calendula at their graves as a solemn tribute to their courage and sacrifice.
yakita:ItemInfo_42601300_BgDescription.zh:
只在狩原生长的奇特花种，传说只在勇士用热血浇灌的大地上盛开。
来到七丘狩猎的角斗士们，若英勇战死，则会由同伴摘一朵辉光金盏放在墓前以寄哀思。

yakita:Term750004_Desc.text: Located on the outskirts of the city of Septimont, it's the "air terminal" where Gladiators cross the canyons and make their trip to and from the Sanguis Plateaus.
yakita:Term750004_Desc.zh: 位于七丘城近郊，为角斗士们横越狭渊、往返桑古伊斯狩原的“空行节点”。

yakita:Term750008_Desc.text: The mainland of Septimont and the Sanguis Plateaus are separated by a narrow and long waterway.
yakita:Term750008_Desc.zh: 七丘主岛与桑古伊斯狩原之间的狭长海域。

yakita:Term750010_Desc.text:
The ruins of a bygone civilization, said to be hidden deep beneath the Sanguis Plateaus. Its entrance is located in the Wastelands. Long ago, it was visited by the three Heroes of Heroes from Septimont.
Legend has it that those who manage to set foot in Manes Deep can hear the whispers of the Heroes of Heroes and thereby gain powers rivaling their own. Some also hold that since the Heroes of Heroes walked this place, the journey to Manes Deep has become an inescapable trial for any who would claim that title.
yakita:Term750010_Desc.zh:
相传藏于桑古伊斯狩原地下深处的前代文明遗迹，入口位于受蚀地区域，曾是七丘三位英雄王的造访之所。
传说进入玛涅斯之底者，能聆听到英雄王们的低语，并由此获得堪比英雄王的力量。亦有人称，正因历代英雄王皆踏足于此，玛涅斯之底即为英雄成王的必由之路。

yakita:Term750016_Desc.text: A lost Gladiator town located in the Wastelands at lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus.
yakita:Term750016_Desc.zh: 位于桑古伊斯狩原下层受蚀地的失落角斗士小镇。

yakita:GNNPC_SJYDXZ_2_11.text: Okay, let's not stick around too long. I don't know why, but the Sanguis Plateaus give me the creeps…
yakita:GNNPC_SJYDXZ_2_11.zh: 嗯，还是早点回去吧。不知道为什么，我总觉得桑古伊斯狩原那边阴森森的……

yakita:GNNPC_SJYDXZ_4_1.text: The Sanguis Plateaus... The travel guide says we're not allowed to go, right?
yakita:GNNPC_SJYDXZ_4_1.zh: 桑古伊斯狩原……按照旅游手册上所说的，我们是不被允许前往吗？

yakita:Guide_SYZL_3_2.text: And just like that, we can enjoy some momentary peace in the Sanguis Plateaus.
yakita:Guide_SYZL_3_2.zh: 这样一来，桑古伊斯狩原就能平静一阵子了。

yakita:MapMark_150201_MarkDesc.text: Look for Lillibet's divination memories in Sanguis Plateaus.
yakita:MapMark_150201_MarkDesc.zh: 在狩原寻找有关莉莉贝的占卜回忆。

yakita:MapMark_321001_MarkDesc.text: A Dreamscape Node on the Sanguis Plateaus. Complete the challenge to purify this Node and obtain rewards.
yakita:MapMark_321001_MarkDesc.zh: 桑古伊斯狩原地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可净化该节点，获得奖励。

yakita:NPC_SYYD_1_5_1.chapter: 剧情_狩原_桑古伊斯狩原_狩猎者营地_2_2
yakita:NPC_SYYD_1_5_1.text: The Sanguis Plateaus… It stretches even farther than I imagined.
yakita:NPC_SYYD_1_5_1.zh: 桑古伊斯狩原……居然比我想象中还要辽阔。

yakita:Flow_11000004_144.text: Why give up just because Sanhua turned you down?
yakita:Flow_11000004_144.zh: 怎么能因为被散华大人拒绝了就放弃呢？

yakita:Flow_11000004_150.text: I did see Sanhua though! Just a fleeting glance, but it was her!
yakita:Flow_11000004_150.zh: 我可是见到散华大人了！她就看了我一眼，就一眼！

yakita:Flow_11000004_17.text: But those rejected by Lady Sanhua just won’t leave.
yakita:Flow_11000004_17.zh: 不过那些被散华大人拒绝了的人怎么都不愿意离开？

yakita:Flow_11000004_30.text: Lady Sanhua. Don’t you think there’s something... strange about her?
yakita:Flow_11000004_30.zh: 散华，你有没有觉得她有些……奇怪？

yakita:Flow_11000004_72.text: No, you need approval or permission from Sanhua before you can see the Magistrate.
yakita:Flow_11000004_72.zh: 不行，必须得经过批准或者有散华大人的许可，你才能觐见令尹大人。
yakita:Flow_11000004_72.speaker: Shuhe

yakita:Flow_11000004_82.text: Guarding City Hall is a duty given to us by the Magistrate and Sanhua, and we take it seriously.
yakita:Flow_11000004_82.zh: 令尹和散华大人把守护边庭的职责交给我们，我们就得做好。
yakita:Flow_11000004_82.speaker: Shuhe

yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_21.text: Currently, she's likely at the ferry terminal in Whining Aix's Mire. I'll reach out to her.
yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_21.zh: 眼下……她大概在怨鸟泽附近的渡口，稍后我会传讯于她。
yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_15_21.speaker: Sanhua

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_7_11.text: "Sanhua has eight hundred matters to handle simultaneously," she wrote… That's impossible. Not even the Academy's computers could do that.
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_7_11.zh: “同时有八百件事等着散华去处理”，哪怕是研究院开发的终端，也不可能同时处理这么多工作吧……
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_7_11.speaker: Sanhua

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_7_2.text: Hi, Sanhua. Are you here for the Moonlit Fair?
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_7_2.zh: 散华？你也是来逛宵月会的吗？

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_7_35.text: There's a special lotus seed called Twin Lotus Seed, found near lakes in the Whining Aix's Mire.
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_7_35.zh: 是一种名为“双生莲实”的特殊莲实，它们一般生长在怨鸟泽深处，有残象活动的危险湖泊。
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_7_35.speaker: Sanhua

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_9_19.text: Soon, Sanhua effortlessly recreates the Plumpcake with her incredible talents.
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_9_19.zh: 片刻之后，散华以行云流水的刀法和出神入化的技巧完美还原了每一个制作团圆饼的步骤。

yakita:Flow_313700000_5.text: Sanhua looks at you, surprised. It was a bit cold when you approached her, but your warmth quickly dispels it.
yakita:Flow_313700000_5.zh: 散华有些惊讶地看着你，走近时的确有些寒冷，但你的体温很快便把它们驱散了。

yakita:Flow_313700000_55.text: Snow? You watch her turn around, putting her guard up to protect you. This is Sanhua's dream, you realize.
yakita:Flow_313700000_55.zh: 雪？你看着她背过身去，做好了防御架势，似乎是想要保护你，你明白了这是属于散华的梦境。

yakita:Flow_6700000_92.text: Are you talking about Sanhua? She does seem quite cold and aloof.
yakita:Flow_6700000_92.zh: 是散华么？她好像是挺冷的

yakita:HuanglongM1_1_22_41.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第一幕_嘤鸣初相召_3_5
yakita:HuanglongM1_1_22_41.text: For some reason, you can tell Sanhua doesn't want to continue this topic.
yakita:HuanglongM1_1_22_41.zh: 不知道为何，你能感受到散华并不想继续这个话题。

yakita:HuanglongM1_1_6_6.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第一幕_嘤鸣初相召_2_3
yakita:HuanglongM1_1_6_6.text: I got to see... Lady Sanhua! She even looked back at me!
yakita:HuanglongM1_1_6_6.zh: 我可是见到了——散华大人呢！散华大人看了我一眼！

yakita:HuanglongM1_1_6_7.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第一幕_嘤鸣初相召_2_3
yakita:HuanglongM1_1_6_7.text: And I even got Lady Sanhua's verbal assurance... That I wasn't the guest the Magistrate was waiting for!
yakita:HuanglongM1_1_6_7.zh: 而且散华大人可是亲口——确认了我不是那位客人！

yakita:HuanglongM1_1_6_9.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第一幕_嘤鸣初相召_2_3
yakita:HuanglongM1_1_6_9.text: I was able to witness Lady Sanhua in the flesh and be rejected by her in person!
yakita:HuanglongM1_1_6_9.zh: 我可是亲眼见到了散华大人并被她亲口拒绝了的啊！

yakita:HuanglongM1_1_7_9.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第一幕_嘤鸣初相召_1_7
yakita:HuanglongM1_1_7_9.text: The few that made it inside said it only took "one freezing look from Lady Sanhua", and they were compelled to leave.
yakita:HuanglongM1_1_7_9.zh: 但前去的人似乎都说是“被散华大人看了一眼，就像被定住了”。然后就被一句话劝返了。
yakita:HuanglongM1_1_7_9.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:HuanglongM1_1_9_2.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第一幕_嘤鸣初相召_3_2
yakita:HuanglongM1_1_9_2.text: Pleased to make your acquaintance. I apologize for the delay. My name is Sanhua, the bodyguard of Madam Magistrate.
yakita:HuanglongM1_1_9_2.zh: 抱歉让您久候，初次见面，我是令尹近卫，散华。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_70_40.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第四幕_奔策候残星_4_1
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_70_40.text: As you anticipated, Scar did not try to kill them... Yes, I stayed out of it like you asked.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_70_40.zh: 和您推断的一样，伤痕并没有伤害到他们……嗯，依照您的意思，我没有出手。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_70_40.speaker: Sanhua

yakita:ItemInfo_41400114_BgDescription.text: The card in Scar's hand with the mark of a black sheep. The flame attached to it seems to never extinguish. That flame will burn forever with Scar's never-ending desire for destruction.
yakita:ItemInfo_41400114_BgDescription.zh: 伤痕的手中带有黑羊标记的卡牌，其上附着的烈焰仿佛永远不会熄灭。而那股烈焰将与伤痕永不止息的破坏欲望一道永远燃烧。

yakita:Flow_313900000_396.chapter: 剧情_1_1_肉鸽_伤痕剧情_残星会房间_2_2
yakita:Flow_313900000_396.text: Scar's flame consumes you. You drift into unconsciousness. Time passes...
yakita:Flow_313900000_396.zh: 你被伤痕释放的烈焰吞噬，渐渐失去了意识。不知过了多久……

yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_401_19.chapter: 剧情_2_7_黎那汐塔主线_下半_4_5
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_401_19.text: Speaking of which, Scar should be in Septimont now.
yakita:HRT_Rinascita_Interludes_401_19.zh: 不过这个时候伤痕应该在七丘吧。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_198_72.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第四幕_奔策候残星_1_38
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_198_72.text: Scar reveals the moral of the tale he has spun for you. He believes himself to be the rule-breaking black lamb. It is clear where his allegiances lie, and you decide you have heard enough...
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_198_72.zh: 伤痕将故事的真相和盘托出，作为始作俑者他却自称是打破规则的“黑羊”，已经没有必要再聊下去了，这样的恶徒必须得到制裁。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_60_3.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第四幕_奔策候残星_6_1
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_60_3.text: If you need to hear it from me, then... Yes, I am Scar.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_60_3.zh: 如果你需要我再自我介绍一遍……是的，我是伤痕。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_60_3.speaker: Scar

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_60_65.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第四幕_奔策候残星_6_1
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_60_65.text: The mysterious man, whose name is Scar, doesn't attack you. He invites you to investigate the village with your own eyes to uncover the truths beneath the surface.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_60_65.zh: 你眼前这个名叫伤痕的男人并没有发起攻击，相反，他似乎想要招揽你，并且看起来非常有把握。他邀请你继续调查这个村子，用你自己的眼睛去发掘惨案背后的真相。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_61_29.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第四幕_奔策候残星_1_4
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_61_29.text: You demand the truth, but Scar refuses. Clearly, revealing it to you directly holds no thrills for him.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_61_29.zh: 你想让伤痕直接告诉你关于村子的真相，但他明显觉得这样实在太无趣了。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_62_14.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第四幕_奔策候残星_1_5
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_62_14.text: You find a diary page that once belonged to a little girl, a wanderer who finally found refuge in this village. The entries hint at unsettling truths. Scar, with an air of detachment, shares a fable of wolves and sheep.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_62_14.zh: 你发现了一张日记纸，它的主人是一个孩子。她似乎一直在流浪并最终在此定居，内容中隐约能感觉一些异样的描述，伤痕轻飘飘地讲起了一个有关狼与羊的寓言故事，听起来意有所指。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_63_19.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第四幕_奔策候残星_1_6
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_63_19.text: You find more notes. Scar continues with his tale about a shepherd providing for the lambs in exchange for their loyalty. He asks whether you would bow to authority to get what you want. You tell him that all are equal.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_63_19.zh: 你找到了更多纸条，伤痕也在继续他的故事。牧羊人为小羊们带来了食物与庇护，而他要的只是小羊们摇尾乞怜。伤痕问你是否会甘愿低头向上位者乞讨，而你回答道人与人是平等的。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_70_3.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第四幕_奔策候残星_4_1
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_70_3.text: I shattered Scar's illusion. That should've injured him.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_70_3.zh: 我打破了他的幻境，他应该也受伤了。
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_70_3.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_70_30.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第四幕_奔策候残星_4_1
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_70_30.text: Yes, that is a possibility, since Scar had been here before...
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_70_30.zh: 有可能，毕竟伤痕曾经也来过这里……
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_70_30.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_70_50.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第四幕_奔策候残星_4_1
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_70_50.text: After Scar's defeat, a mysterious woman in red comes to his aid. You share the events with Yangyang and realize that you need to find the actual location of Scar's tale to determine its truth.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_4_70_50.zh: 战败的伤痕被神秘的红衣女子救走，你也将刚刚的经历告诉了秧秧，现在只有找到“仪式”真正发生的地点，才能佐证这是否是伤痕的一面之词。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_73_39.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第五幕_庭际刀刃鸣_1_1
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_73_39.text: Plus, even if Scar really tried to kill us...
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_73_39.zh: 而且，就算伤痕出了真招……

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_5_73_58.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第五幕_庭际刀刃鸣_1_1

datamine:InfoDisplay_102801033_Text.title: Research Memo–CT1946
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801033_Text.text:
[…]

The only comfort is that my consciousness will be kept still too, so I'll stay sane during this long slumber.

[…]

That one once helped us develop the technology of [data corrupted], helped us reconstruct what was a tiny chip of the Sentinel's supreme power.

[…]

Will that one compare our research to child's play, with that scorn theirs?

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801033_Text.zh:
日期：[---]
测试，测试。啊，很好！至少记录功能还没坏掉。
我，最后的研究主管，维克托·克里斯托弗，以我自己的名义主持该实验，在没有先例，没有动物实验，甚至都没有伦理审查的前提下。事实上，做出这选择简直是在折磨我所剩不多的科学素养。但我……没那个条件，也没那个时间了。其他人都不在了，除了我之外，这里只剩下卡莱伯——那个助理AI。
但我还是要把我马上要做的事记下来。这算不上实验，最多只是我这么一个老头子的妄想和不甘心，所以就不写正式的实验日志了。希望找到这份备忘录的人不要见怪。
我准备了好几台驻流仪，为了防止它对能源系统造成过于庞大的负担，我决定过载它们——理论上来说，这会形成一个持续的，不可逆的独立时间泡，把我像琥珀里的昆虫一样包裹在里面。说实话，我不想称之为永生，这更像是活生生给自己判了无期徒刑。好在我的意识也会随之静止，不会在漫长的时间中发疯。
至于我为什么要这么做，而不是平静地迎接死亡？因为……我要等待那个人回来。
那个人曾经帮我们突破过[数据损坏]的技术壁垒，帮我们窃取了岁主那至高无上的权柄中微不足道的碎片，让我们得以短暂地一窥神明的世界。我只是想……再见那个人一面。即使对方也给不了我们想要的答案。
到时候，那个人看到我这个行将就木的愚蠢老头，会说什么呢？骂我是个无可救药的蠢货？带着不屑否定我们那如同儿戏的研究？还是……看着我们的棺椁，感慨我们做得不错？
我不知道。已经过去太久了，我的记忆早已模糊。那个人如此温柔，但又如此冷漠——至少我记忆中残留的那些东西是这么告诉我的。
好了，时候到了。我该进琥珀里了。我们一万年后，或者……立刻见面，朋友们。反正对我来说，都一样。

datamine:InfoDisplay_102900004_Text.title: Secret Diary - II
datamine:InfoDisplay_102900004_Text.text:
Today once again there is a temporary memory gap, and occasionally I can still hear a faint voice, like ...... Sentinel.
This feeling is like inadvertent drowning, the body continues to sink, the waters gradually isolate the external sound, suffocation enveloped the whole body.
After telling Sentinel about this matter, it always said that it was my hallucination, hmm, surely again in the perfunctory me.
datamine:InfoDisplay_102900004_Text.zh:
今天再次出现暂时性的记忆空白，偶尔还能听到微弱的声音，像是……岁光。
这种感觉就像是不慎溺水，身体不断下沉，水域渐渐隔绝外界的声响，窒息感笼罩着全身。
把此事告诉岁光后，它总说是我的幻听，哼，肯定又在敷衍我。

datamine:InfoDisplay_201001103_Text.title: Memory Fragment 2
datamine:InfoDisplay_201001103_Text.text: On the forty-second full moon of my knighthood, a young man stabbed the right of my abdomen. In retaliation, I took his life. The Order rewarded my killings and celebrated my bloodlust. Yet Sentinel, if my words reach you, I beg for clarity: is mercy the path to saving grace or a swift descent into an early grave?
datamine:InfoDisplay_201001103_Text.zh: 受封骑士后的第四十二次满月，一位少年刺中我的右腹。我还击，夺走了他的生命。修会嘉奖我的杀戮，歌颂我的暴行。可岁主啊，您是否能听到我的呼唤？怜悯究竟是我的通行证，还是我的墓志铭？

datamine:InfoDisplay_201001104_Text.title: Memory Fragment 1
datamine:InfoDisplay_201001104_Text.text: On the first full moon of my knighthood, I was defeated by a band of Plushies. The big Plushie was more terrifying than I imagined—a slight hesitation almost cost me my life. I was lucky to survive. But Sentinel, I ask you to witness how I conquer my fear and become unyielding. Under your divine gaze, I will forge myself into the very embodiment of the Five Knightly Virtues!
datamine:InfoDisplay_201001104_Text.zh: 受封骑士后的第一个满月，我被几只布偶打败了。大个子的布偶比想象中恐怖，身体稍一畏惧就差点丧命，能活下来真是福大命大。哈，岁主啊，请见证吧！见证我克服恐惧，见证我所向披靡，见证我的践行五德，成为最棒的骑士！

datamine:InfoDisplay_201001105_Text.title: Memory Fragment 5
datamine:InfoDisplay_201001105_Text.text: On the hundred and forty-fourth full moon of my knighthood, I was ordered to write a book on an island—despite my illiteracy. I wanted to share my techniques for fighting Tacet Discords, but the Acolytes suggested I center my words around the Five Knightly Virtues. O Sentinel, perhaps you can't hear this, but in all my supposed wisdom, I might be the most foolish of all.
datamine:InfoDisplay_201001105_Text.zh: 受封骑士后的第一百四十四次满月，我被安排在岛上写书——哪怕我并不识字。我想分享与残象交战的技巧，但教士建议我只讲对骑士五德的理解。岁主啊，我估计说了你也听不到吧。被宣称有大智慧的我，也许才是那个最愚蠢的人？

datamine:InfoDisplay_201001106_Text.title: Memory Fragment 3
datamine:InfoDisplay_201001106_Text.text: On the ninetieth full moon of my knighthood, I was assigned to duel on the great bridge. Day after day, knights came to challenge me, only to fall again and again—all to hasten my so-called glory of a hundred victories. O Sentinel, do you hear me? The weight of honor grows heavier, yet my sword feels ever more brittle.
datamine:InfoDisplay_201001106_Text.zh: 受封骑士后的第九十次满月，我被安排在大桥上与人决斗，几名骑士每天变换着名号向我挑战又惨败于我，只为了帮我完成所谓百战百胜的荣誉。岁主啊，你听得到吗？我的荣誉越来越重，我的剑却越来越轻。

datamine:InfoDisplay_201001107_Text.title: Memory Fragment 4
datamine:InfoDisplay_201001107_Text.text: On the ninety-fifth full moon of my knighthood, I managed to gather fifteen crates of donations. After giving dues to the Order and the family I serve, only five remained. Even with the three crates I donated... No, it's not enough. It's nowhere near enough! O Sentinel, please enlighten me: why do the greediest souls always hide behind the banner of generosity?
datamine:InfoDisplay_201001107_Text.zh: 受封骑士后的第九十五次满月。这次一共募集到十五箱，上缴修会及打点家族后还剩五箱。就算加上我的那三箱……不够，这点根本不够！岁主啊，您听得到吗？站在慷慨大旗下的，为何总是最贪婪的灵魂？

yakita:InfoDisplay_35000114_Text.text:
To the Revered Sentinel,

I am deeply moved and honored to have received your invitation and to be favored by your recognition.

As merchants, our calling is to gather the strength of the masses to build communities and unite the hearts of many to foster thriving markets. If we might follow in the footsteps of the wise and virtuous to help alleviate the burdens of the realm, it would be the utmost aspiration, and indeed, the greatest privilege, of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild.

Please accept this humble reply. May you preserve your precious health. 

With highest regards,

Suisui
Zhaoming Commerce Guild
yakita:InfoDisplay_35000114_Text.zh:
承蒙岁主垂青，赐帖相召，感慨万千。
从商之人，聚众力而成城，联万心而为市。若能附诸贤之骥尾，分天下忧患，此昭明之愿也，亦之幸也。
先此奉复，伏惟珍重。

昭明商会，穗穗敬上。

yakita:FavorWord_110603_Content.text: Hey, here's a secret–but don't go blabbing to anyone else. If you recite "Master Youhu's Poem Collection" by the City Hall, the Sentinel will totally bless you. Well, maybe it won't... but hey, at least *I'll* totally help you…
yakita:FavorWord_110603_Content.zh: 嘘！我听说呀，到边庭附近朗诵《釉瑚大师诗选》，就会得到岁主保佑哦！没骗你，真的真的！岁主保不保佑不知道，至少我肯定无条件帮你嘛……

datamine:InfoDisplay_161000001_Text.title: Tarnished Sword Tomb
datamine:InfoDisplay_161000001_Text.text:
[…]

Us old outlaws, ██ for decades, picking up weapons again to guard Septimont.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_161000001_Text.zh:
（剑冢上的文字留有刻意被抹除的痕迹）

孩子们的呜咽在角鳄的吼叫声中无助颤抖。泰娅她说得没错，那怪物确实是朝着这里来的……真混蛋啊，它是注意到████了吗？
我们还有逃跑的能力，但那些孩子们不行——他们翻不过沟壑。等角鳄突破城墙，等待他们的结局不言而喻。
……我们虽然曾为了一时利益出卖过自己的良心，但早已跪地献出时间将其赎回。
██真是造化弄人啊……谁又能想到我们这些███几十年的老家伙们还有为保护七丘重新拿起武器的那一天呢？
老麦哲的腰已经比他握在手里的刀还要弯了，贝肯那家伙也是，陪他征战多年的长枪如今被当成了支撑的拐棍，走起路一瘸一拐的活像个浮灵偶……当然我自己也没好到哪里去……现在眼睛花了，不知道枪法的准度还能有做██时的几成……
想当年我们一个个可都是████……唉，岁月真是不饶人啊。
在出发前我们挑选了一个年纪稍大的孩子带在身边。万一，我是说万一……万一我们████也好争取些时间，他可以趁此跑回去通风报信，早点带着其余的孩子们逃跑。
██的声音愈发接近了。走吧，我亲爱的老对手们，是时候前往██战场了。
祝你，祝我，祝所有人行猎愉快。

datamine:InfoDisplay_161000003_Text.title: Tarnished Sword Tomb
datamine:InfoDisplay_161000003_Text.text:
(Though some parts of the sword tomb have been weathered, the inscription remains clear.)
 
To the twelve valiant souls who laid down their lives to shield Septimont from disaster.
 
Were it not for your courage in the face of the Kerasaurs' threat, we would have perished beneath their claws.
 
Out of reverence for your will, we have shrouded your names and identities, erecting this sword tomb to ensure your sacrifice is never lost to the ages.
 
We shall forever remember you. And so, we who were saved by your valor make this vow:
 
Should the Kerasaur rise again to threaten Septimont, we, or our descendants, shall rise to meet it. We shall defend this land as you once did, carrying forth your spirit.
 
This oath shall endure, untarnished by time.
datamine:InfoDisplay_161000003_Text.zh:
（剑冢的部分区域已经磨蚀难辨，唯有刻下的文字依旧清晰可见）

在此向为保护七丘而牺牲的十二名勇士献上敬意。如果没有你们的挺身而出，我们的性命可能早就葬身于那晚角鳄的利爪之下。
出于对你们意愿的尊重，我们特此将你们的名字和身份隐去，仅立下剑冢让后人铭记这段不该遗忘的历史。
你们的这份恩情我们不会忘记。在此，所有被救下的孩子们郑重起誓：
当威胁七丘的角鳄再度出现时，我们或是我们的后人会像你们一样为了七丘而战，将当年你们守护的精神再度传承。

这份誓言绝不会随时间流逝而褪色。

datamine:InfoDisplay_161000008_Text.title: Worn Journal of a Gladiator I
datamine:InfoDisplay_161000008_Text.text:
Every Gladiator in Septimont knows this place. It's where we hunt and test our mettle.

The dragon corpse lying out there draws in all sorts of TDs, beasts, and glory-chasing Gladiators like us. I've no doubt Flavio was here. I saw his breastplate in one of those old halls. His family sigil was split in half, perhaps his way of cutting ties with his House. I also couldn't help noticing the dents and gashes all over the armor, some deep, some just scratches. To us, those are medals.

Locals say this battered piece once belonged to a man who tamed a damn dragon, a Scourgewing. Faced it alone and made it submit to his will. While I was drowning in ale over my sister's death, Flavio was out in the wilds conquering with his sword. No one knows where he went with the dragon, but I know he's walking the path toward glory... He's becoming a legend.

A pack of Gladiators swaggered past me, fully armed. I overheard them talking. They were tracking a Scourgewing near the Border Mountains. But unlike Flavio, they weren't after a duel, only a dirty hunt.

They'll probably haul it back to the city and sell it off for a good price. That's all it is to them.
datamine:InfoDisplay_161000008_Text.zh:
这里是七丘知名的行猎与试炼之地，是只属于角斗士的殿堂。

横亘山野的巨龙尸体吸引来了各式各样的事物，残象、巨兽，以及渴求历练的角斗士。我确信弗拉维奥来过这里，因为我在一间礼堂里看到了他的胸甲。胸口处家族的徽饰被刻痕一分为二，代表着他和家族决裂的决心。但比刻痕更吸引人目光的，是遍布着铠甲的，长短不一的伤痕。那无异于角斗士的勋章。

我从旁人处得知，这件破烂不堪的铠甲，曾属于一位征服了龙的角斗士——他独自挑战了名为灾蝶龙的巨龙，并将它收为了仆从。原来，当我因妹妹病逝而在城里借酒消愁的时候，弗拉维奥正游荡在荒野，用他的剑征服所见之物。没人知道弗拉维奥带着灾蝶龙去了哪里，但我知道，他肯定正在通往荣耀的路上一往无前……他正在成为传奇。

一群角斗士模样的人经过了我，他们全副武装，姿态散漫。我留意了下这群人的交谈，他们盯上了在分界山出没的一只灾蝶龙。但与弗拉维奥不同，他们将要进行的并非人与龙的公正角斗，而是一场不择手段的围猎。

“作为珍稀品运到城里去，卖个好价钱”……这似乎是他们的目的。

datamine:InfoDisplay_161000009_Text.title: Worn Journal of a Gladiator II
datamine:InfoDisplay_161000009_Text.text:
[…]

After my sister passed, I tried to find him in Septimont.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_161000009_Text.zh:
……

可以确认的是，外面发生了神秘的灾害，附近的出入口都被某种异质的力量彻底封锁了。无论是我还是伊恩都无法脱身。耳边能听到诡异的低语声，靠着伤口的疼痛，我才维持着清醒。不出意外，这份日志将会成为我的遗书吧。

接下来记录的，是我长久以来的悔恨。我和弗拉维奥曾约定在大竞技场的冠军赛上相见，给过去的交锋画上完美的句号。决赛前夜，他的家族托了中间人找到我，希望我在必要时留一手。报酬比奖金更丰厚，他们许诺会给我重病的妹妹找到最优秀的医生。我答应了……其实我和那些围猎伊恩的人并无不同。结果是，我亲手玷污了这场神圣的角斗，低劣的演技也被弗拉维奥识破。他从未如此失望，对我，对家族，对竞技场。他自此离开了赛场，步入了荒野。

走出妹妹离世的阴影后，我在七丘的荒野寻找他的行踪，想要给当年的事情一个交代——我该还他一场全力以赴的角斗。写到这里，我才意识到自己的虚伪，驱使我行动的不仅是心中的忏悔，更是没有和他好好打一场的遗憾。现在看起来……已经不可能了。
 
我将日志交给了伊恩，它肯定活得比我久多了。若有后来者看到了这里……还请见证我利维斯最后的自白。我真诚地祝愿角斗士弗拉维奥，能够在荒野的求索中找到属于他的荣耀。

以呼嚎向所有追寻荣耀之人致意。

datamine:InfoDisplay_26010006_Text.title: A Letter with Nobility Seal
datamine:InfoDisplay_26010006_Text.text:
I never imagined I would come to learn your name, only to meet you at your grave.
You were unstoppable in the arena, yet they say you cherished nothing more than petting your Ta-da. You must have been a man of both power and heart.
Sleep well, my sweet Gladiator.
Our Ta-da wakes to another dawn, and so is our peaceful Septimont.
datamine:InfoDisplay_26010006_Text.zh:
没想到我才得知你的名字，再见面就是你的墓前。
听说你除了在赛场上所向披靡，平日最喜欢的就是摸摸啪嗒宝贝，你一定是个强大又温柔的男人吧。
睡吧，我的角斗士。
啪嗒和七丘的和平，又迎来了新的一天

datamine:InfoDisplay_26010101_Text.title: Notes Left Behind
datamine:InfoDisplay_26010101_Text.text:
Of the Three Heroes' Crest, besides the exploits of the Heroes of Heroes, there is another story seldom told.

A young gladiator once climbed the summit alone after a hunt. When he returned to the camp, his companions were astonished, for this "Dragon Slayer" bore upon his body more than a hundred wounds, large and small. He had clearly endured some dreadful battle, a trial beyond imagining.

The gladiator smiled wryly, admitting his defeat. Many remember this as the first failure of the "Flawless Hero." His second failure—the tragedy of Fabianum—would follow not long after.

That gladiator was Magno, the former Ephor of Septimont.
datamine:InfoDisplay_26010101_Text.zh:
关于三王峰，除了英雄王们的事迹外，还有一个鲜为人知的故事。

曾有一位年轻的角斗士在行猎后的深夜独自攀上了三王峰的峰顶。当他回到山脚处的营地，同伴们惊讶地发现，这位被人冠以「灭龙」之名的英雄，身上居然留下了大大小小上百处伤口。他显然经历了一次惊心动魄的战斗，一场令人难以想象的考验。

角斗士苦笑着承认了自己的败绩。这是许多人记忆里，这位“无瑕的英雄”的第一次失败。而他的第二次失败——法比亚纳的惨剧，即发生在不久之后。

他就是七丘的前任总督，马格诺。

yakita:InfoDisplay_103000001_Text.text:
Record No. 0018 (Internal) 
Submitted by: ███████ 
BS 000/1/00094* 
Tethys ID: A-000 (Archived)

...Is the tape running already? Oh, excuse me...

...Target data has been imported into Tethys, and the Stellar Matrix in question is temporarily designated as No. 001. The Matrix's equatorial coordinates in the Tethys System range from 08h 07.5m to 09h 10.7m in right ascension, and from 15.12° to -0.08° in declination...

According to our observations, Stellar Matrix No. 001 contains at least two pseudo-stars with a Lament magnitude exceeding 2.0. This means the source of our target data was destroyed by at least two near-catastrophic events, consistent with our observations.

Detailed data on 001α and 001β will be available after the data source is processed by the Shorekeeper...

...

All our knowledge, whether past, present, or future, pales in comparison to what we cannot know.
Looking back at Solaris-3 from the starry sky beyond, it may look like a mere pale blue dot. 
But it is also... our star. Our home.
Please, what should I do...
yakita:InfoDisplay_103000001_Text.zh:
总第0018号（内）
提审人：███████
BS 000/1/00094*
泰缇斯编号：A-000（已封存）
…………准备好了？哦，抱歉……
……目标数据导入泰缇斯系统后，构成星图编号暂定为001，星图在泰缇斯系统的赤道坐标系统的赤经位于08h 07.5m到09h 10.7m之间，赤纬在15.12°到-0.08°之间……
根据观测，001号星图至少拥有两颗超过2.0悲鸣星等的拟算恒星，也即目标数据源由至少两个准悲鸣级别的灾害摧毁，与实际情况相符。
关于001α、001β的详细数据，要等候数据源经由守岸人计算后得出…………
………………
我们所有的知识，无论是过去的、现在的、还是将来的，都远远比不上我们无法知道的。
从索拉里斯之外的星空回看这颗星球，也许也只是一颗小小的，蓝色的星星吧。
但这也是……我们的星星。
只是，我究竟该怎么做……
