yakita:ItemInfo_80001040_BgDescription.text:
Snacks kept by Youhu in her ice cauldron, always cool to the touch. 
It’s difficult for Youhu to find food and accommodations while she travels around Solaris hunting for antiquities. These tasty cakes are what keep her from starving at times like these.
Youhu likes to put fruits in the cauldron too. As a result, the moist crusts of the cakes always gives off the faint fragrance of the seasonal fruits.
yakita:ItemInfo_80001040_BgDescription.zh:
釉瑚存放在匣中冰鼎的零嘴，无论何时拿出都带着丝丝凉意。
追寻古物在索拉里斯各地旅行时，时常会有找不到食宿的时刻，小饼就成了她果腹的绝顶美味。
因为釉瑚喜爱往冰鼎中同时镇些水果，饼皮带着湿润的气息，隐隐有股果香，四时不同。

yakita:ItemInfo_9_BgDescription.text: Following the direction of the pointer, you travel on the land of Solaris-3, these journeys will never be forgotten.
yakita:ItemInfo_9_BgDescription.zh: 沿着指针的方向，你游历在索拉里斯的大地上，这些历程永远不会被遗忘。

yakita:Term850075_Desc.text: The term "Lament" refers to the ongoing catastrophic events on Solaris-3. Since the onset of the first Lament, the cycle of destruction has persisted relentlessly. The tide of devastation remains ceaseless, with no signs of stopping.
yakita:Term850075_Desc.zh:
「悲鸣」是索拉里斯一切灾变态势的统称。
人们牢记一切产生变化的时间，那是从第一声悲鸣开始，而「悲鸣」从未结束。
浪潮不止，悲鸣永不停歇。

yakita:Event_TMDZJ_2_18.text: And then... I was able to manifest in Solaris-3 and talk to you.
yakita:Event_TMDZJ_2_18.zh: 而我……我则经由这样的方式来到索拉里斯和你交流。

yakita:FavorWord_130501_Content.text: I first heard about you when my colleagues were discussing your physical. I was caught up in technical support back then, but wanted to meet you in person. Now, I am content to see that, as I predicted... you have the potential to shape Solaris-3's future in unforeseen ways.
yakita:FavorWord_130501_Content.zh: 最初听到有关你的消息，是同事们在谈论你的检测结果。那时候我忙于后方的技术支持，一直没来得及亲自见你。现在我很高兴，和预判的结果一样，你是能够为索拉里斯带来不可知性未来的存在。

yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110052_01.text: "This year, they voted my city the best place to live in Solaris-3. Main reasons? Lowest rates of violence, community satisfaction scores higher than anywhere else, and the most popular hero story ever. Can't deny it, it's all true. This city's always got a new promise for you—"
yakita:RogueRes_EventPlot_Des_110052_01.zh: “就在这一年，我们所在的城市被评为全索拉里斯最棒地区，主要原因包括……最低的犯罪率，满意指数第一的社区环境，还有最受欢迎的英雄故事——令人惊叹？但事实的确如此，这座城市总是会给人新的希望——”

yakita:ZYFZDDDA_35_2.chapter: 剧情_3_0_支线_只有风知道的答案_9_1
yakita:ZYFZDDDA_35_2.text: The light from those stars traversed countless cold nights to reach Solaris-3. By the time we finally reach that sea of stars, they will not look the same anymore.
yakita:ZYFZDDDA_35_2.zh: 那些星光穿过无数寒冷的黑夜才来到索拉里斯，也许等我们真正抵达那片星海，它们早就不是原来的模样了。

yakita:MapMark_3310001_MarkDesc.text: Seek out the lost Soliskin and bring the Soliseeds you gather to Solisia Landing. There, the Giant Soliskin will convert the Soliseed's energy back to the Solvein Canopy, allowing new Soliskin to be born.
yakita:MapMark_3310001_MarkDesc.zh: 找到走失的日灵，并将收集到的青实交还给落日堤屿上的巨日灵吧。巨日灵会将青实转为能量送还给日脉悬林……在那里新的日灵将会诞生。

yakita:MapMark_3340011_MarkDesc.text: The Void Storm Zone I in Solisia Landing. Inside, the remnants of all things are warped into refracted echoes of Voidmatter, re-emerging into this world...
yakita:MapMark_3340011_MarkDesc.zh: 位于落日堤屿的虚质磁暴Ⅰ区。虚质磁暴区内，万物的残留化作虚质折射的映像，于此间浮现……

yakita:LHYSTTHZB_9_3.text: But when the Luminous River runs downstream, it carries Soliskin blessings. When it runs upstream, it nourishes the living green.
yakita:LHYSTTHZB_9_3.zh: 但流光河的水到了下游会承载日灵，到了上游，又恩泽了植被。

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_26_4.text: Somnoire breaks into world. My authority... lost.
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_26_4.zh: 心之集域，侵入现实，我的权限，失去了喵。

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_9_7.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_4_肉鸽主线剧情_1_15
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_9_7.text: In the Whining Aix's Mire, you encounter a white cat that escaped the Somnoire by train. It asks you to enter a mysterious gateway...
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_9_7.zh: 在怨鸟泽，你遇见了乘坐列车逃出心之集域的白猫。它拜托你进入门中……

yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_4_5.text: I was about to contact you... It's about the Somnoire.
yakita:Main_LahaiRoi_BYHM_4_5.zh: 我刚好要找你……是关于心之集域的事。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_7.text: I came here to resolve the anomaly in the Somnoire. Based on what I know, my investigation won't move forward until this train reaches its final stop.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_101_7.zh: 我是为解决心之集域异变而来，按目前的推测，只有列车到达终点停下，我才能进一步调查。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_114_11.text:
"Day 754 in the Somnoire..."
Day 28 in the Somnoire.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_114_11.zh: 这是我在心之集域的第754天/第28天。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_132_12.text: Not good. It's that same pain from when I first entered the Somnoire.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_132_12.zh: 不好，刚进心之集域时的那股疼痛感又来了。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_10.text: A blank canvas means endless possibilities. Maybe the Somnoire knows how much you love diarying, so it gave you a blank page.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_140_10.zh: 空白也意味着我们有无限的可能性，心之集域也许知道你喜欢写日记，所以它给了我们一张白纸让我们去描绘。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_15_1.text: (Something isn't right about the way it's acting. Is the Somnoire anomaly affecting it?)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_15_1.zh: （总觉得它的状态有些奇怪，是心之集域的异常影响了它吗？）

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_213_12.text: Time flows differently in the Somnoire compared to the real world. When she left, I aligned the time difference between both worlds to roughly two days.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_213_12.zh: 心之集域与现实的时间流速不同，她离开时，我把两个世界的时差调整到两天左右。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_21_13.text: (Was that just another one of the Somnoire's illusions? Or is someone pulling strings behind the scenes?)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_21_13.zh: （刚刚是受心之集域影响产生的幻觉吗，还是说的确有人在背后动手脚？）

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_21_4.text: Look, the way out of the Somnoire is just ahead. It's hidden in that battlefield. But you will need a key.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_21_4.zh: 看，离开心之集域的出口就在前面了，藏在那片战场深处，不过你还需要一把钥匙。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_305_2.text: {PlayerName}, I just sent the coordinates of the Somnoire's gateway to your Terminal.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_305_2.zh: {PlayerName}，心之集域入口的坐标我已经发送到你的终端上了。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_13.text: (But this Train of Souls is my only lead on what's happening in the Somnoire. For now, the best move is...)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_47_13.zh: （为了调查心之集域的异变，这辆列车是唯一的线索，现在要做的应该是……）

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_23.text: (Well... an old war resurfacing again inside the Somnoire is something to pay attention to.)
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_23.zh: （不过……过去的战争，却重新出现在了心之集域里，这件事有些让人在意。）

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_28.text: Yeah. From what I know of the Somnoire, things that happen there can't just be brushed off as dreams.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_28.zh: 嗯，而且据我对心之集域的了解，那片空间可不能简单地用梦境概括。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_27.text: I have a different understanding of what this place is. It's the Somnoire... a dreamscape filled with all kinds of imagined things.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_27.zh: 我认识的这里与你不同，这里被叫做心之集域，简单来说这里本身就是一片充斥着各类想象的幻梦世界。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_29.text: The investigation I mentioned earlier is connected to all of you. I want to know why the dead are tied to this place.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_78_29.zh: 之前我提到的调查，和你们有关，我想知道逝去的你们为什么会和心之集域牵扯上关系。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_86_2.text: Yes. We need to dig into the connection between the Somnoire and the war. I doubt we'll know the truth until this train reaches its final station.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_86_2.zh: 嗯，要查清战争与心之集域间的联系，也许只有等列车到达终点后，才能明白一切究竟是怎么回事。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_19.text: In that case... I need your help with something. I need the coordinates of the nearest gateway into the Somnoire.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_8_19.zh: 这样的话……嗯，有件事情我需要你的帮忙，我需要最近的心之集域入口坐标。

yakita:MapMark_7780_MarkDesc.text: Enter Somnoire: Night City through the anomalous gateway at Startorch Academy and complete the event objectives. (Replay access to Somnoire: Night City unlocks after completing the Episodic Quest "At Dream's Edge")
yakita:MapMark_7780_MarkDesc.zh: 通过星炬学院的异常门扉进入心之集域·夜之城，完成活动任务目标。(完成异闻任务「边缘幻梦」后可重复进入心之集域·夜之城)

datamine:InfoDisplay_103000007_Text.title: Fragments of Quiet Reflections
datamine:InfoDisplay_103000007_Text.text:
[…]

"It's a special feeling, when memories of the past manifest in your mind.

[…]

a feeling of nostalgia?"
I can show you whatever you wish to see with a Sonoro Sphere.

[…]

"It links the Tethys System with the stars, allowing you to control it through sound."
Control stars with sound?

[…]

"...Many have perished." 
Sacrifice is inevitable when the Lament strikes.

[…]

I'm just thinking..."
"If everything is already predetermined, then when we want to change the course of history..." 
"There's only one way."
datamine:InfoDisplay_103000007_Text.zh:
…………
“我们跨过许多偶然和必然，才来到了这里。”
“过去发生的事，并非没有意义，但也正因如此，我将希望寄于未来。”
那个人是这样告诉我的。
…………
“你会想家吗？”
想家？是怎样一种感觉。
“大概就是，脑海中浮现起过去的回忆，算是……怀念吗？”
我可以通过索诺拉展示出你想看的影像。
“不是这个意思啦……”
脸上的表情，是……笑吗？还是……“苦涩”？
…………
“嗯哼……按照我记忆里的样子造的，应该没问题。”
钢琴？
“它连接着泰缇斯系统和这片星空，可以通过它用声音来控制泰缇斯系统。”
用声音控制星星吗？
“当然，试试看？”
…………
“……死了很多人。”
在悲鸣前，牺牲难以避免。
“我们所做的一切究竟是为了什么，悲鸣永不停息，这一切究竟有什么意义……”
你可以依赖我，和这里的其他人。
这些事，不止是在你一个人身上。
你已经很久没有休息过了，躺下来吧。
“对不起……我不能在他们面前……”
我们每个人的信念，都不会动摇。
“谢谢……我在想……”
“如果一切都已经被计算好了的话，那要做出改变，也许只能……”
“只有一个方法了。”

datamine:InfoDisplay_120101056_Text.text:
Objective:
- To expand the existing Sonoro Sphere and identify weak points in the Spatial Prism Barriers.
- To contain residual Lament energy and establish control over the Sonoro.


Progress:

- Irideglow capture efficiency increased by 4.16%.
- Small amount of Light Irideglow Crystals detected (confirmed as Lament residue).
- Stasis field collapsed after 11 minutes and 23 seconds.
- Anomalous spatial rift formed (Core coil of containment unit failed due to meltdown).

...

Status Assessment:
- Lament frequency of this period deviated by 4.23% from baseline.
- Current containment protocols are insufficient to support continued experimentation.

Remarks:
The observed periodic resets within this Sonoro are likely induced by Lament's residual power.

datamine:InfoDisplay_72010101_Text.title: Dhalifa's Cherished Item
datamine:InfoDisplay_72010101_Text.text:
A rust-stained electronic sheep toy, loose and wobbly, as if it could fall apart at any moment.

Dhalifa grew bored with this simple gadget almost immediately. But the instant she discovered that turning a single screw, nudging a bearing, or rerouting a thin line of circuitry could make the toy spin, tumble, or even bleat, something inside her ignited.

From that moment on, she seized every chance to pester the visiting Spacetrek Collective researchers with endless questions. It was also the point when the more conservative members of her tribe began to alienate her for her newfound obsession.
datamine:InfoDisplay_72010101_Text.zh:
"一个锈迹斑斑的电子羊玩具，已经松松垮垮，似乎随时要散架。
这个功能简单的小玩具德莉珐很快就玩腻了，但当她发现只要转动一颗螺丝、调整一个轴承、改变一条电路，原本只会缓慢爬行的玩具会转圈，会翻滚，甚至能发出声音时，她便沉迷于此，也是从那时候起，她会抓住偶尔来村里的深空联合研究员问东问西，也是从那时候起，保守传统的族人，开始疏远她。"

datamine:InfoDisplay_72010102_Text.title: Silk with Names
datamine:InfoDisplay_72010102_Text.text: A length of plain, monotone silk, embroidered with the names of the Roya lost to the Void Storm that ravaged the Spacetrek Observatory. Dhalifa's name is there as well, yet a single strand of violet thread crosses it out.
datamine:InfoDisplay_72010102_Text.zh: 一段颜色单调的绸缎，绣着在虚质磁暴席卷深空测界台时死去的罗伊人姓名，德莉珐的名字被绣在上面，但又被一条紫色的织线划去。

yakita:MapMark_3170001_MarkDesc.text: A cavern in Starblind Crashsite, standing solemnly in the biting wind and snow of the frostlands.
yakita:MapMark_3170001_MarkDesc.zh: 位于盲望之塌的一处山洞，沉默吞吐着冰原之上的风刀雪刃。

yakita:Side_WWDLDG_6_5.text: We were right to push for a deep investigation at the Starblind Crashsite. The readings are faint, but there's definitely some new satellite debris down here!
yakita:Side_WWDLDG_6_5.zh: 深入调查盲望之塌是正确的。虽然信号很微弱，但这里果然有还没被发现的卫星残骸！

yakita:ST_LL_1_12.text: So, how's your "stop" here at Startorch Academy been?
yakita:ST_LL_1_12.zh: 那星炬学院这一站你过得怎么样？

yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_50_3.text: To get to the bottom of the perfumer girl's mystery, the Startorch Academy Student Council will keep you posted with the latest developments.
yakita:ST_YYMRDHS_50_3.zh: 为解开调香师少女的谜团，星炬学院学生会将持续为你跟踪报道。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_37.text: Let me take it from here. That day might fall on an afternoon... I'd arrive at Startorch Academy, and the way I'm dressed would draw a few curious looks from the students...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_210_37.zh: 接下来，交给我吧。那天是个下午……我来到了星炬学院，因为身上的穿着引起了不少学生的围观……

yakita:BYCZ_10_3.zh: 我是联运椎骨的安检总负责人，洛夫图斯。

yakita:BYCZ_16_6.text: I don't know who started the rumor about a "secret platform" on the Starward Riseway, but now I've got geniuses headbutting this pillar daily...
yakita:BYCZ_16_6.zh: 也不知道是谁传的谣，说什么联运椎骨有个隐藏站台，没事总有人往这根柱子上撞……

yakita:BYCZ_20_2.text: We're already at the Starward Riseway. You can "decompress" it with hot water after you get back to the dorms.
yakita:BYCZ_20_2.zh: 我们已经到联运椎骨了，一会儿回宿舍，你用热水泡会儿就能“解压缩”了。

yakita:BYCZ_22_7.text: I stay here to see my daughter attending the Academy. Same reason most here stay. Near the Starward Riseway we made our camp, to be close to them.
yakita:BYCZ_22_7.zh: 我嘛，主要是想没事多看看在学院里上学的女儿。这片营地里的罗伊人，也大都是出于类似的想法，才将营地搭建在了联运椎骨附近。

yakita:BYCZ_32_3.text: Oh, for the love of... The Thermostat Array ends past the Starward Riseway. Wanna be a popsicle? Suit up!
yakita:BYCZ_32_3.zh: 唉，你……离开了联运椎骨可就没有温控阵列了，如果不想在外面被冻成冰雕，就赶紧把防寒服穿上！

yakita:BYCZ_39_2.text: That Clockatoo has been here ever since the Starward Riseway was built.
yakita:BYCZ_39_2.zh: ……这只“叫早鸟”，自联运椎骨开始搭建的那天就已经存在了。

yakita:BYCZ_40_4.text: It broke its own code. Woke in the dead of night and screamed an alarm across the entire Starward Riseway. Because of that, researchers at the Institute made it to shelter.
yakita:BYCZ_40_4.zh: 它突破了自己的代码，在深夜启程，以嘹亮的声音对整个联运椎骨发出了全域警报，研究院的成员们这才得以躲避这场灾难。

yakita:BYCZ_58_11.text: This old heart wishes to pass that joy along. Let me tell you a secret. At the end of each year, I take my mech reindeer sleigh to the Starward Riseway and leave presents...
yakita:BYCZ_58_11.zh: 老头子我啊，也想把这份美好传递下去——悄悄告诉你，每年快年底的时候，我都会驾着机麋雪橇车，偷偷在联运椎骨的运输带上放上礼物……

yakita:BYCZ_6_4.text: Let me see it... That won't get anyone. Here—"Social Project at the Starward Riseway. With credits. Come ASAP."
yakita:BYCZ_6_4.zh: 我看看……你这样写不行，得这样写——联运椎骨，社会实践，算学分，速来。

yakita:EventTQDX_1_7.text: Rain, Helios's light, and the Starward Riseway piercing the clouds.
yakita:EventTQDX_1_7.zh: 雨、赫利俄斯的光芒、高耸入云的联运椎骨。

yakita:Kanxingxing_8_4.chapter: 剧情_3_0_支线_无人分享的星空_9_1
yakita:Kanxingxing_8_4.text: I heard from the crew at the Starward Riseway that the blizzards and Void Storms out in the frostlands have been terrible lately...
yakita:Kanxingxing_8_4.zh: 我听联运椎骨那里的人说，最近冰原上的暴风雪一直很大……还有磁暴……

yakita:MAIN_YHX_8_23.text: Here is a peace offering. I've granted you full clearance: passes for the Starward Riseway, archive access, and use of Academy weaponry and equipment.
yakita:MAIN_YHX_8_23.zh: 作为赔礼，我已经为你开通了所有行动会需要的权限：无论是往返联运椎骨，还是访问内部资料库，以及学院兵装的取用。

yakita:NPC_YJYFB_26_5.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_研究院副本_1_18
yakita:NPC_YJYFB_26_5.text: But if you ask me... the most unique one is still RRH-251. It didn't rely on the Reactor's glow from the Drive. Instead, it used superconducting Repulsive Force tech, which doubled the train's stability on the Starward Riseway!
yakita:NPC_YJYFB_26_5.zh: 但要我说啊……最特别的一代果然还得是RRH-251，没有使用炉光能源核心，而是超导斥力悬浮技术，让车身攀上联运椎骨的平稳度增加了两倍！

yakita:NPC_YJYFB_32_1.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_研究院副本_1_24
yakita:NPC_YJYFB_32_1.text: ...I always get sick whenever I take the Starward Riseway.

yakita:Side_YJYCZNPCST_31_1.text: Ah, the sheer magnificence of the Starward Riseway...

yakita:Side_YJYCZNPCST_46_3.text: Oh, come on, that was ages ago. Back during the Starward Riseway's Phase One trials, right?
yakita:Side_YJYCZNPCST_46_3.zh: 那都是多少年前的老黄历了？我记得是联运椎骨一期试运行的时候吧。

yakita:StJJDL_2_8.text: Give me a heads up before you head out... I'll walk you to the Starward Riseway.
yakita:StJJDL_2_8.zh: 走之前记得跟我说一声，我送你到联运椎骨去。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_LLZQMXY_10_29.text: Suisui, no matter what, I'll always be your little sister. That's the one thing that will never change.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_LLZQMXY_10_29.zh: 不管怎样，我是姐姐的妹妹。这件事，无论如何也不会改变的。
yakita:Main_HuangLong_LLZQMXY_10_29.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_5.text: Don't say that, Suisui. It's over now. You've carried that burden alone for far too long.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_5.zh: 别这么说，姐姐。都过去了，你肯定也一个人承担了很多压力。
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_270_5.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_1_10.text: Where is Suisui now? She hasn't left yet, has she?
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_1_10.zh: 穗穗现在在什么地方？她还没出发吧？

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_1.text: Suisui... are you sure you won't stay a few more days?
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_1.zh: 姐姐……真的不再多留几天吗？
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_1.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_22.text: Relax, darling. I am esteemed Chairwoman of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild. The eldest daughter in a family of musicians. And... Yangyang's big sister!
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_22.zh: 放心吧，我可是堂堂「昭明商会」的理事长，声乐世家的大小姐，以及……秧秧的姐姐~
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_20_22.speaker: Suisui

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_1_10.text: I've let Suisui know, too. She's going to use the Guild's connections to try to confirm his identity.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_1_10.zh: 我把这件事也告诉了姐姐，关于他的身份，姐姐正托商会那边的关系在打听。

yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_15_11.text: This big promotion is put on by the Zhaoming Commerce Guild and Huizhen Plaza merchants together. The whole idea was for everyone to make a killing together.
yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_15_11.zh: 这次打折活动，是我们「昭明商会」联合汇珍坊的诸位商家举办的。本来呢，是想大家一起发财。
yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_15_11.speaker: Suisui

yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_15_6.text: Let me introduce you. This is the chief of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild's Xuanfang Hold branch.
yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_15_6.zh: 我来介绍吧，这位是我们「昭明商会」在玄方城分行的行长。
yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_15_6.speaker: Suisui

yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_20_11.text: I'm Suisui, the Chairwoman of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild.
yakita:SIDE_XFYRYR_20_11.speaker: Suisui

yakita:ZXHSMST_2_2.text: At the sound of footsteps, Suoming moves to put the Vermillion Locks away. When she sees that it is you, she stops.
yakita:ZXHSMST_2_2.zh: 注意到脚步声，锁暝正要收起玄朱锁，见到是你便停下了动作。

yakita:ZXHSMST_2_5.text: Mm. I was telling them how Suhsin made a Ninth of its own.
yakita:ZXHSMST_2_5.zh: 嗯，我在和他们说溯心造了一个九儿的事。
yakita:ZXHSMST_2_5.speaker: Suoming

yakita:ZXHSMST_2_9.text: But Suhsin's imitation was too convincing. I confess, I indulged myself. I let that false Ninth walk beside me longer than I should have.
yakita:ZXHSMST_2_9.zh: 但溯心仿得太过逼真，我终是有几分私心，让那虚假的九儿陪我走了许久。
yakita:ZXHSMST_2_9.speaker: Suoming

yakita:ZXHSMST_3_3.text: It had fallen into disrepair over the years. Most of the detail was gone. But the umbrella's silhouette was still intact.
yakita:ZXHSMST_3_3.zh: 雕像年久失修，细节早已模糊，但雕像那撑伞的轮廓还留着。
yakita:ZXHSMST_3_3.speaker: Suoming

yakita:ZXHSMST_3_6.text: For a moment, Suoming sets her burdens down, slipping into easy conversation with her companions...
yakita:ZXHSMST_3_6.zh: 锁暝似乎暂时卸下了肩头的重担，沉浸在与伙伴相谈的闲暇之中……

yakita:ZXHSMST_5_11.text: Done wasting time? Go. See Xuanfang Hold, both of you.
yakita:ZXHSMST_5_11.zh: 好了，别再扯闲篇，你们逛玄方城去吧。
yakita:ZXHSMST_5_11.speaker: Suoming

yakita:ItemInfo_71200026_BgDescription.text: In handing it to you, Suoming seems to carry a deeper meaning.
yakita:ItemInfo_71200026_BgDescription.zh: 将它交给你的锁暝，似乎别有用意。

yakita:FavorWord_131218_Content.text:
Ninth Seal: Sister Suoming!
Suoming: Mm.
Ninth Seal: Whoa!
Suoming: Look.
Suoming: Mm...
yakita:FavorWord_131218_Content.zh:
九契：锁暝姐姐!
锁暝：嗯。
九契：哇!
锁暝：你看。
锁暝：嗯……
yakita:FavorWord_131218_Content.speaker: Suoming

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_11_1.text: You must be Tangning. Intendant Suoming is expecting you.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_11_1.zh: 你就是棠宁吧？锁暝州监在等你。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_163_1.text: Look, Sister Suoming! Doesn't that look like the mechanism teapot the Lord Second Seal made?
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_163_1.zh: 锁暝姐姐你看，这像不像二老爷自己做的机关茶壶？

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_166_8.text: Your timely aid is much appreciated, Intendant Suoming. I have heard much of you.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_166_8.zh: 感谢相助，锁暝州监，久仰。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_168_7.text: And you are just like us, Intendant Suoming. That we do know.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_168_7.zh: 锁暝州监，我们知道，您也是如此。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_170_12.text: Hehe. And that's why I came back, Sister Suoming.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_170_12.zh: 嘿嘿，所以我又回来啦，锁暝姐姐。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_170_7.text: That isn't a bad thing. You needn't dwell on the past anyway, Sister Suoming.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_170_7.zh: 那也挺好的，锁暝姐姐不需要停在过去嘛。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_21_1.text: Well? Still have reservations about Intendant Suoming?
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_21_1.zh: 如何？对锁暝州监还有什么异议吗？

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_247_10.text: Seal Master, Boss, Sister Suoming... They had many names for me.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_247_10.zh: 契主，老大，锁暝姐姐……都有。
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_247_10.speaker: Suoming

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_5_1.text: (Last time I saw Intendant Suoming, I was still a fresh recruit.)
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_5_1.zh: （上次见锁暝州监都是我刚加入组织的时候了。）

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_8_1.text: (I heard Intendant Suoming dislikes anything bitter-tasting. These rice cakes might just be...)
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_8_1.zh: （我记得有锁暝州监不喜苦味的传闻，或许这份粘糕……）

datamine:InfoDisplay_31000033_Text.zh:
第18次维检：
①抑制装置点状态：已重新激活，运转超负荷，对雾气消解率仅有34.265%。
②数据分析与额外说明：
最近的维检结果一直不容乐观，消解率持续降低，如果不提升抑制装置点功率，那么消解失效、雾气继续弥漫只是时间问题。但考虑到抑制装置点功效已经经过了两次提升，雾气由弱转强，持续攀升……雾气的引发源就像是有感应一般在和我们打擂台。
不，这是不可能的，从抑制装置点探索到的频段来看，雾气区并不存在大型生命体，但是……这真的不可能吗？是否为生命体，一定要经过人类的认证吗？我们都没接触过雾气的引发源，怎么能排除它们拥有人类智识的可能。
另，我翻阅了拾贰的记录日志（并没有特殊关注只是他找我探讨而已），我认为或许该抽调部分的人力和设备关注哀声鸷的动向。我没像拾贰那样在雾区看到它的身影，但是我看见过它在另一只鸟形残象死亡的地方不断盘旋、落地、盘旋、落地的情况。它依旧在思念那只残象，并因此失常。同样，我也依旧保留鸟形残象拥有人类感情、人类智识的推论。
通常来说，我们认为两只残象的合鸣是更在模拟某种生物性，但我见过……残象潮来袭时，其中一只拽着濒死的另一只朝人类发出悲鸣的场景。凄厉叫声中传达的心痛，跪下也可以视作是在寻求人类的帮助，那一瞬间，我似乎在它身上看见了与人类别无二致的“灵魂”（我知道这是感性的措辞我不应该这么说，但我坚持）。
记录者：461组研究员，戚戚。

yakita:InfoDisplay_201001001_Text.text:
Day 15.

Some have begun to question the worth of this endeavor, and the very honor we strive to uphold for Fisalia. Such whispers should have no place here.

We have crossed the ridges of Thessaleo Fells, weathered storms, and dared currents to reach this place, losing a ship on the way. Now, it's time to claim our rewards. The "relic" that has been kept from our family by the Order lies somewhere within these forsaken ruins, and treasures glimpsed only in dreams seem at last within our grasp.

Dario will stay behind. His legs were pierced by a TD and he can no longer walk. We've left him with enough provisions.

The rest of the knights will press on, toward the ruins in the southwest.

May we walk ever upon the righteous path.
yakita:InfoDisplay_201001001_Text.zh:
第15天。 

有人开始质疑这次远行的意义，想给翡萨烈的荣耀蒙上阴翳。这样的声音不该存在。

自狄萨莱海脊长途跋涉，穿越风暴和湍流，我们付出了一艘船的代价才抵达这里。现在正是勇敢探索的时候。这些年修会刻意向家族隐瞒的“圣物“，就隐藏在这些让人生厌的废墟里。那些只会在梦里出现的宝藏，从未像现在这样触手可及。

达利会留在相对安全的遗迹里，他的双腿被残象洞穿，已经不能再行走了。

我们留下了必要的饮水和食粮，余下骑士会向西南方向的遗迹前行。

愿一切行于公义的道途。

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_18_17.text: Uncle Li is about to speak when the roars of Tacet Discords interrupt him.
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_18_17.zh: 就在此时，不远处传来了残象的吼声。

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_20_17.text: Your theory makes sense—Uncle Li is known for his exquisite taste, and the items he bought just happened to attract attention from greedy Tacet Discords like Spearback.
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_20_17.zh: 嗯……是个不错的切入点。大家都知道黎叔是个著名的美食家，而他购买的货物偏偏又能吸引箭簇熊这种残象。
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_20_17.speaker: Yinlin

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_9_17.text: But these are said to only grow in the depths of Whining Aix's Mire, where many monsters live...
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_9_17.zh: 但……但这东西，据说只有怨鸟泽深处的残象栖息地才有。
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_9_17.speaker: Uncle Li

yakita:FavorStory_110603_Content.text:
[…]

Youhu was born in a bustling port town known for its antique trade, where her parents were both esteemed appraisers.

On her first birthday, her parents, following local customs, surrounded her with objects representing various trades.

It was said that the first item the child touched would predict their future interests and career path.

[…]

The deep chimes of the ancient bell echoed with memories of distant times when people knelt in devotion before golden statues praying for their family's wellbeing.

[…]

Youhu's lively nature shone through as she immersed herself in the world of antiques, the Tacet Mark on her arm glowing faintly to illuminate her eyes.

In every antique, she saw a little piece of history and a glimpse into the remnants of a civilization.

[…]
yakita:FavorStory_110603_Content.zh:
釉瑚出生在一个古物交易繁忙的港口，她的爸妈都是当地的鉴宝师。
周岁那天，爸妈按照家乡的习俗，在釉瑚身边摆满象征各行各业的器物，据说孩子第一个触摸到的物品，预示着孩子的志趣和未来从事的行当。
那天，釉瑚对笔墨、刀剑、炊具统统视而不见，径直爬向妈妈，伸手握住妈妈佩在腰间的如意环，不肯松开。
那是他们家的传家宝，一件货真价实的古物。
后来，釉瑚在古物堆里长大，她也确实展露出对古物的热忱，与古物有关的事情，她都兴致盎然，哪怕是枯燥晦涩的鉴宝知识，也能听上一整天。当然她最喜欢的，还是听爸妈讲古物背后的故事——
洪钟里回响的，是遥远岁月里的身影，对金色人像虔诚叩拜，祈祷阖家平安。
石雕上镌刻的，是英姿勃发的少年郎，把弓箭拉成满月，剿除残象护佑苍生。
生性活泼的她，屏除所有杂念，沉浸在古物的世界里，手臂泛起微光，声痕若隐若现，把她的眼眸照得很亮很亮。
吉光片羽里，皆是光阴之沉淀，文明之余晖，直至今日，她依然觉得这是古物的魅力所在。


“说实话，你的鉴宝知识完全不成体系，也难怪，毕竟在该学习的年纪……没关系，我都会教给你的。”
“难能可贵的是，你懂得尊重古物的历史底蕴，对此的感知也很敏锐。换言之，你是有鉴宝天赋的。”
师父陈皮多次夸赞釉瑚的天赋。
“嘁，还用你说，爸妈早就说过，我与古物有缘”。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_158_13.text: Tacet Discords... I saw our own dead rise up. Turn into monsters. They look just like Tacet Discords.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_158_13.zh: 是残……残象，我看见死去的战友们复活，变成了和残象一样的怪物。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_27_1.text: Tacet Discords. Were they drawn here by the abnormal frequency too?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_27_1.zh: 是残象，它们也是被异常的频率吸引而来的吗？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_13.text: Could this involve a Nightmare Tacet Discord?

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_14.text: Hmm... I don't think so. He said when he came to, he was standing in the middle of a battlefield.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_14.zh: 嗯……应该与残象无关，他说，当自己回过神来时，已身处一片战场中。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_14.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_88_1.text: Tacet Discords... Wait, where did everyone go?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_88_1.zh: 是残象……列车上的其他人呢？

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_94_1.text: Strange. These Tacet Discords don't seem to want to hurt me. What could they be...?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_94_1.zh: 奇怪，这几只残象似乎没有攻击我的意图，它们究竟是……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_95_1.text: These Tacet Discords sound just like the soldiers from earlier. Who is this "she" they keep mentioning?
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_95_1.zh: 这些残象说的话和之前遇见的战士有些相似，他们口中的“她”是谁？

yakita:STNPC_XFCPYST1_15_2.text: To stand against them, Yuan Fortress and Xuanfang Hold were built.

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_34_9.text: Sister Xuanqing went off alone to the place with all the TDs. Everyone who comes back from there is hurt. I'm so scared for her…
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_34_9.zh: 璇情姐姐，她一个人去了残象最多的地方……从那里来的人都满身是伤，我好害怕……

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_47_3.text: After the Tacet Discord Outbreak, that girl Xuanqing went to the front lines all by herself. I wanted to do something to help, so I followed her here to care for the wounded.
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_47_3.zh: 残象潮爆发后，璇情那孩子一人去了前线。我也想帮她做些什么，就跟着来到这里，照顾受伤的人。

datamine:InfoDisplay_11890101_Text.title: Investigation Log: "Treasures of CSC" Project Incident
datamine:InfoDisplay_11890101_Text.text:
[…]

Tacet Field has been unusually active lately, always feeling unsettled, as if something is about to happen ......
datamine:InfoDisplay_11890101_Text.zh:
这里就是当时研究小组最后留下踪迹的地点了。我们在附近进行了大规模感知，找到了一些杂乱的声纹。
初步分析了声纹组成。发现其中一部分残留时间较长，已经比较模糊，另一部分却很新。难道最近还有别人来过这里？要等进一步的分析出来才好下定论了。
……
根据声纹的详细分析结果，旧声纹的构成很杂乱，不仅有当时那些研究员，还有大量残象的活动痕迹。以研究小组的人数和平均实力，对抗这种规模的残象，他们恐怕并非全员失踪，而是殉职。
新声纹虽然清晰得多，却存在不明干扰，无法被准确识别，但从比对结果来看，应当全都来自同一个人，且时间跨度相当大，此人似乎在事故发生后多次来到这里。从旧声纹中也发现了与其相似的频率，推测他或许是研究小组中唯一的幸存者。幸存者不仅不上报事故情况，还反复回到这里，究竟是为了什么？
……
最近无音区异常活跃，总觉得心神不宁，好像有什么事情要发生了……

datamine:InfoDisplay_120101025_Text.title: A Researcher's Diary
datamine:InfoDisplay_120101025_Text.text:
More researchers have left... No one's going to continue the research on the Tacet Field.
It feels like everything we've been studying is akin to planting a seed in a Petri dish out in the Tacet Field. And guess what? That seed might germinate, dissolve into the culture solution, or even mutate into a monster and burst out.
Our research is just as chaotic. Experimental data that should remain constant at 3.74 can suddenly skyrocket to 7.65 the next moment. Is this the truth we've been pursuing? How bitterly ironic!
I would feel somewhat relieved if such an impossible error was due to my own incompetence. But if the Lament has already overturned the very order of this world, what's the point of scientific inquiry?
datamine:InfoDisplay_120101025_Text.zh:
离开的人越来越多了，无音区的研究……进行不下去了。
我们做的研究就像在无音区的培养皿中种下种子，你知道它会发生什么吗？
它可能会发芽，可能会和营养液融为一体，甚至可以跨物种变成一头野兽飞出培养皿。
这就是我们一直追寻的真理，上一秒还是3.74的常数值也许在下一秒就会变成7.65，常数值无常，多么可笑啊。
如果是因为我能力不够而推演出错误的理论，那还算是对我的一种安慰。
但如果从一开始，我们所做的努力注定会被悲鸣所带来的一切颠覆，那这些研究还有什么意义？

datamine:InfoDisplay_31000039_Text.title: Torn Diary 5
datamine:InfoDisplay_31000039_Text.text:
July 15
It's been two weeks, and only four of us remain. How did the Tacet Field suddenly appear in this place? I saw scary monsters, countless monsters...
No matter what happens, I will protect Yōu, even if it costs me my life.
datamine:InfoDisplay_31000039_Text.zh:
7月15日
已经是第二个星期了。我们还剩4个人。无音区会突然降临在这里呢……那些怪物……那些可怕的……
我会用我的生命保护小优的，哪怕……

yakita:InfoDisplay_11890103_Text.text:
Date: [--02]
The C.V. laboratory is located in an abandoned site within Whining Aix's Mire. The main structure was built using a special material developed by C.V., which prevented severe weathering and corrosion. As a result, the building remained relatively intact. After a risk assessment, the research committee decided to use the base level of the site for an artificial Tacet Field.
A few mechanical instrument abandoned by C.V. are left at the experiment environment. Outside the environment, a low-frequency lighting system was installed at a regulated distance and angle, ensuring permanent illumination of the experiment area.
The experimental environment center is composed of multiple bundled cables that secure a spherical metal device. The cables transmit the input and output data from within the metal device. Surrounding the spherical device are frequency detection instruments of the same specifications. These instruments are typically controlled by dials. When the dial is rotated clockwise, the electrical energy will drive the composite metal frame to rotate in a high angular speed clockwise around the central device for synchronizd frequency detection.
yakita:InfoDisplay_11890103_Text.zh:
日期：[--16]
搬到怨鸟泽的遗址后，工作比以前更累了，不过一切都是值得的。
海森教授在会议上公布试验结果成功的那一刻，我现在都还记忆犹新，他告诉着我们：“我老了，趁我还有些时间，还想做些正确的事。
而你们还年轻，还有无限的未来，我相信你们每一个人，无论天才与否，都想把自己的名字留在时间与历史的丰碑中，而不是碌碌无为地从这扇单门走出去，在此，我恳请大家帮助我，也是帮助大家自己，履行这份研究的职责，直至最后一刻。”
是啊，如果这次研究能够成功，我们这些本该无名的普通人也许也能跟着海森教授的名字一同出现在历史的教科书上。
我们当中有来自各地研究院被遗弃、落选的失败者，也有靠自主学习的民间科学爱好者，甚至还有一些曾做出危险行为而被禁止研究的学者，但是来到这里后，没有人会去追究你的过往，是海森教授给了我们重新来过的机会。虽然现在我们只能躲藏起来，但研究完成的那一天，我们一定能够重新站到阳光的下面。
海森教授是一位天才，很少会给我们讲他过去的故事，只是听他说过自己并不是出身于大型研究院，但工作的地方也是天才云集，做着有趣的研究。每次谈到那段时光的时候，海森教授看上去总是很开心，但好像也有遗憾。诶，来到这里的大家，或许都有自己的遗憾吧。

datamine:InfoDisplay_11040108_Text.title: Construction Notice
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040108_Text.text:
The construction of the Focus Array will officially begin on September 10th, when the Tacetite Industrial Transportation Station will be responsible for the transfer work. Relevant staff members are requested to pay attention to the maintenance of road safety, carefully check the materials and regularly monitor the environment to ensure the safe storage of the sounding liquid.
During the construction process, non-technical personnel should stay away from the construction site and are prohibited from coming into direct contact with the liquid without protection. If you feel unwell, please report promptly.

AL158 August 30, 2008
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040108_Text.zh:
聚焦阵列将于9月10日正式开始施工，届时将由黑石工业运输站负责转运工作，请相关工作人员注意维护路面安全，仔细核对物资，定时监测环境，保证鸣液安全储存。
施工过程中，非技术人员请远离施工现场，禁止在无防护的情况下直接接触鸣液。如有身体不适，请及时上报。

新历158年8月30日

datamine:InfoDisplay_11040110_Text.title: BEWARE THE MENACE
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040110_Text.text:
Dear outsiders, if you find stray cats at the Gate entrance of the transit station, please do not feel free to feed or call them.
There are two bullies in the neighborhood who often approach the staff with the gesture of a soft loved one, and take the opportunity to sneak into the station and hide in the shadows of the important equipment. When discovered, they open their teeth and claws again, deliberately injuring people, and have been repeat offenders!
In order to ensure the safe storage of Tacetite products as well as your personal safety, please be careful of the two bullies and don't be fooled by their appearance.

**We have people who feed them at regular intervals.
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040110_Text.zh:
各位外来人员，如果您在转运站门口发现流浪猫，请不要随意投喂或者呼唤。
附近有两只恶霸经常以柔顺亲人的姿态接近工作人员，趁机偷跑进站，躲藏在重要设备的阴暗处。被发现时又张牙舞爪，蓄意伤人，已是惯犯！
为了保证黑石产品安全储存以及您的人身安全，请小心两只恶霸，不要被它们的外表蒙骗。

**我们有专人定点投喂。

datamine:InfoDisplay_11040168_Text.title: Logs of Hazy Depths Prospecting Team, II
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040168_Text.text:
Chisu left his backpack to me, and I knew he was prepared for a risky rescue. I was filled with fear, afraid that he might not return, and even more afraid that he might come back something else... Tacetite Weapon should never be used against comrades.
Especially the one he left me with.
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040168_Text.zh:
驰速把背包留下给我了，我知道他已经做好了涉陷营救的准备。我很害怕，怕他回不来，更怕他变成别的什么回来……黑石武器，不应该用在战友身上。
更何况，是他留给我的这把。

yakita:Flow_11000009_3.text: I wonder when I will be able to catch up with them, especially Senior Taoqi!
yakita:Flow_11000009_3.zh: 不知道什么时候我才能追上前辈们，特别是桃祈前辈！

yakita:Flow_11000009_53.text: I am wondering if Taoqi's "slow response" is deliberate.
yakita:Flow_11000009_53.zh: 我在想，桃祈前辈的“慢半拍”会不会是故意的。

yakita:Flow_11000009_57.text: But I've sensed I didn't come up with the idea myself. I got the inspiration elsewhere. Perhaps, in the textbook, or in one of Taoqi's sharing sessions?
yakita:Flow_11000009_57.zh: 不过总觉得这套理论是受到了什么东西的启发，是讲义上，还是桃祈前辈的分享会上？

yakita:ItemInfo_80001020_BgDescription.text: Gently simmer the rice over low heat, adding a few delicate flower petals for flavor. As it begins to lightly boil, this simple yet sweet dish becomes a favorite snack for Taoqi when relaxing at home. With each slow sip, it seems to wash away the accumulated fatigue of the day, leaving a refreshing feeling in its wake.
yakita:ItemInfo_80001020_BgDescription.zh:
温火小煮粳米，加入少许花瓣，等待小沸即可。
因烹饪简单而味道香甜，成了桃祈宅家时钟爱的清新小食。
缓缓喝上一口，似乎能驱散不少积累已久的倦意。

yakita:FavorGoods_160103_Content.text: Taoqi always longs to catch a nice, peaceful nap during her free time. The soft and plush Peachy Turtle becomes her haven, a paradise that washes away all fatigue accumulated from work.  "If I could live a slow-paced life just like the Peachy Turtle, and still be a reliable support for everyone, that would be perfect."
yakita:FavorGoods_160103_Content.zh:
闲余时间能美美地睡上一觉是桃祈平日里反复念叨的愿望。
软绵绵的桃桃龟成了包容她一切的乐园与天堂。
“如果能像桃桃龟一样慢悠悠地生活，而又能成为大家安心的依靠就好了。”

yakita:FavorWord_140253_Content.text: Ms. Taoqi is always gracefully poised. She is the kind of person to quickly produce multiple solutions with ease in the most urgent situations, with a smile on her face: "Don't worry. I've got it sorted." Her seemingly unhurried demeanor must have been earned through hard work that we don't know about.
yakita:FavorWord_140253_Content.zh: 桃祈身上有一种举重若轻的气度，好像不管什么突发情况，她都能不紧不慢地掏出几个方案，留下一句“别慌~这样不就解决了嘛~”。所谓懒散，一定是因为她在我们看不见的地方做了十足的努力吧。
yakita:FavorWord_140253_Content.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_118_3.text: If you have questions, talk to Director Taoqi at the nearby pass. She's in charge.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_7_118_3.zh: 如果针对目前的情况还有什么疑惑，可以询问一下桃祈事务长，她就在前方不远的关卡处。

yakita:POI_HKSM_XZ_1_2.chapter: 剧情_剧情_虎口山脉_世界任务_9_1
yakita:POI_HKSM_XZ_1_2.text: Miss Taoqi has already got so much on her plate. I shouldn't be troubling her with this...
yakita:POI_HKSM_XZ_1_2.zh: 桃祈前辈的工作已经够多了，要是再给她添麻烦的话……
yakita:POI_HKSM_XZ_1_2.speaker: Xiaoyu

yakita:Character_ChangLi_22_53.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_1_1_角色_长离线_1_19
yakita:Character_ChangLi_22_53.text: Through discussions with Xinyi, you begin to question Wuli's motives and his sources of information. You suspect that the Temporal Disruption might be part of a larger scheme and could be connected to the Weiqi record you are searching for.
yakita:Character_ChangLi_22_53.zh: 你们与辛夷交换信息，认为梧黎的行为有许多疑点，他很可能隐瞒了其他的信息来源。所谓的时间乱流或许另有真相，而且这些异变似乎与你们想要寻找的“传说中的棋谱”有关。

datamine:InfoDisplay_102801014_Text.title: Strange Messages
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801014_Text.text:
[…]

Future is where you get to eat Star Flakes and realize all of your dreams.

Several days later, this message thing struck my terminal again with a delay notice: "We're sincerely sorry for the delay.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801014_Text.zh:
有一天，我收到了一则通讯。
通讯信息内容很简单，看上去是什么车站安抚滞留乘客的信留言，什么未来号列车组向滞留的旅客致以诚挚的歉意，他们一定会把乘客安全送往目的地之类的话。看完后，我就把这则通讯移进了回收站，毕竟我都很久没坐过列车了，应该是站务的系统出了什么问题吧。
但这之后，我的终端就总会收到一些奇怪的留言，留言总来自于这个什么未来号列车。刚开始，我干脆地忽略掉这些信息，什么未来号啊，长途旅行啊，听起来就像是能够到什么很有意思的地方去，那和我可没多大关系。毕竟我还有很多事要忙，没工夫管那些事儿。最近那些研究员总对我们矿场有些什么不满，又到年关，大家的弦绷得紧，连我这个做后勤的都听说了。
但这些通讯留言也一直发个不停，有天忙里偷闲的时候，我就想着点开来看看。这点开看看，就看到，可能是一个小孩吧，给我发了些话：“老爸老爸，乘务员姐姐要我乖乖坐好，说待会儿列车就要发车了，我们就能跟着未来号去未来啦。乘务员姐姐说会让我们平安到站，还能到未来去！我可期待了！不过，不知道未来是什么样子的呀……”我看着这信息，就想到我女儿，她小时候也这样，看到些什么词就冒出几个奇怪的问题。不过我都有段时间没见她了。想着想着呢，我又想到这小孩，把这信息给发错人了，但看这列车好像又延误了，也不想让这小孩自己等着。我就和她说：“未来啊，未来就是什么……对了，就是有很多星星酥，能实现一大堆愿望的时候。”
又过了几天呢，也不知道这趟列车是咋回事，又给我发了一大条滞留信息：“很抱歉耽误您的行程，未来号会竭尽所能，尽早发车，祝大家旅途愉快、平安顺利。”最后还有句什么，“未来号车组，向所有人致意，我们未来见。”接着就又是一条短信：“到底还有多久才能发车啊，真的还能发车吗？小优一直在问我，我都不知道要怎么和她说，只好说马上就好马上就好，等列车发车了，我们就能一起离开这鬼地方，一起去未来了。大家都在等待，都想快点发车离开，我也想赶紧带着小优离开这里。遇到的好心人还把自己带的干粮分给我们，让我们安心些。唉，到底还要多久……”我想着，哦，合着这该是给站务留言的通讯，不知怎么就转接到我这边来了。还好那几天我清闲，就好脾气地回…

datamine:InfoDisplay_103000006_Text.title: Resolution K626
datamine:InfoDisplay_103000006_Text.text:
[…]

…No, emotions are unnecessary for her function.

[…]

As for Instance Two, the Tethys system will oversee her management.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_103000006_Text.zh:
提出时间：████████
决议时间：██████████
决议结果：全体通过并准备执行
决议等级：——
执行者：██████
————————————————————
简而言之，失败了。
同样，████系统，本机也维持这一判断。
在过去的████年中，这场灾难摧毁了地表百分之八十以上的有效人工建筑，杀死了全球一半以上的人口。
在所有的对抗方式均被证实为无效后，根据泰缇斯研究所的报告，████系统、本机最终展开了第三方案的可行性验证。
过去████年中，本机依序完成了观测序列、收容序列和分析序列的构建，已经初步达成了第三方案的后置条件。
然而最近已经观测到，受已经发生的灾难影响，时间涟漪已经开始向此时空靠拢，扰动强度与时间进度成正比，预计████年后，这一扰动将使此时空与基准线之间负向偏离15度，极有可能越过基准线。
即，在第三方案下，不排除此时空的事件A与目标的事件O之间成为绝对异地事件，失去对事件A的因果关系控制。这一结果是灾难性的，事件O与事件A之间，永远失去关联…………
████████████████
████████████████
████████
████████████████████████
…………
在K626进入执行阶段后，将启用第一实例和第二实例，用以分别辅助完成时间与空间的控制……
尤其是第二实例，她是我们研究中关于索诺拉理论的集合体，由她来完成空间控制，非常合适。
……不，她不需要情感。这种东西，对我们而言是多余的。
只要存续下去就好，一旦我们成为绝对异地事件，我们就真的什么也顾不上了……
关于第二实例，会有泰缇斯系统管住她的，这一点，不用担心……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_305_5.text: All right, I'll go over the Tethys System data again and see if I can find anything new.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_305_5.zh: 好，我也再整理一下泰缇斯系统的数据，看看会不会有新的发现。

datamine:InfoDisplay_102900008_Text.title: Restoration No. 171
datamine:InfoDisplay_102900008_Text.text:
A long horizontal scroll, with a smoky, cascading ink work.
Thanks to the photos of the Lament's former paintings provided by Mr. Chen Pi, the restoration process of this work was smooth and efficient.
The Dragon Lord gave the work the title "Wen Ye", and it is planned to be exhibited in the whole city in AL160.
datamine:InfoDisplay_102900008_Text.zh:
横向长卷，烟波浩渺、层峦叠嶂的水墨作品。
得益于陈皮先生提供的悲鸣前画作照片，该作品修复进程顺利高效。
龙主赐名《闻野》，计划于新历160年全城展览。

datamine:InfoDisplay_102900009_Text.title: Restoration No. 281
datamine:InfoDisplay_102900009_Text.text:
Yellowed photographs. The setting sun is swallowed by the mountains, birds are circling, people are fleeing, and the world is in chaos.
Presumably taken at the time of the Lament, this photo epitomizes the disaster for contemporary mankind.
Under the flood of history, we must be vigilant in peace and not forget the fire of resistance.
The Dragon Lord gave the name "Silent War", and it is planned to be exhibited in the whole city in AL160.
datamine:InfoDisplay_102900009_Text.zh:
泛黄的照片。夕阳的余晖被山峦吞噬，群鸟盘旋，人群蜂拥逃难，世界兵荒马乱。
推测拍摄时间为悲鸣发生时，这张照片让当代人类看见了灾难的缩影。
历史洪流之下，当居安思危，勿忘抗争之火种。
龙主赐名《无声的战争》，计划于新历160年全城展览。

datamine:InfoDisplay_103000005_Text.title: Submission: Lament Incident Report for Port City of Guixu (Eleven)
datamine:InfoDisplay_103000005_Text.text:
[…]

the Lament's core is right above us.

[…]
datamine:InfoDisplay_103000005_Text.zh:
总第0595号（内）
提审人：霍德·特奥菲勒斯·安娜
BS 037/1/99375*
泰缇斯编号：K-125（已弃用）
——TOP SECRET——
……尽管我们一切行为都在证明，为了归墟港市平民百姓的安全和利益，黑海岸正协同当局最大限度地疏散群众，立即离开这座城市。但当我们的医疗队终于从城市东北的高架桥勉强进入城市中心区的时候，我仍然感到力不从心——也许我们已经晚了。
……现在是下午三点，我们已经抵达了中心区的摩天大楼，火光映红了整个东北侧的天空，那里的高架桥似乎也已经崩塌了。
我们刚才遇见了一队前往悲鸣核心区域的特勤，“铁皮”老布兰登带着的那队，我们也必须向更高处前进了……那些从土地里长出来的红色的花，它们在把我们往大楼高处赶，但实际上，在我们头顶就是悲鸣的核心，那颗……黑洞。
这是一场消耗战……有很多人，他们找到我们的时候，已经晚了……
现在是，几点了，六点？应该是早上六点吧。下一台手术马上开始了，我们现在聚集在大楼高层区的一间会议室里，这种时候也计较不了那么多了，就我这一队带着的人来看，至少需要三架游隼级的扑翼机才能都带走。
……阿托品只剩下十三支了，这里越来越热，我们不太好控制伤员的体温。
支援呢！空中部队的支援呢！总部！请求支援！坐标已经返回到泰缇斯系统了，支援！
……哪怕……把这些妇孺老人带走……
越来越热了，老布兰登他们还没回来……请求支援……
………………
不要放弃……希望……

datamine:InfoDisplay_11020111_Text.title: How Old Town was Built: a Record of the Rise and Fall of Gang
datamine:InfoDisplay_11020111_Text.text:
Compiled by: Ah Chin
We found a strange structure here, looking like a tower made from the edges of the surrounding ruins.
Could it be that someone had settled here before us?
It's just that these seawater-soaked traces look like they were left before the Lament.
......
Boss checked around the neighborhood and found that the lights here were surprisingly still electrified.
No matter what the people before this tower did with it, once we change the bulbs in it, we can use it as our first stronghold of the Old City Gang here!
Really looking forward to lighting it up tonight.
......
That idiot, Four Eyes, accidentally dropped a lamp, so it's a good thing we can't see it as it once was.
Still have to plead for him, hope the boss isn't looking forward to it as much as I am ......
datamine:InfoDisplay_11020111_Text.zh:
编撰人：阿芊
我们在这里发现了一处奇怪的建筑，看着像个用周围废墟的边角料搭成的塔楼。
难道是有人赶在我们之前就入驻过这里？
只是这些海水浸泡过的痕迹，又像是悲鸣前留下的。
……
老大在附近检查了下，发现这里的灯竟然还是能通电的。
不管这塔楼之前的人是拿它做啥的，等我们给它换好灯泡，就可以当做我们旧城帮在这里的第一个据点了！
真是期待今晚点亮它的样子啊。
……
四眼那个笨蛋，不小心掉下去了一个灯，这下好了，看不到它曾经的样子了。
还得帮他求情，希望老大没有像我一样期待吧……

datamine:InfoDisplay_11030103_Text.title: Report on Historical Incidents at this Subway Station
datamine:InfoDisplay_11030103_Text.text:
[Record of historical events
Recorder: ■■■

datamine:InfoDisplay_102801001_Text.title: Tattered Booklet
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801001_Text.text:
We went beneath the banyan tree, where darkness shrouded Grandma and me.
Grandma led me with knowing grace, to hang the moons in their rightful place.
A glowing orb above the leaves, banishing shadows, making forest so bright.
Moon O moon, where do you hide? Behind a waterfall's cascading slide?
With gentle hands she'd guide my head, as we gathered moons before bed.
Moon O moon, where do you roam? At the moon pool's alluring home?
Moon in hand I came back and read, by her side she taught me to heed.
Moon O moon, where do you rest? Perched upon a tree stump's crest?
Naughty Hoochiefs watched in glee, trying to catch the moons so free.
Moon O moon, where do you play? In a cave where dry branches sway?
All moons gathered but she was gone, leaving me an everlasting dawn.
I gazed at golden moons so bright, and left for the city that very night.
datamine:InfoDisplay_102801001_Text.zh:
紫色巨榕不见光，外婆带我挂月亮。
金色弯月树上挂，从此森林亮堂堂。
月亮月亮在哪里？瀑布之后洞穴里。
捡回月亮给外婆，外婆为我梳毛发。
月亮月亮在哪里？巨榕旁边月池底。
捡回月亮给外婆，外婆教我念诗书。
月亮月亮在哪里，挂在半截树桩顶。
捣蛋猿猴悄悄看，要把月亮捞到底。
月亮月亮在哪里，洞下枯枝生林意。
所有月亮捡回来，不见外婆人踪影。
金色弯月挂树顶，从此巨榕无阴翳。
小孩看着月亮林，离开乡林人间去。

datamine:InfoDisplay_120101011_Text.text:

Q: First, the moon and stars.

datamine:InfoDisplay_120101011_Text.zh:
「天才」与「凡人」的大碰撞？在这场梦幻对谈中，神秘的天才会向我们分享什么精彩的内容？
Q：紧张吗？这应该是您第一次面向大众的视野吧，大家可很好奇活在传闻中的“天才”究竟是什么模样？
A：哈哈哈，也许这并不是第一次，我在许多意想不到的地方都和大家热情交流过，比如说，以奶油猫老师的笔名和大家一起探讨质子的寿命。

Q：喔！原来近来那位神秘的科普作家也是我们的研究员先生，说起来很多读者都很好奇奶油猫这个名字有神秘特殊的含义吗？
A：只是一个小小的意外，不知道各位有没有弄掉奶油面包的经历？你会发现面包掉在地上总是奶油那一侧，而小猫趋向于四脚落地，那如果把小猫和奶油面包绑在一起，让没有奶油的那侧贴着小猫背部的话，奶油猫的永动机就诞生了，我们解决了科学史上的一个难题。

Q：看起来您是一位随性并且想象力相当丰富的人，那请允许我问一个问题，您也会把它们带入到机关术的研究中吗？
A：回答这个问题前，我们先把头微微抬起吧，头顶的窗户刚好能够看见星空，第一眼你看见了什么，如果我们把距离依次增加又会看见什么？

Q：第一眼的话，当然是月亮和星星了，在那之外的话，也许星星们在碰撞，也许星空是面镜子，另一面是和我们一样的世界。

A：所以，这是不是想象力呢？回到刚刚的问题，我从来都不需要带着它们进入研究，它们只是本能。许多研究员现在过多关注于理论与结果的意义，能不能改变世界，会不会造福人类？我目睹着这些人放弃了许多东西，其中就包括想象，我没有否定他们的想法，灾难后致力于有意义的理论与发明没有错，但……我只是想提醒大家不要忘记科学的初衷，那就是只需要思考如何去达成它，至于它的意义……（笑）

Q：说到评价，听说您家的孩子相里要天赋也相当了得，您作为父亲对他什么期许吗？
A：他还太小，还谈不上什么期许，但……总有一天他也会从屋子里走出去，希望他在迷茫的时候，能毫不犹豫地抬起头来，面对天空，保护好老爸我留给他的知性。

datamine:InfoDisplay_11040106_Text.title: Unsigned Diary: II
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040106_Text.text:
Day 109.
There were two loud sounds today, I couldn't hear what it was, and there was a pause in the middle for about two... three minutes? When the first sound was heard, the new bed that had just been built on Xiao Gui's side was shaken to the point that it all fell apart, and the sand and dust fell from the cracks in the stone above his head, and he was immediately dumbfounded, and he didn't move. Until the second sound, he howled violently again.
Sansui told him to shut up, but he still howled, so Sansui gave him a slap on the face and told him not to affect everyone.
It didn't matter to me. By the time the first sound came, I was already thinking about my next life. In my next life I want to be a Gulpuff, zapping whoever gets me, not hiding in this dank cave.

Day 110.
Sansui says Threnodian can stomp hundreds of Gulpuffs with one foot, I say it doesn't matter, Gulpuff will zap his foot.
Not much rattling today.
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040106_Text.zh:
第109天
今天有两声巨响，听不出来是什么，中间停顿了大概两分钟……三分钟？第一声响的时候，小贵那边刚搭好的新床被震得全散架，沙尘从头顶的石缝里哗哗掉，他立马就傻了，动也不动。直到第二声响，他又猛地嚎起来。
三水叫他闭嘴，他还是嚎，三水就给了他一巴掌，让他别影响大家。
我倒是无所谓。第一声响的时候，我已经在考虑下辈子的事情了。下辈子我想当一只咕咕河豚，谁弄我我就扎谁，不至于在这个阴暗的洞穴里躲躲藏藏。

第110天
三水说鸣式一脚就能踩爆几百只咕咕河豚，我说无所谓，咕咕河豚会扎他的脚。
今天没什么响动。

datamine:InfoDisplay_11040107_Text.title: Unsigned Diary: III
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040107_Text.text:
Xiao Gui's baby was born, at night. The moonlight shone in through the big hole that had been blown up, and it was quite bright. We all chatted about naming the baby, and finally chose "Changming". The child cried at the sound of the name, and then Xiao Gui followed suit, and so did everyone else, even Sanshui, who wiped his eyes.
Before the roof of the cave was blown open, there was no light from the sky. Listening to the cannon fire outside, in addition to fear, there is also a bit of unspeakable ...... ease. Now it was better to always know when it was light and dark and when it was raining. Everyone has decided to live here, Threnodian how it will be in the end, I do not intend to think about it, here is quite good.

Maybe, in the future, someone will come here to investigate and find "cavemen" or something. I'm just writing this down in the hope that the explorer doesn't embarrass us by treating us like ancient apes, with all the research and studies.
We are just villagers who came here for refuge, nothing special, no need to remember us.
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040107_Text.zh:
小贵的孩子出生了，是在夜里。月光从被炸开的那个大洞照进来，还算亮。大家叽叽哇哇给孩子取名，最后选了“长明”。孩子一听就哭了，然后小贵也跟着哭，大家都跟着哭，就连三水也抹了抹眼睛。
在洞顶没被炸开之前，这里一直是看不见天光的。听着外面的炮火，除了恐惧，还有点说不上来的……轻松。现在好了，总归是知道天亮天暗，天雨天晴。大家已经决定住在这里，鸣式最后如何，我也不打算去想了，这里就挺好。

可能，未来会有人来这里调查，发现“洞穴人”之类的。我记下这些是希望那位探险家别把我们当做远古猿人，又是考证又是研究的，弄得很尴尬。
我们只是来这里避难的村民，没什么特别的，不必记住我们。

yakita:ST_LL_1_5.text: Take that Train of Souls you once told me about. All along the way, you tried everything you could to lay the souls lost in the war to rest.

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_18_22.text: Interesting… From what I know, Uncle Li isn't a bad person. If he was actually hiding his true nature this whole time, I have to give him some credit for fooling me.
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_18_22.zh: 有趣……以我对黎叔的了解，他并不是个坏人。难道……他的伪装技术会比我还好吗？

datamine:InfoDisplay_11080106_Text.title: Dim Forest Ecological Survey Summary
datamine:InfoDisplay_11080106_Text.text:
Verina: However, the majority of species in the area are at risk, including Ficus purpurea in the Conservation Area which is nearly extinct and requires urgent conservation measures to be preserved in captivity.
Verina: Also... 
[Hoochief's squeak—] 
Verina: Bad Hoochief! Bad! That's not your food!
[Hoochief's squeak—] 
Verina: Stop right there—

yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1503_Info.chapter: 维里奈档案_共鸣能力鉴定报告
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1503_Info.text: With an extensive knowledge of botany, Verina is always solicitous, always smiling, and always wishing for every flower to be blessed with the miracle of life.
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1503_Info.zh: 具有丰富植物知识储备的育种员维里奈，总是微笑，始终温柔，用她的治愈之力呵护每一个朋友，希望所有的花朵都拥有生命的奇迹。

yakita:Flow_313700000_25.text: A sudden floral scent pulls you into Verina's dream. You realize the scent might be the key to entering her dream.
yakita:Flow_313700000_25.zh: 突如其来的花香，将你带入了维里奈的梦境，你意识到它也许是连接女孩梦境的媒介。

yakita:Flow_313700000_27.text: Surprised, Verina comes close to you and exclaims that this is life's miracle.
yakita:Flow_313700000_27.zh: 维里奈惊喜地凑到你身边，惊叹着这也许是什么生命的奇迹。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_14_7.text: It is… It is a delight to make your acquaintance. I am Verina. My "pressure" to have the opportunity to meet with you today…

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_53_2.zh: 从刚才开始，周围就一直散落着一些黑色的花瓣……它们并不属于维里奈小姐。

datamine:InfoDisplay_102194701_Text.title: Announcement
datamine:InfoDisplay_102194701_Text.text:
Polar Research Station Safety Bulletin:

Recent data monitoring indicates abnormal Voidmatter readings in the surrounding area, which may lead to communication failures, navigation equipment interference, and frequent small-scale Void Storm activity. The aforementioned phenomena pose potential risks to personnel and equipment safety.

Through on-site investigation, we have confirmed that the anomaly originates from a severely contaminated satellite component beneath the ice layer. This component has now been successfully recovered and placed under containment.

We extend our utmost gratitude to Team Leader Professor Atrod Scott of Team 17, who brought this discovery to our attention.
datamine:InfoDisplay_102194701_Text.zh:
科考站安全通告：根据近期监测数据，该区域周边存在虚质检测数值异常，可能导致通讯信号中断、定位设备失真及频繁的小规模虚质磁暴，对人员安全与设备运行构成潜在风险。
经实地勘察，已确认异常源为冰层下方受严重污染的卫星零件。目前，该零件已完成回收处置。
向带来这一发现的第十七分队领队：阿特罗德·司各特教授，致以崇高的敬意。

datamine:InfoDisplay_102194702_Text.title: Announcement
datamine:InfoDisplay_102194702_Text.text:
Polar Research Outpost Safety Announcement:

Recent monitoring has detected abnormal Voidmatter readings in the surrounding area. These anomalies may cause communication failures, navigation system interference, and frequent, small-scale Void Storm activity. Such phenomena pose a potential risk to both personnel safety and equipment integrity.

An on-site investigation has confirmed that the source was a highly contaminated satellite component embedded in the ice. This component has now been successfully recovered and contained.

To ensure the safety of all personnel and the success of expedition operations, team members are advised to avoid this area unless entry is mission-essential.
datamine:InfoDisplay_102194702_Text.zh:
科考站安全通告：根据近期监测数据，该区域周边存在虚质检测数值异常，可能导致通讯信号中断、定位设备失真及频繁的小规模虚质磁暴，对人员安全与设备运行构成潜在风险。

为确保全体人员与科考任务安全，如无必要，请各位队员避免进入该区域。

datamine:InfoDisplay_11040156_Text.title: Dim Forest Ecological Survey 3
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040156_Text.text:
After bidding farewell to the Violuna Banyan, I proceeded towards the most important target—the Central Banyan.
It's a tree towering into the sky, with a large spore cloud perched at the top, spreading toxic spores with the wind.
Any creature approaching this tree exhibited obvious anxiety and fear—the white toxic spores floated around the Central Banyan, almost blocking out my sight. I could even hear faint coughing from the forest. I needed to take every step with extreme caution from now on.
The closer I got to the Central Banyan, the more uneasy I felt—there was a heavy snorting coming from its hollow, and the vibrations caused by breathing shook off the spores accumulated on the branches. As more and more spores fell down, I tightened my filter.
These creations of the Waveworn Phenomenon are infiltrating our world, making everything dangerous and unfamiliar.
datamine:InfoDisplay_11040156_Text.zh:
在告别了紫月榕后，我向着最重要的目标——中央巨榕，前进。
那是一棵高逾千寻的大树，盘踞在树顶的巨大孢子云迎风散布着毒雾孢子。
任何靠近此处的生物都会表现出明显的焦躁与恐惧——毒雾孢子如同雪花般飘散......将周围的一切染成了污浊而迷离的纯白。若是仔细倾听，便能听到林中传来了隐约的咳嗽声......接下来的每一步我都需要更加谨慎。
越是靠近这个大树，我的内心越是不安——巨榕中央的空洞传来了沉重的鼻息，呼吸之间引发的振动，摇落了树枝上积压的孢子。霎时间，「雪势」变得更紧了一些，我不自觉地捂紧了过滤器。
这些海蚀现象的造物，正不择手段地渗透着我们的世界，将一切都变得危险而陌生......

datamine:InfoDisplay_11080103_Text.title: Dim Forest Ecological Survey 3
datamine:InfoDisplay_11080103_Text.text:
After bidding farewell to the Violuna Banyan, I proceeded towards the most important target—the Central Banyan.
It's a tree towering into the sky, with a large spore cloud perched at the top, spreading toxic spores with the wind.
Any creature approaching this tree exhibited obvious anxiety and fear—the white toxic spores floated around the Central Banyan, almost blocking out my sight. I could even hear faint coughing from the forest. I needed to take every step with extreme caution from now on.
The closer I got to the Central Banyan, the more uneasy I felt—there was a heavy snorting coming from its hollow, and the vibrations caused by breathing shook off the spores accumulated on the branches. As more and more spores fell down, I tightened my filter.
These creations of the Waveworn Phenomenon are infiltrating our world, making everything dangerous and unfamiliar.
datamine:InfoDisplay_11080103_Text.zh:
在告别了紫叶榕后，我向着最重要的目标——幽闭禁林，前进。
 那是一颗目测超过200m高的大树，任何人都能嗅到，这巨树身上发散出的，伟大冒险的气息。它的存在仿佛昭示着生命的无穷伟力，我和灯灯花都被其若午后艳阳一般的勃勃生机吸引，不自觉的雀跃欢呼。
 但越靠近这个大树，植物们的声音便越惴惴不安。就连脚下的浮萍都在发出异样的声响。
 我很少在无音区辐射范围外发现这种现象。找到这个现象的源头说不定就可以发现整个无光之森的树木，无论是幽闭禁林还是刚才的紫叶榕都这么巨大的原因。
 那还等什么，坐而言不如起而行，现在就出发！

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_530_3.zh: 虽然极少使用，但我知道一条自渊城取道至方擎西峰的旧路。

yakita:Flow_311000009_11.text: But even with this extra insurance, one can never be too careful when you're traveling through Whining Aix's Mire.
yakita:Flow_311000009_11.zh: 但无论装备多么齐全，在怨鸟泽送包裹啊，还是得处处留心。
yakita:Flow_311000009_11.speaker: Yunyan

yakita:Flow_311000009_13.text: Yeah. It's a must-have when delivering packages in Whining Aix's Mire.
yakita:Flow_311000009_13.zh: 是呀，在怨鸟泽送包裹，可不能没有除湿剂哦。

yakita:Flow_311000009_6.text: Especially when your package has to travel through a timid, foggy swamp here in Whining Aix's Mire.
yakita:Flow_311000009_6.zh: 特别是……在怨鸟泽这样潮湿多雾的环境里。
yakita:Flow_311000009_6.speaker: Yunyan

yakita:InfoDisplay_102801003_Text.text: This authentic photograph might hint at a clue of treasures hidden around Whining Aix's Mire.
yakita:InfoDisplay_102801003_Text.zh: 实拍照片上似乎记录着藏在怨鸟泽地区的宝藏。

yakita:ItemInfo_42300030_BgDescription.text:
A plant native to Whining Aix's Mire. It symbolizes broken or concealed affection.
Affected by the continuous thundercloud weather of this place, this variant has a significantly shortened flowering period compared to its original species. A true pity, indeed.
yakita:ItemInfo_42300030_BgDescription.zh:
怨鸟泽的原生植物，其花语是破碎而隐晦的爱。
受当地持续的雷云气象影响，此种鸢尾花相比原种花期大大缩短，更是令人唏嘘不已。

yakita:ItemInfo_70060012_BgDescription.text: A photograph with blood stained on its back. Marks are made on the photo, indicating somewhere in the Whining Aix's Mire. Treasures might be found there.
yakita:ItemInfo_70060012_BgDescription.zh: 一张背面沾满了血迹的实拍照片，照片上面做了标记，似乎是在怨鸟泽地区的某个地方，或许在那里能够找到些什么宝藏。

yakita:Character_ZheZhi_53_2.text: Most of these paintings were sent to the Whining Aix's Mire.
yakita:Character_ZheZhi_53_2.zh: 这些画大多运到了怨鸟泽。

yakita:Flow_106800000_16.text: But the screams from Whining Aix's Mire do seem to be an interesting hook. Maybe I could incorporate that into my story...
yakita:Flow_106800000_16.zh: 书里提到的怨鸟泽的呜声，倒是个有趣的点。要是能讲成故事……

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_32_13.text: Because of the dangerous weather conditions in Whining Aix's Mire, it's been ages since anyone went there.
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_32_13.zh: 而由于怨鸟泽的异常气象，已经很久没有人踏足过那里了……
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_6_32_13.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:NPC_STHSD_15_3.text: The chorus from the Whining Aix's Mire rises in your mind, and your fingertips unconsciously tap out the rhythm...
yakita:NPC_STHSD_15_3.zh: 来自怨鸟泽的合鸣在脑海中浮现，你的指尖无意识地敲击着节奏……

yakita:POI_YNAQGS_2_6.text: Weather here in the Whining Aix's Mire isn't the kindest. The area is covered with fog most of the year, plus the frequent thunderstorms.
yakita:POI_YNAQGS_2_6.zh: 怨鸟泽这里环境恶劣，常年笼罩无法驱散的迷雾，还不时有伴有雷暴天气。

yakita:Side_DTMZ_28_9.text: According to those coordinates, I can say with confidence that this Stingray is the same ship that we salvaged near the harbor of the Whining Aix's Mire a few years prior.
yakita:Side_DTMZ_28_9.zh: 根据那些坐标信息，我可以确定这艘魔鬼鱼号，就是数年前我们在怨鸟泽地区港口附近打捞到的一艘沉船。

yakita:InfoDisplay_160000010_Text.text:
[…]

First one to take a sip of water picks up the tab!

[…]

A perfect fusion of the rustic charm of Whisperwind Haven and the sophisticated taste of the Montelli Quarters.

[…]
yakita:InfoDisplay_160000010_Text.zh:
【今日饮料推荐】
通风井之夜：以陈酿作为基底，加入沁人心脾的草本植物提取物，一口就能让你从头凉到脚底，就像洗完冰水澡之后去通风井里吹风一样！
推荐指数：☆☆☆☆
燃油龙息：添加从码头货物中盗取的雀翎果汁，以及一勺真正的燃油，极致超绝辣度，硬核老饕的心头好！和朋友一起来挑战从食管灼烧到胃部的感觉吧，谁先喝水谁付钱！
推荐指数：☆☆☆
生化奇藏：用腌鱼和腌肉坛子里的汁液配置的饮料，闻起来和尝起来都一样糟糕。我也不知道为什么有人喜欢喝这个，但根据一封匿名信中提出的需求还是制作出来了……总之，很适合用来整蛊你的朋友！
推荐指数：☆，请寄信者尽快来买走所有已经配置好的成品，不然我就把这事告诉塔洛斯老大，她会查出来那封信是谁寄的。
金色时光特饮：用风滚牦奶油加蜜露果酒精心调制的特饮，拂风水畔风情的田园风味与莫塔里区高雅品味的完美结合体。也许有人会觉得这饮料不够有劲，但请相信我，你们一定会被它绵密的气泡和柔滑的口感所征服的。
推荐指数：☆☆☆☆☆

yakita:Guide_SMD_7_1.text: I've heard from the elders in town that at the end of Whisperwind Haven lies a mystical island, surrounded by a circular forest encasing a mirror-like lake.
yakita:Guide_SMD_7_1.zh: 说起来，我听镇里的老人讲过，拂风水畔的尽头有一座梦幻般的岛屿，圆环状的森林包围着一处镜湖。

yakita:LoadingTipsText_200004_TipsText.text: At the farthest reaches of Whisperwind Haven lies an island where a labyrinth of woods and ruins surrounds a central lake. It is spoken of in knight's tales, said to be the destination of their quests. To this day, the restless spirits of those who sought it wander the ancient paths of the grove.
yakita:LoadingTipsText_200004_TipsText.zh: 拂风水畔的尽头有一处岛屿，树林与遗迹构成了庞大的迷宫，簇拥着中央的湖泊。这里是无数骑士传闻所提及的终点。时至今日，仍有往昔的幻影在林迹中徘徊……

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_2_19.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_2_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_2_19.text:
To your surprise, the Order's "confessional" turns out to be a freight elevator. 
After leaving it behind, you arrive at Whisperwind Haven and meet Zani. Together, you set off to trace Gilberto.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_2_19.zh:
没想到，修会的忏悔室竟然是一间用以运送货物的电梯。 
从电梯出来后，你抵达了拂风水畔，在附近与赞妮汇合，继续寻找吉尔贝的去向。

yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_1.chapter: 剧情_2_0_黎那汐塔主线_第二幕上_35_1
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_1.text: That flower... looks like the petals we found in Whisperwind Haven.
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_1.zh: 那朵花……和之前在拂风水畔找到的花瓣很像。
yakita:Main_Linaxita_2_2_48_1.speaker: Zani

yakita:MapMark_133009_MarkDesc.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Whisperwind Haven area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"O, my beloved hometown, do flowers now blanket every corner of your fields?"
yakita:MapMark_133009_MarkDesc.zh: 拂风水畔地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “我那令人怀念的故乡，是否已有遍地的鲜花绽放？”

yakita:MapMark_133011_MarkDesc.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Whisperwind Haven area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"I'm a professional guard, sworn to protect my employer's safety!"
yakita:MapMark_133011_MarkDesc.zh: 拂风水畔地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “我是职业保安，保卫雇主平安！”

yakita:MapMark_133012_MarkDesc.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Whisperwind Haven area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"Its malevolent essence shattered and spread across the land, refusing to fade with the passage of time."
yakita:MapMark_133012_MarkDesc.zh: 拂风水畔地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “它的恶念在大地里分裂、滋生，丝毫没有随年岁的流逝而消散。”

yakita:MapMark_133013_MarkDesc.text:
A Dreamscape Node in the Whisperwind Haven area. Complete the challenge to claim Dream Samples and rewards.
"Only now do I realize that all my efforts were simply to protect an ordinary life."
yakita:MapMark_133013_MarkDesc.zh: 拂风水畔地区连通集域的梦境节点，完成挑战可收集梦境样本，获得奖励。 “这才知道我的全部努力，不过守护了普通的生活。”

yakita:RGZYYYGJZ_121_20.text: Go to Whisperwind Haven after dusk. I will inform Scarlet Velvet.
yakita:RGZYYYGJZ_121_20.zh: 黄昏之后，拂风水畔见吧。红丝绒那边，我会知会他们的。

yakita:XJXYDTK_22_5.chapter: 剧情_3.0拉海洛_学院中枢电梯生态_23_1
yakita:XJXYDTK_22_5.text: Heh... I hope to see you and your work at next year's World Expo.
yakita:XJXYDTK_22_5.zh: 呵……明年的“万国博览会”上，希望能再见到你和你的作品。

yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_15.text: You carry an exhausted and unconscious Wuli to a doctor to treat his injuries.
yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_15.zh: 将力竭昏睡的梧黎送去医馆，请医师处理了伤势。

yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_3.text: *cough*... Thank you. I'm okay now. Who are you? ... And Wuli, is he...
yakita:Character_ChangLi_21_3.zh: 咳……谢谢你，我没事，请问你们是……还有梧黎他……

yakita:Character_ChangLi_22_11.text: It must've appeared after Wuli entered the mountains.
yakita:Character_ChangLi_22_11.zh: 那它的出现一定晚于梧黎进山。

yakita:STNPC_RCGCST_29_3.text: That guy Wuli? He was already waiting at the pickup window before dawn even broke!
yakita:STNPC_RCGCST_29_3.zh: 那位叫梧黎的男生，早上天还没亮就来取药处排队了！

yakita:AVG_HAOGANDU_60_23.chapter: 剧情_3.8索拉学院_非邀约角色好感度文本_6_1
yakita:AVG_HAOGANDU_60_23.text: No. Every Student Council member is an owner of this Lodge.
yakita:AVG_HAOGANDU_60_23.zh: 不，理事会的每一个成员，都是这间屋子的主人。
yakita:AVG_HAOGANDU_60_23.speaker: Xiangli Yao

yakita:EVENT_AVGmain_330_4.text: A hundred years have passed through this campus, and left behind so much worth cherishing.
yakita:EVENT_AVGmain_330_4.zh: 整整一百年的时光，让这座校园留下了太多珍贵的过往。
yakita:EVENT_AVGmain_330_4.speaker: Xiangli Yao

yakita:EVENT_AVGstudentCouncil_10_15.chapter: 剧情_3.8索拉学院_理事会阵营分线剧情_1_10
yakita:EVENT_AVGstudentCouncil_10_15.text: I agree. Summer is supposed to be a break. For many students, doing a little homework at home is far more relaxing than coming here to study every day.
yakita:EVENT_AVGstudentCouncil_10_15.zh: 我赞成。暑假本就是休息时间，对于很多学生来说，与其每天来学院复习，还不如留在家里自己写写作业更轻松自在。
yakita:EVENT_AVGstudentCouncil_10_15.speaker: Xiangli Yao

yakita:Flow_139700000_709.text: After the consciousness space fades, you and Xiangli Yao return to reality.
yakita:Flow_139700000_709.zh: 意识空间逐渐剥离，你与相里要回到了现实

yakita:Flow_6700003_1.chapter: 剧情_1.2追月节领体力对话_1_1
yakita:Flow_6700003_1.text: Message from Xiangli Yao: The Moonlit Fair is nearing. I hope these can be of help to your preparation.
yakita:Flow_6700003_1.zh: 来自相里要的留言：离宵月会的时间越来越近了，我准备了这些东西，希望能够帮上你。

yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_8_13.chapter: 剧情_新主线_CE版_第一章_第二幕_安此亿兆生_2_3
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_8_13.text: What do you mean by "second only to Xiangli Yao"?
yakita:Huanglong_main_1_2_8_13.zh: 为什么要“除了相里要之外”？

yakita:Side_WYLY_1_69.chapter: 剧情_V1.2追月节_与相里要约会_1_1
yakita:Side_WYLY_1_69.text: As the caretaker of Moontree Lodge, and as Xiangli Yao...
yakita:Side_WYLY_1_69.zh: 无论是出于继承月树屋的使命，还是我个人的意愿……
yakita:Side_WYLY_1_69.speaker: Xiangli Yao

yakita:XDQY_2_1.text: It's been so long since you last heard Xiangli Yao's voice.
yakita:XDQY_2_1.zh: 说话的正是许久不见的相里要。

yakita:zhuiyuejie_first_10_98.text: Xiangli Yao pulls out a tablet showing you four indecipherable files.
yakita:zhuiyuejie_first_10_98.zh: 相里要调出电子屏，向你展示了四份无法阅读的文件。

yakita:zhuiyuejie_first_21_73.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_V1.2追月节主线明线_15_1
yakita:zhuiyuejie_first_21_73.text: After collecting the necessary data, Xiang-LEE suddenly speaks in Xiangli Yao's voice. It turns out Xiangli Yao is remotely controlling Xiang-LEE to assist you in uncovering Shifan's true desire.
yakita:zhuiyuejie_first_21_73.zh: 完成声骸数据收集后，相里的声音突然变成了相里要，相里要解释着接下来他会远程操控相里与你同行，了解十番真实的心声。

yakita:zhuiyuejie_first_32_17.text: One by one, the Rangers share their stories of Xiuyuan with Mrs. Heying, as you and Xiangli Yao stand quietly listening on.
yakita:zhuiyuejie_first_32_17.zh: 不知不觉，你和相里要默契地将空间留给了他们，夜归战士向禾盈分享着修远留下的故事。

yakita:zhuiyuejie_first_9_29.text: Xiangli Yao, a pleasure to meet you. I regret that I was away during your first visit to the Academy, but I'm glad to finally have the chance to meet you.
yakita:zhuiyuejie_first_9_29.zh: ——我叫相里要，很高兴见到你。当初你造访研究院时我恰好不在，直到今天才有机会和你见面。
yakita:zhuiyuejie_first_9_29.speaker: Xiangli Yao

yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_12_9.text: Xiangli Yao? Geez... You're Mrs. Xiangli Yan's son!
yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_12_9.zh: 相里要不就是……那个相里衍阿姨的儿子！

yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_25_13.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_V1.2追月节主线暗线_1_40
yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_25_13.text: You uncover Xiangli Yao's connection with the Moontree Lodge and continue exploring to reveal the hidden truth.
yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_25_13.zh: 你们发现了相里要与月树屋间的联系，为了解真相，你们决定继续前进。

yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_26_3.text: Well, we have Pascar and Xiangli Yao to thank.
yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_26_3.zh: 都是多亏了帕斯卡还有相里要啊。

yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_31_4.text: We need Xiangli Yao... Pascar, where is Xiangli Yao? Where the hell is he!
yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_31_4.zh: 相里要……帕斯卡，相里要呢！他人呢！

yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_35_4.text: Where is Xiangli Yao?! You're nobody compared to him, Pascar!
yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_35_4.zh: 相里要！相里要呢！帕斯卡，你根本不行!

yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_43_7.text: You all despise me, thinking I'll never surpass Xiangli Yao, right?
yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_43_7.zh: 我知道了，你们一定是觉得我超越不了相里要！

yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_51_2.text: Pascar, it's me, Xiangli Yao. Do you recognize me?
yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_51_2.speaker: Xiangli Yao

yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_52_13.chapter: 跳过总结_剧情_V1.2追月节主线明线（第二周）_4_5
yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_52_13.text: Back in the real world, Xiangli Yao needs to check on Patty's condition and suggests meeting up later. You decide to spend time at Taoyuan Vale.
yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_52_13.zh: 从索诺拉出来后，相里要还需要确认一下小帕的状况，你决定去山下逛逛再与他汇合。

yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_54_36.chapter: 剧情_V1.2追月节主线明线（第二周）_4_7
yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_54_36.text: Have you seen Xiangli Yao's room? It's a perfect example of "order out of disorder." I learned it from the genius.
yakita:zhuiyuejie_second_54_36.zh: 懂不懂，我这叫乱中有序。再说相里要的房间不也这样嘛，这说明什么？说明天才啊，大抵是如此。

yakita:NPC_HZ_6_1.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_44_7
yakita:NPC_HZ_6_1.text: Zhichun is still little. It's natural for her to be scared of strangers.
yakita:NPC_HZ_6_1.zh: 稚春年纪小，看到生人觉得紧张也正常。
yakita:NPC_HZ_6_1.speaker: Xiangyi

yakita:NPC_HZ_105_16.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_33_1
yakita:NPC_HZ_105_16.text: Letting Xinyi take over was the smartest move I've ever made.
yakita:NPC_HZ_105_16.zh: 让辛夷做掌事人，是老头子我这辈子做过最明智的决定咯。

yakita:NPC_HZ_90_5.chapter: 剧情_1_1_乘宵山虹镇生态_NPC_虹镇内_56_1
yakita:NPC_HZ_90_5.text: Things were dire at the time. It was inevitable that people would get hurt even with the Magistrate and Lady Xinyi holding down the fort.
yakita:NPC_HZ_90_5.zh: 当时情况急， 即便有令尹和辛夷大人护着，大伙也难免磕着碰着受点伤。

yakita:Side_XLSTJCZZ_1_12.chapter: 剧情_玩法_修理生态监测装置_1_1
yakita:Side_XLSTJCZZ_1_12.text: Oh, this is Patroller Xinyi. She's assisting me in identifying the issue.
yakita:Side_XLSTJCZZ_1_12.zh: 这位是心宜巡尉，正在帮我想办法解决问题。
yakita:Side_XLSTJCZZ_1_12.speaker: Xiyue

yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_140_14.text: My name is Xinyi. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_140_14.speaker: Xinyi

yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_40.text: Xinyi places the Cipher Key onto the Keyforge.
yakita:Chengxiaoshan_main_1_1_272_40.zh: 辛夷携心核来到控制机枢近旁，并将心核置于机枢之上。

yakita:Guide_CLLJ_1_13.chapter: 剧情_活动_1.1历程记忆手册_1_1
yakita:Guide_CLLJ_1_13.text: You remind me of Xinyi the first time I saw her.
yakita:Guide_CLLJ_1_13.zh: 因为我看到你，就想起从前第一次看到辛夷的时候。

yakita:Guide_CLLJ_1_46.chapter: 剧情_活动_1.1历程记忆手册_1_1
yakita:Guide_CLLJ_1_46.text: When I handed over the position to Xinyi, I gave this scale to her as well.
yakita:Guide_CLLJ_1_46.zh: 在刚刚把掌事之位交给辛夷的时候，我把这鳞片也交给了她。

yakita:Side_CFYW_3_13.chapter: 剧情_1_1_支线_乘霄山灵异事件_5_1
yakita:Side_CFYW_3_13.text: Madam Xinyi…? So, she heard the rumor too? Not surprising, she always takes everything here seriously.
yakita:Side_CFYW_3_13.zh: 辛夷大人……？想不到这件事都传到她耳朵里了。不，也难怪。她一向对镇上的事无比关心。

yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_90_1.text: Our reinforcements sent to Xuanfang Hold have reported in.
yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_90_1.zh: 咱们派去玄方城的支援部队有消息了。

yakita:GNNPC_TGBST_31_9.text: Watcher Yangyang being reassigned to Xuanfang Hold has been one of the few pieces of good news these days. Folks all wanted to thank her in person.
yakita:GNNPC_TGBST_31_9.zh: 秧秧骑使调任玄方城的事算是这些天为数不多的好消息，有不少人想去当面答谢她。

yakita:XLCSYJST_17_1.text: If you want to go to Xuanfang Hold, you can go alone.
yakita:XLCSYJST_17_1.zh: 你想去玄方城，你就自己去。

yakita:XLCSYJST_18_7.text: Let's say today I'm scared, so I run off to Xuanfang Hold. And after I'm there, I get scared again. Then what? Run off to the next place?
yakita:XLCSYJST_18_7.zh: 今天怕了，跑去玄方城。未来在玄方城怕了，咱们又能跑去哪儿呢？

yakita:XLCSYJST_34_2.text: As for Yangyang... I hear she'll join the Xuan Watchers over at Xuanfang Hold.
yakita:XLCSYJST_34_2.zh: 至于秧秧姑娘……我听说，她要当玄方城的后玄骑使了。

yakita:XLCSYJST_35_2.text: As for Yangyang, I hear she'll join the Xuan Watchers of Xuanfang Hold.
yakita:XLCSYJST_35_2.zh: 至于秧秧姑娘，我听说，她要当玄方城的后玄骑使了。

yakita:XLCSYJST_5_1.text: C'mon, Wuqing! Tell me all about the battle at Xuanfang Hold!
yakita:XLCSYJST_5_1.zh: 哥！你快和我说说之前守城战的事嘛！

yakita:ZYHSGST_16_20.text: Ahem! Maintenance duty for Xuanfang Hold, of course...
yakita:ZYHSGST_16_20.zh: 咳，自然是肩负维护玄方城的工作……

yakita:LoadingTipsText_925101_TipsText.text: Meanwhile, on the other side of Xuanfang Hold...
yakita:LoadingTipsText_925101_TipsText.zh: 与此同时，玄方城的另一侧……

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_280_16.text: We have to get word back... to Xuanfang Hold...
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_280_16.zh: 我们得……把消息……带到玄方城——

yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_297_4.text: Xiaoyi, pack your things. We're going to Xuanfang Hold.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_SYYLFML_297_4.zh: 小翼，收拾收拾东西，我们要到玄方城去了。

yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_313_21.text: Xuanfang Hold... It's like... we're in the past again.
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_313_21.zh: 这里是玄方城……似乎……我们又回到了过去。
yakita:Main_HuangLong_XLZHDLY_313_21.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_4.text: A pleasure. Welcome to Xuanfang Hold—or rather, to the Cloud Shuttle.
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_270_4.zh: 初次见面，欢迎来到我们的玄方城，或者说，云梭。

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_47.chapter: 剧情_3_6_神宫幻境_地境接舷战_80_1
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_47.text: Simulating... Xuanfang Hold... Reconstructing... Future possibilities converged...
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_6_550_47.zh: 推演……玄方……重塑……可能性已收束……

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_193_5.text: You do realize that the faster Xuanfang Hold is completed... the sooner you—
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_193_5.zh: 你们应该知道，玄方城的进度越是提前，你们……

yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_38_1.text: Behind us stands Xuanfang Hold! No retreat! We fight!
yakita:Main_Mengzhou_3_7_38_1.zh: 身后便是玄方城！无路可退！唯有一战！

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_9_4.text: Yes. My work here in Xuanfang is done. I will miss this place... but I was only assigned here temporarily. I cannot stay forever.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_9_4.zh: 嗯，玄方城的事情也已经告一段落了。虽然有些舍不得……但毕竟是借调，不能一直在这里待下去。

yakita:POI_WSJL_48_1.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_机关宅邸危行支线_17_1
yakita:POI_WSJL_48_1.text: Xuanfang Hold... I'd really love to see it for myself...
yakita:POI_WSJL_48_1.zh: 玄方城……真想亲眼看看啊……

yakita:STNPC_RCGCST_1_2.text: So Xuanfang Hold even has self-service shops. How convenient!
yakita:STNPC_RCGCST_1_2.zh: 原来玄方城里还有自助商店，真是方便啊！

yakita:ST_XFDJGNNPC_44_1.text: Welcome to Yuan's Flavors, Xuanfang Hold branch!
yakita:ST_XFDJGNNPC_44_1.zh: 欢迎来到「渊中鲜」的玄方城分店！

yakita:Side_BGJSY_150_3.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_历程记忆手册_不改旧时影_19_1
yakita:Side_BGJSY_150_3.text: So this is Xuanfang Hold's Autopuppet... Its structure is remarkably intricate...
yakita:Side_BGJSY_150_3.zh: 这就是玄方城的机傀……构造真是精细……

yakita:Side_DESLGYMZ_36_10.chapter: 剧情_活动_找BUG二期_新年别墅_36_1
yakita:Side_DESLGYMZ_36_10.text: It doesn't fit the whole Xuanfang Hold setting.

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_36_4.text: The one you all look to for guidance... in Xuanfang Hold?
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_36_4.speaker: Xuanqing

yakita:Side_QZFZZFHXM_18_1.text: Interested in contributing to Xuanfang Hold's revitalization?
yakita:Side_QZFZZFHXM_18_1.zh: 您要为复兴玄方城出一份力吗？

yakita:Side_QZFZZFHXM_33_24.text: Your fate now rests with the authorities of Xuanfang Hold.

yakita:XFCSYJST_8_3.text: Quality guaranteed! Everyone in Xuanfang Hold knows my name.
yakita:XFCSYJST_8_3.zh: 我的货，质量有保证，整个玄方城也是有口碑的。

yakita:YBWH_97_11.chapter: 剧情_3_5_每日_华胥院找药材_25_2
yakita:YBWH_97_11.text: A token of gratitude from the patients of Xuanfang Hold.

yakita:YBWP_10_10.text: Something big happened in Xuanfang Hold just recently, after all.
yakita:YBWP_10_10.zh: 毕竟玄方城这阵子刚经历了变故。

yakita:StJCFYLQ_4_6.chapter: 剧情_3.5玄方_军策府和园林区配音生态_5_1
yakita:StJCFYLQ_4_6.text: I see. You Wardens do treat people with sincerity. I'll take your advice.
yakita:StJCFYLQ_4_6.zh: 好，诸位定玄卫果真诚义待人，既如此，我便依你之言。

yakita:XLCSYJST_35_5.text: If you ask me, Yangyang is an envoy of the legendary Xuanling Bird!
yakita:XLCSYJST_35_5.zh: 要我说啊，秧秧姑娘肯定是传说中玄翎雀的使者！

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_16_1.text:
This good and pious girl vows three days without meat, if only Yuecheng will try the chili rice cake! —Xuanqing
Then what was that Fish in Vinegar you came by for two nights ago? —Yuecheng
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_16_1.zh:
善女愿三日不吃肉，换樾成哥尝试剁椒粘糕！——璇情
那你前晚来买的醋鲙算什么？——樾成

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_18_1.text: Excuse me, miss! Are you here to play with Sister Xuanqing too?
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_18_1.zh: 大姐姐，你也是来找璇情姐姐玩的么？

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_281_3.text: Tell me, Xuanqing. What do you think a single mortal body can accomplish against all of this?
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_281_3.zh: 璇情，你凭一介凡人之躯，又能做什么？

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_34_13.text: As for Xuanqing... I will bring her back myself.
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_34_13.zh: 至于璇情……我自会领她回来。

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_38_10.text: Waaah! I'm sorry, I shouldn't have, Sister Xuanqing—
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_38_10.zh: 呜、呜啊！我错了，我错了璇情姐姐——

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_493_2.text: Where's that girl Xuanqing...? I don't see her anywhere...
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_493_2.zh: 怎么没看到璇情那孩子呢……

yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_51_9.text: How about you try again? I want to hear you say "Sister Xuanqing"—
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_51_9.zh: 比如，听你喊我一声“璇情姐姐”——
yakita:Side_FSCHPOI_51_9.speaker: Xuanqing

yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_14_1.text: You know, the new Watcher Yangyang was truly something else out there on the battlefield.
yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH2_14_1.zh: 说起来，秧秧骑使在战场上真是太可靠了啊。

yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH_81_4.text: Don't worry. We have Ms. Yangyang and all the soldiers keeping watch. We'll be fine.
yakita:GNNPC_QXJRSPH_81_4.zh: 嗯，放心去吧。外面有秧秧姑娘和众多的将士们在，我们不会有事的。

yakita:GNNPC_TGBST_121_1.text: Ah, you're the young {Male=man;Female=lady} who was with Watcher Yangyang. Please give her my regards.
yakita:GNNPC_TGBST_121_1.zh: 啊，你是和秧秧骑使在一起的那位年轻人，请替我向她问个好吧。

yakita:GNNPC_TGBST_121_2.text: I thought I wasn't going to make it through the last incident, and had Yangyang send a letter home for me.
yakita:GNNPC_TGBST_121_2.zh: 我曾以为自己活不过之前的那场变故了，托秧秧骑使给家里人寄过信。

yakita:GNNPC_TGBST_31_1.text: Hmm? You're the hero who fought alongside Watcher Yangyang during the defense of the Hold.
yakita:GNNPC_TGBST_31_1.zh: 咦，你是那位在守城战里和秧秧骑使并肩作战的英雄？

yakita:XLCSYJST_35_4.text: It's just... The way Yangyang changed on the battlefield...
yakita:XLCSYJST_35_4.zh: 只是，秧秧姑娘在战场上的变化……

yakita:YangYang_Shengtai_10_13.text: Mm. I hope you never lose sight of yours, either. That wish you have always carried, the one that matters most.
yakita:YangYang_Shengtai_10_13.zh: 嗯，我也希望，你也能一直保持着你那个，最初的愿望。
yakita:YangYang_Shengtai_10_13.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_1_2.chapter: 剧情_3.5主线第一幕上生态_2_1
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_1_2.text: Ha... Easy for you to say. What if something does happen to her and Yangyang...?
yakita:ZXSTSPH_YYZX_1_2.zh: 唉……说得轻巧，小芳秧秧但凡有个三长两短……

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_5_1.text: Miss Yangyang, for your safety, please keep your distance.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_5_1.zh: 秧秧小姐，为了安全，也请你与他保持一定的距离。

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_17.text: It seems he's had dealings with Bloom Bearers before. He was asking about them everywhere in the Hold. That's why I reached out to you.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_17.zh: 他似乎和执花打过交道，进城后见人就打听执花们的下落，所以我才找到你。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_17.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_30.text: I have things handled here. You should go ahead and look into it.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_30.zh: 这边的事情有我处理，你就放心去调查吧。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_30.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_34.text: I'm glad to help. But remember, you're just one person. Please be careful, and contact me if you run into anything unexpected.
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_34.zh: 能帮上你就好。但一个人的话，请小心行事，有什么意外请随时联系我。
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_34.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_45.text: And he heard voices in his head, just like what you saw just now...
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_45.zh: 有些声音一直在他脑袋里回响，就像刚刚那样……
yakita:Main_YYMRDHS_6_45.speaker: Yangyang

yakita:Flow_11000001_492.text: Tell you what, Mister Yuanwu's got really awesome boxing moves!
yakita:Flow_11000001_492.zh: 诶我跟你说，渊武叔真的很厉害！
yakita:Flow_11000001_492.speaker: Yeye

yakita:Flow_11000001_493.text: He joined the Rangers after I got older, so I went ahead to take boxing lessons from Mister Yuanwu, and he'd offer me Trine Tea after each session. Man, boxing really gets your body going!
yakita:Flow_11000001_493.zh: 后来哥哥去参军了，我就跟着渊武叔练拳，练完拳就喝三清茶。每天练上几套拳，身体倍儿棒！
yakita:Flow_11000001_493.speaker: Yeye

yakita:ZXHYLST_4_8.text: You and Yinlin trade news of her recent days, and the hours pass in easy company...
yakita:ZXHYLST_4_8.zh: 你和吟霖聊起了她近来的经历，度过了一段平稳的时光……

datamine:InfoDisplay_101400008_Text.title: Hastily Written Research Note
datamine:InfoDisplay_101400008_Text.text:
Close... So close... 
Almost there. Almost.
My own memories failed me, and Yinlin is no longer an option. 
I've spent over a decade on these two puppets. I live for finishing this project.
I'll do whatever it takes, even teaming up with those I once despised. 
Sacrifices will be made. I will see it through, no matter what.
datamine:InfoDisplay_101400008_Text.zh:
还差一步……还差最后一点……
我能感觉到已经触碰到了成功的边缘。
但……无论我怎么尝试，就是没有办法使用我自己的记忆来制作人偶。
吟霖也已经指望不上了……
花了十数年的时间不断研究，我所做的一切都是为了完成这两个人偶。
我一定要破解这个难题，就算不得不和那帮人合作……就算不得不牺牲掉一切可以牺牲的东西。

yakita:Character_YinLin_10_18.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_吟霖线新_87_1
yakita:Character_YinLin_10_18.text: The name's Yinlin. I am also a Patroller… Here's my ID.
yakita:Character_YinLin_10_18.zh: 我叫吟霖，也是一名巡尉……这是我的证件。

yakita:Character_YinLin_11_46.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_吟霖线新_69_1
yakita:Character_YinLin_11_46.text: Yinlin reactivates the puppet. It turns back into Yuanyuan's form.
yakita:Character_YinLin_11_46.zh: 吟霖唤醒了人偶，人偶再次变成了小女孩媛媛的样子。

yakita:Character_YinLin_37_9.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_吟霖线新_83_1
yakita:Character_YinLin_37_9.text: Why you insolent little whippersnapper. Show some manners when you're talking to Miss Yinlin.
yakita:Character_YinLin_37_9.zh: 你这年轻人怎么这么没有礼貌，和吟霖小姐说话要客气点。

yakita:Character_YinLin_39_5.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_吟霖线新_25_1
yakita:Character_YinLin_39_5.text: Thanks for asking, Miss Yinlin. I'm feeling a lot better now.
yakita:Character_YinLin_39_5.zh: 谢谢吟霖小姐的关心，我已经好很多了。

yakita:Character_YinLin_59_15.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_吟霖线新_94_1
yakita:Character_YinLin_59_15.text: Yinlin heads off to retrieve some medicine from Dr. Wu Sheng.
yakita:Character_YinLin_59_15.zh: 吟霖暂时离开这里，去向吴盛医生拿取伤药。

yakita:Character_YinLin_75_1.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_吟霖线新_102_1
yakita:Character_YinLin_75_1.text: After a while, Yinlin came back with some first-aid supplies to treat Quxiu's wounds.
yakita:Character_YinLin_75_1.zh: 稍等了一会，吟霖便带着伤药回来，替曲秀的伤口做了简单的处理。

yakita:Character_YinLin_87_2.chapter: 剧情_剧情_角色_吟霖线新_107_2
yakita:Character_YinLin_87_2.text: No, Miss Yinlin. My body is fully functional.

yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_28_1.chapter: 剧情_1_4_角色梦境副本_吟霖_1_1
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_28_1.text: Yinlin, do you copy? Got an emergency for you to handle.
yakita:Event_AYKXBRZM_28_1.zh: 吟霖，有一个紧急任务必须马上去做。

yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_13_10.text: In no time, Ganxue locates the puppets Yinlin needs and brings them to you.
yakita:Event_THCQDYBF_13_10.zh: 甘雪很快找到了吟霖所需要的人偶，并将它们交给了吟霖。

yakita:Event_WWPDJSBF_4_12.chapter: 剧情_春节活动角色邀约_吟霖_1_1
yakita:Event_WWPDJSBF_4_12.text: Besides, like I said, I'm not here on assignment. I'm simply "Yinlin," on vacation.
yakita:Event_WWPDJSBF_4_12.zh: 而且，我刚才说过了，我此行并不是为了任务而来。其实，我只是以“吟霖”的身份，来这里休假的。
yakita:Event_WWPDJSBF_4_12.speaker: Yinlin

yakita:Flow_31000188_572.chapter: 剧情_角色_吟霖线_副本临时_6_3
yakita:Flow_31000188_572.text: Yinlin ties you up again before activating the switch to the inner chamber.
yakita:Flow_31000188_572.zh: 吟霖再次用异能将我拘束起来以免暴露，然后启动了打开暗室的机关。
