yakita:FavorGoods_110601_Content.text:
A booklet Youhu always carries to jot down her favorite poems and snippets of inspiration for her limericks. 
 
They say to record all your ideas—you never know when they'll come in handy. That's exactly what Youhu does every day, capturing every clever thought, whether for antique appraisals or an occasion that calls for a witty poem. It's her way of keeping her mind sharp. 
 
But of course, this is her little secret, so let's keep it between us, hm?
yakita:FavorGoods_110601_Content.zh:
釉瑚随身携带的小册子，记录着她的打油诗的灵感痕迹与好诗精选。
书到用时方恨少，点子也一样！正所谓台上一分钟，台下十年功……为了将那些经她鉴定的古物用有趣的方式记下来，也为了能在恰到好处的时候摇头晃脑吟诗一首，日常的积累是必不可少的。
当然，这就是釉瑚不足为外人道的秘密了。

yakita:FavorStory_110604_Content.text:
[…]

History?

[…]

However, Youhu has a different approach.

[…]

The courage to sacrifice.

[…]
yakita:FavorStory_110604_Content.zh:
那些被港口奉为座上宾的鉴宝大师，总在讨论古物的定价。
他们先贬低古物的价值，用最低的价格购入；再极力吹捧，好卖出最高的价格。制作工艺与历史沉淀，都只是价格的添头。
但釉瑚的定价体系里，能够支付古物价值的并不只有货币。为她构造出这个体系的种种事物，也迥然不同。
比如，真实流动的情感。
釉瑚喜欢促成心意相通的交易，买家对古物未敢有一丝怠慢，卖家如遇知己，将珍视的藏品托付给对方。古物与货币在双方手中流动，而古物回响的频率，则同时沉淀在两个人心中。
比如，被献祭的良知。
釉瑚七岁那年，掠宝者入侵港口。他们为掠夺财富而来，古物，只是一种财富。
无论是曾斥巨资购入古物的富商，还是港口的鉴宝师，大多毫不犹豫地抛下“身外之物”逃难去了。
掠宝者不了解古物的一切，却依然振振有词：反正这片羸弱的土地无法保护自己的珍宝，还不如由他们送到更懂欣赏的地方去。
比如，付出自己的一切。
也有人选择了留在被暴乱侵蚀的港口，他们深知古物的价值，毅然直面掠宝者的屠刀，为守护身后的古物，伫立到最后一刻。
如今，轮到釉瑚为古物付出一些什么了，可以是自己与生俱来的鉴宝天赋，是自己日积月累的知识，是自己跋山涉险的追讨。
曾经，那些不懂欣赏与珍视的人，践踏了古物的价值。而她要做的，便是让那些飘零四海的古物，一件一件，回到原本的土地上。

yakita:FavorWord_110606_Content.text: I am Master Youhu, the best antique appraiser ever! Needless to say my favorite is antiques of all kinds. Some say I talk too much, but hey, if they brought me cool stuff, I'd zip it real quick. No lie.
yakita:FavorWord_110606_Content.zh: 我可是鉴宝大师釉瑚，最喜爱的自然是形形色色的古物。听说总有人嫌我聒噪，哼哼，呈上几件俏货给我把玩把玩，我不就安静啦。
yakita:FavorWord_110606_Content.speaker: Youhu

yakita:FavorWord_110622_Content.text: Time may deceive, but wisdom takes hold. Here comes Master Youhu, the great antique appraiser!
yakita:FavorWord_110622_Content.zh: 鉴宝如破迷魂阵，细观岁月辨伪真，鉴宝大师釉瑚是也！
yakita:FavorWord_110622_Content.speaker: Youhu

yakita:FavorWord_110630_Content.text: As per Master Youhu's professional opinion, I am invincible now! Those who don't appreciate antiques shall tremble before me!
yakita:FavorWord_110630_Content.zh: 经我鉴定，我现在所向披靡无人能敌！颤抖吧，那群不珍惜古物的家伙——
yakita:FavorWord_110630_Content.speaker: Youhu

yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_17_39.text: You hand over the card Youhu gave you to the peculiar robot.
yakita:Heihaian_main_1_3_17_39.zh: 将釉瑚给自己的卡片交给了面前奇特的机器人……

yakita:Flow_11000001_116.text: That's right. I've been learning boxing from Mister Yuanwu lately. I've got enough skills to protect Grandma against anything!
yakita:Flow_11000001_116.zh: 嗯嗯，我平时都跟着渊武叔练拳呢，现在已经有能力保护奶奶了！

yakita:Side_XYHTZST_52_2.text: Mr. Yuanwu, could you teach me some tricks for walking on these Plum Blossom Poles?
yakita:Side_XYHTZST_52_2.zh: 渊武叔，这梅花桩有什么诀窍吗？

yakita:ItemInfo_80001008_BgDescription.text: The Sanqing tea from Yuanwu Boxing Gym has healing properties, aiding the spleen, lungs, and alleviating worries. A cup after a boxing session boosts blood flow and circulation while soothing the mind. The perfect combination of exercise and tea brings a sense of inner peace, momentarily freeing one from mundane concerns and desires.
yakita:ItemInfo_80001008_BgDescription.zh:
渊武拳馆特供的三清茶，清脾，清肺，清烦恼。
练完拳后来上一杯，可以活血化瘀，修生养气。
一套拳，一杯茶，一股由内而外的放松感笼罩全身，得以让人暂时忘却那些世俗的算计与追赶。

yakita:Term850114_Desc.text: A unique martial art practiced by Yuanwu, known for its heavy and fierce strikes. However, only those who temper their strength with precise control can wield it without breaking themselves.
yakita:Term850114_Desc.zh: 渊武的独家拳术，拳风刚猛狠戾，但若想打得长久，又讲求收放自如。

yakita:FavorGoods_130302_Content.text:
The secret of Leihuangquan lies in the good control of power and balancing combat with mindful self-care. The deadlier the strike, the greater the devotion to health.
That's why Yuanwu always carries a flask with him during his daily activities. Some say it contains his secret potion for staying fit, but in reality, it's usually just ordinary hot water.
yakita:FavorGoods_130302_Content.zh:
雷煌拳讲究收放自如，力量循环之道。挥拳时有多刚猛，平日的保养就得有多悉心。
所以，拳馆的渊武老板经常随身携带着一个保温杯。
据说，这里面装着不可言说的养身秘诀……其实大多数时候，就是平平无奇的热水啦。

yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1303_Info.chapter: 渊武档案_共鸣能力鉴定报告
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1303_Info.text: Yuanwu owns a boxing gym where he teaches Leihuangquan and health management. He is well-respected in the community for his cordial demeanor and pleasant temperament.
yakita:FavorRoleInfo_1303_Info.zh: 拳馆老板渊武，精通雷煌拳和养生术，为人处世颇为温和，有一种物质精神双重富足的余裕感，深受街坊邻居欢迎。

yakita:FavorStory_130304_Content.text:
[…]

The standout feature that sets Yuanwu Boxing Gym apart from others is the emphasis on comfort.

[…]
yakita:FavorStory_130304_Content.zh:
渊武拳馆和别家最大的不同，就是练着舒坦。

按照渊武老板的指导，痛痛快快打上几场拳，末了擦一把汗，饮上一壶茶，别提有多舒坦了。
练灵巧的羡风拳，就喝墨菊茶提精神；练刚猛的雷煌拳，就喝凌霄茶补气力；练柔顺的三馥拳，就喝杜若茶养气血……渊武为不同拳路搭配了不同茶方，精心烹煮后趁热喝下，能放松因锻炼而酸胀的肌肉，舒经活络，抒气排瘀。

这些茶方都是由渊武亲自试出，再交由隔壁茶楼调制茶包，按期配送。说来也怪，隔壁茶楼生意兴旺，要订茶通常得提前数月预约，有时还会延期配送，可从来没有误过渊武的单。不仅不误，渊武还能随时下单，随时提货。难道真如传闻那般，渊武表面上是个喝茶撸猫晒太阳的普通老板，其实是个手握多家企业的大人物？那一壶难求的茶楼，也不过是他众多产业中的一处？

有好奇之人上门询问，渊武只是笑着递上一杯三清茶：“别想那些有的没的了，喝了提提神，多出汗，少发梦。”
一套拳，一杯茶，清新的香气浸润鼻腔，那些疑惑和焦虑都随着滴落的汗珠一起烟消云散了。至于渊武到底有没有钱，那些钱又是怎么赚来的，似乎没那么重要了。一股由内而外的放松感笼罩全身，得以让人暂时忘却那些世俗的算计与追赶。

这世上之物，多半都有张有弛，有急有缓。要是累了，就停下来喝一壶茶，好好休息够了再继续。

yakita:FavorWord_130317_Content.text: Hello. I am Yuanwu, and I run a boxing gym. It's not a big place, but we make sure every customer is treated with finesse. You're welcome to visit any time.
yakita:FavorWord_130317_Content.zh: 你好，我叫渊武，经营一家拳馆。店不算大，但每一个客人我都会用心对待。有空的话，欢迎过来坐坐。
yakita:FavorWord_130317_Content.speaker: Yuanwu

yakita:Flow_313700000_89.text: The aggressiveness vanishes instantly. The man removes his hat and apologizes to you. As he speaks, you are surprised to realize that Yuanwu is sober in this dream.
yakita:Flow_313700000_89.zh: 那股杀意烟消云散，摘下帽子的男子向你致歉，言语中，你发现渊武竟清醒于梦境。

yakita:Flow_313700000_92.text: As you watch him put away the cup, it comes to you that the tea is not just something in a dream, but Yuanwu's willpower, honed by years of meditation.
yakita:Flow_313700000_92.zh: 你看着他将茶杯收走，意识到这盏茶不仅仅是梦中之物，也是渊武千锤百炼的心境。

yakita:Side_BGJSY_70_11.chapter: 剧情_3_5_支线_历程记忆手册_不改旧时影_9_1
yakita:Side_BGJSY_70_11.text: Turns out... back then, both sides of the family were at odds. They didn't want my parents together. My father was young and hot-blooded, and he loved my mother dearly, so he cut ties with his family and ran off with her. They wandered for a while before finally settling down in Yuezhou.
yakita:Side_BGJSY_70_11.zh: 原来……当年我的爷爷与外公两家不和，他们不同意父亲母亲在一起，父亲年轻气盛，又很喜欢我母亲，于是他和家里断绝了关系，和我母亲出走，兜转了一些时日后，最后在越州定居了下来。

yakita:XFJCFST_24_6.text: Fine, when you pass through Yuezhou, make sure to stop by the inn in the southern district. My family runs it.
yakita:XFJCFST_24_6.zh: 行，那你路过越州的时候，记得去一趟城南的客栈。那是我家的产业。
